In accordance with 19 CFR 351.213(b), an interested party as defined by section 771(9) of the Act may request in writing that Commerce conduct an administrative review. For both AD and CVD reviews, the interested party must specify the individual producers or exporters covered by an AD finding or an AD or CVD order or suspension agreement for which it is requesting a review. In addition, a domestic interested party or an interested party described in section 771(9)(B) of the Act must state why it desires Commerce to review those particular producers or exporters. If the interested party intends for Commerce to review sales of merchandise by an exporter (or a producer if that producer also exports merchandise from other suppliers) which was produced in more than one country of origin and each country of origin is subject to a separate order, then the interested party must state specifically, on an order-by-order basis, which exporter(s) the request is intended to cover.
Note that, for any party Commerce was unable to locate in prior segments, Commerce will not accept a request for an administrative review of that party absent new information as to the party's location. Moreover, if the interested party who files a request for review is unable to locate the producer or exporter for which it requested the review, the interested party must provide an explanation of the attempts it made to locate the producer or exporter at the same time it files its request for review, in order for Commerce to determine if the interested party's attempts were reasonable, pursuant to 19 CFR 351.303(f)(3)(ii).
Commerce is instituting a new formatting request. Specifically, Commerce asks that requests for review of multiple companies also include an appendix listing, in alphabetical order, the company names for which a review is requested. The list should be limited solely to company names and formatted as a single column, with each company name identified on a separate line, except in the case of companies that Commerce previously determined should be collapsed into a single entity or found to be cross-owned with other companies. Companies that Commerce previously determined should be collapsed or found to be cross-owned with one another should be listed together as a group, on one line—or more, as needed, for the group—with the company names within each group listed alphabetically and separated by semicolons.
As explained in Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Proceedings: Assessment of Antidumping Duties,68 FR 23954 (June 6, 2003), and Non-Market Economy Antidumping Proceedings: Assessment of Antidumping Duties,76 FR 65694 (October 24, 2011), Commerce clarified its practice with respect to the collection of final antidumping duties on imports of merchandise where intermediate firms are involved. The public should be aware of this clarification in determining whether to request an administrative review of merchandise subject to AD findings and orders.[3]
Commerce no longer considers the non-market economy (NME) entity as an exporter conditionally subject to an AD administrative review.[4] Accordingly, the NME entity will not be under review unless Commerce specifically receives a request for, or self-initiates, a review of the NME entity.[5] In administrative reviews of AD orders on merchandise from NME countries where a review of the NME entity has not been initiated, but where an individual exporter for which a review was initiated does not qualify for a separate rate, Commerce will issue a final decision indicating that the company in question is part of the NME entity. However, in that situation, because no review of the NME entity was conducted, the NME entity's entries were not subject to the review and the rate for the NME entity is not subject to change as a result of that review (although the rate for the individual exporter may change as a function of the finding that the exporter is part of the NME entity). Following initiation of an AD administrative review when there is no review requested of the NME entity, Commerce will instruct CBP to liquidate entries for all exporters not named in the initiation notice, including those that were suspended at the NME entity rate.
All requests must be filed electronically in Enforcement and Compliance's Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Centralized Electronic Service System (ACCESS) on Enforcement and Compliance's ACCESS website at https://access.trade.gov.[6] Further, in accordance with 19 CFR 351.303(f)(l)(i), a copy of each request must be served on the petitioner and each exporter or producer specified in the request. Interested parties should note that Commerce has amended certain of its requirements pertaining to the service of documents in 19 CFR 351.303(f).[7]
Commerce will publish in the Federal Register a notice of “Initiation of Administrative Review of Antidumping or Countervailing Duty Order, Finding, or Suspended Investigation” for requests received by the last day of November 2026. If Commerce does not receive, by the last day of November2026, a request for review of entries covered by an order, finding, or suspended investigation listed in this notice and for the period identified above, Commerce will instruct CBP to assess antidumping or countervailing duties on those entries at a rate equal to the cash deposit of estimated antidumping or countervailing duties required on those entries at the time of entry, or withdrawal from warehouse, for consumption and to continue to collect the cash deposit previously ordered.
For the first administrative review of any order, there will be no assessment of antidumping or countervailing duties on entries of subject merchandise entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption during the relevant provisional-measures “gap” period of the order, if such a gap period is applicable to the period of review. ( printed page 68940)
Establishment of and Updates to the Annual Inquiry Service List
On September 20, 2021, Commerce published the final rule titled “ Regulations to Improve Administration and Enforcement of Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Laws ” in the Federal Register .[8] On September 27, 2021, Commerce also published the notice entitled “ Scope Ruling Application; Annual Inquiry Service List; and Informational Sessions ” in the Federal Register .[9] The Final Rule and Procedural Guidance provide that Commerce will maintain an annual inquiry service list for each order or suspended investigation, and any interested party submitting a scope ruling application or request for circumvention inquiry shall serve a copy of the application or request on the persons on the annual inquiry service list for that order, as well as any companion order covering the same merchandise from the same country of origin.[10]
In accordance with the Procedural Guidance, for orders published in the Federal Register before November 4, 2021, Commerce created an annual inquiry service list segment for each order and suspended investigation. Interested parties who wished to be added to the annual inquiry service list for an order submitted an entry of appearance to the annual inquiry service list segment for the order in ACCESS and, on November 4, 2021, Commerce finalized the initial annual inquiry service lists for each order and suspended investigation. Each annual inquiry service list has been saved as a public service list in ACCESS, under each case number, and under a specific segment type called “AISL—Annual Inquiry Service List.” [11]
As mentioned in the Procedural Guidance, beginning in January 2022, Commerce will update these annual inquiry service lists on an annual basis when the Opportunity Notice for the anniversary month of the order or suspended investigation is published in the Federal Register .[12] Accordingly, Commerce will update the annual inquiry service lists for the above-listed AD and CVD proceedings. All interested parties wishing to appear on the updated annual inquiry service list must take one of the two following actions: (1) new interested parties who did not previously submit an entry of appearance must submit a new entry of appearance at this time; (2) interested parties who were included in the preceding annual inquiry service list must submit an amended entry of appearance to be included in the next year's annual inquiry service list. For these interested parties, Commerce will change the entry of appearance status from “Active” to “Needs Amendment” for the annual inquiry service lists corresponding to the above-listed proceedings. This will allow those interested parties to make any necessary amendments and resubmit their entries of appearance. If no amendments need to be made, the interested party should indicate in the area on the ACCESS form requesting an explanation for the amendment that it is resubmitting its entry of appearance for inclusion in the annual inquiry service list for the following year. As mentioned in the Final Rule,[13] once the petitioners and foreign governments have submitted an entry of appearance for the first time, they will automatically be added to the updated annual inquiry service list each year.
Interested parties have 30 days after the date of this notice to submit new or amended entries of appearance. Commerce will then finalize the annual inquiry service lists five business days thereafter. For ease of administration, please note that Commerce requests that law firms with more than one attorney representing interested parties in a proceeding designate a lead attorney to be included on the annual inquiry service list.
Commerce may update an annual inquiry service list at any time as needed based on interested parties' amendments to their entries of appearance to remove or otherwise modify their list of members and representatives, or to update contact information. Any changes or announcements pertaining to these procedures will be posted to the ACCESS website at https://access.trade.gov.
Special Instructions for Petitioners and Foreign Governments
In the Final Rule, Commerce stated that, “after an initial request and placement on the annual inquiry service list, both petitioners and foreign governments will automatically be placed on the annual inquiry service list in the years that follow.” [14] Accordingly, as stated above and pursuant to 19 CFR 351.225(n)(3), the petitioners and foreign governments will not need to resubmit their entries of appearance each year to continue to be included on the annual inquiry service list. However, the petitioners and foreign governments are responsible for making amendments to their entries of appearance during the annual update to the annual inquiry service list in accordance with the procedures described above.
This notice is not required by statute but is published as a service to the international trading community.
Acting Deputy Assistant Secretary for Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Operations.

Upon Written Request, Copies Available From: Securities and Exchange Commission, Office of FOIA Services, 100 F Street NE, Washington, DC 20549-2736
Notice is hereby given that pursuant to the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995 (“PRA”) (44 U.S.C. 3501 et seq.), the Securities and Exchange Commission (“Commission”) is soliciting comments on the existing collection of information provided for in Rule 18a-5, under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (15 U.S.C. 78a et seq.). The Commission plans to submit this existing collection of information to the Office of Management and Budget (“OMB”) for extension and approval.
Rule 18a-5 enumerates the recordkeeping and reporting requirements for security-based swap dealers (“SBSDs”) and major security-based swap participants (“MSBSPs”). More specifically, Rule 18a-5 establishes recordkeeping requirements applicable to stand-alone SBSDs, stand-alone MSBSPs, bank SBSDs, and bank MSBSPs. Rule 18a-5 was modeled on Rule 17a-3 under the Exchange Act, which applies to broker-dealers, but Rule 18a-5 does not include a parallel requirement for every requirement in Rule 17a-3 because some of the requirements in Rule 17a-3 relate to activities that are not expected or permitted of SBSDs and MSBSPs. The collections of information under Rule 18a-5 include the following types of records that are required to be created: trade blotters, general ledger, ledgers for customers and non-customer accounts, stock record, memoranda of brokerage orders, memoranda of proprietary orders, confirmations, accountholder information, options positions, trial balances and computation of net capital, associated person's employment application, account equity and margin calculations under Rule 18a-3, possession or control requirements for security-based swap customers, customer reserve requirements for security-based swap customers, unverified transactions, political contributions, and compliance with business conduct requirements. The purpose of requiring stand-alone SBSDs, stand-alone MSBSPs, bank SBSDs, and bank MSBSPs to create the records specified in Rule 18a-5 is to enhance regulators' ability to protect investors. These records and the information contained therein are used by examiners and other representatives of the Commission to determine whether stand-alone SBSDs, stand-alone MSBSPs, bank SBSDs, and bank MSBSPs are in compliance with the Commission's anti-fraud and anti-manipulation rules, financial responsibility program, and other laws, rules, and regulations.
Not all types of records enumerated in Rule 18a-5 are required to be made by each of the entities to which Rule 18a-5 applies. For example, Rule 18a-5 requires thirteen types of records to be made and kept current by stand-alone ( printed page 69018) SBSDs and stand-alone MSBSPs.[1] Rule 18a-5 also requires three types of records to be made and kept current by stand-alone SBSDs.[2] Rule 18a-5 requires 10 types of records to be made and kept current by bank SBSDs and bank MSBSPs, all of which are limited to the firm's business as an SBSD or MSBSP.[3] Further, Rule 18a-5 includes paragraphs (b)(9), (b)(10), and (b)(12) which requires bank SBSDs to make and keep current various records for security-based swaps.[4]
As of September 24, 2026, there are 15 stand-alone SBSDs, zero stand-alone MSBSPs, 29 bank SBSDs, and zero bank MSBSPs registered with the Commission. The Commission estimates that each recordkeeping provision of Rule 18a-5 imposes on each firm that is subject to the provision an initial burden and an ongoing annual burden. The total initial industry hour burden attributable to Rule 18a-5 is estimated to be 12,340 hours in the first year and the total industry ongoing hour burden attributable to Rule 18a-5 is estimated to be 15,425 hours per year (including the first year). Over a three-year period, the total estimated industry burden is estimated to be 58,615 hours, or about 19,538 hours per year when annualized. These burdens are recordkeeping burdens.
In addition, the Commission estimates that Rule 18a-5 causes a stand-alone SBSD or stand-alone MSBSP to incur an initial dollar cost of approximately $1,000 to purchase recordkeeping system software and an ongoing dollar cost of $4,650 per year to provide adequate physical space and computer hardware and software for storage. As of September 24, 2026, there are 15 respondents (15 stand-alone SBSDs and zero stand-alone MSBSPs), resulting in an estimated industry-wide initial burden of $15,000 and an industry-wide ongoing burden of $69,750 per year. Over a three-year period, the total estimated industry burden would be $224,250, or about $74,750 per year when annualized.
An agency may not conduct or sponsor, and a person is not required to respond to, a collection of information unless it displays a currently valid OMB Control Number.
Written comments are invited on: (a) whether this proposed collection of information is necessary for the proper performance of the functions of the SEC, including whether the information will have practical utility; (b) the accuracy of the SEC's estimate of the burden imposed by the proposed collection of information, including the validity of the methodology and the assumptions used; (c) ways to enhance the quality, utility, and clarity of the information to be collected; and (d) ways to minimize the burden of the collection of information on respondents, including through the use of automated, electronic collection techniques or other forms of information technology.
Please direct your written comments on this 60-Day Collection Notice to Austin Gerig, Director/Chief Data Officer, Securities and Exchange Commission, c/o Tanya Ruttenberg via email to PaperworkReductionAct@sec.gov by January 4, 2027.

[Investigation Nos. 731-TA-1550-1553 (Review)]
United States International Trade Commission.
The Commission hereby gives notice that it has instituted reviews pursuant to the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended, to determine whether revocation of the antidumping duty orders on polyester textured yarn from Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, and Vietnam would be likely to lead to continuation or recurrence of material injury. Pursuant to the Act, interested parties are requested to respond to this notice by submitting the information specified below to the Commission.
Instituted November 2, 2026. To be assured of consideration, the deadline for responses is December 2, 2026. Comments on the adequacy of responses may be filed with the Commission by January 12, 2027.
Judson Monson (202-205-3314), Office of Investigations, U.S. International Trade Commission, 500 E Street SW, Washington, DC 20436. Hearing-impaired persons can obtain information on this matter by contacting the Commission's TDD terminal on 202-205-1810. Persons with mobility impairments who will need special assistance in gaining access to the Commission should contact the Office of the Secretary at 202-205-2000. General information concerning the Commission may also be obtained by accessing its internet server ( https://www.usitc.gov). The public record for this proceeding may be viewed on the Commission's electronic docket (EDIS) at https://edis.usitc.gov.
Background. —On December 14, 2021, the Department of Commerce (“Commerce”) issued antidumping duty orders on imports of polyester textured yarn from Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, and Vietnam (86 FR 71031). The Commission is conducting reviews pursuant to section 751(c) of the Act, as amended (19 U.S.C. 1675(c)), to determine whether revocation of the orders would be likely to lead to continuation or recurrence of material injury to the domestic industry within a reasonably foreseeable time. Provisions concerning the conduct of this proceeding may be found in the Commission's Rules of Practice and Procedure at 19 CFR part 201, subparts A and B, and 19 CFR part 207, subparts A and F. The Commission will assess the adequacy of interested party responses to this notice of institution to determine whether to conduct full or expedited reviews. The Commission's determinations in any expedited reviews will be based on the facts available, which may include information provided in response to this notice.
Definitions. —The following definitions apply to these reviews:
(1) Subject Merchandise is the class or kind of merchandise that is within the scope of the five-year reviews, as defined by Commerce.
(2) The Subject Countries in these reviews are Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, and Vietnam.
(3) The Domestic Like Product is the domestically produced product or products which are like, or in the absence of like, most similar in characteristics and uses with, the Subject Merchandise. In its original determinations, the Commission defined a single Domestic Like Product as polyester textured yarn, that is coextensive with the scope.
(4) The Domestic Industry is the U.S. producers as a whole of the Domestic Like Product, or those producers whose collective output of the Domestic Like Product constitutes a major proportion of the total domestic production of the product. In its original determinations, the Commission defined the Domestic Industry as all producers of polyester textured yarn.
(5) The Order Date is the date that the antidumping duty orders under review became effective. In these reviews, the Order Date is December 14, 2021.
(6) An Importer is any person or firm engaged, either directly or through a parent company or subsidiary, in importing the Subject Merchandise into the United States from a foreign manufacturer or through its selling agent.
Participation in the proceeding and public service list. —Persons, including industrial users of the Subject Merchandise and, if the merchandise is sold at the retail level, representative consumer organizations, wishing to participate in the proceeding as parties must file an entry of appearance with the Secretary to the Commission, as provided in § 201.11(b)(4) of the Commission's rules, no later than 21 days after publication of this notice in the Federal Register . The Secretary will maintain a public service list containing the names and addresses of all persons, or their representatives, who are parties to the proceeding.
Former Commission employees who are seeking to appear in Commission five-year reviews are advised that they may appear in a review even if they participated personally and substantially in the corresponding underlying original investigation or an earlier review of the same underlying investigation. The Commission's designated agency ethics official has ( printed page 68972) advised that a five-year review is not the same particular matter as the underlying original investigation, and a five-year review is not the same particular matter as an earlier review of the same underlying investigation for purposes of 18 U.S.C. 207, the post-employment statute for Federal employees, and Commission rule 201.15(b) (19 CFR 201.15(b)), 79 FR 3246 (Jan. 17, 2014), 73 FR 24609 (May 5, 2008). Consequently, former employees are not required to seek Commission approval to appear in a review under Commission rule 19 CFR 201.15, even if the corresponding underlying original investigation or an earlier review of the same underlying investigation was pending when they were Commission employees. For further ethics advice on this matter, contact Charles Smith, Office of the General Counsel, at 202-205-3408.
Limited disclosure of business proprietary information (BPI) under an administrative protective order (APO) and APO service list. —Pursuant to § 207.7(a) of the Commission's rules, the Secretary will make BPI submitted in this proceeding available to authorized applicants under the APO issued in the proceeding, provided that the application is made no later than 21 days after publication of this notice in the Federal Register . Authorized applicants must represent interested parties, as defined in 19 U.S.C. 1677(9), who are parties to the proceeding. A separate service list will be maintained by the Secretary for those parties authorized to receive BPI under the APO.
Certification. —Pursuant to § 207.3 of the Commission's rules, any person submitting information to the Commission in connection with this proceeding must certify that the information is accurate and complete to the best of the submitter's knowledge. Filings must be made through the Commission's Electronic Document Information System (EDIS, https://edis.usitc.gov). In your response, please discuss the various factors specified in § 752(a) of the Act (19 U.S.C. 1675a(a)) including the likely volume of subject imports, likely price effects of subject imports, and likely impact of imports of Subject Merchandise on the Domestic Industry.
(5) A list of all known and currently operating U.S. producers of the Domestic Like Product. Identify any known related parties and the nature of the relationship as defined in § 771(4)(B) of the Act (19 U.S.C. 1677(4)(B)).
(6) A list of all known and currently operating U.S. importers of the Subject Merchandise and producers of the Subject Merchandise in each Subject Country that currently export or have exported Subject Merchandise to the United States or other countries since the Order Date.
(7) A list of 3-5 leading purchasers in the U.S. market for the Domestic Like Product and the Subject Merchandise (including street address, World Wide Web address, and the name, telephone number, fax number, and Email address of a responsible official at each firm).
(8) A list of known sources of information on national or regional prices for the Domestic Like Product or the Subject Merchandise in the U.S. or other markets.
(9) If you are a U.S. producer of the Domestic Like Product, provide the following information on your firm's operations on that product during calendar year 2025, except as noted (report quantity data in pounds and value data in U.S. dollars, f.o.b. plant). If you are a union/worker group or trade/business association, provide the information, on an aggregate basis, for the firms in which your workers are employed/which are members of your association.
(a) Production (quantity) and, if known, an estimate of the percentage of total U.S. production of the Domestic Like Product accounted for by your firm's(s') production;
(b) Capacity (quantity) of your firm to produce the Domestic Like Product (that is, the level of production that your establishment(s) could reasonably have expected to attain during the year, assuming normal operating conditions (using equipment and machinery in place and ready to operate), normal operating levels (hours per week/weeks per year), time for downtime, maintenance, repair, and cleanup, and a typical or representative product mix);
(c) the quantity and value of U.S. commercial shipments of the Domestic Like Product produced in your U.S. plant(s);
(d) the quantity and value of U.S. internal consumption/company transfers of the Domestic Like Product produced in your U.S. plant(s); and
(e) the value of (i) net sales, (ii) cost of goods sold (COGS), (iii) gross profit, (iv) selling, general and administrative (SG&A) expenses, and (v) operating income of the Domestic Like Product produced in your U.S. plant(s) (include both U.S. and export commercial sales, internal consumption, and company transfers) for your most recently completed fiscal year (identify the date on which your fiscal year ends).
(10) If you are a U.S. importer or a trade/business association of U.S. importers of the Subject Merchandise from any Subject Country, provide the following information on your firm's(s') operations on that product during calendar year 2025 (report quantity data in pounds and value data in U.S. dollars). If you are a trade/business association, provide the information, on an aggregate basis, for the firms, which are members of your association.
(a) The quantity and value (landed, duty-paid but not including antidumping duties) of U.S. imports and, if known, an estimate of the percentage of total U.S. imports of Subject Merchandise from each Subject Country accounted for by your firm's(s') imports;
(b) the quantity and value (f.o.b. U.S. port, including antidumping duties) of U.S. commercial shipments of Subject Merchandise imported from each Subject Country; and
(c) the quantity and value (f.o.b. U.S. port, including antidumping duties) of U.S. internal consumption/company transfers of Subject Merchandise imported from each Subject Country.
(11) If you are a producer, an exporter, or a trade/business association of producers or exporters of the Subject Merchandise in any Subject Country, provide the following information on your firm's(s') operations on that product during calendar year 2025 (report quantity data in pounds and value data in U.S. dollars, landed and duty-paid at the U.S. port but not including antidumping duties). If you are a trade/business association, provide the information, on an aggregate basis, for the firms, which are members of your association.
(a) Production (quantity) and, if known, an estimate of the percentage of total production of Subject Merchandise in each Subject Country accounted for by your firm's(s') production;

(c) the quantity and value of your firm's(s') exports to the United States of Subject Merchandise and, if known, an estimate of the percentage of total exports to the United States of Subject Merchandise from each Subject Country accounted for by your firm's(s') exports.
(12) Identify significant changes, if any, in the supply and demand conditions or business cycle for the Domestic Like Product that have occurred in the United States or in the market for the Subject Merchandise in each Subject Country since the Order Date, and significant changes, if any, that are likely to occur within a reasonably foreseeable time. Supply conditions to consider include technology; production methods; development efforts; ability to increase production (including the shift of production facilities used for other products and the use, cost, or availability of major inputs into production); and factors related to the ability to shift supply among different national markets (including barriers to importation in foreign markets or changes in market demand abroad). Demand conditions to consider include end uses and applications; the existence and availability of substitute products; and the level of competition among the Domestic Like Product produced in the United States, Subject Merchandise produced in each Subject Country, and such merchandise from other countries.
(13) (OPTIONAL) A statement of whether you agree with the above definitions of the Domestic Like Product and Domestic Industry; if you disagree with either or both of these definitions, please explain why and provide alternative definitions.

16位台湾青年农业大使将访问荷兰 - 聚焦台湾
16位台湾青年农业大使访问荷兰
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
外交部长林家龙（后右五）周一举行活动，介绍16名台湾年轻农业专家前往荷兰参加一年一度的政府资助的农业交流计划。中央通讯社照片2026年11月2日
中新社台北11月2日电 外交部长林佳龙周一举行活动，介绍16位前往荷兰参加年度政府资助农业交流计划的台湾年轻农业专家。
林在外交部台北总部举行的仪式上表示，青年农业大使计划于2017年启动，由外交部和农业部共同举办。
其初衷是为了促进台湾与新南向政策所覆盖国家的交流。
林说，自该项目启动以来，已有150多名年龄在18岁至45岁之间的农业、林业、渔业和畜牧业大使前往澳大利亚、印度尼西亚、菲律宾、越南、马来西亚、印度和泰国。
林说，今年是该计划首次派团到新南向政策范围之外的国家。
他说，荷兰之所以被选为今年的目的地，是因为荷兰以其花卉业而闻名于世，并且是智能农业的先驱。
台湾和荷兰也保持着密切的农业合作，双方自1993年起举行农业工作组会议，建立了林所说的“深厚而牢固的农业伙伴关系”。
时任总统蔡英文于2016年推出新南向政策，旨在扩大台湾与东盟10个成员国、南亚6个国家、澳大利亚和新西兰的经济、教育和文化联系。
与此同时，荷兰驻台北办事处副代表Matthijs van der Hoorn在仪式上致辞时强调了荷兰与台湾之间“强大、稳健和长期”的农业关系。
荷兰驻台北办事处副代表Matthijs van der Hoorn。中央通讯社照片2026年11月2日
他说：“我们一直在知识交流、大多成功的商业配对活动以及解决复杂的行星和星际市场准入问题方面进行合作。”
他说：“对于今年选出的年轻农业投资者来说，你们代表了农业的未来。”他补充说，他们的旅程将“为下一代农业解决方案铺平道路”。
据外交部介绍，本届代表团由农、林、渔业、畜牧、花卉、环境农业、果蔬生产销售、畜牧业等领域的青年专业人士组成。
外交部表示，代表团计划于11月8日离开台湾，前往荷兰进行为期八天的访问，其间代表团成员将与荷兰同行加强双方在花卉栽培、可控环境农业、畜牧业、果蔬生产和营销方面的合作。
公众对台湾金融服务的信心升至64。

16 young Taiwanese agricultural ambassadors to visit the Netherlands - Focus Taiwan
16 young Taiwanese agricultural ambassadors to visit the Netherlands
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung (fifth right from back) holds an event on Monday to introduce 16 young Taiwanese agricultural experts who are heading to the Netherlands to take part in an annual government-funded agricultural exchange program. CNA photo Nov. 2, 2026
Taipei, Nov. 2 (CNA) Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung (林佳龍) on Monday held an event to introduce 16 young Taiwanese agricultural experts who are heading to the Netherlands to take part in an annual government-funded agricultural exchange program.
Speaking at a ceremony at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' (MOFA) Taipei headquarters, Lin said the Young Agricultural Ambassadors program was launched in 2017 and is co-organized by MOFA and the Ministry of Agriculture.
It was originally designed to promote exchanges between Taiwan and countries covered by the New Southbound Policy.
Since the program's inception, more than 150 ambassadors aged 18-45, specializing in agriculture, forestry, fisheries and animal husbandry have traveled to Australia, Indonesia, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia, India and Thailand, Lin said.
This year marks the first time the program has sent a delegation to a country outside the scope of the New Southbound Policy, Lin said.
The Netherlands was chosen as this year's destination because it is globally renowned for its floriculture industry and is a pioneer in smart agriculture, he said.
Taiwan and the Netherlands have also maintained close agricultural cooperation, with the two sides holding agricultural working group meetings since 1993 and fostering what Lin described as "a deep and robust agricultural partnership."
The New Southbound Policy was launched in 2016 under then-President Tsai Ing-wen (蔡英文) to expand Taiwan's economic, educational and cultural ties with the 10 ASEAN member states, six South Asian countries, Australia and New Zealand.
Meanwhile, Matthijs van der Hoorn, deputy representative of the Netherlands Office Taipei, highlighted the "strong, robust and long-standing" agricultural relationship between the Netherlands and Taiwan, during his address at the ceremony.
Matthijs van der Hoorn, deputy representative of the Netherlands Office Taipei. CNA photo Nov. 2, 2026
"We have been collaborating in knowledge exchange, mostly successful business matchmaking events, and tackling complex planetary and interplanetary market access issues," he said.
"To the young agricultural investors selected this year, you represent the future of agriculture," he said, adding that their journey would "pave the way for the next generation of agricultural solutions."
According to MOFA, this year's delegation comprises young professionals specializing in agriculture, forestry, fisheries, animal husbandry, floriculture, controlled-environment agriculture, fruit and vegetable production and marketing, and livestock farming.
The delegation is scheduled to leave Taiwan on Nov. 8 for an eight-day visit to the Netherlands, during which its members will engage with their Dutch counterparts to strengthen bilateral cooperation in floriculture, controlled-environment agriculture, livestock farming, and fruit and vegetable production and marketing, MOFA said in a press release.

content:
林外长呼吁中国遵循APEC峰会既定惯例 - 聚焦台湾
林外长呼吁中国遵循APEC峰会惯例
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
中新社台北11月2日电 台湾外交部长林佳龙周一呼吁中国按照惯例正式邀请台湾参加亚太经合组织(APEC)峰会，并强调尽管中国给予台湾“差别待遇”，台湾仍将维护其参与权利。
《自由时报》周一早些时候发表的一篇报道援引未透露姓名的政府消息人士的话称，中国作为 2026 年 APEC 的东道主，最近向台湾发出了一封信函，而不是正式邀请台湾参加即将于 11 月 18 日至 19 日在深圳举行的 APEC 峰会。
报道称，这封信没有提及台湾在亚太经合组织内的正式名称“中华台北”，并降低了台湾的地位。
周一晚些时候在台北被要求对该报告发表评论时，林说台湾是亚太经合组织的正式成员，并与所有其他成员经济体平等地参与该论坛。
不过，他指责中国在今年举办各种APEC会议时一再对台湾实施“差别待遇”。
林说，例如，中国没有安排官员亲自向台湾递交APEC邀请函，而是选择发送电子邮件。
他指出，这封电子邮件确实用亚太经合组织的官方名称“中华台北”来指代台湾。
台湾外交部长林家龙。中央通讯社照片2026年10月28日
林郑月娥呼吁中方恪守举办APEC峰会的既定做法。
林补充说：“我们将立即对任何违反惯例的行为提出抗议，但我们不会因此而放弃参与的权利。”
APEC成立于1989年，是一个由环太平洋地区21个成员经济体组成的政府间论坛，旨在促进整个亚太地区的自由贸易。台湾和中国都是APEC正式成员。
中国已两次主办亚太经合组织峰会，第一次是2001年，第二次是2014年。
2001年，时任总统陈水扁领导的民进党政府，北京发传真拒绝了台湾选择前国家副主席李元簇出席APEC峰会的特使。台北随后决定抵制该活动。
2014年，时任总统马英九的国民党政府执政，与北京关系升温，中国派时任台办副主任龚清概在台北亲自向时任陆委会主任王郁琦转达邀请。

FM Lin calls on China to follow established practice for APEC summits
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Taipei, Nov. 2 (CNA) Taiwan's Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung (林佳龍) on Monday called on China to follow established practice in formally inviting Taiwan to the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, stressing that Taiwan will uphold its right to participate despite what he described as China's "differential treatment."
A Chinese-language Liberty Times report published early Monday, citing unnamed government sources, said that China, as the host of APEC in 2026, recently sent a letter rather than a formal official invitation to Taiwan to attend the upcoming APEC summit, scheduled to take place in Shenzhen on Nov. 18-19.
The letter did not refer to Taiwan by its official name within APEC, "Chinese Taipei," and downgraded Taiwan's status, according to the report.
Asked to comment on the report in Taipei later Monday, Lin said Taiwan is a full APEC member and has participated in the forum on an equal footing with all other member economies.
However, he accused China of repeatedly subjecting Taiwan to "differential treatment" while hosting various APEC meetings this year.
For example, China did not arrange for an official to personally deliver the APEC invitation to Taiwan, opting instead to send an email, Lin said.
He noted that the email did refer to Taiwan by its official APEC designation, "Chinese Taipei."
Taiwan's Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung. CNA photo Oct. 28, 2026
Lin called on China to adhere to established practices for hosting APEC summits.
"We will lodge an immediate protest against any action that violates established practices, but we will not, as a result, forfeit our right to participate," Lin added.
Established in 1989, APEC is an intergovernmental forum comprising 21 member economies in the Pacific Rim that promotes free trade throughout the Asia-Pacific region. Taiwan and China are both full APEC members.
China has hosted the APEC summit twice, first in 2001 and again in 2014.
In 2001, under the then-ruling Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) government of President Chen Shui-bian (陳水扁), Beijing sent a fax and rejected Taiwan's choice of special envoy, former Vice President Li Yuan-zu (李元簇), to attend the APEC summit. Taipei subsequently decided to boycott the event.
In 2014, when the Kuomintang (KMT) government of then-President Ma Ying-jeou (馬英九) was in power and ties with Beijing were warming, China sent then-Taiwan Affairs Office Deputy Director Gong Qinggai (龔清概) to personally deliver the invitation to then-Mainland Affairs Council Minister Wang Yu-chi (王郁琦) in Taipei.

美國中期選舉：民調顯示民主黨將取得勝利，但預測還準確嗎？ - BBC News 中文
Author, 安東尼·澤克爾（Anthony Zurcher）
民主黨帶著很高的期望迎接這場舉足輕重的美國中期選舉。
一位支持率創歷史新低的共和黨總統、對食品和各項帳單費用上漲心懷不滿的美國公眾，以及連續數月對民主黨有利的民調，都預示著週二對民主黨而言將是個美好的夜晚。
民調顯示，民主黨候選人在遠超218個議席的選區中領先，而218席正是奪取國會下院眾議院（House of Representatives）控制權所需的席位數。在關鍵的參議院（Senate）選戰中，他們與對手持平或略微領先。
《紐約時報》（New York Times）近期的一項民調顯示，南卡羅來納州（South Carolina）的參議院選戰呈現平局，而唐納德·特朗普（Donald Trump）2024 年在該州領先18個百分點。有線電視新聞網（CNN）近期的調查則顯示，民主黨在得克薩斯州（Texas）、堪薩斯州（Kansas）和緬因州（Maine）領先。
美國近年的政治史上，民意調查失準的例子比比皆是，即便是在選舉前幾天進行的民調也不例外。特朗普在2016年和2024年入主白宮的過程中，表現都超出預測。2020 年，他以微弱差距落敗，而當時多數調查顯示民主黨人喬·拜登（Joe Biden）將更輕鬆獲勝。
今年早些時候，民調顯示民主黨人阿卜杜勒·埃爾-賽義德（Abdul El-Sayed）有望在密歇根州（Michigan）民主黨參議員初選中以兩位數優勢獲勝。結果差距僅為1%。在威斯康星州（Wisconsin）民主黨州長初選中，一名民調領先幅度接近20個百分點的候選人，最終以不到一個百分點的差距敗北。
Play video, "What's at stake for Trump in the US midterms?", 節目全長 0,59
進行政治和市場研究調查的益普索公共事務部（Ipsos Public Affairs）總裁克利福德·揚（Clifford Young）表示，近年來民調變得困難，原因是美國人紛紛棄用座機並過濾來電，聯繫他們更加不易。而且，民調機構聯繫到的人當中，許多人參與的意願也有所下降。
台灣新北市長選戰：「政二代」蘇巧慧對決「專業副手」李四川，誰能拿下藍綠關鍵一城？
「保守派，尤其是極右翼保守派，本質上更加反建制，」揚說。 「他們什麼都不參與。他們憎恨這個體制。這就是挑戰所在。」
如果共和黨選民被系統性地低估，而民調公司在建立投票模型時沒有考慮到這一點，那麼他們的數據可能會向民主黨傾斜。
特朗普在此前總統選舉中表現超出預期，一種解釋是，他的支持者——其中許多人並非經常投票的選民——以高於預期的人數湧向投票站。
這種不可預測性是近年來幾次明顯的民調失準的主要原因之一，儘管大多數信譽良好的民調的誤差只有幾個百分點。
在勢均力敵的選戰中，這幾個百分點就可能決定候選人的勝負。而今年，許多關鍵的參議院選戰都處於這樣狹窄的差距之內。
近年來，中期選舉的大選民調已被證明更為準確，部分原因是特朗普——以及他吸引心懷不滿的美國人前往投票的獨特能力——不在選票上。
2022年，民調顯示，儘管拜登的支持率低迷，民主黨仍將打破常規預期，避免遭遇選舉慘敗。
雖然民主黨最終失去了眾議院的控制權，但差距很小，而且民主黨保住了美國參議院的控制權。
雖然今年的初選結果確實帶來了更大的意外，但揚表示，初選歷來變數較大，選民更可能在最後一刻才做出決定。不應將此視為當前這批大選民調失準的跡象。
近年來最引人注目的例子之一發生在 2010 年，當時共和黨人從民主黨手中奪得 60 多個眾議院席位，並在參議院也取得了進展。
那次選舉的背景是，經濟仍在從金融危機中艱難復甦，以及保守派對總統巴拉克·奧巴馬（Barack Obama）醫療改革的擔憂。民調曾預測民主黨會失利，但沒有預料到規模如此之大。
這次角色互換，民主黨成為反對黨，經濟議題成為選民關注的焦點。但鑑於特朗普的低支持率，民主黨的表現可能不會像歷史經驗所顯示的那樣好，也不會像一些人預期的那樣出色，原因有很多。
首先，這次選舉中涉及的大部分地區，特朗普在兩年前的總統選舉中都輕鬆拿下。對共和黨來說，這就像是主場比賽一樣。
其次，多年來眾議院選區邊界的調整，使得在兩黨之間易手的議席減少。
第三，由於國家的兩極分化加深，搖擺選民減少。一些專家形容選民群體已經僵化。
此外，共和黨一直享有資金優勢，這使他們在最後幾週有數億美元可用於投放攻擊性廣告。
Play video, "Voter voices: What issues matter most to Americans", 節目全長 1,16
民意調查模型旨在捕捉基本面的變化。精心設計的民意調查會預先考慮可能降低其可靠性的因素。
單一民調都存在固有的誤差範圍，這是基於樣本量與總體比例的統計不確定性。綜合來看，民調平均值而非單一調查結果可以提供更準確的預測。
目前來看，即使是像近幾屆總統選舉那樣的民調傾向，也顯示民主黨在11月3日晚上可能會取得不錯的成績。而且，民調失準可能偏向任何一方。在去年的州選舉和特別選舉中，民主黨的表現優於大多數民調預測，因為他們的選民投票率遠超預期。
特朗普在競選的最後幾天，在他2024年輕鬆獲勝的州舉行集會，這一景象提振了民主黨人的希望，他們認為共和黨內部民調顯示保守派候選人處境艱難。
有時，後期的轉向會改變一場選戰的態勢。有時，未決定的選民——在許多此類選戰中他們仍佔選民的重要部分——會全部倒向同一方。
在民調中，總會存在一定程度的不確定性，而管理這種不確定性，正是與科學相伴的藝術。
「我認為我們做得更好了，」揚說。 「但我們一直面臨的問題不僅僅在於民調機構，部分原因在於我們正在和人打交道。人可不是那麼容易對付的。」
本文原以英文撰寫，我們使用了人工智能協助翻譯，並由BBC記者在發佈前進行審核。了解更多關於我們如何使用人工智能的資訊。

title: 台揭中共53艘船艦動態 美日深化第一島鏈防禦

content:
【大紀元2026年11月01日訊】（大紀元記者程木蘭報導）中共近日出動包含航空母艦「遼寧號」在內共53艘軍艦與公務船，在第一島鏈周邊展開大規模演訓，威脅範圍涵蓋日本南部、台灣東部及菲律賓外海。與此同時，美日兩國國防部長宣示深化第一島鏈聯防，除計劃在日本聯合生產先進飛彈、前沿部署「多領域特遣部隊」，以聯手建構「拒止型防衛」外，並於「利劍」軍演中展現堅定的同盟意志。
台灣國家安全會議祕書長吳釗燮於10月28日公布軍情地圖，指出中共部署了53艘船艦，其中包含34艘海軍主力軍艦與遼寧號航母編隊，活動海域自日本南部延伸至台灣，並涵蓋菲律賓外海。他強調，國軍正密切監控相關動態，並直言台灣、日本與菲律賓正面臨顯而易見的共同威脅。
依地圖所示，遼寧號及其隨行戰鬥群部署於菲律賓以東，其它編隊位於台灣東部與東南方外海，另有3艘位於日本南部沿海。日本防衛省也表示追蹤到3艘中共軍艦和1艘海警船通過九州外海的大隅海峽進入太平洋。
對此，中共國防部發言人張曉剛於29日聲稱，遼寧號在西太平洋的訓練屬年度例行活動，旨在檢驗遠程與遠海作戰能力，並非針對任何特定國家。
台灣國防部長顧立雄於立法院接受媒體採訪時表示：「我們不樂見有任何展現威脅的企圖，進而影響印太區域和平穩定。」他說明，台灣軍方除透過聯合情監偵手段外，亦與盟友交換情資，充分掌握遼寧號、其它艦隊以及公務船、海警船動態。
淡江大學國際事務與戰略研究所副教授林穎佑接受《台北時報》（Taipei Times）採訪時表示，共軍已整合北部、東部與南部戰區的海軍兵力，這些行動應視為更大範圍「第一島鏈戰區」的一部分，反映出針對第一島鏈的整體作戰計劃。
林穎佑引述日本統合幕僚監部資訊指出，遼寧號通過日本宮古海峽、航行至台灣以東並朝菲律賓海前進，顯示中共戰略重心仍在南海，北京正以「砲艦外交」的形式向菲律賓施壓。他並提醒，共軍此次行動中出現的055型飛彈驅逐艦，是衡量中共海軍作戰實力的關鍵指標。
台灣國防安全研究院副研究員舒孝煌則分析，共軍這些活動具備三項政治意涵：一是回應美日兩國於10月19日至29日在日本西南諸島舉行的「利劍」演習；二是回應美日防長28日在菲律賓宿霧（Cebu）的會晤；三是回應美國陸軍將中共列為「主要威脅對象」的作戰指導文件。
舒孝煌表示，遼寧號每年雖皆有出海部署，但本次投入兵力規模相當可觀，顯示中共正利用例行演習建立第一島鏈以外的作戰能力，並逐步發展仿效美國海軍的航母打擊群架構。
日本防衛大臣小泉進次郎與美國國防部長海格塞斯28日前往宿霧出席東協防長擴大會議。雙方針對中共日益強勢的軍事活動，確認將加強自日本九州、沖繩經台灣延伸至菲律賓的第一島鏈防衛合作，以建立足以阻止敵方攻擊的「拒止性防衛」為共同目標，同時確認擴大防衛投資、強化彈藥生產及聯合訓練的重要性。
小泉強調，日本將強化「拒止能力」，對憑藉武力和脅迫單方面改變現狀的企圖進行威懾，即使日本遭到進攻也能將其擊退，讓對方無法達成目的。
《讀賣新聞》報導，日本政府計劃於年內修訂《國家安全保障戰略》等安保三文件，擬將「拒止防禦能力」列為防衛支柱，透過提升持續作戰能力與強化長程飛彈部署等措施。美國川普政府已於今年初將「拒止防禦」寫入《國家防務戰略》。
美日已同意在日本設立聯合生產 AMRAAM 的最終組裝與檢驗設施。
小泉並表示，美日同意在日本設立AMRAAM最終組裝及檢驗設施，擴大飛彈供應能力。台灣戰略專家林廷輝29日在「年代向錢看」政論節目上分析，日本是除美國外擁有最多F-35戰機的國家，若取得中程空對空飛彈在地生產能量，代表美國對日本的高度信任，並使美方多一處海外供應基地。
據美軍聲明，「利劍27」軍演包括美國海軍陸戰隊、美國海軍及日本自衛隊進行跨軍種協同反艦作戰演練。10月23日至24日，美軍F/A-18及F-35戰機分別由海軍陸戰隊基地及「羅斯福號」（USS Theodore Roosevelt）航空母艦起飛，與海軍陸戰隊的地面飛彈發射系統協同，模擬應對敵方海軍威脅。
在更南端，西方前沿拒止架構正進行跨區域整合，「美英澳三方安全夥伴關係」（AUKUS）取得突破，美軍指定維吉尼亞級核子動力攻擊潛艦「科羅拉多號」（USS Colorado）於2027年底起常態輪駐西澳史特林基地（Stirling Base）。
2026年10月23日，在「利劍27」（Keen Sword 27）聯合演習期間，美軍的羅斯福號航母（CVN 71）和日本、澳大利亞、加拿大和法國海軍的戰艦在菲律賓海域航行。（美國海軍）
林廷輝補充，未來美軍將有4艘核潛艦與1艘英國航母集中部署於西澳，與台灣F-16維修中心及南韓戰術據點相呼應，形成涵蓋印度洋、南海與台海的強大「核子保護傘」與區域拒止網絡。
美國陸軍太平洋司令部司令克拉克上將於10月27日在檀香山舉行的印太技術網絡會議上強調，「戴維森窗口」帶來的威脅「依然存在」。
他表示：「對我們美國陸軍太平洋司令部而言，答案是肯定的。」據《星條旗報》報導，美軍已採取「陸軍前沿戰備計劃」，於第一島鏈沿線以輪換方式部署裝備、物資與人員。
「戴維森窗口」一詞源自2021年，時任印太司令部司令戴維森（Philip Davidson）於參議院聽證會上指出，中共可能在六年內具備武力攻台的能力。
然而，美國國家情報總監辦公室（ODNI）今年3月發布的年度威脅評估報告指出，中共領導人目前並未計劃在2027年對台灣發動侵略，亦無固定的統一時間表。
美國陸軍於10月7日發布46頁的《陸軍如何作戰》指引文件，將中共視為「主要對標威脅」，並要求部隊於衝突爆發首日即投入行動。文件序言發出警告：「為確保來自本土的主力部隊能順利抵達，必須在敵軍家門口打贏第一場仗。」
據美國海軍學會新聞（USNI News）報導，美陸軍將發展加固型指揮管制、戰區內後勤與彈藥儲備，並部署約2,100人、配備長程飛彈與電子戰能力的「多領域特遣部隊」（MDTF），以瓦解中共的反介入／區域拒止網絡。
美國國防部政策次長柯爾比（Elbridge A. Colby）於9月22日向參議院軍事委員會提交報告，強調應沿第一島鏈建立「拒止式嚇阻」防衛態勢，透過陸基機動飛彈發射系統、前沿部署部隊、水雷及空中作戰力量，提高中共發動軍事攻擊的難度。
柯爾比並指出，美軍需要建立高低搭配的彈藥供應體系，除高端彈藥外，亦需可快速大量生產的通用彈藥。報導指出，美國海軍已於10月1日授予雷神公司（Raytheon）一份價值244億美元的標準六型飛彈（SM-6）多年期合約，採購數量超過1,900枚，藉此擴大產能、增加海軍彈藥庫存並強化軍工供應鏈。

title: 分析：中共無法攻打台灣的關鍵軟肋

content:
中共別無選擇，只能進口大豆。圖為資料照，農民在收穫季趁著夕陽採摘大豆。（Buddhika Weerasinghe/Getty Images）
【大紀元2026年11月02日訊】（大紀元記者王蘭報導）在評估中共攻打台灣的可能性時，分析師往往關注中國可能面臨的幾個顯而易見的風險：軍事失敗、經濟放緩，以及石油和技術進口受限。這些固然重要，但還有一個同樣關鍵的脆弱環節卻常被忽略：糧食。
美國外交政策期刊《外交事務》（Foreign Affairs）11月2日刊登了署名喬爾‧伍斯諾（Joel Wuthnow）的分析文章《中國自給自足能力的侷限性》，文章中指出北京方面意識到了這一軟肋。
在2022年召開的中共二十大上，中共黨魁習近平將「確保糧食、能源資源、重要產業鏈供應鏈安全」列為關係國家安全與社會穩定的核心議題。其中，糧食安全被置於首位，這對中國超10億人口而言是一個極其敏感的問題：如今中國約15%的人口曾親歷1959年至1961年間的大飢荒，那場災難據估計造成了3000萬人死亡（實際死亡數字更高）。
北京試圖通過建立儲備和實現進口來源多元化，來降低對大豆的依賴。然而，由於大豆屬於易損農產品，中共的應變能力終究有限。因此，北京能夠支撐戰爭行動的前提，在於中國人民是否願意將軍隊的勝利置於自身的營養需求之上。要阻止中共黨魁發動衝突，關鍵在於讓他意識到：國內危機的爆發，恐怕會比戰場上的勝利來得更快。
中共使用武力所面臨的最大危機之一就是：關鍵進口物資被中斷；至少自2003年起，中共領導人開始擔憂馬六甲海峽可能遭遇外國封鎖，畢竟中國進口的石油大多經由此處。當時，中共領導人胡錦濤曾發出警告，指出大國干預可能對中國的能源安全帶來「馬六甲困境」。不過，北京方面已儲備了大量的石油；一旦發生危機，中共不僅可以增加從俄羅斯的石油進口，還可以效仿莫斯科的做法，組建一支旨在規避制裁的「影子船隊」，用於從中東運輸石油。
外國技術是中共近年面臨的一項較新、但同樣重要的隱憂。中共也在大量囤積芯片等關鍵零組件，同時成功開發國產替代產品。
然而，在糧食自給方面，北京能夠選擇的空間就小得多。中國的小麥、大米及玉米等主要穀物，國內產量占這些穀物消費量的90%以上，但在大豆、牛肉及大麥等其它重要食品方面，中國仍然依賴外國供應商。
2000年至2020年間，進口食品占中國食品供應總量的比例，從6%上升至34%。分析人士預測，到2030年，這一比例將進一步升至41%。因為中國人不再滿足於只吃穀物。1962年至2024年間，肉類在中國人日常飲食中的占比增加了18倍。
這正是大豆發揮關鍵作用的地方。大豆這種豆科作物能夠為動物飼料提供複雜而豐富的蛋白質組合，其它食物來源及合成胺基酸都無法完全取代。缺少大豆，中國的畜禽養殖規模將會萎縮，進而威脅國內肉類及乳製品供應。
此外，大豆油也是中國使用最廣泛的食用油，占據近一半市場份額。棕櫚油及菜籽油等替代品同樣主要依賴進口，也面臨海上運輸中斷的相同風險，因此難以提供多少緩解。
中國的大豆儲備可能只能維持幾個月。中共已投入大量資源，確保並儘可能分散外國食品供應來源。
2013年，一家中國企業收購了美國最大豬肉生產商史密斯菲爾德食品公司（Smithfield Foods）。此外，中國最大的食品及農業企業旗下分支中糧國際（COFCO International）等國有企業，也在阿根廷、巴西等主要農業生產國購買農場，並興建物流基礎設施，使企業能夠直接向農民採購農產品。
這些直接投資能夠緩衝價格波動，讓北京在供應源頭對採購數量及成本擁有更大的控制權。中國也持續增加國內肉類產量。
然而，這些努力對於緩解海上運輸中斷所造成的影響，作用十分有限，尤其是大豆供應鏈，即使在和平時期也相當脆弱。
2018年7月19日，在中國河北省三河市，好福糧油集團（Hopeful Grain and Oil Group）展示了進口大豆。（Greg Baker/AFP via Getty Images）
中國沒有足夠的可耕地，既能擴大大豆種植，又能維持主要穀物的自給自足。（此外，在中國乾旱的北方地區，大豆的單位土地產量及經濟效益遠不如玉米或小麥，因此從經濟角度來看，這種取捨更為合理。）
但種植及出口大豆的國家幾乎都位於西半球，這也帶來更多物流挑戰。例如，2018年中美貿易戰爆發後，北京將美國大豆占中國大豆供應的比例，從40%降至約20%，並通過增加從巴西進口來彌補缺口。
然而，巴西基礎設施不足，加上自然災害頻繁，使其大豆收成比美國更容易受到影響。2024年，巴西一個州因洪災損失了四分之一至三分之一的大豆收成。
美國及巴西的港口距離中國也幾乎是全球最遠的航運路線之一。例如，巴西桑托斯港（Santos）距離廣州超過1萬英里，海運需要45天。由於大豆對濕度十分敏感，這段漫長航程意味著貨船抵達中國時，貨物往往已經腐爛。基於類似原因，大豆也不容易長期儲存。
與北京聲稱可以維持數年供應的大米及小麥儲備不同，大豆儲備規模較小，而且必須更頻繁地更新。如果進口被切斷，中國的大豆庫存可能只能維持幾個月。
儘管中共一直在試驗生物工程飼料添加劑，希望減少動物飼料中的大豆用量，但食品需求持續增加，抵銷了這些努力所帶來的成效。
中國與美國一旦爆發戰爭，將對食品供應鏈構成生存層面的威脅。在最極端的情況下，美國軍方會封鎖從西半球運往中國的貨運船隻，切斷中國大部分大豆進口來源。中共在拉丁美洲沒有海軍基地或前沿部署的軍事力量，無法有效反制這類行動。
但即使美國沒有實施禁運或海上封鎖，中國的食品供應鏈也可能受到戰爭衝擊。任何太平洋地區的戰爭，都會大幅推高海上運輸的保險風險溢價，甚至可能令航運公司望而卻步。
這種情況已經在紅海航運中出現。自2024年以來，胡塞武裝的飛彈威脅導致相關航運保險成本急劇上升。
太平洋戰爭的規模和成本可能更高，因為衝突將涉及主要海軍力量，而且船隻無法繞開危險海域。對許多航運公司而言，從巴西出發、長途運輸大豆到中國，在財務上將難以承受。
理論上，北京可以提供國家主權擔保、補貼或抵銷航運公司的保險費用。即使如此，大多數由美國及其盟國企業持有的運輸公司，仍可能停止向中國運送貨物，以避免協助敵對政權、避免員工面臨生命危險，以及防止未來因與中國做生意而受到制裁。
中國分析人士認為，中共可以利用自己的商船隊規避部分風險。和平時期，中國商船隊的運力相當可觀。中國航運巨頭中遠海運（COSCO）擁有468艘乾散貨船。但在戰爭時期，這支船隊將面臨沉重負擔，不僅要協助運送建築材料、工業物資及供軍隊使用的食品，還必須運輸煤炭、鐵礦石等重要軍事及工業原料。即使有船隻可以調用，也很可能缺乏具備專業訓練的人員，無法確保大豆在漫長航程中保持新鮮。
如果船隻試圖避開最危險的航道，航程還可能進一步延長，超過大豆能夠安全儲存的40天期限。屆時，即使貨物最終能夠抵達，也可能已經腐爛變質。
太平洋爆發戰爭，並不意味著中國會立即陷入糧食危機。短期內，政府可以通過釋放國家儲備中的大豆、冷凍豬肉及其它主要食品，應對進口減少的問題。
政府也可以降低動物飼料中大豆的最低添加比例。這會減慢牲畜生長速度，減少肉類產量，但在一段時間內仍然可以維持運作。不過，這種通過政府管理來緩解數月供應緊張的情況，已經是最理想的情境。
更可能出現的情況是，民眾恐慌性搶購，加上海上運輸中斷，導致儲備消耗速度超出原定計劃，使原本可以控制的供應短缺，在幾個月內演變成物價上漲及明顯的食品短缺。
事實上，有理由懷疑中國的糧食儲備，未必能提供官方所宣稱的短期安全保障。過去十年間，一些地方政府原本用來儲存應急食品的倉庫，被發現空空如也，或存放的食品已經腐爛，主要原因是貪污腐敗。
這不僅令人質疑中國實際擁有多少額外食品儲備，也會削弱民眾對政府的信任。
一旦爆發衝突，意識到供應中斷可能長期持續的民眾，便可能開始恐慌性搶購及囤積物資。無論實際存在多少儲備，最終都會耗盡，而且很可能優先供應給社會精英階層。
如果戰爭持續下去，情況將變得愈來愈嚴峻。農業生產者，尤其是小型農場，將被迫大量淘汰牲畜，家禽養殖將首當其衝，因為雞隻飼料中特別依賴大豆蛋白。隨後，雞蛋供應也將受到威脅。
接下來將是豬肉供應。食用油也會變得短缺且價格昂貴，使餐館及家庭日常運作面臨困難。
最終，民眾的忍耐程度將逐漸下降。囤積物資、因物價及食品短缺而引發的抗議，以及地方官員挪用或轉移供應物資等問題，都可能對北京形成愈來愈大的壓力，迫使中共政府結束戰爭。
與中國在能源或科技領域存在的脆弱性不同，其糧食體系的脆弱性是根深蒂固的。如果太平洋地區爆發衝突，美國無需對中國的農產品供應實施封鎖，也無需糾集國際聯盟來制裁中國的大豆進口。僅憑飆升的保險成本以及船東不願駛入戰區這一現實，就足以嚴重阻滯糧食供應，而中共政府對此幾乎束手無策。
如果中共領導人認為他們能夠迅速取勝且無需付出重大代價，他們或許會選擇孤注一擲。因此，要實現威懾，就必須讓他們確信這種想法行不通。美國、台灣及其它相關方政府應加大對無人機的投入，重建彈藥儲備，並向中共明確傳達一個訊號：一旦爆發衝突，極有可能演變為一場曠日持久的拉鋸戰。只要中共領導人認定戰爭在初期無法分出勝負，那麼由此可能引發的國內危機，便會成為他們避免開戰的有力考量。+
作者簡介：喬爾‧伍斯諾（Joel Wuthnow）是美國國防大學國家戰略研究所的高級研究員，也是《中國對軍事優勢的追求》（China’s Quest for Military Supremacy）一書的合著者。

title: 中共醫療系統反倫理道德案頻發 美國出手打擊
summary: 2020年5月14日，北京大學北京基因體學高精尖創新中心的研究人員正在北京的實驗室進行測試。(Wang Zhao/AFP via Getty Images) 【大紀元2026年11月02日訊】（大紀元記者江寒報導）近年來，中共治下的醫療系統，不論是臨床試驗當中的草菅人命，還是肆意篡改人類胚胎基因，乃至強迫摘取良心犯器官用於移植牟利等事件頻繁被曝光，美國正採取行動打擊中共黑暗的醫療系統。 2026年10月26日，美國財政部在《聯邦公報》上發布了實施《全面對外投資國家安全法案》（
content:
2020年5月14日，北京大學北京基因體學高精尖創新中心的研究人員正在北京的實驗室進行測試。(Wang Zhao/AFP via Getty Images)
【大紀元2026年11月02日訊】（大紀元記者江寒報導）近年來，中共治下的醫療系統，不論是臨床試驗當中的草菅人命，還是肆意篡改人類胚胎基因，乃至強迫摘取良心犯器官用於移植牟利等事件頻繁被曝光，美國正採取行動打擊中共黑暗的醫療系統。
2026年10月26日，美國財政部在《聯邦公報》上發布了實施《全面對外投資國家安全法案》（COINS法案）的擬議法規。擬議法規將禁止美國公民投資從事小分子、生物製劑、疫苗、細胞和基因療法及其遞送機制研發或生產的中國生物技術公司。
如果這項法規實施，幾乎所有中國創新藥物研發企業都將成為被禁止投資的外國實體。新規生效的日期很可能在2027年第一季度末左右。
在財政部提出這項提議之前，製藥行業對華府進行了數月的遊說，反對限制投資中國製藥企業。
近年，製藥巨頭和生物技術投資者越來越多地轉向中國藥物研發企業。今年，輝瑞、百時美施貴寶和羅氏等公司已與中國企業達成數十億美元的許可協議。2008年，在所有新啟動的創新藥物臨床試驗中，只有不到5%在中國進行。而在2025年，這一比例迅速增加到45%。
總部位於波士頓的生物技術初創公司InGel Therapeutics就是一個例子。該公司致力於治療一種罕見的遺傳性眼病。據彭博社報導，該公司一度只剩下100萬美元。而在美國做臨床試驗，成本可能高達1000萬到2000萬美元。於是他們去了中國，將這100萬美元投資於上海一家醫院組織的臨床試驗。預計明年初將公布結果。
歐美藥企湧向中國的原因是，這裡有廉價的臨床試驗和簡單的監督流程。麥肯錫估計，在中國，1期臨床試驗每位患者的成本約為全球基準的三分之一，試驗招募速度快2到5倍。
中國吸引歐美藥企的另外一個原因是，在這裡發起研究者發起臨床試驗（IIT）的手續也比較簡單，只需獲得醫院倫理委員會的批准，無需國家藥品監管機構的審批。相比之下，美國和歐洲的規定要嚴格得多，幾乎不可能以同樣的速度和成本開展IIT。
比如，在美國，進行人體試驗之前，首先實驗室和動物研究會評估安全性、毒性和基本藥代動力學。
第二步，向FDA提交研究性新藥（IND）申請。FDA有30天時間審查IND，以確保人體受試者不會面臨不合理的風險。
第三步，將方案、研究者手冊和招募材料提交給機構審查委員會（IRB）。所有患者在入組前都必須獲得倫理審查委員會的批准。每位參與者都必須審閱並簽署經IRB批准的知情同意書，其中詳細說明研究的風險、益處、程序以及隨時退出的權利。
第四步，在ClinicalTrials.gov上註冊試驗。
然而，中國廉價的臨床試驗成本和簡單的監管手續是有代價的。近幾個月來，中國臨床試驗中曝出多起死亡事件。
今年7月，《科學》雜誌報導說，一名6歲女孩患有影響神經發育的基因突變，於2025年3月在上海新華醫院接受了旨在糾正潛在缺陷的治療。幾天後，女孩因與治療相關的嚴重免疫反應而去世。
然而，上海交通大學研究人員就該研究發表在《自然》雜誌上的一篇論文並未提及上述死亡事件。該論文詳細介紹了這項療法的動物研究，該療法利用一種名為鹼基編輯的技術來精確改變單個DNA鹼基。據《科學》雜誌報導，該論文還忽略了早期猴子實驗中出現的令人擔憂的腎臟和肝臟問題。
今年8月，中國藥企輝大基因曝出另外一起死亡事件。該公司發布公告說，一名參與該公司臨床試驗的男孩死於急性呼吸窘迫綜合徵，原因是其對用於治療的病毒產生了嚴重的免疫反應。
去年，輝大基因首席執行官陸英明展示了全球首批CRISPR基因編輯技術治療杜氏肌營養不良症（一種難治性致命疾病）患兒的臨床試驗數據。美國類似的試驗因技術難題而擱淺，但輝大基因憑藉其「獨特」的監管途徑，迅速取得了進展。該途徑允許中國醫院在無需政府監管機構監督的情況下開展研究。
前兩名患者的治療結果並不理想，甚至無法確定這種療法是否有效。但陸英明仍然表示，數據顯示該療法可能有效，公司即將測試更高劑量。希望更高劑量能帶來更好的效果。
然而，在那次會議之後的15個月裡，這家總部位於上海的公司沒有再發布任何消息。去年夏天，陸英明悄然離職。在美國醫藥行業數字媒體STAT追蹤調查數月之後，該公司發布了患兒死亡的消息。
中國醫療行業違反倫理道德、漠視生命的行為屢見不鮮。
2018年11月，中國南方科技大學生物系副教授賀建奎及其團隊宣布，他們利用基因編輯技術，改造一對雙胞胎的胚胎細胞的CCR5基因，嘗試使嬰兒獲得對部分艾滋病具備免疫能力，並且這對雙胞胎已經降生。這是人類基因庫首次遭到人為篡改。
然而，11月26日，中共官媒人民網洋洋得意地宣稱賀建奎的行為「意味著中國在基因編輯技術用於疾病預防領域實現歷史性突破」，令科學界和社會震驚，因為基因編輯胚胎涉及仍未解決的倫理和技術問題。諾貝爾獎得主、逆轉錄酶發現者戴維·巴爾的摩代表第二屆人類基因組編輯國際峰會組委會發布聲明，譴責賀建奎的行為。
中國醫院喪失人倫道德的另外一個例子是，活摘良心犯器官用於移植牟利。
2021年6月，聯合國人權專家表示，他們已收到可靠信息，少數族裔、語言或宗教群體的被拘留者可能在未經知情同意的情況下被強制接受血液檢查和器官檢查，例如超聲波和X光檢查。據報道，這些檢查結果會被錄入一個活體器官來源數據庫，用於器官分配。
聯合國人權專家表示：「根據收到的指控，從囚犯身上摘取的最常見器官據稱是心臟、腎臟、肝臟、角膜，以及較少見的肺部。這種以醫療為目的的販運活動據稱涉及醫療行業的專業人員，包括外科醫生、麻醉師和其他醫學專家。」
2022年4月，《美國移植雜誌》發表了一項大規模的計算機文本分析，分析了1980年至2015年間發表在中國學術期刊上的2,838篇中文文章。分析顯示，中華人民共和國的移植外科醫生違反了國際公認的「死亡捐獻者」規則，即在捐獻者被宣布為「腦死亡」之前，摘取了包括心臟和肺在內的器官。
中共被廣泛指控為強摘器官的主要販運者和非法器官販運者。現有公開信息表明，法輪功學員是這種殘忍做法的主要受害者，被監禁的維吾爾族人和其他少數民族和宗教群體也是受害者。數據顯示，中國醫院進行的器官移植手術數量遠遠超過符合倫理的捐獻者數量所能達到的最高估計值。
9月28日，美參議院通過《法輪功及活摘器官受害者保護法案》（S.4009），對明知故犯、協助或負責在中國進行強迫摘取器官或販運器官的外國人，凍結其在美國境內的財產和禁止有關其財產權益的所有交易。對涉案人員甚至其家庭成員取消美國簽證和入境資格。
對於中國臨床試驗發生的死亡事件，美國食品藥品監督管理局（FDA）在9月份發出警告說，如果無法核實外國數據的收集方式是否符合該機構的標準，則可能拒絕批准某種藥物上市。該機構還計劃加強對早期外國研究的監管。
波士頓生物技術公司Ginkgo Bioworks Holdings, Inc.首席執行官、美國國家新興生物技術安全委員會前主席傑森·凱利告訴彭博社，FDA的政策可能會改變有意在中國開展早期研發的製藥公司的考量。
參與杜克臨床研究所研討會的專家指出，中國通過加快I期臨床試驗的速度以及降低成本，吸引美國生物技術公司前往開展早期研究。然而，對中國的依賴會削弱美國的早期臨床試驗能力，最終可能會影響美國患者獲得新藥的機會。
專家還指出，外國臨床試驗的質量和倫理道德合規性存在疑問。外國醫療組織和醫療服務模式跟美國之間的結構性差異——包括知情同意標準不一以及患者自主權受限——都會影響試驗數據的質量和完整性。在缺乏美國監管的機構中，很難核實其是否遵守良好臨床實踐（GCP）標準，而且提交給FDA的海外早期臨床試驗數據可能並不總是符合美國國內試驗的嚴格標準。
專家們鼓勵政府採取改革措施，促使臨床試驗迴流美國。最近，美國監管機構明確了I期臨床試驗的證據標準，並通過改進平臺認定降低了CMC（化學、製造和控制）的要求。
專家們還希望當局採取更多行動，包括簡化監管、規範場地運營、為國內早期投資創造財政激勵，包括採用稅收抵免、退稅或政府支持採購等金融機制。+

content:
香港金融峰会以人工智能欢迎晚宴开幕 |中国劳工公告栏
星期二, 3 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港金融峰会以人工智能欢迎晚宴拉开帷幕
香港2026年国际金融领袖投资峰会于11月2日以欢迎晚宴拉开帷幕，主题讨论涉及人工智能和机器人技术。财政司司长陈茂波和金管局总裁余伟文在周二的主要峰会和周三的峰会之前的活动上致辞
香港金融管理局（金管局）宣布，香港2026年国际金融领袖投资峰会于11月2日星期一以欢迎晚宴拉开帷幕。主要峰会将于周二上午举行，周三将举行题为“与国际投资者对话”的研讨会。
金管局在社交媒体上发帖称，今年峰会的主题是“拥抱变革，开辟新路”。晚宴以“科技向善”为主题，重点讨论香港和中国大陆蓬勃发展的科技生态系统。参与者探讨了人工智能 (AI) 和机器人技术如何重塑工作模式、创造新商机并改善日常生活。讨论还涵盖香港的研究能力以及下一波技术突破和投资机会的前景。
财政司司长陈茂波和金管局总裁余伟文在欢迎晚宴上致辞。圆桌讨论由红杉中国创始人兼管理合伙人沉南鹏主持。演讲嘉宾包括Moonshot AI创始人兼首席执行官杨志林和致远创新联合创始人、联席总裁兼中心研究负责人熊岩。
此次峰会汇聚了全球金融领袖，旨在讨论快速发展的技术领域的新兴趋势和投​​资前景。

Tuesday, 3 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong financial summit opens with AI-focused welcome dinner
Hong Kong's 2026 International Financial Leaders Investment Summit began with a welcome dinner on 2 November, featuring a keynote discussion on AI and robotics. Financial Secretary Paul Chan and HKMA Chief Executive Eddie Yue addressed the event, which precedes Tuesday's main summit and Wednesday's
Hong Kong's 2026 International Financial Leaders Investment Summit commenced with a welcome dinner on Monday 2 November, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) announced. The main summit will be held on Tuesday morning, followed by a seminar titled “Dialogue with International Investors” on Wednesday.
According to a social-media post by the HKMA, this year's summit is themed “Embrace Change, Forge a New Path”. The dinner featured a “Tech for Good” panel discussion focusing on the thriving technology ecosystems in Hong Kong and mainland China. Participants explored how artificial intelligence (AI) and robotics are reshaping work patterns, creating new business opportunities and improving daily life. The discussion also covered Hong Kong's research capabilities and prospects for the next wave of technological breakthroughs and investment opportunities.
Financial Secretary Paul Chan and HKMA Chief Executive Eddie Yue delivered addresses at the welcome dinner. The panel was moderated by Shen Nanpeng, founder and managing partner of Sequoia China. Speakers included Yang Zhilin, founder and chief executive of Moonshot AI, and Xiong Yan, co-founder, co-president and head of central research at Zhiyuan Innovation.
The summit, which brings together global financial leaders, aims to discuss emerging trends and investment prospects in the rapidly evolving technological landscape.

香港驻柏林贸易办事处于 10 月 28 日至 30 日在维也纳举行的工发组织论坛上展示了香港的绿色转型战略。黄文忠局长概述了香港在“一带一路”倡议下作为超级联系人的角色及其2050年气候行动计划的目标，包括逐步淘汰
香港驻柏林经济贸易办事处于10月28日至30日在奥地利维也纳举行的联合国工业发展组织（工发组织）论坛上推广香港的绿色转型经验。此次活动汇聚了来自世界各地的政策制定者、行业领袖和城市发展专家，分享关于可持续城市发展和绿色转型的见解。
10月29日（维也纳时间），香港驻柏林经济贸易办事处处长黄文忠参加小组讨论。他强调香港在“一带一路”倡议下的“超级联系人”和“超级增值者”角色。他还介绍了香港在《香港气候行动计划2050》下的低碳经济策略和进展。
黄先生表示：“我们设定了在2035年或之前逐步淘汰燃煤发电，并停止注册新的汽油动力私家车的目标。这些目标表明香港追求绿色转型和实现碳中和的决心。作为全球领先的国际金融中心和国际创新科技中心，香港在金融和创新方面的优势可以促进跨界别合作，从而加速绿色转型。”
访问期间，黄大使会见了中华人民共和国常驻联合国维也纳办事处等国际组织大使兼代表李松以及临时代办王涛。中国驻奥地利大使馆.他们就加强香港与奥地利的合作交换意见。
香港驻柏林经济贸易办事处是香港特别行政区政府在德国、奥地利、捷克共和国、匈牙利、波兰、斯洛伐克共和国、斯洛文尼亚和瑞士处理商业及其他经济贸易事宜的官方代表。

Hong Kong promotes green transition at UNIDO forum in Vienna | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 3 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong promotes green transition at UNIDO forum in Vienna
Hong Kong’s trade office in Berlin showcased the city’s green transition strategy at a UNIDO forum in Vienna from 28-30 October. Director Wong Man-chung outlined Hong Kong’s role as a super-connector under the Belt and Road Initiative and its Climate Action Plan 2050 targets, including phasing out c
The Hong Kong Economic and Trade Office in Berlin promoted the city’s green transition experience at a United Nations Industrial Development Organization (UNIDO) forum in Vienna, Austria, from 28 to 30 October. The event brought together policymakers, industry leaders and urban development experts from around the world to share insights on sustainable urban development and green transition.
On 29 October (Vienna time), Hong Kong Economic and Trade Office in Berlin Director Wong Man-chung took part in a panel discussion. He highlighted Hong Kong’s role as a “super-connector” and “super-value-adder” under the Belt and Road Initiative. He also introduced the city’s strategy and progress towards a low-carbon economy under the Hong Kong’s Climate Action Plan 2050.
Wong said: “We have set targets to phase out coal-fired power generation by or before 2035, and to stop registering new petrol-powered private cars. These targets demonstrate Hong Kong’s determination to pursue green transition and achieve carbon neutrality. As a leading global international financial centre and international innovation and technology hub, Hong Kong’s strengths in finance and innovation can facilitate cross-sector collaboration, thereby accelerating the green transition.”
During his visit, Wong met with Li Song, Ambassador and Permanent Representative of the People’s Republic of China to the United Nations Office at Vienna and other international organisations, as well as Wang Tao, Chargé d’Affaires a.i. of the Chinese Embassy in Austria. They exchanged views on strengthening cooperation between Hong Kong and Austria.
The Hong Kong Economic and Trade Office in Berlin is the official representative of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government in commercial and other economic and trade matters in Germany, Austria, the Czech Republic, Hungary, Poland, the Slovak Republic, Slovenia and Switzerland.

title: Iran engages US in 'intensive' negotiations to avert fresh war outbreak
zh_title: 伊朗与美国进行“密集”谈判以避免新的战争爆发
summary: [伊朗](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/iran/)周一证实，它已与华盛顿进行“密集”交流，并提出在严格的条件下重新开放[霍尔木兹海峡](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/strait-of-hormuz/)，因为努力升级[以避免重返战争](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261102-iran-warns-renewed-war-with-us-could-outlast-previous-conflict)。外交部长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇表示，间接谈判正在通过调解人进行。 [中国](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/china/)也敦促重返谈判，而伊朗安全负责人
content:
[伊朗](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/iran/)周一证实，它已与华盛顿进行“密集”交流，并提出在严格的条件下重新开放[霍尔木兹海峡](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/strait-of-hormuz/)，因为努力升级[以避免重返战争](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261102-iran-warns-renewed-war-with-us-could-outlast-previous-conflict)。

外交部长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇表示，间接谈判正在通过调解人进行。 [中国](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/china/)也敦促重返谈判，而伊朗安全负责人则与俄罗斯总统[弗拉基米尔·普京](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/vladimir-putin/)讨论了冲突。

因伊朗封锁霍尔木兹海峡能源走廊而导致油价飙升的油价周一下跌逾 6%，原因是人们对结束八个月冲突的措施持乐观态度。

阿拉格奇在接受官方伊斯兰通讯社的视频采访时表示：“鉴于当前局势的敏感性和严重性，磋商和审议非常密集。”

“[卡塔尔](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/qatar/) 和[巴基斯坦](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/pakistan/) 在这些谈判中发挥着非常积极的调解作用。”
据 Axios 新闻媒体报道，美国副总统 JD 万斯 (JD Vance)(https://www.france24.com/en/tag/jd-vance/) 已致函最高国家安全委员会秘书 Mohsen Rezaei，讨论可能举行的新会谈，这是数月来最高级别的举动。

阅读更多[特朗普称美国可能对伊朗发动“另一次小型史诗般的愤怒”攻击](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261023-trump-says-us-may-launch-another-little-epic-fury-attack-iran)

在周二的[美国中期选举](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/us-midterm-elections/)之前，加倍外交努力，对战争和燃油价格上涨的不满正在给美国总统[唐纳德·特朗普](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/donald-trump/)的共和党人带来压力。

民主党预计将赢得至少部分国会控制权，并在两年内首次对特朗普施加政治限制。

伊朗第一副总统穆罕默德·礼萨·阿雷夫表示，从美国收到的信息是“对我们胜利的认可”。

据伊朗伊斯兰通讯社报道，他说：“我们的敌人在过去两场战争中都未能实现其任何目标。即使在今天，尽管美国出于自身目标和国内舆论的担忧，正在采取各种行动，但通过中间人向伊朗传达的信息表明我们承认我们的胜利。”

但特朗普继续对伊朗发出威胁，他在一次竞选集会上表示，“在某个时候，我们将不得不向他们敲击”。
##“善意的方法”

一名伊朗高级官员表示，德黑兰准备在两天内开放霍尔木兹海峡，这是能源丰富的海湾地区的出口高速公路——只要华盛顿同意其要求清单。

9月，如果美国同意包括结束所有战线的战争、解冻伊朗资产、解除石油供应等要求，伊朗提出了[为期七天的重新开放海峡计划](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20260927-trump-expects-iran-talks-next-week-after-rejecting-seven-day-truce-proposal) [制裁](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/sanctions/)并结束对伊朗港口的反封锁。

外交部表示：“两天内实施该计划的可能性再次表明了伊朗的诚意。”

[Iran](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/iran/) on Monday confirmed it has engaged Washington in "intensive" exchanges and has offered to reopen the [Strait of Hormuz](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/strait-of-hormuz/) under strict conditions, as efforts escalate[to avert a return to war](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261102-iran-warns-renewed-war-with-us-could-outlast-previous-conflict).

Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said indirect talks were taking place via mediators. [China](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/china/) also urged a return to negotiations, while Iran's security chief discussed the conflict with Russian President [Vladimir Putin](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/vladimir-putin/).

Oil prices– sent rocketing by Iran's blockade of the Strait of Hormuz energy corridor– dropped more than six percent on Monday, optimistic over steps to halt the eight-month-old conflict.

"Given the sensitivity and gravity of the current situation, consultations and deliberations are very intensive," Araghchi said in a video interview with the official IRNA news agency.

"[Qatar](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/qatar/) and [Pakistan](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/pakistan/) are playing a very active mediating role in these negotiations."

The Axios news outlet reported that US Vice President [JD Vance](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/jd-vance/) had sent a letter to Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council Mohsen Rezaei about possible new talks, marking the highest-level move in months.

Read more[Trump says US may launch ‘another little Epic Fury’ attack on Iran](https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20261023-trump-says-us-may-launch-another-little-epic-fury-attack-iran)

The redoubled diplomatic push comes ahead of Tuesday's [US midterm elections](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/us-midterm-elections/), where dissatisfaction over the war and higher fuel prices are weighing on US President [Donald Trump](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/donald-trump/)'s Republicans.

Democrats expect to win at least partial control of Congress and impose political constraints on Trump for the first time in two years.

Iran's First Vice President Mohammad Reza Aref said the messages received from the US were "an acknowledgement of our victory".

"Our enemy failed to achieve any of its objectives in the last two wars. Even today, although the United States, driven by its own goals and concerns regarding domestic public opinion, is engaging in various manoeuvres, the messages conveyed to Iran through intermediaries point to an acknowledgment of our victory," he said, according to IRNA.

But Trump kept up his threats against Iran, telling a campaign rally that at "some point we're going to have to give them the hammer".

## 'Good-faith approach'

A senior Iranian official said Tehran was ready to open Hormuz, the export highway for the energy-rich Gulf, within two days– as long as Washington agrees to its list of demands.

In September, Iran proposed [a seven-day plan to reopen the strait](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20260927-trump-expects-iran-talks-next-week-after-rejecting-seven-day-truce-proposal) if the US agreed to demands including ending the war on all fronts, unfreezing Iranian assets, lifting oil [sanctions](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/sanctions/) and ending its counter-blockade of Iranian ports.

"The possibility of implementing this plan in two days is another indication of Iran's good-faith approach," foreign ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei told reporters at a briefing.

"We have stated that, if Iran's demands are met, it would be possible to restore security to the Strait of Hormuz and resume the negotiating process within a short period."

Baghaei said "everything depends" on the US side accepting the Iranian demands.

"Only then can we discuss the subsequent stages," he added.

Chinese President [Xi Jinping](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/xi-jinping/) discussed the war with [Oman](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/oman/)'s Sultan Haitham bin Tariq in [Beijing](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/beijing/) on Monday– the first visit to China by the Gulf nation's head of state since diplomatic ties were established.

"The two sides called for resolving disputes through political and diplomatic means, urging the United States and Iran to pursue a peaceful path, achieve a ceasefire (and) prevent war entirely," an Omani statement said.

China also held meetings with Iranian and Saudi officials in Beijing on Monday.

Beijing supports Tehran in "safeguarding its own sovereignty and security", Foreign Minister Wang Yi told Ali Bagheri, deputy secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, according to a Chinese statement.

Bagheri told Wang that "Tehran's stance on defending its national security, sovereignty, and territorial integrity remains unchanged, and that Iran will make no compromises in this regard", according to state TV.

Russian President Putin also spoke with Iran's security chief Mohsen Rezaei about the war by telephone, Iranian state media said.

## 'Powerful response'

In an interview with [Al Jazeera](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/al-jazeera-1/) released on Sunday, Araghchi said Washington must accept a new route agreed between Iran and [Oman](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/oman/) for transiting the Strait.

He said the US must also remove sanctions imposed in recent months and reduce American troop numbers in the region.

Washington has since August rolled out a fresh raft of sanctions, part of what it called "economic asphyxiation" of Iran.

American and Israeli threats to Iran rose in the run-up to the midterms and last week's elections in [Israel](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/israel/), where Prime Minister [Benjamin Netanyahu](https://www.france24.com/en/tag/benjamin-netanyahu/)[failed to secure a majority](https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261026-israeli-candidate-eisenkot-pledges-to-unite-israelis-as-netanyahu-deems-him-soft-on-iran).

On Saturday, Trump said he still had to "take care" of one or two targets including Pickaxe mountain in central Iran, a suspected nuclear site which Tehran denies is such a facility.

"Any act of aggression against Iran, any military attack against Iran, by whatever means, will be met with a powerful, immediate and comprehensive response from us," Baghaei said.

_(FRANCE 24 with AFP)_

title: 德國生活成本抗議演變成暴力事件 商店遭洗劫
summary: Play video, "Protesters clash with police and shops looted in Germany", 節目全長 0,55 Author, 陳傑銘（James Chater） 德國金融中心法蘭克福（Frankfurt）市中心爆發關於生活成本問題的衝突，騷亂者洗劫商店。 衝突發生在星期六（10月31日）深夜。除法蘭克福外，首都柏林（Berlin）、科隆（Cologne）和漢堡（Hamburg）也發生暴力事件。警方表示，他們使用高壓水炮驅散
content:
Play video, "Protesters clash with police and shops looted in Germany", 節目全長 0,55
Author, 陳傑銘（James Chater）
德國金融中心法蘭克福（Frankfurt）市中心爆發關於生活成本問題的衝突，騷亂者洗劫商店。
衝突發生在星期六（10月31日）深夜。除法蘭克福外，首都柏林（Berlin）、科隆（Cologne）和漢堡（Hamburg）也發生暴力事件。警方表示，他們使用高壓水炮驅散以煙花、石塊和瓶子攻擊緊急救援人員的示威者。
當天稍早，數千人參加了大致和平的示威活動。這些示威由倡議團體 Gen Z regelt——意為「Gen Z接管一切」——所組織，抗議學校資金不足、生活成本高企、公共開支削減以及兵役制度。
德國的動盪發生之前，法國也曾爆發由年輕人主導的大規模抗議；星期六當天，法國有超過32萬人參與示威。
德國內政部長亞歷山大·多布林特（Alexander Dobrindt）星期日（11月1日）接受《圖片報》（Bild）訪問時表示，警方在夜間阻止了「近幾週巴黎所見的那種暴力行為」，並呼籲對參與騷亂和搶掠的人施以「嚴厲懲罰」。
警方於夜間封鎖了法蘭克福主要購物街的大部分區域。一名警方發言人表示，當地已有多人被捕。
法蘭克福、慕尼黑（Munich）和柏林當局表示，示威人數最多約為1.8萬人，大約只有主辦方網站估計人數的一半。德國媒體稱，星期六全國各城市共有數萬人參與抗議。
Gen Z regelt發言人莉娜·弗里德里希（Lina Friedrich）表示，這些示威活動是「為和平與自由而抗爭，而不是為戰爭與強制措施而抗爭」。
台灣新北市長選戰：「政二代」蘇巧慧對決「專業副手」李四川，誰能拿下藍綠關鍵一城？
她說：「對我們而言，最重要的是為醫療及教育體系提供更好的支援。我們反對強制兵役，支持更公平地分擔負擔。」
圖像加註文字，法蘭克福警方拘留一名打扮成蝙蝠俠的示威者。
法蘭克福警方星期六晚表示，市中心正在發生「暴力騷亂」，並已部署特別警察部隊。
警方表示，多家商店櫥窗被砸毀，且有人向緊急救援人員投擲汽油彈。
官員表示，一家槍械店的櫥窗被砸毀，他們在逮捕一名嫌疑人後查獲兩件武器。另有民眾闖入其他商店，偷走運動鞋及其他物品。
黑森州（Hesse）內政部長羅曼·波塞克（Roman Poseck）表示，大約100名「表明身份的極左翼極端分子」滲透到該市的抗議活動中。他補充說，抗議最終以這樣的方式收場，「令人羞愧」。
波塞克說：「我們腦海中都有來自法國的那些畫面：搶掠、焚燒房屋、焚燒警車，以及襲擊警員⋯⋯法國不應在這方面被視為榜樣。」
圖像加註文字，示威者試圖砸破法蘭克福一家販售武器商店的櫥窗。
德國其他城市也出現類似情況，而稍早的示威大多維持和平。
科隆警方表示，在中央火車站附近有警員遭襲，有人投擲瓶子，還有人將一輛單車拋向警方。
科隆警察局長約翰內斯·赫爾曼斯（Johannes Hermanns）表示：「那些希望為自己的未來和平示威的年輕人，今天卻被除了暴力別無目的的極端分子滲透，這令人深感痛心。」
柏林警方表示，當日晚間一場規模較小的示威活動——此前白天曾舉行更大型抗議——導致27名警員受傷，最多56人被暫時拘留。
在漢堡，身穿黑衣的人燃放煙花並焚燒路障；公共廣播機構北德廣播公司（NDR）報導稱，有120人被捕。
德國的抗議活動與歐洲其他地區的大規模示威發生在同一天。
在法國，超過32萬人連續第三個週末參加遍及全國各城市、整體上大致和平的示威活動，要求政府就高生活成本及公共服務不足採取行動，尤其是教育領域的問題。
全國部署了數千名警員應對示威，在部分城市，警方向示威者發射催淚氣體。
在圖盧茲（Toulouse）、里昂（Lyon）和馬賽（Marseille）發生衝突後，共有超過500人被捕。
Play video, "Thousands demonstrate in Paris as protests spread across Europe", 節目全長 1,01
音頻加註文字，數千人在巴黎示威，抗議活動蔓延至歐洲各地。（英語影片）
法國內政部長洛朗·努涅斯（Laurent Nuñez）表示，一名警員被汽油彈炸傷，其後法國檢察官以企圖謀殺罪名展開調查。
法國抗議活動組織者「黃背心」（Gilet Jaune）表示，近期國內各地近期示威中有數十名示威者重傷，其中許多人是被「手榴彈」所傷。
今年10月初，在一名15歲少年被炸斷手掌後，法國暫停在處理學生示威時使用震撼彈。
意大利也爆發抗議活動，在羅馬（Rome）和都靈（Turin），警方與示威者發生一些衝突。
在葡萄牙里斯本（Lisbon），警方清理了一處新搭建的帳篷營地。此前，數千人遊行抗議一項租屋法案，他們認為該法案可能加劇當地住房危機。在過去十年裏，葡萄牙房價已上升超過一倍。
近來，以年輕人為主的示威者已走上多個歐洲國家的街頭，包括法國、比利時、愛爾蘭、西班牙、葡萄牙、意大利、希臘、塞爾維亞和阿爾巴尼亞。
雖然各國提出的具體訴求有所不同，但示威者大多聚焦於生活成本問題，例如住房可負擔性、教育質素以及公共服務削減等議題。
French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said a police officer had been injured by a molotov cocktail and French prosecutors later launched an attempted murder probe.
Police in Paris said several hundred rioters had attacked security forces with projectiles.
French protest organisers, the Gilet Jaune, or Yellow Vests, have said dozens of protesters have been seriously injured during recent demonstrations across the country, with many hurt by "grenades".
France suspended the use of stun grenades for policing student protests in early October after a 15-year-old's hand was blown off.
Protests also took place in Italy, with some clashes between police and demonstrators in Rome and Turin.
In Portugal, police moved to clear a new tent camp assembled after thousands marched to protest against a rental bill that they argue could worsen a housing crisis in the country, where house prices have more than doubled over the past decade.
Mostly young protesters have recently taken to the streets in a swathe of European nations: France, Belgium, Ireland, Spain, Portugal, Italy, Greece, Serbia and Albania.
While the specific demands vary from country to country, the protesters have largely focused on cost-of-living issues, such as access to housing, the quality of education and cuts to public services.

content:

西非国家塞内加尔经过历时8年的等待，迎来了2026年青年奥林匹克运动会这场体育盛事。10月31日星期六在达喀尔（Dakar）举行的开幕式令人印象深刻,难以忘却。这是本台法广非洲组（RFI Afrique）和体育组(RFI Sport)今天（2026年11月01日星期天）法文报道的关注焦点之一。其中之一是本台法广（RFI）特派记者（envoyé spécial）发自塞内加尔新城Diamniadio的现场报道。这一为期两周，从10月31日周六开始计划一直举行到11月13日星期五的青年奥运盛会在非洲体育史上具有重要意义。

发表时间： 01/11/2026 - 22:05 更改时间： 01/11/2026 - 22:55

14 分钟 浏览时间

JOJ (Jeux olympiques de la jeunesse) Dakar 2026;
YOG (Youth Olympic Games) Dakar 2026;
2026年达喀尔青年奥林比克运动会。](https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/e3dc80a4-d632-11f1-9ff6-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-01-D-FMM-Image-Afrique-JOJ-Dakar-S%C3%A9n%C3%A9gal-YOG-archive-RFI.jpg)

 Image d'archive / JOJ (Jeux olympiques de la jeunesse) Dakar 2026; YOG (Youth Olympic Games) Dakar 2026; 2026年达喀尔青年奥林比克运动会。 © rfi fulfulde

综合本台[非洲](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/)组（RFI Afrique）和体育组(RFI Sport)在过去24小时里刊出的多篇法文报道，法国国际广播电台（RFI）法语[世界体育]《[Mondial Sports](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/podcasts/mondial-sports/)》栏目在[塞内加尔](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E5%85%B3%E9%94%AE%E8%AF%8D/%E5%A1%9E%E5%86%85%E5%8A%A0%E5%B0%94/)(le [Sénégal](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/tag/s%C3%A9n%C3%A9gal/))首都达喀尔（Dakar）设点，为在[非洲](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E9%97%9C%E9%8D%B5%E8%A9%9E/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/)举办的首届奥运会（第四届夏季青年奥林匹克运动会）推波助澜、营造氛围。本台法广（RFI）法语特派记者Christophe Diremszian，在Diamniadio进行现场报道。

[![Image 2: Image d'archive / le Sénégal : JOJ (Jeux olympiques de la jeunesse) Dakar 2026; YOG (Youth Olympic Games) Dakar 2026; 存档图片 / 塞内加尔：达喀尔2026青年奥林比克运动会，10月31日星期六的开幕仪式照片。](https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/e3dc80a4-d632-11f1-9ff6-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/2026-11-01-D-FMM-Image-Afrique-JOJ-Dakar-S%C3%A9n%C3%A9gal-YOG-archive-RFI.jpg) Image d'archive / le Sénégal : JOJ (Jeux olympiques de la jeunesse) Dakar 2026; YOG (Youth Olympic Games) Dakar 2026; 存档图片 / 塞内加尔：达喀尔2026青年奥林比克运动会，10月31日星期六的开幕仪式照片。 © rfi fulfulde](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/20261101-rfi%E6%B3%95%E5%BB%A3-%E5%B0%BC%E5%8F%A4%E6%8B%89-%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2-%E9%81%94%E5%96%80%E7%88%BE2026%E9%9D%92%E5%A5%A7%E6%9C%83%E9%9B%A3%E5%BF%98%E7%9A%84%E9%96%8B%E5%B9%95%E5%BC%8F)
**--****达喀尔****2026****青奥会****在****非洲体育史上****具有****重要意义****--**

贝宁（le Bénin）作家Frédéric Sohounde讲述这场盛会在[非洲](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/)体育史上的重要意义。他是[塞内加尔](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E9%97%9C%E9%8D%B5%E8%A9%9E/%E5%A1%9E%E5%85%A7%E5%8A%A0%E7%88%BE/)L'Harmattan出版社发行的《[非洲](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E5%85%B3%E9%94%AE%E8%AF%8D/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/)挑战：从自行车运动到非洲国家杯，向达喀尔2026进发》（Défis africains, du cyclisme à la CAN, cap sur Dakar 2026）一书的作者。

[![Image 3: 非洲体育 / 达喀尔2026青年奥林匹克运动会。 Le logo des JO lors de la cérémonie d'ouverture des JOJ 2026 au Sénégal, le samedi 31 octobre 2026.](https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/09a0e508-d568-11f1-b656-a575454bc579/w:1024/AP26304724782988.jpg) 非洲体育 / 达喀尔2026青年奥林匹克运动会。 Le logo des JO lors de la cérémonie d'ouverture des JOJ 2026 au Sénégal, le samedi 31 octobre 2026. © AP Photo/Sylvain Cherkaoui](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/tag/joj-dakar-2026/)
此外，塞内加尔篮球界的两位传奇运动员：法图·科内·恩迪亚耶（Fatou Koné Ndiaye）和乔·洛佩兹（Joe Lopez）也将向他们的接班人，那些来自非洲乃至全球各地、正蓄势待发准备在达喀尔大放异彩的青年们，分享他们的经验与智慧。

-- **达喀尔****2026****青奥会****开幕式在舆论中受到一致好评****--**

另外，本台法广体育组（RFI Sport）今天（2026年11月01号星期日）以{[令人难以置信（**Incroyable****）、**精彩绝伦（**géniale**）、充满魔力**（****magique**）：青年奥林匹克运动会开幕式令人难忘]为标题，描述在以塞内加尔前总统阿卜杜拉耶·瓦德（[Abdoulaye Wade Stadium](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/sports/20261101-incroyable-g%C3%A9niale-magique-la-c%C3%A9r%C3%A9monie-d-ouverture-des-joj-a-marqu%C3%A9-les-esprits)）命名的体育场举行的青年奥林匹克运动会开幕式，巧妙融合了塞内加尔本土文化、非洲文化与奥林匹克元素，令现场观众、运动员和志愿者们赞叹不已；大家一致使用[令人难以相信]（**incroyable**）及[充满魔力]（**magique**）等词语来形容这场盛会。

[![Image 4: L'union africaine chantée à la cérémonie d'ouverture des JOJ](https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/fb9b2d4c-d562-11f1-91a9-a575454bc579/w:1024/AP26304698753634.jpg) L'union africaine chantée à la cérémonie d'ouverture des JOJ AP Photo/Sylvain Cherkaoui - Sylvain Cherkaoui](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/sports/20261101-incroyable-g%C3%A9niale-magique-la-c%C3%A9r%C3%A9monie-d-ouverture-des-joj-a-marqu%C3%A9-les-esprits)
在塞内加尔首都达喀尔（Dakar）的本台法广（RFI）特派记者（envoyé spécial）报道说，11岁的Yacoub在体育场草坪上与家人分享着喜悦，此处距离圣火台仅几米之遥。他的双眼依然闪烁着光芒——那是孩子们在亲眼见证了极其宏大的场面后，才会流露出的神采。“太不可思议了！”他惊叹道。哪他最喜欢的是那个环节呢？就此，他毫不犹豫地回答：“点燃圣火的那一刻。”本次体育盛会的奥运圣火在几分钟之前，是由塞内加尔年轻的柔道运动员Aïcha Diop亲手点燃的。冈比亚代表团的15岁游泳女运动员Fatou Sabally睁大着双眼，目光充满了惊叹。她反复说道：“太满意了”（Tellement contente）。

[![Image 5: elsa lepinay will carry the French flag at the opening ceremony of the 2026 Youth Olympic Games in Dakar on 31 October](https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/62d7eeb4-c71c-11f1-bd8f-77317c09f325/w:1024/elsa-1.png) elsa lepinay will carry the French flag at the opening ceremony of the 2026 Youth Olympic Games in Dakar on 31 October © CNOSF](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/CNOSF)
对法国的两名旗手（porte-drapeau）:Raphaël de Boussac和Elsa Lepinay来说也一样。法国的这位海岸赛艇（l'aviron de mer.）运动员表示：这太棒了,这充满了魔力，一个令人难忘的时刻（_c’était génial, c’était magique, un moment inoubliable_ _._）”
