人们在乌克兰基辅参加集会，手持标语，要求建立人道主义走廊，以便将赫尔松地区奥莱什基(Oleshky)镇的乌克兰平民撤离出来。(2026年10月6日)

美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普(Melania Trump)斡旋的一项局部停火于星期二(10月27日)凌晨在俄罗斯占领的乌克兰城市奥列什基周边生效，为开展援助行动扫清了道路。与此同时，俄罗斯导弹在夜间袭击了基辅和其他城市。

停火于基辅时间凌晨3时开始，比原定时间提前两天，双方官员均证实停火得到遵守。乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基(Volodymyr Zelenskyy)所属政党的议会党团领袖达维德·阿拉哈米亚(David Arakhamia)在电报(Telegram)平台上表示，停火将持续至基辅时间11月1日晚上10时59分。他称，这是2022年以来最大规模的局势降温行动。

代表基辅方面主持谈判的乌克兰人权事务专员德米特罗·卢比涅茨(Dmytro Lubinets)表示，根据协议，援助物资将在任何撤离行动开始前运抵该市。他告诉美联社，必须首先清除通往该市道路上的地雷。克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫(Dmitry Peskov)说，撤出有意离开的居民预计需要数天时间。奥列什基战前人口约为2.4万，目前仍有多达2000人居住，当地已经断电、停止供暖和自来水供应。

梅拉尼娅·特朗普星期六表示，这项行动“能得到教宗的支持，真是太好了”。教宗良十四世(Pope Leo XIV)此前一直敦促停火，并于10月16日致电克里姆林宫，要求普京安排在奥列什基停火。

第一夫人还表示，希望“一切按计划进行”。唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)总统赞扬了第一夫人发挥的作用，说：“我认为，她现在比专业人士做得还好。”

赫尔松州乌克兰控制区的官员报告说，星期二当地出现了罕见的平静。不过，赫尔松市军事行政长官雅罗斯拉夫·尚科(Yaroslav Shanko)敦促保持谨慎。他对美联社说：“让我们拭目以待，因为不能相信敌人，尤其是俄罗斯人。”

停火仅适用于南部战线的部分地区，其他地方的战斗仍在继续。据基辅市政府官员说，星期一凌晨3时刚过，俄罗斯对基辅发动弹道导弹袭击，击中一所大学校园，造成一人死亡、12人受伤。泽连斯基表示，俄罗斯在这轮夜间袭击中向11个州发射了16枚弹道导弹和280多架无人机。他特别指出，对首都南部大桥的袭击是“一次严重升级”。

哈尔科夫市长伊霍尔·捷列霍夫(Ihor Terekhov)在Telegram上写道，前一天的俄罗斯袭击造成该市两人死亡。第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克州州长亚历山大·汉扎(Oleksandr Hanzha)说，在巴甫洛赫拉德，一次无人机袭击造成一人死亡、10人受伤。

在其他事态发展方面，星期一发布的一份联合国报告说，俄罗斯针对乌克兰电网的持续攻击构成战争罪和危害人类罪。这份报告由联合国人权理事会设立的独立调查委员会发布，指出停电导致数百万人在严寒的冬季失去供暖。

俄罗斯常驻联合国代表团拒绝承认该委员会的权限，并称报告依据的是“伪造的数据”。

俄罗斯当局报告说，乌克兰无人机对布良斯克的袭击造成一人死亡。扎波罗热州俄控区的官员说，一辆公共汽车遭袭，造成一人死亡、30人受伤。美国之音(VOA)无法独立核实这两项报告。

同样在星期二，芬兰总统亚历山大·斯图布(Alexander Stubb)和挪威首相约纳斯·加尔·斯特勒(Jonas Gahr Stoere)与普京通了电话。这是西方领导人与克里姆林宫之间一次罕见的直接接触。斯图布在一份声明中称，这次谈话“坦诚且具有实质性”。

克里姆林宫随后表示，只有俄罗斯的“正当利益”得到“充分且无条件的考虑”，才有可能实现持久和平。泽连斯基在两位领导人与普京通话后与他们交谈，并在X上写道：“必须实现和平，需要缓和局势，俄罗斯必须停止拖延战争。”

title: 台灣「九合一」選舉五大看點：「洋流」能否撼動台北？誰在卡位2028大選？
summary: 圖像來源，AFP via Getty Images 圖像加註文字，學者出身的沈伯洋（中）聲勢看漲，在台灣前總統蔡英文（左一）及現任總統賴清德（右）支持下挑戰台北市長。 * * Author, 呂嘉鴻 * Role, BBC中文記者 * Published 2026年10月28日凌晨2時00分 最近更新： 18 分鐘前 * 閱讀時間: 5 分鐘 台灣「九合一」地方選舉將於11月底舉行，台北「首都」之戰，執政民進黨候選人沈伯洋異軍突起，與代表國民黨的現任市長蔣萬安在民調中互有高下
content:
圖像來源，AFP via Getty Images

圖像加註文字，學者出身的沈伯洋（中）聲勢看漲，在台灣前總統蔡英文（左一）及現任總統賴清德（右）支持下挑戰台北市長。

*       *   Author, 呂嘉鴻
    *   Role, BBC中文記者

*   Published 2026年10月28日凌晨2時00分

最近更新： 18 分鐘前
*   閱讀時間: 5 分鐘

台灣「九合一」地方選舉將於11月底舉行，台北「首都」之戰，執政民進黨候選人沈伯洋異軍突起，與代表國民黨的現任市長蔣萬安在民調中互有高下。

由於台北市長一直是台灣總統大位「跳板」，使這場選戰成為關注熱點。

此外，在海峽另一端，北京同樣出手。近日，大陸國台辦公開抨擊沈伯洋為「台獨頑固份子」並點名其家人。

中共是否介入台灣選舉？ 這次選舉將如何影響賴清德與國民黨主席鄭麗文的政治能量？捲土重來、希望藉著地方議員選舉有所斬獲的小黨，此次結盟能否在主流政黨夾殺中突圍而出？

BBC中文採訪台灣議題專家，整理出此次選舉值得關注的五大看點。

圖像來源，Gene Wang/Getty Images

圖像加註文字，蔣萬安表示台北市政府執政團隊戰戰兢兢，但他也坦言此次對手挑戰頗大，因此呼籲市民繼續支持他連任。

## 看點一：「洋流」海嘯，還是曇花一現？

身兼立法委員和台北大學副教授的沈伯洋，選情從不被看好到明顯回升，在台灣政壇掀起千層浪，輿論稱為「洋流」現象。

事實上，根據台灣[TVBS民調中心](https://news.tvbs.com.tw/politics/4033527)10月初公布的調查，蔣萬安支持度為49%、沈伯洋為41%，雙方差距已從今年5月下旬約28個百分點，大幅縮小至8個百分點，台北選情愈發激烈。而新成立的台北信民兩岸研究協會10月[20日公布](https://taipeishinmin.wixsite.com/ttda/%E9%9B%99%E5%8C%97%E6%B0%91%E8%AA%BF20261020)的台北市長選舉民調中，沈伯洋以50.3%支持度領先蔣萬安的33.3%。

兩份民調何以南轅北轍？

信民協會贊助人曹興誠為知名綠營支持者，與沈伯洋同被中國列為「台獨頑固份子」；TVBS舊稱無線衛星電視台，曾是香港無線電視（TVB）子公司，台灣輿論傾向將其視為「親藍」媒體。

對此，台灣資深媒體人黃暐瀚稱「民調是一時一地，可以注意，不必在意。」但他又說，這幾次台北市民調結果，沈伯洋攀升而蔣萬安下滑的「趨勢」浮現。

外界開始聚焦：這股動能是否能真正「破圈」、外溢到其他縣市，並轉化為實質投票？

而面對「洋流」聲勢，蔣萬安陣營以市政成績回應。

他在台灣政論節目呼籲支持者「勇敢站出來」，並肯定自己執掌台北市政府四年來的政績。他還數次強調台北市在「幸福城市」評比連續兩年獲得六都第一，團隊一路走來都抱持「戰戰兢兢」的態度。

台灣台北大學公共行政暨政策學系劉嘉薇教授向BBC中文分析，沈伯洋「這股選情的提升是否可以轉化成支持度，還需要進一步觀察。」

劉嘉薇解釋，原因是政治冷漠的選民未必瞭解沈伯洋，但熱衷政治的選民對相關事件相當熟悉：「他們記得沈伯洋過去在『大罷免』的積極參與、在立法院問政時的『肢體衝突』的形象，以及鮮明的『台獨』立場。」

然而，一位戶籍在大安區，在外商會計事務所上班的黃小姐則向BBC中文表示，她這次會把選票投給沈伯洋，原因是「沈先生在政策論述及配套措施清楚並有說服力。作為一個挑戰者，有備而來。」

黃小姐說，在兒童虐待及食安等問題，她對現任市府團隊失去信心。

相反地，一位居住在紐約的台僑接受台灣自媒體[採訪](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3uqaJHyhf98)說，他一定會回台灣投給蔣萬安，他認為蔣萬安對台北市的發展很有想法，另一位在法拉盛受訪的移居美國的女士也強調，台北市政府在蔣萬安領導下行政效率高，值得她信任。

圖像來源，Getty Images

圖像加註文字，有分析認為，此次選舉是國民黨主席鄭麗文在黨內展現實力的第一次大考。

## 看點二：北京會介入台灣地方選舉嗎？

研究認知作戰以及境外勢力的分析人士指出，AI深偽、假訊息、社交媒體定向攻擊特定候選人、假民調、經濟利誘等，是常見的[境外勢力介入](https://www.bbc.com/zhongwen/trad/chinese-news-67832273)其他國家或對手的手段。

中國大陸國務院台灣事務辦公室也在最近出招。

據官媒新華社[報導](https://www.news.cn/20261014/a31d192fe26c421e9300aaf902ef6355/c.html)，國台辦發言人陳斌華在10月14日答問直接點名沈伯洋的父親，稱其為躲避制裁，以另一家公司名義，繼續同中國大陸相關企業做生意，「從中謀取經濟利益。」

陳斌華稱：「沈伯洋一邊鼓噪『反中抗中』、阻礙兩岸交流合作，一邊會同親屬想方設法從大陸賺錢，醜陋行徑令人不齒。」

對此，美國智庫太平洋論壇（Pacific Forum）兼任資深研究員藍若思教授（Elizabeth Larus）向BBC中文指出，她訪問的親民進黨學者與社運人士，以及台北國防部的一些官員表示，中共正運用「認知作戰」來影響台灣選民。

藍若思說，她的研究對象向她表示中共已建立超過100個假新聞網站，企圖影響選舉。

「這些網站刻意在選民心中播下疑慮，質疑美國是否會支持或防衛台灣，或是操弄選民對『抵抗中國是徒勞無功』的恐懼，藉此促使選民拒絕民進黨候選人。」她說。

圖像來源，Puma Shen Meta

圖像加註文字，沈伯洋本月在台北市的造勢活動

美國哈佛大學政府系講師索羅卡博士 （George Soroka）過去[曾向BBC中文表示](https://www.bbc.com/zhongwen/trad/chinese-news-69299138)，所謂「非民主」國家部署的宣傳攻勢向來要更凌厲許多。

他觀察到北京採用了許多與莫斯科相似手法，特別是近年利用對過往歷史事件的選擇性解讀，來增加其對台灣和南海等地區主張的合理性。

台灣事實查核中心（TFC）2025年也出版一[份調查報告](https://en.tfc-taiwan.org.tw/shadows-of-doubt-disinformation-national-security-2025/)聚焦在台灣防衛安全焦慮相關假訊息。

該報告稱，許多挪用台灣戲劇或廣告畫面，最早可追溯到中國微博、抖音等平台，再流傳到臉書（Facebook）、TikTok等。事件驅動的敘事（如恢復軍審）則常由台灣本地政治人物或「小型」網紅放大。

對此，美國聖湯瑪斯大學教授葉耀元則在個人網站分析，此次台灣選舉，中共的認知作戰雖未必會直接改變選民投票立場，但有加深台灣社會對立與兩極化的效果。

圖像來源，Ko Chih-En Meta

圖像加註文字，來自政治家庭的國民黨立法委員柯志恩（中）二度參選高雄市長，與前高雄市長韓國瑜合體在高雄選舉造勢。

## 看點三：最大「票倉」的關鍵對決與「政二代」面臨考驗

人口400萬，300多萬選民，新北市的這兩組數字皆為全台之冠。

此次新北市長選舉由民進黨現任立委蘇巧慧對上曾擔任新北市及高雄市副市長的國民黨李四川。

許多評論稱，新北市中間選民比例高，民調互有領先，被視為決定全國版圖勝負的指標戰場。

綜合各方數據顯示，李四川在藍營基本盤與特定族群中擁有較高凝聚力，蘇巧慧則在年輕選民中獲得青睞，雙方選情仍呈拉鋸狀態。

蘇巧慧是前行政院長、前台北縣長蘇貞昌之女，國民黨高雄市長參選人柯志恩之父，為前屏東縣長柯文福；民進黨新竹縣長參選人鄭朝方之父，為國民黨籍前新竹縣長鄭永金。

因此，有分析稱，這些中壯派的政治人物回到地方爭取首長大位，折射出台灣政治家族的延續與更新。

[跳過 YouTube 帖子, 1](https://www.bbc.com/zhongwen/articles/cm8xzrg40dq1o/trad?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss#end-of-youtube-content-1)

告知: BBC不對外來網站内容負責 YouTube 内容可能包含廣告

結尾 YouTube 帖子, 1

有些「政二代」選擇跨出家族的黨派路線，如鄭朝方強調自己早在學生時期即確立「台派」立場，蘇巧慧則稱自己為「民主二代」，也有如同台中顏家及雲林張家，始終是國民黨在當地派系的中流砥柱。

受訪專家稱，這凸顯台灣地方政治中「政二代」的資源、形象優勢與包袱並存的處境。

譬如，這次選舉幾位熱門的政二代候選人雙親都未高調站台。也有候選人幕僚向BBC中文婉拒談論政二代議題，背後是希望凸顯「靠自己，不靠爸媽」。

台灣東海大學政治學系張峻豪向BBC中文強調，台灣民主化經歷一段時間，因此政二代是資產還是包袱還不一定。仍需要從政二代自己的表現，包含在地方的經營夠不夠扎實，在議會或立院的表現來判斷。

換言之，政二代無法「無縫接軌」的從家族長輩傳承中拿下選票。

以蘇巧慧為例，張峻豪分析蘇女士此次能與政治實力龐大的李四川一較高下，主要在於她自己長年的地方經營，年輕形象以及洋流外溢有關。

但張峻豪也表示蘇貞昌的「老縣長」資歷，與地方的長期良好關係，也帶給女兒優勢。

或許，在新北市選情的膠著，正是這波世代交替在最大票倉的具體呈現。

## 看點四：「無大台」的台灣小黨能在地方選舉突圍嗎？

全台灣約有60萬名首投族，許多專家都表示，歷次選舉以來，緊繃的選區勝負往往取決於中間選民與投票率。

因此，有專家指出，這次地方選舉多數候選人聚焦住房、交通、經濟、地方治理等民生問題，而非直接以「抗中保台」為主軸。

小黨如何在民生議題打動選民，尋求突破也成為焦點。

譬如時代力量、台灣綠黨、小民參政歐巴桑聯盟與台灣基進組成「台灣前進」陣線，承諾選區不重疊、集中資源，試圖在基層議會層級建立「本土第三勢力」。

在台北市文山區擔任無黨籍里長八年的陳峙穎，此次接受時代力量提名，參與北市市議員選舉，他強調唯有出身基層的人，才知道每天為房租、物價、醫療、交通與工作奔波的人在想什麼。

在高雄，從時代力量退黨加入民眾黨的前議員林于凱，在當地發起行人路權促進會專注路權交通問題，此次再次加入選戰希望以民生議題重返議會。

[跳過 YouTube 帖子, 2](https://www.bbc.com/zhongwen/articles/cm8xzrg40dq1o/trad?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss#end-of-youtube-content-2)

告知: BBC不對外來網站内容負責 YouTube 内容可能包含廣告

結尾 YouTube 帖子, 2

分析小黨困境，台灣大學政治系王業立教授曾[指出](https://newtalk.tw/news/view/2024-01-06/903546)，台灣社會長期有第三勢力存在的空間，卻往往互相取而代之，近期甚至有「淘汰率」提高、生命週期變短的趨勢。

長期觀察台灣小黨發展，王教授發現多數小黨分裂自藍綠，因此意識形態上難以完全獨立，又或者資源有限導致黨內內鬥逐漸失去政治能量。

此外，台灣的選舉制度也不利小黨。以台灣不分區立委來說，若政黨票得票率低於5%，該政黨無法獲得任何不分區立委席次，要超過3%的得票率才有政黨補助金。

張峻豪教授便告訴BBC中文，即便是縣市議員的地方政治工作，都需要穩定經營蹲點，才能在地方獲得支持。

小黨便因為欠缺資源補助，說到底缺錢也缺人去經營地方，張教授因此並不看好小黨這次在選舉能有滿意的成績。

唯一例外的是台灣社會民主黨的[苗博雅](https://tw.news.yahoo.com/74-375%E7%A5%A8%E5%AF%AB%E6%AD%B7%E5%8F%B2-%E6%95%97%E9%81%B8%E7%9A%84%E8%8B%97%E5%8D%9A%E9%9B%85%E7%A8%B1-%E5%80%8B%E4%BA%BA%E5%8A%AA%E5%8A%9B%E4%B8%8D%E5%A4%A0-%E5%96%8A%E8%A9%B1-170410503.html)，自2018年當選台北市市議員以來，連任至今，在當地廣獲中產階級及學生選民支持。

## 看點五：賴清德與鄭麗文首次交手 牽動2028大選佈局

圖像來源，Getty Images

圖像加註文字，台北市長此次選舉氣氛熱絡，成為各界焦點。

這場選舉被視為總統賴清德的執政「期中考」，也是上任一年的國民黨主席鄭麗文的重要考驗。

美國《外交家》（The Diplomat）雜誌兩位台灣研究者[投書稱](https://thediplomat.com/2026/10/taiwans-local-elections-are-not-about-china-president-lai-or-the-united-states/)，地方選舉本質是地方議題，不應直接解讀為對賴清德或全國政治的公投。

但兩位作者認為，賴清德與鄭麗文都是高度兩極化人物，地方選戰中多刻意迴避兩人形象，若國民黨表現不佳，身為潛在候選人的鄭麗文將面臨黨內壓力，2028總統初選也會更複雜。

藍若思則強調「所有政治都是地方政治」認同此次九合一選舉關乎台灣國內政治與地方現實的程度，遠超過兩岸關係。

半年前剛結束台灣訪問的藍若思指出，前總統蔡英文在2022年地方選舉最後幾週大力強調中國因素，結果執政民進黨在北部縣市長候選人全數落敗，即是明證。

# Help a girl to complete her university study

大家好，我是张怡然，是一名加州大学戴维斯分校社会学专业的大二学生。在我父亲的支持下，我来到美国留学。我父亲，鲁扬，是一位努力推动中国人权和民主的著名诗人和作家。 2020年5月，他在社交媒体平台上发表了一段视频，要求中国的执政党及其领导人下台，给中国人民民主权利。（https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a8Bb0FxZXZw) 因此，我父亲被逮捕，被判罪名"煽动颠覆国家政权"。审判初期，我母亲为父亲聘请的律师被政府拒绝接见，而政府另外指定的官派律师拒绝向我们透露父亲被关押和审判的具体情况。2022年7月26日，我母亲接到法院判决结果，被告知我爸爸被判刑6年。这令我们痛心万分。他的案件卷宗里根本没有任何实质性的足以判罪的证据。此外，法院以此案是“秘密案件”为由，拒绝给我妈妈案件的判决书。当前，我爸爸已经提出上诉。 我父亲被抓前，书法生意做得很好。但是他被抓后，书法生意被迫关闭，还使得我们家平白无故欠下很多债务。更糟糕的是，我母亲的所有银行账户也都被冻结，本来办的教学辅导班也被勒令停止。 我父亲接下来还要面对数年的牢狱囚禁，我家里还有年迈的老人需要赡养，经济负担使我母亲感到绝望，不堪重负。现在，由于我的学习费用很高，她无法负担我在加州大学戴维斯分校的学费。中国的公安部门以我出国留学为借口，限制我母亲的行动和言论自由。我和我母亲都知道，我的学习和前途是我们家唯一的希望，所以我不想从大学辍学。因此，我必须在这里筹集资金以维持我未来的学习。 请帮助我，一个勇敢而真诚的中国政治异见人士的孩子，完成我的大学学业。您的帮助将是对我、我的家庭和中国人权的重要支持! 张怡然 Hello everyone, my name is Yiran Zhang, a sophomore majoring in sociology at the University of California, Davis. With the support of my father, I came to the United States to study abroad. My father, Lu Yang, was a famous poet and writer who strived to promote human rights and democracy in China. In May 2020, he posted a video on social media platforms demanding that China's ruling party and its leaders step down and give the Chinese people democratic rights. (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a8Bb0FxZXZw) My father was arrested and charged with "inciting subversion of state power". At the beginning of the trial, the lawyer hired by my mother was denied access by the government, and another government-appointed lawyer refused to disclose to us the specific circumstances of my father's detention and trial. On July 26, 2022, my mother received the court verdict and was told that my father was sentenced to 6 years in prison. This saddens us greatly. There is simply no substantial incriminating evidence in his case file. In addition, the court refused to give my mother a paper copy of the verdict on the grounds that the case was a "secret case." Currently, my dad has filed an appeal. Before my father was arrested, his calligraphy business was doing well. But after he was arrested, the calligraphy business was forced to close, and our family owed a lot of debt for no reason. Even worse, all of my mother's bank accounts were frozen, and the tutoring classes she held were demanded to stop. The financial burden makes my mother feel hopeless and overwhelmed. Now, due to the high cost of my studies, she could hardly afford my tuition at UC Davis. At the same time, she also needs to provide for the elderly. China's public security authorities used my right to study abroad as an excuse to restrict my mother's freedom of movement and speech. 2020年5月，他在社交媒体平台上发表了一段视频，要求中国的执政党及其领导人下台，给中国人民民主权利。（[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a8Bb0FxZXZw%25252529)[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a8Bb0FxZXZw](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a8Bb0FxZXZw)) 因此，我父亲被逮捕，被判罪名"煽动颠覆国家政权"。审判初期，我母亲为父亲聘请的律师被政府拒绝接见，而政府另外指定的官派律师拒绝向我们透露父亲被关押和审判的具体情况。2022年7月26日，我母亲接到法院判决结果，被告知我爸爸被判刑6年。这令我们痛心万分。他的案件卷宗里根本没有任何实质性的足以判罪的证据。此外，法院以此案是“秘密案件”为由，拒绝给我妈妈案件的判决书。当前，我爸爸已经提出上诉。

Taipei, Oct. 27 (CNA) Mayoral and magistrate candidates across Taiwan drew ballot numbers Tuesday for the Nov. 28 local elections.

Candidates are identified by number on Taiwanese ballots, and campaign teams build slogans around the number selected.

Draws took place at election commission venues across the country. Some candidates attended in person, while others sent representatives to draw numbers on their behalf.

Supporters cheered as the numbers were announced, and campaign teams quickly used the selected numbers in their campaign slogans.

The following are the results of the ballot-number lottery for the main contenders in Taiwan's six special municipalities:

## **Taipei**

Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) Taipei mayoral candidate Puma Shen (沈伯洋, center) draws No. 3 in a ballot-number lottery for the 2026 local elections in Taipei on Tuesday. Shen's team promoted the slogan "Taipei backs No. 3." CNA photo Oct. 27, 2026

Kuomintang (KMT) Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an (蔣萬安, center) draws No. 5 as he seeks reelection in the 2026 local elections in Taipei on Tuesday. His team chanted "No. 5 Chiang Wan-an, Taipei, encore!" after the draw. CNA photo Oct. 27, 2026

## **New Taipei**

A representative draws No. 1 on behalf of DPP New Taipei mayoral candidate Su Chiao-hui (蘇巧慧) in a ballot-number lottery for the 2026 local elections in New Taipei on Tuesday. Su's campaign team celebrated with the slogan "In 2026, we will definitely win." CNA photo Oct. 27, 2026

A representative of KMT New Taipei mayoral candidate Lee Shu-chuan (李四川) draws No. 3 in a ballot-number lottery for the 2026 local elections in New Taipei on Tuesday. His team responded with the slogan "Vote No. 3, support Shu-chuan." CNA photo Oct. 27, 2026

## **Taoyuan**

KMT Taoyuan Mayor Chang San-cheng (張善政) draws No. 2 as he seeks reelection in the 2026 local elections in Taoyuan on Tuesday. Chang said the number symbolized "double good fortune" and expressed hope for continued public support. CNA photo Oct. 27, 2026

DPP Taoyuan mayoral candidate Huang Shih-chieh (黃世杰) draws No. 1 in a ballot-number lottery for the 2026 local elections in Taoyuan on Tuesday. Huang, known by the nickname "Penguin Dad," promoted the slogan "Penguins persevere, Taoyuan comes first." CNA photo Oct. 27, 2026

## **Taichung**

DPP Taichung mayoral candidate Ho Hsin-chun (何欣純, center) draws No. 1 in a ballot-number lottery for the 2026 local elections in Taichung on Tuesday. Supporters cheered with the slogan "For a good mayor, Taichung comes first." CNA photo Oct. 27, 2026

KMT Taichung mayoral candidate Johnny Chiang (江啟臣, third right) draws No. 3 in a ballot-number lottery for the 2026 local elections in Taichung on Tuesday. Chiang said the number symbolized his commitment to being a solid backer for Taichung residents. CNA photo Oct. 27, 2026

## **Tainan**

A city council candidate draws No. 2 on behalf of KMT Tainan mayoral candidate Hsieh Lung-chieh (謝龍介) in a ballot-number lottery for the 2026 local elections in Tainan on Tuesday. CNA photo Oct. 27, 2026

DPP Tainan mayoral candidate Chen Ting-fei (陳亭妃) draws No. 3 in a ballot-number lottery for the 2026 local elections in Tainan on Tuesday. Chen promoted the slogan "Tainan's first female mayor, backed by the people." CNA photo Oct. 27, 2026

## **Kaohsiung**

DPP Kaohsiung mayoral candidate Lai Jui-lung (賴瑞隆) draws No. 5 in a ballot-number lottery for the 2026 local elections in Kaohsiung on Tuesday. He shouted his campaign slogan in Taiwanese: "Kaohsiung's future belongs to you and me." CNA photo Oct. 27, 2026

KMT Kaohsiung mayoral candidate Ko Chih-en (柯志恩, center) holds up her No. 3 ballot number after the draw for the 2026 local elections in Kaohsiung on Tuesday. CNA photo Oct. 27, 2026

title: Full, rigorous party self-governance: How the CPC holds itself accountable
summary: _Editor's note: CGTN has launched a new season of its Ask China campaign. We've invited experts, editors, reporters and other professionals to answer insightful questions about China and the CPC sent to CGTN by our viewers from around the w
content:
_Editor's note: CGTN has launched a new season of its Ask China campaign. We've invited experts, editors, reporters and other professionals to answer insightful questions about China and the CPC sent to CGTN by our viewers from around the world. Rimas Ma is a reporter for CGTN Arabic._

In 2012, the Communist Party of China (CPC) introduced a set of rules governing officials' conduct. The document was just over 600 Chinese characters long, and its provisions might have sounded trivial: no floral arrangements at meetings, no lavish dishes at official receptions, no luxury hotels on business trips, and no road closures or traffic restrictions to clear the way for officials.

The rules had a straightforward name: the Party's eight-point frugality code.

Some people initially thought it would be just another short-lived campaign. Yet more than a decade later, it is still going strong.

Behind these rules lies a broader concept: full, rigorous Party self-governance. The idea is that a party that has governed for an extended period cannot rely solely on external oversight to maintain its integrity. It must also hold itself to higher standards and impose stricter internal discipline. Its underlying logic is simple: regulate the exercise of power through rules and constrain conduct through institutions.

**Why does a meal matter?**

You might ask: Does it really matter if an official enjoys a meal at someone else's expense?

The answer can be found in the numbers, without any need for abstract theory. In 2025, China's discipline inspection and supervision authorities investigated more than 290,000 cases involving violations of the spirit of the Party's eight-point frugality code, with more than 370,000 people receiving criticism, education or disciplinary or administrative action.

Many such problems begin with something as seemingly minor as a meal.

In many corruption cases in China, serious misconduct follows a similar path: first, an official accepts a dinner invitation; then gifts; then money in exchange for favors; and eventually, large-scale corruption. A meal may seem insignificant, but it can be the first link in a chain that pulls people into increasingly serious wrongdoing.

That is why these rules target the first link in the chain. By addressing seemingly minor violations, they seek to stop problems before they escalate.

**The story behind an elderly person's allowance**

But keeping officials in check is only half of the picture. The other half is ensuring that ordinary people are not deprived of their rightful benefits.

In Qinghai Province, more than 400,000 people are aged 70 or above. Under government policy, they are eligible for elderly allowances. For a period, however, some did not receive them. Some were unaware of the policy, some found the application procedures too complicated, and some had not been properly informed by local officials.

Local discipline inspection and supervision authorities identified the problem and launched a targeted campaign to address it. The result? All 404,000 elderly people eventually received the allowances to which they were entitled, bringing coverage to 97.6%.

The phrase "full, rigorous Party self-governance" may sound remote from everyday life. But its practical implications can be very concrete: ensuring that an elderly person in a remote village receives a few hundred yuan in annual assistance on time. The amount may be modest, but it is a benefit she is entitled to receive.

In Jiujiang, east China's Jiangxi Province, discipline inspection and supervision authorities discovered that some medical institutions had obtained medical insurance funds through practices such as inflating reimbursement claims, falsifying accounting documents and manipulating billing items.

Medical insurance funds help ordinary people pay for healthcare. Every yuan fraudulently taken from these funds means fewer resources available to those who genuinely need medical treatment. After investigating the cases, the authorities issued recommendations to the medical insurance authorities, prompting the establishment of stricter fund supervision mechanisms and measures to close regulatory loopholes. This gave ordinary people an additional safeguard when seeking reimbursement for medical expenses.

These cases may not have made national headlines. Yet together, they illustrate the most basic purpose of governance: not grand political narratives, but ensuring that ordinary people are treated fairly, one case at a time.

**Can corrupt officials escape accountability by fleeing abroad?**

Corrupt officials in many countries may share one assumption: once they flee abroad, they will be safe.

China's answer is no.

From January to November 2025, China recovered 782 fugitives from overseas and retrieved more than 23.6 billion yuan in illicit funds through its "Sky Net" operation. The operation has continued for more than a decade and involved law enforcement cooperation with multiple countries.

Behind these figures lies a clear message: fleeing to another country or obtaining new passports does not make the matter disappear.

But the significance of pursuing fugitives and recovering illicit assets goes beyond bringing individuals back. It reaffirms a more fundamental principle: the exercise of power carries responsibility.

Officials who violate people's rights, fail to fulfill their duties or abuse their positions for personal gain should face the consequences prescribed by law, wherever they may flee. This is not simply about pursuing particular individuals. It is about upholding a rule: within this system, those who exercise power cannot enjoy its benefits while evading responsibility.

**Corruption is not a challenge unique to China**

Corruption is not unique to any one country.

A World Bank study has pointed out that corruption significantly raises business costs, discourages investment and undermines economic growth. This is not merely theoretical. When businesses no longer have to spend time and money dealing with demands for improper payments or other forms of official misconduct, they can devote more resources to products and technology. When ordinary people can access public services without relying on personal connections, the costs of social and economic activity fall and efficiency improves.

Countries have chosen different approaches to tackling corruption. China has opted for a sustained, institutionalized system of internal oversight: using rules to constrain power, data to identify irregularities, and international cooperation in fugitive repatriation and asset recovery to prevent those accused of corruption from evading accountability abroad.

At the heart of this approach is the logic of full, rigorous Party self-governance. Rather than relying on a single campaign to solve the problem, it seeks to keep the exercise of power under continuous constraint through institutions that operate over time.

**There is no finish line, but there is a clear direction**

This system is not static. Corruption cases continue to emerge, and new problems continue to arise. That is precisely why the system must remain in operation and adapt over time. New cases are investigated every year, and new loopholes are addressed.

In 2025, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the National Commission of Supervision continued publishing monthly figures on cases involving violations of the spirit of the Party's eight-point frugality code for the 148th consecutive month. This monthly reporting, sustained for more than 12 years, sends a message in itself: this is not a campaign launched for a limited period or a one-off crackdown, but an ongoing effort.

For ordinary people, these figures may seem distant. But when an official is publicly disciplined for accepting a banquet, when an institution is investigated for improperly distributing benefits, or when an official is penalized for using a government vehicle for private purposes, these individual cases add up to something important: the rules contained in that document of just over 600 Chinese characters are not merely words on paper.

Nor is full, rigorous Party self-governance simply an abstract political slogan. It means that a party with more than 100 million members is using an ongoing institutional framework to address a question faced by countries around the world: How can those entrusted with power be held accountable for their actions?

That is why full, rigorous Party self-governance must be pursued with perseverance and sustained effort. Not because the system is already perfect, but because problems will continue to arise; not because a single campaign can solve everything, but because only sustained efforts can keep the exercise of power under continuous constraint.

## 12th BRICS parliamentary forum concludes in New Delhi, with adoption of joint declaration

### The 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum, which was inaugurated by Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla yesterday, concluded today with the adoption of a Joint Declaration.

[ANI](https://www.devdiscourse.com/article/international/3998041-tibet-uyghur-rights-concerns-raised-in-geneva-with-china-amid-fears-over-minority-freedoms?amp)

Updated:27-10-2026 17:11IST | Created:27-10-2026 17:11IST

Image Credit: ANI

The 12th [BRICS](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=BRICS) Parliamentary Forum, which was inaugurated by [Lok Sabha](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Lok%20Sabha) Speaker Om [Birla](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Birla) yesterday, concluded on Tuesday with the adoption of a Joint Declaration. According to a press release, the declaration formally reiterates member nations' dedication to the principles of the United Nations Charter, sovereign equality, mutual respect, non-interference in internal affairs, and the peaceful settlement of international disputes.

Demonstrating India’s growing diplomatic footprint under its ongoing chairship, the Joint Declaration seamlessly aligned with New Delhi’s core strategic priorities. Reaffirming the consensus of the [New Delhi](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=New%20Delhi) Declaration (NDD), member parliaments issued an explicit endorsement of UN Security Council reform—referencing NDD Paragraph 13—to make global governance more representative of the Global South. India’s firm stance on national security scored a major victory through robust, uncompromised counter-terrorism language; building on NDD Paragraph 40, the declaration condemned cross-border terrorism, terror financing, and safe havens while demanding zero tolerance and an end to double standards.

As per the release, the final text also strongly embedded India-led developmental and climate agendas, including the expansion of Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) repositories, ethical Artificial Intelligence governance, adherence to Common but Differentiated Responsibilities (CBDR-RC), and unanimous support for India’s [BRICS](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=BRICS) Chairship. Delivering the valedictory address, [Lok Sabha](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Lok%20Sabha) Speaker emphasised that global challenges can only be resolved through steadfast dialogue, mutual peace, and collaborative action rather than conflict.

Addressing presiding officers, distinguished delegates, and international parliamentarians from [BRICS](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=BRICS) member and partner nations, [Birla](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Birla) reflected on two days of profound discussions. He noted that while participating nations possess diverse backgrounds, circumstances, and challenges, their shared commitment to humanity's welfare, peace, and prosperity remains the ultimate strength of the [BRICS](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=BRICS) coalition. Highlighting the current global climate of instability, economic uncertainty, and regional conflicts, [Birla](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Birla) reiterated India’s core philosophy: permanent solutions are forged in dialogue, not war; in peace, not conflict; and in collaboration, rather than competition.

He called for a global framework built on absolute respect for national sovereignty, peaceful resolution of international disputes, and equitable development opportunities for all. "Global peace truly means security, respect, justice, and the assurance of a better future for everyone—especially the younger generation,” he stated, noting that coming generations will judge current leaders by the safety and prosperity of the world they leave behind.

Underscoring the evolving responsibilities of democratic institutions, the [Lok Sabha](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Lok%20Sabha) Speaker emphasised that [Parliaments](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Parliaments) are not merely law-making bodies but vital centres of dialogue, consensus, accountability, and public trust. As per the release, he urged global legislatures to adapt to changing times by becoming more effective, transparent, and citizen-centric. Addressing the integration of modern tools, [Birla](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Birla) noted that the adoption of Artificial Intelligence and digital technology can heavily optimise parliamentary workflows and deepen citizen participation, provided its development aligns strictly with human values, ethics, transparency, and accountability.

Birla stressed that the success of [BRICS](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=BRICS) must extend far beyond the progress of its individual member [States](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=States) to benefit the wider international community, granting proper representation to the aspirations of the Global South in global decision-making processes. As the 12th [BRICS](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=BRICS)[Parliamentary Forum](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Parliamentary%20Forum) successfully concluded, [Birla](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Birla) extended warm congratulations and best wishes to China, which assumes the [BRICS](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=BRICS) chair for the year 2027, expressing full confidence that cooperation will continue to flourish under its leadership.

The forum concluded with a resounding call to action for [Parliaments](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Parliaments) worldwide to serve as powerful voices for peace, cooperation, and shared prosperity. (ANI)

(This story has not been edited by Devdiscourse staff and is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

## Bombay HC adjourns Imran Khan’s plea against 'Leave India Notice' to Nov 2

### Imran Khan’s petition in the Bombay High Court challenging the 'Leave India Notice' has been adjourned till November 2.

[ANI](https://www.devdiscourse.com/article/international/3998041-tibet-uyghur-rights-concerns-raised-in-geneva-with-china-amid-fears-over-minority-freedoms?amp)

Updated:27-10-2026 16:35IST | Created:27-10-2026 16:35IST

Image Credit: ANI

Imran Khan’s petition in the [Bombay](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Bombay) High Court challenging the 'Leave [India](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=India) Notice' has been adjourned till November 2. [Imran](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Imran)[Khan](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Khan) was asked to leave [India](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=India) by October 28. ASG appearing for the central government has given oral assurance to the court that no action against [Imran](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Imran)[Khan](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Khan) will be taken till the next hearing.

The challenge shall be kept in abeyance till the next date. Earlier, [Khan](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Khan) filed a writ petition before the [Bombay](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Bombay) High Court challenging a Leave [India](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=India)[Notice](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Notice) (LIN) dated October 14, 2026, issued by the [Foreigners Regional Registration Officer](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Foreigners%20Regional%20Registration%20Officer) (FRRO), Mumbai, directing him to leave [India](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=India) on or before October 28.

Imran Khan's PR team issued a statement, "Mr [Imran](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Imran)[Khan](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Khan) Pal, actor and Overseas Citizen of [India](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=India) (OCI) Cardholder residing in [India](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=India) since the age of 2 years, has filed a [Writ Petition](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Writ%20Petition) before the Hon'ble [Bombay](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Bombay) High Court challenging the Leave [India](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=India)[Notice](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Notice) dated 14.10.2026 (“LIN”) issued by the [Foreigners Regional Registration Officer](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Foreigners%20Regional%20Registration%20Officer) (FRRO), Mumbai, which directs him to leave [India](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=India) on or before 28.10.2026. The petition challenges the procedure the [FRRO](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=FRRO) adopted. The [FRRO](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=FRRO) concluded that Imran, a US National, had taken part in a protest, and on that basis ordered him to leave India. It did so without giving him any opportunity of being heard." The actor’s petition argues that the notice does not specify the provisions of the Immigration and Foreigners Act, 2025, that he allegedly violated. It also contends that the notice was issued without a show-cause notice or an opportunity to be heard.

According to the petition, [Khan](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Khan) has held Overseas Citizen of [India](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=India) (OCI) status since 2006 and has lived in [India](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=India) since he was about two years old. He has cited his education, professional work and family ties in the country to underline his longstanding association with India. The actor has linked the notice to an incident on October 10 near August [Kranti Maidan](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Kranti%20Maidan) and [Nana Chowk](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Nana%20Chowk) in Mumbai, where he says he was briefly detained by police. According to his account, he was returning to his vehicle when he was surrounded by media personnel and apprehended by the police.

He has denied entering any restricted or barricaded area or disobeying police directions to leave. His team said, "After the petition was filed, the [FRRO](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=FRRO) issued a detailed show cause notice (“SCN”). The notice asks [Imran](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Imran) to explain why his OCI registration should not be cancelled because of his presence at the gathering of 10.10.2026, where he was briefly detained by the [Mumbai](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Mumbai) Police. [Imran](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Imran) was neither an organiser of nor a participant in the protest. He had gone to see what was happening. Before he could reach the site, he was surrounded by the media and detained by the police."

The petition further states that [Khan](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Khan) was taken to the Yellow Gate Police Station along with family members and was subsequently released. It refers to an FIR registered at [Gamdevi Police Station](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Gamdevi%20Police%20Station) on October 10 under provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). [Khan](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Khan) has contended that the notice appears to have been issued in connection with the FIR, despite the allegations remaining unproven.

The petition also points out that, according to him, no chargesheet had been filed and no charges framed when the notice was issued. Arguing that the direction to leave [India](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=India) has serious consequences for him, [Khan](https://www.devdiscourse.com/news?tag=Khan) has challenged the action as disproportionate and in violation of the legal safeguards he claims are applicable in his case. He has also raised concerns over the circumstances and timing of the notice, including what he describes as public calls for action against him. The petition seeks quashing of the notice and disclosure of the records and material relied upon by the FRRO.

title: Four days, four protests — Desperate Joburg residents hit the streets over water cuts
summary: Soiled nappies piled up, toilets went unflushed and dirty bed linen could not be washed as a five-day water outage plunged a Johannesburg home for people with disabilities into a hygiene crisis. At St Giles Association for the Physically Di
content:
Soiled nappies piled up, toilets went unflushed and dirty bed linen could not be washed as a five-day water outage plunged a Johannesburg home for people with disabilities into a hygiene crisis.

At St Giles Association for the Physically Disabled in Dewetshof, near Kensington, many of the 29 residents are frail or physically disabled and rely on caregivers to get out of bed, dress, bathe and use the toilet. Some need to be bathed two or three times a day because of incontinence.

“The past few days have been hell. We have never had such a long outage, and for us it was a complete nightmare,” said manager Palesa Nhlapo.

Emergency reserves of 25 litres in each bathroom ran out within a morning. Dirty linen and clothing accumulated, floors could not be washed properly and staff struggled to keep toilets clean, raising fears about the spread of disease.

“We keep 25 litres of water in every bathroom for emergencies, but that was finished in one morning,” Nhlapo said.

Even preparing meals and providing drinking water, tea, coffee and juice became difficult in the heat.

Alongside water donated from the Kensington community, St Giles manager Palesa Nhlapo (left) sits with a disabled resident. (Photo: Jamie Ho)

Staff hired a bakkie to collect water from the Jeppe Fire Station – an extra expense for a struggling nonprofit whose residents contribute only about 40% of its running costs.

“It has been very distressing and caused a lot of anxiety as we watched the pile of soiled bedding and clothing and nappies grow, wondering about the spread of infection and germs. Not only were our 58 members of staff alarmed, but it deeply affected our most vulnerable residents who were not being given their regular care,” Nhlapo said.

But when the home’s plight was shared through the Water Crisis Committee network, neighbours arrived with bottled drinking water and filled 25-litre containers.

“The outpouring of love has overwhelmed us. People have been coming in for days now, just bringing whatever water they can. We are truly grateful. We now at least have containers, although we never know when there is going to be another outage,” Nhlapo said.

### **Residents take to the streets**

The ordeal at St Giles comes as water shortages trigger protests across Johannesburg in the days before the 4 November municipal elections. Some households say they have gone more than a week without running water or an emergency tanker delivery.

On Saturday, 24 October, residents of Mayfair, Crosby and surrounding areas protested outside Brixton Police Station after days without running water. They depend on the troubled Commando supply system, which includes the Brixton, Crosby and Hursthill reservoirs.

Further water protests have been announced in the coming days.

Melville residents plan to gather at Main Road and Fourth Avenue from 6am to 8am on Wednesday, 28 October, urging neighbours to bring bottles and “make some noise”.

On Thursday, 29 October, residents of Kensington, Observatory, Bezuidenhout Valley, Bertrams, Judith’s Paarl, Yeoville, Berea and surrounding areas plan to meet at Queen Street and Albertina Sisulu Road from 5pm to 7pm.

The Water Crisis Committee says many have been without reliable supply since 22 October. It is demanding emergency water deliveries, clear restoration timelines and repairs, and has barred political branding from the protest.

Parktown West residents plan to gather on Jan Smuts Avenue, between Loch Avenue and Seymour Road, from 7am to 9am on Friday, 30 October.

Their notice reads: “Weeks Dry. ZERO Answers.”

Residents also protested in February, when some reported weeks without dependable water.

In Lenasia, service-delivery protesters blocked the N12 near Nana’s Farm on 26 October, after another demonstration the previous week. Their grievances have included water and electricity shortages.

> ### **Join the protests**
>
>
> If you’ve been affected by the water cuts or want to protest in solidarity, you can make your voice heard at one of the above protests. The events are aimed at being peaceful and are not affiliated to political parties. Pitch up with or without a sign and feel free to bring something to make some noise.

### **Desperation in the suburbs**

In Malvern, opposite Malvern West Primary School, a resident reported this week seeing people illegally opening a municipal fire hydrant and filling 20-litre containers, which were loaded on to a bakkie. It is not known who opened the hydrant, whether they were authorised or what the water was intended for.

In neighbouring Bezuidenhout Valley, Johannesburg Water issued a warning on 24 October after receiving reports of a private truck selling water on Ninth Avenue.

“The source and quality of the water being sold have not been verified,” the utility said, urging residents not to buy it because its safety could not be guaranteed. Water delivered by authorised Johannesburg Water tankers is free and must not be sold, it said.

Yet residents complain that official tankers are not reaching them. One person living in flats opposite 226 Sixth Avenue in Bezuidenhout Valley wrote in a community WhatsApp group: “9 days without water and not even a water truck in 9 days.”

The resident questioned how many germs were accumulating in homes where people could no longer maintain basic hygiene in the heat.

A Kensington resident complained that emergency supplies appeared to be concentrated in Bezuidenhout Valley.

“It feels as though we in Kensington are being punished, despite also having had no water since Thursday last week,” the resident wrote.

“To make matters worse, water tankers are not reaching us, and when assistance does arrive, it appears to go only to Bez Valley.”

The complaints about unequal tanker distribution have not been independently verified.

Melville residents collect water from a tanker during a previous outage. (Photo: Archive / Ihsaan Haffejee)

Despite their growing desperation, residents have expressed appreciation for the community volunteers trying to help them.

“We appreciate you guys, heartily! You are doing a noble job,” one resident wrote in the Water Crisis Committee’s WhatsApp group.

“We just can’t help but cry out loud right here when the pain of being waterless cuts deep.”

At least 11 care, medical and educational facilities have been identified in or near the eastern suburbs, including homes for elderly people and people with disabilities that were left without water for days.

### **Water that may not be safe**

Bezuidenhout Valley residents face a second difficulty: a precautionary water contamination warning after a drinking-water pipe was damaged during sewer-replacement work.

Initial tests showed no indication of contamination, but Johannesburg Water warned residents in a limited section of Eighth Avenue, near Fourth to Seventh streets, not to use tap water until further clearance.

On 26 October, the utility said a supply interruption had delayed further sampling. Councillor Neuren Pietersen said this was because there was no water to test as the pipes were empty.

### **Financial strain**

The failures are unfolding as Johannesburg grapples with serious financial pressures.

In April, Finance Minister [Enoch Godongwana warned Mayor Dada Morero](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-05-06-finance-minister-warns-joburg-is-in-severe-financial-distress-in-letter-to-mayor-morero/) about mounting debt, weak revenue collection and an unfunded budget.

The City has rejected suggestions that it is bankrupt and says it is working to restore services. Residents, however, are judging those plans by whether water flows, the lights stay on and rubbish is collected.

Pietersen said the shortages were part of a province-wide crisis, with Johannesburg losing an estimated 400 million litres of water daily and Ekurhuleni another 200 million litres, while Rand Water struggled to meet demand of about five billion litres a day.

On Friday, Rand Water said, “To protect the water supply system and ensure equitable distribution, Rand Water will begin restricting supply to municipalities that continue to exceed their allocated consumption volumes. These restrictions may result in low water pressure or intermittent water supply in affected municipalities.”

Following a public meeting with MP Stephen Moore, Pietersen said the national government was considering stronger measures to compel municipalities to reduce water losses and protect revenue for infrastructure maintenance.

An O6 pipeline (a high-capacity bulk water transmission main) and pump station project was already under way to improve supply to the Yeoville reservoir serving his ward. However, he warned that residents needed to conserve water to reduce pressure on the system and avoid further restrictions while infrastructure was repaired.

### **Power failures**

Electricity outages are adding to the pressure on households and businesses. Repeated fires and explosions at City Power’s Central Substation left sections of the CBD without power, forcing businesses to buy diesel for generators or interrupt trading. Another explosion on 14 October delayed repairs; by 23 October, City Power said it had restored supply to about 98% of affected customers.

Elsewhere, residents continue to report unplanned outages linked to ageing equipment, faults, theft and vandalism. City Power has also scheduled maintenance interruptions in several areas. Those planned shutdowns are distinct from breakdowns, but both leave households and businesses having to make alternative arrangements.

### **Refuse collection**

Rubbish has also gone uncollected in parts of Johannesburg as Pikitup struggles with vehicle shortages and recurring collection backlogs. The entity acknowledged delays earlier this month and said teams were clearing missed rounds. Previous disruptions included protests affecting six depots in August, while its reliance on hired trucks has raised further questions about the sustainability of the services. **DM**

title: 担心生育旅游和安全风险，美暂停中国公民前往北马里亚纳群岛的免签计划
summary: 华盛顿 — 美国国土安全部星期二(10月27日)宣布将暂停中国公民前往美国位于西太平洋的海外领地北马里亚纳群岛的免签旅行计划，在此之前，多位共和党议员警告该计划可能助长“生育旅游”并构成国家安全风险。新措施将于美国东部时间10月30日下午2时生效。 免签计划全名为“经济活力与安全旅行授权计划”（EVS-TAP)，由拜登政府于2024年制定，并于2025年2月20日正式实施。该计划允许符合条件并获得美国海关与边境保护局(CBP)电子旅行授权的中国公民，可免签前往北马里亚纳群岛，
content:
华盛顿 —

美国国土安全部星期二(10月27日)宣布将暂停中国公民前往美国位于西太平洋的海外领地北马里亚纳群岛的免签旅行计划，在此之前，多位共和党议员警告该计划可能助长“生育旅游”并构成国家安全风险。新措施将于美国东部时间10月30日下午2时生效。

免签计划全名为“经济活力与安全旅行授权计划”（EVS-TAP)，由拜登政府于2024年制定，并于2025年2月20日正式实施。该计划允许符合条件并获得美国海关与边境保护局(CBP)电子旅行授权的中国公民，可免签前往北马里亚纳群岛，最长停留14天。

国土安全部在宣布该决定的[公告](https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/27/2026-21880/suspension-of-the-commonwealth-of-the-northern-mariana-islands-cnmi-economic-vitality-and-security)中指出，该计划可能助长“生育旅游”、间谍活动，并导致中国公民非法前往邻近的关岛那里是重要的美国军事枢纽，带来“安全和执法风险”。

**免签证项目曾带来医疗压力和安全风险**

该项目将于美国东部时间10月30日下午2点起暂停实施，适用于新申请者和已获批准的旅客。措施生效前已经入境而且仍在何方停留期限内的人员，可以继续停留至期限届满。此后前往北马里亚纳群岛，则须申请美国签证，除非符合其他入境豁免的条件。

国土安全部表示，此次暂停时为了重新评估该计划的运作和相关风险，在与国务卿和内政部长共同评估该项目期间，暂停措施将持续有效。目前，公告没有设定恢复日期。

国土安全部警告称，免签证项目可能会使中国公民更容易前往北马里亚纳群岛生育。“虽然生育旅游在北马里亚纳群岛一直是一个问题，但根据经济活力与安全旅行授权计划提供的免签旅行和简化的审查程序，可能会降低这种做法的门槛。”公告指出。

生育旅游是指外国人前往美国的主要目的是生育，以便其子女获得美国公民身份。美国国土安全部说，2025财年有超过3000名中国公民利用该项目进入北马里亚纳群岛。

国土安全部还表示，生育旅游会给这些岛屿的医疗系统带来压力。不过，公告没有提供通过免签证计划入境的旅客相关的生育数量。

该部门警告说，免签旅行可能被人用于在美国军事设施附近收集情报。北马里亚纳群岛是天宁岛(Tinian)美军空军基地的所在地，而关岛则是美军在西太平洋的重要战略据点。

尽管该计划不允许游客前往关岛或美国本土，但国土安全部列举了此前一些案例，涉及中国公民从北马里亚纳群岛乘船偷渡到关岛的案件。国土安全部表示，这些案例表明，相关风险尚未完全消除。

暂停免签是特朗普政府加大力度打击生育旅游的一部分。美国国务院于8月12日成立“生育旅游预防特别工作组”(Birth Tourism Prevention Task Force)，负责调查相关活动及打击牟利中介。

《纽约邮报》10月20日的一篇[报道](https://nypost.com/2026/10/20/us-news/over-300k-visas-revoked-so-far-in-trumps-second-term-state-department-announces/)说，自从唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)总统在去年上任以来，美国政府已经撤销了超过30万份签证，其中至少4，000份被取消是因为签证持有人“参与或协助生育旅游”。白宫官方账号“快速反应47”(Rapid Response 47)当天转发了这篇报道。

**共和党议员们庆祝这一决定**

来自犹他州共和党籍联邦参议员迈克·李(Mike Lee)星期一晚间在X平台上上发帖庆祝这一决定。“美国不是中共窃取公民身份的温床。”李写道，“感谢特朗普总统！”

迈克·李、佛罗里达州州共和党籍参议员里克·斯科特(Rick Scott)、德克萨斯州共和党籍联邦参议员约翰·科宁(John Cornyn)以及路易斯安那州共和党籍联邦参议员比尔·卡西迪(Bill Cassidy)在月曾致函穆林，敦促他终止该项目，并警告称该项目助长了生育旅游，构成国家安全风险。

德克萨斯州共和党众议员奇普·罗伊(Chip Roy)的新闻办公室也对这一举措表示欢迎，并说自己和威斯康星州共和党众议员汤姆·蒂芙尼(Tom Tiffany)在3月就对该项目表示担忧。

“罗伊众议员很高兴听到特朗普政府堵上了这一危险的漏洞。”他的办公室在X网站上写道。

来自弗吉尼亚州的民主党众议员詹姆斯·沃金肖(James Walkinshaw)今年9月在接受美国之音采访时曾表示，美国公民身份不应被滥用，任何从事“生育旅游”的人都应受到法律追究。

但来自宾夕法尼亚州的民主党籍众议员，众议员司法委员会宪法与有限政府小组委员会的首席成员玛丽·盖伊·斯坎伦(Mary Gay Scanlon)曾在9月表示，围绕“生育旅游”和“定锚婴儿”(anchor babies)的许多说法，是过于夸大和“凭空臆想”。

title: How to make your plastic coffee cup biodegradable
summary: We live in a plastic world. It’s only natural: when it was first invented, virgin plastic (a synthetic polymer made from fossil fuels) transformed countless industries by creating an incredibly cheap, durable, lightweight, and versatile mat
content:
We live in a plastic world. It’s only natural: when it was first invented, virgin plastic (a synthetic polymer made from fossil fuels) transformed countless industries by creating an incredibly cheap, durable, lightweight, and versatile material that revolutionised manufacturing, packaging and consumer culture. From medical devices to vehicle components and furniture. From food packaging to children’s toys and even skincare products, the list goes on and on. Plastic is virtually everywhere. But that’s also the problem. Plastic is virtually everywhere: in our ecosystems, in wildlife, and even in the human body. The [United Nations Environment Programme (Unep)](https://www.unep.org/en/what-we-do/chemicals-and-pollution-action/plastic-pollution) estimated that in 2025, more than 400 million tonnes of plastic were produced globally, 79% of which either ends up in landfills, is dumped, or is left as unmanaged litter in the environment. South Africa is no different. An estimated 440,000 tonnes of plastic waste leak into the country’s rivers, coastlines and open landscapes every year. The Centre for Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR), through its advanced polymer research, is trying to address SA’s plastic pollution problem by developing biodegradable, compostable plastics made from plants. Speaking to Daily Maverick in his lab in Pretoria, CSIR principal scientist Dr Sudhakar Muniyasamy explained that South Africa’s plant-based plastic industry was growing rapidly, and the CSIR was at the forefront of developing innovative bio-polymer solutions to the country’s plastic pollution problem. “So we know that in South Africa, we produce a lot of plastic that is being sent to landfill. Normally, it’s mainly made from petroleum-based materials that can last 200 to 300 years. So we are trying to find out what the problematic plastics are in South Africa and replace them with structurally sound plastics made from plants,” Muniyasamy said. Dr Sudhakar Muniyasamy, principal scientist at the CSIR, shows one way the council creates soil conditions to test the biodegradability of the plastic they developed. (Photo: Lerato Mutsila) This includes agricultural biomass that is openly available, like sugarcane by-products, forestry by-products, and other organic material that is underutilised in South Africa. ### **From the soil to the lab, through the hands that harvest it** The journey of alternative plastics begins long before plant-based materials reach the hands of Scientists like Dr Muniyasamy, or local manufacturers like Bonnie Bio and Fortis X, on the diverse farms scattered across South Africa. From the sugar cane belts of KwaZulu-Natal and Mpumalanga, to the maize fields in the Free State and North West and even poultry farms in KZN and Gauteng. Farm workers collect the harvest, and processing the plants generates mountains of bagasse (a by-product of sugar cane), sawdust (a by-product of forestry), and even chicken feathers. The South African sugar industry as a whole supports a million livelihoods. (Photo: Guillem Sartorio / Bloomberg via Getty Images) Instead of composting the crop residue, they send it to facilities like the CSIR, where it is turned into plant-based plastic products. Leading Daily Maverick through the CSIR’s bioplastics and packaging production facility, Dr Muniyasamy said one of the organisation’s most significant achievements was developing biodegradable mulching film for the agricultural sector. SA’s agricultural sector, while far from the leading driver for single-use plastic consumption, uses approximately 140,000 to 180,000 tons of plastic products per year. Dr Sudhakar Muniyasamy explains how the twin-screw extruder turns raw plant-based resins into biodegradable plastic made from agricultural material. (Photo: Lerato Mutsila) The CSIR’s plant-based mulching films are designed to cover crops like pineapples, strawberries and cucumbers, protecting them and promoting growth. What sets them apart is that they are tailored to biodegrade naturally in soil in one to three months for short-term crops, or up to 12 months in longer-term crops. Beyond mulching films, CSIR is developing a range of biodegradable products, including cutlery, takeaway containers, medical test kits, straws and compostable bags, and is even exploring applications for fishing nets and hygiene products.
(Photo: Lerato Mutsila)](https://cdn.dailymaverick.co.za/i/IF3nDohEbTyMUJn2sVH1mzTZ1OU=/200x100/smart/filters:strip_exif()/file/attachments/orphans/Lerato-Plant-basedPlastics-LifeCycle2_573360.jpg) Dr Sudhakar Muniyasamy shows bioplastic pellets that the CSIR uses to make biodegradable and compostable plastic products. (Photo: Lerato Mutsila) Although it is a relatively new field in the country, SA’s plant-based plastic industry is growing rapidly. However, so are consumer misconceptions about what is biodegradable and greenwashing from some manufacturers. ### **Clearing the molecular confusion** A persistent misconception undermines public understanding of green packaging: that plant-based inherently means biodegradable. In reality, these two terms are not synonymous. Plant-based plastics fall into two distinct groups: bio-based “drop-in” plastics (Bio-PET) and compostable biopolymers (PLA and PHA). Bio-PET is derived from sugarcane ethanol rather than crude oil, effectively replacing fossil feedstocks with renewable plant materials. But its final molecular structure is chemically identical to standard, traditional plastic (PET). It behaves like conventional plastic: recyclers can melt and reprocess it, but if it ends up on a roadside or buried in a landfill, it will exist there for centuries. It cuts fossil carbon at the source, but it does nothing to prevent plastic pollution. On the other hand, PLA and PHA are made from fermented plant starches, like corn or cassava, and can naturally break down into water, biomass and carbon dioxide, but only under specific conditions. In reality, most PLA and PHA only break down properly under industrial composting conditions. This means they need sustained temperatures of 58°C to 60°C, specific humidity levels, and regulated aerobic microbial activity to break down. Home composting cannot provide these conditions. Under SANS 1728, the labelling on this biodegradable plastic shows it can only be broken down at an industrial composting facility. (Photo: Lerato Mutsila) ### **The infrastructure gap** South Africa faces a gap between the promise of bioplastics and the reality on the ground. Although compostable plastics such as PLA offer green alternatives, the country possesses virtually no municipal industrial composting facilities capable of handling post-consumer packaging at scale. The government has acknowledged this infrastructure gap. Speaking to Daily Maverick, Sello Molekwa, Acting Chief Director at the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment, explained that modern bio-polymers require specialised waste facilities that local infrastructure simply cannot match: “The end-of-life treatment for most of the biodegradable alternative materials requires industrial-scale facilities with standard operations (i.e., temperature-controlled) which are currently in short supply in South Africa,” Molekwa said. Without temperature-regulated processing, post-consumer alternative plastics can go straight into municipal landfills like Robinson Deep in Johannesburg or Mariannhill in Durban. Buried beneath layers of mixed domestic waste, the environmental benefits vanish. Deprived of oxygen, heat, and microbial activity, PLA sits intact for decades, slowly decaying under anaerobic conditions that generate harmful methane. Molekwa said that under SA’s circular economy vision, _“_ landfilling is no longer a feasible option”. To divert plant-based plastics from dumpsites, the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment relied on its 2018 Guidelines on Separation of Waste at Source, encouraging households to sort refuse before collection. To build needed capacity, Molekwa said the department was using the Waste Management Flagship Programme, supported by the International Finance Corporation and Development Bank of Southern Africa, to pilot organic recovery, alongside the Recycling Enterprise Support Programme (Resp), which offers up to R5-million in grants to emerging waste ventures. Until those initiatives scale up, compostables threaten mechanical recycling. South Africa has a robust recycling network that processes tons of conventional PET and HDPE annually. But when well-meaning consumers throw PLA items into standard recycling bins, trouble begins. Because clear PLA looks identical to standard PET, it slips into recycling batches. Because PLA melts at a lower temperature, it chars during processing, degrading the recycled material’s structural integrity. The department highlighted this contamination risk, noting that protecting clean streams demanded strict sorting at the source: “It is important to note that the correct blend of materials is required to ensure proper degradation without negatively impacting compost quality. Furthermore, there is a high risk of contamination with non-biodegradable plastics; therefore, separation at source and accurate sorting are required. If this is in place, conventional plastics can slot in with other mechanical recycling systems,” Molekwa said. To assess the situation, producer responsibility organisation Petco is conducting a targeted study on market penetration of plant-based packaging to guide future policy interventions. While the bio-plastic industry in South Africa is growing, it is still at an early stage compared to other countries. Munyisamy said that accelerated growth required a concerted effort from the government, industry, scientists and policymakers. The CSIR continued to advocate for scientifically backed, locally relevant solutions to ensure a truly sustainable and pollution-free future.**DM**

title: 塞尔维亚变天：武契奇14年执政落幕，中塞“铁杆友谊”何去何从？

content:
图像来源，Getty Images

图像加注文字，败选前不久，武契奇才到访过北京，获习近平颁发“友谊勋章”。

*       *   Author, 余美霞
    *   Role, BBC中文记者

*   Published 3 小时前

*   阅读时间: 4 分钟

“很明显，我们输掉了选举。”塞尔维亚前总统武契奇（Aleksandar Vucic）在10月25日国会选举点票后承认落败。

由学生发起的“学生名单”取得议会大多数，终结武契奇长达14年的执政。尽管该名单的候选人几乎没有从政经验，大批塞尔维亚民众仍走上街头庆祝，有学生在社交平台写道：“塞尔维亚自由了。”

从总理到总统，武契奇领导的塞尔维亚进步党（SNS）一步步将塞尔维亚打造成欧洲最强硬的亲华国家之一，北京也曾以“铁杆友谊”形容两国关系。这场选举意味着塞尔维亚政治版图的巨变，外界关注亲华领导人下台后，中塞关系将走向何方。

有分析人士向BBC中文指出，北京“可能失去一个在欧洲最可靠的政治伙伴”，但两国投资关系紧密，外交政策不会出现“根本性的转向”。塞尔维亚与欧盟的关系如何发展，将是观察中塞关系走向的关键。

视频加注文字，塞尔维亚“变天”：武契奇输给一场没有领袖的学生运动

## 从火车站惨剧到国会变天

今届议会选举原定2027年举行。

但2024年11月1日，塞尔维亚北部城市诺维萨德（Novi Sad）火车站的混凝土檐篷倒塌，造成16人死亡，引爆持续近两年的大规模学生示威。抗议者要求政府审视工程安全并追究责任，并强调运动“没有领导者”。在示威压力下，武契奇辞去总统职务，9月宣布提前大选，转而角逐总理一职。

去年5月，示威学生筹组“学生名单－学生获胜”（Student List – Students Are Winning），由心脏病学教授斯尔贾诺维奇（Ilija Srdanovic）领军250名素人参选，角逐国民议会全部250个议席。

初步点票结果显示，“学生名单”得票53%，赢得141席，取得议会大多数；武契奇领导的塞尔维亚进步党得票39%，获104席。

图像来源，Getty Images

图像加注文字，由学生发起的“学生名单”取得议会大多数，终结前总统武契奇长达14年的执政。

根据“学生名单”的11项[竞选纲领](https://studenti.org.rs/en/plan/)，反腐与政策透明化是其首要任务，具体措施包括成立专责警察部门、审查公职人员资产、提高公共及国家项目采购透明度，以及让公共广播机构摆脱政治控制。

纲领写道：“塞尔维亚面临着一个明确的选择：要么在腐败中继续衰落，要么建立一个以尊重宪法和法律为基础、服务每一位公民的崭新国家。”

根据塞尔维亚宪法，新议会须在30天内召开会议，并在90天内组成新政府，议会多数党领袖将获提名为总理候选人。

但摆在新阵营眼前的挑战不少：候选人大多是学者、律师、医生、运动员和农民，几乎没有执政经验，组织又完全以去中心化模式运作，外界至今仍未知道他们将如何筹组内阁。

## 武契奇与中国的“铁杆友谊”

图像来源，Getty Images

图像加注文字，塞尔维亚总统武契奇（Aleksandar Vucic）在10月25日的国会选举承认败选，塞尔维亚民众上街庆祝。

在武契奇领导下，塞尔维亚成为中国在西巴尔干地区最重要的伙伴。它是最早与中国签署共建“一带一路”合作文件的欧洲国家之一，两国2016年建立全面战略伙伴关系，2024年更签署中国与中东欧国家之间的首个自由贸易协定。

这些年间，中资企业参与了塞尔维亚多个铁路、公路、能源等重大基建项目。引爆示威浪潮的诺维萨德火车站，正是“一带一路”框架下匈塞铁路项目的沿线车站之一。中国海关统计显示，2025年中塞双边贸易额达64.8亿美元，中国是塞尔维亚仅次于德国的第二大贸易伙伴。

经贸之外，两国领导人互访频密。武契奇曾于2023年访华；2024年，习近平对塞尔维亚进行国事访问，形容塞尔维亚是“真朋友、好伙伴”，称两国“铁杆友谊历久弥坚”。今年5月武契奇再度访华期间，习近平亲自向他颁授“友谊勋章”。新华社当时报导，武契奇“眼含热泪”，体现“两国关系的坚韧”。

“学生名单”的压倒性胜利，无疑是对武契奇政治阵营的一记重击。这场政坛变天会否动摇塞尔维亚和中国的“铁杆友谊”，更是外界关注的焦点。

德国墨卡托中国研究所（Mercator Institute for China Studies，MERICS）高级分析师埃娃·赛韦特（Eva Seiwert）向BBC中文指出，武契奇在发展塞中关系上一直扮演核心角色，但两国关系并非依赖其个人。她分析，塞尔维亚与欧盟经济联系紧密，政治上又对北京较为开放，中国企业得以在欧盟门户附近设立生产设施、建立供应链，涉及采矿、制造业等战略领域。

政治上，塞尔维亚一直是中国在欧洲“最可靠的伙伴之一”：塞方在台湾等敏感议题上支持北京，中国则在科索沃问题上支持塞尔维亚。赛韦特认为，武契奇落败肯定会打击中国在西巴尔干的地位，“因为北京可能失去一个在欧洲最可靠的政治伙伴”。

图像来源，Getty Images

图像加注文字，2026年5月25日，塞尔维亚总统武契奇在中国北京获颁“友谊勋章”。

## 北京会否改变对塞战略？

截至目前，北京尚未就选举结果公开表态。

赛韦特分析，由于北京在塞尔维亚已建立相当庞大的经济利益，投资“不可能轻易逆转”，两国关系不会出现“根本性决裂”。不过，“学生名单”在政纲中一直强调打击贪腐、公开所有国家合约和公开招标，同时着重保护农业用地和水资源。她指出，未来最主要的变化，可能是新政府对中国项目采取“更审慎、批判的态度”。实际发展仍要视乎新政府的施政优先次序，以及它会否切实履行加强问责的承诺。

现居曼谷的布鲁塞尔马滕斯中心（Martens Centre）学术委员会成员冯儒莎博士（Zsuzsa Anna Ferenczy）向BBC中文分析，由于北京仍希望维持在该地区的影响力，很可能会尝试与新领导层合作，寻找培养互信的方法。

“这需要时间，而北京愿意接受这个过程，亦愿意为此投入资源。”冯儒莎说。

她同样认为，“学生名单”强调寻求公义和问责，新政府可能会重新审视现有合作协议，加强审查中国在塞尔维亚的投资。

“因此关键问题是：北京能否在面对一个更重视透明度的政府时，继续维持其在塞尔维亚的经济及外交影响力？”

图像来源，Getty Images

图像加注文字，“学生名单”（Student's List）首位候选人伊利亚·斯尔贾诺维奇（Ilija Srdanovic）在该组织的总部进行庆祝。

## 欧盟因素成最大变数

冯儒莎指出，塞尔维亚与欧盟关系的发展，同样会左右中塞关系的走向。

多年来，塞尔维亚在与北京合作的同时一直寻求加入欧盟：2012年成为候选国，2014年启动入盟谈判，但因法治、腐败问题及与欧盟的立场分歧，进展缓慢。

冯儒莎指出，武契奇过去刻意在两条路线之间维持平衡，以巩固自己的执政地位。

新政府的外交取态目前仍不明朗。除了已表明[不参与](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-26/all-about-the-serbian-student-list-movement-that-ousted-leader-vucic)西方对俄罗斯的制裁外，它未就重大外交议题表态。

不过，塞尔维亚非政府组织CRTA今年9月发布的民调[显示](https://crta.plus/updates/serbias-foreign-policy-divide-follows-the-domestic-one/)，在“学生名单”的选民受访者中，42%认为加入欧盟是保护国家利益的最佳途径，只有9%选择与俄罗斯和中国结盟。

邻国匈牙利或可作为参照。今年4月，马扎尔（Péter Magyar）领导的蒂萨党（Tisza）在国会大选中终结总理欧尔班（Viktor Orbán）长达16年的执政，当时有分析[预测](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E5%B0%88%E6%AC%84%E6%AA%A2%E7%B4%A2/%E4%BB%8A%E6%97%A5%E7%B6%93%E6%BF%9F/20260417-%E5%BE%8C%E6%AD%90%E7%88%BE%E7%8F%AD%E6%99%82%E4%BB%A3%E5%8C%88%E7%89%99%E5%88%A9%E5%B0%8D%E8%8F%AF%E7%B6%93%E6%BF%9F%E9%97%9C%E4%BF%82-%E5%8B%99%E5%AF%A6%E9%9D%9E%E6%95%B5%E5%B0%8D-%E9%87%8D%E6%96%B0%E5%B9%B3%E8%A1%A1-%E5%BC%B7%E5%8C%96%E7%9B%A3%E7%AE%A1)，匈牙利将逐渐摆脱过度亲华的倾向，“重新融入欧洲主流”。

冯儒莎认为，“如果加入欧盟仍然是一个切实可行的目标，塞尔维亚可能会更有意愿减少在不同势力之间周旋，转而进一步靠拢欧盟”。

中欧亚洲研究所（CEIAS）项目总监理查·图尔察尼博士（Richard Turcsanyi）亦向BBC中文分析，胜出的政治联盟没有把太多焦点放在国际事务上，但他预计新政府会改善与欧盟的关系，施政上更遵循欧盟的价值观和原则，“这可能导致塞尔维亚与俄罗斯及中国的关系降温”。

选举结果出炉后，欧盟委员会主席冯德莱恩（Ursula von der Leyen）公开祝贺，表示：“我们随时准备支持在法治、媒体自由、反腐败和强大的民主制度方面进行的改革。”德国总理默茨（Friedrich Merz）亦在社交平台公开祝贺“学生名单”，肯定其法治、反腐败与基本自由的诉求，重申德国会积极支持塞尔维亚加入欧盟。

图尔察尼早前曾研究塞尔维亚民众对中国的看法，他指出民众普遍对中国抱持好感，“而且这种好感并不限于支持武契奇的选民”。他表示，无论新政府倾向为何，塞尔维亚政坛仍会经历一段动荡期，“直到新的政治平衡逐渐形成”。

韩联社首尔10月27日电 韩国国防部27日表示，国防部长官姜信哲当天将启程前往菲律宾，并于29日在宿务出席第13届东盟防长扩大会议（ADMM-Plus）。他是否会借此与美国防长皮特·赫格塞思举行会晤，备受关注。

这将是姜信哲自上月22日就任以来首次出席多边安全会议。据美国战争部（国防部）当地时间25日消息，赫格塞思也将出席东盟防长扩大会议。姜信哲前一天在国会国防委员会国政监查会上被问及“是否会在会议期间与赫格塞思会晤”时表示，双方正在协调安排。

姜信哲将在会上介绍韩国政府为实现韩半岛和平稳定所付出的努力，并呼吁与会各方予以关注和支持。姜信哲还计划与地区主要国家防长举行会谈，就防务交流与合作、军工合作等事宜进行讨论。（完）

## 女性影展台灣競賽揭曉！短片《防颱準備》奪金獎 風雨中展現女性韌性

2026-10-27 18:41 經濟日報／ 記者[侯思蘋](https://udn.com/news/reporter/NDExODc=)／台北即時報導  電影 ![Image 1: 2026台灣國際女性影展閉幕大合影。圖／台灣國際女性影展提供](https://pgw.udn.com.tw/gw/photo.php?u=https://uc.udn.com.tw/photo/t3/2026/10/27/35459554.jpg&M=1&s=Y&x=0&y=0&sw=1280&sh=853&sl=W&fw=930&exp=3600&w=930)

2026台灣國際女性影展閉幕大合影。圖／台灣國際女性影展提供

2026台灣國際[**女性**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E5%A5%B3%E6%80%A7)[**影展**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E5%BD%B1%E5%B1%95)閉幕暨台灣競賽頒獎典禮25日晚間於光點華山[**電影**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E9%9B%BB%E5%BD%B1)館登場，即便風雨來臨，仍不減影展的熱度與影迷的支持。巧合的是，台灣競賽「金獎：佑爾康品味講究獎」由香港導演陳穎文短片《防颱準備》摘下，片名與當前天候相互呼應，也讓這份得獎喜訊更添時事趣味。

今年女性影展台灣競賽共有19部影片入圍角逐大獎，直面移工、戰爭、跨性別等複雜議題，展現豐沛的創作能量。決審陣容囊括國內外資深學者、電影工作者，得獎名單於閉幕典禮盛大揭曉。主持人開場時提及，女性影展走過33年並不容易，而今年在颱風過後迎來閉幕，更讓人感受到影展一路走來「堅定而有韌性」的精神。

眾所矚目的台灣競賽頒獎名單，由香港導演陳穎文的《防颱準備》奪得「金獎：佑爾康品味講究獎」，評審陳明秀（Mia Chen Ming-Hsiu）、安努奇卡・德安德拉德（Annouchka de Andrade）、洪卲寅（Hong So-in）一致給予高度肯定。決選評審代表陳明秀在共同致詞中提到「評審團在這次的觀影過程中被深深感動，從參賽作品中看到了對於社會多元的包容，也感受到年輕創作者的活力。」也讚賞金獎《防颱準備》的情感力道，細膩勾勒了兩個世代的台港女性情誼，當風暴來襲時，深刻映照出女性的韌性與抵抗。

在接下金獎獎盃時，陳穎文驚訝表示自己並未預料到能夠奪得如此大獎，感性提到女性影展是此作品第一個入圍的影展，意義重大。也特別感謝台灣以及故鄉香港，表示兩地帶給她的養分成就了她。

銀獎頒予許慧如導演的《她的碎片》與施方婷、温晉豪導演的《餘波》。《她的碎片》揉合多元素材與檔案影像，在時間的跨度中為導演、母親與外婆的情感留下動人紀錄。雖然《她的碎片》導演許慧如不克參加這次的頒獎典禮，仍然為現場帶來致詞，表示女性的聲音在歷史中常常被遺忘，這次能夠拍攝這樣記錄「失去」的電影是一大幸事，也感謝所有願意在電影中出鏡的女性。

評審亦盛讚《餘波》，以緬甸戰火下的日常故事邀請觀眾在艱困時刻仍然跨越國界，想像更包容的未來。導演施方婷在得獎感言感性表示：「希望可以繼續拍下去，在世界各地繼續拍。」

評審團特別提及獎則由《恨女的逆襲》、《你不在這個蛋糕裡》拿下。《恨女的逆襲》主角林怡婷去年（2025）入圍金馬獎最佳新演員，今年女性影展評審亦熱烈肯定，直呼「注意！年輕一代登場了！」。導演李宜珊上台領獎時，表示這是《恨女的逆襲》的第一個影片獎。她感性表示，之前的短片作品都有投件，未來也會持續投件！

陳亭叡導演甫入圍2026金馬影展最佳動畫短片的《你不在這個蛋糕裡》大玩黑色幽默，成功擄獲評審的心。本片在後同婚年代持續關注女同志反抗歧視的力量，把歡笑與解放一同帶進戲院。發表感言時，導演陳亭叡開心分享女性影展對她有深刻影響，從女影實習生的身分，到今年的女影主視覺設計主視覺，女影是教會她許多事情的地方。

會外賽推出兩大獎項，其中台灣影評人協會推薦獎再度由《餘波》拿下，導演一晚驚喜抱回兩座獎項。評審讚許片中精準的調度，在有限的環境中拍出動人生命力。

而代表觀眾票選獎的王道女子力獎則獻給陳冠君導演執導的《一生二命》。影片中對跨性別生命之路的溫柔刻畫，將掙扎與困境化作感人影像，悉數傳遞給觀眾。頒獎現場，導演陳冠君攜手主角Birdy一同上台領獎，導演提及如果沒有Birdy，這部片就無法存在。

即使展期迎來颱風，仍不減觀眾對女性影展的支持與熱情。第33屆女性影展在志工、贊助夥伴及各界影迷的支持下，持續透過電影匯聚多元觀點，讓不同女性的生命經驗與創作得以被看見，順利落幕。策展人陳慧穎也感謝每一位在風雨中同行的工作夥伴，表示儘管放映艱辛，但電影價值就在於不斷的被播放、觀看。這樣的信念讓影展得以順利舉行，這場關於性別與影像的相遇將持續非分擾動。

content:
> 如果留给特朗普政府特权，人工智能可能会侵蚀美国的言论自由。

中国还提供了人工智能如何进一步限制和先发制人的反乌托邦预览。政府目前[使用（在新窗口中打开）](https://www.aspi.org.au/report/the-partys-ai-how-chinas-new-ai-systems-are-reshaping- human-rights/)人工智能来扫描和审查大量文本和视觉数据，而中国公司正在开发技术，使国家能够[重塑（在新窗口中打开） window)](https://www.nytimes.com/2025/08/06/us/politics/china-artificial-intelligence-information-warfare.html)通过个性化宣传舆论和[预测（在新窗口中打开）](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/01/us/politics/china-ai-predicting-dissent.html)哪些人将成为未来的持不同政见者。
“差距”一词意味着有一些东西需要填补，美国落后了，美国人应该尽快给予坚定的支持。这假设中国超过美国的威胁所造成的后果将远远大于缺乏公开辩论所造成的后果。这种成本效益分析是值得怀疑的。低成本中国模型的激增，包括[DeepSeek和Z.ai（在新窗口中打开）](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/07/chinese-ai-models-costs-us-openai-anthropic.html)发布的模型，正在[成本计算（在新窗口中打开）窗口）]（https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/26/china-ai-global-adoption.html）美国公司的市场份额以及[出口（在新窗口中打开）]（https://sccei.fsi.stanford.edu/publication/political-censorship-large-language-models-originating-china）[政治偏见（在新窗口中打开） window)](https://www.reuters.com/world/china/us-scrutinizes-chinese-ai-ideological-bias-memo-shows-2025-07-09/)和[提供（在新窗口中打开）](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/05/31/world/china-surveillance-solomon-islands-trump-nepal.html)监视工具专制国家。
然而，虽然中国对公共数据的获取具有扩展优势，但正是开放权重设计使其模型免费可用，从而支持了其扩散。有几种方法可以让美国公司获得更多的数据访问权，同时保护民主和隐私。其中包括[合成数据生成（在新窗口中打开）](https://hai.stanford.edu/ai-definitions/what-is-synthetic-data)，它从[模仿（在新窗口中打开）](https://www.weforum.org/stories/artificial-intelligence/data-ai-training-synthetic)真实场景的算法和模拟模型创建信息。国内辩论和监管的缺乏不会抵消中国开放模式的迭代优势。它可能会从内部瓦解美国的民主。

如果让特朗普政府拥有特权，人工智能可能会侵蚀美国的言论自由，特朗普政府[一再（在新窗口中打开）](https://www.aclu.org/news/free-speech/government-Pressure-to-suspend-jimmy-kimmel-was-an-abuse-of-power)违反了宪法对[言论自由（在新窗口中打开）]的保护。窗口）]（https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/13/politics/judge-gives-cnn-white-house-access-media-ban）。这种威胁使得围绕人工智能的公开辩论成为辩论权的元保障。
特朗普政府还可能使用数字工具在选举中操纵舆论，这是它所采用的策略

【原文 English Original】
> AI may erode freedom of expression in the US if left to the prerogative of the Trump administration.

China additionally offers a dystopian preview of how AI can further curtail and pre-empt public expression. The government currently [uses (Opens in new window)](https://www.aspi.org.au/report/the-partys-ai-how-chinas-new-ai-systems-are-reshaping-human-rights/) AI to scan and censor swathes of textual and visual data, while Chinese companies are developing technology that would allow the state to [reshape (Opens in new window)](https://www.nytimes.com/2025/08/06/us/politics/china-artificial-intelligence-information-warfare.html) public opinion through personalised propaganda and [predict (Opens in new window)](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/01/us/politics/china-ai-predicting-dissent.html) which individuals will become future dissidents.

The word “gap” implies that there is something to fill, that the US is behind and Americans should hasten towards unflagging support. This presumes that the threat of China outpacing the US would inflict consequences far greater than those resulting from a lack of public debate. Such a cost–benefit analysis is questionable. The proliferation of low-cost Chinese models, including those released by [DeepSeek and Z.ai (Opens in new window)](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/07/chinese-ai-models-costs-us-openai-anthropic.html), is [costing (Opens in new window)](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/26/china-ai-global-adoption.html) US companies market share as well as [exporting (Opens in new window)](https://sccei.fsi.stanford.edu/publication/political-censorship-large-language-models-originating-china)[political biases (Opens in new window)](https://www.reuters.com/world/china/us-scrutinizes-chinese-ai-ideological-bias-memo-shows-2025-07-09/) and [supplying (Opens in new window)](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/05/31/world/china-surveillance-solomon-islands-trump-nepal.html) surveillance tools to autocracies.

However, while China’s access to public data has [afforded (Opens in new window)](https://sccei.fsi.stanford.edu/china-briefs/has-access-government-data-given-chinas-ai-firms-innovation-edge) it a scaling edge, it is the open-weight design that has made its models freely available, supporting its proliferation. Several approaches could allow US companies greater data access while preserving democracy and privacy. They include [synthetic data generation (Opens in new window)](https://hai.stanford.edu/ai-definitions/what-is-synthetic-data), which creates information from algorithms and simulation models that [mimic (Opens in new window)](https://www.weforum.org/stories/artificial-intelligence/data-ai-training-synthetic) real-world scenarios. A lack of domestic debate and regulation would not offset the iterative advantage of China’s open models. It could unravel American democracy from the inside.

AI may erode freedom of expression in the US if left to the prerogative of the Trump administration, which has [repeatedly (Opens in new window)](https://www.aclu.org/news/free-speech/government-pressure-to-suspend-jimmy-kimmel-was-an-abuse-of-power) violated the constitutional protection of [free speech (Opens in new window)](https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/13/politics/judge-gives-cnn-white-house-access-media-ban). Such a threat makes public debate surrounding AI a meta-safeguard for the very right to debate.

The Trump administration may also use digital tools to manipulate public opinion in elections, a tactic it employed – through [human trolls (Opens in new window)](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/national-security/russian-trolls-who-interfered-2016-u-s-election-also-made-n1013811) – that predates the widespread and incisive competencies of AI. The risk of AI undermining free elections further underscores a need for public debate, which has animated [both sides (Opens in new window)](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/05/03/us/politics/democrats-republicans-ai.html) of the aisle.

Describing Chinese support for AI as the result of “optimism” and “enthusiasm” quietly counsel against such debate. Used to compare the US and China in what is characterised as a [zero-sum race (Opens in new window)](https://www.bloomberg.com/graphics/2026-us-china-ai-race/) between the countries to dominate AI, these phrases suggest that the American public should surrender judgement calls surrounding regulatory guardrails. They imply that Americans’ concerns do not serve their self-interest. The irony of these descriptors lies in their exclusionary effects within the hawkish, binary framework of “us versus them”.

Given the Chinese government’s control over technology companies and their deployment of AI, “them” is clearly defined. “Us”, however, could mean tech executives who express societal aspirations for their R&D, politicians, civil society, or media in the United States. The appraisal of the American public’s concerns as a competitive disadvantage insinuates that the public should remove itself from decisions that will have significant political consequences.

Taking public pressure out of the equation may benefit AI executives and a White House that favours unilateral action. It is unlikely to benefit the American people, whose agency may be ephemeral as a result.

# Help 88-year old Veteran Keep His Home After Marriage Fraud

UPDATE 9/8: Our retainer is gone and we are in need of funds to replenish the trust account with the attorney. We are in the middle of the discovery process, and while the wife continues to hide assets, we are forced to subpoena her bank and investment accounts which costs more money. The lawyer will ask the court that she pay our attorney fees, it likely won’t be granted until the trial in February. By then we may be out a lawyer because we can’t pay him. UPDATE 6/25: We have retained an attorney! We are continuing to seek donations for when the retainer runs out. Due to family donations, we need to raise less money than originally anticipated, so we’ve lowered our fundraiser from $15,000 to $10,000. My 88-year-old father is a victim of elder abuse and marriage fraud that may leave him homeless and destitute. I am setting up this GoFundMe to pay for his legal representation, likely the only way he will be able to keep his home of 23 years. Please hear our story: About six years ago, my father was pursued through an online dating site by a woman named Candy. In a matter of days and through very limited communication, she convinced my father she was in love with him, asked for his address, hopped on a Greyhound, and moved into his small home. Within two weeks they were married at the courthouse. Candy is a citizen of the People’s Republic of China, had been in and out of the country on a B2 tourist visa, and is 22 years younger than my father. Immediately after the marriage, Candy began the US citizenship process with my father's sponsorship. Upon her demand, my father took out a series of small loans to hire her an immigration attorney even though she started working. She began to receive social security spousal support, and was also receiving money from her Chinese pension. In spite of her income, my father continued to pay all their bills himself, including the mortgage and utilities. When Candy took a trip to Hawaii (with her friends and her own income), my father disclosed to me that he did not feel safe with her. I learned she had become increasingly hostile towards him, calling him fat, denying him food, referring to him as “the sickly old man” behind his back, and at times being aggressive enough that he would choose to sleep and/or sit in his car until she left the house. Her favorite insult was "garbage husband." It became increasingly clear that Candy was exploiting my father. At one point she approached him with a Quit Claim deed to transmute his sole property into community property. In the throes of an abusive relationship, my father felt like he had no choice but to sign the deed. Now my father's home of 23 years - and its equity - belongs to her as well. About a year ago, Candy started stealing money from my father, and he found himself overwhelmed with not being able to pay the bills that supported them both. By this time, my father had long been beaten down from the abuse, but in a last ditch effort he built up the nerve to ask Candy to return the stolen money and sign a quit claim to give back his house - she said only if he gave her $80,000! My brother and I were relieved when my father made the decision to file for divorce, and we become increasingly involved on his behalf. We prepared court paperwork for him as he cannot identify the correct documents. My father can't type and his handwriting is slow, so filling out forms is also challenging. He is a poor communicator. He often nods off at court. Recognizing that my father cannot represent himself in court, a judge ordered a settlement conference, which went nowhere fast because Candy still demands $80,000. My father does not have any money laying around, and is leveraged to the hilt with debt from the marriage (all in his name), so he couldn't borrow money to pay her even if he wanted. As a National Guard veteran, senior, and low-income individual, my father is eligible for free legal advice three times over, but what he needs is representation. Because of his advanced age and the complexity of his case, he does not have the mental capacity to represent himself. He has long been unable to organize and process decent amounts of detailed information without assistance. He is overwhelmed at the thought of losing his house, which flusters him even more. If he loses his house, not only does he face homelessness, but more importantly he loses the property's equity that was intended to cover his long-term nursing care, care that he is starting to need, and the emotional toll of being forced to sell and move out of his house would surely be the end for him. We appreciate every donation, big and small. The money raised will go directly to his legal representation. Please feel free to contact me with questions or more details.
