content:
#### The China Channel Gets a Regulator

##### _What State Council Order No. 841 Means for EB-5 Migration Agents, Regional Centers, and Issuers_

_**By: Osvaldo F. Torres, Esq. | Torres Law PA**_

On July 22, 2026, Premier Li Qiang signed State Council Order No. 841, promulgating the Regulations of the State Council on Exit and Entry Administration (the “Regulation”), which took effect on September 15, 2026.[[1]](https://iiusa.org/what-chinese-state-council-order-no-841-means-for-eb-5/#_ftn1) Most early commentary from the international trade bar has focused on Article 4, which authorizes the Ministry of Commerce and other authorities to bar Chinese citizens from leaving China for export-control and technology-transfer violations.[[2]](https://iiusa.org/what-chinese-state-council-order-no-841-means-for-eb-5/#_ftn2) That provision deserves attention, but for the EB-5 industry the more consequential text sits a few articles later.

Articles 7 through 13 create a national filing and conduct regime for “outbound and inbound intermediary services,” defined to include policy consultation, document processing, and procedure handling on behalf of persons leaving or entering China. That description fits the day-to-day work of the Chinese migration agencies that introduce investors to EB-5 offerings, assemble source-of-funds files, and coordinate with U.S. counsel. Mainland China has long been the largest single source of EB-5 capital, and the migration agent remains the principal channel through which that capital reaches U.S. projects. A new regulatory layer on that channel therefore reaches, directly or indirectly, most regional centers and new commercial enterprises (NCEs) that raise capital in China.

This article summarizes the intermediary provisions, identifies where they intersect with U.S. securities and EB-5 compliance obligations, and suggests practical steps for sponsors before the first filing deadline in December.

#### The Intermediary Framework in Brief

The Regulation implements the Exit and Entry Administration Law, which took effect in 2013. According to official explanatory remarks, one of its three stated objectives is to improve regulation of the immigration intermediary service market.[[3]](https://iiusa.org/what-chinese-state-council-order-no-841-means-for-eb-5/#_ftn3) The Regulation pursues that objective through four mechanisms.

**Mandatory filing.** Agencies providing intermediary services must file with the local immigration administration within 15 days of establishment. Individual practitioners are filed through their agencies.[[4]](https://iiusa.org/what-chinese-state-council-order-no-841-means-for-eb-5/#_ftn4) Agencies already operating before September 15, 2026 must complete the filing within 90 days, which is on or about December 14, 2026.[[5]](https://iiusa.org/what-chinese-state-council-order-no-841-means-for-eb-5/#_ftn5) The National Immigration Administration, working with the State Council’s market-supervision authorities, is charged with issuing detailed filing measures, and none had been published as of this writing.[[6]](https://iiusa.org/what-chinese-state-council-order-no-841-means-for-eb-5/#_ftn6)

**Qualification standards.** Article 8 requires that an agency be lawfully established; that its legal representative not have been criminally punished for an intentional crime; that it have staff with professional knowledge of exit-entry law and policy, together with funds and premises proportionate to its services; that client-facing staff not have been convicted of intentional crimes endangering national security, public safety, or border administration; and that it maintain management systems covering personnel, training, data preservation, data security, and compliance.[[7]](https://iiusa.org/what-chinese-state-council-order-no-841-means-for-eb-5/#_ftn7) Two further provisions in Article 8 matter most for EB-5, and are discussed below. First, agencies engaged in outbound services “should also have established cooperative relationships with relevant overseas service agencies or signed valid letters of intent for cooperation.” Second, “[f]oreign companies and institutions are prohibited from providing outbound and inbound intermediary services within China.”

**Prohibited conduct.** Article 10 bars intermediaries from (i) publishing false information or soliciting clients through “exaggerated or misleading publicity”; (ii) providing false materials or helping others obtain visas, residence permits, or other documents illegally; (iii) disclosing, selling, or illegally providing trade secrets, personal privacy, or personal information learned in the course of their services; (iv) operating beyond the scope of their registration; (v) organizing or assisting cross-border illegal activity; and (vi) other acts that endanger national security or disrupt exit-entry order. Article 9 directs immigration authorities, together with the commerce, education, human resources, market supervision, and other departments, to supervise intermediaries and to publish information on violations and adverse records.[[8]](https://iiusa.org/what-chinese-state-council-order-no-841-means-for-eb-5/#_ftn8)

**Penalties.** An agency that fails to file or does not meet the Article 8 conditions will be ordered to rectify. If it refuses, it faces fines of RMB 5,000 to 10,000 and suspension; in serious cases, fines of RMB 10,000 to 50,000 and revocation of its business license. Article 10 violations carry confiscation of illegal gains and a fine of one to five times those gains where they exceed RMB 20,000, or RMB 20,000 to 50,000 otherwise, along with possible suspension or license revocation and fines of RMB 10,000 to 50,000 on directly responsible managers. Issuing false invitation letters or supporting materials is separately fined under Article 11. Article 16 requires immigration authorities to maintain open reporting channels, and Article 17 preserves criminal liability.[[9]](https://iiusa.org/what-chinese-state-council-order-no-841-means-for-eb-5/#_ftn9)

The monetary penalties are modest by U.S. standards. The reputational and operational consequences, however, can be significant. Public adverse records, suspension, and license revocation could each remove an agent from the market in the middle of an offering.

#### Why It Matters for EB-5 Sponsors

##### 1. Cooperation agreements put U.S. sponsors in the Chinese record

Because Article 8 expects outbound agencies to show a cooperative relationship or letter of intent with an overseas service provider, Chinese agents will likely ask their U.S. counterparties to sign one. In EB-5, that counterparty is usually the regional center or NCE, and sometimes U.S. immigration counsel. Some agents may present short-form documents drafted for submission to Chinese authorities rather than the negotiated agent agreement.

Sponsors should treat these documents as offering-related materials. A cooperation letter that describes the sponsor’s program, the agent’s role, or the investment’s features in terms that differ from the private placement memorandum creates a second, inconsistent record, and one that now sits in a government file. Any such document should be reviewed by securities counsel, conform to the agent agreement and the offering documents, and avoid statements about returns, visa outcomes, government endorsement, or the sponsor’s regulatory status.

##### 2. The foreign-firm prohibition limits direct-to-investor models

Article 8 prohibits foreign companies and institutions from providing intermediary services within China. The Regulation does not define the boundary between “outbound policy consultation” and adjacent activities. A U.S. sponsor’s staff, or even a U.S.-licensed immigration attorney, explaining EB-5 eligibility, the I-526E process, or conditional residence to prospective investors at an in-China seminar could plausibly be characterized as the former.

Structures that warrant review include representative offices or wholly foreign-owned enterprises of U.S. regional centers, roadshows and seminars led by U.S. personnel, China offices of U.S. law firms that advise on immigration process, and hybrid models in which a U.S. sponsor effectively runs a domestic agent’s client service. The prohibition could also limit the participation of regional centers and U.S. immigration law firms in conferences and events in China, including those organized by Chinese organizations such as provincial exit-entry associations. The sale of an interest in a U.S. limited partnership is conceptually distinct from an immigration intermediary service. In EB-5, however, the two are marketed together, and Chinese authorities may not separate them. The offering of foreign securities in China also raises its own PRC securities and foreign-exchange questions that fall outside this Regulation.

Until the implementing measures clarify scope, the conservative approach is to have in-China immigration consulting performed by filed domestic agencies, to confine U.S. personnel to activities that PRC counsel has confirmed fall outside Article 8, and to document that analysis.

##### 3. The misleading-publicity ban converges with U.S. antifraud standards

Article 10(i)’s prohibition on “exaggerated or misleading publicity” reaches the marketing claims that have repeatedly caused trouble in EB-5: “guaranteed” green cards, “guaranteed” return of capital, implied U.S. government backing, and understated risks or timelines. Those claims already expose issuers and anyone who makes them to liability under Section 17(a) of the Securities Act and Rule 10b-5.[[10]](https://iiusa.org/what-chinese-state-council-order-no-841-means-for-eb-5/#_ftn10) They also implicate the [Reform and Integrity Act’s](https://www.congress.gov/117/plaws/publ103/PLAW-117publ103.pdf) promoter provisions and the regional center’s obligation to oversee persons involved in its offerings.[[11]](https://iiusa.org/what-chinese-state-council-order-no-841-means-for-eb-5/#_ftn11)

The practical change is that agent misstatements now carry regulatory risk in China as well as the United States, and Chinese enforcement may produce a public adverse record. Migration agents may respond by curtailing their EB-5 marketing, particularly on social media platforms such as WeChat, to reduce the risk of an Article 10(i) violation. Sponsors should plan for that possibility in their fundraising timelines. They should also require agents to use only sponsor-approved materials, including reviewed Chinese-language translations; prohibit agent-generated summaries of offering terms; keep copies of all materials in circulation; and add the Article 9 adverse-record publications to their periodic diligence on agents.

##### 4. Screening for public officials and military personnel

The final paragraph of Article 10 directs that where public officials, military personnel, or other individuals entrust agencies to “illegally process foreign nationality, permanent residency status abroad, foreign residency documents, or other outbound and inbound documents or procedures,” the agency “shall not process such applications and shall promptly report such cases to supervisory authorities.”[[12]](https://iiusa.org/what-chinese-state-council-order-no-841-means-for-eb-5/#_ftn12) An EB-5 petition is, by definition, a step toward permanent residence abroad. The qualifier “illegally” matters: the provision appears aimed at persons whose positions restrict foreign residency, not at emigration generally.

The provision has two consequences for sponsors. First, investor pipelines may narrow because agents are likely to decline clients who hold, or recently held, government, military, or state-enterprise positions subject to restrictions on foreign residency. Second, an investor’s file may be reported to Chinese authorities before it reaches USCIS. Sponsors should add a representation on public-official and military status to s

title: Strength vs. Confrontation: Do American Forces in the First Island Chain Deter or Invite War?
summary: “We are not going to get involved militarily in any way on the Island of Formosa,” [announced Secretary of State Dean Acheson](https://www.jstor.org/stable/pdf/44639236.pdf) in January 1950. Taiwan fell outside of America’s security commitm
content:
“We are not going to get involved militarily in any way on the Island of Formosa,” [announced Secretary of State Dean Acheson](https://www.jstor.org/stable/pdf/44639236.pdf) in January 1950. Taiwan fell outside of America’s security commitment. He further described an [American defensive perimeter](https://www.cia.gov/readingroom/docs/1950-01-12.pdf) spanning from the Aleutian Islands through Japan and the Philippines. For the rest of the Pacific, he said that “a [security] guarantee is hardly sensible or necessary within the realm of practical relationship.”

Along with Taiwan, Korea fell outside American guarantees. Concerned about provoking a conflict in Korea, the [United States pressed South Korea](https://history.army.mil/portals/143/Images/Publications/catalog/30-3.pdf) to build a small, constabulary army that lacked heavy weapons. Without an American security commitment, forward-deployed United States forces, or a capable South Korean army, North Korea saw an opportunity to quickly reunify the peninsula. Five months after Acheson’s speech, North Korean forces invaded. T-34 tanks, invulnerable to South Korea’s light weaponry, spearheaded the attack and almost conquered the South [before the United States could deploy forces](https://www.armyupress.army.mil/Journals/Military-Review/English-Edition-Archives/May-June-2025/Preparing-Advisors/) to halt the communist offensive at the Pusan Perimeter. By October, China entered the war. This deterrence failure cost the lives of [](https://web.archive.org/web/20190724211722/https:/history.army.mil/brochures/kw-stale/stale.htm#analysis)[36,516 Americans](https://web.archive.org/web/20190724211722/https:/history.army.mil/brochures/kw-stale/stale.htm#analysis), hundreds of thousands of Chinese, and over two million Koreans.

After the deterrence failure that led to the Korean War, the United States recognized the necessity of forward presence to prevent war. Within two days of the start of that war, President Harry S. Truman [deployed the 7th Fleet](https://www.trumanlibrary.gov/library/public-papers/173/statement-president-situation-korea) to defend Taiwan. In September 1954, the Chinese shelled Taiwan’s Kinmen Island. Two months later, the United States had signed a mutual defense treaty with Taiwan, which deterred further Chinese escalation.

**The US Commitment to the First Island Chain**

As the risk of a catastrophic war in East Asia has reemerged, the United States must maintain this lesson: When it has defended forward and demonstrated the capability and resolve to make [aggression infeasible](https://editorials.voa.gov/a/time-for-pacific-allies-to-share-defense-burden/8157641.html), it has deterred opponents. When it has not, it has invited war.

With that understanding, the 2026 [](https://media.defense.gov/2026/Jan/23/2003864773/-1/-1/0/2026-national-defense-strategy.pdf)[National Defense Strategy](https://media.defense.gov/2026/Jan/23/2003864773/-1/-1/0/2026-national-defense-strategy.pdf) commits the military to “build, posture, and sustain a strong denial defense along the [first island chain],” which includes Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, and the Philippines. By focusing on forward-deployed forces, which could immediately respond to Chinese aggression, [the strategy](https://yalebooks.yale.edu/book/9780300268027/the-strategy-of-denial/) reduces the potential for China to achieve its policy objectives in a quick, cheap war. The strategy prioritizes cost-effective, asymmetric capabilities to buttress America’s allies. It prevents war for cheap, so what is the argument against it?

In a [recent analysis](https://www.defensepriorities.org/explainers/a-second-island-chain-strategy-for-asia/), Jennifer Kavanagh asks whether America’s commitments to the first island chain “really make Americans safer and more prosperous?” She argues that since the United States has limited interests in the region, it should withdraw to the more defensible second island chain and end its security commitments to the countries of the first island chain. While she leads a worthwhile thought exercise, her recommendations risk Chinese regional hegemony, war, and economic upheaval while precluding an overdue shift by the American military to cheap, asymmetric military capabilities.

At the moment, her argument seems far from becoming policy. Elbridge Colby, head of policy in the Pentagon, recently [briefed the Senate](https://media.defense.gov/2026/Sep/28/2004007869/-1/-1/1/UPDATE-ON-IMPLEMENTATION-OF-THE-2026-NATIONAL-DEFENSE-STRATEGY-AS-SUBMITTED-TO-THE-SENATE-ARMED-SERVICES-COMMITTEE.PDF) on the implementation of the National Defense Strategy, discussing the increasing complexity of [Exercise Balikatan](https://www.pacom.mil/Media/News/News-Articles/Article/4483964/philippines-us-conclude-balikatan-2026/) in the Philippines, which included a live fire of the new [Typhon missile system](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/05/us-fires-tomahawk-missile-from-typhon-launcher-in-philippines-for-the-first-time/). He also argued that America’s posture has led to increased commitment by South Korea, Japan, and Australia to regional security.

However, some recent events have raised questions about the endurance of America’s commitment to the first island chain. For example, the United States [did not counter a Chinese diplomatic and economic campaign against Japan](https://reader.foreignaffairs.com/2026/09/28/japan-is-giving-the-united-states-a-chance-in-asia/content.html) following Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s statement that a Chinese use of force against Taiwan would constitute an “[existential threat](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/japan-and-china-trade-barbs-after-pm-takaichi-says-an-attack-on-taiwan-would-be-an-existential-threat)” for her country. The United States has also [postponed missile shipments](https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/japans-order-tomahawk-missiles-delayed-by-us-use-iran-bloomberg-news-says-2026-04-03/) to Tokyo, paused a planned arms sale to Taiwan, temporarily operated [without an aircraft carrier](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/u-s-pulls-last-aircraft-carrier-in-asia-as-trump-focuses-on-iran-and-the-western-hemisphere) in the region, and [scaled back military exercises](https://mwi.westpoint.edu/ulchi-freedom-shield-one-shortened-exercise-does-not-mean-us-south-korean-conventional-nuclear-integration-is-breaking-down/) with South Korea. Whether a critic’s charge that all of this amounts to “[great-power collusion](https://www.foreignaffairs.com/united-states/trump-rise-and-fall-great-power-competition)” or it is just the messy detritus of multifaceted great-power competition is not the point. The point is that perceptions of a weakened commitment could undermine allied confidence and create opportunities for China to expand its sphere of influence within the first island chain.

The US administration would argue that these moves are apart of deterrence as it attempts to navigate the trade-offs of deterring China “[through strength, not confrontation](https://media.defense.gov/2026/Sep/28/2004007869/-1/-1/1/UPDATE-ON-IMPLEMENTATION-OF-THE-2026-NATIONAL-DEFENSE-STRATEGY-AS-SUBMITTED-TO-THE-SENATE-ARMED-SERVICES-COMMITTEE.PDF)”—seeking to preserve the capability to deny Chinese aggression while not provoking Beijing—it raises an important question: Where does the balance lie between strength and confrontation?

**The Problem with Narrow National Interests**

To provide the foundation of her argument for restraint, Kavanagh begins by defining US interests in Asia, which she does more narrowly than either the current and previous administrations. She writes that “The United States has two core interests in Asia worth protecting with military power: defending the US homeland and safeguarding access to key economic markets and trade routes.”

While such an approach can seem intellectually fruitful, the use of national interests to drive policy can be [problematic](https://www.econlib.org/Columns/y2018/Lemieuxnationalinterest.html#_ftnref4). A narrow list of national interests cannot capture the complexity of American foreign relations.

Kavanagh mentions safeguarding markets, but she sees no core interest in ensuring peace in the region, although the United States [traded $2 trillion in goods](https://www.census.gov/foreign-trade/balance/c0016.html) with Asia in 2025. A war over Taiwan would indefinitely disrupt the world’s supply of advanced computer chips. As the American economy has become reliant on those chips to fuel its [economic growth](https://am.jpmorgan.com/us/en/asset-management/adv/insights/market-insights/market-updates/on-the-minds-of-investors/how-much-of-the-ai-boom-is-adding-to-us-growth/) and technological competitiveness, a prolonged interruption in their production would risk an economic crisis.

**The Risk of War**

When Kavanagh does discuss the risk of war, she seems to see the main threat as being unintended escalation. She argues that “The United States should also remove the long-range fire system (the Typhon) currently located in the Philippines, as it’s both unnecessary to support the commitments outlined here and highly escalatory.” Her argument raises a crucial debate on whether forward-deployed forces deter conflict or escalate its risks.

China would certainly argue that the American deployments of [Typhon to the Philippines](https://mb.com.ph/2025/1/28/china-mum-marcos-typhon-deal) or [THAAD to Korea](https://digital-commons.usnwc.edu/cgi/viewcontent.cgi?article=1736&context=nwc-review) are escalatory. But that is Chinese messaging, not reality. In a similar vein, Xi Jinping [regularly cites](https://hegemon.substack.com/p/chinas-favorite-american-idea)[_The Thucydides Trap_](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/26/xi-trump-thucydides-trap-us-china.html). Even though that book has [several](https://substack.com/home/post/p-153768458)[methodological](https://www.airuniversity.af.edu/Portals/10/SSQ/documents/Volume-15_Issue-4/SC-Hanania.pdf)[problems](https://issforum.org/roundtables/12-2-thucydides), it provides Xi with a means to argue that provocative moves could lead to war.

In contrast to Xi’s self-serving argument, historical experience provides little support for the proposition that provocation through position is itself the primary cause of war. Of course, leaders often cite enemy provocations to legitimize military action, but that does not mean those incitements actually caused a war. Adolf Hitler blamed Polish “[saboteurs](https://tvpworld.com/82061340/tracing-the-origins-of-world-war-two-the-gleiwitz-incident-85-years-on)” for war in 1939. Vladimir Putin blamed Ukrainian “[fascists](https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2022/02/24/putin-denazify-ukraine/)” for war in 2022. In fact, both Poland and Ukraine, in worrying about provoking war through escalation, delayed military mobilization and so [presented tempting targets](https://www.brookings.edu/books/surprise-attack/).

Whatever their public justifications, leaders tend to initiate wars when they gamble that a short war could be [a cost-effective means of achieving a policy objective](https://cornellpress.cornell.edu/book/9780801493461/conventional-deterrence/#bookTabs=1). In addition to the Korean War, modern history is replete with examples of leaders gambling on a short war: the Suez Crisis, the Six-Day War, the Indo-Pakistan War of 1971, the Yom Kippur War, the Cambodian-Vietnamese War, the Sino-Vietnamese War, the Soviet-Afghan War, the Iran-Iraq War, the Falklands War, the Persian Gulf War, the Afghanistan War, the Iraq War, the Russo-Georgian War, and the Russo-Ukrainian War. As with those examples, the risk of war in the first island chain comes not from US provocation but from Xi Jinping betting he could quickly seize Taiwan in a [fait accompli](https://people.tamu.edu/~ahmertarar/fait_accompli.pdf) before American intervention.

MANILA – A sharp exchange between Philippine and Chinese officials over the South China Sea is highlighting rising tensions in the region, even as the movement of the USS George Washington carrier group from Japan to the Middle East raises questions about the U.S. military commitment to the Indo-Pacific.

At a security forum in Seoul, Philippine Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. was emphasizing the importance of international law when a South Korean staff member handed him a note from a Chinese official challenging Manila's position on the South China Sea.

Teodoro read the message aloud before delivering a pointed response.

"China neither recognizes nor accepts the award. Of course, because you lost. And opposes it and will never accept any claim or action arising from it," Teodoro said.

He then criticized the delivery of the message, calling it disrespectful to international law, South Korean hosts and the audience.

"This is actual coercion, bullying and aggression," he said.

The confrontation underscores a long-running dispute over the 2016 international arbitral ruling that rejected the legal basis for China's expansive claims in the South China Sea. The ruling remains a major point of contention between Beijing and Manila, with China refusing to accept the decision.

Now, questions about the movement of major U.S. naval assets are adding another dimension to regional security concerns. The departure of the USS George Washington carrier group from Japan has prompted questions about whether a shift in American military deployments could affect deterrence in the Indo-Pacific.

Philippine military officials, however, say there is no reason for alarm.

Philippine Navy spokesman Rear Admiral Roy Trinidad said Manila remains confident in its security arrangements with Washington, despite the movement of U.S. naval vessels.

"We are not concerned about any reduction in US forces or other like-minded nations' forces in the Indo-Pacific Region. Despite the transfer of US naval vessels, the Mutual Defense Treaty remains in place," Trinidad said.

He added that military activities had been planned and approved in advance, with many exercises already conducted this year and additional joint exercises scheduled for next year.

International security expert Dr. Renato de Castro said U.S. carrier strike groups serve as a visible demonstration of American naval power and help deter potential aggression by China.

However, he noted that American military capabilities in the region extend well beyond aircraft carriers.

"Aside, of course, from the American battle groups, you have also the operation of nuclear attack submarines and American ballistic missile submarines. They are there; they operate. They are also very deadly, but of course they're not visible," De Castro said.

Meanwhile, Chinese military activity continues to raise concerns among U.S. allies and partners. Chinese warships have increased operations near Japan and the Philippines, while Taiwan has reported 118 sightings of Chinese vessels, highlighting the continuing pressure around the island.

De Castro said countries across the region are responding by strengthening their own defense capabilities rather than simply relying on the United States.

The goal, he said, is to ensure that security alliances with Washington remain a two-way commitment as regional tensions continue to mount.

# 特朗普：美国若有聪明的总统 台湾和中国的问题就不会存在

茉莉花综合报道 2026年10月27日 01:08

美国总统特朗普10月25日接受电视节目主持人柯德洛（Larry Kudlow）电话访问时说：“你看，如果我们有聪明的总统，台湾和中国之间的问题就不会存在，就会是，你知道的，没人会在乎。”他接着说，“他们偷走了我们的芯片生意，全部，100%，因为他们用荒谬的价格生产芯片，然后硬推进来”，但没有说明“他们”指谁。

特朗普是在谈汽车厂和关税时说这番话的：他说汽车厂商回到美国，是因为不想付25%的关税，他已经把关税定得很低，如果他们开始占便宜，他可以提高到50%。受影响的首先是台湾的芯片产业：特朗普10月13日在阿拉斯加的造势活动上就说，台湾多年前偷走了美国的芯片生意，因为以前没有一位总统愿意对芯片征关税，所有人都搬到台湾生产芯片，但现在都在搬回来。10月20日，他在北卡罗来纳州的造势活动上宣布，战争部将投资15亿美元在当地生产尖端芯片；商务部长卢特尼克说，总统的根本目标之一，就是把半导体制造带回美国，半导体都在台湾制造，对美国来说实在太远。特朗普14日还宣布，台湾承诺采购价值700亿到800亿美元的阿拉斯加液化天然气，并投入44亿美元股权投资。

特朗普多次说台湾偷了美国的芯片产业；台湾外交部长林佳龙今年5月曾重申，台美是共生伙伴关系，没有谁偷谁、谁伤谁，要把饼做大，保护民主供应

title: 巴西总统卢拉：北京在美国后院的“老朋友”第四次赢得大选
summary: ## 巴西总统卢拉：北京在美国后院的“老朋友”第四次赢得大选 视频加注文字，卢拉总统如何扭转局势击败弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗？（英语影片） * * Author, 玛丽娜·罗西（Marina Rossi） * Role, BBC巴西葡语记者 * Reporting from, 圣保罗报导 * Author, 利安德罗·普拉泽雷斯（Leandro Prazeres） * Role, BBC巴西葡语记者 * Reporting from, 巴西利亚报导 * Author, 瓦妮莎·布

## 巴西总统卢拉：北京在美国后院的“老朋友”第四次赢得大选

视频加注文字，卢拉总统如何扭转局势击败弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗？（英语影片）

*       *   Author, 玛丽娜·罗西（Marina Rossi）
    *   Role, BBC巴西葡语记者
    *   Reporting from, 圣保罗报导

    *   Author, 利安德罗·普拉泽雷斯（Leandro Prazeres）
    *   Role, BBC巴西葡语记者
    *   Reporting from, 巴西利亚报导

    *   Author, 瓦妮莎·布施吕特（Vanessa Buschschlüter）
    *   Role, BBC拉丁美洲网上新闻编辑
    *   Reporting from, 伦敦报导

*   Published 2026年10月26日上午10点13分

*   阅读时间: 4 分钟

在经过一场激烈角逐的竞选之后，巴西资深左翼总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦（Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva；劳拉）成功连任，击败了尚未承认败选的右翼对手弗拉维奥·博索纳罗（Flávio Bolsonaro；博尔索纳罗）。

巴西高等选举法院（Superior Electoral Court）宣布，在所有选票点算完毕后，卢拉获得51.79%的选票，而博索纳罗获得48.21%。

但博索纳罗拒绝承认选举结果，称投票延长两小时“无法解释”——尽管他的竞选团队以及其对手的竞选团队都曾要求投票站延长开放时间。他在巴西利亚向支持者表示，他将寻求撤销此次选举。

然而，这并未阻止卢拉及其支持者庆祝他们所称的“历史性胜利”和一次出人意料的逆转胜。

在胜选演说中，将于星期二（10月27日）满81岁的卢拉赞扬年轻选民走上街头“捍卫巴西民主”。

他通往第四个任期的道路并不平坦。自巴西于1988年恢复民主以来，他是首位在第一轮投票落败却最终赢得总统大选的领导人。而他再次当选、展开额外第二个任期，也属前所未有。

他还逆转了拉丁美洲更广泛的趋势——在该地区，选民纷纷惩罚执政者并转向右翼。整个地区内，阿根廷、智利和哥伦比亚等大国如今都由保守派领导人执掌。

](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/ws/640/cpsprodpb/41be/live/5969d000-d094-11f1-93e1-3b657b665bcf.jpg.webp)

图像来源，EPA/ Shutterstock

图像加注文字，卢拉周日投票后向支持者致意。

“我们的喉咙都很疲倦了。”在胜选演说中，卢拉以沙哑的嗓音开场。

他几乎立刻把麦克风交给副总统杰拉尔多·阿尔克明（Geraldo Alckmin），说希望由阿尔克明先发言。

阿尔克明对卢拉说：“你第二次拯救了巴西民主。”卢拉随后感谢竞选团队的统筹者，也感谢“巴西人民的慷慨”，其中包括“走上街头捍卫巴西民主”的年轻人。

他对群众说，人们之所以投票，是因为我们能够说服他们，这一票对我们国家的主权很重要。

他说，这场选举是“消极情绪与谎言的失败”。卢拉在胜选演说中再次强调，巴西“不会接受成为任何人的后院”。

这是他在竞选期间一再重复的说法之一，指向“美国的后院”一词，用来概括美国政策中一种观念：拉丁美洲应处于美国的势力范围之内。

卢拉的竞选活动在首轮失利后重新焕发生机，其动力来自街头示威和大规模的社交媒体攻势。

这位前金属工人自1989年首次参选总统以来一直是巴西左翼的主导人物，然而，他现在面对的是自2003年首次执政以来最具挑战性的政治格局。

他将于2027年1月5日开始的新任期，将在国内外重重掣肘之下展开，其中包括来自美国总统唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump；川普）的敌意。

虽然特朗普并未直接为卢拉的对手弗拉维奥·博索纳罗背书——他曾在哥伦比亚和洪都拉斯举行的总统选举中为最终获胜的右翼候选人背书——但几乎可以肯定，他的政府更希望看到一位保守派执掌这个拥有2.13亿人口的国家。

白宫将拉丁美洲视为美国的势力范围，特朗普政府热切希望支持其政策的领导人上台执政，包括在国防、安全和贸易方面的政策。

美国政府还热切希望削弱中国在西半球的影响力。

巴西石油资源丰富，并拥有全球第二大稀土矿物储量，是南美洲唯一非右翼领导人执政的大国，而卢拉在很大程度上被视为对华友好。

弗拉维奥·博索纳罗曾承诺让巴西与华盛顿结盟，而卢拉则警告美国不要干预选举，并坚称巴西“绝不会成为任何人的后院”。

不过，尽管白宫可能感到失望，卢拉的胜利将受到环保人士的欢迎。他们曾担心，博索纳罗若胜选，将使巴西颇具影响力的农业综合企业和采矿业获得更大权力。

他们曾指出，在博索纳罗的父亲雅伊尔（Jair Bolsonaro）担任总统期间，亚马逊地区的森林砍伐和森林火灾创下纪录水平，并认为在这位较年轻的博索纳罗治下，更宽松的环境政策可能再次导致这一关键生态系统遭到破坏。

图像来源，Reuters

图像加注文字，2025年，在巴西马拉尼昂州（Maranhao）新中心（Centro Novo）附近举行的联合国气候变化大会（COP30）期间，绿色和平组织（Greenpeace）空中巡查拍摄的航拍画面显示亚马逊雨林中一处正在燃烧的火点

尽管卢拉的支持者对他的胜利欣喜若狂，但选举结果显示这个国家仍然深度分裂，超过48%的选民选择了博索纳罗。

除了团结这个如此严重极化国家的挑战之外，卢拉还将不得不与巴西民主时代最右翼的国会同朝执政。

博索纳罗的自由党（PL）是此次选举中斩获最多的政党。

然而，卢拉的劳工党（Workers' Party）在决选前成功组织了大型集会，显示出该党所拥有的强大基层支持。

选举前，卢拉曾将这次投票形容为“巴西的分水岭”。

他承诺以“新的治理方式”弥合巴西对立政治阵营之间的鸿沟，并在选前的一场WhatsApp直播中补充说，“这个国家将不会再是原来的样子”。

虽然他几乎没有提供有关新治理方式具体内容的细节，但他坚称自己将“坚定不移地为建设一个更公正的国家而奋斗，让人人都有机会，让政策以民众的需求为导向”。

面对一个大致上充满敌意的国会，这场奋斗对这位资深领导人来说——其第四任期结束时将年满85岁——可能会比他此前三次执政时期艰难得多。

## 卢拉：北京在美国后院的“老朋友”

**BBC 中文记者陈岩**

图像来源，Getty Images

卢拉这个名字，在中国并不陌生。作为巴西左翼的代表，卢拉一向乐于与中国发展良好关系。

2023年4月，他对北京进行国事访问，这是他时隔12年重新执政后，首次出访美洲以外的国家，习近平在那次会谈中称他为“老朋友”。

2023年那次访问期间，卢拉专程前往上海，出席罗塞夫出任新开发银行行长的就职典礼。罗塞夫被视为卢拉一手提携的政治接班人，2011年至2016年任巴西总统，卸任后加入新开发银行。

这家银行由金砖国家（BRICs）于2015年成立，总部设在上海。不仅如此，2024年9月，习近平在北京人民大会堂向罗塞夫颁授“友谊勛章”。这是中国对外国人的最高国家荣誉，她也是该批授勛者中唯一的外国人。

颁奖仪式后不到两个月，习近平便访问巴西，受到卢拉的盛情接待。欢迎仪式上，巴西艺术家用中文演唱了《我的祖国》。2025年5月，卢拉再度国事访华，这是他第六次到访中国，也是同一任期内第二次访华。

巴西与中国在农业（尤其是大豆）、矿产等出口产业上的贸易往来十分紧密，但其实卢拉始终强调战略自主，避免选边站队。

卢拉任内，巴西并未直接加入“一带一路”倡议。2024年11月习近平访巴期间，双方签署合作规划，把“一带一路”与巴西的“加速增长计划”等本国发展战略对接。这显示出卢拉的务实取向：既希望通过与中国合作获取经济利益，又坚持把主导权握在自己手里。

中国资本也在加速进入巴西。据巴中企业家委员会统计，2024年中国对巴西直接投资同比增长113%，约42亿美元，巴西跃升为中国全球第三大投资目的地；2025年增至61亿美元，升至第一位。投资领域从石油、电力等传统行业，扩展到新能源汽车、科技和可再生能源制造。比亚迪在巴伊亚州卡马萨里（Camaçari, Bahia）的工厂，2025年10月下线了该公司全球第1400万辆新能源汽车，这辆车最终交付给了卢拉本人。

另一方面，卢拉经常批评美国，也多次抨击美元霸权，希望以金砖国家机制为支点，不必依附华盛顿。但他并未放弃与美国企业合作。

今年8月，卢拉推动的“巴西AI计划”公布超级计算项目，总投资约23亿雷亚尔（4.6亿美元；30.9亿元人民币；151亿元新台币）。其中，里约热内卢的先进计算中心交由华为和科大讯飞两家中国企业合作建设。

另有约10亿雷亚尔用于采购一台高性能超级计算机，外界预计将由美国企业英伟达中标。

同一项战略安排同时纳入中美企业，说明即便与北京关系密切，卢拉也没有在中美之间一边倒。

这一逻辑同样适用于此次大选中卢拉的对手弗拉维奥·博索纳罗。这位参议员是前总统博索纳罗的长子，与父亲一脉相承，强调国家安全和深化对美合作，家族与特朗普交情甚笃，今年5月他刚在华盛顿与特朗普会面。

但选战临近，弗拉维奥也拒绝把外交描绘成中美二选一。他在9月明确表示，若当选，对华关系将以经济务实为原则，“我们不必选边”。

这也折射出许多中等国家面对中美竞争的心态：不愿倒向任何一方成为附庸，而是希望成为两边都想争取的对象，从中获取更大收益。

图像来源，Reuters

图像加注文字，福田康夫任职日本首相仅仅一年，但早已是执政自民党的“影子外相”。

Published 5 小时前

阅读时间: 5 分钟

日本执政自民党宣布，在2007至2008年间担任日本首相的福田康夫已于近日逝世，享年90岁。

[自民党星期一（10月26日）公布](https://www.jimin.jp/news/information/214461.html)，福田康夫上星期四（22日）逝世，葬礼将仅安排近亲参加。共同社等媒体引述消息人士称，福田康夫因心脏功能衰竭，在东京一家医院去世。

福田康夫从上任到辞任首相仅365天，且当时曾招致批评，但中日媒体均指出其致力改善两国关系，包括促成时任中国国家主席胡锦涛访问日本。

现任日本首相高市早苗赞扬福田康夫在任期间“竭尽所能”；中国外交部称呼其为“中国人民的老朋友”。

## 改善中日关系的“终身事业”

福田康夫2007年9月26日就任日本首相，2008年9月24日卸任，前后仅365天。但在此之前，他担任内阁官房长官三年半，是自由民主党政权迄今任期第二长的官房长官。

福田康夫是在[安倍晋三](https://bbc.com/zhongwen/trad/world-62093144)辞去其首次任期后当上执政自民党党总裁与日本首相。他被视为外交“鸽派”，在任内主张改善周边尤其是对华关系。

福田康夫回避安倍晋三修改和平宪法以促进海外军事部署等较具野心的政策，又促成了胡锦涛到访，那是时隔十年来首次有中国国家元首访日。

图像来源，Reuters

图像加注文字，福田康夫担任首相期间，胡锦涛成为了10年来首位访日的中国国家主席。

福田康夫在日本内阁任内也曾处理中日外交冲突：2001年4月，森喜朗内阁与小泉纯一郎内阁交接之际，[东京批准台湾前总统李登辉到访](http://news.bbc.co.uk/hi/chinese/news/newsid_1293000/12931952.stm)，引起北京强烈不满。作为政府首席发言人的内阁官房长官福田康夫为内阁辩护，称是基于人道理由而向李登辉发出签证。

1995年1月，仍只是众议员的福田康夫曾访问台湾，会晤李登辉。当时由中国国民党执政的台湾总统府仍将访问称为“访华”，[官方新闻稿](https://www.president.gov.tw/NEWS/22444)除了称福田康夫“曾多次访华”外，还称他“担任众议员以来，经常给予我国支持与协助”。

共同社指出，由于在官房长官任内积极推动官邸外交，福田康夫这位发言人也被称为“影子外相”。

图像来源，Reuters

图像加注文字，上任约三个月，福田康夫以日本首相身份访华，与时任中国总理温家宝开展“棒球外交”。

[Skip 2007年12月：福田康夫访华 and continue reading](https://bbc.com/zhongwen/articles/cm4g149yw14lo/simp#end-of-article-links-block)**2007年12月：福田康夫访华**

End of 2007年12月：福田康夫访华

辞任首相后，福田康夫于2010年给中国参与创办的博鳌亚洲论坛担任理事长，并连任至2018年，卸任后留任论坛咨询委员会主席。[2025年3月](https://www.news.cn/20250327/be307fbb96fa4948b12aa1c82d14a2f5/c.html)，福田康夫仍有为博鳌论坛年会一场周边会议发表书面致辞。

[2014年7月](https://bbc.com/zhongwen/trad/china/2014/08/140804_japan_china_talks)，中国与日本再次因东海钓鱼岛（日本称尖阁诸岛；台湾称钓鱼台列屿）主权争议陷入外交僵局之际，福田康夫以博鳌论坛理事长身份访华，秘密替二度出任日本首相的安倍晋三传话，呼吁现任中国国家主席习近平同意对话。

“或许连中方也没想到事态会陷入如此僵局。这真是一件令人遗憾的事。”

报导称，福田康夫在专访中也反问了究竟是哪一方制造了对立的火种。

图像来源，Kyodo News/Reuters

图像加注文字，2014年10月，福田康夫在北京会晤习近平。同年7月，福田康夫曾替安倍晋三充当说客，秘密访华斡旋中日外交僵局。

在星期一的例行记者会上，中国外交部对福田康夫逝世表示“沉痛哀悼”。

外交部发言人郭嘉昆说：“福田康夫先生是中国人民的老朋友，为推动中日关系改善发展作出积极贡献。他长期心系中日友好、秉持正确历史观，担任首相期间签署了中日第四份政治文件，卸任后参观了侵华日军南京大屠杀遇难同胞纪念馆。”

郭嘉昆不点名批评高市早苗说：“福田康夫先生曾指出，中日四个政治文件规定了两国关系遵循的原则，必须时刻牢记，不能走回头路。这一表态掷地有声，体现了日本老一辈政治家的信义和担当，日本当政者应当深思自省。”

台湾总统赖清德[透过社交平台X](https://x.com/ChingteLai/status/2114631536826003860)对福田康夫逝世表达“深切哀悼”。

“台日之间由深厚情谊紧密相连。期盼今后双方交流与合作进一步深化，并愿这份无可替代的友谊长久延续。”

图像来源，China News Service

图像加注文字，从日本政坛引退后，福田康夫仍长期参与中国主导的博鳌亚洲论坛工作。

## “前无古人”的首相父子

据NHK报导，高市早苗对福田康夫辞世感到“悲痛”。

高市早苗在首相官邸对记者说：“在丰富的经验和卓越的见识基础上，即使面对极其困难的课题，他也始终竭尽所能，一项一项持续推动相关工作。”

“作为北海道洞爷湖峰会主席，他也大力向世界展现了我国的存在感。”

图像来源，JIJI PRESS/AFP via Getty Images

图像加注文字，2000年10月底，时任日本首相森喜朗（右）任命福田康夫（左）出任内阁官房长官。福田康夫及后成为自民党迄今任期第二长的官房长官。

福田康夫1936年7月16日生于东京，祖籍群马县高崎市，父亲福田赳夫最初是代表群马县选区的众议院议员，后来出任首相。

尽管出身政治世家，福田年轻时对职业政治并没有太大兴趣，在石油公司以“上班族”身分度过了17年。

然而，原本被培养成政治接班人，过继他人的弟弟横手征夫染上重病后，福田康夫接手成为父亲的秘书，并跟随其进入首相官邸任职。

1990年，福田赳夫退休，当时53岁的福田康夫接替父亲参选，并首次当选众议员。

福田康夫先后给森喜朗和小泉纯一郎两任首相担任官房长官，其中小泉纯一郎任内发生美国911恐怖袭击，福田康夫被日本媒体视为该国应对后续影响的主要人物。

图像来源，AFP via Getty Images

图像加注文字，福田康夫被视为外交鸽派，与他曾经的上级小泉纯一郎（左）形成鲜明对比。

当小泉纯一郎的继任人安倍晋三宣布辞职，福田康夫宣布竞逐党总裁，旋即获得党内不同派系支持。[他的当选](http://news.bbc.co.uk/chinese/trad/hi/newsid_7010000/newsid_7011600/7011682.stm)，使福田家成为日本宪政史上首个父子先后出任首相的家族。

但在他出选时，被外界形容为以脾气急躁见称的福田康夫曾笑说，面对国会朝野分立、在野党有能力拖延立法进程的景况，他当选首相“也许是抽到了下下签呢”。

2008年，冲绳发生驻日美军士兵涉嫌强奸14岁女孩事件，[福田康夫对此表示“不可饶恕”](http://news.bbc.co.uk/chinese/trad/hi/newsid_7240000/newsid_7240300/7240367.stm)，但他曾在2003年被国内媒体曝光其私下称，一些女性衣着暴露自招强奸，“穿成那种样子的人自己也有问题”。

作为一个鸽派人物，福田康夫除了主张与中国修补关系外，也对朝鲜（北韩）采取较灵活立场，尤其是在尝试解决[1970至1980年代平壤绑架问题](https://bbc.com/zhongwen/articles/cj03vgl8dz3o/trad)方面。

图像来源，Reuters

图像加注文字，福田康夫当选日本首相，缔造了父子二代先后担任日本政府首脑的历史。

在立法施政受制于在野党派之下，福田康夫执政风格显得被动，其任内爆发的一连串丑闻也逐步侵蚀其民望：年金纪录遗失、军方贿赂丑闻，以及一项因增加老年人负担而引发强烈不满的医疗制度改革。

2008年4月至6月间，日本经济出现萎缩，只要多持续一个季度，日本便技术上进入经济衰退。8月的内阁改组曾短暂提振福田政府的声势，但在此过程中，他也提拔了自己的竞争对手[麻生太郎](http://news.bbc.co.uk/chinese/trad/hi/newsid_7630000/newsid_7633700/7633700.stm)。

[2008年9月1日深夜](http://news.bbc.co.uk/chinese/trad/hi/newsid_7590000/newsid_7592000/7592086.stm)，福田康夫宣布辞任首相，[舆论譁然](http://news.bbc.co.uk/chinese/trad/hi/newsid_7590000/newsid_7594200/7594287.stm)。一些评论指责他“放弃政权”，《每日新闻》更形容其行为属“毫无信念的政治漂流”。9月24日，麻生太郎当选首相，正式接替福田康夫。

一年后，日本举行大选，福田康夫并未参选，且正式宣布退出政坛，由长子福田达夫继承衣钵。

title: 东京专栏 - 中美俄首脑或举行首次首脑峰会  日本担心什么？
summary: 最近，关于于11月18日、19日在中国深圳举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）领导人会议，将举行中美俄三国领导人会谈的消息日益显现出实现的现实性，而三国的首脑会谈，也会对把美国作为唯一同盟国的日本造成一定的冲击。 **三国会谈能否真的实现？** 从现在各方面的消息看，三国领导人会谈可能性很大。据多家媒体报道，俄罗斯总统普京于9日与美国总统特朗普举行电话会谈，并提议借下月在中国举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）领导人非正式会议之机，举行中美俄三国领导人会谈。 而美国总统特朗普则在
content:
最近，关于于11月18日、19日在中国深圳举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）领导人会议，将举行中美俄三国领导人会谈的消息日益显现出实现的现实性，而三国的首脑会谈，也会对把美国作为唯一同盟国的日本造成一定的冲击。

**三国会谈能否真的实现？**

从现在各方面的消息看，三国领导人会谈可能性很大。据多家媒体报道，俄罗斯总统普京于9日与美国总统特朗普举行电话会谈，并提议借下月在中国举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）领导人非正式会议之机，举行中美俄三国领导人会谈。

而美国总统特朗普则在19日表示，他愿意最早于11月与中国国家主席习近平、俄罗斯总统普京举行有关军备控制问题的领导人会谈。如果会谈得以实现，这将是三国首脑首次举行此类磋商。

特朗普对记者表示：“我们可能会举行会谈，讨论核武器和无核化问题。”他还说：“如果习近平主席希望举行会谈，我会同意。我们还会讨论贸易等其他问题。”

从目前来的情况看，美国和俄罗斯已经直接表达了希望会谈的意愿，那么中国怎么样呢？

俄罗斯总统助理（负责外交政策事务）乌沙科夫10月21日透露，鉴于中国、俄罗斯和美国可能于下月举行首次三国领导人会谈，中国政府已着手进行相关准备。

乌沙科夫表示：作为APEC领导人非正式会议东道国的中国朋友们，将着手进行相关准备。更准确地说，他们已经开始准备了。如果条件成熟，中国将把三国领导人会谈纳入APEC领导人非正式会议的日程安排。

普京21日在圣彼得堡与美国总统特使威特科夫举行会谈。会谈结束后，乌沙科夫就三国磋商的构想称：“莫斯科、华盛顿和北京都没有拒绝这一设想。”看来三国首脑首次会谈呼之欲出。

**特朗普会不会顺访朝鲜或在中国与金正恩会面引人注目**

在11月3日举行的美国中期选举中，由特朗普总统领导的共和党正面临一场艰难的选战。目前，共和党在国会参众两院维持的多数席位，都有可能被民主党夺走。特朗普在短期内已经无法挽回支持率低迷，四面楚歌的境地，而在外交与安全保障领域，总统依然拥有很大的权力和自由裁量权。这次欲举行中美俄三国首脑会谈，也是希望在外交上得分。

而特朗普会不会再打出另一张“王牌”，即与他称为“亲密朋友”的朝鲜最高领导人金正恩举行一场出人意料的首脑会谈十分引人注目。朝鲜不是亚太经济合作组织成员，特朗普要实现与金正恩的会谈需要顺访朝鲜或在中国与其会谈。

特朗普或许打算从金正恩那里争取到某种让步，取得一定成果，并以此向选民展示政绩。

10月12日，特朗普在白宫接受记者提问时，当被问及其访问亚洲期间是否可能举行美朝首脑会谈时，他回答说：“也许会见面。那将会令人兴奋。” “我和他（金正恩）相处得很好。”可以认为，特朗普借助媒体向朝鲜方面传递了希望举行首脑会谈的信息。

而特朗普在19日（当地时间）在白宫接受记者采访，有记者问特朗普“你认为下个月能在中国与朝鲜领导人会面吗”时，他表示：“不知道。”

但是同时特朗普总统表示：“我和金正恩委员长相处得非常好”，再次强调了自己与金正恩之间的密切关系。他还说：“我不确定他是否希望举行会谈，但我和金正恩的关系非常好。”

而金正恩于10月24日突然访问中国。日本舆论普遍认为，表面上看，金正恩此行是为了纪念中国参加朝鲜战争76周年以及边境大桥通车等活动，但外界认为，其真正目的一方面是向国际社会炫耀中朝关系的“蜜月状态”，另一方有意重开美朝交涉，也可能是为安排在中国进行美朝首脑会谈“打前战”。

如果特朗普能和金正恩见面，不论是否取得什么成果，可能都会给特朗普所领导的共和党在中期选举中加分。

**日本担心什么？**

那么，日本对这次会谈担心什么呢？

首先，如果中美俄首次实现首脑会谈，将对乌克兰战局乃至东北亚的地缘政治产生深刻的影响。中俄朝在安全保障方面都在威胁着日本，如果特朗普与这些对日本的安全保障形成重大威胁的集权国家在某种意义上握手言欢，达成某种合作的共识，那就一定会严重弱化日美同盟和美韩同盟。

第二，日本对三国首脑会谈的举行对将与会的高市早苗首相的外交活动产生的影响比较担心高市早苗的外交空间可能会受到挤压。高市早苗在10月16日的参议院预算委员会会议上，被问及是否会出席11月在中国广东省深圳市举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）领导人非正式会议时回答说：“如果能够获得国会的批准，我就会出席。”如果中美韩三国首脑的会谈先于高市首相与特朗普的首脑会谈，那么高市怎样对应与特朗普的会谈将很难预设，针对中俄加强日美同盟的威慑力等话题也将很难开口，高市如何与特朗普讨论三国会谈都将成为外交难题。

日本方面现在也正在积极争取在亚太经济合作组织领导人会议期间实现与中国国家主席习近平的会谈，如果实现了三国首脑会谈，日中首脑会谈可能会因为中国实现了三大国的合作更加蔑视日本，使日中首脑会谈更难实现。

第三，日本担心在中美俄三国会谈中，美国为了从中俄得到更多的利益，在台海安全等方面作出出人意料的让步，那么对一贯认为“台湾有事就是日本有事”的日本来说，就又增加了新的忧虑。

第四，日本担心历史的叠印。美国总统特朗普9月24日在白宫举行的欢迎中国国家主席习近平的仪式上表示，第二次世界大战期间，美国和中国曾是“盟国”（allies）。美国总统在谈及二战时称中国为“盟国”这种说法极为罕见，在日本政府内部和媒体都引起很大波澜。

而这次中美俄首脑会谈，也会令人想起中美俄共同抗日的历史。韩国《韩民族日报》论说委员朴显10月23日在雅虎新闻网上发表题为《中美俄三国首脑会谈会成为“第二次雅尔塔会议”吗？》的文章，在题目和文章中谈及雅尔塔会议。

雅尔塔会议（Yalta Conference）中，美、英、苏三国首脑（罗斯福、丘吉尔、斯大林）签署了一份针对日本的秘密协定，即《苏美英三国关于日本的协定》（通称《雅尔塔协定》或“雅尔塔密约”）， 在协定中苏联正式承诺，在纳粹德国投降且欧洲战争结束后的2至3个月内，参加同盟国方面对日作战。

朴显在文章中指出：“如果此次会谈得以实现，那么，世界三大核大国领导人齐聚一堂的场景本身就将成为一种信号。这可能成为一个象征性场景，预示着一种‘势力范围秩序’的到来——大国之间取代‘基于规则的秩序’，转而决定弱小国家的命运。”

三国能不能像9月中美首脑会谈那样，谈及中美俄共同抗日的历史，也是日本十分担心的。

title: DPP's Shen unveils Taipei waterway plan, attends Halloween event - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: 民进党沉沉公布台北航道规划并出席万圣节活动 - 聚焦台湾

中新社台北10月26日电 民进党台北市市长候选人沈伯洋周一在参加万圣节活动前提出振兴首都水道，家长们纷纷表示支持他的育儿政策。

在台北中正区竞选总部举行的新闻发布会上，沉从新加坡的城市水管理方法中汲取灵感，概述了振兴城市水道的计划。

沉说，该计划重点关注五个优先事项——活跃、美丽、清洁、拘留和生态系统——统称为“ABCDE”。

具体措施包括改善淡水河和基隆河沿线的滨水设施，以方便公众使用；利用湿地和植被改善水质；以及在学校和公园建设小型蓄洪设施，以增强城市的防洪能力。

“我们每天都在用水，但我们的城市实际上距离水还很远。”沉说，他认为城市水管理应该融入教育、文化和环境保护，而不是仅仅关注工程。

沉说，在城市发展过程中，台北的许多溪流和灌溉渠道已被覆盖、填平或纳入地下排水系统，使居民与城市的水道疏远。
他说，该举措旨在重新连接居民与这些水道，并使水成为城市规划的核心考虑因素。

## 万圣节活动

周一晚些时候，沉在天母棒球场外的万圣节活动中打扮成船长，戴着爆炸式假发，向孩子们和其他参加者分发糖果。

台北居民韩武是参加此次活动的人之一，他是一位 35 岁的设计师，带着妻子和 2 岁的女儿前来参加。

吴告诉中央社，他不是民进党的坚定支持者，此前曾支持前台北市长柯文哲，但对沉的育儿建议表示欢迎。

其中一项特别吸引他的提议是，沉计划每周为学龄前儿童提供最多四个小时的免费上门托儿服务。

据市政府称，台北市目前在指定设施提供临时托儿服务，其中大多数收费每小时 200 新台币（6.13 美元）。

吴说，提议的免费托儿服务可以提供急需的缓解，因为他和妻子都工作，他们的女儿工作日每天要和保姆一起度过大约 12 个小时。

“我认为这会给父母一些喘息的空间，”他说，并补充说这项服务可以让他们在周末休息或处理紧急情况。

39 岁的艺术教育家 Yinling Hsu 与丈夫和 6 岁的女儿一起参加了这次活动，她说她也被沉的建议所吸引，该建议旨在解决他所说的父母抚养孩子所经历的“孤立”问题。
台北居民许回忆，女儿在幼儿园生病时，她不得不带女儿去上班，因为她和丈夫都工作，而且亲戚都住在台北以外的地方。

她说：“父母通常需要的是在抚养孩子时出现紧急情况时的支持。”她补充说，拟议的每周四小时免费上门托儿服务可以让父母有时间做出其他安排。

台北市政府对沉的提议的可行性提出质疑，社会福利部在 6 月份估计，与该市以前的计划相比，每周需要 414,000 小时的托儿服务。

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 26 (CNA) Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) Taipei mayoral candidate Puma Shen (沈伯洋) on Monday proposed revitalizing the capital's waterways before attending a Halloween event where parents expressed support for his childcare policies.

At a news conference at his campaign headquarters in Taipei's Zhongzheng District, Shen outlined a plan to revitalize the city's waterways, drawing inspiration from Singapore's approach to urban water management.

The plan focuses on five priorities -- Active, Beautiful, Clean, Detention and Ecosystem -- collectively known as "ABCDE," Shen said.

Specific measures include improving waterfront facilities along the Tamsui and Keelung rivers to make them more accessible to the public, using wetlands and vegetation to improve water quality, and developing small-scale floodwater retention facilities in schools and parks to strengthen the city's flood control capacity.

"We use water every day, but we are actually very far removed from the water in our city," Shen said, arguing that urban water management should incorporate education, culture and environmental protection rather than focus solely on engineering.

Shen said many of Taipei's streams and irrigation channels had been covered, filled in or incorporated into underground drainage systems during urban development, distancing residents from the city's waterways.

He said the initiative aimed to reconnect residents with these waterways and make water a central consideration in urban planning.

## Halloween event

Later Monday, Shen, dressed as a ship captain and wearing an Afro wig, handed out candy to children and other attendees at a Halloween event outside the Tianmu Baseball Stadium.

Among those at the event was Taipei resident Han Wu, a 35-year-old designer who came with his wife and 2-year-old daughter.

Wu told CNA he was not a staunch DPP supporter and had previously supported former Taipei Mayor Ko Wen-je (柯文哲), but welcomed Shen's childcare proposals.

One proposal that particularly appealed to him was Shen's plan to provide up to four hours of free drop-in childcare per week for preschool children.

Taipei currently offers drop-in childcare at designated facilities, most of which charge NT$200 (US$6.13) per hour, according to the city government.

Wu said the proposed free childcare could provide much-needed relief, as he and his wife both work and their daughter spends around 12 hours a day with a nanny on weekdays.

"I think it would give parents some breathing room," he said, adding that the service could allow them to rest on weekends or deal with emergencies.

Yinling Hsu, a 39-year-old art educator who attended the event with her husband and 6-year-old daughter, said she was also drawn to Shen's proposals to address what he calls the "isolation" experienced by parents raising children.

Hsu, a Taipei resident, recalled having to bring her daughter to work when the child fell ill at kindergarten because both she and her husband worked and their relatives lived outside Taipei.

"What parents often need is support when emergencies come up while raising children," she said, adding that the proposed four hours of free drop-in childcare per week could give parents time to make alternative arrangements.

The Taipei City government has questioned the feasibility of Shen's proposal, with its Department of Social Welfare estimating in June that it would require 414,000 hours of childcare services per week, compared with the city's existing capacity of 130,000 hours.

## Taiwan's local elections

Shen is challenging incumbent Kuomintang Mayor Chiang Wan-an (蔣萬安) in the Nov. 28 local elections.

The elections are also known as the "9-in-1" elections because voters in Taiwan's 22 cities and counties will cast ballots for candidates vying for nine different local government posts, including city mayors, county magistrates, and city and county councilors.

Other positions being contested include township chiefs, chiefs of Indigenous districts in municipalities, township councilors, Indigenous councilors in municipalities and ward chiefs.

In total, elections will be held for 11,051 officials at all levels of local government.

(By Huang Li-yun and Sunny Lai)

title: “自我革命”、持续清洗：习近平为下一任期铺路
source: 美国已不是世界老大 - 纽约时报中文网
summary: 十多年来，中国领导人习近平一直通过一波又一波的反腐调查和忠诚教育运动来约束该国的官员。 如今，73岁的习近平准备争取再执政五年，他抱怨一些官员依然不忠诚、麻木不仁且腐败，并表示需要采取更严厉的措施。 本月，中国共产党宣布对中国西南部城市重庆的前市长[黄奇帆展开调查](https://english.news.cn/20261013/0ec6725bb5b242e69f65dd7866b5259e/c.html "Link: https://english.news.cn/20
content:
十多年来，中国领导人习近平一直通过一波又一波的反腐调查和忠诚教育运动来约束该国的官员。

如今，73岁的习近平准备争取再执政五年，他抱怨一些官员依然不忠诚、麻木不仁且腐败，并表示需要采取更严厉的措施。

本月，中国共产党宣布对中国西南部城市重庆的前市长[黄奇帆展开调查](https://english.news.cn/20261013/0ec6725bb5b242e69f65dd7866b5259e/c.html "Link: https://english.news.cn/20261013/0ec6725bb5b242e69f65dd7866b5259e/c.html")，这充分展现了习近平巩固权力的行动之无情。黄奇帆曾历经数位曾任其上司的党内官员倒台而安然无恙，卸任后也仍然保持活跃，地位显赫。这类调查几乎总是以官员被判刑入狱而告终。

黄奇帆的新闻传出之际，正值党的精英机构中央委员会准备本周在北京举行会议。在[为期四天](https://english.news.cn/20260921/f67fb4c531814047a7954a05f86d6a66/c.html "Link: https://english.news.cn/20260921/f67fb4c531814047a7954a05f86d6a66/c.html")的会议期间，这个由数百名官员组成的群体预计将为习近平明年开启第四个党领导人任期奠定基础，并批准用于审查官员的严格规则。

党正在为其下一届全国代表大会做准备，每五年举行一次的大会旨在宣布领导层的改组。将在2027年晚些时候举行的这次大会上，习近平必须任命一批新的年轻官员在他麾下工作。专家表示，这一背景或许可以解释他为何重新执着于强化服从。

“习近平希望留下怎样的遗产？我认为，首要的是一个更强大的共产党，甚至可能比一个更强大的中国更为重要，”亚洲协会政策研究所中国政治高级研究员[牛犇](https://asiasociety.org/policy-institute/neil-thomas)(Neil Thomas)表示。“在他看来，前者是后者的首要前提。”

2016年，时任重庆市市长黄奇帆在北京。在接受调查之前，作为一名退休官员，他有超乎寻常的公众知名度，经常发表演讲并撰写书籍。Jason Lee/Reuters

再连任五年将巩固习近平作为中国数十年来最具主导地位的领导人这一地位，尤其是因为他[没有明确的接班人](https://cn.nytimes.com/china/20251021/china-communist-succession-plenum/ "Link: https://cn.nytimes.com/china/20251021/china-communist-succession-plenum/")。

但是，牛犇和他的同事在一份关于这次党内会议的[前瞻中写道](https://asiasociety.org/policy-institute/limits-xis-control-what-watch-chinas-fifth-plenum)，习近平“对那些本应执行其意愿的人始终感到失望”。

现届中央委员会在2022年上届党代会成立时共有[376名成员](http://english.news.cn/special/cpc20/documents.html)。但习近平的清洗行动造成了严重减员。在去年的委员会会议上，出席人数[降至315名官员](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202510/24/WS68faba01a310f735438b6991.html "Link: https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202510/24/WS68faba01a310f735438b6991.html")。考虑到已经被开除、受调查或失踪的官员，本周的出席人数可能会降至约300人甚至更少。

习近平在今年早些时候的一篇讲话中（该讲话[于本月发表](https://www.qstheory.cn/20261015/a6ed86729ae947d99a83bb431867b7d3/c.html)）表示，有太多的官员未能忠实地执行命令，反而假装顺从。他说，有些人是“两面人”，在忠诚的面具背后隐藏着对党的规则和价值观的蔑视。他将腐败官员比作有病的树木，表示党应该做到“‘病树’该拔就拔、该伐就伐”。

习近平议程中的很大一部分是管理拥有[1.01亿党员](https://www.12371.cn/2026/06/30/ARTI1782784973166823.shtml)的中国共产党的繁重日常工作，这些党员中很多是官员。正是通过这套党内机制，习近平得以管理世界第二大经济体并统治14亿人口。自2012年上台以来，他将党的触角延伸到工厂、村庄、学校以及社会的几乎每一个角落，重塑了党的权威。

**自我革命**

习近平似乎认为，中国官场的诸多问题根源于纪律松懈和思想软弱。他对此给出的药方是“自我革命”，这是一项由持续检查、自我评估和批判会议组成的计划，旨在让干部保持警觉。

“自我革命”并没有放缓。根据官方数据，2023年，[检查人员惩处了49名省部级干部](http://politics.people.com.cn/n1/2024/0125/c1001-40166029.html)和2.4万名县处级干部；而去年，[对应的数字](https://www.news.cn/politics/20260117/b67fae3369f449b68d45d6bee8a010ff/c.html)分别为69人和3.5万人。

习近平的整肃行动最近在军队中最为剧烈。今年早些时候，中国最高级别的将领张又侠被[拘留](https://cn.nytimes.com/china/20260511/china-military-generals/)，并被[指控腐败](https://cn.nytimes.com/china/20260922/china-generals-expelled-corruption/)和不忠。自2022年以来，已有[约100名高级军官](https://cn.nytimes.com/china/20260225/china-military-purges-xi/)接受调查，或直接失踪，很可能正在接受调查。

2023年，张又侠（中）在当选中央军委副主席后宣誓就职。张又侠随后被拘留，并被指控贪腐。Greg Baker/Agence France-Presse — Getty Images

“反腐运动已经不再是一场临时运动了，因为它已经变得如此常态化，”维也纳大学中国政治与法律讲师[李玲](https://ufind.univie.ac.at/en/person.html?id=60055)表示。“一方面，由于腐败机会的减少，给官员的‘胡萝卜’变小了。另一方面，‘大棒’正变得越来越重。”

在明年的党代会召开之前，对官员的审查可能会进一步加剧。由于长期的房地产危机，中国经济有所放缓，也重创了长期依赖土地出让收入的地方政府财政。习近平希望确保，尽管面临种种困难，官员们仍能坚定致力于他的领导，以及将中国建设成为技术先进的超级大国的议程。

“历史表明，在困难时期，党代会召开时可能会出现不同的声音，”李玲说。“注入恐惧感将使达成共识变得更加容易。”

前重庆市长黄奇帆的落马可能会引发一阵恐慌。

74岁的黄奇帆在八年前就从主要公职岗位上退休，但他保持着超乎寻常的高调公众形象，经常就经济问题发表演讲并撰写书籍。但随后调查人员宣布他因“严重违纪违法”正在接受调查。上周，[党还宣布](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202610/22/WS6ad9dc5ee4b06d4aa056440a.html "Link: https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202610/22/WS6ad9dc5ee4b06d4aa056440a.html")北京市副市长夏林茂正在接受调查。

**前反腐高官是否陷入麻烦？**

党内调查人员最近的其他举措表明，习近平的怀疑可能延伸到了更高的层级，甚至可能包括78岁的前中央纪律检查委员会书记王岐山。王岐山曾负责监督习近平反腐行动的第一阶段工作，现已退休。

王岐山的几位长期助手已因涉嫌腐败被拘留，包括金融领域官员周亮和纪检官员黎晓宏。王岐山的另一位[前秘书](https://news.inewsweek.cn/politics/2026-06-04/30474.shtml)董宏于2022年[因腐败指控被判刑](https://english.news.cn/20220128/86a0f11ae8f94788b060a325ff91d77d/c.html)。今年，[王岐山的两名前下属](https://web.archive.org/web/20261020104155/https://www.ccdi.gov.cn/toutiaon/202608/t20260828_509362.html)被降职，不再担任中央纪律检查委员会的职务，这表明他们可能也处于阴影之下。

王岐山的助手成为目标的具体原因尚不清楚，王岐山本人也没有被指控有违法行为。但这些案件引发了人们的猜测，认为习近平对于退休官员可能通过其网络和门生保留的影响力保持警惕。

2023年，习近平在北京与王岐山握手。王岐山曾负责监督习近平反腐败运动的第一阶段工作，但王岐山本人的一些长期助手后来却成为纪律检查机关的调查对象。Noel Celis/Agence France-Presse — Getty Images

“我能理解习近平的想法，王岐山即使为他做了那么多脏活累活，但他依然是少数有能力、甚至有足够胆量给习近平制造麻烦的人之一，”布鲁金斯学会研究中国政治的研究员、曾在美国中央情报局工作过的[秦江南](https://www.brookings.edu/people/jonathan-a-czin/)(Jonathan Czin)表示。“这关乎习近平的心态以及他对风险的认知。”

这种看似无休止的审查带来的负面效应在于，习近平可能会发现，越来越难确保数以百万计基层官员保持工作积极性。[最近的一项研究](https://www.journals.uchicago.edu/doi/abs/10.1086/738564)发现，官员们往往不敢承担风险。他们有时感到彻底丧失干劲。

“地方政府——尤其是农村地区的地方政府——没有能力和资源去满足中央层层下达的所有要求，”该研究的合著者、澳大利亚国立大学教授[本杰明·希尔曼](https://researchportalplus.anu.edu.au/en/persons/benjamin-hillman/)表示。“地方官员有时不得不弄虚作假。”

【大紀元2026年10月26日訊】（大紀元記者林丹紐約報導）中國新時代人民黨（簡稱中國新民黨）10月24日在紐約法拉盛舉行集會，紀念第81個聯合國日，呼籲「把中共從聯合國趕出去」。與會者回顧中華民國參與創建聯合國的歷史，批評中共對民主國家及國際組織的滲透，並提出廢止聯大第2758號決議、推動聯合國改革等主張。

[![Image 6: 中國新民黨法拉盛集會紀念聯合國日，籲將中共逐出聯合國。](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14876704-195445-450x253.jpeg)](https://i.epochtimes.com/assets/uploads/2026/10/id14876704-195445-450x253.jpeg)

中國新民黨法拉盛集會紀念聯合國日，籲將中共逐出聯合國。（主辦方提供）

活動現場展示中華民國國旗，並拉起「紀念聯合國日，把中共從聯合國趕出去」及「抵抗才有希望，革命才是出路」等橫幅。

中國新民黨創辦人楊茂森表示，中華民國是聯合國創始會員國，也是首個簽署《聯合國憲章》的國家。中共取得中國在聯合國的代表權後，向民主國家，尤其是美國及聯合國各機構滲透，企圖以極權專制的價值觀改變二戰後建立的國際秩序，已對自由民主世界構成嚴重威脅。

他說，國際社會應重新審視中國在聯合國的代表權問題，並呼籲讓聯合國「回歸法律，回歸常識，回歸常態」。

中華民國海外公民委員會執行長曹勝華指出，1971年通過的聯大第2758號決議應該廢止廢止。他認為，這項決議使中共得以取代中華民國在聯合國的代表，國際社會應正視其後續影響。

曹勝華表示，蘇聯解體並不意味著民主與共產體制之間的對抗已經結束。他批評中共採取「韜光養晦」策略，利用民主國家提供的發展機會逐步壯大，最終試圖以專制價值觀改變世界秩序，呼籲美國及其他民主國家提高警覺。

他建議，由美國總統川普聯合烏克蘭及中華民國政府，推動召開聯合國創始會員國領袖會議，重申聯合國成立初衷，商討改革事宜。

中華民國國軍老兵關愛中心董事長胡福慶則關注俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭及台海安全。他表示，身為安理會常任理事國，俄羅斯發動侵略戰爭，中共則頻繁以軍事演習威脅台灣，這些情況與聯合國維護和平的宗旨背道而馳。

中國新民黨成員白祺帆回顧柏林圍牆倒塌、東歐民主化及蘇聯解體，指出蘇聯共產黨、東歐社會主義政權解體展現了人民追求自由、擺脫共產統治的力量。

聯合國日定於每年10月24日，紀念《聯合國憲章》於1945年當日生效。活動由中國新民黨創始人楊茂森組織，王建盾、張偉明、白祺帆、曹勝華、胡福慶、林學軍等人參加。

## 中国市场放缓，英国传统精英私立学校纷纷进军印度

图像来源，Harrow School, Bengaluru

图像加注文字，在哈罗公学的班加罗尔（Bengaluru）校区，学生们穿着传统的哈罗帽子和制服。

*       *   Author, 尼基尔·伊南达尔（Nikhil Inamdar）
    *   Role, 印度孟买报道

*   Published 1 小时前

*   阅读时间: 3 分钟

位于印度西北部旁遮普邦（Punjab）昌迪加尔（Chandigarh）市郊，一间拥有473年历史的英国传统公学今年开设首个全女子国际校园。

与英格兰贝德福德郡（Bedfordshire）校园内标志性的哥德式中央建筑相比，印度校舍采用较现代化设计，设有专门兴建的教学大楼。但校园内一座醒目的红砖钟楼，仍保留着这所英国学校的传统印记。

位于莫哈利（Mohali）的贝德福德学校（Bedford School）是最新一所在印度设校的英国公学。至少已有六所英国公学（历史悠久的精英私立收费学校），包括三所在英国历史最悠久的学校，近年陆续在印度各地开设校园。

它们的扩张，正值中国市场环境趋紧，以及英国自2025年1月1日起对私立学校学费征收增值税（VAT）之际。

自2023年起，素有印度“矽谷”之称、汇聚大量软件和初创企业的班加罗尔（Bengaluru），已成为著名的哈罗公学（Harrow School）在印度的据点。印度首任总理尼赫鲁（Jawaharlal Nehru）便毕业于该校。

思贝礼学校（Shrewsbury School）则在印度中部城市博帕尔（Bhopal）设立校园；而威灵顿学院（Wellington College）选择落户浦那（Pune）。这座印度西部城市因拥有享负盛名的大学和学院而自称为“东方牛津”。

据报，米尔菲尔德学校（Millfield）、伊利沙伯女王学校（Queen Elizabeth's School）以及其他几所英国学校，未来数年亦将在印度开设分校。

数十年来，印度一直设有仿照英国殖民时期公学制度运作的寄宿学校，主要服务精英和贵族家庭。然而，随着新兴富裕阶层壮大，愈来愈多印度家庭希望让子女接触更国际化的教育，市场亦迅速扩展。

哈罗公学的班加罗尔分校校长卡洛琳·帕斯科（Caroline Pascoe）向BBC表示：“我们的国际课程对许多家长而言是一大吸引力。”

哈罗公学及贝德福德学校是印度少数提供完整剑桥课程（Cambridge curriculum）的学校之一，涵盖小学至高考（A-level）阶段。剑桥课程是一套全球教育体系，目前获全球约10,000所学校采用。

图像来源，Bedford School, Mohali

图像加注文字，至少六间英国公学进入印度，最新的一所是贝德福德学校。

哈尔西姆兰·辛格·科查尔（Harsimran Singh Kocchar）的大家族本身就在印度经营连锁学校，但他仍决定把五岁女儿帕丽妮特（Parineet）送入莫哈利的贝德福德学校。

他表示，原因在于学校“重视品格培养及自信，而不只是学业成绩”。

辛格又说，吸引他的另一个因素，是学校不像许多印度同类学校般存在“VIP文化”。

他说：“所有孩子都被一视同仁对待。部长和高级官员的子女不会享有较多特权。”

帕斯科表示，除了愈来愈多富裕的本地家庭外，海外印度人亦是这些学校的重要市场，包括长年在外国生活后回流印度的人士，以及仍居于英国或中东、希望子女保持与印度文化联系的家庭。

哈罗公学班加罗尔校区有60%的教职员来自海外。与其他英国公学一样，该校把自身独特传统带到印度校园。教师被称为“Beaks”，学生穿着传统哈罗帽和校服，并参加“The Long Ducker”跨国赛跑，该活动在哈罗全球各校同步举行。

校内亦设有英式教育标志性的“学院制度”。

这些充满英国传统色彩的校园文化，同时融入印度本地习俗，例如每天早上齐唱印度国歌，以及庆祝印度教重要节日象神节（Ganesh Chaturthi）。

图像来源，Harrow School, Bengaluru

图像加注文字，像班加罗尔的哈罗公学这样的学校会鼓励学生参加音乐和戏剧等课外活动。

印度不断增强的经济实力，以及迅速增加的新晋百万富翁人口，为英国公学扩张提供了有利条件，但这波增长部分亦是受到中国市场放缓所推动。

过去十年间，英国公学海外扩张很大程度上依赖中国和香港市场。目前由50所英国学校营运的151个海外分校校区中，有一半位于中国和香港。

不过，根据英国智库“私立教育政策论坛”（Private Education Policy Forum，PEPF）于2025年[发表的研究](https://www.pepf.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/SatelliteCampuses_PEPFReport_270525.pdf)，随着监管政策改变，以及各国政府加强审查甚至出现抗拒态度，相关增长已经放缓。

PEPF指出，中国于2024年实施的新法例要求学校将爱国主义教育融入所有学科，进一步增加海外学校在中国发展的挑战，甚至导致部分原定兴建的校园计划被取消。这促使有关学校开始考虑印度和越南等其他市场。

此外，英国在2024年秋季财政预算案中宣布对私立学校学费征收20%增值税（VAT）。莫哈利贝德福德学校（Bedford School Mohali）创校校长娜欧蜜·阿特金斯（Naomi Atkins）表示，这项措施迫使许多私立学校寻求海外发展机会。

她向BBC表示：“它们正处于非常艰难的处境。即使是过去从未考虑国际扩张的学校，如今也突然开始积极进入印度市场。”

图像来源，Harrow School, Bengaluru

图像加注文字，在印度，富裕的当地家庭和海外印度人是英国学校的主要目标市场。

不过，阿特金斯承认，印度并非一个容易开拓的市场。

这些学校大多透过与当地投资者或营运商合作设立分校。

阿特金斯表示，过去在其他国家，英国学校一般可从合作伙伴收取相当于收入10%的费用，但在印度，利润率在某些情况下可能低至仅1%。

她又表示，部分学校亦高估了印度市场的规模。

尽管印度有接近2.5亿名在学学生，但英语教育早已深深植根当地，来自本土学校的竞争远较中国、韩国或越南等非英语国家激烈得多。

此外，印度人均收入仍然较低，而英国学校的高昂学费亦限制了增长空间。部分学校的全寄宿学费可高达15,000英镑甚至更高。

阿特金斯说：“我曾在印尼、马来西亚和中国工作，但印度人对价格敏感得多，他们喜欢寻找划算的选择。”

正因如此，莫哈利贝德福德学校的学费约为其他英国学校的一半。

根据PEPF数据，2011/12学年至2022/23学年间，英国学校海外分校共录得1.524亿英镑利润，而且相关收益多年来显著增长。

不过，在印度，这些学校的发展看来更可能是缓慢而稳定，而非爆发式增长。

印度的殖民历史背景，以及新兴富裕阶层的崛起，确实为这些历史悠久的英国学校带来可观的商机，但至少在短期内，这个市场规模仍不足以弥补中国市场萎缩造成的损失。

我们使用了人工智慧协助翻译这篇文章，它的原文是英文。在发布之前，BBC记者检查了翻译的内容。

title: Between Development and Oversight: China’s Approach to Addressing Artificial Intelligence Risks
summary: **The rapid development of artificial intelligence capabilities is broadening the way China defines the risks posed by this technology. Alongside espionage, cyber threats, and familiar national security threats, Beijing is increasingly addr
content:
**The rapid development of artificial intelligence capabilities is broadening the way China defines the risks posed by this technology. Alongside espionage, cyber threats, and familiar national security threats, Beijing is increasingly addressing the risks originating from advanced AI systems themselves—including autonomous operation and loss of control. At the same time, technological lag and dependence on foreign technologies are also perceived as risks to national security. Official publications from September 2026 show that different approaches to these risks exist within the Chinese system, but all call for continued development of domestic AI capabilities alongside expanded mechanisms for safety, oversight, and control.**

In mid-September 2026, Chinese officials issued three major statements on AI risks. On September 13, Minister of State Security Chen Yixin [published an article](https://www.secrss.com/articles/93912) addressing their implications for Chinese national security. The following day, the [Artificial Intelligence Safety Governance Framework 3.0](https://www.cac.gov.cn/2026-09/14/c_1791137092283345.htm) was released, mapping the risks and the tools for addressing them. The [Chinese Foreign Ministry also addressed](https://www.mfa.gov.cn/eng/xw/fyrbt/202609/t20260915_12022885.html) AI risks and the possibility of slowing the development of advanced models.

This sequence of statements reflects different perspectives among China’s institutional bodies. Chen’s article examines the technology through the lens of national security, while Framework 3.0, developed by cybersecurity and standardization bodies, gives greater weight to risks arising from the systems’ evolving capabilities. The Foreign Ministry connects the two dimensions, presenting risk management as compatible with continued development. In any case, the boundaries between them are not clear-cut: the Chinese term _anquan_ (安全) denotes both "safety" and "security," bringing technological safety, cybersecurity, political stability, and national security under a single conceptual framework.

## **Artificial Intelligence Through the Lens of National Security: The Minister of State Security's Article**

Chen Yixin, Secretary of the Party Committee and Minister of State Security (MSS), published his article ahead of [National Cybersecurity Awareness Week](https://www.cac.gov.cn/2026-09/14/c_1791137133265127.htm). It draws heavily on earlier ideas and formulations of the Chinese leadership. A [comparative analysis](https://markparkeryoung.net/posts/chen-ai-lineage/) by Mark Parker Young, a former CIA analyst and senior official at the US National Intelligence Council, found that a significant portion of the minister's language is based on earlier documents and statements by President Xi Jinping and other Chinese officials. However, the section on AI risks contains a high proportion of material that could not be traced to previous texts, suggesting that the innovation lies primarily in applying existing security concepts to recent developments in the field.

Chen outlines six types of risks stemming from the development of artificial intelligence. For the purposes of this analysis, they can be grouped into three spheres. The first is the political and social sphere, which includes threats to political and ideological security, as well as challenges to governance and social order. In this context, Chen warns against the use of deepfakes, AI-generated content, and automated accounts to spread disinformation, inflame disputes, and wage cognitive warfare against China. He also points to algorithmic bias, privacy violations, and the difficulty of establishing accountability for automated decisions.

The second sphere concerns cybersecurity, espionage, and information security. According to Chen, artificial intelligence lowers the cost and skill barrier for executing cyberattacks, enabling the discovery of vulnerabilities and the automation of attacks, and even “AI versus AI” confrontations. He further warns against foreign intelligence services using the technology to collect and analyze sensitive data, as well as data leakage to foreign AI products.

The third sphere is technological and military competition. Chen frames technological gaps and dependency as a risk, arguing that countries with an advantage in the field use technology restrictions, standards, and closed systems to limit other countries’ access to advanced technologies. At the same time, he points to the increasing integration of AI in intelligence, decision-making, target identification, operational support, and cognitive influence. He describes a shift of the technology from a supporting role to a "pivotal role" on the battlefield.

Equally interesting is what does _not_ feature prominently in Chen’s list of risks. While Framework 3.0 (see below) emphasizes the risk of autonomous systems exceeding their assigned tasks or escaping human control, Chen focuses on how people, states, and hostile actors use AI—and on the risks posed by technological lag. This reflects the concept of “holistic national security,” which views technology as a force multiplier for existing threats and as another arena of competition between states. Accordingly, Chen defines innovation as the "primary driving force" and security as the "bottom-line requirement," calling for the reinforcement of self-reliant AI capabilities alongside mechanisms for monitoring, early warning, and oversight.

## **Risk Management: The Artificial Intelligence Safety Governance Framework 3.0**

Framework 3.0 was developed under the guidance of the Cyberspace Administration of China (CAC) and organized by the National Cybersecurity Standardization Technical Committee (TC260), in collaboration with research institutes, professional bodies, and technology companies. The institutional response is distributed among several entities: the CAC leads regulation in the areas of services, content, algorithms, and data; TC260 handles standardization and technical tools; and the Ministry of State Security brings a national security perspective. AI providers are responsible for implementing the safety requirements, under the supervision of the relevant regulators.

This is the third version of the framework, which has been updated annually since September 2024. It is not a binding law or regulation, but rather a guiding document built around three tiers: mapping and classifying risks, using technological measures to reduce them, and establishing oversight and governance mechanisms. Among other things, the framework recommends risk assessments, monitoring and early warnings, restricting the permissions of AI agents, human involvement in high-risk operations, audits of tools and plug-ins, and mechanisms for shutting down systems that exceed their assigned tasks. One of the system's guiding principles is promoting AI development while ensuring it remains "safe and controllable" (安全可控).

The framework operates alongside a binding regulatory system that has evolved in China in recent years. This includes rules for generative AI services, registration and review procedures for services and algorithms, and requirements for labeling AI-generated content. As of late August 2026, over one thousand generative AI services have completed the national-level registration process in China. Framework 3.0 provides a risk roadmap and technical principles to guide the further development of standards and regulation, while legal obligations remain anchored in the existing regulatory system.

[According to an analysis by AI Safety in China](https://aisafetychina.substack.com/p/brief-29-what-chinas-new-ai-safety), an independent research project tracking AI policy and governance in China, the number of risks detailed in the framework grew from 30 in Version 2.0 to 54 in Version 3.0. Particular attention is given to AI agents, which can plan, perform tasks, and operate in external systems, and to embodied AI, in which a digital failure could cause physical harm. The framework also addresses systems that obtain unauthorized permissions or resources, deceive safety evaluators, deviate from their intended goal, or act autonomously in cyberspace. In [commentary published following the framework's presentation](https://www.cac.gov.cn/2026-09/17/c_1791397053329870.htm), this change was described as a shift in large models from "answering questions" to "executing tasks."

The framework also addresses open-weight models—models whose parameters learned during training are publicly available, allowing them to be run and modified independently. The framework warns that once weights have been distributed, the model can be run independently, modified, or even stripped of its safety mechanisms, making it difficult to retroactively restrict copies that have already been released. This warning is particularly noteworthy given the prominent role of Chinese open-weight models in the domestic industry. DeepSeek, for instance, [released the weights for its V4 models](https://deepseek.com/en/news/v4-preview/) and presented this openness as part of its development strategy. This creates a tension between the contribution of open weights to innovation, adoption, and China's technological influence on the one hand, and the difficulty of controlling their use after distribution on the other.

[A comparison of the document's three versions](https://www.cac.gov.cn/2026-09/17/c_1791397053329870.htm) illustrates how China’s conception of risk has expanded alongside technological developments. Version 1.0, published in 2024, focused primarily on risks stemming directly from the technology itself and its use. Version 2.0 broadened the discussion to social risks, including impacts on employment and ethics. Version 3.0 further expands the focus to risks arising from the evolving capabilities of advanced systems, such as autonomous operation and AI agents.

The difference between Chen's article and Framework 3.0 demonstrates that the concept of risk operates across multiple dimensions. Externally, Beijing is concerned about falling behind in technological competition, dependence on foreign technologies, and the use of AI by states and hostile actors for cyber operations, espionage, and influence. Within China, there are also concerns about threats to political security and social order. Framework 3.0 adds another layer: the risk posed by the behavior of advanced systems themselves. Artificial intelligence is thus viewed simultaneously as a source of national power and a potential threat.

## **Development Alongside Security: The Chinese Foreign Ministry’s Position**

On September 14, Chinese Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Guo Jiakun was asked about calls by senior US AI industry figures to slow the development of advanced AI systems, and particularly regarding [comments by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei](https://darioamodei.com/post/we-must-pace-the-frontier), who linked the risks of advanced AI models to technological competition with China. [Guo responded that China advocates for the "open and inclusive" development](https://www.mfa.gov.cn/fyrbt_673021/202609/t20260914_12021744.shtml) of AI, and warned against threat-mongering, confrontation, and "malicious competition."

The following day, Guo clarified that China also recognizes the risks themselves. According to Guo, regulation must be adapted and safeguards strengthened to prevent the technology from spiraling out of control. He emphasized that China places "[equal emphasis on development and security](https://www.mfa.gov.cn/eng/xw/fyrbt/202609/t20260915_12022885.html)," takes both the inherent and derivative risks of AI seriously, and works to ensure that the technology remains "safe, reliable, and controllable." In this context, Guo explicitly referenced Framework 3.0, which had been published the previous day.

新北市新莊區塭仔圳市地重劃共管工程，傳出疑造成民宅鄰損意外。義豐街有民宅屋主反應陽台有裂縫，新北市地政局派員檢視發現圍牆些微傾斜且有2公分裂縫，立即協助修補並進行回填以穩固建物，後續鑑定若確認為工程導致將負起賠償責任。
有網友在Threads上PO文表示，住家旁重劃區正進行工程，今年9月開挖後家中後陽台出現坍塌狀況，前天（31日）又發生嚴重坍塌，擔心會像基泰大直一樣整個房子都沒了。
市議員陳世軒說，經實地了解，有3戶民宅的陽台有毀損、坍塌，他主張由土木技師公會做出安全評估，新北市府與施工單位，必須與3戶受影響的住戶建立溝通管道，市府及施工單位必須協助屋主做後續的修復及賠償。陳也說，塭仔圳的開發將能帶動新莊地方的發展，但各項工程的施作必須將公共安全列為第一要件，市府相關局處務必嚴加管控施工情況，避免類似事件再發生。
新北市地政局回應，疑發生鄰損狀況的區域為塭仔圳市地重劃工程的共管工程，因開挖深度3.5公尺，預先打了鋼板樁保護週邊建物。10月21日接獲該名屋主反應陽台有裂縫，當天隨即派員前往檢視，發現圍牆些微傾斜且有2公分裂縫，立即協助修補，已開挖部分加速施作同時進行回填以穩固建物。
地政局指出，昨天屋主再度陳情表示圍牆有持續傾斜的狀況，對此十分憂心，地政局今天立即協調新北市技師公會技師前往勘查。地政局強調，接獲民眾反映後第一時間前往處理並補強，確保民眾安全無虞，並請第三公正單位進行鑑定，若確認受工程影響導致，地政局將負起鄰損賠償責任。
新北市汐止區同興路穿越國道工期延宕，工務局在與原包商解約後，重新招標接手施作。市長侯友宜今到工地視察時說，市長任內沒能完成這條道路，他覺得很不好意思，「千拜託、萬拜託」新包商要完成，施工過程中更務必注意中山高交通安全。
新北市新莊區塭仔圳市地重劃共管工程，傳出疑造成民宅鄰損意外。義豐街有民宅屋主反應陽台有裂縫，新北市地政局派員檢視發現圍牆些微傾斜且有2公分裂縫，立即協助修補並進行回填以穩固建物，後續鑑定若確認為工程導致將負起賠償責任。
新北汐止青山國中小完成地下雙滯洪池，容量4470噸，搭配活化廢棄汙水槽，紓解積淹水並打造防洪教育場域。
新北市汐止消防分隊、第六大隊、特搜大隊暨市民活動中心共構工程，今天舉行落成典禮，新北市長侯友宜表示，新廳舍導入AI智能派遣系統，119報案後可自動派遣，讓消防人員秒秒必爭提前20秒出勤，特搜大隊進駐後也可提升跨區支援救災效能。
新北市議員候選人鄭丞宏11月1日下午在泰山文程廣場舉辦「阿宏叔叔的親子同樂會」。折氣球、魔術秀、歡樂帶動跳與繽紛泡泡秀輪番登場，孩子開心參與，家長也投入互動，廣場洋溢歡笑與掌聲。鄭丞宏表示，希望透過親子活動，讓家庭留下溫暖回憶，也將對孩子的關心落實為托育、通學與成長環境的具體改善。 鄭丞宏表示，孩子的成長只有一次，父母陪伴孩子的時光格外珍貴。一場同樂會帶來午後歡樂，城市更需要努力讓這份安心延續到家庭日常，讓家長有人分擔育兒壓力，讓孩子每天都有安全、友善的地方學習與遊戲。 針對五股、泰山、林口的家庭需求，鄭丞宏提出三大方向：五股將爭取活化閒置空間，增設公共托育及親子館，提供便利的育兒支持；泰山則主張塭仔圳新城建設同步完善道路、人行道、公園及停車空間，並納入托育、親子與長照服務，兼顧新舊市區需求；林口因應人口成長，應提前盤點校舍容量、完善安全通學步道，並擴充幼兒照顧資源、運動休閒空間及公園親子設施。 「親子友善城市的責任，要從陪伴孩子玩耍，延伸到守護孩子的身心安全。」鄭丞宏指出，除了硬體建設，孩子能否在校園裡受到尊重、遇到困難時敢於求助，同樣需要重視。 對於近日新北市傳出的疑似

content:
朝鮮「精英」黑客組織是誰？為何成為幣安63億美元盜竊案的頭號嫌疑者？ - BBC News 中文
Author, 莉莉·賈馬利（Lily Jamali）
兩家大型區塊鏈分析公司表示，掌握充分的情報，顯示一個獲朝鮮政府支持的黑客組織，很可能是全球最大加密貨幣交易所幣安（Binance）遭黑客攻擊、損失63億美元（47億英鎊）事件的幕後黑手。
區塊鏈分析公司TRM Labs和Chainalysis均表示，有「高度信心」認為，這次攻擊是由朝鮮黑客組織「拉撒路集團」（Lazarus Group）發動。該組織又稱「TraderTraitor」。
這只是近期一系列被指與朝鮮有關的黑客攻擊事件中最新的一宗。朝鮮是全球最貧窮的國家之一，民眾上網受到嚴格限制。
專家指控，朝鮮領導人金正恩的政府依靠網絡犯罪活動獲取資金，但平壤長期否認有關指控。
朝鮮涉嫌發動的黑客攻擊中，最轟動的一宗並非為了金錢，而是2014年針對索尼影業（Sony Pictures）的網絡攻擊。該公司當時製作了荷里活電影《刺殺金正恩》（The Interview，又譯《名嘴出任務》或《採訪》），故事圍繞一宗暗殺金正恩的陰謀。
這次黑客攻擊導致索尼影業高層之間數以千計的電郵外洩，當中不少內容令公司尷尬。
美國聯邦調查局（FBI）去年表示，朝鮮須為加密貨幣交易所Bybit遭盜取15億美元的事件負責。
事發後，FBI表示，「TraderTraitor」迅速採取行動，清洗及分散被盜資產，將其轉換成比特幣和其他數字資產，目的是最終兌換成可實際使用的貨幣。
FBI亦曾廣泛指控朝鮮從事「非法網絡犯罪及虛擬資產盜竊活動」。
根據多份報告，朝鮮一直有系統地發展其網絡攻擊能力，從大學招募最有潛質的學生，安排他們加入由朝鮮情報機構監督的黑客組織。
科技公司的分析亦顯示，朝鮮部分網絡戰活動是在與其接壤的中國境內進行。
Play video, "What we know about Binance's $6.3bn hack and what to do if you're affected", 節目全長 0,59
音頻加註文字， 幣安63億美元黑客攻擊事件：目前我們知道甚麼？受影響人士應如何應對？（英文影片）
朝鮮黑客亦被懷疑涉及2022年一宗價值6.2億美元的加密貨幣盜竊案。
在最新這宗案件中，朝鮮黑客被指利用一項特殊授權，改變幣安一個連接互聯網的「熱錢包」（hot wallet）的運作方式，使其自動將資金轉移給攻擊者。
TRM表示，攻擊者很可能在這次行動中取得了幣安熱錢包簽署系統的存取權限。
幣安未有直接回應BBC就事件可能與朝鮮有關而提出的查詢。
該公司最初表示，懷疑一名工程師的手提電腦遭入侵，讓黑客得以在未經授權下提取資產，但其後表示，攻擊涉及的範圍比最初所知的更廣。
幣安聯席行政總裁鄧偉政（Richard Teng）表示：「我們隨後的調查發現了其他遭入侵的環節。」
幣安一名發言人周五（10月30日）表示，約80%的被盜資產已得到保全，但其餘資產的去向仍然不明。
如果有關指控屬實，這宗創下紀錄的盜竊案顯示，涉嫌來自朝鮮的黑客已變得何等強大，也反映黑客使用的工具和技術日益精密。
專家指出，人工智能的興起亦為網絡攻擊者提供了新的犯罪手段，包括利用自動化技術等方式發動攻擊。
在這宗案件中，攻擊者有可能利用人工智能入侵幣安的系統。
正如Chainalysis所指出，攻擊者採用了「我們前所未見」的洗錢模式。
本文原以英文撰寫，我們使用了人工智能協助翻譯，並由BBC記者在發佈前進行審核。了解更多關於我們如何使用人工智能的資訊。

zh_title: 美国批准向乌克兰购买500枚爱国者导弹，盟友将支付21亿美元
summary: 美国批准向乌克兰购买 500 枚爱国者导弹，盟友将支付 21 亿美元 - Breaking Defense 美国爱国者导弹防御系统于 2022 年 3 月 9 日在波兰热舒夫波兰-乌克兰边境附近的热舒夫机场新安装。（摄影：Agnieszka Majchrowicz/Anadolu Agency via Getty Images）华盛顿 — 美国国务院今天宣布，它已批准这一潜在计划向乌克兰出售 500 枚爱国者导弹，预计价格为 21 亿美元，“全部由合作伙伴和盟友”支付。 “乌克兰政府已要求购买五百架
content:
美国批准向乌克兰购买500枚爱国者导弹，盟友将支付21亿美元 - Breaking Defense
2022 年 3 月 9 日，波兰热舒夫波兰-乌克兰边境附近的热舒夫机场新安装的美国爱国者导弹防御系统。（照片由 Agnieszka Majchrowicz/Anadolu Agency via Getty Images 提供）
华盛顿——美国国务院今天宣布，已批准向乌克兰出售 500 枚爱国者导弹，估计价格为 21 亿美元，“完全由合作伙伴和盟友”支付。
根据网上发布的国务院国会通知，“乌克兰政府已请求购买五百（500）枚爱国者先进能力-3（PAC-3）导弹段增强（MSE）导弹”以及机密和非机密零件。
通知称，基辅可以“通过加拿大、德国和挪威通过 JUMPSTART 计划和国家基金的捐赠，并由欧盟乌克兰支持贷款资助”来购买高科技导弹。此次销售不涉及美国资金。 JUMPSTART是指乌克兰跨国联合计划——服务、培训和物品快速时间表计划，该计划于2022年建立，作为第三方国家提供资金以允许乌克兰购买美国设备的机制。
通知称，潜在的出售“将通过改善作为欧洲政治和经济稳定力量的伙伴国的安全来支持美国的外交政策和国家安全目标”。
然而，外交语言掩盖了基辅和华盛顿之间挥之不去的紧张关系，尤其是在爱国者导弹方面。 10月19日，《华盛顿邮报》报道称，由于美国总统特朗普与乌克兰总统泽连斯基之间发生争执，美国似乎推迟了向乌克兰转移爱国者拦截机的计划。几天前，美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 报道称，基辅的拦截器已经用完，使该国更容易受到致命的俄罗斯导弹和无人机袭击。
10 月 25 日，泽伦斯基表示，乌克兰和美国已经解决了最近的另外两个棘手问题——星链/星盾连接意外中断以及美国提供的导弹预警信息——但他似乎指责美国在爱国者交付方面拖延。
“防空问题仍然存在。爱国者系统的导弹取得了进展，但进展非常缓慢。比俄罗斯导弹的飞行速度还要慢，”他说。 “你不能说，‘是的，我们会把导弹给你’，然后一两个月不交付。这样根本行不通。”
赞助帖子，空战
欧洲制造的黑鹰获得武装升级
新装备在短短三个小时内将黑鹰队变成攻击鹰队。
这位四面楚歌的领导人此前告诉美国广播公司新闻，乌克兰每月需要 350 架拦截机才能妥善保卫其领土。
对外军售通知通常是长达数年流程的早期步骤。美国国务院没有立即回应就今天的声明可能如何影响基辅的近期拦截问题发表评论的请求。
FMS 交易在宣布时通常也不是最终的，因为随着合同谈判的继续，数量和价格可能会发生变化。此外，立法者也可以介入并推迟或阻止该交易，尽管考虑到两党对乌克兰的剩余支持，这种情况不太可能发生。

US greenlights 500 Patriot missiles for Ukraine, with $2.1 billion to be paid by allies - Breaking Defense
US Patriot missile defense batteries newly installed at the Rzeszow airport located near the Poland-Ukraine border in Rzeszow, Poland on March 09, 2022. (Photo by Agnieszka Majchrowicz/Anadolu Agency via Getty Images)
WASHINGTON — The State Department announced today that it has approved the potential sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine, with an estimated price tag of $2.1 billion to be paid “entirely by partners and allies.”
“The Government of Ukraine has requested to buy five hundred (500) PATRIOT Advanced Capability-3 (PAC-3) Missile Segment Enhancement (MSE) missiles” along with classified and unclassified parts, according to a State Department congressional notification posted online.
The notification said that Kyiv could buy the high-tech missiles “with donations from Canada, Germany, and Norway via the JUMPSTART program and national funds, financed by the European Union’s Ukraine Support Loan. No U.S. funds are involved in this sale.” JUMPSTART refers to the Joint Ukrainian Multinational Program–Services, Training and Articles Rapid Timeline program, established in 2022 as a mechanism for third-party countries to contribute funds to allow Ukraine to buy American equipment.
The potential sale “will support the foreign policy and national security objectives of the United States by improving the security of a partner country that is a force for political and economic stability in Europe,” the notice says.
However, the diplomatic language belies lingering tensions between Kyiv and Washington, especially when it comes to Patriot missiles. On Oct. 19, The Washington Post reported that the US appeared to have delayed the transfer of Patriot interceptors to Ukraine amid a falling out between US President Donald Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. A few days earlier, CNN reported that Kyiv had run out of interceptors, leaving the country more vulnerable to deadly Russian missile and drone attacks.
On Oct. 25, Zelenskyy said Ukraine and the US had resolved two other recent sticking points — the surprise disruptions in Starlink/Starshield connectivity and in US-provided missile warning information — but he appeared to call out the US for dragging its feet on Patriot deliveries.
“The issue of air defense remains. There is progress on missiles for Patriot systems, but things are moving very slowly. More slowly than Russian missiles fly,” he said. “You cannot say, ‘Yes, we will give the missiles to you,’ and then not deliver them for a month or two. It simply does not work that way.”

The embattled leader previously told ABC News that Ukraine would need 350 interceptors per month to properly defend its territory.
Foreign Military Sales notifications are generally early steps in what can be years-long processes. The State Department did not immediately respond to a request for comment as to how today’s announcement may affect Kyiv’s near-term interceptor problem.
FMS deals are also typically not final when they’re announced, as quantities and prices can change as contract negotiations continue. Additionally lawmakers could step in and delay or block the deal as well, though that is less likely in this case considering the remaining bipartisan support for Ukraine.

title: Hong Kong reveals maritime arbitration cases and steps to boost legal services
zh_title: 香港公布海事仲裁案件和加强法律服务的措施
summary: 香港当局披露了2023-2025年海事仲裁和调解案件数量，概述了修订《仲裁条例》、在标准航运合同中推广香港法律、引入“双旗”船舶登记处以及建立海事学院以培养法律人才的计划。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 28 日 12:00 HKT · 3 分钟阅读政府已披露海事仲裁的细节
content:
香港
香港当局披露了2023-2025年海事仲裁和调解案件数量，概述了修订《仲裁条例》、在标准航运合同中推广香港法律、引入“双旗”船舶登记处以及建立海事学院以培养法律人才的计划。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 28 日 12:00 香港时间 · 阅读时间 3 分钟

香港政府在10月28日公布的立法答复中披露了过去三年处理的海事仲裁和调解案件的详细信息，以及加强香港海事法律服务的计划。

根据香港海事仲裁协会和香港国际仲裁中心提供的数据，两机构在2023年共处理了25起海事仲裁案件，2024年处理了28起，2025年处理了30起。总部设在香港的国际争议解决及调解中心于2025年10月正式成立。该中心于今年5月调解了一起涉及中国内地和新加坡的国际海事纠纷，从而达成和解协议。
政府表示，计划于 2027 年完成的《仲裁条例》修订不包括海事仲裁的具体措施。然而，它表示，以速度、终局性、增强保密性、公平性和当事人意思自治原则为指导的仲裁制度的全面升级将有利于海事和航运纠纷。这项改革由 2025 年成立的一个工作组负责监督，该工作组负责审查该条例。

为推动香港法律成为标准航运合同的管辖法律以及香港作为标准航运合同的选定仲裁地，政府指出，香港已成为波罗的海及国际海事理事会标准合同的四个指定仲裁地之一。今年6月，香港推出了一项税收法案，为实物商品贸易商提供半税优惠，要求符合资格的贸易商使用指定的香港海事服务，包括海事法律和仲裁服务，并签订仲裁协议规定香港为仲裁地。 4 月和 9 月，我们前往日内瓦、北京和上海进行了推广活动，以推销这些奖励措施。
关于计划中的“双旗”船舶登记，政府表示，今年将提交一项修订法案以引入这一安排，允许在暂停原船东登记的同时，以第二面旗帜进行光船租赁登记。该法案将包括澄清第一面旗帜的效力暂停而第二面旗帜生效的条款，确保两个登记处之间不存在管辖权重叠，符合《联合国海洋法公约》。

对于设立海事学院，运输及物流局表示，将采取“校企合作”模式，联同国内外海事机构和全球航运企业，为业界从业者提供课程。自2023年9月起，该局还开展了海事人才培训资助计划-法律，已资助11名实习生，其中8人已完成培训。香港国际法律人才培训学院有望拓展

Hong Kong
Hong Kong authorities disclosed maritime arbitration and mediation case numbers for 2023-2025, outlined plans to revise the Arbitration Ordinance, promote Hong Kong law in standard shipping contracts, introduce a "dual-flag" ship registry, and establish a maritime college to train legal talent.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

28 Oct 2026 at 12:00 HKT · 3 min read

The Hong Kong government has disclosed details of maritime arbitration and mediation cases handled over the past three years, alongside plans to strengthen the city's maritime legal services, in a legislative answer published on 28 October.

According to data provided by the Hong Kong Maritime Arbitration Association and the Hong Kong International Arbitration Centre, the two bodies handled a combined total of 25 maritime arbitration cases in 2023, 28 in 2024, and 30 in 2025. The International Dispute Resolution and Mediation Centre, headquartered in Hong Kong, was officially inaugurated in October 2025. It mediated an international maritime dispute in May this year involving parties from mainland China and Singapore, resulting in a settlement agreement.

The government said its planned revision of the Arbitration Ordinance, to be completed in 2027, does not include specific measures for maritime arbitration. However, it stated that an overall upgrade of the arbitration regime, guided by principles of speed, finality, enhanced confidentiality, fairness and party autonomy, would benefit maritime and shipping disputes. The reform is being overseen by a working group established in 2025 to review the ordinance.

To promote Hong Kong law as the governing law and Hong Kong as the chosen seat for arbitration in standard shipping contracts, the government noted that Hong Kong is already one of four designated arbitration venues in the Baltic and International Maritime Council's standard contracts. In June, it introduced a tax bill offering a half-tax concession for physical commodity traders, which requires qualifying traders to use specified Hong Kong maritime services, including maritime legal and arbitration services, with arbitration agreements stipulating Hong Kong as the venue. Promotion trips to Geneva, Beijing and Shanghai were conducted in April and September to market the incentives.

On the planned "dual-flag" ship registry, the government said it will table an amendment bill this year to introduce the arrangement, which allows a bareboat charter registration under a second flag while the original owner's registration is suspended. The bill will include provisions to clarify that the first flag's effect is suspended and the second flag takes effect, ensuring no overlapping jurisdiction between the two registries, in line with the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea.

Regarding the establishment of a maritime college, the Transport and Logistics Bureau said it will adopt a "college-industry collaboration" model, coordinating with domestic and international maritime institutions and global shipping firms to offer courses for industry practitioners. The bureau has also been operating a Maritime Talent Training Sponsorship Scheme – Law since September 2023, which has funded 11 interns, eight of whom have completed their training. The Hong Kong International Legal Talent Training College is expected to explore cooperation with the future maritime college to combine expertise and resources for training programmes and professional exchanges.
