content:
德国总统施泰因迈尔同习近平一道检阅仪仗队图像来源: Katharina Kausche/dpa/picture alliance
（德国之声中文网）德国联邦总统施泰因迈尔(Frank-Walter Steinmeier)在北京人民大会堂对习近平表示，应当缩小中国对德国的巨大贸易顺差，“我们希望建立的是密切经贸关系，而这种关系应能为双方带来可持续的利益。”
施泰因迈尔还说，德中两国之间的经济联系极具活力，“在如此高水平的活力之下，我们定期审视双方合作的基础框架，也是顺理成章的事。”
施泰因迈尔的表态也与前一天他在北京大学的演讲相呼应。他在演讲中说，“如果我们欧洲人发现，我们的企业无法进入中国市场，或者只能在受到严格限制的情况下进入，而与此同时，中国那些获得国家补贴的出口产品却源源不断地涌入我们的市场……那么，我们便面临着陷入‘单方面脆弱性’的风险。”
习近平则在会晤的开场白中表示，中方重视发展中德两国的“全方位战略伙伴关系”，认为两国理应发挥引领作用，构建一种基于平等、互利和战略稳定的新型合作模式。“这一新模式向世界传递了一个积极信号：我们主张开放而非封闭，主张合作而非对抗。”习近平还强调，中德关系正开启新篇章。
施泰因迈尔在北京大学接受名誉教授头衔并做演讲图像来源: Katharina Kausche/dpa/picture alliance
会晤中，施泰因迈尔还对中国经济实力、科技水平、政治影响力的巨大提升表示钦佩。“与此同时，我们双方都对国际秩序承担职责，这也是世界各国维持和塑造相互关系所依据的条件；我们也共同承担着维护我们所遵循的共同规则的责任。”德国总统略带担忧地表示，尽管德中两国几十年来都极大地受益于基于规则之国际秩序，“然而，如今在世界许多地方，我们看到这种秩序正承受着压力；我们看到规则遭到破坏，也目睹了‘强权即公理’似乎正在抬头。”
双方在会晤中还提及了中东地区、苏丹以及俄乌之间的危机与战火。施泰因迈尔呼吁习近平共同努力，维护并加强全球秩序的基础。“世界需要中国来协助维护这一秩序。”
在会谈开始前，习近平还在人民大会堂外为施泰因迈尔举行了隆重的欢迎仪式，包括鸣响21响礼炮。
当天早些时候，德国总统还和中国国务院总理李强进行了会晤，他同样提到了欧中贸易逆差问题，同时也赞扬了不久前欧中双方就混动汽车对欧出口限额达成的协议，称这说明“即便在困难的情况下，我们也总能找到解决问题的办法。”李强则称赞施泰因迈尔是“中国多年来的老朋友”。
施泰因迈尔10月26日就从柏林启程出发访问中国，先是前往安徽参访德国大众研发中心等，随后前往北京，继续与欧中双方的各界人士会谈。随着中共二十届五中全会的闭幕，施泰因迈尔在行程的最后两天密集会晤中国政要。按照行程，他将在10月31日回到德国。

content:
10月30日，正在中国进行访问的施泰因迈尔与习近平举行会晤。图像来源: Kai Naito/AFP
（德国之声中文网）在结束本周访华行程、启程返德前，德国总统施泰因迈尔接受德国电视一台（ARD）专访。该台记者戴斯（Matthias Deiß）提问：“最近有消息称，中国希望或者将与美国和俄罗斯进行共同谈判，可能还会涉及乌克兰问题。对此，您能向我们透露些什么？”
施泰因迈尔回答说：“我读到这类报道，也直接向习近平主席提及此事。从他的面部表情可以看出，他似乎有些困惑，因为他随后反问，这些传闻从何而来。”
施泰因迈尔表示，习近平提到了即将在中国深圳举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会，但认为目前根本没有筹备任何由美国、俄罗斯和中国三方参与的乌克兰问题峰会。
施泰因迈尔补充道，习近平对此还明确表示：“这是一个欧洲的冲突，欧洲人必须坐到谈判桌前。”
美国特使威特科夫（Steve Witkoff）10月21日在圣彼得堡与俄罗斯总统普京会晤后，普京助理乌沙科夫（Yury Ushakov）介绍：“此次会晤还谈及一个受到全球关注的话题：俄罗斯、中国和美国领导人可能在即将在中国深圳举行的APEC峰会期间举行历史性的首次会晤”。
乌沙科夫表示，莫斯科、华盛顿和北京都没有排除这一设想。他还称，作为APEC峰会东道主的中国“将负责——或者说已经在负责——筹备工作”，如果条件允许，中方肯定会将这场会晤纳入深圳峰会的议程。
全球各大媒体对此进行了报道。截至发稿，乌沙科夫的上述表态仍可在俄罗斯总统官方网站上查阅。
施泰因迈尔介绍，在北京访问期间的所有会谈中，德方都重点谈到了经贸关系。图像来源: Kai Naito/AFP
施泰因迈尔还介绍，在北京访问期间的所有会谈中，德方都重点谈到了经贸关系，特别是其中的失衡问题。这名德国总统透露，习近平已表示，支持与欧盟委员会就此进行进一步会谈。施泰因迈尔坦言，“我也强调，不仅是欧洲，我们德国也对贸易战不感兴趣，我们致力于通过对话寻求解决途径。”
当被问及是否与习近平讨论了人工智能这一重要话题时，施泰因迈尔认为，关于人工智能风险的辩论正在不断加强。他指出：“在与中方会谈时，有趣的一点是，习近平主席也认为这关乎全人类的问题、涉及如何确保技术处于可控范围之内。习近平主席同样认为，我们必须为此寻求一套国际规则体系。”
施泰因迈尔相信，要想对人工智能进行监管，首先必须掌握这项技术。他坦言，尽管与中美的差距已经拉大，但欧洲正在迎头追赶。
他观察到，中国也面临着老龄化严重问题，因此，中国自然也希望未来能够通过人工智能应用弥补劳动力短缺，“但这并不意味着我们可以毫无顾忌地引入人工智能，甚至因此危及民主进程。”
施泰因迈尔解释道：“因为事实是，对于由专制政权领导的社会而言，人工智能带来的问题相对较少。有时甚至让人觉得，这些国家乐于借助人工智能进一步完善对社会的控制。”
这位即将卸任的联邦总统警告称：“但对于民主国家来说，这是一项巨大的挑战，因为民主制度建立在公民的自主意识和判断能力之上。我们必须维护这些能力，不能让人类沦为机器的附庸。这需要我们付出巨大努力。”

content:
香港旅游发展局推出十一月美食月 逾400家食肆齐聚中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 2 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港旅游发展局推出十一月美食月 逾400间食肆齐聚
香港旅游发展局于 11 月推出美食月，超过 400 家餐厅和酒吧提供特别优惠。亮点包括包含 100 个场所的深夜美食地图以及旅游热点的延长营业时间。组织者的目标是促进当地支出和社区探索。
香港旅游发展局（旅发局）推出「香港美食月」，为期整个十一月，全城超过 400 间餐厅、酒吧及食店提供限时餐饮优惠。
该计划包括连接100家餐厅和酒吧的“香港深夜美食地图”，晚上9点后将提供独家优惠。一些热门旅游区的参与商店将延长营业时间至午夜或更晚。
刚刚结束的“香港美酒佳肴巡礼”的参加者还可凭活动中派发的“香港美食月尊享礼遇卡”，获得超过250项额外优惠。其中包括套餐折扣、餐饮折扣、迎宾饮品、买一送一优惠和活动兑换。
旅发局主席林建岳表示，是次活动旨在连接星级餐厅、地方风味餐厅、特色酒吧和深夜热点等五个主题类别，让游客和居民在整个11月从早到晚都能享受到香港的美食魅力。他表示希望这项活动能够鼓励更多人探索当地社区并在香港消费。

Hong Kong Tourism Board launches November Food Month with over 400 eateries
The Hong Kong Tourism Board launches Food Month in November, with over 400 restaurants and bars offering special deals. Highlights include a late-night food map with 100 venues and extended hours at tourist hotspots. Organisers aim to boost local spending and community exploration.
The Hong Kong Tourism Board (HKTB) has launched “Hong Kong Food Month”, running throughout November, with more than 400 restaurants, bars and food outlets across the city offering limited-time food and beverage promotions.
The initiative includes a “Hong Kong Late-Night Food Map” linking 100 restaurants and bars, which will offer exclusive deals after 9pm. Some participating outlets in popular tourist areas will extend their opening hours until midnight or later.
Attendees of the recently concluded “Hong Kong Wine and Food Festival” can also use the “Hong Kong Food Month Exclusive Privilege Card” distributed at the event to access more than 250 additional benefits. These include discounts on set menus, dining discounts, welcome drinks, buy-one-get-one-free offers and activity redemptions.
HKTB chairman Peter Lam said the event aims to connect five themed categories—star-rated restaurants, regional eateries, specialty bars and late-night hotspots—so that both tourists and residents can enjoy the city’s culinary appeal from day to night throughout November. He expressed hope the campaign would encourage more people to explore local communities and spend in Hong Kong.

content:
遗产嘉年华 (Heritage Fiesta) 推出敞篷巴士之旅，聚焦北方都市 |中国劳工公告栏
星期二, 3 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
遗产嘉年华以敞篷巴士之旅聚焦北部大都会
香港遗产嘉年华将于 11 月 21 日、22 日和 29 日举办，首次在北部大都会举办敞篷巴士之旅。 3条路线将覆盖屏山、厦村、龙跃头及新田，并提供三种语言的语音导览。
香港一年一度的文物嘉年华今年将前往北大都会，提供导赏服务，参观 12 处法定古迹和评级历史建筑。一项新特色——敞篷巴士古迹之旅，将于11月21日、22日及29日举行，并设有3条专用路线，涵盖屏山及厦村、龙跃头及新田。船上将提供粤语、普通话和英语的语音导览。
文物保育专员梁志基表示，《施政报告》提出了“文物+旅游”的方向，希望通过活动让居民了解北都深厚的文化根源。他援引前几届活动的强烈反响称，去年的活动吸引了超过 18 万名游客，反映出公众对遗产和文化的兴趣日益浓厚。
北都会拥有31处法定古迹、341处历史建筑及屏山文物径。梁振英表示，他相信今年的乘客人数将会很高，政府将监控需求并考虑增加更多敞篷巴士运营。
每条主题路线将在指定日期提供 15 个班次。每位申请人最多可预订两张门票，遵循先到先得的原则。周五上午 10 点开始报名，下周二下午 5 点结束。

Tuesday, 3 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Heritage Fiesta to spotlight Northern Metropolis with open-top bus tours
Hong Kong's Heritage Fiesta will feature open-top bus tours in the Northern Metropolis for the first time, running on 21, 22 and 29 November. Three routes will cover Ping Shan, Ha Tsuen, Lung Yeuk Tau and San Tin, with audio guides in three languages.
Hong Kong's annual Heritage Fiesta will head to the Northern Metropolis this year, offering guided tours of 12 declared monuments and graded historic buildings. A new feature — open-top bus heritage tours — will run on 21, 22 and 29 November, with three dedicated routes covering Ping Shan and Ha Tsuen, Lung Yeuk Tau, and San Tin. Audio guides in Cantonese, Mandarin and English will be available on board.
Commissioner for Heritage David Leung Chee-kay said the Policy Address had set out a "Heritage + Tourism" direction, and expressed hope the event would introduce residents to the Northern Metropolis' deep cultural roots. Citing a strong response to previous editions, he said activities had drawn more than 180,000 visitors last year, reflecting growing public interest in heritage and culture.
The Northern Metropolis has 31 declared monuments, 341 historic buildings and the Ping Shan Heritage Trail. Leung said he was confident this year's turnout would be strong, and that the government would monitor demand and consider adding more open-top bus runs.
Each themed route will offer 15 departures across the designated dates. Reservations are capped at two tickets per applicant on a first-come, first-served basis. Registration opens at 10am on Friday and closes at 5pm the following Tuesday.

content:
五角大楼考虑“公私合作伙伴关系”来帮助资助美国堡垒基地计划 - Breaking Defense
2026 年 10 月 10 日，从弗吉尼亚州阿灵顿罗纳德·里根华盛顿国家机场起飞的航班上看到五角大楼。 （安娜·钱梅梅克/盖蒂图片社拍摄）
佛罗里达州坦帕——一位五角大楼高级官员告诉《突破防务》杂志，五角大楼正计划寻求“公私合作伙伴关系”，以抵消其雄心勃勃的“美国堡垒”本土基地强化计划的成本，各军种已经在寻找机会。
“我认为现实情况是，公私合作伙伴关系真正开始付出代价，”负责能源、设施和环境的助理国防部长戴尔·马克斯本周在设施创新会议间隙表示。 “我们试图推行的模式不是我必须伸出手回到国会山。”
马克斯表示，军方“正在制定优先计划”，以便部分工作可以从“商业承购”中受益。
“正是这些合作伙伴关系可能会让我们以更快的速度和更大的规模推动这一进程，”他说。
就在一个月前，国防部长皮特·赫格斯 (Pete Hegseth) 推出了 FORTRESS，以“充当国家的保险”。这个想法是追求五个支柱，每一个支柱都将使各个国土基地更加安全：能源独立、促进供应链、更好地分配关键库存、强化设施以及确保武器在卫星通信中断时发挥作用。
“美国堡垒并不意味着我们要撤退到境内。这意味着我们正在确保我们的发射台安全，”马克斯本周在台上说道。 “这意味着，当美国决定在全球投射力量时，这种力量将是坚定的、持续的、不可阻挡的，因为后方无法被切断。”
马克斯表示，他与其他高级领导人的工作重点不是要求美国每个现有设施的完成日期都符合 FORTRESS 标准，而是确定优先事项和降低成本的方法。
赞助帖子，陆战
庞巴迪防务，您值得信赖、以任务为中心的合作伙伴
对长期运营价值的承诺。
在接受 Breaking Defense 采访时，马克斯没有具体说明哪些领域或项目可能适合公私合作，也没有具体说明国防部是否可以像以前那样为关键行业提供额外的高美元贷款。
但在采访和公开演讲中，他确实阐述了《堡垒》五个支柱背后的想法，以及为什么国防部试图采取灵活的方法。
马克斯在展会上以及在接受 Breaking Defense 采访时强调，五角大楼并不是从头开始开发 FORTRESS，因为已经采取了多项举措来帮助解决一些长期存在的问题。
以第一支柱为例：能源独立。马克斯告诉观众，美国基地一直在努力实现能源自给自足，在 FORTRESS 的领导下，这一努力正在不断推进，目标是找到为基地提供“30、60 甚至 90 天而不需要一瓦外部电源”的方法。
马克斯补充说：“每个主要军事设施都必须实现主权运行连续性。” “我们的首要任务很简单：我们正在结束依赖商业民用电网的基地运营时代。”
但具体情况会因地点而异，他后来发现

【原文 English Original】
Pentagon eyes 'public-private partnerships' to help fund FORTRESS America homeland base plan - Breaking Defense
The Pentagon is seen from a flight taking off from Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport on October 10, 2026 in Arlington, Virginia. (Photo by Anna Moneymaker/Getty Images)
TAMPA, Fla. — The Pentagon is planning to pursue “public-private partnerships” to offset the cost of its ambitious FORTRESS America homeland base-hardening initiative, with the services already looking to identify opportunities, a senior Pentagon official told Breaking Defense.
“I think the reality of this one is this is where the public-private partnerships really start to pay,” Assistant Secretary of Defense for Energy, Installations, and Environment Dale Marks said on the sidelines of the Installation Innovation conference here this week. “The model that we’re trying to drive on is not me having to go back up on Capitol Hill with my hand out.”
Marks said the military services “are working on a prioritization scheme” for portions of the effort that could benefit from “commercial offtake.”
“It’s those partnerships that are going to probably allow us to move this at a little bit more speed and scale,” he said.
Exactly a month ago, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth unveiled FORTRESS to “serve as the nation’s insurance policy.” The idea was to pursue five pillars that would each make individual homeland bases more secure: energy independence, boosting supply chains, better distributing key stockpiles, hardening installations and making sure weapons work if satellite communications go dark.
“Fortress America does not mean we are retreating behind our borders. It means we are securing our launching pad,” Marks said on stage this week. “It means that when the United States decides to project power across the globe, that power will be unyielding, sustained, and unstoppable because the home front cannot be severed.”
Marks said that his work with other senior leaders is focused not mandating a completion date for every existing US installation to be FORTRESS-compliant, but on identifying priorities and ways to drive down costs.

Bombardier Defense, your trusted, mission-focused partner
A commitment to long-term operational value.
In the interview with Breaking Defense, Marks didn’t specify which areas or projects may be ripe for public-private deals — or if DoD could involve itself in additional high-dollar loans for critical industries as part of the effort as it has previously.
But in the interview and during a public address here he did expand on the thinking behind FORTRESS’s five pillars and why the DoD is trying to take a flexible approach.
Marks emphasized at the show and when speaking to Breaking Defense that the Pentagon isn’t starting from scratch with FORTRESS, as several initiatives have been underway to help solve some longstanding problems.
Take the first pillar: energy independence. There has been an ongoing push to make US bases energy self-sustaining, and that is moving forward under FORTRESS with the goal of finding ways to power bases for “30, 60, or even 90 days without a single watt of outside power,” Marks told an audience.
“Every premier military installation must achieve sovereign operational continuity,” Marks added. “Our priority is straightforward: We are ending the era of base operations, depending on the commercial civilian grid.”
But just what this looks like will vary from location to location, he later told Breaking Defense.
Part of the goal is to build off of the Army’s Janus program that is spending $2.2 billion for five companies to build out and test their nuclear microreactors prototypes on military installations. But, Marks explained, the plan is not to field those microreactors on every installation.
“There’s going to be other sources of energy that we’re going to use, whether that’s natural gas, geothermal,” he said.
The second pillar, domestic supply chain resilience, is another area the department has been previously working on.
“We built exquisite fifth-gen aircraft and stealth destroyers, and then quietly allowed the critical components – the rare earth magnets, the titanium sponge, the defense-grade semiconductors, and the solid rocket propellants – to be mined, refined, and manufactured across foreign supply chains,” Marks told the audience. “That dangerous vulnerability ends now.”
Work to shore up the US supply chain is already underway and has included President Donald Trump’s executive order in July that essentially gave companies until the start of 2027 to stop using critical materials and minerals from Russia, Iran, North Korea and China. The Pentagon also recently provided conditional loans to private firms within the rare earth elements sector.
RELATED: As critical minerals deadline looms, Army expects to feel ‘some impact’
FORTRESS’s third pillar revolves around installation hardening and cyber-physical survivability. On stage, Marks explained that this will mean “moving beyond cosmetic physical security” and will require outfitting installations with “biomimetic and ultra high-performance concrete protective structures, subterranean command and control vaults, layered short-range air defenses, concealed direct energy counter drone systems, and zero trust completely air-gapped operational technology networks.”
While Marks did not publicly tie work on this pillar to the Golden Dome homeland defense plan, he told Breaking Defense his team is currently embedded with the Direct Reporting Portfolio Manager to prioritize coverage areas.
The fourth FORTRESS pillar centers around shoring up strategic reserves like ammunition and spare parts, and better dispersing them around the country — an area ripe of various public-private opportunities like factories and depots.
“We’re mandating a 90-day sovereign stockpile of critical parts, fuels, propellants, ammunitions on site, coupled with digital additive manufacturing depots capable of fabricating critical combat spares directly inside the wire under embargo conditions,” Marks explained on stage.
The fifth and final FORTRESS pillar the Pentagon is pursuing revolves around space inspector resilience and making sure the US can still use its weapons if adversaries are using anti-satellite, terrestrial jamming, or electronic warfare weapons.
“Fortress America mandates that our primary operational platforms operate within a contested, by design, electromagnetic environment for deploying ground-based GPS, subterranean inertial reference networks, and direct optical laser trunk lines,” Marks said. “If every commercial communication cell line in low Earth orbit is blinded tomorrow, our commanders will still see the battle space.”

title: 3 Questions on Lula's victory in Brazil to Regine Schönenberg | Heinrich Böll Stiftung | Brussels office - European Union
summary: Lula has won a historic fourth term, a hopeful signal that the far right can be defeated at the ballot box. Young voters, grassroots activists and more than 10 million members of “Lula’s Army” turned the tide in three weeks. Regine Schönenb
content:
Lula has won a historic fourth term, a hopeful signal that the far right can be defeated at the ballot box. Young voters, grassroots activists and more than 10 million members of “Lula’s Army” turned the tide in three weeks. Regine Schönenberg, Director of the Heinrich-Böll-Stiftung office in Rio de Janeiro, explains what drove this comeback, how civil society can defend social justice, climate and Indigenous rights against a conservative Congress, and what Europe should prioritise now.

### 1. What proved decisive in securing Lula’s re-election, and what does the close result tell us about the continued appeal of Bolsonarism in Brazilian society?

The historic switch to the leading position between the first and second turn of the Brazilian elections demonstrated the vitality of the Brazilian democracy. Within three weeks of intensive campaigning of “Lula's Army” on the streets and within cyberspace the election spirit changed completely. Especially, the mass mobilisation of young people energised the campaign. The most significant factor, however, was the online and on-the-ground mobilisation led by André Janones, a pro-Lula federal congressman, whose WhatsApp channel, known as “Lula's Army,” grew to more than 10 million members who followed his daily instructions to spread pro-Lula content. Over several weeks, rallies also brought supporters to the streets, many organised outside formal party structures. The result: About 3 million voters that abstained in the first turn participated in the runoff, and Lula gained about 4,4 million votes more than Flávio Bolsonaro, and about 10 million votes more than in the first round, whereas his opponent gained less than 4 million additional votes.

However, almost 60 million Brazilians voted for the candidate of the extreme-right due to a strong rejection of the person, Lula da Silva, the worker`s party (PT), an endless flood of fake news and Flavio’s aggressive promises of crime-combat in Bukele's style. Also, the fact, that Flávio Bolsonaro served as a substitute for his imprisoned father further weakened his campaign. Just as the far right fostered anti-PT sentiment within society, anti-Bolsonaro sentiment was a key factor in this election, leading people to reject Flávio Bolsonaro.

### 2. Where do you see the greatest opportunities – and political obstacles – for Lula to advance social justice, climate protection and Indigenous rights? What role can civil society play in pushing for progress?

Lula retaining the Presidency has a major impact on federal policy areas, such as social policies, environmental policy and various multilateral partnerships. In part, this election was not about Lula or the PT; it was about ensuring the continuation of social programmes and strengthening democracy. What must not be forgotten, however, is that from February 2027 on, Lula will have to deal with a Senate and Parliament that are considerably more conservative than at present. Traditionally, elections for governors, senators and members of parliament are heavily regional in nature and linked to numerous clientelist relationships. The fact that Brazil has a first-past-the-post electoral system does not help in this regard.

Lula's most important policy fields such as social justice, climate protection and Indigenous rights are in serious danger to be torpedoed by both chambers of Congress. Draft bills on all critical questions in those policy fields are already prepared and often ready for voting. To prevent them to get implemented is a complicated process of vetoing and counter-vetoing that, together with a lot of negotiation might take years. Unfortunately, the latter is true for constructive legislative projects of the government, too.

The extent to which Lula will be able to prevent the centre-right faction from adopting an obstructionist stance will depend on the composition and communication skills of his government team. During his first speech following his victory on Sunday evening, he was flanked by his loyal Vice-President, Geraldo Alckmin, and surrounded by young politicians and activists. He explicitly highlighted the issues of cybersecurity and the regulation of platforms, his learning process regarding political communication in the virtual sphere, and his plans for greater political participation. It spoke of a new beginning, innovation and the inclusion of civil society, which had made his victory possible in the first place.

It is therefore no surprise that Flávio Bolsonaro immediately declared that he would not recognise the election victory. The extension of polling station opening hours until 7 pm, due to rain and bus cancellations, is now being used as a pretext for this all too obvious manoeuvre, which is not expected to meet with much success. Flavio’s claim is controversial, given that his own campaign had also requested an extension of voting hours. In fact, people here are waiting for Flávio, just like his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro, to leave the country for the US to escape prosecution over numerous corruption scandals.

### 3. What does Lula’s victory mean for Brazil’s relations with the EU, and what should European partners prioritise to support democracy and a socially just ecological transition?

The most important outcome for Europe is that Lula can now continue his role as an important player – entirely in the spirit of traditional Brazilian foreign policy – within forums such as the G20, BRICS and also in the EU-Mercosur agreement, and that Brazil will not bow to pressure to join Trump’s ‘Shield of the Americas’.

As a democrat, one can only hope that the shift in Brazil – and, at the same time, in Serbia – signals a reversal of a global trend towards greater democratic representation.

_以下是2026年10月26日发布的日本2026年防卫白皮书的英文全文_

## 摘自报告

### 日本周边安全环境概要

**国际社会面临战后时代最大的考验**

不认同普世价值观或基于这种价值观的政治和经济制度的国家正在扩大其影响力。以武力单方面改变现状的企图是对现有国际秩序的严重挑战。国际社会正面临二战以来最大考验，进入危机新时代。全球力量平衡正在发生巨大变化，国家之间的竞争日益加剧。特别是，未来中美之间的国家间竞争可能会进一步加剧。

科学技术的快速发展正在从根本上改变安全范式。各国正在努力开发可以成为所谓游戏规则改变者的创新技术。传统的军事结构正在发生根本性变化，战争战术和战略也正在发生根本性变化。

网络空间等领域风险更加突出，信息战、气候变化等全球性安全问题不断涌现。
涉及领土争端的灰色地带局势不断发生。结合军事和非军事手段的混合战争的使用可能会变得更加复杂。
 印太地区安全形势日益严峻

这种全球安全环境和挑战在日本所在的印太地区尤为突出，并有可能进一步加剧。

不排除未来印太地区特别是东亚地区可能出现类似俄罗斯侵略乌克兰的严重局势。

**俄罗斯的侵略和乌克兰的防御**

俄罗斯对乌克兰的侵略损害了乌克兰的主权和领土完整。这严重违反了禁止使用武力的国际法和《联合国宪章》。这种单方面武力改变现状动摇了包括亚洲在内的国际秩序的基础。

一个本应对维护国际和平与安全负有首要责任的安理会常任理事国，公然从事挑战国际法和国际秩序的军事行动，夺走无辜生命，屡次使用可被解读为核武器威胁的语言和行动，这种情况是前所未有的。
如果容忍这种侵略行为，它可能会发出错误的信息，并暗示通过武力单方面改变现状在其他地方也是可以接受的。

因此，包括日本在内的国际社会不应容忍俄罗斯的行为。

除了乌克兰的强烈抵制外，国际社会还联合起来实施强有力的制裁等措施。作为美国的盟友（北约成员国）和横跨欧亚大陆与欧洲相对的国家，日本必须密切关注欧洲局势的未来变化，包括其战略影响，认识到欧洲和印太地区的安全密不可分。

**其他国家和地区的国防政策**

【原文 English Original】
_The following is the full English translation of Japan’s 2026 Defense White Paper, released Oct. 26, 2026._

## From the Report

### Security Environment Surrounding Japan Overview

**International Community amid the Greatest Trial of the Postwar Era**

States that do not share universal values or political and economic systems based on such values are expanding their influence. Unilateral changes to the status quo by force and such attempts represent a serious challenge to the existing international order. The international community is facing its greatest trial since World War II and entering a new era of crisis. The global balance of power is shifting dramatically and competition among states is growing. In particular, the inter-state competition between the U.S. and China is likely to intensify even further in the future.

Rapid developments in science and technology are fundamentally changing the paradigm of security. Countries are striving to develop innovative technologies that can become so-called game changers. The traditional military structure is undergoing fundamental changes, as are warfare tactics and strategies.

Risks in cyberspace and other domains are becoming more serious, and other security-related global issues such as information warfare and climate change are emerging.

Gray zone situations involving territorial disputes are constantly occurring. The use of hybrid warfare, which combines military and non-military means, may become even more sophisticated.
 Increasingly Severe Security Situation in the Indo-Pacific Region

Such global security environment and challenges are particularly prominent in the Indo-Pacific region, where Japan is located, and are likely to intensify still further in the future.

It cannot be ruled out that a serious situation similar to Russia’s aggression against Ukraine may occur in the Indo-Pacific region in the future, particularly in East Asia.

**Russia’s Aggression and Ukraine’s Defense**

Russia’s aggression against Ukraine undermines the sovereignty and territorial integrity of Ukraine. It is a serious violation of international law prohibiting the use of force and of the United Nations (UN) Charter. Such unilateral changes to the status quo by force have shaken the very foundation of the international order, including in Asia.

This situation, in which a permanent member of the Security Council, which is supposed to take primary responsibility for maintaining international peace and security, openly engages in military actions challenging international law and the international order, claims innocent lives and repeatedly uses language and actions that can be interpreted as threats involving nuclear weapons, is unprecedented.

If such aggression is tolerated, it could send out the wrong message and implication that unilateral changes to the status quo by force are also acceptable elsewhere.

Accordingly, the international community, including Japan, should not tolerate Russia’s action.

In addition to Ukraine’s strong resistance, the international community has united to implement strong sanctions and other measures. As an ally of the U.S.—a NATO member—and a country located on the opposite side of Europe across the Eurasian continent, Japan must closely monitor future changes in the European situation, including their strategic impact, acknowledging that the security of Europe and the Indo-Pacific is inseparable.

**Defense Policies of Other Countries and Regions**

The U.S. – Security Policy and Activities of the Second Trump Administration

The second Trump administration was formed in January 2025. The National Security Strategy was released in December of the same year, followed by the National Defense Strategy in January 2026. These documents clarified the security strategy envisioned by the second Trump administration.

Under the banner of “America First,” the Department of War indicated its intention to restore “peace through strength” and to focus on the Indo-Pacific region, where Japan is located, while prioritizing homeland defense. The documents also provide detailed descriptions of relations with allies, among other matters.

**China – Intensified Unilateral Attempts and Activities to Change the Status Quo by Force or Coercion**

China’s external posture, military activities, and other activities are a matter of serious concern for Japan and the international community and present an unprecedented and the greatest strategic challenge which Japan should respond with its comprehensive national power and in cooperation and collaboration with its ally, like-minded countries, and others.

For more than 30 years, China has sustained high-level growth of its defense budget without transparency, engaging in broad and rapid improvement of its military power in qualitative and quantitative terms with a focus on nuclear, missile, naval, and air forces.

China has been intensifying its activities in the region surrounding Japan, including the East China Sea, particularly in the area around the Senkaku Islands, the Sea of Japan, and the western Pacific Ocean, extending beyond the so-called first island chain to the second island chain.

In 2025, a series of incidents occurred, including: the activity of an aircraft carrier in the waters east of Iwo-To and the activity of two aircraft carriers in the Pacific Ocean in June; the unusual close approach by a Chinese fighter aircraft to a Japan Self-Defense Forces (JSDF) aircraft in June; the unusual close approach by a Chinese fighter-bomber to a JSDF aircraft in July; the activity of an aircraft carrier in the Pacific Ocean from the east of the main island of Okinawa to the east of Amami Oshima Island in December; and intermittent radar illumination against a JSDF aircraft by a Chinese fighter for approximately 30 minutes in December.

Such unusual close approaches by Chinese military aircraft could have triggered an accidental collision. Furthermore, the radar illumination by the Chinese military aircraft was a dangerous act exceeding the range necessary for the safe flight of an aircraft, and it is extremely regrettable that such incidents took place.

China has intensified its military activities around Taiwan. China conducted military exercises in the sea and airspace several times. It is believed that through the series of activities, China seeks to create a fait accompli where the People’s Liberation Army (PLA) is operating, and improve its actual combat capabilities.

China has intensified its activities in the South China Sea, while promoting militarization, based on assertions of unlawful maritime claims. Such actions to further promote its attempts to unilaterally change the status quo by force or coercion are serious concerns to Japan. Issues surrounding the South China Sea are directly connected to peace and stability in the Indo-Pacific region and represent a legitimate concern, not only for Japan, which has major sea lanes in the South China Sea, but also for the entire international community.

China is further strengthening its cooperation with Russia, including in military activities. In the Commemoration of the 80th Anniversary of the Victory in the Chinese People’s War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War in September 2025, President Xi Jinping, President Vladimir Putin, and Chairman of the State Affairs Commission Kim Jong Un were seen standing side by side. In the vicinity of Japan, China and Russia conducted joint flights of bombers and joint navigations of vessels. Such repeated joint activities are obviously intended as demonstration activities against Japan and pose a grave concern for Japan’s security.

content:
香港监管机构指出人工智能速度风险，敦促行业合作中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 2 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港监管机构指出人工智能速度风险，敦促行业合作
香港证券监管机构警告称，人工智能的发展速度超过了政府规则制定的速度。一项调查显示，所有主要机构都在使用人工智能，其中 55% 的机构测试了代理人工智能。该监管机构呼吁行业在网络安全和运营风险方面进行合作，优先考虑安全和人工监督。
香港证券及期货事务监察委员会（证监会）行政总裁梁美兰 11 月 2 日表示，前沿人工智能模型和代理人工智能的发展速度已经超出了政府和监管机构制定规则的能力。她在一次金融科技活动上发表讲话时指出，代理人工智能会动态选择自己的执行方法，这使得其下一步行动难以预测。梁振英呼吁行业合作解决网络安全、第三方依赖和其他运营风险。
梁警告说，如果无法管理网络安全等风险，就应该考虑放慢人工智能的发展。不过，她强调，监管机构将安全放在第一位，现有要求已经涵盖了必要的治理、风险管理和问责制。
证监会发布了一项针对20家大型机构和78家持牌公司的调查，涵盖2026年上半年证券市场交易的75％。调查发现，所有接受调查的机构都已经使用人工智能，并且95％的机构预计将在明年加速采用人工智能。十分之九的受访者表示，他们已经使用或正在评估人工智能来防范网络攻击，而 55% 的受访者目前正在使用或试用代理人工智能。
证监会重申其对人工智能的监管方针，被描述为“安全第一、以人为本、协作主导”，确保人类保持控制权。该政策有四个重点：保护投资者，因为人工智能重塑了投资者与机构的互动方式；加强网络安全和运营弹性，应对新的威胁和依赖；随着工作流程变得更加自主，重新审视问责制和人工监督；通过对话与合作建设知识和能力。

Hong Kong regulator flags AI speed risks, urges industry cooperation | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 2 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong regulator flags AI speed risks, urges industry cooperation
Hong Kong's securities regulator warns that AI development outpaces government rule-making. A survey shows all major institutions use AI, with 55% testing agentic AI. The regulator calls for industry collaboration on cybersecurity and operational risks, prioritising safety and human oversight.
Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) chief executive, Yolanda Leung, said on 2 November that the pace of development in frontier AI models and agentic AI has outstripped the ability of governments and regulators to set rules. Speaking at a fintech event, she noted that agentic AI chooses its own execution methods dynamically, making its next steps hard to predict. Leung called for industry cooperation to address cybersecurity, third-party dependence and other operational risks.
Leung warned that if risks such as cybersecurity cannot be managed, a slowdown in AI development should be considered. However, she stressed that the regulator places safety first and that existing requirements already cover necessary governance, risk management and accountability.
The SFC released a survey of 20 large institutions and 78 licensed firms, covering 75 per cent of securities market transactions in the first half of 2026. It found that all surveyed institutions already use AI, and 95 per cent expect to accelerate its adoption in the next year. Nine in ten respondents said they already use or are evaluating AI to guard against cyberattacks, while 55 per cent are currently using or trialling agentic AI.
The SFC reiterated its regulatory approach to AI, described as “safety-first, human-centric and collaboration-led”, ensuring that humans retain control. The policy has four focuses: protecting investors as AI reshapes how they interact with institutions; strengthening cybersecurity and operational resilience against new threats and dependencies; re-examining accountability and human oversight as workflows become more autonomous; and building knowledge and capacity through dialogue and cooperation.

content:
香港廉署起诉庄臣两名前高层 涉嫌就清洁车辆采购和维修收贿逾7500万港元 · 茉莉花新闻网 跳转到主要内容 跳转到页脚 在新标签页中打开
香港廉政公署11月2日公布，已在10月30日（星期五）起诉清洁公司庄臣有限公司（庄臣）的两名前高层封志宏和李细亮，控告两人涉嫌就采购清洁车辆和清洁车辆维修服务收受贿款，合共超过7,500万港元。两人被控一项串谋使代理人接受利益罪，违反《防止贿赂条例》第9(1)(b)条和《刑事罪行条例》第159A条；案件11月2日上午在观塘裁判法院提堂，廉署的公报和本文引用的报道都没有说明提堂的结果。
廉署说，被告封志宏54岁，案发时是庄臣的董事，兼任庄臣母公司的行政总裁，负责监督庄臣的业务，包括分判合约、采购订单和发放款项；李细亮57岁，当时是庄臣的总经理，直接受封志宏监督。按廉署的描述，2024年11月至2026年1月，庄臣向一家供应商购置了多批清洁车辆，并定期使用这家供应商的车辆维修保养服务，总费用超过1.6亿港元；控罪指两人串谋从这家供应商的东主等人收受贿款，作为在这些与庄臣有关的业务上优待这家供应商的报酬。受影响的是庄臣和在香港上市的母公司庄臣控股：被控收钱优待这家供应商的是庄臣当时的董事和总经理；廉署说庄臣在调查期间全面协助，调查还在继续，不排除会有进一步检控。
庄臣控股今年3月30日公布，封志宏因家庭及个人事务原因，辞去公司行政总裁、风险管理和环境、社会及管治委员会成员，以及集团所有其他职位，即日生效；公司当时说正在物色新的行政总裁。
廉署今年1月拘捕了14人，其中有庄臣控股一名高级管理层成员和两名经理级雇员，以及分判商的东主和职员。廉署发言人当时回应媒体查询，没有说出公司名字，说怀疑一家提供清洁服务的上市公司的三人串谋向三家分判商收受利益，把多份合约批给这些分判商；合约涉及这家上市公司为商业机构提供的服务，以及向这家公司提供车辆和相关维修保养，不牵涉与政府签订的合约。被捕的人涉嫌违反《防止贿赂条例》，以及串谋诈骗和洗黑钱；廉署在1月的行动中检走现金约100万港元和大量名贵手表，手表估值超过1,000万港元，廉署说涉嫌被用来“清洗”涉案贿款和相关犯罪得益。
项目金额（港元）出处庄臣向这家供应商买车、修车的总费用超过1.6亿廉署11月2日公报两人被控收受的贿款超过7,500万廉署11月2日公报1月检走的名贵手表的估值超过1,000万廉署1月的公报1月检走的现金约100万廉署1月的公报
庄臣控股1月22日发声明说，廉署前一天到公司的主要营业地点执行搜查令，拘捕公司一名高级管理层成员和两名雇员，董事会当天已决议即时暂停三人所有营运、行政及执行职务和权力；公司说三人都不是集团董事，没有其他董事或雇员被捕，也没有人被廉署检控。廉署11月2日的公报只公布起诉封志宏和李细亮两人，没有提到1月的拘捕，也没有写出这家供应商的名字。
庄臣控股在网站上介绍，公司1979年开始在香港提供清洁服务，客户包括不同政府部门、大学和商业机构，有超过13,000名员工和接近400辆车的专业用途车队。网站上的里程碑页面写明，庄臣控股2019年在香港联合交易所主板上市，股份代号1955，珠海华发集团有限公司在2015年成为主要股东。
2024年11月廉署所说庄臣向一家供应商购置清洁车辆、使用维修保养服务的期间开始，到2026年1月为止
2026年1月21日廉署到庄臣控股的主要营业地点搜查，拘捕公司一名高级管理层成员和两名雇员
我们的分析不论控罪是否成立，庄臣当时的监督过于集中，监督买车、修车的就是被控的人。这是因为，廉署说封志宏负责监督庄臣的采购订单和发放款项，另一被告也直接受他监督；按庄臣控股的公告，他到辞职时还是母公司风险管理和环境、社会及管治委员会的成员。
不同看法庄臣控股董事会1月在员工被捕当天就暂停三人职务，廉署也说庄臣全面协助，可以说公司的监督起了作用。我们同意庄臣事后处理很快，但这不改变我们的看法。这是因为，这些都是对廉署调查的回应，而2024年11月至2026年1月监督采购和付款的正是封志宏。
后续走向廉署会不会就庄臣或庄臣控股的车辆或外判合约公布起诉更多人。我们判断，到2027年6月30日（含当天），廉署会就庄臣或庄臣控股的车辆或外判合约公布起诉这两人以外的至少一人。这是因为，控罪指贿款来自供应商东主等人，这些人没有一起被起诉，廉署也不排除进一步检控；1月被捕的人还涉嫌串谋诈骗和洗黑钱，这次的控罪里没有这两项。
按廉署公布的数字计算，两人被控收受的贿款约为庄臣同期向这家供应商买车、修车总费用的47%。

content:
吴宝儿荣获世界杰出华人终身成就奖 |中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 2 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
胡宝仪荣获世界杰出华人终身成就奖
94岁的香港资深艺人胡宝仪在第19届世界杰出华人奖上荣获首届终身成就奖。该颁奖典礼由世界华商投资基金会主办，表彰了娱乐、科学、商业和体育领域的中国领军人物
由世界华商投资基金会主办的第十九届世界杰出华人颁奖典礼于周日举行，表彰华人领军人物的卓越成就和全球影响力。
今年活动的一大亮点是颁发给传奇资深艺人冯宝仪的“终身成就奖”。该荣誉由基金会永远名誉会长、英皇集团主席杨受成联同全国人大常委、立法会主席李慧琼共同颁发。
94岁的胡先生在香港影视界拥有七十年的职业生涯。他受到广泛尊重，仍然是华人社区的重要人物。
主礼嘉宾包括旭日国际主席蔡志明、英皇集团副主席杨正龙等。杰出的获奖者包括香港贸易发展局主席马时亨的表兄弟以及著名艺人曾志伟。著名演员兼导演吴京和入行 44 周年的资深演员梁家辉也获此殊荣。
其他获奖者包括菲尔兹奖和克莱研究奖获得者邓宇、香港大学法学院前院长陈鸿毅、香港中文大学副校长卢旭明、科学家吕朝阳和严宁，以及临床肿瘤学家莫书金。
在商业领域，洛杉矶中华总商会董事会主席Chester Chong获奖。乒乓球运动员朱雨玲和香港艺术体操运动员石伟雄荣获中国杰出青年奖。此外，新设立的最高荣誉奖颁予资深银行家林光兆。

Bowie Woo receives Lifetime Achievement at World Outstanding Chinese Awards | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 2 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Bowie Woo receives Lifetime Achievement at World Outstanding Chinese Awards
Veteran Hong Kong entertainer Bowie Woo, 94, received the inaugural Lifetime Achievement award at the 19th World Outstanding Chinese Awards. The ceremony, organised by the World Chinese Business Investment Foundation, honoured leading Chinese figures across entertainment, science, business and sport
The 19th World Outstanding Chinese Award Ceremony, organised by the World Chinese Business Investment Foundation, took place on Sunday, celebrating the remarkable achievements and global influence of leading Chinese figures.
A highlight of this year's event was the introduction of the “Lifetime Achievement” award, presented to legendary veteran entertainer Bowie Woo Fung. The honour was bestowed by Albert Yeung Sau-shing, permanent honorary president of the Foundation and chairman of the Emperor Group, together with Starry Lee Wai-king, member of the Standing Committee of the National People’s Congress and president of the Legislative Council.
Woo, 94, has enjoyed a career spanning seven decades in Hong Kong’s film and television industry. He is widely respected and remains a significant figure in the Chinese community.
Officiated guests included Early Light International chairman Francis Choi Chee-ming, vice chairman of Emperor Group Alex Yeung Ching-loong and more. Among the distinguished awardees were cousins Frederick Ma Si-hang, chairman of the Hong Kong Trade Development Council, and renowned entertainer Eric Tsang Chi-wai. Acclaimed actor and director Jacky Wu Jing and veteran actor Tony Leung Ka-fai—who marks his 44th year in the industry—were also honoured.
Other honorees included Fields Medal and Clay Research Award recipient Deng Yu, former Dean of the Faculty of Law at the University of Hong Kong Albert Chen Hung-yee, Chinese University of Hong Kong vice-chancellor Dennis Lo Yuk-ming, scientists Lu Chao-Yang and Yan Nieng, and clinical oncologist Tony Mok Shu-kam.
In the business sector, Chester Chong, president of the Board of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Los Angeles, received an award. The Outstanding Chinese Youth honour went to table tennis player Zhu Yuling and Hong Kong artistic gymnast Shek Wai-hung. Additionally, the newly established grand honorary award was presented to veteran banker Lam Kwong-siu.

title: Taiwan vows vigilance as Beijing releases satellite imagery of island landmarks
zh_title: 北京发布岛屿地标卫星图像，台湾发誓保持警惕
source: 南华早报SCMP（中国社会/科技/舆情）
summary: 在北京发布该岛的高分辨率卫星图像后，[台湾](https://www.scmp.com/topics/taiwan?module=inline&pgtype=article)军方誓言对中国大陆的情报收集活动保持警惕，引发对其日益增长的[监视](https://www.scmp.com/topics/surveillance?module=inline&pgtype=article)能力的担忧。国防部长辜立雄周二对记者表示：“对于所有针对台湾的此类卫星图像和相关情报收集，国防部任何时候都不会放松警惕。”
content:
在北京发布该岛的高分辨率卫星图像后，[台湾](https://www.scmp.com/topics/taiwan?module=inline&pgtype=article)军方誓言对中国大陆的情报收集活动保持警惕，引发对其日益增长的[监视](https://www.scmp.com/topics/surveillance?module=inline&pgtype=article)能力的担忧。

国防部长辜立雄周二对记者表示：“对于所有针对台湾的此类卫星图像和相关情报收集，国防部任何时候都不会放松警惕。”

“我们还将采取适当的预警和应对措施，包括必要的隐蔽、机动和疏散措施，以确保武装部队的行动安全。”

在他发表上述言论之前，中国大陆国家广播机构 [CCTV](https://www.scmp.com/topics/cctv?module=inline&pgtype=article) 于周日发布了一段 42 秒的视频，其中包含商业吉林一号遥感卫星星座捕获的台湾高分辨率图像。

标有“这是中国的台湾省”的镜头从整个岛屿的景色转移到中正纪念堂、国立故宫博物院、台北巨蛋和台北港以及日月潭和玉山等地标建筑。

“（从太空）每条街道都清晰可见，”它说。

10 月 12 日，人们在台北中正纪念堂外走过台湾国旗。照片：EPA
这次发布标志着吉林一号图像连续第二年在北京 10 月 25 日左右发布的信息中占据显着位置，以纪念 1945 年日本对台湾殖民统治的结束。

北京去年正式将这一天定为“台湾光复日”，吉林一号图像成为将技术能力与台湾主权主张联系起来的更广泛活动的一部分。

北京将台湾视为中国的一部分，必要时可以用武力统一台湾。包括美国在内的大多数国家都不承认台湾是一个独立国家，但华盛顿反对任何以武力夺取这个自治岛屿的企图，并致力于向其提供武器。

去年10月，高分辨率图像显示了台湾各地的地点，包括日月潭、阿里山、台北港和新竹科学园区，街道、建筑物和其他结构清晰可辨。

这一消息的发布当时引起了北京国防部的公开回应。

当被问及如果商业星座能够如此详细地显示台湾街道时，军用卫星可以产生更清晰的图像时，发言人张晓刚说：“中国卫星看到中国台湾的壮丽景观是完全正常的。没有什么值得惊讶的。”

内地报道称，公开发布的图像分辨率一般为亚米级，可以区分街道布局和其他特征。
据其运营商长光卫星技术公司称，吉林一号星座由 141 颗卫星组成，在距地球约 500 公里（311 英里）的地方运行。

在周二的立法会议上，执政的民进党议员吴思耀表示，北京“故意突出了台湾的著名地标，以强化其对台湾的主权主张”，同时利用这些图像来表明其有能力密切监视台湾。

【原文 English Original】
[Taiwan](https://www.scmp.com/topics/taiwan?module=inline&pgtype=article)’s military has vowed to remain vigilant against mainland Chinese intelligence-gathering activities after Beijing released high-resolution satellite images of the island, raising concerns about its growing [surveillance](https://www.scmp.com/topics/surveillance?module=inline&pgtype=article) capabilities.

“The defence ministry will not lower its vigilance at any time regarding all such satellite imagery and related intelligence collection directed at Taiwan,” Defence Minister Wellington Koo Li-hsiung told reporters on Tuesday.

“We will also take appropriate early-warning and response measures, including the necessary concealment, mobility and dispersal measures, to ensure the operational security of the armed forces.”

His comments followed mainland Chinese state broadcaster [CCTV](https://www.scmp.com/topics/cctv?module=inline&pgtype=article)’s release on Sunday of a 42-second video featuring high-resolution imagery of Taiwan captured by the commercial Jilin-1 remote-sensing satellite constellation.

Labelled “This is China’s Taiwan Province”, the footage moved from views of the entire island to landmarks including Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall, the National Palace Museum, Taipei Dome and Taipei Port, as well as Sun Moon Lake and Mount Jade.

“Every street is clearly visible [from space],” it said.

People walk past Taiwan flags outside Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall in Taipei on October 12. Photo: EPA

The release marked the second consecutive year that Jilin-1 imagery featured prominently in Beijing’s messaging around October 25, which commemorates the end of Japanese colonial rule over Taiwan in 1945.

Beijing last year formally designated the date as “Taiwan Restoration Day”, with Jilin-1 imagery becoming part of a broader campaign linking technological capability with its claim over the island.

Beijing regards Taiwan as part of China to be reunited by force if necessary. Most countries, including the United States, do not recognise Taiwan as an independent state, but Washington is opposed to any attempt to take the self-ruled island by force and is committed to supplying it with weapons.

Last October, high-resolution images showed locations across Taiwan including Sun Moon Lake, Alishan, Taipei Port and Hsinchu Science Park, with streets, buildings and other structures clearly discernible.

The release prompted a public response at the time from Beijing’s defence ministry.

Asked about suggestions that military satellites could produce even clearer images if a commercial constellation could show Taiwan’s streets in such detail, spokesman Zhang Xiaogang said: “It is perfectly normal for Chinese satellites to take a look at the magnificent landscape of China’s Taiwan. There is nothing to be surprised about.”

Mainland reports said the publicly released images were generally at sub-metre resolution, allowing street layouts and other features to be distinguished.

The Jilin-1 constellation then comprised 141 satellites operating about 500km (311 miles) above Earth, according to its operator, Chang Guang Satellite Technology.

At a legislative meeting on Tuesday, ruling Democratic Progressive Party lawmaker Wu Szu-yao said Beijing had “deliberately highlighted prominent Taiwanese landmarks to reinforce its claim” over the island while using the imagery to signal its ability to closely monitor Taiwan.

02:20

Premier Cho Jung-tai said in response that Taipei was strengthening its defences through regular and special budgets, and responding to external threats through legal and technological measures.

Analysts said the imagery carried both political and military implications.

Joseph Wen, an adjunct research fellow at Taiwan’s government-funded Institute for National Defence and Security Research, said Jilin-1 illustrated Beijing’s “ability to conduct high-resolution observation of virtually any part of Taiwan”.

Whether mainland China could maintain continuous and real-time surveillance depended on the number and orbital configuration of its satellites, the mix of optical and radar sensors, and the speed at which imagery could be transmitted and processed, he added.

But publicly available information suggested Beijing was probably already capable of near-real-time satellite observation of Taiwan or would be in the foreseeable future, Wen said.

“Persistent observation could reveal militarily useful information from seemingly mundane details, such as changes in the number of vehicles parked at military bases,” he warned.

Analysts also said the releases combined a display of technological prowess with political messaging, as part of a broader pressure campaign involving military exercises, legal warfare and public-opinion operations.

“Through the images, Beijing sent the message that under its satellites, Taiwan is effectively transparent and can be observed in considerable detail,” political commentator Chiu Yi said, adding that this was intended to reinforce the impression that the island was within Beijing’s reach.

Retired Major General Li Cheng-chieh said the imagery carried more than symbolic significance because satellite intelligence could expose troop movements and other military activities.

“Mainland China’s growing constellation could also make surveillance increasingly persistent,” he said, arguing that the pressure created by showing such capabilities could rival that of [People’s Liberation Army](https://www.scmp.com/topics/peoples-liberation-army-pla?module=inline&pgtype=article) exercises around Taiwan.

title: Alibaba wins preliminary injunction against Pentagon lobbying rule
zh_title: 阿里巴巴赢得针对五角大楼游说规则的初步禁令
source: 南华早报SCMP（中国社会/科技/舆情）
summary: 一名联邦法官发现，这家中国科技巨头可能会以言论自由为由成功挑战该措施，随后阿里巴巴赢得了一项初步法院命令，阻止美国一项限制措施赶走了其华盛顿游说者。美国地区法官 Eumi K. Lee 周一裁定，政府未能提供足够的证据来证明这一限制的合理性，这实际上迫使游说公司在代表阿里巴巴和寻求五角大楼合同的客户之间做出选择。阿里巴巴拥有《南华早报》。这一决定使阿里巴巴得以保留也代表阿里巴巴的游说者。
content:
一名联邦法官发现，这家中国科技巨头可能会以言论自由为由成功挑战该措施，随后阿里巴巴赢得了一项初步法院命令，阻止美国一项限制措施赶走了其华盛顿游说者。

美国地区法官 Eumi K. Lee 周一裁定，政府未能提供足够的证据来证明这一限制的合理性，这实际上迫使游说公司在代表阿里巴巴和寻求五角大楼合同的客户之间做出选择。

阿里巴巴拥有《南华早报》。

该决定允许阿里巴巴在诉讼进行期间保留同时代表国防承包商的游说者。它不会将该公司从五角大楼所谓的中国军事公司名单中删除，也不会解决其[对该指定的挑战](https://www.scmp.com/tech/big-tech/article/3365751/cxmt-joins-forming-list-chinese-tech-firms-suing-us-pentagon-over-blacklists?module=inline&pgtype=article)。

“通过限制阿里巴巴保留说客的能力，第 4663 条在功能上限制了其政治言论，”李在加州北区发布的 26 页命令中写道。
该法律于 6 月 30 日生效，禁止五角大楼与那些保留为其[第 1260H 条中国军方名单”上的企业工作的说客的公司（或其母公司或子公司）签订合同。公司](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3356419/us-adds-alibaba-byd-and-other-chinese-tech-champions-military-company-list?module=inline&pgtype=article)。

00:44

中央情报局在新的招募视频中针对中国军官

6月份更新的1260H名单已大幅扩展至互联网、新能源、生物技术和半导体等领域。与阿里巴巴并列的其他知名公司包括百度、比亚迪、蔚来、宇树机器人和药明康德。

裁决中引用的证据显示，尽管这一限制是通过国防合同实施的，但它对阿里巴巴接触美国政策制定者的影响却是巨大的。

在被指定之前，阿里巴巴已聘请了两打游说者和多家游说公司，在国会和行政部门代表其利益。截至 6 月 30 日，该组织已没有注册游说者。

根据该命令，多家公司告诉阿里巴巴，他们因法律原因而退出。有些人代表该公司工作了近十年。
阿里巴巴辩称，失去这些代表使其被边缘化，因为华盛顿正在考虑影响其业务的政策，包括人工智能、消费品进口和设备授权。

政府辩解称，这一限制是一项国家安全措施，称指定公司可以通过共同的游说者获取敏感军事信息，或利用这些关系影响五角大楼的决策。

五角大楼没有立即回应置评请求。

李承认国家安全的重要性，但发现政府没有充分证实这些风险，以证明限制言论的合理性。

它唯一的支持证据是国会的解释性声明，呼吁对涉及与五角大楼和中国政府合作的咨询公司的风险进行研究。

【原文 English Original】
Alibaba has won a preliminary court order blocking a US restriction that drove away its Washington lobbyists, after a federal judge found the Chinese technology giant was likely to succeed in challenging the measure on free-speech grounds.

US District Judge Eumi K. Lee ruled on Monday that the government had failed to provide sufficient evidence to justify the restriction, which effectively forces lobbying firms to choose between representing Alibaba and clients seeking Pentagon contracts.

Alibaba owns the South China Morning Post.

The decision allows Alibaba to retain lobbyists who also represent defence contractors while its lawsuit proceeds. It does not remove the company from the Pentagon’s list of alleged Chinese military companies or resolve its [challenge to that designation](https://www.scmp.com/tech/big-tech/article/3365751/cxmt-joins-growing-list-chinese-tech-firms-suing-us-pentagon-over-blacklists?module=inline&pgtype=article).

“By restricting Alibaba’s ability to retain lobbyists, Section 4663 functionally restricts its political speech,” Lee wrote in the 26-page order issued in the Northern District of California.

The law, which took effect on June 30, bars the Pentagon from entering into contracts with companies – or their parents or subsidiaries – that retain lobbyists working for businesses on its [Section 1260H list of Chinese military companies](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3356419/us-adds-alibaba-byd-and-other-chinese-tech-champions-military-company-list?module=inline&pgtype=article).

00:44

CIA targets Chinese military officers in new recruitment video

The 1260H list updated in June has expanded significantly into sectors such as the internet, new energy, biotechnology and semiconductors. Other prominent companies included alongside Alibaba in the same cohort feature Baidu, BYD, Nio, Unitree Robotics and WuXi AppTec.

Although the restriction operates through defence contracts, its consequences for Alibaba’s access to US policymakers were substantial, according to evidence cited in the ruling.

Before its designation, Alibaba had retained more than two dozen lobbyists and multiple lobbying firms to represent its interests before Congress and the executive branch. By June 30, it had no registered lobbyists.

Several firms told Alibaba they were withdrawing because of the law, according to the order. Some had represented the company for almost a decade.

Alibaba argued that losing those representatives left it sidelined as Washington considered policies affecting its business, including artificial intelligence, consumer product imports and device authorisations.

The government defended the restriction as a national security measure, arguing that designated companies could obtain sensitive military information through shared lobbyists or use those relationships to influence Pentagon decisions.

The Pentagon did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

Lee acknowledged the importance of national security but found that the government had not substantiated those risks sufficiently to justify restricting speech.

Its sole supporting exhibit was a congressional explanatory statement that called for a study of risks involving consulting firms working with both the Pentagon and the Chinese government or its affiliates.

The statement contained no findings about the risks posed by lobbyists representing designated companies, she wrote.

The government also failed to demonstrate why less restrictive alternatives, such as disclosure requirements, would be inadequate, the judge found.

Alibaba [sued on June 23](https://www.scmp.com/news/us/article/3358113/alibaba-sues-pentagon-over-china-military-blacklist?module=inline&pgtype=article) after the Pentagon included it in a June update to the military-company list. The department had also named Alibaba in a [February notice that was withdrawn](https://www.scmp.com/news/us/article/3343540/pentagon-adds-chinese-firms-military-list-then-withdraws-filing?module=inline&pgtype=article) shortly after being posted.

The Pentagon cited Alibaba’s alleged affiliations with China’s state assets regulator and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology as grounds for its designation, according to the order.

Alibaba disputes those grounds. In submissions described by the court, the company said it did not have a close relationship with the state assets regulator and characterised its relationship with the ministry as that of a regulated company dealing with its regulator.

Monday’s preliminary injunction follows an [earlier temporary restraining order](https://www.scmp.com/tech/big-tech/article/3359638/alibaba-wins-reprieve-us-lobbying-after-pentagon-blacklisted-companies?module=inline&pgtype=article) that was due to expire that day. The relief applies specifically to the lobbying-related restriction concerning Alibaba; the judge declined at this stage to block the law across the board or remove the company’s military designation.

The company did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

content:
为期四天的中共二十届五中全会星期一(10月26日)在北京开幕。外界普遍认为这次闭门会议要为2027年召开的中共二十一大作准备。分析人士认为，本届全会聚焦“从严治党”是习近平的政治刚需；另外，会议可能只会对中共高层进行局部调整，而不会全面重新洗牌。

根据中国官媒报道，中共总书记习近平10月26日代表中央政治局向全会作工作报告，并就《中共中央关于持之以恒推进全面从严治党若干重大问题的决定(讨论稿）》向全会作了说明。

对于许多海外观察人士来说，虽然中共党内反腐行动、加强干部监督和问责等问题都是重要话题，但是全面从严治党才是五中全会的最主要议题。

人权组织“公民力量”(Citizen Power Initiatives for China)创办人杨建利告诉美国之音(VOA)，习近平上台十多年，权力已经非常集中，但是高调讨论“从严治党”仍是刚需。

**观察人士：对习来说，权力越集中越需要持续“从严治党”**

杨建利表示，对习近平来说，“从严治党”不光是反腐，也是巩固权力、统一思想、约束官僚体系的手段，权力越集中越需要持续做。

杨建利告诉美国之音，习近平多年清洗党内本身说明问题一直在冒出来，军队和要害部门接连出事，最高层很可能认为还没有清理干净。

杨建利说：“在二十一大之前，可以借这个机会把‘自我革命’的体系定型，作为执政遗产，也为人事布局铺路。”

杨建利认为，“从严治党”同时也是习近平本人的政治需要。他指出：“党内有人质疑‘反腐’，习近平要为自己的标志性政治路线，即反腐，盖棺论定，确定其正确性，避免翻案。”

《北京之春》杂志荣誉主编胡平甚至预测，习近平不仅要大张旗鼓讨论“从严治党”，而且还可能对这个问题做出一个相应的“决定”或者“决议”，因为反腐是习近平上台以来最主要的工作，他需要以中央全会的名义在反腐问题上给他一个正式的肯定。

胡平在接受美国之音采访时说：“他(习)知道反腐在内部造成了高度的紧张，有很多人对他的这些做法非常非常不满。因此他必须通过这么一个决定，把不同的声音给压下去。因此这是他在这次会上的重点。”

**美智库：出席五中全会的人数将降至毛泽东时代以来的最低水平**

美国亚洲协会政策研究所(ASPI)中国分析中心10月19日发布了一篇题为《习近平控制力的局限：中共五中全会观察重点》的文章，分析了中共二十届五中全会的核心议题、人事变动及政治走向。

文章开篇便称习近平“像是一位‘列宁主义版’的洛根·罗伊(Logan Roy）”。洛根·罗伊是美剧《继承之战》(Succession)中一位专横跋扈的大家长，他执掌着世界上最大的传媒娱乐集团之一，行使着绝对的权威，却又抱怨那些无法落实其想法的下属。

文章指出，习近平在党内开展的整肃行动，将导致五中全会会场出现许多空位。文章主要作者、“亚洲协会政策研究所”资深研究员牛犇(Neil Thomas)在社媒平台X上发帖指出：“据我们估算，出席此次全会的中央委员及候补委员人数，将降至毛泽东时代以来的最低水平，仅占总数的77%。”

对于外界关注的五中全会上是否会有更多的高官遭到清洗，长期观察和分析中国政治的杨建利表示，按惯例，全会上会确认此前已经查处的中央委员、候补委员的处分，并递补候补委员，名单很可能包括军队将领和部分省部级官员。

杨建利告诉美国之音：“全会当场宣布新的大老虎比较少见，更多是追认已经处理的人。但是全会后，清洗将会继续。”

《北京之春》荣誉主编胡平认为，党内清洗在五中全会开会前便已经结束，该处理的人员习近平已经处理好了。

胡平告诉美国之音：“(习)反而还可能把有些人补充上来，因为有的缺员太多了，他需要补充。”

**会不会有重大的权力布局？**

本届五中全会距离明年秋季召开的中共二十一大不到一年，外界普遍认为这是中共最高领导层换届前夕的重要政治节点，因此，权力布局和高层动向备受关注。

其中，中央军委人事变动特别是外界广泛关注的一个重点。在中共二十大产生的七人中央军事委员会中，包括李尚福、苗华、何卫东、张又侠和刘振立在内的五位成员，在习近平的军中反腐运动中先后落马，如今只剩习近平和张升民两人。

观察人士普遍认为，本届五中全会很有可能增补军委副主席或委员，而不会等到明年二十一大的召开。

不过，杨建利告诉美国之音，五中全会上大概率只是对高层进行局部调整，而不会是全面重新洗牌。

杨建利说：“补齐空缺的中央委员；很可能调整中央军委成员；政治局常委层面大幅变动的可能性较低。全会奠定基础，真正的重大布局在会后，包括可能的接班人选，更可能留到二十一大。”

杨建利强调说，本届全会的人事和措辞，均可“看作二十一大前的风向标”。

## Kenya: Chinese Nationals Held Hostage in Violent Robbery At Kilimani Construction Site

27 October 2026

[Capital FM (Nairobi)](https://capitalfm.africa/ "Visit Capital FM (Nairobi)")

Nairobi — Police are investigating a violent robbery at a construction site along Kilungu Road in Nairobi's Kilimani area, where three Chinese nationals were held hostage and property and cash stolen.

According to a police report filed at Kilimani Police Station, the incident occurred on the night of Sunday, with the victims managing to raise the alarm at about 5am on Monday.

The report indicates that one of the victims returned to the Luna Oak construction site at around 11pm and found the site's security guard, Augustine Momanyi, who works for Marshall Security Company, dressed in civilian clothes instead of his security uniform.

The guard was reportedly accompanied by three men who turned against the returning resident and attacked him with a kitchen knife.

The attackers allegedly took the house keys from his pocket, entered the residence, tied his hands and legs with a rope and confined him in the washroom.

At around midnight, two other Chinese nationals, identified as Chen Guang Jun, 37, and Yang Bin, 40, returned to the house and were also held hostage.

The suspects allegedly used crude weapons to break into other rooms, ransacked the house and stole electronic equipment, construction materials and cash.

According to the police report, Chen lost three mobile phones -- an iPhone 13 Pro, an iPhone 10 and a Huawei phone -- as well as a Huawei laptop and two television sets measuring 50 inches and 45 inches.

The suspects also stole 50 bags of scaffolding materials, two generators and KSh30,000 in cash.

Chen further reported that KSh10,000 was transferred from his Stanbic Bank account and another KSh87,000 from his M-Pesa account.

Yang reportedly lost an Oppo mobile phone and KSh80,000 in cash, while a further KSh2,000 was transferred from his account.

A third victim, Qian Hongxing, 53, reported the loss of two Oppo 13 mobile phones.

The attackers also disconnected and stole the CCTV installations at the premises, potentially removing equipment that could have helped investigators establish how the robbery was carried out.

The victims managed to raise the alarm at around 5am on Monday, prompting police officers to visit the scene.

Scenes of Crime personnel processed the premises as part of the investigation, while the crude weapons allegedly used during the robbery were preserved as exhibits.

The victims were taken to Nairobi Hospital, where they were receiving treatment in stable condition, according to the police report.

Police are expected to investigate the circumstances surrounding the incident, including the alleged involvement of the security guard and the identity of the three men who reportedly accompanied him.

The report did not indicate whether any arrests had been made or whether the stolen property had been recovered.

The total value of the stolen property and the money lost through the reported transfers had not been established.

summary: 香港警方在针对社交媒体上宣传的非法跨境出租车服务的卧底行动中逮捕了两名司机。警员冒充乘客预订前往深圳的行程，分别支付港币 950 元和港币 1,050 元的费用，然后拘捕司机，因为司机没有报酬载客 [![图 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), 主编 2026 年 10 月 27 日 19:57 香港时间 · 2 分钟读 香港警方在卧底行动中逮捕了两名司机

香港
香港警方在针对社交媒体上宣传的非法跨境出租车服务的卧底行动中逮捕了两名司机。警员冒充乘客预订前往深圳的行程，并支付港币950元及港币1,050元的费用后，拘捕载客无酬载乘客的司机。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 27 日 19:57 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港警方在打击跨境非法出租车服务（即“白牌”汽车）的卧底行动中逮捕了两名司机。港岛总区交通部及管制组特遣队高级督察施思豪表示，10 月 27 日，一名 33 岁的本地司机和一名 27 岁的持有双向许可证的中国内地司机被拘留。

警方表示，非法服务中介利用各种社交媒体平台招募乘客，提供豪华七座车，从香港经陆路边境检查站前往中国内地城市。警察冒充乘客联系了两个社交媒体账户，请求前往深圳。账户报价分别为港币950元及港币1,050元，需于出发前将全额车费存入指定电子钱包。
缴付车费后，执法人员于行动当日登上两辆香港注册、挂有跨境车牌的豪华七座车。旅程开始后，警方透露了他们的身份并逮捕了两名司机。当地司机涉嫌无证载客取酬、无第三方保险驾驶。该内地司机还涉嫌违反逗留条件。两人仍被拘留接受调查，警方不排除进一步逮捕的可能性。两辆车被扣押接受检查。

警方提醒公众，仅使用有执照的公共交通工具，切勿乘坐非法营运的车辆以获取报酬。他们警告说，如果车辆被用于非法出租，第三方保险可能会失效，从而使乘客和其他道路使用者在发生事故时得不到保护。司机们被敦促不要从事非法出租或带报酬活动。首次定罪可处以最高 10,000 港元罚款及六个月监禁，而第二次定罪可处以最高 25,000 港元罚款及最高一年监禁。被定罪的司机将面临至少 12 个月至最多 3 年的驾驶资格取消，并且他们的车辆执照可能会被吊销。
警方补充，如果涉案车辆属于跨境车辆，运输署将吊销其通行许可证（跨境许可证）。如果涉及中国大陆司机，警方将调查他们是否从事非法就业或违反其他法律，包括停留条件。证据充分就会导致起诉。警方指出，内地执法部门严格规范车辆运营和有偿出租活动。在内地非法营运的司机也将面临调查和检控，警方呼吁所有司机切勿心存侥幸或违法。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Hong Kong police arrested two drivers in an undercover operation targeting illegal cross-border taxi services advertised on social media. Officers posing as passengers booked trips to Shenzhen, paying fees of HK$950 and HK$1,050 before arresting the drivers for carrying passengers for reward without

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

27 Oct 2026 at 19:57 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong police have arrested two drivers in an undercover operation against cross-border illegal taxi services, known as “white plate” cars. A 33-year-old local driver and a 27-year-old mainland Chinese driver holding a two-way permit were detained on 27 October, according to Senior Inspector Sze Sze-ho of the港島總區交通部執行及管制組特遣隊 (Hong Kong Island Regional Traffic Division Enforcement and Control Group Taskforce).

Police said intermediaries for the illegal services used various social media platforms to recruit passengers, offering luxury seven-seater vehicles to travel from Hong Kong to cities in mainland China via land border checkpoints. Officers posed as passengers and contacted two social media accounts requesting trips to Shenzhen. The accounts quoted prices of HK$950 and HK$1,050 respectively, requiring the full fare to be deposited into designated e-wallets before departure.

After the fares were deposited, officers boarded two Hong Kong-registered luxury seven-seater vehicles bearing cross-border number plates on the day of the operation. Once the journeys began, police revealed their identities and arrested both drivers. The local driver was suspected of carrying passengers for reward without a licence and driving without third-party insurance. The mainland driver was additionally suspected of breaching his stay conditions. Both remain in custody for investigation, and police did not rule out further arrests. The two vehicles were seized for examination.

Police reminded the public to use only licensed public transport and not to take vehicles operating illegally for reward. They warned that third-party insurance could be invalidated if a vehicle is used for illegal hire, leaving passengers and other road users unprotected in the event of an accident. Drivers were urged not to engage in illegal hire or reward-carrying activities. A first conviction carries a fine of up to HK$10,000 and six months in jail, while a second conviction can result in a fine of HK$25,000 and up to one year’s imprisonment. Convicted drivers face disqualification from driving for a minimum of 12 months and up to three years, and their vehicle licences may be revoked.

Police added that if the vehicles involved are cross-border vehicles, the Transport Department will revoke their通行許可證 (cross-border permits). Where mainland Chinese drivers are involved, police will investigate whether they are engaged in illegal employment or have breached other laws, including stay conditions. Sufficient evidence would lead to prosecution. Police noted that mainland law enforcement authorities strictly regulate vehicle operations and hire-for-reward activities. Drivers operating illegally on the mainland would also face investigation and prosecution, and police urged all drivers not to take chances or break the law.

[![Image 3: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

[David von Diemar / Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/jM6Y2nhsAtk "https://unsplash.com/photos/jM6Y2nhsAtk")

(File photo)

26 October 2026

[Capital FM (Nairobi)](https://capitalfm.africa/ "Visit Capital FM (Nairobi)")

Nairobi — President William Ruto has mourned the 23 people killed in a road accident at Kanga near Mtito Andei along the Nairobi-Mombasa Highway, calling for greater caution among motorists and stricter safety inspections for public service vehicles (PSVs).

In a condolence message shared on social media, Ruto expressed sympathy with the families and friends of the victims, describing the incident as a devastating loss for the affected families and the country.

"I convey my heartfelt condolences to the families and friends of the 23 people who lost their lives in the tragic road accident," the President said, adding that the country shared in their grief.

He also wished those injured in the crash a quick recovery.

Follow us on [WhatsApp](https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VaIdDi8Bqbr263erhw1K "https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VaIdDi8Bqbr263erhw1K") | [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/allafrica/ "https://www.linkedin.com/company/allafrica/") for the latest headlines

The President urged all motorists, particularly drivers operating public service vehicles, to exercise caution and observe traffic regulations to prevent further loss of life on Kenyan roads.

Ruto further directed relevant authorities to conduct thorough inspections of public service vehicles to ensure they comply with the required safety standards.

The directive comes amid renewed concerns over road safety following the fatal collision at Kanga, near Mtito Andei, on the busy Nairobi-Mombasa Highway.

The President said vehicle inspections should help ensure that public service vehicles meet the required safety standards, as part of efforts to prevent road accidents.

The accident has renewed calls for motorists to adhere to traffic rules and for authorities to strengthen enforcement of road safety regulations.

The Nairobi-Mombasa Highway is a key transport corridor connecting the capital to the Coast, carrying passenger buses, commercial vehicles and private motorists.

Ruto's call places renewed emphasis on responsible driving, compliance with traffic regulations and regular inspections of public service vehicles.

The President's message did not provide further details on the cause of the crash or the condition of those injured.

[Capital FM](https://capitalfm.africa/police-tighten-nairobi-security-with-checkpoints-ahead-of-defiant-saba-saba-protests/ "https://capitalfm.africa/police-tighten-nairobi-security-with-checkpoints-ahead-of-defiant-saba-saba-protests/")

Police setting up checkpoints in Nairobi (file photo)

26 October 2026

Cape Town — Nairobi police arrested several protesters on Monday as officers and demonstrators clashed in running battles across the CBD over rising fuel prices and the cost of living, The Eastleigh Voice [reports](https://eastleighvoice.co.ke/news/416253/several-protesters-arrested-as-police-clash-with-demonstrators-over-fuel-prices-in-nairobi "https://eastleighvoice.co.ke/news/416253/several-protesters-arrested-as-police-clash-with-demonstrators-over-fuel-prices-in-nairobi").

Protesters gathered on Moi Avenue and Kimathi Street despite a heavy police deployment, carrying placards reading 'Remove taxes on fuel'. The protests followed the Energy and Petroleum Regulatory Authority's latest pricing review for the October-November cycle, which pushed petrol in Nairobi to Sh226.96 per litre, diesel to Sh227.76, and kerosene to Sh219.87.

In a letter dated October 22 and received at police headquarters the same day, the Coalition of Human Rights Defenders said the demonstration aimed to highlight the burden of fuel costs on households and businesses. Organisers estimated 500 to 900 participants, and pledged to keep the march orderly and respect the rights of other members of the public.

## Gabon Lifts Social Media Ban

[Facebook](https://allafrica.com/#facebook)[Twitter](https://allafrica.com/#twitter)[WhatsApp](https://allafrica.com/#whatsapp)[Flipboard](https://allafrica.com/#flipboard)[LinkedIn](https://allafrica.com/#linkedin)[Reddit](https://allafrica.com/#reddit)[Email](https://allafrica.com/#email)[Share](https://www.addtoany.com/share#url=https%3A%2F%2Fallafrica.com%2Fstories%2F202610260103.html&title=Gabon%20Lifts%20Social%20Media%20Ban)

[pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/phone-display-apps-applications-292994/ "https://pixabay.com/photos/phone-display-apps-applications-292994/")

(file photo).

26 October 2026

Gabon has[lifted](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c6x2w0ngejneo "https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c6x2w0ngejneo")its eight-month social media ban, which was introduced in February over concerns that online content was fuelling conflict and deepening divisions.

The ban took effect on 17 February, with the High Communication Authority (HAC) saying online content was fuelling conflict and deepening divisions in the country.

The restriction drew widespread criticism, particularly from young people and businesses reliant on platforms such as Facebook, TikTok, YouTube and Instagram. Many users resorted to virtual private networks (VPNs) to bypass the ban.

The ban came at a time when Gabonese President Brice Oligui Nguema faced a wave of social unrest less than a year after his election.

The suspension came amid social unrest, including strikes by teachers and civil servants over pay and working conditions.

The opposition said the suspension was an abuse of power.

zh_title: 国际刑警组织将在香港大会上推动资产追查
summary: 国际刑警组织秘书长瓦尔德西·乌尔基扎 (Valdecy Urquiza) 表示，国际刑警组织第 94 届大会将于 11 月 30 日至 12 月 3 日在香港举行，重点讨论追踪犯罪资产、人工智能相关犯罪和国际警务合作。 [![图片 1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 26 日 06:00 香港时间 · 3 分钟阅读国际刑警组织寻求加强追踪和扣押犯罪资产方面的国际合作，第 94 届会议将讨论一项新能力

香港
国际刑警组织秘书长瓦尔德西·乌尔基扎 (Valdecy Urquiza) 表示，国际刑警组织第 94 届大会将于 11 月 30 日至 12 月 3 日在香港举行，重点讨论追查犯罪资产、人工智能相关犯罪和国际警务合作。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 26 日 06:00 香港时间 · 阅读时间 3 分钟

国际刑警组织秘书长瓦尔德西·乌尔基扎表示，国际刑警组织正在寻求加强追查和扣押犯罪资产方面的国际合作，并将在香港举行的第 94 届大会上讨论新的能力。

大会将于 11 月 30 日至 12 月 3 日在香港举行，来自 196 个成员国的 2,000 多名代表将齐聚一堂，讨论执法重点、全球挑战和国际刑警组织的未来战略。

乌尔奎扎表示：“香港是金融、贸易和数字服务的中心，也是我们将国际执法界聚集在一起的完美地点。”他形容香港是一个积极而忠诚的合作伙伴，并指出从当地警察部队借调到国际刑警组织的警官贡献了专业知识，特别是在金融犯罪调查方面。
香港警务处处长周一鸣表示，大会的筹备工作已于2025年初开始，由政务司司长担任主席的香港特别行政区督导委员会、保安局局长领导的跨部门专责小组以及警务处处长领导的警队工作小组组成三层协调架构。他表示，香港致力于确保会议安全可靠，并利用这次活动加强与海外执法机构的伙伴关系，同时展示香港的安全和举办重大国际活动的能力。

乌尔基扎引用了国际刑警组织的银色通缉令倡议作为该组织希望在大会上推进的新能力的一个例子。该计划的重点是帮助执法机构调查和追踪犯罪组织隐藏在不同司法管辖区的金融资产。国际刑警组织已对该倡议进行了为期两年的试点，并希望成员国予以支持。周还强调了金融调查和预防欺诈的重要性，称诈骗占该市 9 月份报告的犯罪案件的一半左右。他指出国际合作打击金融犯罪的重要性，并指出香港已建立反诈骗平台FRONTIER+，帮助海外合作伙伴追查资金并拦截可疑交易。
与人工智能相关的犯罪是今年大会议程上的另一个问题。乌尔奎扎表示，人工智能使犯罪环境变得更加复杂，使犯罪组织能够到达他们以前无法进入的地区，并以其他犯罪领域未曾见过的规模开展活动。他表示，国际刑警组织正在通过三个领域解决与人工智能相关的犯罪问题：了解犯罪集团如何使用人工智能、帮助执法机构利用人工智能提高调查效率和分析大量数据、以及促进警察负责任地使用人工智能。

乌尔基扎表示，国际刑警组织作为一个技术平台的作用是让其 196 个成员国的警察机构保持联系，并在政治分歧的情况下实现合作。周说香港h

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Interpol's 94th General Assembly in Hong Kong from 30 November to 3 December will focus on tracing criminal assets, AI-related crime and international police cooperation, Secretary-General Valdecy Urquiza said.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

26 Oct 2026 at 06:00 HKT · 3 min read

INTERPOL is seeking to strengthen international cooperation in tracing and seizing criminal assets, with a new capability set to be discussed at its 94th General Assembly in Hong Kong, Secretary-General Valdecy Urquiza said.

The General Assembly will take place from 30 November to 3 December in Hong Kong, bringing more than 2,000 representatives from its 196 member countries to discuss law enforcement priorities, global challenges and INTERPOL's future strategy.

“Hong Kong is a hub for finance, trade, digital services, and is the perfect location for us to bring the international law enforcement community together,” Urquiza said. He described Hong Kong as an active and committed partner, noting that officers seconded from the local police force to INTERPOL had contributed expertise, particularly in financial crime investigations.

Hong Kong Police Commissioner Joe Chow Yat-ming said preparations for the assembly had begun in early 2025, with a three-tier coordination structure comprising the HKSAR Steering Committee chaired by the Chief Secretary for Administration, an Inter-departmental Task Force led by the Secretary for Security, and the Force Working Group headed by the Commissioner of Police. He said the city is committed to ensuring a safe and secure conference and to use the event to strengthen partnerships with overseas law enforcement agencies while showcasing Hong Kong's security and ability to host major international events.

Urquiza cited INTERPOL's Silver Notice initiative as an example of the new capabilities the organisation hopes to advance at the General Assembly. The initiative focuses on helping law enforcement agencies investigate and trace financial assets that criminal organisations hide in different jurisdictions. INTERPOL has conducted a two-year pilot of the initiative and hopes member countries will endorse it. Chow also highlighted the importance of financial investigations and fraud prevention, saying scams accounted for about half of reported crime cases in the city in September. He pointed to the importance of international cooperation in tackling financial crime, noting Hong Kong had established the anti-scam platform FRONTIER+ to help overseas partners trace funds and intercept suspicious transactions.

Artificial-intelligence-related crime is another issue on this year's General Assembly agenda. Urquiza said AI had made the criminal landscape more complex, enabling criminal organisations to reach regions they had previously been unable to access and operate on a scale not seen in other areas of crime. INTERPOL is addressing AI-related crime through three areas: understanding how criminal groups use AI, helping law enforcement agencies use AI to improve investigative efficiency and analyse large amounts of data, and promoting the responsible use of AI by police, he said.

Urquiza said INTERPOL's role as a technical platform was to keep police agencies across its 196 member countries connected and enable cooperation despite political differences. Chow said Hong Kong hoped to strengthen operational and intelligence-sharing ties with Asian counterparts while expanding training and capacity-building cooperation with other regions, including Africa. The force also hoped to provide training for overseas officers and send its own personnel to learn from international partners, he added. Chow said the Hong Kong International Academy of Policing will also be established on 11 November, with the aim of bringing international policing experience to Hong Kong and sharing local expertise with overseas partners.

content:
香港首席财务官：预计到 2030 年，女性将控制大部分财富，重塑投资格局中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 2 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港财政部长：预计到 2030 年女性将控制大部分财富，重塑投资格局
财政司司长陈茂波表示，随着婴儿潮一代的财富转移，到 2030 年，女性将控制大量资本，从而重塑投资重点。他指出，金融领域的女性高层领导比例从 2018 年的 34% 上升至 45%，但职业中期障碍仍然存在。
财政司司长陈茂波周一在 2026 年女性首席执行官峰会上表示，预计到 2030 年，女性将控制大部分财富，从而重塑投资决策和资本流向。
陈指出，仅美国婴儿潮一代就持有约 30 万亿美元（234 万亿港元）的金融资产。他说，随着这些财富逐渐转移给配偶和年轻一代，到本世纪末，女性将掌握大部分资本。
陈补充说，随着财富易手，投资重点将相应改变，要求金融机构适应新一代的目标，而不是依赖过去的模式。
他还强调了女性在金融领导层中的代表性方面取得的进展，并援引一项联合研究显示，在接受调查的金融机构中，女性占据了 45% 的高级领导职位，高于 2018 年的 34%。陈表示，尽管取得了这些进展，但职业障碍仍然存在，特别是对于职业中期女性而言。他强调需要扩大领导机会并利用多元化人才来帮助机构应对变革。
渣打银行香港及大中华区及北亚区首席执行官兼峰会倡导工作流程联席负责人禤惠仪表示，女性首席执行官峰会已从八年前的一小群金融界女性成员发展成为一个连接香港金融业60多名女性首席执行官的网络。 Huen 概述了该网络的四个核心支柱：宣传、人才、教育和社区参与。主要举措包括支持女性高管的职业发展、将大学生与金融领袖联系起来以及帮助中学生探索职业道路。
“成为领导者并不意味着我们要把年轻时的自己抛在后面，”瑞银全球财富管理亚洲区主席兼瑞银香港区总裁兼首席执行官卢彩云 (Amy Lo Choi-wan) 表示，她也是倡导工作组的联合领导者。罗表示，形成性经验继续塑造领导力历程，强调集体学习与合作在管理行业转型中的重要作用。

Women expected to control major share of wealth by 2030, reshaping investment: Hong Kong finance chief | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 2 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Women expected to control major share of wealth by 2030, reshaping investment: Hong Kong finance chief
Financial Secretary Paul Chan said women will control a substantial share of capital by 2030 as baby boomer wealth transfers, reshaping investment priorities. He noted female senior leadership in finance rose to 45% from 34% in 2018, but mid-career barriers remain.
Women are expected to control a substantial share of wealth by 2030, reshaping investment decisions and where capital is directed, Financial Secretary Paul Chan Mo-po said at the Women Chief Executives Summit 2026 on Monday.
Chan noted that the baby boomer generation in the United States alone holds some US$30 trillion (HK$234 trillion) in financial assets. As this wealth gradually passes to spouses and younger generations, women will command a major share of capital by the end of the decade, he said.
As wealth changes hands, investment priorities will shift accordingly, requiring financial institutions to adapt to the goals of a new generation rather than relying on past models, Chan added.
He also highlighted progress in women's representation within financial leadership, citing a joint study showing that women held 45 per cent of senior leadership positions in surveyed financial institutions, up from 34 per cent in 2018. Despite these gains, career barriers remain, particularly for mid-career women, Chan said, emphasising the need to widen leadership access and draw on diverse talent to help institutions navigate change.
The Women Chief Executives Summit has developed from a small group of women in finance eight years ago into a network connecting more than 60 women chief executives across Hong Kong's financial industry, according to Mary Huen Wai-yi, chief executive officer of Hong Kong and Greater China and North Asia at Standard Chartered and co-lead of the summit's Advocacy Workstream. Huen outlined the network's four core pillars: advocacy, talent, education, and community engagement. Key initiatives include supporting women executives' career progression, linking university students with financial leaders, and helping secondary students explore career paths.
“Becoming leaders doesn't mean we leave our younger self behind,” said Amy Lo Choi-wan, chairman of UBS Global Wealth Management Asia and head and chief executive of UBS Hong Kong, who also co-leads the Advocacy Workstream. Lo said that formative experiences continue to shape leadership journeys, underscoring the vital role of collective learning and cooperation in managing industry transformation.

summary: 香港 香港政府将于 10 月 29 日发布一份关于大埔鸿福苑火灾的独立报告，并宣布改革措施，包括将建筑物维修中的串通投标定为刑事犯罪，最高可判处 10 年监禁。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 28 日 10:23 HKT · 2 分钟阅读《香港报》政府将于 10 月 29 日星期五发布期待已久的独立委员会调查去年的报告
content:
香港
香港政府将于10月29日发布一份关于大埔鸿福苑火灾的独立报告，并宣布改革措施，包括将建筑物维修中的串通投标定为刑事犯罪，最高可判处10年监禁。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 28 日 10:23 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

据政府消息人士称，香港政府将于 10 月 29 日星期五公布期待已久的独立委员会调查去年大埔鸿福苑致命火灾的报告。该报告于 10 月 22 日提交给政府。

行政长官李家超预计将于周五主持新闻发布会，宣布一揽子改革措施，以回应该委员会的建议。政府计划连续两天举行简报会，详细说明将如何实施改革并堵塞建筑维护法规的漏洞。
其中一项关键提案是将建筑维护合同中的串通投标行为定为刑事犯罪——这种做法在当地被称为“wai biu”。竞争委员会此前曾建议将此类串通定为刑事犯罪，最高可判处七年监禁，一些消息来源表明，刑罚可能最高可达 10 年。政府的改革方案将包括立法取缔建筑维护工程中的串通投标行为。

改革还将加强对参与大型建筑维修的承包商和专业人员的监督。消息人士称，政府将提议修订《建筑物条例》，从目前的行业自律模式转向主动的政府监管，包括加强审计和检查。政府还将研究提高对违规行为的最高处罚力度，并提高建筑和消防安全标准。

为确保改革有效实施，政府将成立一个由政务司司长担任主席的督导委员会，负责监察和跟进委员会的建议。
该独立委员会是行政长官去年12月在鸿福苑火灾后成立的。委员会举行了 30 场听证会，听取了 80 名事实证人、专家证人和当事人法律代表的口头证词，并考虑了不同个人和组织的书面陈述和其他证据，以查明事件事实。
