title: Cyberport Venture & Capital Forum to spotlight AI, digital assets and OPCs
zh_title: 数码港风险与资本论坛聚焦人工智能、数字资产和 OPC
summary: 香港数码港将于 11 月 4 日至 5 日举行的年度风险与资本论坛将重点关注人工智能、数字资产和个人公司。该活动旨在帮助初创企业和投资者克服融资和市场扩张障碍，凸显香港作为连接中国内地、东盟和中东地区的门户[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 26 日 20:52 香港时间 · 更新于 10 月 27 日，04:26 · 阅读 2 分钟 人工智能、数字资产等
content:
香港
数码港将于 11 月 4 日至 5 日举行的年度风险与资本论坛将重点关注人工智能、数字资产和个人公司。该活动旨在帮助初创企业和投资者克服融资和市场拓展障碍，凸显香港作为连接中国内地、东盟和中东的门户

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 26 日，香港时间 20:52 · 更新于 10 月 27 日，04:26 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

组织者周一表示，人工智能、数字资产和个人公司（OPC）将成为[数码港](https://clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Six-charged-over-HK-20m-digital-grant-fraud-involving-Cyberp-21d5e8)风险与资本论坛的重点关注点，该论坛将于11月4日至5日在数码港举行，与会者将探讨新兴市场机遇和全球扩张战略。

据 Cyber​​port 称，该论坛的主题是“在不断变化的世界中扩展：赢得下一个竞争周期”，将汇集全球投资者和企业家，讨论企业和代理人工智能、OPC 和前沿技术。该活动旨在帮助初创企业和投资者突破融资和市场拓展障碍，抓住新的市场机遇。
数码港表示，香港还将凸显其作为连接中国内地、东盟、中东、全球创新和融资网络的战略门户的独特地位。

数码港强调，其初创企业去年筹集了 745 亿港元的资金，有 481 家公司加入，展现了强劲的筹款表现。年内，数码港共有 19 家公司成功上市，并新增两家独角兽公司。

数码港行政总裁郑崇智表示：“随着全球创新和资本市场加速重塑，人工智能、数据技术和新兴产业已成为推动经济增长的重要引擎。”

Cyber​​port 表示，最近的高价值融资轮包括 Finloop、Qupital、Premialab 和 Buy&Ship，其中许多都利用了人工智能、区块链和数字资产。

CIN指导集团主席、中手游科技联合创办人兼弘昌资本董事长冼亨德里表示：“数码港投资者网络（CIN）今年已迈入九周年，我们的网络由超过240名全球投资者组成，已成功促成超过133个项目配对，金额超过60亿港元，较去年增加超过19个项目。”
今年的论坛将继续举办广受欢迎的“投资者配对”环节，根据投资者和初创企业的技术重点和投资偏好，与他们进行面对面和在线配对。其他亮点包括 80 多个实体展示摊位、资助者力量推介、初创诊所和研讨会，为与会者提供实用见解和战略建议。

数码港与戈壁创投和泰国国家创新局等国际合作伙伴也将于当天签署一份谅解备忘录。另一个亮点将是代理经济峰会，汇聚人工智能先驱、监管机构和金融巨头，探讨数字身份、机构代币化、港元稳定币发行、可编程支付和机器对机器商务如何构建未来的金融轨道。

[![图3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/e

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Cyberport's annual Venture & Capital Forum on November 4-5 will focus on AI, digital assets and one-person companies. The event aims to help start-ups and investors overcome financing and market expansion barriers, highlighting Hong Kong as a gateway connecting mainland China, ASEAN and the Middle E

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

26 Oct 2026 at 20:52 HKT · updated 27 Oct, 04:26 · 2 min read

Artificial intelligence, digital assets and one-person companies (OPCs) will be key focuses at the [Cyberport](https://clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Six-charged-over-HK-20m-digital-grant-fraud-involving-Cyberp-21d5e8) Venture & Capital Forum, to be held on November 4-5 at Cyberport, where participants will explore emerging market opportunities and global expansion strategies, the organiser said on Monday.

Themed “Scaling in a Changing World: Winning the Next Competitive Cycle,” the forum will bring together global investors and entrepreneurs to discuss enterprise and agentic AI, OPCs and frontier technology, according to Cyberport. The event aims to empower start-ups and investors to break through financing and market expansion barriers, seizing new market opportunities.

Hong Kong will also spotlight its unique position as a strategic gateway connecting the Chinese mainland, ASEAN, the Middle East, global innovation and funding networks, Cyberport said.

Cyberport highlighted that its start-ups raised HK$74.5 billion in funding last year, demonstrating robust fundraising performance with 481 companies joining the community. During the year, 19 Cyberport companies successfully listed, alongside the addition of two new unicorns.

“As global innovation and capital markets undergo accelerated reshaping, AI, data technology, and emerging industries have become crucial engines driving economic growth,” said Cyberport’s chief executive Rocky Cheng.

Recent high-value fundraising rounds include Finloop, Qupital, Premialab and Buy&Ship, many of which leverage AI, blockchain and digital assets, Cyberport said.

“Cyberport Investors Network (CIN) has come to its 9th anniversary this year, and our network of over 240 global investors has successfully facilitated more than HK$6 billion across over 133 project matchings, representing an increase of over 19 projects compared to last year,” said Hendrick Sin, CIN Steering Group’s chairman, CMGE Technology’s co-founder and China Prosperity Capital’s chairman.

This year’s forum will continue to feature the popular “Investor Matching” session for face-to-face and online pairing with investors and start-ups, based on their technological focus and investment preferences. Additional highlights include over 80 physical showcase booths, funder power pitches, a start-up clinic and workshop, providing attendees with practical insights and strategic advice.

Cyberport and international partners, including Gobi Partners and Thailand’s National Innovation Agency, will also sign a memorandum of understanding on the day. Another highlight will be the Agentic Economy Summit, bringing together AI pioneers, regulators and financial giants to examine how digital identity, institutional tokenisation, HKD stablecoin issuance, programmable payments and machine-to-machine commerce are building the financial rails of the future.

[![Image 3: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

Editor in Chief

# 2026 ELECTIONS/Chiang, Shen speak out after entertainer's 'Taiwan independence' statement

10/26/2026 05:37 PM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

[Link](javascript:)[Whatsapp](javascript:)[Reddit](javascript:)[Line](javascript:)[Email](javascript:)

To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.

Entertainer Kevin Tsai (center) attends the opening of Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an's reelection campaign headquarters on Monday. CNA photo Oct. 26, 2026

Taipei, Oct. 26 (CNA) Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an (蔣萬安) and mayoral candidate Puma Shen (沈伯洋) responded Monday after entertainer Kevin Tsai (蔡康永) issued a statement disavowing "Taiwan independence" amid suspected pressure from China.

In a post on his Weibo and Xiaohongshu accounts Sunday, Tsai, a well-known television host, said "I have always hoped for friendly exchanges across the Taiwan Strait. I have never supported Taiwan independence."

In the post, written in Simplified Chinese, the 64-year-old Tsai explained that he had recently attended "various events" to conduct interviews and gather material for his work.

He said that since becoming a host in 1998, he had interviewed over 10,000 people holding a range of views, and that conducting an interview does not equate to endorsing a guest's views.

In the post, Tsai also apologized for "misunderstandings" that had caused trouble for his collaborators and supporters. Even if a relationship has now ended, he said, he remained grateful for every connection and bond that has allowed him to be seen and heard.

Tsai made the post after his attendance at a campaign event for Puma Shen -- the Democratic Progressive Party's (DPP) candidate for Taipei mayor and a prominent critic of Beijing -- drew backlash from China earlier this month.

Tsai (in white hat) attends a campaign event for Puma Shen. CNA photo Oct. 4, 2026

Following the event, a Weibo account affiliated with China's People's Liberation Army criticized a "Taiwanese public figure" for attending a rally for Shen, saying that there is "no room for ambiguity" on "Taiwan independence."

It also warned that those who profited from the Chinese market while "flirting with Taiwan independence" would eventually "pay a price too heavy to bear."

In local media, Tsai's post on Sunday was widely compared to a 2016 incident in which Taiwanese K-pop star Tzuyu (周子瑜) issued a video publicly apologizing for holding a Republic of China (Taiwan) flag on television.

## Taipei mayor candidates respond

On Monday morning, Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an of the Kuomintang (KMT) told reporters that he welcomed Tsai's scheduled attendance at the opening of his campaign headquarters later that day.

Regardless of whether Tsai or any other citizen supports him, Chiang said, he respects their opinions and is committed to serving them as mayor.

Chiang also criticized the tendency to attack, boycott or ostracize people because of their differing political views. "I absolutely will not permit or accept such anti-democratic intimidation," he said.

Shen, meanwhile, said Taiwanese people are free to attend whatever events they wish, and should not be subject to "intervention" by China.

Chiang (left) and Shen (right). CNA composite photo

Responding to a question at a press conference, Shen said Tsai had already explained, after attending his rally, that he had been going to various events to interview politicians and understand their policy proposals.

"As far as Taiwanese people are concerned, such activities are entirely normal, and the fact that China would intervene in this way is deeply distressing," Shen said.

Kevin Tsai co-hosted the popular Taiwanese talk show Kangsi Coming (康熙來了) from 2004 to 2016.

Taiwan will hold its 2026 local elections on Nov. 28.

(By Yang Shu-min, Huang Li-yun, Wang Hsin-yu and Matthew Mazzetta)

title: Lawmaker questions whether proposed HK$100,000 fines for private hospitals will deter hidden fees
zh_title: 立法会议员质疑对私家医院罚款10万港元是否能阻止隐性收费
summary: 一名香港立法会议员质疑政府提高香港私营医疗保健提供者价格透明度的提议所规定的罚款是否太低，无法起到有效的威慑作用。新民党议员何鸿燊对 2026 年 2 月 25 日的预算案作出回应。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。根据卫生部长罗仲茂周五向立法会提交的拟议法案，私人医疗服务提供者将被要求在接待处和收银台提供双语价目表。他们还必须在治疗前向患者提供预算估算
content:
一名香港立法会议员质疑政府提高香港私营医疗保健提供者价格透明度的提议所规定的罚款是否太低，无法起到有效的威慑作用。新民党议员何鸿燊对 2026 年 2 月 25 日的预算案作出回应。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。根据卫生部长罗仲茂周五向立法会提交的拟议法案，私人医疗服务提供者将被要求在接待处和收银台提供双语价目表。他们还必须在具体治疗和手术之前向患者提供预算估算，并在患者的账单比原始估算高出 20% 或更多时提供解释。新规定将适用于所有私人诊所、医院和保健中心。不遵守规定的私家医院每次违规最高可被罚款10万港元。对于日间手术中心和诊所，罚款最高可达 25,000 港元。建制派新民党议员何鸿燊向立法会部长表示，拟议的罚款可能太低，不足以对私立医院产生威慑作用。何说，一些私立医院，例如“跑马地一家”——可能是指养和医院——赚取“巨额利润”，10万港元对他们来说只是一笔小钱。卫生局局长罗仲茂。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。
何先生用粤语说：“即使罚款10次，也只是100万港元，这对他们来说只是零钱。”对此，卫生局长表示，将根据具体情况开出罚单。 “如果一家大医院看诊人数较多，多次被罚款，累计罚款金额就相当可观了。”罗用粤语说。无价格上限 除了向患者提供价格信息和预算估算外，拟议的法案还将要求私立医院向卫生部提交与特定治疗和程序相关的账单统计数据和数据。持有执照的私立医院还必须公布历史账单统计数据，包括出院情况、住院时间中位数、住院费用和医生费用。罗告诉立法者，政府不会考虑限制私人医疗机构的收费，因为如果价格太高，患者可以去其他地方。香港中文大学医院是一家新私立医院，于 2021 年开业。照片：Wai Ki Wong/Google 地图。政府在提案中表示，新规定还将考虑医疗服务的性质——治疗过程中可能出现不可预见的临床因素，从而产生难以提前预测的医疗费用。
如果机构发现无法提供预算估算（例如，在需要立即护理的突发医疗紧急情况期间），则应在治疗后 48 小时内向患者或其代表提供固定的服务价格。

【原文 English Original】
A Hong Kong lawmaker has questioned whether fines under a government proposal to increase price transparency among the city’s private healthcare providers are too low to serve as an effective deterrent. Lawmaker Adrian Ho of the New People’s Party responds to the budget address on February 25, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Under the proposed bill introduced to the Legislative Council by health minister Lo Chung-mau on Friday, private healthcare providers will be required to provide a bilingual price list at reception desks and cashier counters. They must also give patients budget estimates before specific treatments and procedures and provide an explanation if patients’ bills are 20 per cent or more above the original estimate. The new rules will apply to all private clinics, hospitals, and health centres. Private hospitals that do not comply will see a maximum fine of HK$100,000 for each violation. For day procedure centres and clinics, this penalty falls to a maximum fine of HK$25,000. Adrian Ho, a lawmaker with the pro-establishment New People’s Party, told the minister in LegCo that the proposed fines might be too low to have a deterrent effect on private hospitals. Ho said some private hospitals, such as “one in Happy Valley” – likely a reference to the Hong Kong Sanatorium & Hospital – earn “massive profits” and HK$100,000 is a small sum for them. Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “Even if they are fined 10 times, that’s just HK$1 million, which is just loose change for them,” Ho said in Cantonese. In response, the health chief said penalty tickets would be issued on a per-case basis. “If a major hospital sees a high volume of patients and is fined repeatedly, the cumulative fines can add up to a substantial sum,” Lo said in Cantonese. No price cap Apart from providing price information and budget estimates to patients, the proposed bill will also require private hospitals to submit statistics on billing and figures related to specific treatments and procedures to the Department of Health. Licensed private hospitals will also have to publish historical billing statistics including discharges, median lengths of stay, hospital fees, and medical practitioners’ fees. Lo told legislators that the government is not considering capping the prices charged by private healthcare facilities, since patients can simply go elsewhere if prices are too high. CUHK Medical Centre, a new private hospital opened in 2021. Photo: Wai Ki Wong/Google Maps. The government said in its proposal that the new rules will also take into account the nature of healthcare services – unforeseeable clinical factors may arise during treatment and necessitate medical charges that are difficult to predict in advance. In cases where a facility finds it impractical to provide budget estimates – for example, during sudden medical emergencies that require immediate care – it should provide a fixed price for the service to the patient or their representative within 48 hours of treatment.

content:
澳门将于12月16日公布2027年施政报告；居民希望获得现金援助，立法者敦促明显的优势|中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 2 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
澳门将于12月16日公布2027年施政报告；居民希望获得现金援助，立法者敦促独特的优势
澳门行政长官岑浩辉将于12月16日发表2027年施政报告和财政预算案。居民和小企业希望继续发放现金和消费券，而立法者则呼吁在新兴产业上与香港和中国内地进行更明确的区分。
据香港电台报道，澳门行政长官岑厚辉将于 12 月 16 日向立法会提交 2027 年施政报告和财政预算案。许多居民和中小微企业经营者希望政府继续采取现金发放、医疗券、消费券等措施来提振经济。
直选议员、澳门工会联合总会常务副主席梁善玉表示，他担心政府将如何保护本地就业。他还表示，政府应该考虑推进澳门与横琴的一体化，以及如何让投入横琴的资源能够回报特区财政的红利，实现共建共享。
立法会议员、科技界人士周家俊表示，澳门在发展高科技产业、特色金融、中医药、大健康等新兴产业方面有自己的优势。不过，他强调需要突出与香港和内地的差异，避免将其优势变成口号。他补充说，政府应该量入为出，用公帑来帮助那些真正需要帮助的人。

Macau to unveil 2027 policy address on 16 December; residents hope for cash handouts, lawmakers urge distinct advantages
Macau Chief Executive Sam Hou-fai will deliver the 2027 policy address and budget on 16 December. Residents and small businesses hope for continued cash handouts and consumption vouchers, while lawmakers call for clearer differentiation from Hong Kong and mainland China in emerging industries.
Macau Chief Executive Sam Hou-fai will deliver the 2027 policy address and budget to the Legislative Assembly on 16 December, according to RTHK. Many residents and operators of micro, small and medium-sized enterprises are hoping the government will continue measures such as cash handouts, medical vouchers and consumption vouchers to boost the economy.
Leong Son-iok, a directly elected lawmaker and permanent deputy chair of the Macau Federation of Trade Unions, said he is concerned about how the government will protect local employment. He also said the government should consider advancing the integration of Macau and Hengqin, and how resources invested in Hengqin can return dividends to the special administrative region's finances, achieving co-construction and sharing.
Chau Ka-chun, a lawmaker appointed to the Legislative Assembly who works in the technology sector, said Macau has its own advantages in developing high-tech industries, specialty finance and traditional Chinese medicine and big health as emerging sectors. However, he stressed the need to highlight differences with Hong Kong and mainland China to avoid turning its advantages into mere slogans. He added that the government should live within its means and use public money to help those who truly need it.

香港根据内地与香港法律协议寻求仲裁机构申请中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 2 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港根据内地与香港法律协议寻求仲裁机构申请
香港律政司邀请仲裁机构申请成为2019年内地与香港仲裁临时措施安排下的指定机构。申请必须在 2026 年 12 月 1 日之前提交。
香港律政司（律政司）已根据《香港特别行政区律政司与中华人民共和国最高人民法院关于仲裁程序相互协助保全的安排》展开新一轮指定仲裁机构和常设机构的申请。
该安排于 2019 年 4 月签署，允许在香港进行仲裁并由合格的指定机构或常设办事处管理的仲裁的当事人向中国内地法院申请临时措施，包括资产或证据保全。
有兴趣的仲裁机构可向司法部提交申请，成为该协议下的指定机构或常设办事处。被授予任命的人的认可期限为自任命之日起三年。
所有申请和支持文件必须以书面形式（通过邮寄或电子邮件）提交给司法部民法司的替代性争议解决 (ADR) 团队。提交截止日期为 2026 年 12 月 1 日。
申请须邮寄至：香港中环下亚厘毕道 18 号律政中心东翼 2 楼律政司民法科替代性争议解决小组。如有疑问，可通过电话（3902 8825 或 3902 8889）或电子邮件（[email protected]）联系 ADR 团队。
香港政府于2026年11月2日发布上述公告。

Hong Kong seeks applications for arbitration institutions under Mainland-HK legal pact | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 2 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong seeks applications for arbitration institutions under Mainland-HK legal pact
Hong Kong's Department of Justice invites applications from arbitration bodies to become designated institutions under the 2019 Mainland-Hong Kong arrangement on interim measures in arbitration. Applications must be submitted by 1 December 2026.
Hong Kong's Department of Justice (DoJ) has opened a new round of applications for arbitration institutions and permanent offices seeking designation under the Arrangement between the Department of Justice of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and the Supreme People's Court of the People's Republic of China on Mutual Assistance in Interim Measures in Connection with Arbitral Proceedings.
The arrangement, signed in April 2019, allows parties in arbitrations seated in Hong Kong and administered by qualified designated institutions or permanent offices to apply to Mainland Chinese courts for interim measures, including preservation of assets or evidence.
Interested arbitration bodies may submit applications to the DoJ to become designated institutions or permanent offices under the pact. Those granted designation will be recognised for a period of three years from the date of appointment.
All applications and supporting documents must be submitted in writing, either by post or email, to the DoJ's Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) team in the Civil Law Division. The deadline for submissions is 1 December 2026.
Applications should be addressed to: Alternative Dispute Resolution Team, Civil Law Division, Department of Justice, 2/F, East Wing, Justice Centre, 18 Lower Albert Road, Central, Hong Kong. Enquiries can be directed to the ADR team by telephone (3902 8825 or 3902 8889) or email ([email protected]).
The announcement was made on 2 November 2026 by the Hong Kong government.

content:
香港FPS将与银联联动 跨境二维码支付覆盖40个市场 |中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 2 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港FPS将与银联联动 跨境二维码支付覆盖40个市场
香港转数快支付系统（FPS）将与银联国际合作，支持香港、中国内地以及40多个海外市场的二维码支付，覆盖超过1亿商户。
香港财政司司长陈茂波在香港金融科技周上宣布，香港快速支付系统（FPS）将与银联国际合作，在香港、中国内地以及40多个海外市场提供二维码支付，覆盖超过1亿商户。陈表示，该举措旨在促进跨境交易。
陈先生表示，FPS注册人数已超过2200万，去年通过该系统的港币支付日均金额达162亿港元。 FPS已经连接到中国大陆和泰国的系统。
陈强调，提高效率取决于连接金融系统，而不是简单地加速单个系统。支付网络互通让公众可以在更多地方使用熟悉的服务进行支付，而商户也可以更轻松地接收跨境支付。将代币化资产与数字货币连接可以提高交易和结算效率。
针对全球未满足的 2.5 万亿美元贸易融资需求，陈表示，香港正在利用商业数据来弥补中小企业 (SME) 抵押品的不足。商业数据交换 (CDI) 于 2022 年推出，已协助超过 125,000 笔中小企业贷款申请和审批，涉及信贷额估计达 1,100 亿港元。
陈补充说，效率和金融包容性都依赖于信任。代币化资产的二级市场流动性仍待建立，稳定币的大规模应用仍在测试中。他表示，金融科技不应停留在试点阶段，而应使企业日常收款、融资以及向海外供应商付款更加快捷、可靠。政府将提供明确的规则和可靠的基础设施，鼓励行业应用，造福企业和公众。

Hong Kong's FPS to link with UnionPay for cross-border QR payments across 40 markets | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 2 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong's FPS to link with UnionPay for cross-border QR payments across 40 markets
Hong Kong's Faster Payment System (FPS) will partner with UnionPay International to support QR code payments in Hong Kong, mainland China, and over 40 overseas markets, covering more than 100 million merchants.
Hong Kong's Financial Secretary Paul Chan Mo-po announced at the Hong Kong Fintech Week that the city's Faster Payment System (FPS) will collaborate with UnionPay International to enable QR code payments across Hong Kong, mainland China and more than 40 overseas markets, covering over 100 million merchants. Chan said the initiative aims to facilitate cross-border transactions.
Chan said FPS registrations have exceeded 22 million, and the average daily value of Hong Kong dollar payments through the system reached HK$16.2 billion last year. The FPS already connects to systems in mainland China and Thailand.
Chan stressed that improving efficiency depends on connecting financial systems rather than simply accelerating individual systems. Payment network interoperability allows the public to use familiar services to pay in more places, while merchants can more easily receive cross-border payments. Connecting tokenised assets with digital currencies can enhance transaction and settlement efficiency.
Addressing the global unmet trade finance demand of US$2.5 trillion, Chan said Hong Kong is using commercial data to compensate for small and medium-sized enterprises' (SMEs) lack of collateral. The Commercial Data Interchange (CDI), launched in 2022, has facilitated over 125,000 SME loan applications and approvals, involving an estimated HK$110 billion in credit.
Chan added that both efficiency and financial inclusion rely on trust. Secondary market liquidity for tokenised assets still needs to be established, and large-scale application of stablecoins remains under testing. He said fintech should not remain at the pilot stage but should make businesses' daily collections, financing and payments to overseas suppliers faster and more reliable. The government will provide clear rules and reliable infrastructure to encourage industry applications that benefit businesses and the public.

content:
警方警告假旅行社出售旅游团和音乐会门票中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 2 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
警方警告假旅行社出售旅游团和音乐会门票
香港警方警告公众，诈骗者冒充持牌旅行社出售低价旅游团和音乐会门票。骗徒复制机构名称及标志，推销虚假套餐，包括港币20,999元的云南西藏之旅及刘德华演唱会门票。
香港警方警告公众，冒充持牌旅行社出售低价旅游套餐和音乐会门票的虚假社交媒体页面和网站激增。据《星岛日报》报道，骗子复制了至少两家当地旅行社的名称、标志和行程，以推销欺诈性旅行，其中包括价值 20,999 港元的云南-西藏旅游团和价值 39,999 港元的澳大利亚套票。
诈骗网页亦以歌迷为目标，提供刘德华演唱会门票，声称杜绝黄牛，并在门票价格基础上只收取港币50元服务费，诱骗市民转账。当一名冒充客户的记者联系其中一个页面时，卖家提供了一份为期两天的澳门经济套餐，其中包括酒店住宿、回程交通、自助餐以及水舞间和水上乐园的门票。卖家向记者施压，要求其快速付款，理由是可用性有限，并提供了快速支付系统（FPS）和银行账户详细信息。
两家受影响的旅行社已在脸书上发布警告。一家机构表示，诈骗者复制了其行程，并强调该机构仅接受通过公司账户付款。另一家机构指出，虚假账户使用其公司全名，并敦促消费者使用官方渠道，并向平台和警方举报任何冒充行为。一家机构的发言人表示，已收到两名顾客的询问，但尚未向警方报案。该机构已通知其管理层和旅游业管理局。
今年首8个月警方共接获6,973宗网上购物诈骗案，损失总额达2.3亿港元。他们建议消费者从信誉良好的卖家处购买，考虑面对面交易，并在付款前检查卖家的联系方式、付款账户和页面名称。任何怀疑受骗的人应立即停止交易，拨打反诈骗热线18222，并保留相关记录以便向警方报案。公众还可以使用 Scameter 网站或移动应用程序检查可疑帐户名称、电话号码、付款详细信息、电子邮件地址和 URL。

Police warn of fake travel agencies selling tours and concert tickets | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 2 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Police warn of fake travel agencies selling tours and concert tickets
Hong Kong police have warned the public about scammers impersonating licensed travel agencies to sell cut-price tours and concert tickets. Fraudsters have replicated agency names and logos to promote fake packages, including a HK$20,999 Yunnan-Tibet trip and Andy Lau concert tickets.
Hong Kong police have warned the public about a surge of fake social media pages and websites impersonating licensed travel agencies to sell cut-price tour packages and concert tickets. Scammers have replicated the names, logos and itineraries of at least two local travel agencies to promote fraudulent trips, including a HK$20,999 Yunnan-Tibet tour and a HK$39,999 Australia package, according to Sing Tao Daily.
Fraudulent pages have also targeted fans by offering tickets to Andy Lau Tak-wah concerts, claiming to eliminate scalpers and asking for only a HK$50 service fee on top of the ticket price to trick citizens into transferring money. When a reporter posing as a client contacted one of the pages, the seller offered a budget two-day Macau package that included hotel accommodation, return transport, buffet meals and tickets to House of Dancing Water and a water park. The seller pressured the reporter to make a quick payment, citing limited availability and providing both Faster Payment System (FPS) and bank account details.
The two affected travel agencies have posted warnings on Facebook. One agency stated scammers had copied its itineraries and stressed that it only accepts payments through corporate accounts. The other agency noted that fake accounts were using its full company name and urged consumers to use official channels and report any impersonation to both the platforms and police. A spokesperson for one agency said it had received inquiries from two customers but had not yet filed a police report. The agency had notified its management and the Travel Industry Authority.
Police recorded 6,973 online shopping scams in the first eight months of the year, with losses totalling HK$230 million. They advised consumers to buy from reputable sellers, consider face-to-face transactions and check sellers' contact details, payment accounts and page names before paying. Anyone who suspects a scam should stop the transaction, call the Anti-Scam Helpline on 18222 and keep relevant records for a police report. The public can also use the Scameter website or mobile app to check suspicious account names, phone numbers, payment details, email addresses and URLs.

香港部长在大湾区颁奖典礼上赞扬女企业家 |中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 2 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港特区行政长官在大湾区颁奖典礼上赞扬女企业家
香港商务部长在2026年大湾区杰出女企业家奖上赞扬女性企业家，强调她们在创新和市场拓展方面的作用。她指出政府在“十五五”规划和新的地方五年计划下的支持，以促进业务增长
香港商务及经济发展局局长于11月2日在2026年大湾区杰出女企业家奖颁奖典礼上致辞，庆祝女商界领袖的成就。国务卿赞扬获奖者推动创新、开拓新领域和拓展市场，强调了女性在商业中的重要作用。
该活动由香港中小企业协会和新城广播公司主办，旨在表彰来自不同背景和发展阶段的女企业家。秘书强调了她们对创业、企业管理和社会责任的贡献，称她们是女性进入商界的灵感来源。
局长注意到香港的新发展阶段，表示政府于 2026 年 9 月发布了香港第一个五年规划，与国家“十五五”规划的优先事项保持一致。她表示，《规划》为企业开拓市场、拓展经营、增强竞争力提供了方向。
今年的《施政报告》提出深化内地企业海外专责小组，自2025年成立以来，已协助超过300家内地企业在香港设立或拓展业务。司长鼓励本地企业利用行业经验和创新管理，与这些企业合作，创造共同进入国际市场的机会。
她表示，粤港澳大湾区跨城市优势互补、市场广阔，为女性创业者提供了更广阔的前景。政府继续通过商务及经济发展局支持中小企业，促进贸易、市场准入、数字化转型和运营效率。
秘书最后重申女企业家是创新和社会进步的推动者，敦促她们抓住香港和大湾区的机遇，保持经济活力。

Monday, 2 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong minister praises women entrepreneurs at Greater Bay Area awards
Hong Kong's commerce minister lauded female entrepreneurs at the 2026 Greater Bay Area Outstanding Women Entrepreneur Awards, highlighting their role in innovation and market expansion. She noted government support under the 15th Five-Year Plan and a new local five-year plan to boost business growth
Hong Kong's Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development addressed the Greater Bay Area Outstanding Women Entrepreneur Awards 2026 on 2 November, celebrating the achievements of female business leaders. The secretary praised awardees for driving innovation, breaking new ground and expanding markets, underscoring the significant role of women in commerce.
The event, organised by the Hong Kong Small and Medium Enterprises Association and Metro Broadcast Corporation, recognises women entrepreneurs from diverse backgrounds and stages of development. The secretary highlighted their contributions to entrepreneurship, corporate management and social responsibility, calling them an inspiration for women entering business.
Noting Hong Kong's new development phase, the secretary said the government released the city's first five-year plan in September 2026, aligning with national 15th Five-Year Plan priorities. The plan, she said, offers enterprises directions for discovering new markets, expanding operations and enhancing competitiveness.
This year's Policy Address proposed deepening the Mainland Enterprises Overseas Taskforce, which has helped over 300 mainland firms set up or expand in Hong Kong since its launch in 2025. The secretary encouraged local enterprises to leverage their industry experience and innovative management to partner with these firms, creating mutual opportunities for international market access.
The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, she added, provides broader prospects for women entrepreneurs, with complementary advantages across cities and a large market. The government continues to support small and medium enterprises through the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau, promoting trade, market access, digital transformation and operational efficiency.
The secretary concluded by reaffirming women entrepreneurs as drivers of innovation and social progress, urging them to seize opportunities in Hong Kong and the Greater Bay Area to sustain economic vitality.

content:
香港订购多栋建筑项目分阶段进行外墙维修中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 2 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港要求对多栋建筑项目进行分阶段外墙维修
香港屋宇署要求未来涉及多于一栋建筑物的大型维修工程必须分阶段进行外墙维修。专业人士和承包商必须确保楼梯和电梯大堂的窗户在施工期间关闭。自 12 月以来，独立检查员发出了 24 次纠正警告
香港屋宇署署长已发出通函，要求日后涉及多于一栋建筑物的大型修葺工程必须分阶段进行外墙修葺工程。在此类工程中，建筑专业人士和承包商必须确保楼梯或电梯大堂的窗户安全关闭。
房屋局向立法会房屋事务委员会提交文件，指出部分旧楼宇的楼梯或电梯大堂仍保留可开启的窗户。政府应发布临时警告通知，确保窗户关闭，并从长远考虑是否应更换为密封防火窗。屋宇署署长上周四向专业人士和承包商发出了通函。
另外，自去年12月起，独立检查小组已加强巡查辖区内正在进行大型修葺工程的建筑物。涉及五个居者有其屋计划屋村及租者置其屋计划屋村，共涉及29幢大厦。截至今年9月，该小组已对这些屋村进行了316次检查，其中包括277次脚手架检查和39次突击检查，以检查防火屏障是否被拆除或窗户附近是否使用了可燃材料。已发出整改警告24次。

Hong Kong orders phased facade repairs for multi-building projects | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 2 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong orders phased facade repairs for multi-building projects
Hong Kong's Buildings Department has required that future major repair works involving more than one building must phase facade repairs. Professionals and contractors must ensure staircase and lift lobby windows are closed during works. Independent inspectors issued 24 correction warnings since Dece
The Director of Buildings in Hong Kong has issued a circular letter requiring that future major repair projects involving more than one building must carry out facade repairs in phases. During such works, building professionals and contractors must ensure that windows in staircases or lift lobbies are securely closed.
The Housing Bureau submitted a paper to the Legislative Council's Panel on Housing, noting that some older buildings still retain openable windows in staircases or lift lobbies. The government should issue temporary warning notices to ensure windows are closed, and in the longer term review whether these should be replaced by sealed fire-resistant windows. The Director of Buildings sent the circular letter to professionals and contractors last Thursday.
Separately, since December last year, the Independent Checking Team has stepped up inspections of buildings undergoing major repair works within its jurisdiction. This covered five Home Ownership Scheme estates and Tenants Purchase Scheme estates, involving a total of 29 buildings. As of September this year, the team conducted 316 inspections at these estates, including 277 scaffold inspections and 39 surprise checks to see whether fire barriers had been removed or combustible materials used near windows. Twenty-four rectification warnings have been issued.

summary: 香港在日本食品样本中未发现异常辐射 |中国劳工公告 2026 年 11 月 2 日星期一 · 香港 香港及中国劳工英文新闻 香港未发现日本食品样本中存在异常辐射 香港食品安全部门于 2026 年 10 月 30 日至 11 月 2 日期间对 341 个日本食品样本进行了检测，未发现辐射超出安全限度。渔农自然护理署亦测试了150个本地渔业样本，全部合格。自 2023 年 8 月起，食品环境卫生署辖下的食品安全中心（CFS）共有 272,082 名日本人
content:
香港在日本食品样本中未发现异常辐射 |中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 2 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港在日本食品样本中未发现异常辐射
香港食物安全当局于2026年10月30日至11月2日期间测试了341个日本食物样本，未发现辐射超出安全限度。渔农自然护理署亦测试了150个本地渔业样本，全部合格。自 2023 年 8 月以来，共有 272,082 名日本人
食物环境卫生署辖下食物安全中心（中心）正对所有非禁止输入香港的日本水产、海盐及海藻进行全面辐射测试。产品只有在确认辐射水平在安全范围内后才可投放市场供应。
中心于10月30日中午至2026年11月2日中午，对341个日本进口水产品及其加工品、海藻及海盐样本进行辐射测试。根据中心有关日本进口食品管制措施的专题网页，没有发现样本的辐射水平超出安全标准。
同期，渔农自然护理署（渔护署）对150个本地渔产品样本进行辐射测试。渔护署在其网站上报告说，所有样品均通过了测试。
香港天文台亦加强监测本地水域的环境辐射水平。天文台在海水辐射监测网页上表示，目前尚未发现异常情况。
由2023年8月24日至2026年11月2日中午，中心及渔护署共检测了272,082个日本进口食物样本（包括169,436个水产品及其加工品、海藻及海盐样本）及57,962个本地渔业产品样本的辐射，所有样本均合格。

Hong Kong finds no abnormal radiation in Japanese food samples
Hong Kong's food safety authority tested 341 Japanese food samples from 30 October to 2 November 2026, finding no radiation exceeding safety limits. The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department also tested 150 local fishery samples, all passing. Since August 2023, a total of 272,082 Japane
The Centre for Food Safety (CFS), under the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department, is conducting comprehensive radiation tests on all Japanese aquatic products, sea salt and seaweed that are not banned from entering Hong Kong. Products are only released for market supply after being confirmed to have radiation levels within safe limits.
From noon on 30 October to noon on 2 November 2026, the CFS tested 341 food samples of Japanese imported aquatic products, their processed items, seaweed and sea salt for radiation. No samples were found to have radiation levels exceeding safety standards, according to the CFS's dedicated webpage on control measures for Japanese imported food.
During the same period, the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) tested 150 local fishery product samples for radiation. All samples passed the tests, the AFCD reported on its website.
The Hong Kong Observatory has also stepped up monitoring of environmental radiation levels in local waters. As of now, no abnormalities have been detected, the Observatory stated on its seawater radiation monitoring webpage.
From 24 August 2023 to noon on 2 November 2026, the CFS and AFCD have tested a total of 272,082 Japanese imported food samples (including 169,436 samples of aquatic products, their processed items, seaweed and sea salt) and 57,962 local fishery product samples for radiation, with all samples passing the tests.

content:
香港警察局长报告电话诈骗激增，命令电信公司屏蔽 VoIP 号码 |中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 2 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港警察局长报告电话诈骗激增，命令电信公司屏蔽 VoIP 号码
2026年前9个月，香港警方共记录了68,015起犯罪案件，同比增长2.1%，其中欺诈案件占51%。电话诈骗超过电子商务成为首要诈骗类别，促使警方要求紧急暂停犯罪集团使用的 VoIP 号码。
香港警务处处长任周一表示，2026 年前 9 个月，香港共录得 68,015 起犯罪案件，同比增长 2.1%。诈骗案件共 34,679 宗，占所有罪案的 51%，上升 7.9%，损失增加 6.7% 至 60.2 亿港元。
任在南区区议会会议上发表讲话时表示，电话诈骗已超过网上购物诈骗，成为最严重的诈骗类别，有近万起案件，约占所有诈骗案件的30%。电话诈骗损失达19.4亿港元。
该专员表示，最近电话诈骗激增，8月和9月记录了3900多起案件，其中80%涉及虚假客户服务电话。警方对受害者电话记录的分析显示，大多数诈骗电话来自本地号码。
警方发现，人们在零售店购买 SIM 卡，在网上实名注册，然后将其交给诈骗集团。目前，出租或出售SIM卡并不构成犯罪，当局计划修改法律以弥补这一漏洞。
Yam 补充说，欺诈集团正在利用互联网协议语音 (VoIP) 服务中的漏洞。 8 月和 9 月，使用 VoIP 号码实施的诈骗比例从 10% 上升至 30%。这些电话无论来自何处都不会显示“+852”，从而误导接听者相信他们来自香港。警方已要求电信运营商紧急暂停受影响的号码，并分享识别可疑用户的方法，以帮助该行业加强控制。

Hong Kong police chief reports surge in phone scams, orders telecoms to block VoIP numbers | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 2 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong police chief reports surge in phone scams, orders telecoms to block VoIP numbers
Hong Kong police recorded 68,015 crimes in first nine months of 2026, up 2.1 per cent, with fraud accounting for 51 per cent. Phone scams surpassed e-commerce as the top fraud category, prompting police to demand emergency suspension of VoIP numbers used by syndicates.
Hong Kong police commissioner Monday Yam said the city recorded 68,015 crimes in the first nine months of 2026, up 2.1 per cent year on year. Fraud accounted for 34,679 cases, or 51 per cent of all crime, rising 7.9 per cent, with losses increasing 6.7 per cent to HK$6.02 billion.
Speaking at a Southern District District Council meeting, Yam said phone scams had overtaken online shopping fraud as the most serious category, with nearly 10,000 cases, or about 30 per cent of all fraud. Losses from phone scams reached HK$1.94 billion.
The commissioner said phone scams had surged recently, with more than 3,900 cases recorded in August and September, 80 per cent of which involved fake customer service calls. Police analysis of victims' phone records showed most scam calls originated from local numbers.
Police discovered that people were buying SIM cards at retail outlets, registering them online with real names, then handing them over to fraud syndicates. Currently, renting or selling SIM cards does not constitute an offence, and authorities plan to amend the law to address the loophole.
Yam added that fraud syndicates were exploiting vulnerabilities in Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) services. The share of scams using VoIP numbers rose from 10 per cent to 30 per cent in August and September. These calls do not display '+852' regardless of where they originate, misleading recipients into believing they are from Hong Kong. Police have demanded that telecom operators urgently suspend the affected numbers and have shared methods to identify suspicious users to help the industry tighten controls.

title: 马来西亚警方逮捕18名台湾人 涉嫌冒充香港警察骗香港居民
source: 新闻汇总 - 茉莉花新闻网
summary: 马来西亚警方逮捕18名台湾人 涉嫌冒充香港警察骗香港居民 · 茉莉花新闻网 跳转到主要内容 跳转到页脚 在新标签页中打开 马来西亚吉隆坡金马警区商业罪案调查组10月29日傍晚约6时35分根据情报突击搜查登亚路（Jalan Tengah）圣玛丽公寓（St Mary Residence）的两个单位，逮捕17名男子和1名女子，起获69部手机、5台笔记本电脑和两件香港警察制服。被捕的18人都是台湾籍，年龄在19岁到43岁之间，涉嫌参与一个网上诈骗集团。 金马警区主任、助理总监阿哈迈德
content:
马来西亚警方逮捕18名台湾人 涉嫌冒充香港警察骗香港居民 · 茉莉花新闻网 跳转到主要内容 跳转到页脚 在新标签页中打开
马来西亚吉隆坡金马警区商业罪案调查组10月29日傍晚约6时35分根据情报突击搜查登亚路（Jalan Tengah）圣玛丽公寓（St Mary Residence）的两个单位，逮捕17名男子和1名女子，起获69部手机、5台笔记本电脑和两件香港警察制服。被捕的18人都是台湾籍，年龄在19岁到43岁之间，涉嫌参与一个网上诈骗集团。
金马警区主任、助理总监阿哈迈德阿兹万（Ahmad Azwan Amin Nordin）发文告说，初步调查发现这个集团冒充香港警察；根据现场搜获的证物，警方相信这个集团主要锁定香港居民，通过网络电话及相关设备进行线上诈骗，估计已在当地活动约5个月。初步调查也显示，这个集团租用当地的住宅宽带服务，设立网络呼叫中心打网络电话。受影响的是接到这类电话的香港居民；香港警方多次提醒市民，真正的执法部门绝不会通过通讯软件做视像笔录，也绝不会索取银行密码，或要求市民把钱转到所谓的安全账户。
香港特区政府商务及经济发展局局长丘应桦今年6月24日在立法会答复议员提问时说，根据香港警方提供的数字，2025年香港的骗案约有4.3万宗、损失金额约81亿元，骗案数字比2024年轻微下跌，这是自2019年逐年上升后第一次下跌。丘应桦还说，骗徒利用电话和网络行骗已成为全球趋势。
法庭10月30日批准把18人延扣4天，到11月2日。警方按《刑事法典》第420条（诈欺）和第511条（企图犯罪）调查，当局正在追查这个集团背后的组织结构，警方也呼吁知情的民众提供情报。按当地法律，诈欺罪成立最高可判10年监禁、鞭笞和罚款，企图犯罪也要负相应的刑责。针对诈骗集团把马来西亚当作犯罪据点，马来西亚社区治安关怀组织此前接受媒体采访时呼吁，执法机关应针对实际的犯罪行为追究责任，不能只按违反移民规定处理。
10月29日金马警区警方傍晚约6时35分突击搜查圣玛丽公寓的两个单位，逮捕18名台湾籍男女
台中警方此前也破获过一宗专门锁定香港民众的诈骗案：刑事警察局侦查第六大队第三队公布，一个由黄姓男子主导的集团在台中北屯区和南屯区设立话务机房，打电话给香港民众，假冒中国检察官和公安人员，谎称对方个人资料被盗用、涉及刑案，要对方配合资金监管汇款。这个集团把来电显示改成中国地区派出所的号码，布置仿真的检警办公场景，还用AI视频技术假扮检察官和公安人员，在视频里和被害人对话。警方2025年6月中旬同时突袭两处机房，当场逮捕17名机手（打电话的人）和干部，查扣手机、电脑和假检察官制服、公安制服、徽章等证物，同年12月初又抓到黄姓主嫌；检方已把全案起诉。
案子机房冒充的身份起获的证物被捕的人台中（2025年6月中旬突袭）台中北屯区和南屯区中国检察官和公安人员手机、电脑、假检察官制服、公安制服、徽章等17名机手和干部；同年12月初抓到黄姓主嫌吉隆坡（10月29日突袭）登亚路圣玛丽公寓的两个单位香港警察69部手机、5台笔记本电脑、两件香港警察制服18名台湾籍男女
2016年11月30日，中国外交部发言人耿爽在例行记者会上就马来西亚把21名涉嫌诈骗的台湾籍民众押往中国大陆一事说，中方高度赞赏和感谢马来西亚坚定奉行一个中国政策、与中方合作打击电信网络诈骗等跨国犯罪，中国有关部门会对带回的嫌犯依法处理。这次被捕的18人同样是涉嫌诈骗的台湾籍民众；不同的是，那次的21人被押往中国大陆，这次的18人10月30日起在马来西亚延扣。
我们的分析我们认为，这个集团备下香港警察制服，用意可能是在视像里穿给香港居民看；视像里的制服证明不了对方是警察。这是因为，集团设在吉隆坡，锁定的却是香港居民，制服只有在镜头前才用得上；台中那个集团也备了假检察官制服，用AI视频和被害人对话。
不同看法警方说集团用网络电话及相关设备行骗，没有提到视像，制服未必用上过。我们同意，但我们说的是用意：香港警方多次提醒市民真正的执法部门绝不会通过通讯软件做视像笔录，可见骗徒会在视像里冒充执法人员。
前瞻马来西亚会不会以诈欺或企图诈欺起诉这18人中的任何人。我们判断，到2026年12月31日（含当天），马来西亚会以诈欺或企图诈欺起诉这18人中的至少一人。这是因为，警方已按诈欺和企图犯罪的条文调查并取得延扣，证物也在手里。
两宗案子的机房一个设在台中，一个设在吉隆坡，都不在香港；香港居民能靠的是香港警方那句提醒：真正的执法部门绝不会通过通讯软件做视像笔录。
综合香港01、东方日报、Portal Berita RTM、中央社、NOWnews今日新聞报道

香港一周新增六宗退伍军人病病例
香港卫生署于10月25日至31日报告六宗社区获得性退伍军人病个案，涉及多区48岁至78岁的男性。该中心表示，这些病例是零星的，与之前的病例没有流行病学联系，使 2026 年总数达到 169 例。
香港卫生署11月2日发表声明称，10月25日至31日一周内，新增六例社区获得性退伍军人病病例，涉及六名年龄在48岁至78岁之间的男性。患者居住在湾仔、油尖旺、南区、沙田和大埔区。
卫生防护中心已展开流行病学调查，以确定可能的感染源和高风险暴露因素。该中心表示，初步调查结果显示，这些病例是零星的，没有证据表明它们与香港之前记录的其他确诊病例有联系。
卫生署表示，截至10月31日，今年香港共录得169宗退伍军人病个案，而2025年及2024年分别有167宗及135宗。
该部门指出，男性、50岁以上的人、吸烟者、酗酒者和免疫系统较弱的人更容易患军团病。其他风险因素包括供水系统维护不善、家庭使用旧供水系统、靠近冷却塔或喷泉、使用电热水器、水疗中心或温泉，以及最近入住酒店或船上。
军团菌可以在各种环境中繁衍生息，特别是在 20 至 45 摄氏度之间的温水中。来源包括水箱、冷热水系统、冷却塔、水疗中心、喷泉、加湿器和家庭呼吸医疗设备。感染可能通过吸入人造水系统中受污染的水滴或雾气以及处理花园土壤、堆肥或盆栽混合物时发生。
该部门建议免疫功能低下的人士饮用、刷牙和漱口时使用无菌水或开水；避免使用加湿器或其他产生雾气的装置；如果使用此类设备，请使用无菌水或新煮沸的冷却自来水，而不是直接使用自来水。它还敦促根据制造商的说明定期清洁和维护。
该部门还呼吁公众不要吸烟和避免饮酒，并提供了戒烟热线的联系方式以及为初级医疗保健提供者提供的酒精筛查和简短干预工具。

Hong Kong reports six new Legionnaires' disease cases in one week
Hong Kong's Department of Health reported six community-acquired Legionnaires' disease cases from 25 to 31 October, involving men aged 48 to 78 in various districts. The centre said the cases are sporadic with no epidemiological link to previous cases, bringing the 2026 total to 169.
Hong Kong's Department of Health reported six new community-acquired cases of Legionnaires' disease in the week from 25 to 31 October, involving six men aged between 48 and 78. The patients resided in Wan Chai, Yau Tsim Mong, Southern, Sha Tin and Tai Po districts, the department said in a statement on 2 November.
The Centre for Health Protection has launched epidemiological investigations to identify possible sources of infection and high-risk exposure factors. Preliminary findings indicated the cases are sporadic, with no evidence linking them to other confirmed cases previously recorded in Hong Kong, the centre said.
As of 31 October, a total of 169 Legionnaires' disease cases have been recorded in Hong Kong this year, compared with 167 in 2025 and 135 in 2024, according to the department.
The department noted that men, people aged over 50, smokers, heavy drinkers and those with weakened immune systems are more susceptible to Legionnaires' disease. Other risk factors include poorly maintained water supply systems, use of old water systems in homes, proximity to cooling towers or fountains, use of electric water heaters, spas or hot springs, and recent stays in hotels or on ships.
Legionella bacteria can thrive in various environments, particularly in warm water between 20 and 45 degrees Celsius. Sources include water tanks, hot and cold water systems, cooling towers, spas, fountains, humidifiers and home respiratory medical equipment. Infection can occur through inhaling contaminated water droplets or mist from human-made water systems, and also when handling garden soil, compost or potting mix.
The department advised immunocompromised individuals to use sterile or boiled water for drinking, brushing teeth and rinsing; avoid using humidifiers or other mist-producing devices; and, if using such devices, to use sterile water or freshly boiled cooled tap water rather than direct tap water. It also urged regular cleaning and maintenance according to manufacturers' instructions.
The department also called on the public not to smoke and to avoid alcohol, and provided contact details for its smoking cessation hotline and an alcohol screening and brief intervention tool for primary healthcare providers.

香港房屋委员会公布华富村重建及人工智能交通计划 |中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 2 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港房屋委员会公布华富村重建及人工智能交通计划
香港房屋委员会向南区区议会汇报华富村重建及华富村新公屋第一期工程，获得广泛支持。第一个接待屋村华富北将于今年竣工，居民将于 2027 年第三季度入住。当局计划采用人工智能技术
香港房屋委员会于11月2日向南区区议会通报华富村重建及搬迁计划的最新进展，并就华富村新公营房屋发展第一期征求议员意见，获普遍支持。
第一个落成的接待屋村，位于华径街的华富北，将于今年年底竣工。华安楼及华乐楼的住户将陆续入住，预计于2027年第三季完成搬迁。新华富村第一期工程随后将开始拆迁，较原计划提早六年接纳华翠楼及华景楼的住户。
为帮助受第一期b期清拆影响的住户，即华祥楼、华健楼及华泰楼的住户，当局将推出一项早期搬迁计划，将华富北的400多个单位纳入其中。成功申请者预计将于 2027 年 3 月入住。其他四个接待屋村将于 2028 年至 2031 年间竣工。
新华富村采用“社区为本”的核心设计理念。通过“十种华府”公众参与计划，设计团队收集了利益相关者的意见，并制定了四项策略：保育与活化、社区建设、可持续发展和创新技术。该局将利用数字信息管理和数据分析平台，对关键工程和环境参数进行模拟和分析。当局亦正与路政署铁路发展部及港铁公司就南港岛线（西段）路线及华富站选址进行协调。总体规划设计预计2028年上半年基本完成。
新华富村第一期以「重建华富」为主题，拟建三座住宅楼，供华翠楼及华景楼居民居住。它将保护和振兴现有的华富（1）购物中心和外面的“悦榕庄头”，延续原来的“市中心”概念。该计划包括社会福利设施、室外庭院、有顶公共空间和华富历史档案馆。华富路的部分路段将会重新调整。当局预计于 2027 年初公布相关道路工程，并于 2028 年中开始施工。
土木工程拓展署薄扶林南的行人及道路改善工程预计于2027年完成。港铁公司正为南港岛线（西段）进行详细规划及设计，计划于2034年通车。当局正与香港大学的研究团队合作开发综合智能监控平台，利用人工智能和实时交通数据动态规划施工车辆路线

Monday, 2 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong Housing Authority unveils Wah Fu Estate redevelopment, AI traffic plan
Hong Kong Housing Authority briefs Southern District Council on Wah Fu Estate redevelopment and first phase of new Wah Fu Estate public housing, gaining broad support. The first reception estate, Wah Fu North, will finish this year, with residents moving in by Q3 2027. The authority plans AI-powered
Hong Kong's Housing Authority on 2 November briefed the Southern District Council on the latest progress of the Wah Fu Estate redevelopment and relocation plan, and sought councillors' views on the first phase of the new Wah Fu Estate public housing development, receiving general support.
The first completed reception estate, Wah Fu North on Wah Keng Street, will finish construction by the end of this year. Residents of Wah On House and Wah Lok House will gradually move in, with relocation expected to be completed by the third quarter of 2027. Demolition will then begin to make way for the first phase of the new Wah Fu Estate, enabling it to receive residents of Wah Chui House and Wah King House six years earlier than originally planned.
To help households affected by phase 1b clearance – those in Wah Cheung House, Wah Kin House and Wah Tai House – the authority is offering an early relocation scheme with more than 400 flats at Wah Fu North. Successful applicants are expected to move in by March 2027. The other four reception estates will be completed between 2028 and 2031.
The new Wah Fu Estate adopts a 'community-based' core design concept. Through the 'Ten Kinds of Wah Fu' public participation programme, the design team has gathered stakeholder views and developed four strategies: conservation and revitalisation, community building, sustainable development, and innovative technology. The authority will use digital information management and data analysis platforms to simulate and analyse key engineering and environmental parameters. The authority is also coordinating with the Highways Department's Railway Development Division and MTR Corporation on the South Island Line (West Section) alignment and Wah Fu station location. Overall planning and design are expected to be largely completed by the first half of 2028.
The first phase of the new Wah Fu Estate, themed 'Rebuilding Wah Fu', proposes three residential towers for Wah Chui House and Wah King House residents. It will conserve and revitalise the existing Wah Fu (1) Shopping Centre and the 'Banyan Tree Head' outside, continuing the original 'town centre' concept. The plan includes social welfare facilities, outdoor courtyards, covered public spaces and a Wah Fu history archive. Part of Wah Fu Road will be realigned. The authority expects to gazette related road works in early 2027 and begin construction by mid-2028.
The Civil Engineering and Development Department's pedestrian and road improvement works in Pok Fu Lam South are expected to finish in 2027. MTR Corporation is conducting detailed planning and design for the South Island Line (West Section), which is scheduled to open by 2034. The authority is collaborating with a research team from the University of Hong Kong to develop an integrated smart monitoring platform, using artificial intelligence and real-time traffic data to dynamically plan construction vehicle routes, aiming to reduce traffic impact on surrounding areas.

content:
香港特首与教育部长讨论大学城规划 |中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 2 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港特首与教育部长讨论大学城规划
香港特首会见了中国教育部长，并概述了北领地建设“大学城”的计划，以吸引顶尖机构和人才。香港旨在提升香港的全球教育地位并深化跨境学术合作。
政府宣布，香港行政长官李家超于 2026 年 11 月 2 日会见了中国教育部部长王锦彪。李显龙对部长表示欢迎，并重点介绍了香港有五所世界排名前 100 的大学，使香港跻身全球教育领导者之列。
李说，政府正在实施第一个五年教育计划，将香港打造成全球高端人才的中心。他补充说，针对海外学生的专门计划和首届“香港留学周”，以有史以来规模最大的亚太国际教育协会年会为特色，都展示了香港的高等教育影响力。
李说，在“一国两制”原则下，香港将继续开展“香港：你的世界级校园”国际活动，并支持本地院校在内地和海外举办招聘活动，扩大人才库。
李说，该市正在加快北领地或“北城”的发展，以大学城为中心，集教育、科技、产业、人才和城市发展于一体。这一模式推动政府、产业、学术、研究和投资之间的合作，为高等教育和创新打造战略基地。政府将与教育部合作，吸引更多内地顶尖大学和研究机构落户北领地，汇聚学术和研究优势，实现互利共赢。
李指出，大湾区内的高等教育关系密切，他表示，所有八所公帑资助的香港大学均在深圳设立产学基地，并在内地城市设有四个校区。今年是粤港澳大学联盟成立十周年，政府将优化联盟机制，深化创新和人才交流。李说，在部长级支持下，香港与内地将加强师资培训、数码教育、爱国主义教育等领域的合作，助力教育强国建设。

Monday, 2 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong leader and education minister discuss university city plan
Hong Kong's chief executive met China's education minister and outlined plans for a 'university city' in the Northern Territory to attract top institutions and talent. The city aims to boost Hong Kong's global education standing and deepen cross-border academic collaboration.
Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee met China's Education Minister Wang Jinpiao on 2 November 2026, the government announced. Lee welcomed the minister and highlighted Hong Kong's five world top-100 universities, placing the city among global education leaders.
The government is implementing its first five-year education plan to turn Hong Kong into a hub for high-end global talent, Lee said. A dedicated scheme for overseas students and the inaugural 'Study in Hong Kong Week', featuring the largest-ever Asia-Pacific International Education Association annual conference, are showcasing the city's higher education influence, he added.
Under the 'one country, two systems' principle, Hong Kong will continue its 'Hong Kong: Your World-class Campus' international campaign and support local institutions in recruiting events on the mainland and overseas to expand the talent pool, Lee stated.
Lee said the city is accelerating development of the Northern Territory, or 'North City', centred on a university city that integrates education, technology, industry, talent and urban development. This model drives collaboration among government, industry, academia, research and investment to create a strategic base for higher education and innovation. The government will work with the education ministry to attract more top mainland universities and research institutes to the Northern Territory, pooling academic and research strengths for mutual benefit.
Noting close higher-education ties within the Greater Bay Area, Lee said all eight publicly funded Hong Kong universities have set up industry-academia bases in Shenzhen, with four operating campuses in mainland cities. As the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau University Alliance marks its tenth anniversary this year, the government will optimise alliance mechanisms to deepen innovation and talent exchanges. With ministerial support, Hong Kong and the mainland will enhance cooperation in teacher training, digital education and patriotic education to help build a strong education nation, Lee said.

香港提议修改噪音规则以促进建筑发展并减少交通噪音
香港环境负责人概述了简化北领地夜间建筑噪音许可证、采用新的国家和联合国车辆噪音标准、推广创新型降噪窗户和低噪音路面的计划，以减少约 15 万居民的交通噪音。
环境及生态局局长于 2026 年 11 月 2 日向立法会事务委员会表示，香港政府已提出一揽子措施，以更新建筑和道路交通的噪音法规。
根据现行制度，承建商在夜间或公众假期进行建筑工程，必须向环境保护署（环保署）申请噪音许可证。政府现在提议简化北领地开发项目的申请流程，同时保持现有的噪音限制不变。北领地的一项新技术备忘录将允许承包商在现场实时监测噪音水平，并在不超过标准的情况下灵活调整设备，以加快施工速度。
针对交通噪音，政府在新建住宅楼推广创新型降噪窗户和阳台设计，可将交通噪音降低高达12分贝（A）。这使得在以前被认为过于嘈杂的地点开发住房成为可能。此外，高速公路和约130条区道已铺设低噪音路面，惠及约15万居民。
政府还对《噪音管制（汽车）规例》（第400I章）提出三项修订，为车辆首次在香港登记时设定噪音标准。现有标准自 2002 年起开始使用。修正案将：首先，采用可接受的国家标准和联合国法规；二是对机动三轮车进行监管。第三，将目前对噪音水平极低的电动汽车的行政豁免立法化。
局长表示，环保署已就立法建议咨询业界并获得支持。

Hong Kong proposes noise rule changes to boost building and cut traffic din | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 2 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong proposes noise rule changes to boost building and cut traffic din
Hong Kong's environment chief outlined plans to simplify night-time construction noise permits for the Northern Territory, adopt new national and UN vehicle noise standards, and promote innovative noise-reducing windows and low-noise road surfaces to cut traffic noise for about 150,000 residents.
The Hong Kong government has proposed a package of measures to update noise regulations for construction and road traffic, the Secretary for Environment and Ecology told a Legislative Council panel on 2 November 2026.
Under the current system, contractors carrying out building work at night or on public holidays must apply for a noise permit from the Environmental Protection Department (EPD). The government now proposes to simplify the application process for developments in the Northern Territory while keeping existing noise limits unchanged. A new technical memorandum for the Northern Territory would allow contractors to monitor noise levels in real time on site and adjust equipment flexibly, as long as standards are not exceeded, to speed up construction.
For traffic noise, the government has promoted innovative noise-reducing windows and balcony designs for new residential buildings, which can cut traffic noise by up to 12 decibels (A). This has made it possible to develop housing on sites previously considered too noisy. In addition, low-noise road surfaces have been laid on expressways and about 130 district roads, benefiting approximately 150,000 residents.
The government also proposed three amendments to the Noise Control (Motor Vehicles) Regulation (Chapter 400I), which sets noise standards for vehicles when they are first registered in Hong Kong. The existing standards have been in use since 2002. The amendments would: first, adopt both national standards and UN regulations as acceptable; second, bring motor tricycles under the regulation; and third, make statutory the current administrative exemption for electric vehicles, which produce very low noise levels.
The EPD has consulted the industry on the legislative proposals and received support, the secretary said.

民進黨台北市長參選人沈伯洋（中）2日錄製節目「新聞面對面」，他在錄影前接受媒體聯訪，談及被指看起來疲倦時表示，「我只是眼睛比較小一點」，強調精神狀況其實一直都滿好的。中央社記者王飛華攝 115年11月2日
（中央社記者黃麗芸台北2日電）是否再辦第2場辯論，台北市長蔣萬安說，理解對手沈伯洋想再辦的用意，很可惜沈沒好好把握。對此，民進黨台北市長參選人沈伯洋今天表示，沒好好把握的是蔣，提問都不回答反拿來做攻擊。
沈伯洋下午接受年代電視台「新聞面對面」節目主持人謝震武專訪錄影，媒體會前聯訪詢問，如何看台北市長蔣萬安競選總幹事羅智強今天說，沈伯洋競選總幹事吳思瑤來加LINE要討論第2次辯論事宜，但他先提出6點辯論規則；以及蔣受訪時表示，理解沈想再辦1場辯論的用意，很可惜沈沒好好把握，是否為怯戰。
沈伯洋表示，羅智強的言論問他本人即可，羅開心就好，自己常不知羅在講什麼。
他認為，蔣萬安個人可能心有定見，但自己一直覺得沒有好好把握的是蔣，因問了一堆問題都全部不回答，並將回答時間拿來做攻擊，變成兩邊一直沒有交集，非常可惜，所以自己當下才提出要第2場辯論，所以應該是要問蔣萬安為何一直不回答問題。
媒體追問，台中市長兼蔣萬安競選總部主委盧秀燕下午分別拜會台北市議會藍、白黨團，是否要幫蔣鞏固白營選票。
沈伯洋說，盧秀燕現在應該有滿多時間要來台北幫忙蔣萬安，但對自己來說，仍不太習慣將民眾分成是白營或藍營支持者，而是各式各樣在城市不同需求的民眾，針對各自不同需求去提出政見，這才是說服大家投票支持的最好方式，若預設成政黨支持者則較無那麼強的對話空間。
由於蔣陣營召開記者會說沈的都更政策很像在作夢，媒體問如何看他們舉前總統陳水扁當年參選台北市長的口號「有夢最美」，但「失望相隨」；另外，事實查核中心發現蔣萬安在辯論時所提內湖康樂街都更案內容和事實不符，且將都更卡關歸咎於航高限制也過於簡化。
沈伯洋表示，這個城市本就該要讓大家能有各式各樣理想可實現之處，但對方若用空洞口號做批評，蠻令人難過，但也因此大家會開始注意自己的政見，可檢視最初是如何提出住戶交換計畫和加速進入無限都更等緣由，反而是好事。
他認為，在辯論時針對細節討論很浪費秒數，但大家可以回看蔣當時所講內容有多少與事實不符，但這不是辯論重點，自己仍鎖定暢談立場、價值和城市未來發展方向給市民聽，兩人最大不同就是，蔣一直在開都更入口，自己則認為要能走到最後動工的出口才最重要，陪伴機制才是現在要做的。
媒體問到，因沈伯洋在社群平台Threads瀏覽量突破1億，卻被蔣萬安酸說是認知作戰專家，看法為何；另外，媒體人趙少康還提說民進黨歷任參選人就愛裝暖男，認為蔣萬安始終如一才是真暖男。
沈伯洋認為，蔣萬安都沒有在聽別人講話，自己早多次說過認知作戰是國跟國之間的戰爭，但蔣每次都扣這種帽子，並說破億瀏覽量是因自己經常回覆他人文章，都會計入在瀏覽次數內，加上選舉進入倒數階段，瀏覽數字自然會越來越高。
另外，趙少康和自己相識不到1個月，其評論不一定那麼精準，但許多親友認識他逾20、30年，網路上應該都可看到他們的評論，希望趙少康能跟他認識更長久，才知道是否一致。
沈伯洋說，民調高高低低，現階段要注意的其實是投票率，認為藍營投票率向來都很高，自己則是力拚將民調數字轉換成實質投票率。
媒體再問到，沈伯洋和高雄市長陳其邁市長通話，相談哪些市政問題；以及民進黨發動競總背板創意大賽，是否要營造歡樂選舉感。
沈伯洋說，自己蠻常和陳其邁討論市政，了解其高雄經驗，今天也討論相關都更議題等；另外也希望大家不要覺得政治距離很遠，所以希望用較歡樂、平易近人方式，讓大家了解要反應事情或得到回覆，並非難事。
因民進黨秘書長徐國勇說沈有規劃到外縣市和其他選將合體計畫，但沈說有空檔才有機會，媒體續問，是否因整體選情仍戒慎恐懼，以及後續是否會舉辦一些座談會活動。
沈伯洋表示，小型座談會從以前迄今都舉辦很多，政見會議也開上百場，會一直進行到選舉、甚或選後，了解大家在這座城市裡的不同需求；另台北選情都可感受到非常緊繃，主要仍以台北市民為主，但若有空檔到外縣市，會希望可以多提雙邊合作政見，不會脫離台北這個主軸，畢竟自己要選的是台北市長。
媒體提到，昨天結束大安文山區車掃活動後，有士林北投區的民眾建議可在關渡宮旁包船以進行「船掃」造勢，看法為何。
沈伯洋說，安全還是最重要的，也會遵守相關規範，現在還不清楚包船狀況，會盡快盤點再告訴大家後續進度。（編輯：張國政）1151102

content:
欧美“黑色星期五”促销旺季来临前，欧盟对廉价小包裹开征处理费，叠加此前的关税、合规要求等，导致中国低价小商品跨境卖家经营压力增加，备货量大减。图为10月30日，一名行人走过法国西南部城市波尔多的圣凯瑟琳购物街。 （法新社）
（北京/布鲁塞尔综合讯）欧美“黑色星期五”促销旺季来临前，欧盟对廉价小包裹开征处理费，叠加此前的关税、合规要求等，导致中国低价小商品跨境卖家经营压力增加，备货量大减。
欧盟自11月1起，在对直邮消费者的小件包裹征收每类商品三元（欧元，下同，约4.3新元）关税的基础上，再增收新费用，对包裹中每类商品征收两欧元的处理费。
欧盟赶在黑色星期五、网络星期一及圣诞购物旺季前实施新规，可遏制低价商品，尤其是中国跨境电商商品涌入欧洲。
这项新规让中国跨境商品卖家陷入两难：把小包裹从中国直邮到海外消费者手中，会面临高税费；若提前把货物以批量出口方式运到欧洲仓库，又有库存积压和资金占用的问题。
中国媒体《经济观察报》指出，不少卖家因此选择减少备货，降低经营风险。
报道称，今年7月起实施的三欧元小包裹关税、最新的包裹处理费，叠加新合规要求，让中国跨境电商卖家面临更高的经营成本。往年11月27日的“黑色星期五”前，中国卖家都会提前大量备货，但今年卖家的备货量大减。
一位深圳跨境卖家透露，往年都按“黑五”预估销量的1.2倍备货，以防旺季断货。今年，他只按预估销量的一半做准备。报道形容：“过去他赌的是旺季销量，今年他赌不起的是欧盟新关税下的试错成本”。
另一位义乌卖家则透露，去年“黑五”，他在主要销售市场安排了41款商品入海外仓，今年减至33款，计划入仓总量约为去年同期的35%。
今年7月1日，欧盟取消150欧元以下的小额包裹关税豁免政策，包裹内每类商品均面临三欧元的临时固定关税。欧盟官方解释，征收处理费是基于清查小包裹带来的海关工作成本。
中国卖家也面临补齐小商品相关合规资料的压力。一名地方电子商务科工作人员称，自7月1日起，欧盟还将产品标识、合格认证、生产者延伸责任相关要求，由指导性合规指引调整为强制性法定义务，资料不全的货物无法在欧盟完成清关。
有卖家申诉，一些低价小商品很难备齐完整材料，一旦资料缺失，整批货物就可能遭遇清关受阻。
据法新社报道，自欧盟今年7月实施三欧元小包裹关税以来，相关进口量已下降约64%。
中国跨境电商平台已开始调整经营策略。据路透社报道，为减轻新收费对低价商品吸引力的冲击，拼多多的跨境电商平台Temu已经向一些消费者提供新折扣，阿里巴巴旗下速卖通则正扩大欧洲当地的仓储量。

船舶追踪数据显示，中国的研究船在台湾南部和东部的大片海域反复往返航行，测绘海床、收集水文资料，帮北京逐步掌握台湾周边海域的完整面貌；最近几个月，这些研究船在台湾东部海域出现得尤其频繁。台湾海巡署说，北京这样做实际上是在为战场做准备。台湾东部海域是台海一旦发生冲突时美军增援必须经过的海域。以美国和台湾为据点的地理空间情报分析公司ingeniSPACE分析船舶自动识别系统（AIS）等数据发现，中国4艘调查船从今年5月起在台湾周边特定海域反复减速、停船和不规则转向，减速或停船的海域都和连接台湾与海外的海底电缆位置重叠。
受影响的是靠海底电缆和外界通讯的台湾民众和企业：台湾近年接连发生海底电缆疑似被船只蓄意切断或损坏的事件，深海电缆一旦被切断，修复可能要一周以上。台湾一名官员接受媒体采访时说，这家公司的分析和台湾当局掌握的情况相符（未经证实）。这4艘船是中国自然资源部所属的向阳红22、上海和福建的大学所属的同济和嘉庚，以及船舶自动识别系统显示为MUSHANZI的船。
研究船用多波束声纳测量大片海域的深度和海底地形，也用遥控和自主水下无人载具做更精细的测绘；测到的数据可以在船上处理，也能通过卫星传回地面的实验室。美国智库哈德逊研究所国防概念与科技中心主任克拉克（Bryan Clark）对媒体说，北京想掌握详细的海床地形，方便潜艇和水下无人载具行动，这些装备可以用来封锁台湾，或阻止美军介入台海冲突。
根据台湾海巡署的资料，中国现在有超过120艘研究船，台湾真正能执行海洋调查任务的研究船只有5艘。台湾今年8月为研究船队增加了2艘新船，也在投入资源建立海上无人载具部队；台湾总统赖清德出席下水典礼时说，只有完整掌握自己的海域环境，才能维护国家安全。
所属研究船（艘）中国超过120台湾5其中：大学管理3其中：台湾海洋科技研究中心管理1其中：海军1
6月16日至18日，自然资源部的向阳红22在台湾以东海域做海洋环境调查，被台湾海巡驱离；国台办发言人张晗当时说，大陆海洋科考调查船在相关海域作业完全正当合法。7月17日到23日，中国水产科学研究院的科学调查船蓝海201在台湾东部海域调查渔业资源，国台办发言人陈斌华7月29日说，这是为了全面了解中国管辖海域的渔业资源状况，完全正当合法。台湾海巡署当时说，蓝海201在台湾东部海域期间，海巡署全程掌握了船的动态；中国对台湾东部海域没有主权或管辖权，长期借科学调查的名义做政治宣示，已经涉及灰色地带袭扰。
2026年5月日本和菲律宾宣布就台湾东部重叠的经济海域展开会谈，此后北京在台湾周边的探测活动明显增加
2026年6月16日至18日自然资源部的向阳红22在台湾以东海域做海洋环境调查，被台湾海巡驱离
2026年7月17日至23日中国水产科学研究院的蓝海201在台湾东部海域调查渔业资源
2026年10月30日一份船舶追踪数据分析公布：中国研究船在台湾南部和东部海域反复往返测绘
我们的分析我们认为，台湾对自己周边海底的了解可能还不如北京。这是因为，中国有超过120艘研究船，正在台湾南部和东部海域来回测绘海床，帮北京逐步掌握台湾周边海域的完整面貌；台湾能做海洋调查的研究船只有5艘。
不同看法台湾今年8月为研究船队增加了2艘新船，也在建立海上无人载具部队，可以说台湾正在设法缩小和北京的差距。我们同意台湾在设法缩小差距，但这不改变我们的看法。这是因为，台湾能做海洋调查的研究船只有5艘，中国超过120艘，8月新增的2艘新船改变不了台湾研究船远少于中国的局面。
我们的判断台湾海巡署会不会公布新的中国研究船或调查船在台湾东部海域活动的事件。我们判断，到2026年12月31日，台湾海巡署会公布至少一起中国研究船或调查船在台湾东部海域活动的事件。这是因为，今年6月向阳红22被台湾海巡驱离，7月蓝海201进入时海巡署也公开表态；最近几个月，中国研究船在台湾东部海域出现得尤其频繁。
停船海域和电缆位置重叠不等于船破坏过电缆，但台湾大量国际通讯靠海底电缆，深海电缆一旦被切断，修复可能要一周以上。

content:
台湾陆委会副主委说五中全会在为习近平续任作准备 中共可能加大对台灰色地带施压 · 茉莉花新闻网 跳转到主要内容 跳转到页脚 在新标签页中打开
台湾陆委会副主委沈有忠11月2日在台北的一场座谈会上说，中共二十届五中全会通过的全面从严治党决定是为习近平明年在中共二十一大续任提前作准备。沈有忠说，缺乏制衡的权力可能推高政治风险；中共为了转移内部压力和治理焦虑，不排除加速推动对台湾的「未统先治」，用各种手段营造对台海和台湾有常态管辖权的假象，近来已经发展出在台海周边常态性的袭扰和干预台湾民主选举。
受影响的是在台湾周边海域执法的台湾海巡和年底九合一选举的选民：沈有忠当天下午在另一场座谈会上预料，五中全会后中共会频繁地用海警船、科研船和民兵船等非正规的军事力量，在不引发全面军事冲突的前提下，用片面的执法宣告挑战台湾、日本和菲律宾的海域管辖权和执法权。沈有忠也提醒，台湾年底地方选举和美国期中选举临近，中共可能用AI生成假影音、散播错假讯息干扰选举，甚至让民众怀疑选举结果是否公平、正当。
台湾国家安全局10月20日送交立法院的报告说，今年1到9月，中共军机侵扰超过1450架次，还和军舰执行了28次联合战备警巡；去年同期是超过3000架次和31次。报告也说，中共从6月起把海警船等执法巡航的范围延伸到台湾东部海域和西太平洋。国安团队今年1到9月搜报的争议讯息约250万则，去年同期约169万则；国安局说，中共针对九合一选举，扩大用AI技术操弄资讯，想影响选民的支持倾向和选举结果。
项目2025年1到9月2026年1到9月中共军机侵扰（架次）超过3000超过1450联合战备警巡（次）3128搜报的争议讯息（万则）约169约250
下午那场座谈会上，中华亚太菁英交流协会秘书长王智盛说，五中全会后习近平面临军方高层整肃和指挥体系断层，发动全面战争的把握下降，短期内海警执法、法律战、跨国镇压和经济胁迫等手段的比重会提高。王智盛也说，明年是解放军建军100年，大型军演和以演代训的声势会不断增加。
沈有忠说，政府会加强自我防卫能力，「备战才能避战」，也会健全民主防卫的体制，加强防范境外渗透和认知战的法律。2025年9月，台湾国安人士对媒体说，国安单位发现YouTube上一段48秒的AI深伪影片，模拟赖清德和萧美琴对话，让赖清德说出没有说过的话（未经证实）。
2026年10月20日国安局的报告送交立法院：中共针对九合一选举扩大用AI技术操弄资讯
2026年11月2日陆委会副主委沈有忠说，五中全会后中共可能加大对台灰色地带施压
我们的分析我们认为，北京对台湾的压力可能正从军机军舰转向海上执法和选举干预。这是因为，中共军机侵扰从去年1到9月的超过3000架次减到今年同期的超过1450架次；同一时期，海警船的巡航范围延伸到台湾东部海域，争议讯息从约169万则增加到约250万则。
不同看法王智盛说，明年解放军建军100年，大型军演的声势会不断增加。我们同意明年军演可能增加，但这不改变我们的看法。这是因为，王智盛也说，短期内海警执法、法律战和跨国镇压的比重会提高。
前瞻台湾的政府机关会不会公开指出中共针对九合一选举的AI假影音。我们判断，到2026年12月31日，台湾的政府机关会公开指出至少一段中共针对九合一选举的AI假影音。这是因为，国安局10月已经说中共针对九合一选举扩大用AI技术操弄资讯；2025年9月，国安人士也公开过一段模拟赖清德的AI深伪影片。
年底投票的台湾选民面对的可能不是更多军机，而是更多AI假影音和错假讯息。

title: 台湾外交部长说中国用电子邮件寄APEC峰会邀请函 台方已抗议、不放弃出席
source: 新闻汇总 - 茉莉花新闻网
summary: 台湾外交部长说中国用电子邮件寄APEC峰会邀请函 台方已抗议、不放弃出席 · 茉莉花新闻网 跳转到主要内容 跳转到页脚 在新标签页中打开 台湾外交部长林佳龙11月2日说，今年亚太经合组织（APEC）领袖峰会的主办方中国没有派人亲自递交邀请函，而是用电子邮件寄送，外交部已在第一时间抗议。峰会11月18日、19日在深圳举行；林佳龙说，台湾不会因为中国企图差别待遇就放弃参与的权益，会以平等的经济体地位出席。 受影响的是代表台湾出席领袖峰会的人：台湾的领袖代表按惯例持邀请函与会，AP
content:
台湾外交部长说中国用电子邮件寄APEC峰会邀请函 台方已抗议、不放弃出席 · 茉莉花新闻网 跳转到主要内容 跳转到页脚 在新标签页中打开
台湾外交部长林佳龙11月2日说，今年亚太经合组织（APEC）领袖峰会的主办方中国没有派人亲自递交邀请函，而是用电子邮件寄送，外交部已在第一时间抗议。峰会11月18日、19日在深圳举行；林佳龙说，台湾不会因为中国企图差别待遇就放弃参与的权益，会以平等的经济体地位出席。
受影响的是代表台湾出席领袖峰会的人：台湾的领袖代表按惯例持邀请函与会，APEC主办方按惯例派特使亲送邀请函；林佳龙说，这次中方信里对台湾的称呼仍是“Chinese Taipei”，也就是台湾参与APEC的名称。代表人选还没有公布，林佳龙说，等总统府作业完成后会对外宣布。
中国过去两次主办APEC峰会；2001年陈水扁执政时，中方用传真发出通知，并拒绝台湾指派的代表李元簇出席，台湾最后没有出席那一届领袖会议。今年5月13日，中国国台办说会按一个中国原则处理台湾参会事宜；台湾外交部当天谴责，并说中国2024年曾书面保证与会人员的人身安全和顺利进出，2024年和2025年的双部长会议联合声明也写明所有经济体都应平等参与包括领袖会议在内的各项会议。林佳龙说，今年各种APEC相关会议里，中国对台湾都有一些差别待遇；APEC实行共识决，中国如果对台湾差别待遇，台湾也会在对中方的倡议上表达立场。
我们的分析我们认为，中方改用电子邮件寄邀请函，可能是想在不公开拒绝台湾与会的情况下，降低对台湾的礼遇。这是因为，按惯例主办方派特使亲送邀请函，这次改成电子邮件，称呼却仍是“Chinese Taipei”。和2001年相比，那次中方用传真通知，还拒绝了台湾指派的代表；这次只改了送信方式，称呼没变，邀请已经收到，代表人选还没有公布。
不同看法中方的邀请函已经发出，称呼也是正式名称；照这个看法，改用电子邮件只是送信方式的小事。我们同意称呼和邀请没有变，但这不改变我们的看法。这是因为，林佳龙说今年各种APEC相关会议里中国都对台湾有差别待遇，国台办5月也说要按一个中国原则处理台湾参会，改送信方式和这些是同一个方向。
我们的预判台湾的领袖代表能不能出席深圳的领袖峰会。我们判断，台湾指派的领袖代表会出席11月18日、19日在深圳举行的APEC领袖峰会。这是因为，中方这次虽然改用电子邮件，还是发了邀请、用了正式称呼，2024年也书面保证过与会人员的安全和顺利进出；台湾也说会出席。改用电子邮件变的是礼遇；台湾代表能不能平等出席，要等人选公布、到了深圳才知道。

香港海关在机场查获大麻、毒品和未税香烟
香港海关在机场逮捕了一名42岁的中国内地男性旅客，原因是他的手提行李中发现了疑似大麻、管制药物和未征税的香烟。他被指控犯有贩毒和其他罪行，将于 11 月 3 日出庭。
2026 年 11 月 2 日 20:02 香港时间 · 更新于 11 月 2 日 20:19 · 阅读时间 2 分钟
11月2日，一名42岁的中国内地男性旅客在香港国际机场清关时在其手提行李中发现怀疑大麻、含有怀疑附表1毒物的产品以及未征税的香烟，在香港国际机场被捕。该男子于当天从泰国曼谷抵达。
被捕人士被控一项贩运危险药物罪名、一项管有应课税品罪名、一项没有向海关人员申报应课税品罪名，以及一项管有附表1毒药罪名。案件将于11月3日在西九龙裁判法院审理。
香港海关表示，会根据情报分析，继续加强打击贩毒活动。海关亦呼吁市民保持警惕，切勿参与贩毒以获取经济利益，切勿接受任何委托或委托，运送受管制物品进出香港，亦不要在未确认物品性质前协助他人运送物品。
海关表示，会继续运用风险管理原则，挑选来自高风险地区的旅客进行清关​​检查，以确保有效打击跨境贩毒活动。
根据《危险药物条例》，贩运危险药物属严重罪行。一经定罪，违法者最高可被罚款港币五百万元及终身监禁。根据《药剂业及毒药条例》，未经授权管有毒药表第1部所列任何毒药即属犯罪，最高可处罚款10万港元及监禁两年。根据《应课税品条例》，香烟属于应课税品。进口、处理、管有、出售或购买私烟均属犯罪，最高可判处罚款港币200万元及监禁七年。
市民可致电海关24小时热线182 8080、专用电邮账户([email protected])或网上表格(eform.cefs.gov.hk/form/ced002)举报怀疑贩毒活动。

Tuesday, 3 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong customs seize cannabis, drugs and untaxed cigarettes at airport
Hong Kong customs arrested a 42-year-old mainland Chinese male traveller at the airport after finding suspected cannabis, controlled drugs and untaxed cigarettes in his hand luggage. He has been charged with drug trafficking and other offences, and will appear in court on 3 November.
2 Nov 2026 at 20:02 HKT · updated 2 Nov, 20:19 · 2 min read
A 42-year-old mainland Chinese male traveller was arrested at Hong Kong International Airport on 2 November after customs officers found suspected cannabis, products containing suspected Schedule 1 poison and untaxed cigarettes in his hand luggage during clearance. The man had arrived from Bangkok, Thailand, on the same day.
The arrested person has been charged with one count of trafficking a dangerous drug, one count of possessing dutiable goods, one count of failing to declare dutiable goods to customs officers, and one count of possessing a Schedule 1 poison. The case will be heard at the West Kowloon Magistrates' Court on 3 November.
Hong Kong Customs said it would continue to strengthen efforts to combat drug trafficking based on intelligence analysis. The department also called on the public to stay vigilant, not to participate in drug trafficking for financial gain, not to accept any appointment or commission to transport controlled items into or out of Hong Kong, and not to help others transport items without first confirming their nature.
Customs said it would continue to use risk-management principles to select travellers from high-risk areas for clearance checks to ensure effective enforcement against cross-border drug trafficking.
Under the Dangerous Drugs Ordinance, trafficking in dangerous drugs is a serious offence. Upon conviction, offenders face a maximum fine of HK$5 million and life imprisonment. Under the Pharmacy and Poisons Ordinance, unauthorised possession of any poison listed in Part 1 of the Poisons Table is an offence, punishable by a maximum fine of HK$100,000 and two years' imprisonment. Under the Dutiable Commodities Ordinance, cigarettes are dutiable goods. Importing, handling, possessing, selling or purchasing illicit cigarettes is an offence, punishable by a maximum fine of HK$2 million and seven years' imprisonment.
Members of the public can report suspected drug trafficking activities by calling the Customs 24-hour hotline at 182 8080, via the dedicated email account ([email protected]), or through the online form (eform.cefs.gov.hk/form/ced002).

content:
数码港推出50万港元区块链资助计划2.0及tConnect平台 |中国劳工公告栏
星期二, 3 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
数码港推出50万港元区块链资助计划2.0及tConnect平台
数码港周一推出区块链及数字资产试点补贴计划2.0，为每个试点项目提供高达50万港元的资助，并推出tConnect Launchpad平台。这些举措旨在加速香港金融领域的代币化和数字资产部署。
数码港周一推出两项战略举措，以加速香港金融领域的代币化和数字资产部署。该数字技术中心推出了区块链和数字资产试点补贴计划 2.0 以及 tConnect Launchpad 平台。这两项举措旨在促进数字资产解决方案的实际应用并促进行业合作。
计划2.0受财经事务及库务局委托，为测试区块链解决方案的企业提供财务支持。合资格的试点项目可获高达80%的资助，最高资助额为50万港元。申请者可在2026年12月31日申请截止日期前提交最多三个项目建议书。去年推出的首个计划吸引了超过200份申请，九个入围试点项目中有一半以上成功商业化。
财经事务及库务局局长许正宇表示，政府推出计划2.0是因为业界反应热烈，市场效益丰厚。许补充说，香港继续在全球金融科技产品方面处于领先地位，同时加强监管制度以促进可持续增长。
在香港金融管理局的支持下，tConnect Launchpad 为机构提供了专用的技术环境。参与者可以在结构化框架内验证代币化和数字资产解决方案。该平台有助于测试代币化基金、支付解决方案、现实世界资产代币化和结算基础设施。金管局总裁余伟文表示，代币化是金管局金融科技 2030 愿景的基石。 Yue指出，该平台将区块链创新与实际金融应用联系起来，并将金融机构与代币化社区连接起来。
数码港行政总裁郑忠岩表示，香港数字资产发展正进入新阶段。 Cheng指出，市场正在从创新探索走向大规模采用。新举措针对高影响力领域，包括机构去中心化金融、链上金融和代理经济。数码港拥有香港最大的金融科技和区块链社区以及人工智能超级计算中心。该中心继续通过孵化、融资和跨境扩张来支持初创企业。

Tuesday, 3 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Cyberport launches HK$500,000 blockchain subsidy scheme 2.0 and tConnect platform
Cyberport on Monday unveiled the Blockchain and Digital Asset Pilot Subsidy Scheme 2.0, offering up to HK$500,000 per pilot project, and the tConnect Launchpad platform. The initiatives aim to accelerate tokenisation and digital asset deployment in Hong Kong's financial sector.
Cyberport launched two strategic initiatives on Monday to accelerate tokenisation and digital asset deployment across Hong Kong's financial sector. The digital tech hub introduced the Blockchain and Digital Asset Pilot Subsidy Scheme 2.0 alongside the tConnect Launchpad platform. The twin moves aim to boost real-world applications of digital asset solutions and foster industry collaboration.
Commissioned by the Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau, Scheme 2.0 provides financial support for enterprises testing blockchain solutions. Eligible pilot projects can receive up to 80 per cent funding with a maximum subsidy of HK$500,000. Applicants may submit up to three project proposals before the application deadline on 31 December 2026. The inaugural scheme launched last year attracted over 200 applications, with more than half of the nine shortlisted pilot projects successfully commercialising.
Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui Ching-yu said the government is rolling out Scheme 2.0 due to enthusiastic industry response and substantial market benefits. Hui added that Hong Kong continues to top global fintech offerings while enhancing regulatory regimes for sustainable growth.
Supported by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority, tConnect Launchpad provides a dedicated technical environment for institutions. Participants can validate tokenisation and digital asset solutions within a structured framework. The platform facilitates testing for tokenised funds, payment solutions, real-world asset tokenisation, and settlement infrastructure. HKMA chief executive Eddie Yue Wai-man said tokenisation forms a cornerstone of the authority's Fintech 2030 vision. Yue noted that the platform bridges blockchain innovations with practical financial applications and connects financial institutions to the tokenisation community.
Cyberport chief executive Rocky Cheng Chung-ngam said Hong Kong's digital asset development is entering a new stage. Cheng noted the market is progressing from innovation exploration to large-scale adoption. The new initiatives target high-impact areas including institutional decentralised finance, on-chain finance, and the agentic economy. Cyberport houses Hong Kong's largest fintech and blockchain community alongside its AI Supercomputing Centre. The hub continues to support start-ups through incubation, funding, and cross-border expansion.

summary: 内地女子香港假结婚假生育罪被判无罪中国劳工布告栏 星期二, 2026 年 11 月 3 日 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 内地女子香港假结婚及假生育罪名被判无罪 控方未提供任何证据，一名 42 岁的内地女子周芙蓉因串谋诈骗及以欺骗手段获取服务罪被判无罪。这些指控涉及涉嫌假结婚以获得香港入境权和私立医院产科服务。一名42岁中国内地女子被控入境
content:
内地女子香港假结婚假生育罪被判无罪中国劳工公告栏
星期二, 3 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
内地女子香港假结婚及诈骗生育罪被判无罪
在检方没有提供证据的情况下，42岁的中国内地女子周芙蓉因串谋诈骗和以欺骗手段获取服务罪被宣告无罪。这些指控涉及涉嫌假结婚以获得香港入境权和私立医院产科服务。
一名42岁的中国大陆女子被控通过假结婚获得香港入境许可和私人医院产科服务，在检方没有提供对她不利的证据后，她被无罪释放。
被告人周芙蓉面临串谋诈骗和串谋以欺骗手段获取服务两项罪名。她周一在沙田裁判法院出庭受审，由高级大律师蔡伟邦代表出庭。
审判原定于今年六月举行，但因涉及线人证人的问题而推迟。当案件重新审理时，检方宣布不会提供对周不利的证据，促使地方法官正式驳回两项指控并宣告她无罪。
随着诉讼程序开始，检方告知法庭，虽然周此前对两项罪名均表示不认罪，但司法部上周提交了一份备忘录，表明他们不会继续起诉。检方表示，撤回证据的决定是经过深思熟虑的。作为回应，辩方要求地方法官正式宣布周无罪释放所有指控。陈批准了该申请，并裁定两项指控均不成立，而辩方没有提出额外的费用或命令申请。
这些指控源于据称在 2018 年至 2018 年 4 月 20 日期间在香港或其他地方发生的事件，具体日期不详。检方指控周与一名李姓男子和一名名叫艾伦的人串谋诈骗入境事务处处长和部门人员。当局声称，她与李缔结了婚姻，并向边境管制官员不诚实地表示，她来港的主要目的是与配偶团聚，从而诱使官员批准她入境，否则他们会拒绝。
此外，周某还被指控在同一时期与同一两人合谋，以欺骗手段在协和医院获得产科和产后服务。指控指出，她谎称李是她未出生孩子的亲生父亲，以确保在私人机构进行医疗预约和分娩安排。

Mainland woman acquitted of Hong Kong sham marriage and maternity fraud charges | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 3 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Mainland woman acquitted of Hong Kong sham marriage and maternity fraud charges
A 42-year-old mainland Chinese woman, Zhou Furong, was acquitted of conspiracy to defraud and obtain services by deception after the prosecution offered no evidence. The charges involved an alleged sham marriage to obtain Hong Kong entry and private hospital maternity services.
A 42-year-old mainland Chinese woman accused of entering into a sham marriage to obtain Hong Kong entry clearance and private hospital maternity services has been acquitted of all charges after the prosecution offered no evidence against her.
The defendant, Zhou Furong, faced two counts of conspiracy to defraud and conspiracy to obtain services by deception. She appeared before Deputy Magistrate Chan Yue-chow at Sha Tin Magistrates' Courts on Monday, represented by Senior Counsel Edwin Choy Wai-bond.
The trial had originally been scheduled for June this year but was adjourned to address issues regarding an informant witness. When the case resumed, the prosecution announced it would not offer evidence against Zhou, prompting the magistrate to formally dismiss both charges and acquit her.
As proceedings commenced, the prosecution informed the court that while Zhou had previously pleaded not guilty to both counts, the Department of Justice had submitted a memorandum last week indicating that they would not pursue the prosecution. The prosecution remarked that arriving at the decision to withdraw evidence had taken some deliberation. In response, the defence requested that the magistrate officially declare Zhou acquitted of all allegations. Chan granted the application and ruled that neither charge stood, while the defence made no additional applications for costs or orders.
The charges stemmed from events that allegedly took place between an unspecified date in 2018 and 20 April 2018, in Hong Kong or elsewhere. Prosecutors had alleged that Zhou conspired with a man surnamed Li and an individual known as Alan to defraud the Director of Immigration and departmental officers. Authorities claimed that she contracted a marriage with Li and dishonestly represented to border control officers that her primary purpose for visiting Hong Kong was to reunite with her spouse, thereby inducing officials to approve her entry when they would have otherwise refused.
In addition, Zhou was accused of conspiring with the same two individuals during the identical period to obtain obstetric and postnatal delivery services at Union Hospital by deception. The charge specified that she had falsely claimed Li was the biological father of her unborn child to secure medical booking and delivery arrangements at the private facility.

source: 总部设于伦敦的国际知名言论自由机构“查禁目录”

content:
在 2026 年的前 140 天里，伊朗公民只能限制访问互联网，而且只有 20 天。国际特赦组织的艾格尼丝·卡拉玛德表示，在数字封锁的掩护下，伊斯兰共和国对抗议者进行了史无前例的屠杀。它还加快了逮捕、监禁、酷刑、逼供和处决的速度，成为目前中国以外世界上已知的首屈一指的刽子手。在伊朗之外，文学和出版界似乎有一种暗中有组织的行动，旨在压制对该政权的批评，而这些行动的发起者自然应该是持不同政见的伊朗人的盟友：学者、编辑和出版商。作为一名伊朗裔加拿大诗人和翻译家，我最近与编辑和学者发生了令人震惊的遭遇。我粗略地浏览了我在文学期刊和杂志上发表的出版物清单（超过 300 种），以确认我批评伊斯兰共和国的政治诗歌没有出现在加拿大公认的杂志上。这些诗歌已在美国、英国、孟加拉国和澳大利亚出版。我与拒绝我作品的编辑进行的几次交流证明，他们的决定与诗歌的质量无关，而与诗歌的内容有关。
一家位于美国的诗歌媒体犹豫是否接受我的诗歌，因为这些诗“将大屠杀归咎于伊朗当局” 2026 年 1 月伊朗大屠杀之后，一家美国诗歌媒体犹豫是否接受我的诗歌，因为这些诗“将大屠杀归咎于伊朗当局”。这些诗后来被接受，因为编辑从他信任的消息来源那里听到了消息，而他恰好同意我的评估。 2026 年 7 月，同一位编辑拒绝了我受伊朗活动家启发的诗。他称，在美国和以色列发动的战争中，对伊斯兰共和国的批评是煽动性和叛国性的。这位活动家反对战争和国内暴政并不重要。用他的话来说，“更大的利益”是“犹太复国主义和帝国主义的失败”。在最近的另一次遭遇中，加拿大的一家杂志最初接受了我对伊朗持不同政见诗人西娜·贝马内什 (Sina Behmanesh) 的翻译，但后来又拒绝了。小编解释说，他因为以色列美伊战争而改变了主意。就背景而言，战争始于2026年2月28日，直到2026年5月12日，编辑仍在计划出版这些诗歌。为了证明自己的决定合理，他写道：“现在是保持沉默并寻求和解的时候了。说话对任何人都没有帮助。”他写道，他意识到该政权正在变得“极其暴力和镇压”。但他的结论是不出版他的作品，以“保护”诗人和他的亲人。
尽管这位诗人在自己的社交媒体上发表了波斯语原文，而且是加拿大一位直言不讳的活动家，但这并不重要。编辑建议诗人向他发送“恳求爱与和解的诗歌”。用他的话说，“更大的利益是犹太复国主义和帝国主义的失败”。我曾担任文学评审团成员，并目睹了我的加拿大出生的评审员同胞更喜欢不批评南半球政治和宗教制度的作品。其中一些陪审员在大学教授英语和创意写作。许多是加拿大创意写作项目的产物，并且是由这些项目厌恶带有明确政治立场的写作而形成的。杂志读者、文学大赛评委，

【原文 English Original】
In the first 140 days of 2026, Iranian citizens had only restricted access to the internet, and that for only 20 days. Under the cover of a digital blackout, the Islamic Republic committed an unprecedented massacre of protesters, according to Agnes Callamard of Amnesty International. It also accelerated the rate of arrests, jailings, tortures, forced confessions and executions, becoming the world’s leading known current executioner outside of China. Outside Iran, there seems to be a tacit organised effort to silence critics of the regime on the literary and publishing scene, conducted by those who should naturally be allies to dissident Iranians: academics, editors, and publishers. As an Iranian-Canadian poet and translator, I have recently had alarming encounters with editors and academics. I took a cursory look at the list of my publications in literary journals and magazines (over 300), to confirm that none of my political poems critical of the Islamic Republic have appeared in recognised Canadian magazines. These poems have been published in the US, the UK, Bangladesh and Australia. The few exchanges I’ve had with editors who rejected my work prove that their decisions had nothing to do with the quality of the poems and everything to do with their content. One poetry outlet based in the US hesitated to accept my poems because the poems “placed blame for the massacre on the authorities in Iran” After the January 2026 massacre in Iran, one poetry outlet based in the US hesitated to accept my poems because the poems “placed blame for the massacre on the authorities in Iran.” The poems were later accepted because the editor heard from his trusted source, who happened to agree with my assessment. In July 2026, the same editor rejected my poem inspired by an Iranian activist. He described the critique of the Islamic Republic, in the middle of a war launched by the US and Israel, as seditious and treasonous. It did not matter that the activist was against war and domestic tyranny. “The greater good” in his words “is the defeat of Zionism and imperialism”. In another recent encounter, a magazine in Canada initially accepted my translations of a dissident Iranian poet, Sina Behmanesh, only to reject them later. The editor explained that he changed his mind because of the Israel-US-Iran war. For context, the war started on 28 February 2026, and as late as 12 May 2026, the editor was still planning to publish the poems. To justify his decision, he wrote: “Now, it is time to stay silent and search for reconciliation. Speaking won’t help anyone.” He wrote that he was aware that the regime was becoming “extremely violent and repressive.” But his conclusion was to “protect” the poet and his loved ones by not publishing him. And it didn’t matter that the poet had published the original Persian texts on his social media and is an outspoken activist in Canada. The editor advised the poet to send him “poems pleading for love and reconciliation.” “The greater good” in his words “is the defeat of Zionism and imperialism” I have been on literary juries and have witnessed that my fellow Canadian-born jurors prefer works that do not critique political and religious systems in the global South. Some of these jurors teach English and creative writing at universities. Many are products of creative writing programmes in Canada and have been shaped by these programmes’ aversion to writing with a clear political stance. Magazine readers, literary contest judges, editors, and publishers are products of this noncommittal aesthetic. The African American poet and civil rights activist Audre Lorde spoke words that are true: “Your silence will not protect you.” It is also true that silencing others does not protect them. Silencing writers, journalists and activists exposes them to greater danger. It empowers dictators and perpetrators of crimes against humanity and allows them to continue their violent actions with impunity. Censorship is collaboration with criminals, not protection of victims. The poems of Sina Behmanesh have been published in the latest issue of Index on Censorship’s magazine, “Death by a thousand bots”. The post “The greater good”: Why Canadian editors censored Iran’s anti-regime voices appeared first on Index on Censorship .

香港大律师公会发表大埔火灾修法报告 原则上支持把围标定为刑事罪 · 茉莉花新闻网 跳转到主要内容 跳转到页脚 在新标签页中打开
香港大律师公会11月1日发表大埔火灾法律研究专责小组的报告，提出约50项修例建议，涉及《竞争条例》《建筑物管理条例》《建筑物条例》和《消防条例》等至少6条条例。公会原则上支持修改《竞争条例》，把围标定为刑事罪，和现行的民事程序双轨并行，同时要有保障，避免同一行为受两次审判。公会说，专责小组今年1月成立，研究了7个海外司法管辖区的相关条例；研究工作在独立委员会的报告和政府几天前宣布的改革之前就已开始，没有参考两者。
受影响的是要做大型维修工程的业主立案法团和投标的承办商：公会建议，法团的工程超过指定金额时，投标要用双信封制，把技术建议书和价格建议书分开提交，技术建议书达到最低分数后才能打开价格建议书。公会也建议，超过指定金额的投标，所有投标者包括顾问都要用标准表格申报过去的安全纪录，低于指定标准的不予考虑。公会还建议设立安全扣分制：承办商因安全问题被定罪或受纪律处分，扣分超过上限的，在一段时间内不得承接业主立案法团或超过指定金额的工程，关联公司和幕后控制人也适用。公会另外建议，以法例规定注册结构工程师、认可人士等专业人士在获聘前后都要申报实际和潜在的利益冲突，并规定物业管理公司要和业主一同承担维修保养消防设备的法定责任。
公会关注罪行元素和举证责任是否清晰：竞争事务委员会建议在民事程序中由答辩人就「未有透露」举证，公会则建议在刑事诉讼中由控方承担举证责任；公会还建议刑事检控以意图为基础，而不是疏忽、推论知情或严格法律责任。政府建议围标最高可判监禁10年，罚款1000万港元，或违法所得商业得益的3倍，或违法期间每年本地营业额的50%；公会主席毛乐礼说，刑期和其他普通法司法管辖区相近。公会建议刑事化后保留宽待机制，让第一个合资格的申请人获豁免刑事检控，豁免自动延伸到申请人的高级人员、雇员和代理人；毛乐礼说，如果宽待机制不包括刑事检控，可能影响举报人站出来的意愿。公会竞争法专业委员会联席主席林定韵说，原则上同一行为不应同时受刑事检控和竞争事务审裁处罚款，一个过错只应受一次惩罚。
宏福苑大火将近一年，公会说，大火造成168人死亡，约2000个家庭受影响。本站11月1日报道过，独立委员会的报告10月29日公布，点名批评多个部门，房屋局局长何永贤请辞。公会说，知道政府计划修改6条条例，期待看到条例草案。
我们的分析我们认为，大律师公会支持把围标定为刑事罪，但更在意怎样定罪，而不只是要不要定罪。这是因为，公会要求写清楚罪行元素和举证责任、以意图作为检控基础，还要防止同一行为既被刑事检控又被审裁处罚款，这些都是关于怎样定罪的条件；公会还说，宽待机制如果不包括刑事检控，可能影响举报人站出来的意愿。
不同看法竞争事务委员会建议，在民事程序中由答辩人就「未有透露」举证；照这个看法，举证责任可以放在被告一方。我们同意民事程序可以这样安排，但这不改变我们的看法。这是因为，公会说的是刑事诉讼：罪行要由控方举证，检控要以意图为基础，而不是疏忽、推论知情或严格法律责任。
后续走向到11月30日，特区政府会不会在宪报刊登把围标定为刑事罪的条例草案。我们判断，到2026年11月30日，特区政府不会在宪报刊登把围标定为刑事罪的条例草案。这是因为，政府几天前才宣布改革方案；公会说，政府计划修改6条条例，公会正期待看到条例草案。政府建议的是最高10年监禁，公会先提醒的却是罪行元素和举证责任要写清楚。
综合集志社 The Collective HK、香港大律师公会 Hong Kong Bar Association报道

title: 中国国家主席习近平正以创纪录的数量清洗高级官员，以维持党的运转。
source: 澳洲唐人街 – Australia ChinaTown News 中文华人新闻

content: 习近平预计将在 2027 年寻求担任中国共产党总书记的史无前例的第四任期。(路透社：王廷书) 本周，中国共产党（CCP）高层的权力更迭发生了令人震惊的转折。在高级将领清洗之后，中国中央军事委员会的七名成员中仅剩两人，其中包括国家主席习近平。 通过留下五个空缺职位，最高军事指挥体系出现了重大空白，引发了关于中国雄心勃勃的军事扩张与其核心决策者仍不稳定的问题。 这一转变是习近平最新一轮旨在全方位执行党纪的扫荡行动的一部分。 如今已进入第 14 年，习近平标志性的反腐运动，针对“老虎和苍蝇”，已对至少 790 万名涉嫌腐败的中共成员和官员进行了惩处。 在本周中共二十大第五次全体会议上，33 名成员和候补成员被开除出党，其中包括 16 名军人。 此次清洗的规模在近半个世纪中前所未有，创下了空缺席位的纪录，使委员会规模小于往常。 这提出了一个习近平必须面对的重大问题：这是系统性的力量还是失败？ 党的建设 中共被广泛认为是世界上最大的政党之一，拥有高度复杂的组织结构。 建设和管理一个拥有超过 1 亿名成员的政党是一项棘手的任务；这是毛泽东将其视为政党成功关键之一的“三把法宝”之一。 中国共产党（CCP）本周在北京举行了第五次全体会议。(路透社：王廷书) 今年的全会进一步巩固了习近平在党内的核心地位，将严格纪律与其政治意志联系起来。 人们普遍预计，习近平将在 2027 年下半年党的下一次代表大会上寻求担任中共总书记的史无前例的第四任期。 自他掌权以来，中国观察家经常将其反腐运动视为清除其对手的工具。但这次运动也波及到他身边的人，包括前外交部长秦刚，以及像高级军事领导人张又侠这样的权贵人物。 即使清洗波及到他自己的圈子，也有助于习近平强化其权威，使其继续掌控权力的合法性得以确立。 “如果用绝对化的话说，我会说他的下一任期是 100% 的，”前中共党报编辑邓玉文说。 尽管该党在威权体制下运作，但它有着长期的内部竞争历史，这几十年来帮助塑造了权力平衡。 中国领导层在党建全会上开会 习近平的最新举措表明，他正在进一步集中权力，以控制风险并确保其成员牢牢处于控制之下。 “反腐只是方程的一部分，”悉尼大学中国政治副教授陈明禄说。 “这也是关于党的治理能力、它与人民的关系，以及确保中央政府政策得以实施。” 目前尚不确定的是，这种集中化将如何重塑中共长期存在的省际官员竞争以及政治局内部竞争，后者是国家政治机构。 本周该党驱逐了三名前政治局成员。它在高层创造了空缺，为低层人才提供了晋升的机会。 习近平可能利用这一点，允许政党更新其领导层，而无需挑战其权威，这意味着在国家的政治体系中更难表达反对意见。 武装斗争 这是毛泽东的“三把法宝”之二。 习近平的军事使命已从夺取政治权力转变为维护国家安全并捍卫中共的统治。台湾，当然，在这个背景下是政治上最重要的目标之一。 对于习近平来说，实现国家统一不仅关乎中国的领土主张，而且与他所倡导的中国梦——即“民族复兴”的实现——密切相关。 中国人民解放军（PLA）由中国共产党控制。(路透社：王廷书) 全会强调加快中国人民解放军（PLA）的现代化，并继续党在台湾的工作。 然而，习近平对军事人物的持续清洗提出了一个实际问题：加强政治忠诚是否以牺牲军事有效性为代价。 随着 2027 年 PLA 迎来 100 周年，其指挥结构中的权力真空也引发了关于军队是否准备好实现习近平雄心的问题。 “习近平将致力于解决台湾问题。这并不意味着在他离任前台湾将统一，但方向已明确，”邓说。 如果这一评估属实，邓补充道，本周的清洗也可能旨在确保该体制在未来任何冲突中在政治上与习近平的目标保持一致。 至少，习近平正在表明他决心确保军队对党的政治目标的长期服从。 然而，风险在于体制对他人的依赖日益增加。 统一战线 法国足球明星基利安·姆巴佩本周在将毛泽东称为“中国独裁者”后道歉，意外地将党的第三把法宝——统一战线——置于现实世界的考验之中。 该事件恰逢全会，重新引发了人们对毛泽东近 27 年统治及其在一年中中国政治最敏感时期对党的权威影响的问题。 这一争议显示了该党如何将对其政治叙事的批评描绘成对中国人民的“侮辱”，从而团结公众情绪反对外部批评者。 对于中共来说，维护党的权威和控制其叙事不仅关乎国内稳定，而且塑造了中国在国际舞台上的形象。 尽管姆巴佩的言论是随意的，但它触动了中国最敏感的神经。对毛泽东的批评可能会引发对习近平无限期总统任期的审查。 这导致姆巴佩被中国商业合作伙伴、国有广播公司和体育平台取消合作。这显示了该党的影响力如何超越中国国界，中国市场成为对国外个人和机构施压的来源。 由毛泽东倡导的统一战线，原本是中共赢得国内社区支持并团结政治盟友的关键策略。 近年来，西方对这种努力是否也能用于在国界之外施加政治影响表示担忧。 “统一战线的根本原则是团结一切可以团结的力量。中国越来越认识到结交朋友而非制造敌人的重要性，”陈说。 北京中南海领导层大楼外有一块写着“万岁，伟大的中国共产党”的标牌。(美联社：Ng Han Guan) 然而，寻求认可并要求遵守特定的政治叙事是两个截然不同的目标。 当对毛泽东的批评被视为对中国人民的对抗性言论时，正如中国外交部本周所说，北京正在模糊党、中国和中国人民之间的界限。 这使得该党能够利用政治压力和公众情绪作为维护立场的工具。 全会强调全面严格的党的治理和坚持习近平的集中领导，反映了中共管理风险和维持政治秩序的方向。 它不太可能解决党、中国人民和国际社会之间的信任问题。
