content: 在海外留学，感情往往是生活中很重要的一部分。 离开熟悉的家庭和朋友圈，来到一个陌生的国家，身边能说得上话的人不多。一段感情带来的陪伴，有时会让人觉得终于有了依靠。 但当亲密关系开始出现控制、威胁甚至暴力，原本的陪伴也可能变成危险。 2016年，24岁的中国女生毕习习在英国卡迪夫遭男友殴打致死。她身上共有41处损伤，长期遭受暴力的痕迹也出现在尸检报告中。 十年过去，类似的悲剧仍在发生。2026年10月，英国伦敦法院又对一起中国女性遭前男友杀害的案件作出判决。 在异国他乡，一旦亲密关系演变成持续的控制和暴力，受害者可能面临比想象中更复杂的困境。 24岁中国留学生遇害，身上41处伤痕 毕习习出生于南京，她精通四门语言，语言天赋与学习能力令人钦佩。15岁那年，她便凭借自身努力与优秀，远赴牛津开启求学之旅。 大学毕业后，她又毅然前往卡迪夫大学，攻读国际商务硕士学位，那时的她，未来之路铺满了希望与可能，前途一片光明璀璨。 2015年，她在当地酒吧找了一份兼职，当是体验别样生活的一种途径，就是这段经历，却断送了她年轻的生命。 在打工期间，酒吧里的保安马修斯对她持续不断的热情，以及始终如一的坚持，渐渐攻破了她的心防，两人随后发展为恋人并开始同居。 马修斯的经济状况并不稳定。交往期间，毕习习承担了两人的房租和日常开销，也经常为男友支付其他费用。 但一味地付出，反而让这段关系逐渐失去了平衡。 马修斯对小毕的依赖与日俱增，甚至到了理直气壮伸手向她索要金钱的地步。 一旦小毕因为繁重的课业压力或者自身经济上的捉襟见肘而拒绝他的要求，他便会瞬间变脸，用暴力来宣泄自己的不满。 第一次遭受暴力，仅仅是因为她上课时，没能及时回复马修斯那句“你帮我买个饭”的消息。 据案件审理期间披露的信息，马修斯长期对毕习习实施身体暴力和言语羞辱。 她的亲友注意到，她的状态与过去相比发生了明显变化，脸上的淤青也曾引起旁人怀疑。为了遮掩伤痕，她开始化浓妆。 但这段关系并没有因此结束。 2016年8月，马修斯要求毕习习向家里要钱为自己购买宝马汽车。遭到拒绝后再次对毕习习施暴，最终导致她死亡。救援人员赶到时，她已经没有生命体征。 尸检显示，毕习习全身有41处损伤，包括下颌骨骨折、多根肋骨断裂以及大面积瘀伤。 部分伤势处于不同的愈合阶段，表明她此前可能已经遭受过多次暴力。 案件审理期间，马修斯试图以过失杀人等说法为自己辩解，还声称毕习习使用约会软件，引发了他的愤怒。 但警方调查后发现，根本没有任何小毕出轨的证据，反而看到小毕在这段关系里，不管是经济上还是情感上，都一心一意地付出，从来没有背叛过。 2017年2月17日，英国法院做出了最终判决：马修斯谋杀罪成立，判无期徒刑，最低得服刑18年。 这场“爱情”最后变成了一场悲剧。 十年后的今天，又发生一次类似案件 2026年10月，英国伦敦中央刑事法院对中国女性柯晓清遭杀害一案作出判决。 39岁的柯晓清在国内独自抚养两个孩子，赴英后曾在南安普顿生活，之后搬到伦敦。 她与24岁的印度籍男子迪帕克·桑杜交往后，逐渐发现对方存在欺骗和侵占财物等问题。 庭审信息显示，桑杜曾偷走她的钱财，并有控制其手机、护照等行为。 2025年8月，柯晓清提出分手，并要求对方归还欠款。 但分手没有让骚扰停止。 2025年12月，桑杜以归还欠款等理由接近柯晓清，随后持刀袭击她，造成38处刀伤。 行凶后，他更换手机卡并购买机票，试图离开英国，最终在前往机场的途中被警方抓获。 2026年10月，陪审团裁定桑杜谋杀及妨碍司法公正罪名成立。法院判处其终身监禁，最低服刑28年后才可申请假释。 每当类似案件发生，外界很容易把注意力放在受害者身上，追问她们为什么没有早点离开。 但长期处于暴力关系中的人，往往面对着比旁人想象中更复杂的处境。 一段关系开始时，未必就伴随着明显的暴力。对方可能先表现得体贴、热情，随后逐渐干涉日常生活，要求随时回复消息，限制与朋友来往，甚至通过贬低和威胁，让另一方不断怀疑自己。 当控制越来越严重，受害者可能已经习惯了为对方的行为找理由，也可能担心分手后遭到报复。 对留学生而言，异国生活还会增加一些现实困难。 语言不熟练、不清楚当地法律和求助渠道、身边缺少可以立即联系的亲友，都可能让人更难应对突发状况。有些人担心把感情问题告诉家人，会引发争执；也有人害怕报警后影响学业、签证或个人生活，于是选择暂时忍耐。 留学生遭遇到类似情况一定要保护自己 此前一项针对澳大利亚女性国际学生的研究访谈了30名来自16个国家的学生，其中23人表示曾经历亲密关系暴力。研究指出，社会孤立是受访者寻求帮助时面临的突出障碍之一。 跨国恋爱本身没有问题。不同国家、不同文化背景的人建立感情关系，是再正常不过的事。真正需要关注的，是一个人在相处过程中如何对待伴侣。 尤其需要记住，第一次出现暴力时，不必等到下一次发生，才证明这段关系有问题。 推搡、扇耳光、威胁伤害，以及以自伤相逼迫，都不应该被当成普通的情侣争执。 如果已经出现危险信号，优先考虑安全，比试图改变对方更重要。 在澳大利亚，遇到紧急危险时可以拨打000；在英国，紧急情况下可以拨打999。身处其他国家时，应提前了解当地的紧急求助号码。学校的学生服务部门、国际学生支持团队，以及所在地区的相关援助机构，也可能提供实际帮助。 如果担心语言沟通困难，可以提前了解当地的翻译服务。不要因为英语不够流利，或者不确定事情是否严重，就放弃寻求帮助。 对于身边的人来说，发现朋友突然变得沉默、频繁遮掩伤痕，或者明显与原有社交圈疏远时，也可以主动关心。与其急着批评她的选择，不如先让她知道，自己愿意倾听，也愿意在她需要时提供帮助。 毕习习案已经过去近十年，柯晓清案也有了法院判决。 但刑罚无法挽回逝去的生命，更无法消除留给家人的伤痛。 对在海外学习和生活的人而言，感情可以慢慢了解，关系也可以随时重新评估。无论对方来自哪个国家，都不应该以爱为理由限制你的自由，更不应该让你生活在恐惧之中。 如果一段关系已经让你感到害怕，离开并不是失败。 保护自己，也不需要向任何人证明理由。

title: Officers lack power to order identity proof under police ordinance, court hears as Ronson Chan seeks top court appeal
zh_title: 陈荣森向最高法院提出上诉，法庭听取了警察法令，官员无权下令提供身份证明
summary: 香港最大报业工会前主席陈荣森的律师辩称，《警察条例》并没有授权警员要求提供身份证明。 Ronson Chan，2023 年 5 月 16 日。照片：Lea Mok/HKFP。 2021年至2024年执掌香港记者协会（HKJA）的陈肇始周三向高等法院申请允许向最高法院提出质疑。他正在寻求终审法院的证明，这是复杂的最高法院上诉程序的第一步。
content:
香港最大报业工会前主席陈荣森的律师辩称，《警察条例》并没有授权警员要求提供身份证明。 Ronson Chan，2023 年 5 月 16 日。照片：Lea Mok/HKFP。 2021年至2024年执掌香港记者协会（HKJA）的陈肇始周三向高等法院申请允许向最高法院提出质疑。他正在寻求终审法院的证明，这是该市法律体系复杂的最高法院上诉程序的第一步。这位资深记者于 2023 年 9 月因前一年妨碍警察罪被定罪，被判处 5 天监禁。该案与2022年9月发生的一起事件有关，当时41岁的他正在旺角麦花臣大球场报道业主委员会会议。在执行任务时，他被一名便衣警察拦住，警察称他的行为“可疑”，并要求查看他的身份证。高等法院。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。据称，尽管多次警告，他仍没有遵守出示身份证明的要求，因此被捕。据当地媒体报道，陈的律师关史蒂文周三在法庭上发言时表示，该警官命令记者出示身份证，因为她有权根据《警察条例》出示身份证。
但他表示，法律的措辞表明警官实际上并没有这种权力。关说，该法令第 54 条描述了授权警官阻止某人“以要求他出示身份证明以供检查”，但没有明确规定警官有权阻止他们并要求提供身份证明。他说，标题为“阻止、拘留和搜查的权力”的法令部分明确指出了警察对这三项行动的权利，但不要求提供身份证明。他说，另外两项条例，即《公安条例》和《入境条例》，也规定了要求提供证据的权力。 2022 年 9 月 19 日，香港记者协会主席陈启宗在旺角警署外。照片：Peter Lee/HKFP。他说，《公共秩序条例》规定，如果认为有必要防止或调查犯罪，官员可以要求提供身份证明。关说，因此，该官员不应能够依据该条例要求陈出示身份证。对此，司法部代表指责关先生玩“文字游戏”并试图改写法律。高等法院副法官 Lily Wong 于周三听取了双方的论点，并推迟了裁决。陈先生今年早些时候在高等法院上诉失败后提出了挑战。
今年5月，高等法院法官维持了陈的定罪和刑罚，同意主审法官的观点，即警官要求查看陈的身份证的要求是合法的，陈故意拖延出示身份证，从而妨碍警方执法。

【原文 English Original】
The police ordinance does not empower officers to demand identity proof, a lawyer for Ronson Chan has argued as the former head of Hong Kong’s largest press union applied to challenge his conviction for obstructing police at the Court of Final Appeal. Ronson Chan on May 16, 2023. Photo: Lea Mok/HKFP. Ronson Chan, who helmed the Hong Kong Journalists Association (HKJA) from 2021 to 2024, applied to the High Court on Wednesday for permission to take his challenge to the top court. He is seeking a Certificate to Court of Final Appeal, the first step in the convoluted top court appeal procedures in the city’s legal system. The veteran reporter was convicted in September 2023 of obstructing a police officer the previous year and sentenced to five days in jail. The case relates to  an incident in September 2022 , when the then-41-year-old was reporting on a homeowners’ committee meeting at MacPherson Stadium in Mong Kok. While on assignment, he was stopped by a plainclothes police officer who said he was acting “suspiciously” and asked to see his identification card. The High Court. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. He was arrested after allegedly not complying with requests to present his identification despite multiple warnings. Police Force Ordinance Addressing the court on Wednesday, Chan’s barrister Steven Kwan said the officer ordered the journalist to produce his identification card on the basis that she had the right to under the Police Force Ordinance, according to local media. But he said the wording of the law suggested officers do not in fact have that power. Kwan said Section 54 of the ordinance describes empowering an officer to stop someone “for the purpose of demanding that he produce proof of his identity for inspection,” but does not explicitly state that officers have the power to stop them and demand identity proof. He said the ordinance section, titled “power to stop, detain and search,” clearly indicated officers’ rights to those three actions – but not for demanding identity proof. The power to demand proof is spelled out in two other ordinances, the Public Order Ordinance and the Immigration Ordinance, he said. Ronson Chan, chairperson of the Hong Kong Journalists Association, outside the Mong Kok Police Station on September 19, 2022. Photo: Peter Lee/HKFP. The Public Order Ordinance states that officers can order proof of identity if believed necessary for preventing or investigating an offence, he said. Therefore, the officer should not have been able to rely on the ordinance to demand Chan produce his identity card, Kwan said. In response, the Department of Justice representative accused Kwan of playing “word games” and attempting to rewrite the law. Deputy High Court Judge Lily Wong heard both sides’ arguments on Wednesday and adjourned her decision. Chan’s challenge comes after he lost his appeal in the High Court earlier this year. In May, a High Court judge upheld Chan’s conviction and sentence, agreeing with the trial judge’s view that the police officer’s demand to see Chan’s identification card was lawful and that Chan had obstructed the police by wilfully delaying the presentation of his ID.

title: Hong Kong civil service pension costs top HK$500 billion, may peak in mid-2030s
zh_title: 香港公务员养老金成本突破5000亿港元 或于2030年代中期达到顶峰
summary: 香港 2025-26 年，香港公务员和司法养老金支出超过 5000 亿港元，比五年前增长 18%，政府预计从 2030 年代中期开始逐渐下降。截至 2025 年 3 月，精算负债为 9,248 亿港元，但官方排除了问题 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026年10月28日 12:25 HKT · 2分钟读懂香港公务员和司法人员养老金支出大幅上升
content:
香港
2025-26年，香港公务员和司法养老金支出超过5000亿港元，比五年前增长18%，政府预计从2030年代中期开始逐渐下降。截至 2025 年 3 月，精算负债为 9,248 亿港元，但官员排除了问题的可能性

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 28 日 12:25 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

根据2026年10月28日发布的政府对立法问题的答复，香港公务员和司法人员养老金支出大幅上升，从五年前的约4,220亿港元，在2025-26财政年度达到逾5,000亿港元。同期，养老金领取者人数从约15万人增至超过16万人，增幅为9%。

在2025-26财政年度，新退休公务员及司法人员每月平均领取退休金约20,200港元，而已退休人员每月平均领取约17,700港元。 2.1%的生活费用调整使每位养老金领取者每月增加约370港元。
政府表示，固定福利养老金计划仅适用于2000年6月1日之前雇用的员工。预计年度养老金支出将在几年内持续上升，然后从2030年代中期开始逐渐下降。公务员事务局估计，到 2040 年左右，几乎所有剩余的计划成员都会退休，但无法提供准确数字。

截至2026年3月31日，约有16万名退休公务员和司法人员每月领取养老金。回复中没有透露活跃计划成员的人数。财政部没有保留这两个群体按性别划分的现成细目。

截至2025年3月31日，未来退休金的法定精算负债为9,248亿港元，其中约40%由在职员工承担，60%由退休人员承担。政府强调，这是预计 40 至 50 年或更长时间的累计付款的现值，而不是需要立即提供的金额。

当被问及政府是否会考虑发行约6,500亿港元的通胀挂钩债券以锁定养老金成本时，当局拒绝了这一想法。他们表示，养老金是2000年之前雇员雇佣合同的一部分，作为负责任的雇主，政府不应单方面改变付款条件。现行退休金法例要求从政府一般收入中支付，政府没有计划改变退休金支付金额或方式。

Hong Kong
Hong Kong's civil service and judicial pension spending exceeded HK$500 billion in 2025-26, up 18 per cent from five years earlier, with the government projecting gradual declines from the mid-2030s. The actuarial liability stood at HK$924.8 billion as of March 2025, though officials ruled out issui

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

28 Oct 2026 at 12:25 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong's civil service and judicial pension spending has risen sharply, reaching more than HK$500 billion in the 2025-26 financial year from about HK$422 billion five years earlier, according to a government reply to a legislative question published on 28 October 2026. The number of pension recipients grew from about 150,000 to more than 160,000 over the same period, an increase of 9 per cent.

For the 2025-26 financial year, newly retired civil servants and judicial officers received an average monthly pension of about HK$20,200, while those already retired received about HK$17,700 per month. A 2.1 per cent cost-of-living adjustment added about HK$370 per month per pensioner.

The government said the defined-benefit pension scheme applies only to staff hired before 1 June 2000. It expects annual pension expenditure to keep rising for some years before gradually declining from the mid-2030s. The Civil Service Bureau estimated that virtually all remaining scheme members would have retired by around 2040, though it could not provide precise figures.

As of 31 March 2026, about 160,000 retired civil servants and judicial officers were drawing monthly pensions. The number of active scheme members was not disclosed in the reply. The Treasury does not maintain a readily available breakdown by gender for either group.

The statutory actuarial liability for future pension payments stood at HK$924.8 billion as of 31 March 2025, with about 40 per cent attributable to serving staff and 60 per cent to retirees. The government stressed that this is the present value of projected cumulative payments spread over 40 to 50 years or more, not a sum requiring immediate provision.

Asked whether the government would consider issuing about HK$650 billion in inflation-linked bonds to lock in pension costs, the authorities rejected the idea. They said the pension is part of employment contracts for pre-2000 hires and that, as a responsible employer, the government should not unilaterally alter payment terms. Existing pension laws require payments from general revenue, and the government has no plans to change the amount or method of pension disbursement.

title: Hong Kong targets 5,000 fast chargers by 2031 under new EV plan
zh_title: 根据新的电动汽车计划，香港的目标是到 2031 年拥有 5,000 个快速充电桩
summary: 香港 香港政府表示，该市拥有超过 18,000 个公共充电器，但计划在五年内增加 5,000 个快速充电器，以支持不断增长的电动汽车数量。新计划针对商用车和更快的充电技术。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 28 日 12:35 HKT · 2 分钟阅读 Hong香港政府于 10 月 28 日表示，目标是将电动汽车 (EV) 高速公共充电桩数量增加至 5,000 瓦
content:
香港
香港政府表示，该市拥有超过 18,000 个公共充电器，但计划在五年内增加 5,000 个快速充电器，以支持不断增长的电动汽车数量。新计划针对商用车和更快的充电技术。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 28 日 12:35 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港政府于 10 月 28 日表示，根据 2026 年施政报告中概述的计划，目标是在五年内将电动汽车 (EV) 高速公共充电桩的数量增加到 5,000 个。该目标是支持该市到 2050 年实现零排放汽车目标的努力的一部分。

政府表示，截至2026年9月底，香港电动汽车数量超过18万辆，是2021年的六倍多。车辆与公共充电桩的比例已扩大至约10.5:1，现有公共充电桩超过60%属于中速，充满电需要几个小时。
政府在回应立法质询时透露，2025年7月推出的3亿港元高速充电桩激励计划，截至2026年9月已向792个高速充电桩发出认可信，其中124个已投入运营。该计划旨在利用私营部门投资扩大快速充电网络。政府还指出，已于2026年10月1日优化了该方案，放宽了申请条件，简化了移动充电设备和电池存储系统的要求，引起了积极的市场反应。

在商用车问题上，政府承认，包括纯电动小巴在内的电动商用车因技术不成熟、购买成本高和续航里程有限而面临挑战。该公司表示，已与业界成立工作小组，帮助推出更多合适的车型，并将公共小巴作为试点目标。扩大充电设施的措施包括：逐步将加油站改造成高速充电站，现有约60个加油站预计可提供多达180个快速充电桩；耗资2,000万港元的商用车专用快速充电器计划；目标是到2027年底安装50个电动出租车专用快速充电器，其中12个已投入运营。
政府表示，现时没有计划在路边泊车咪表位大规模安装充电设施，但会研究在东涌及大澳两个新公众停车场提供充电服务的可行性，并鼓励快速充电站营运商对充电完成后仍停泊的车辆征收附加费，以提高周转率。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Hong Kong’s government says the city has over 18,000 public chargers but plans to add 5,000 fast chargers within five years to support rising EV numbers. New schemes target commercial vehicles and faster charging tech.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

28 Oct 2026 at 12:35 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong’s government said on 28 October that it aims to increase the number of high-speed public charging piles for electric vehicles (EVs) to 5,000 within five years, under a plan outlined in the 2026 Policy Address. The target forms part of efforts to support the city’s goal of achieving zero-emission vehicles by 2050.

According to the government, the number of EVs in Hong Kong exceeded 180,000 as of the end of September 2026, more than six times the figure for 2021. The ratio of vehicles to public charging piles has widened to about 10.5:1, with over 60 per cent of existing public chargers classified as medium-speed, requiring several hours for a full charge.

In response to a legislative question, the government disclosed that a HK$300 million High-Speed Charging Pile Incentive Scheme, launched in July 2025, had issued recognition letters for 792 high-speed piles by September 2026, of which 124 were already operational. The scheme aims to leverage private-sector investment to expand the fast-charging network. The government also noted that it had optimised the scheme on 1 October 2026, relaxing application conditions and simplifying requirements for mobile charging equipment and battery storage systems, resulting in a positive market response.

On the issue of commercial vehicles, the government acknowledged that electric commercial vehicles, including pure-electric minibuses, face challenges due to immature technology, high purchase costs and limited range. It said it had set up a working group with the industry to help introduce more suitable models, with public minibuses as a trial target. Measures to expand charging facilities include: gradually converting petrol stations into high-speed charging stations, with about 60 existing stations expected to provide up to 180 fast chargers; a HK$20 million scheme for commercial-vehicle-specific fast chargers; and a target to install 50 dedicated fast chargers for electric taxis by the end of 2027, with 12 already in operation.

The government said it has no current plans to install charging facilities on a large scale at roadside parking meter spaces, but it will explore the feasibility of providing charging at two new public car parks in Tung Chung and Tai O. It also encourages operators of fast-charging stations to impose surcharges on vehicles that remain parked after charging is complete, to improve turnover.

title: Hong Kong lawmaker calls for more early adoption pathways for tech startups
zh_title: 香港立法会议员呼吁为科技初创企业提供更多早期采用途径
summary: 香港一位香港立法者敦促政府为科技初创公司创造更多途径，让其产品尽早被采用。政府为现有计划辩护，其中包括一项试验计划，该计划在三年内资助了超过 110 个项目，总价值超过 2.7 亿港元。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 28 日 13:15 HKT · 2 分钟阅读 A 香港立法者敦促政府为技术创新创造更多途径
content:
香港
一位香港立法者敦促政府为科技初创公司创造更多途径，让他们的产品尽早被采用。政府为现有计划辩护，其中包括一项试验计划，该计划在三年内资助了超过 110 个项目，总价值超过 2.7 亿港元。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 28 日 13:15 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

一位香港立法者敦促政府为科技初创公司创造更多途径，以确保其产品获得早期采用者，并警告说，缺乏此类机会会阻碍研究的商业化。

在 10 月 28 日的立法会质询中，议员 Johnny Ng 询问政府和法定机构在过去三年中提供了哪些资助计划来支持本地科技产品的早期采用，并要求提供有关金额、期限和结果的详细信息。他还询问政府是否会考虑采取政策措施来促进早期采用，例如在政府招标中优先考虑本地初创企业，以及是否会加强与大湾区内地城市的跨境政策协调，以帮助初创企业扩张。
创新科技工业局回应政府表示，当局一直积极引进和应用本地初创企业的产品。创新科技署公营机构试验计划过去三年资助超过110个试验项目，价值逾2.7亿港元。数字政策办公室下属的智慧政府创新实验室针对30多个政府部门的约60个业务需求匹配了解决方案，并为30多个潜在技术解决方案安排了概念验证试验，其中一些最终获得试点使用。机电工程署网上平台收集超过110项科技愿望及超过760项科技建议，成功配对超过110个涉及人工智能、物联网、无人机、机械人及可再生能源的项目。

该局补充说，香港科技园公司、河套区香港科技园公司和数码港这三大科技园也帮助初创企业与业界建立联系，并通过其投资和商业网络促进早期采用。
在采购方面，该局表示，香港作为世界贸易组织政府采购协议的成员，必须确保本地和外国供应商的投标程序公平和公开。对于非工程采购，采购部门一般不会将投标人的经验列为鼓励竞争的硬性要求。采用评分系统时，技术分数通常占总分的50%至70%，其中至少15%保留用于评估采用技术提高服务效率、有效性和生产力的创新提案。

为帮助初创企业拓展内地市场，政府表示与大湾区城市当局保持密切联系，每年举办香港国际科技展（InnoEX）等科技活动，以促进商业配对和交流。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
A Hong Kong legislator has urged the government to create more avenues for technology startups to have their products adopted early. The government defended existing schemes, including a trial programme that funded over 110 projects worth more than HK$270 million in three years.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

28 Oct 2026 at 13:15 HKT · 2 min read

A Hong Kong legislator has pressed the government to create more pathways for technology startups to secure early adopters for their products, warning that a lack of such opportunities hinders commercialisation of research.

In a legislative council question on 28 October, lawmaker Johnny Ng asked what funding schemes the government and statutory bodies had provided over the past three years to support early adoption of local tech products, requesting details on amounts, duration and outcomes. He also asked whether the government would consider policy measures to boost early adoption, such as giving local startups priority in government tenders, and whether it would strengthen cross-border policy coordination with mainland cities in the Greater Bay Area to help startups expand.

Responding for the government, the Innovation, Technology and Industry Bureau said authorities had been actively introducing and applying products from local startups. The Innovation and Technology Commission’s Public Sector Trial Scheme funded more than 110 trial projects worth over HK$270 million in the past three years, it said. The Smart Government Innovation Lab under the Digital Policy Office matched solutions for about 60 business needs across over 30 government departments and arranged proof-of-concept trials for more than 30 potential tech solutions, some of which were eventually adopted for pilot use. The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department’s online platform collected over 110 tech wishes and more than 760 tech proposals, successfully matching over 110 projects involving artificial intelligence, the Internet of Things, drones, robotics and renewable energy.

The three major science parks — the Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation, the Hong Kong Park Company in the Loop and Cyberport — also help startups connect with industry and facilitate early adoption through their investment and business networks, the bureau added.

On procurement, the bureau said Hong Kong, as a member of the World Trade Organization Agreement on Government Procurement, must ensure fair and open bidding procedures for both local and foreign suppliers. For non-engineering purchases, procuring departments generally do not list bidders’ experience as a mandatory requirement to encourage competition. When a scoring system is used, technical scores typically account for 50 to 70 per cent of the total, with at least 15 per cent reserved for evaluating innovative proposals that adopt technology to improve service efficiency, effectiveness and productivity.

To help startups expand into the mainland market, the government said it maintains close contact with authorities in Greater Bay Area cities and organises annual tech events such as the Hong Kong International Tech Fair (InnoEX) to facilitate business matching and exchanges.

[![Image 3: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

title: Hong Kong government weighs 'failure to protect' law amid rising child abuse cases
zh_title: 香港政府在虐待儿童案件不断增加的情况下考虑“未能保护”法律
summary: 政府 香港政府表示，将首先全面实施强制性儿童虐待报告法，然后再考虑“未能保护”罪行。它计划在 2027 年初试用一个使用人工智能识别高风险家庭的社会福利数据共享平台。政府也捍卫其做法 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), 主编 2026 年 10 月 28 日 14:00 HKT · 2 分钟阅读 香港政府表示将首先全面实施
content:
政府
香港政府表示，将首先全面实施虐待儿童强制报告法，然后再考虑“未能保护”罪行。它计划在 2027 年初试用一个使用人工智能识别高风险家庭的社会福利数据共享平台。政府还为其方法辩护。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 28 日 14:00 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

香港政府在 10 月 28 日回应立法质询时表示，将首先全面实施虐待儿童的强制报告制度，然后再决定是否引入“未能保护”罪名。

立法会议员卢家强询问，政府在检讨于2026年1月20日生效的《强制报告虐待儿童条例》时，会否研究设立“未能保护”罪行。该条例要求指定专业人士在切实可行的范围内尽快报告对儿童严重伤害或严重伤害风险的合理怀疑。
政府回应称，该条例实施顺利，加强了公众对儿童保护的关注。它指出，法律改革委员会于 2021 年 9 月建议将“未能保护”定为犯罪，这符合该法令强制某些人采取合理措施保护儿童免受严重伤害的政策目标。不过，政府表示，将首先重点关注强制报告机制，确保足够的紧急安置和专业支持，并为指定专业人员提供培训，然后再考虑采取进一步措施。

在识别高风险家庭方面，政府概述了现有机制，包括2005年推出的综合儿童发展服务，该服务涉及社会福利署、卫生署、医院管理局和教育局，以识别有五岁以下儿童的高风险家庭。今年成立了四所社区亲子中心，倡导积极育儿。全港现时共有65间综合家庭服务中心及两间综合服务中心。
2026年施政报告宣布分阶段建立“社会福利数据共享平台”，整合政府部门和非政府组织的数据。该平台将利用人工智能及早识别高风险个人或家庭，进行有针对性的干预。政府表示，计划在2027年上半年与选定的部门和非政府组织进行数据整合和分析试点，然后逐步扩大该平台的应用，并将儿童保护作为首要任务。

在防止福利滥用方面，政府表示综合社会保障援助（综援）计划维持严格的经济审查。虽然不能因情况不同而对受助人实行统一的支出限制，但对滥用行为采取零容忍态度。社会福利署积极调查虐待举报，定期与其他机构进行数据核对，并对严重案件提出刑事检控。若综援停止发放，社署会转介受影响人士，包括儿童，到适当的服务机构寻求跟进援助。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.

【原文 English Original】
Government
Hong Kong's government says it will first fully implement the mandatory child abuse reporting law before considering a 'failure to protect' offence. It plans to trial a social welfare data-sharing platform using AI to identify high-risk families in early 2027. The government also defends its approac

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

28 Oct 2026 at 14:00 HKT · 2 min read

The Hong Kong government has said it will first fully implement the mandatory reporting regime for child abuse before deciding whether to introduce a 'failure to protect' offence, in response to a legislative question on 28 October.

Lawmaker Lou Ka-keung asked whether the government would study creating a 'failure to protect' offence while reviewing the Mandatory Reporting of Child Abuse Ordinance, which took effect on 20 January 2026. The ordinance requires designated professionals to report reasonable suspicions of serious harm or risk of serious harm to a child as soon as practicable.

The government replied that the ordinance has been implemented smoothly and has strengthened public attention on child protection. It noted that the Law Reform Commission recommended a 'failure to protect' offence in September 2021, which aligns with the ordinance's policy goal of compelling certain persons to take reasonable steps to protect children from serious harm. However, the government said it will first focus on monitoring the mandatory reporting mechanism, ensuring adequate emergency placement and professional support, and providing training for designated professionals before considering further measures.

On identifying high-risk families, the government outlined existing mechanisms including the Comprehensive Child Development Service launched in 2005, which involves the Social Welfare Department, Department of Health, Hospital Authority and Education Bureau to identify at-risk families with children aged up to five. Four community parent-child centres were established this year to promote positive parenting. There are currently 65 Integrated Family Services Centres and two Integrated Services Centres across Hong Kong.

The 2026 Policy Address announced a phased establishment of a 'Social Welfare Data Sharing Platform' that will integrate data from government departments and NGOs. The platform will use artificial intelligence to identify high-risk individuals or families early for targeted intervention. The government said it aims to trial data integration and analysis with selected departments and NGOs in the first half of 2027, then gradually expand the platform's application, with child protection as a key priority.

Regarding welfare abuse prevention, the government said the Comprehensive Social Security Assistance (CSSA) scheme maintains strict means testing. While it cannot impose uniform spending restrictions on recipients due to differing circumstances, it takes a zero-tolerance approach to abuse. The Social Welfare Department actively investigates reports of abuse, conducts regular data cross-checks with other agencies, and pursues criminal prosecution in serious cases. If CSSA payments are stopped, the department will refer affected individuals, including children, to appropriate services for follow-up assistance.

title: Hong Kong government outlines plans to boost 'island-hopping' ferry links
zh_title: 香港政府概述了加强“跳岛”渡轮连接的计划
summary: 香港运输当局表示，他们鼓励渡轮运营商尝试连接离岛的新航线，而无需集中转运，并将继续简化街渡渡轮服务的发牌程序。政府正在香港旅游局下推广海岛旅游 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 28 日11:10 HKT · 2 分钟阅读 香港政府概述了发展跳岛游的战略
content:
香港
香港交通当局表示，他们鼓励渡轮运营商尝试连接离岛的新航线，而无需集中转运，并将继续简化街渡渡轮服务的发牌程序。政府正在香港旅游局推动海岛旅游

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 28 日 11:10 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

香港政府制定了通过改善离岛之间的渡轮连接来发展跳岛旅游的战略，这是香港旅游蓝图2.0的重要组成部分。运输局及文化体育及旅游局于2026年10月28日向立法会回覆，详细阐述水运现时的服务及未来计划。

政府指出，香港拥有1,180公里海岸线和263个岛屿。发展海岛旅游，要尊重生态环境，考虑海岸线和岛屿承载能力。目前，有14条持牌渡轮航线和68条街渡航线提供前往离岛的水上交通，包括长洲、梅窝、大澳和西贡外岛等热门旅游目的地。
至于新增离岛直达航线，运输局表示欢迎并鼓励渡轮营办商考虑开发新航线，包括设有多个站点的航线，以吸引更多乘客。文告举例，沙头角往荔枝窝、鸭洲及吉澳的街东路线，是应政府邀请，根据沙头角第二阶段开放计划，于2024年初开通的。该局表示，允许运营商根据需求灵活调整服务，包括在旺季增加班次，并欢迎新航线试运营以测试市场反应。

在简化街东渡轮发牌程序方面，该局表示已设立网上渠道，用于提交街东渡轮航线牌照的申请和续签。全年均可提交申请。该局表示，会继续积极跟进所有街东渡轮服务申请，包括为申请者提供协助，以及与海事处、土木工程拓展署及相关民政事务处等相关部门紧密沟通，以加快审批程序。
为了降低跳岛游客的交通成本，政府表示鼓励渡轮运营商提供各种票价优惠，例如多程票，包括月票、当日往返票和假期往返票。运输局透过「离岛游计划」，为合资格团体到离岛举办活动提供免费渡轮服务。去年，约有4万人根据该计划免费出行。

文化体育及旅游局透过香港旅游发展局，继续透过「探索香港」平台、宣传影片及社交媒体内容推广海岛旅游。鼓励业界利用海岛资源开发更具特色的海岛旅游产品。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Hong Kong's transport authorities said they encourage ferry operators to trial new routes linking outlying islands without requiring a central transfer, and will continue to simplify licensing procedures for kaito ferry services. The government is promoting island tourism under the Hong Kong Tourism

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

28 Oct 2026 at 11:10 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong's government has outlined its strategy to develop island-hopping tourism, a key component of the Hong Kong Tourism Blueprint 2.0, by improving ferry connections between outlying islands. In a legislative council reply on 28 October 2026, the Transport Bureau and the Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau detailed current services and future plans for water transport.

The government noted that Hong Kong has 1,180 kilometres of coastline and 263 islands. It said it will develop island tourism while respecting the ecological environment and considering the carrying capacity of the coastline and islands. Currently, 14 licensed ferry routes and 68 kaito (small ferry) routes provide water transport to outlying islands, including popular tourist destinations such as Cheung Chau, Mui Wo, Tai O and the outer islands of Sai Kung.

Regarding new direct routes between islands, the Transport Bureau said it welcomes and encourages ferry operators to consider developing new routes, including those with multiple stops, to attract more passengers. It cited the example of a kaito route from Sha Tau Kok to Lai Chi Wo, Ap Chau and Kat O, which was launched in early 2024 following a government invitation under the second phase of the Sha Tau Kok opening plan. The bureau said it allows operators to flexibly adjust services based on demand, including increasing frequencies during peak seasons, and welcomes trial operations of new routes to test market reception.

On simplifying licensing procedures for kaito ferries, the bureau said it has set up an online channel for submitting applications and renewals for kaito ferry route licences. Applications can be submitted year-round. The bureau said it will continue to actively follow up on all kaito ferry service applications, including providing assistance to applicants and communicating closely with relevant departments such as the Marine Department, the Civil Engineering and Development Department and the relevant District Offices to speed up the approval process.

To reduce transport costs for island-hopping tourists, the government said it encourages ferry operators to offer various fare concessions, such as multi-trip tickets, including monthly passes, same-day return tickets and holiday return tickets. Through the 'Island Excursion Scheme', the Transport Bureau provides free ferry travel to eligible groups organising activities on outlying islands. In the past year, about 40,000 people travelled free of charge under this scheme.

The Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau, via the Hong Kong Tourism Board, continues to promote island tourism through the Discover Hong Kong platform, promotional videos and social media content. It encourages the industry to develop more distinctive island tourism products using island resources.

法国足球巨星基利安·姆巴佩（Kylian Mbappé）因一段视频陷入风波，多家中国赞助商已终止与他的合作。视频中，他似乎在谈论一张把他的脸换到毛泽东身上的表情包。

片段中，姆巴佩说，最让他发笑的表情包，是把他的脸叠在“一个人的身体上，我想他是中国的独裁者”。

他还说，自己会“经常和网上的朋友们用这个表情包”。

片段中出现一张图片显示，姆巴佩的头像被合成到似乎是中华人民共和国开国领袖毛泽东的身体上。

姆巴佩在片段中说，他“经常和网上的朋友们用这个表情包”。(Supplied: Reddit)

澳大利亚广播公司（ABC）无法核实这段视频的真实性，已联系表情包的制作者置评。

该片段似乎出自今年早些时候法语谈话节目《The Bridge》的一段后台采访。

姆巴佩周二晚间发表声明，向“所有被我的言论所伤害的人”道歉。

他在声明中说：“我的言论欠妥，如今我明白，这些话伤害了中国以及世界各地华人社区的许多人。”

“这绝非我的本意。”

> "我对中国人民及其历史怀有深深的敬意，我真心感到抱歉。"

这场风波发生的时间，与周一举行的国际足球盛事金球奖颁奖典礼大致重合。

中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆表示：“伤害中国人民感情的言行自然会遭到中国社会各界的共同抵制。”

东鹏饮料集团宣布终止与姆巴佩的合作。该公司在今年4月，世界杯开赛前，官宣姆巴佩为旗下电解质饮料的品牌代言人。

东鹏饮料在声明中说：“我司坚决反对、零容忍伤害民族感情的行为。即日起终止与基利安·姆巴佩全部合作。”

中国乳企蒙牛和妙可蓝多也宣布终止与这名法国球员的合作。

## “他到底说啥了？”

东鹏饮料的声明周二下午登上微博热搜榜首，相关话题页面的阅读量已超过六亿。

但一些中国网民似乎并不清楚事件的起因。

一名网民写道：“[他]到底说啥了？热搜上全是解约，搜不到一个他说了什么。”

东鹏饮料称，已终止与基利安·姆巴佩的合作。(Weibo: Yi Cheng Feng Xu)

还有人用更隐晦的方式提及这场争议。

另一名网民写道：“说百元人民币[上的人]是‘堵猜’（谐音‘独裁’）。”

中国体育平台懂球帝表示，不会翻译姆巴佩的言论。

懂球帝在声明中说：“近日，效力于皇家马德里的法国球员姆巴佩在接受采访时发表涉中国的不当言论。由于他的发言涉及对中国和中国人民的伤害，我们不能进行翻译。”

在中国，拿国家领导人开玩笑通常被视为禁忌。(Reuters:Tingshu Wang)

ABC查看了多个中国社交媒体平台，均找不到该采访的原始视频。

据西班牙媒体elDiario报道，《The Bridge》已从其社交媒体账号上删除该片段，不过在Reddit和其他媒体报道中仍可看到。

YouTube、Instagram和Reddit在中国大陆被屏蔽，用户一般需要借助VPN才能访问这些平台上的内容。

至少三家中国企业已终止与姆巴佩的合作。(Weibo: Mengniu)

此事的影响不止于赞助合同。中国中央广播电视总台叫停了西班牙足球甲级联赛（La Liga）赛事以及涉及姆巴佩的所有比赛和其代言广告的播出。

西甲联赛表示，对姆巴佩言论造成的冒犯“深表遗憾”，但这些言论“属个人行为，不代表西甲立场”。

姆巴佩发表道歉声明后，央视表示已经注意到相关信息，“我们听其言更观其行”。

姆巴佩今年9月接受《法国足球》（France Football）采访时承认，把他描绘成独裁者的AI生成表情包有幽默的一面，但他不喜欢被拿来与这类人物相提并论。

他对该杂志说：“这里面有好笑的部分，因为你能看出，有些人是出于善意。”

“也有不那么好笑的部分，因为我们都知道，这类人在历史上造成了多大的伤害。”

“被比作杀人的人，或者让数以百万计的人生活悲惨的人……我不认为我这辈子做过这种事。所以这件事很复杂。”

ABC已联系皇家马德里置评。

title: Hong Kong lawmakers’ monthly pay tops HK$110K after unannounced 1.6% salary rise
zh_title: 香港立法会议员未经宣布加薪1.6%，月薪突破11万港元
summary: 香港立法会议员在冻薪一年后获准加薪，追溯至10月1日，每月基本工资超过11万港元。即将离任和新当选的香港立法会议员于 2025 年 12 月 9 日与新闻界会面。照片：HKFP。 《星岛日报》周二上午报道称，立法会在其网站上更新了数字，但立法会议员已收到未经宣布的 1.6% 加薪。加薪后，议员的基本月薪将增加1,740港元至110,053港元。最高医疗津贴也将增加
content:
香港立法会议员在冻薪一年后获准加薪，追溯至10月1日，每月基本工资超过11万港元。即将离任和新当选的香港立法会议员于 2025 年 12 月 9 日与新闻界会面。照片：HKFP。 《星岛日报》周二上午报道称，立法会在其网站上更新了数字，但立法会议员已收到未经宣布的 1.6% 加薪。加薪后，议员的基本月薪将增加1,740港元至110,053港元。最高医疗津贴亦将增加1.6%至每年38,500港元。立法会主席李慧琼的底薪是其他议员的两倍，月底薪达221,060港元。立法会内务委员会主席陈振英的月薪是其他立法会议员基本月薪的1.5倍，加薪后每月收入为165,800港元。目前担任行政会议成员的议员，包括刘江明、吴季礼和陈家良，与其他立法会议员相比，收入较低。他们的每月基本工资将从72,530港元增加至73,690港元。 2012年，香港立法机关的席位从60个扩大到70个。2021年，北京彻底改革了立法机关的选举制度，将席位扩大到90个。大多数传统反对派人物仍被关在监狱中、离开政坛或自我流放。
2026 年 1 月 8 日，香港立法会议员李慧琼当选立法会主席后与其他议员握手。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 10月初，1997年回归后香港立法会首任主席范丽泰在香港电台表示，维持立法会90名议员的成本太高，并援引“一位朋友”的意见。 《星岛日报》周二报道称，范的言论在政界引起广泛讨论，公众期望议员的表现能更好地“证明他们的薪酬合理”。今年早些时候，香港批准公务员、法官和司法官员加薪2%，最高部长和其他政治任命人员加薪1.3%。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong lawmakers have been given a pay rise retroactive to October 1 after a one-year pay freeze, bringing their monthly basic salary to more than HK$110,000. Outgoing and newly elected Hong Kong lawmakers meet the press on December 9, 2025. Photo: HKFP. Sing Tao Daily reported on Tuesday morning that legislators had received an unannounced 1.6 per cent pay rise, although the Legislative Council updated figures on its website . Following the pay rise, lawmakers will receive a basic monthly salary of HK$110,053, an increase of HK$1,740. The maximum medical allowance will also be increased by 1.6 per cent to HK$38,500 per year. The basic salary of Legislative Council President Starry Lee is double that of other lawmakers, bringing her basic monthly salary to HK$221,060. Chan Chun-ying, chairman of LegCo’s House Committee, receives 1.5 times the basic monthly salary of other lawmakers, earning HK$165,800 per month after the pay rise. Lawmakers who currently serve as members of the Executive Council, including Kenneth Lau, Stanley Ng and Gary Chan, earn less compared to other legislators. Their monthly basic salary will rise from HK$72,530 to HK$73,690. ‘Justify their pay’ Hong Kong’s legislature was expanded from 60 to 70 seats in 2012. In 2021, Beijing overhauled the electoral system for the legislature, expanding it to 90 seats. Most traditional opposition figures remain in prison, have left politics, or have fled into self-imposed exile. Hong Kong legislator Starry Lee shakes hands with other lawmakers after being elected as Legislative Council president on January 8, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Earlier in October, Rita Fan, the first president of Hong Kong’s legislature after the 1997 Handover, said on RTHK that it was costing too much to sustain 90 lawmakers in the Legislative Council, citing the opinions of “a friend.” Sing Tao Daily reported on Tuesday that Fan’s remarks were widely discussed in political circles, and the public expected lawmakers’ performance to better “justify their pay.” Earlier this year, Hong Kong approved a 2 per cent pay rise for civil servants, judges and judicial officers, and a 1.3 per cent pay rise for top ministers and other political appointees.

title: How migrants survive xenophobia in Johannesburg
summary: Ask any ordinary African migrant – legal or undocumented – what they fear most in their daily life negotiating Johannesburg, and they will tell you that it is being on the receiving end of enforcement. It comes in three guises: Vigilantes,
content:
Ask any ordinary African migrant – legal or undocumented – what they fear most in their daily life negotiating Johannesburg, and they will tell you that it is being on the receiving end of enforcement.

It comes in three guises: Vigilantes, cops and “the volunteers”.

First, outside the law. In a year where the likes of March and March, with its violent attacks on migrants, has been raging and is set to intensify before the local government elections, it goes without saying that migrants try to avoid these vigilantes.

Second, the police. The SAPS or metro police unfortunately have lots of rotten apples – dealing with migrants often involves extortion, bribery and, if you don’t want to play along, heavy-handed treatment. Even if you have the right papers, migrants say the cops will try to intimidate you and walk away with their palms greased.

The third bunch, “the volunteers”, after which this podcast series is named, are an unknown force to most South Africans.

In The Volunteers, we go undercover over four episodes, exposing the inner workings of the “volunteers”. They are linked to community policing forums and are called patrollers – but they are better known as “volunteers” by the migrant community. They are the so-called eyes and ears of the police, but many focus mainly on migrants.

The migrants all know and fear them, because many have been on the receiving end of these “volunteers”, even describing them as “South Africa’s ICE” after the US’ notorious Immigration and Customs Enforcement.

They operate mainly in Johannesburg’s CBD, where many migrants live, work and commute. Many of them use their power for shakedowns and bribe-taking.

But The Volunteers also tell the stories of ordinary migrants in Johannesburg, how they got here, how they deal with discrimination, and how their communities organise themselves.

We tell the heartbreaking story of a disabled migrant who had to walk kilometres after he was thrown out of a taxi, a hawker tells us why she doesn’t take cellphone calls in a taxi, and a coffee shop manager explains what he has learned in 20 years about how to deal with South African police officers.

But what happens when you get caught, even when your papers are in order? We also explore the little-known Johannesburg court, dedicated to pursuing migrants, where “justice” means one-way traffic for foreign nationals: straight to prison and deportation.

Listen to the four-part podcast below.

### E**pisode 1: ‘Why are you screaming?’**

South Africa has recently experienced a resurgence of xenophobia. In this episode, two migrant women from Zimbabwe tell their harrowing experiences about crossing the border into South Africa.

A researcher also explains the xenophobic roots as well as why the resurgence is happening now.

### **Episode 2: ‘Open the borders!’**

Despite constant threats and attacks, migrants in South Africa have communities they can turn to for support. Churches and WhatsApp groups provide refuge. This episode looks at how migrants navigate and survive life in Johannesburg.

### **Episode 3: ‘I want to join — what do I do?’**

The South African police have outsourced some of their pursuit of urban migrants to so-called volunteers. So, these volunteers – who are they, where do they operate and what do they do to migrants? And are they South Africa’s ICE?

### **Episode 4: ‘You caused serious discomfort to the country!’**

This is what happens when migrants get caught by the cops and those volunteers. And then? We visit a court dedicated to hounding migrants. **DM**

_The host of The Volunteers, Tebadi Mmotla, and the series producer, Charles Leonard, are independent journalists, podcasters and media trainers. They have been working closely together doing current affairs and narrative podcasts for the past seven years. Leonard is a multi-award-winning journalist who has worked across the media for nearly four decades, and Mmotla is one of our country’s finest young journalists and brightest minds._

_The podcasts were made possible with funding from the Rosa Luxemburg Foundation._

# Taiwan CDC cites health token initiative for vaccination uptick

10/27/2026 06:00 PM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

CDC Director-General Lo Yi-chun. CNA photo Oct. 27, 2026

Taipei, Oct. 27 (CNA) The Centers for Disease Control (CDC) said Tuesday that vaccination rates for influenza, COVID-19 and pneumococcal disease have risen in Taiwan this year for both publicly funded and self-paid vaccines, partly due to a health token initiative launched Oct. 1.

Between Oct. 1 and Oct. 26, about 2.725 million adults aged 18 and older had received publicly funded flu vaccinations, while 288,000 had paid out of pocket for the shots, the CDC said in a news release.

The figures represented increases of about 7 percent and 70 percent, respectively, from the same period last year, the agency said.

For COVID-19, about 1.176 million people had received publicly funded vaccinations and 188 had paid out of pocket, up 35 percent and 58 percent, respectively, from the same period in 2025.

For pneumococcal disease, 104,000 people had received publicly funded vaccinations and 3,000 had paid out of pocket between Oct. 1 and 26. The figures were 3.5 times and 2.4 times those recorded during the same period last year, respectively, the CDC said.

Under the health token initiative, people receive 450 tokens for getting a flu shot, 900 for a COVID-19 vaccination and 600 for a pneumococcal vaccination.

Between Oct. 18 and 24, Taiwan recorded 101,746 outpatient and emergency department visits for influenza-like illness, down 18 percent from the previous week, mainly because clinics were closed due to Typhoon Champi, the CDC said.

From Oct. 20-26, 85 new severe flu cases and 28 flu-related deaths were reported, it added.

CDC Director-General Lo Yi-chun (羅一鈞) said at a regular news conference that vaccination is the best way to reduce the risks of transmission, severe illness and death from both influenza and COVID-19.

The second phase of the publicly funded flu and COVID-19 vaccination programs, expanding eligibility to people aged 50 to 64 without chronic illnesses, is scheduled to begin Nov. 2, Lo said.

In addition to getting vaccinated, Lo urged the public to maintain good personal hygiene, including washing their hands, wearing masks when experiencing respiratory symptoms and staying home when ill.

People experiencing warning signs such as shortness of breath, labored breathing, altered consciousness or low blood pressure should seek immediate medical attention, he added.

(By Chen Chieh-ling and Wu Kuan-hsien)

content:
[法国巴黎](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E6%B3%95%E5%9B%BD%E5%B7%B4%E9%BB%8E)是那样一个古迹遍地的艺术殿堂，却磨难重重，最近暴乱又给这座城市搞的伤痕累累：在2026年10月17日超过55万黑衣人冲上巴黎、里昂、马赛城市街头，打砸抢烧，纵火损毁拥有140多年历史市政厅标志性建筑，焚毁大量汽车、街头设施，将3000 家商店洗劫一空。

六七名暴徒强行掀开餐馆铁闸门闯入，一记闷棍迎面而来，阿琳当场昏迷过去，带头钻进店里的是一名年仅12岁左右的男童，他们翻箱倒柜抢走现金，并将货架上的酒水、食材等一扫而空，搬不走的则直接砸烂后放火，阿琳苦心经营了7年的心血付之一炬。

行凶者在采访中毫不掩饰对华人的偏见：“我不喜欢中国人，中国人在法国变得太有钱了，这不公平，他们穿着漂亮的衣服，开着豪华轿车。”

这就是他们的逻辑，勤劳者变成被嫉恨的对象，把美好的打碎，甚至把抢劫包装成如此理直气壮，是不是已经有了点中共当年打土豪分田地的感觉了？《纽时》披露，这背后还真是**[共产党](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E5%85%B1%E4%BA%A7%E5%85%9A)**人及其赞助的组织干的。共产主义，它会把人性中那些邪恶的、贪婪的、那些最坏的东西放大，把人性中最美好的扭曲。

[![Image 1](https://img6.secretchina.com/bigpic/2024/11-4/p3557701a911506510.jpg)](https://naturexcels.com/language/zh/)

大家好，我是自媒体“Edward文鸣”，今天咱们就讲讲法国的创伤，从历史到今天是怎么造成的。来看一看到底发生了什么、幕后金主是何方妖魔、是谁在背后主使？

**从1789年法国大革命说起**

英国预言家帕克，曾多次预测欧洲和北美将面临大规模的社会抗议，他特别指出，法国、德国、意大利和荷兰将处于社会极度紧绷的前沿，骚乱和示威游行不仅源于经济压力，还与黑暗势力的教唆交织在一起，酿成街头冲突不断，传统社会秩序受到严重挑战，欧洲一体化也会面临严峻考验。他甚至预言欧盟的统一框架将经历逐渐的侵蚀与分解。他说，看看法国街头骚乱的人群面孔，是典型法国人或法国女人吗？据说这是是从巴黎中学生抗议教育资源短缺开始的，其实背后是彻头彻尾的骗局！为什么早在10月1号，就有人精准预告了17号的暴乱，号召大家上街的是TikTok的一个匿名账号？背后在联合操盘的54个组织，有几个是学生团体？又有多少全是成人操控的左翼工会、共产党、社会主义党、巴勒斯坦倡导组织及其宣传网络——也就是经典的“红绿联盟”呢？当巴黎火光冲天的时候，27个左翼组织已经从四面八方11个国家奔赴而来，开会密谋下一步的行动了。现场看不到一面法国国旗，取而代之的是锤子与镰刀！法国的共产革命传统、共产主义的阴魂从欧洲出世，却从没有真正消散，而是潜藏在欧美的政治教育文化的每一个细胞中。

美国牧师布兰登·比格斯也从异象中提到法国将走向某种形式的“**[无政府状态起义](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E6%97%A0%E6%94%BF%E5%BA%9C%E7%8A%B6%E6%80%81%E8%B5%B7%E4%B9%89)**”，法国及欧洲部分核心地区的社会秩序会彻底崩塌，街头失去控制，暴乱和权力真空让整个地区陷入极大的混乱之中，并向周边国家蔓延，进一步加剧了整个欧洲大陆的政治震荡。

但我们今天想更多的从历史和现实角度来理解法国这种暴力轮回之因。咱们的故事就先从1789年法国大革命说起吧

1789年法国大革命，像今天一样，巴黎底层市民涌上街头，推翻了法国一千多年的君主制，由雅各宾派接管了政权。雅各宾派首脑、残暴的罗伯斯比尔以理性与美德为名义，把巴黎变成了一座屠杀场。短短一年的时间，设在共和广场的断头台铡刀，日夜不停地落下，砍掉了7万多个脑袋。数以万计的无辜者，从国王路易十六、王后玛丽·安托瓦内特，一直到普罗大众、农民、修女，仅仅是因为不够革命，便被送上了刑场。最先掉脑袋的是一名律师，理由就是，罗伯斯比尔年轻时曾经追过一个女孩没成功，女孩后来嫁给了这个律师，当年我想追的女人没追上，我追不上的就要毁掉他们。

真实的法王路易十六善良、博学、勤奋与道德自律，他精通英语和拉丁语，对历史、地理、海洋学以及物理学有极浓厚的兴趣。他与祖父路易十五以及许多前任法王不同，路易十六在婚姻中相当忠诚，没有任何公开的情妇或宫廷绯闻，性格温和且颇具同情心。在面对革命风暴时，他多次拒绝向法国民众开枪。这种不愿流血的仁慈，最终导致他失去了对政局的控制。

王后玛丽·安托瓦内特尊贵而克制，在被捕囚禁于圣路易岛监狱及面对革命法庭的审判时，面对控方极其荒谬且污蔑性的控诉，她的辩驳赢得了在场许多人的敬佩。1793年10月被送上断头台时，她神态镇定自若，表现出了皇室应有的尊严。

跟中共镇压地主、资本家是一脉相承的:所谓地主、资本家，不就是有钱人吗？穷人有好人，但也有坏人；有钱人有坏人，但更多好人，因为富足，会得到更好的培育与教养，素质更高，他们实际上是社会城乡的士绅与民族精英。

雅各宾派还摧毁了传统秩序，斩断天主教信仰、和传统道德以及历史根基的一切的联系。正是这场崇尚暴力、否定一切传统道德价值和神圣秩序的革命，为共产主义思潮的诞生提供了土壤。

**美国共产党人罗伊.辛汉姆及其“地下****党****”成长史**

8月7号《纽约时报》刊登了一篇长篇报导，4个记者做了几个月的调查挖掘，把中共在海外西方世界的一个地下党组织挖出来了，其首脑就是美国共产党人罗伊.辛汉姆。

大家记得在2021年10月底，当时很多香港人逃到英国去定居吗？结果英国有多个华人团体，实际都是亲共团体，在中国城那儿举行一个所谓反对歧视华人的集会，在那儿声援中共。那么反对这帮集会者的在伦敦的港人，就集会起来做对立性的抗议，结果亲共侨团就突然就伸手打人，冲到对面港人人群中对他们拳打脚踢，并且带着金属物品藏在衣服里作为武器。有的港人被打到头破血流，最后送到医院去救治。此事当时喧嚣一时。今年2月份，美国新一届国会特别成立了“中国特别委员会”，举行听证。听证时有三个美国白人站起来抗议，说什么中国不是敌人之类的。那三个人标写着“Code Pink”（**粉红代码**），即他们来自“粉红代码”这个组织。 “粉红代码”是谁呢？是美国共产党人罗伊.辛汉姆的妻子朱迪‧埃文斯的组织。但从现在开始，你就应该知道得一清二楚了，无论“粉红代码”，还是在伦敦打人的这些团体，都是中共在海外的资助的，以美国为中心的一个中共的地下党组织的成员、组织和行动。

辛汉姆1954年出生在美国的康涅狄格州，他比习近平只小了一岁。辛汉姆的老爸叫安奇.辛汉姆，是斯里兰卡政治学家和历史学家，后来移民到美国，去到纽约城市大学布鲁克林学院教政治学，他是早期“不结盟运动”的一个重要参与者。

什么叫“不结盟运动”？就是冷战时代，这边是华约，那边是北约，大家都在站队，有些国家像南斯拉夫的铁托，印度、埃及就说，我们谁也不靠，我们就抱团来个不结盟，叫“不结盟运动”。辛汉姆的老爹被认为是“不结盟运动”的一个重要人物，所以辛汉姆从小在饭桌上听到的，都是如何反帝、如何革命的东西。所以18岁时，在同龄人忙着谈恋爱、申请大学的时候，他加入了革命黑人工人联盟，这是一个搞黑人民族主义和[毛泽东](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E6%AF%9B%E6%B3%BD%E4%B8%9C)思想的一个美国组织，信的是毛泽东思想，宣言的第一句话就是：要对种族主义、资本主义、帝国主义进行无情的斗争。1972年，辛汉姆被派到底特律克莱斯勒工厂工作，被FBI盯上，说白了他就是个美国共产党人，他是委内瑞拉当初的独裁者查韦斯的忠实粉丝，同时也是毛泽东的忠实的粉丝。他认为查韦斯把委内瑞拉建成了一个非常民主的地方，认为中国正在西方传授这样一个道理，是既有自由市场调节，又能长期规划的双轨制的世界，比西方更好。

罗伊.辛汉姆软件很厉害， 1993年在芝加哥创办了Thoughtworks公司，帮大公司写软件、搭系统的一个外包公司。客户倒都是大名鼎鼎的，像微软、甲骨文，还有好几家大银行，和英国的卫报。后来变成一个上市的软件公司，在最全盛的时候有4，500员工，在18个国家有49个办事处。

2001年，辛汉姆作为一个不断壮大的美国软件公司的老板，来到了华为，成了中国华为公司的战略技术顾问，而且一干就是7年。于是，辛汉姆和中共的缘分，早在这个时候就开始了。而这个关系还远不止于此。

2017年辛汉姆跟朱迪‧埃文斯结婚，埃文斯就是“粉红代码”（Code Pink）组织的创始人。它最早是一个反战组织，早年还强烈地批评中共，呼吁中共停止残酷镇压女性。但是婚后就开始转向了，再也不批评中共了。

2017年结婚之后，辛汉姆就把他的公司卖了大概将近8亿美元。他说要把这个钱来资助他要做的事业。他拿出了基金和中共政府的媒体机关密切合作，花了将近3亿美元，来资助中共在全球范围的大外宣，并且把这些宣传机构公司、媒体伪装成独立组织、独立内容。

它具体怎么操作的呢？它首先设立了四个空壳公司，叫做非盈利公司，这些非盈利公司没什么名声，连地址都没有，就在联合包裹UPS那里买一个邮箱，这四个非盈利组织叫什么“联合社区基金”，“正义与教育基金”，“粉红代码”（code pink）和“三洲组织”（Tricontinental）。

这些组织成立之后，啥也不做，它就往下再通过这些组织把它的钱再传到它在全球各地资助的各种各样的革命单位去。在美国它成立了一些智库；在南非成立了一个政党；在印度、巴西成立了很多媒体，有的媒体已经相当大了，做到在脸书上的订阅就将近四百万人；还包括在伦敦成立了“不要冷战”（no cold war）组织，攻击在英国的香港人就他们搞出来的名堂；还有包括加纳之类的，就是在很多国家，遍布全球。

它主要的纲领，就是跟中共贴的很紧，叫做carry water for CCP，专门为中共传话，中共想说的话它们就把它掰开了揉碎了用各种各样的方法去做。

2023年《纽约时报》记者顺着线索找到上海市中心时代广场18楼一间红黄装修的办公室，即辛汉姆落脚点。与他共用办公室的是中国传媒公司“玛酷”，口号是“讲好中国故事”，招聘广告明确写着为全球流行媒体网络和进步智库生产文字、音频与视频，输出中国好故事，属中共外宣。《纽约时报》称其公司与上海一档YouTube节目合作，部分资金来自上海市委宣传部。2023年7月，他参加中共培训班，主题是如何在国际上宣传中国共产党。2025年11月，他在上海举办的全球南方学术论坛上说：“如果我们想要建立一个在多边主义基础上的新世界秩序，就像习主席、中国共产党和中国所提出的那样，我们就必须消除二战叙事造成意识形态伤害。”当《纽约时报》问他说，你跟中（共）国是不是穿一条裤子？他却断然否认，说我完全是以我的信仰为指导，这些信仰是我长期坚持的个人观点。

《纽约时报》通过各种非政府组织的申报内部文件，挖出了和他有关的20多个机构。采访以前给他干活的前雇员，揭开了他所谓的四个慈善组织和下面一堆空壳公司的关系网，就发现，这个关系网非常绵密，遍布各地。从外部看，这些数十家各自独立的草根组织，但背后出资人是同一人辛汉姆。2017年起至今累计注入高达5.91亿美元，资金流向五大洲。他所花的这些钱，他卖掉软件公司的8亿美元，能撑几年？所以他背后，估计中共肯定是源源不断给他钱，再通过他的账号去到他四个非盈利组织，再从四个非盈利组织像金融喷泉一样喷涌出去。这是《纽约时报》的话：金融喷泉一样喷涌而出，流到中共在美国、在欧洲、在非洲的种种他们的外围宣传机构去。

至此，这位曾在底特律汽车厂流水线上向工友宣讲毛泽东思想的少年，已在五大洲铺开一张网络，等待一场“火”的到来。2026年秋天，这场火在法国燃起。

当巴黎郊区高中生因教育问题上街时，有人悄悄入场取代学生。法国托派组织“永久革命”（信奉托洛茨基“不断革命”的共产主义派别）下属青年组织“举起的拳头”混入抗议群体，帮助零散自发的人群搭建骨架：号召各校开全体大会、选代表跨校跨城串联，形成看不见的指挥系统；同时堵死学生与政府谈判的退路，公开以学生名义发声却不去谈判，并号召他人也不要去。随后，抗议诉求从教育升级为反政策、反马克龙乃至革命。街上出现法国共产党带队、共产主义青年组织挥舞锤子镰刀旗、横幅写“阶级战争”的场面，打砸主力为极左black bloc。法国总理直言是极左团体组织了暴力，是辛汉姆利用其资金建立了横跨欧洲、亚洲、非洲与美洲的宣传与激进组织网络，将法国的动乱报导传播至全球。

辛汉姆的妻子、同时也是由其资助的极左翼团体“**粉红代码**”（CodePink）联合创办人朱迪‧埃文斯（Jodie Evans），在接受纽约媒体“突破新闻”（BreakThrough News）采访时，明确引用了法国、西班牙和印度的青年示威，作为呼吁美国民众走上街头的范例。那就是说要想他们看齐，也要在美国发动了。这显示出相关组织如何跨国串联，利用各地冲突推动其全球政治主张。

目前调查尚未发现辛汉姆的钱直接进入法国打砸抢者手中的证据。但比对幕后推手与资金图可见：与抗议组织方巴黎印度联盟关联的人民论坛是辛汉姆资助的；为暴乱剪正面宣传片的BreakThrough是辛汉姆资助的；在X上喊“让愤怒主宰此刻”的普拉沙德研究所是辛汉姆资助的；号召美国人上街的埃文斯及其粉红代码与辛汉姆有直接关联。他没有直接付钱给打砸抢的人，但台子是他出钱搭的，喇叭是他出钱买的，吹号的人是他出钱招的。

因为他给外国政府代言、办事，却没有在美国政府做任何的登记，美国已开始调查。今年夏天，美国司法部在纽约组建联邦大陪审团，调查辛汉姆下属组织的电汇诈骗、银行诈骗和洗钱。众议院筹款委员会向其资助的三家机构发传票，三家均拒绝递交材料。委员会下最后通牒：10月20日前不交，就将21人全部召至国会宣誓作证，名单包括辛汉姆本人。21日，众议院中国问题特别委员会公开点名辛汉姆。但国会目前无法强制其作证，因此时的辛汉姆早已躲到他认为最安全的地方——上海。

那么，《纽约时报》不是左派媒体吗？怎么会登出这个报导揭极左的中共呢？把跟中共一个鼻孔出气，穿一条裤子的辛汉姆旗下经营了这么久的公司全部给挖出来？

就因为他和《纽约时报》是不同的两个版本的共产主义。辛汉姆是斯大林主义和毛泽东主义这一脉过来，就是暴力共产主义；而《纽约时报》自己也是个极左的力量，只是它是渐进性的共产主义，它会做这样的事情，现在美国民主、共和两党都反中共，虽然以前他们有的人跟中共有勾结，民主、共和两党都有勾结，但是美国整体是反中共的，因为中共是另外一派。这叫做“路线斗争”， 即使是他的同志，斗争是共产主义的家常便饭。第二个可能性，就是记者可能也真的是他有他的自由、他的意志、他的政治倾向，也有可能。但是最终怎么通过《纽约时报》总编辑让它出去，那他一定是不喜欢中共的那一套东西。所以确实，这个世界存在自由社会和中共对抗这条战线，同时也存在美国内部的文化马克思主义，或叫文化共产主义、渐进式共产主义和美国的传统理念、传统力量、传统思想文化的冲突。

而这场由共产党人辛汉姆远程操盘的欧洲革命之火，似乎才刚刚开始。那些势力已经在地图上标出了212场活动，11月20号，意大利、西班牙、葡萄牙、德国、阿尔巴尼亚、希腊等至少12个国家联动同时爆发大罢课，工会和社会组织会集体上街。他们的首都和数百大城市中心已经扎满了抗议的帐篷。店主和居民也在为应对新一轮抗议活动而准备枪支，巴黎枪店生意异常火爆，武器的销量“增长了 10 倍”。下一波骚乱已经风雨满楼，西方文明正在陷入一场前所未有的深重的危机。

Saint Lucian Prime Minister Philip J. Pierre. Image taken from Pierre's Facebook page

Taipei, Oct. 27 (CNA) Saint Lucian Prime Minister Philip J. Pierre arrived in Taiwan on Tuesday morning for a five-day state visit, during which he will meet with President Lai Ching-te (賴清德) and other officials to discuss bilateral issues.

Lai will host a military honors ceremony to welcome Pierre, and Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung (林佳龍) will host a banquet for him, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) said in a statement late Monday night.

The two sides will also engage in discussions on issues of mutual interest and prospects for future cooperation, it said.

This is the Saint Lucian leader's fourth visit to Taiwan since taking office in the summer of 2021, according to MOFA.

Joining Pierre's delegation are Saint Lucian Attorney General Leslie Mondesir, Senator Allison A. Jean, and Daryl Raymond, chairman of the Saint Lucia Development Bank.

While in Taiwan, the delegation will visit Cathay General Hospital and the iconic Taipei 101 skyscraper in Taipei and the TSMC Museum of Innovation in Hsinchu, MOFA said.

Saint Lucia is one of 12 states worldwide that recognize the Republic of China (ROC) -- Taiwan's official name -- instead of the People's Republic of China (PRC).

The two countries first established diplomatic relations in 1984, but ties were broken in 1997 when Saint Lucia switched recognition from Taipei to Beijing.

In April 2007, the ROC and Saint Lucia reestablished diplomatic relations, prompting the PRC to sever the formal ties it had with the Caribbean country.

(By Joseph Yeh)

# HELP BRING MY SON BACK HOME

My name is Nelson Wells, Sr. and I write to you on behalf of my wife, Cynthia Wells, and our family, asking for your assistance in our fight to bring home our son, Nelson Wells, Jr., who has been unjustly imprisoned in China for more than eight years. We are natives of Louisiana, who have served our country for decades. I served in the United States Army for more than 20 years, and Cynthia, served at the Department of Defense for nearly 28 years. We’ve traveled all over the United States and world and have a host of extended family and friends, who join us in the fight for our son. This includes Nelson’s wife and three children, who are desperate to have him returned to our family unit. Like us, Nelson, Jr. loved to travel, and it was this love of travel that inspired him to live in Japan and visit China. Unfortunately, it was on one of these visits there that Nelson was arrested and later convicted on a drug charge with little evidence of his guilt, opportunity to defend himself, or due process prior to this conviction and incarceration. Still, we fear that he will not last much longer. It is time to bring Nelson home, perhaps through medical parole. Even the act of creating this go fund me page and sharing our story publicly has given us – including Nelson – purpose and hope for the future when we can be reunited. ## **Takeaways** by Bloomberg AI[Subscribe](https://www.bloomberg.com/subscriptions)

A Tanzanian critic of President Samia Suluhu Hassan’s government has been abducted by unknown people in neighboring Kenya, bringing to three such attacks in the East African nation.

Twaha Mwaipaya had been sheltering in Kenya and was snatched from a taxi by masked men in the capital, Nairobi, on Sunday afternoon, according to Amnesty International.

title: Australian medtech firm uses Hong Kong as launchpad for bone repair tech
zh_title: 澳大利亚医疗科技公司利用香港作为骨修复技术的发射平台
summary: 香港 澳大利亚医疗科技公司 SDIP Innovations 在香港贸易发展局的支持下，利用香港作为其骨再生产品 JAZBI 的区域基地。该公司计划拓展至中国大陆和其他亚洲市场。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 26 日 04:58 香港时间 · 2 分钟阅读澳大利亚医疗科技公司 SDIP Innovations 正利用香港作为拓展其专利骨再生的启动平台
content:
香港
在香港贸易发展局的支持下，澳大利亚医疗科技公司 SDIP Innovations 正在利用香港作为其骨再生产品 JAZBI 的区域基地。该公司计划拓展至中国大陆和其他亚洲市场。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 26 日 04:58 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

澳大利亚医疗科技公司 SDIP Innovations 在香港贸易发展局 (HKTDC) 的支持下，以香港为起点，在整个亚洲推广其专利骨再生技术 JAZBI。

SDIP Innovations 成立于 2018 年，致力于开发帮助身体修复受损骨骼的先进材料。其旗舰产品 JAZBI 可吸收骨空隙填充物，当放置在受损骨骼的间隙中时，可充当临时支架，并在被患者自身的健康骨骼取代时逐渐溶解。该技术为从患者身体其他部位采集骨骼的手术提供了一种替代方案，有可能使治疗的侵入性更小。

据该公司称，全世界每年有超过 2500 万人接受修复因受伤、手术或疾病而受损或丢失的骨骼的手术，其中中国约有 250 万人。
SDIP Innovations Hong Kong 总经理 Stephanie Nemec 表示：“JAZBI 帮助身体自然修复受损的骨骼。” “我们的目标是将创新的再生技术带给更多患者并改善治疗结果。”

经过公司创始人在澳大利亚十多年的研究，JAZBI 在今年早些时候获得了美国食品和药物管理局的许可，为更广泛的商业化铺平了道路。

SDIP Innovations 的香港之旅始于 2025 年中，当时香港贸发局悉尼办事处邀请这家医疗科技公司参加亚洲全球健康峰会。此次会议将公司与主要参与者联系起来，并介绍了港深创新及科技园及其 IGNITE 孵化计划。该公司于 2025 年 12 月在香港成立了实体，随后被选为该计划的第一批成员。

从那时起，该公司与当地医院的临床医生和研究人员建立了关系，以验证其技术并探索更广泛的采用。展望未来，SDIP Innovations计划深化与医疗机构的合作，同时准备进军内地市场。 Nemec 表示：“我们将香港视为我们的战略区域总部，这是建立临床、商业和制造合作伙伴关系的门户，这将使我们能够在全球最大、增长最快的医疗保健市场之一进行扩张。”
[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

负责 CLB.org.hk 报道和编辑标准的主编。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Australian medtech company SDIP Innovations is leveraging Hong Kong as a regional base for its bone-regeneration product JAZBI, with support from the Hong Kong Trade Development Council. The company plans to expand into mainland China and other Asian markets.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

26 Oct 2026 at 04:58 HKT · 2 min read

Australian medtech company SDIP Innovations is using Hong Kong as a launchpad to expand its patented bone-regeneration technology, JAZBI, across Asia, with support from the Hong Kong Trade Development Council (HKTDC).

Founded in 2018, SDIP Innovations develops advanced materials that help the body repair damaged bone. Its flagship product, JAZBI Resorbable Bone Void Filler, acts as a temporary scaffold when placed into gaps in damaged bone, gradually dissolving as it is replaced by the patient’s own healthy bone. The technology offers an alternative to procedures that involve harvesting bone from elsewhere in the patient’s body, potentially making treatment less invasive.

Every year, more than 25 million people worldwide undergo procedures to repair bones damaged or lost through injury, surgery, or disease, including around 2.5 million in China, according to the company.

“JAZBI helps the body repair damaged bone naturally,” said Stephanie Nemec, general manager of SDIP Innovations Hong Kong. “Our goal is to bring innovative regenerative technologies to more patients and improve treatment outcomes.”

Following more than a decade of research by the company’s founders in Australia, JAZBI received US Food and Drug Administration clearance earlier this year, paving the way for wider commercialization.

SDIP Innovations’ Hong Kong journey began in mid-2025, when the HKTDC’s Sydney office invited the medtech firm to join the Asia Summit on Global Health. The conference connected the company with key players and led to an introduction to the Hong Kong-Shenzhen Innovation and Technology Park and its IGNITE incubation program. The company established a Hong Kong entity in December 2025 and was subsequently selected for the program’s first cohort.

Since then, the company has built relationships with clinicians and researchers at local hospitals to validate its technology and explore wider adoption. Looking ahead, SDIP Innovations plans to deepen its partnerships with healthcare institutions while preparing to enter the mainland market. “We see Hong Kong as our strategic regional headquarters – a gateway for building clinical, commercial, and manufacturing partnerships that will enable us to scale across one of the world’s largest and fastest-growing healthcare markets,” Nemec said.

title: China's Communist Party Set for Biggest Leadership Shake-Up Before Xi's Fourth Term
summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping (first row, fourth from left) attends a ceremony marking the 90th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army's Long March at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing on Oct. 22. Xin
content:
Chinese President Xi Jinping (first row, fourth from left) attends a ceremony marking the 90th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army's Long March at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing on Oct. 22. Xinhua-Yonhap

The fifth plenary session of the Chinese Communist Party's 20th Central Committee opens in Beijing on the 26th and runs through the 29th, bringing together the party's top leadership. Coming just one year before the 21st Party Congress, which will decide whether Chinese President Xi Jinping secures a fourth term, the meeting is expected to produce a sweeping personnel overhaul aimed at shoring up the ground for that extension.

Hong Kong's South China Morning Post reported on the 25th that the plenum, held behind closed doors over four days from the 26th, will formalize the largest reshuffle of senior party, government and military officials on record.

The Central Committee, which convenes the plenum, is the Communist Party's highest body of power, made up of 205 full members including the general secretary. Plenary sessions, held once or twice every one to two years, set major party policy and personnel decisions between the party congresses that take place every five years. Xi himself locked in his third term at the first plenum in October 2022, when he was re-elected as the committee's general secretary. Last year's fourth plenum adopted the 15th five-year plan covering 2026 to 2030 and confirmed the expulsion of 14 full and alternate members, including He Weidong and Miao Hua.

According to the SCMP, 20 full members and seven alternate members of the Central Committee are currently under investigation on corruption allegations and are awaiting formal expulsion at this plenum. They include former Jiangxi party secretary Yi Lianhong, former Jiangxi governor Ye Jianchun, former Inner Mongolia party secretary Sun Shaocheng and former Inner Mongolia regional government chairwoman Wang Lixia. Additional expulsions are also expected among the People's Liberation Army generals caught up in this year's extensive purge.

Even setting aside the purge, about two-thirds of the current Central Committee members will have reached mandatory retirement age by the time the party congress convenes in October next year. That has fueled persistent expectations that the party's seventh-generation cadres, who now account for roughly 8% of the central leadership, will emerge as the core of the next power structure. The seventh generation refers to those born from the late 1960s through the 1970s, nearly half of whom hold doctorates, making them what observers call the most highly educated group in the party's history. Many are specialists in engineering fields, giving the cohort a deep bench for the advanced technology competition with the United States. The group also carries little factional baggage, as its members belong to neither the so-called princelings nor the Communist Youth League, and built their careers during Xi's first and second terms — both advantages from the standpoint of a leader seeking a fourth term.

Seventh-generation officials have indeed taken over the top posts at local governments and central ministries one after another this year. A prominent example is Shanghai Mayor Zhu Zhongming, born in 1972, who is expected to be elevated to the Central Committee at next year's congress. Belonging to the seventh generation, however, offers no shield from the anti-corruption drive. Xia Linmao, Beijing's executive vice mayor, who was born in 1970, was placed under investigation by disciplinary authorities last week. The SCMP described the case as the latest warning that cadres singled out as rising stars face relentless scrutiny and will be judged strictly on political compliance and administrative integrity rather than on potential or promise.

Even so, the SCMP assessed that the seventh generation is a leading pool of candidates to move beyond the next leadership lineup into the top echelon after 2032. A report published in May by the Center for China Analysis at the Asia Society, a U.S.-based nonprofit organization for international exchange, concluded that Xi is diffusing immediate succession threats while building a talent base that allows him to retain control well past 2032. The SCMP said that with the countdown to the 2027 party congress underway, this plenum will provide fresh momentum to tighten party control and secure absolute loyalty ahead of the next congress.

# Jota Food chairman dies after car plunges off bridge in Hualien

10/25/2026 09:18 PM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

[Link](javascript:)[Whatsapp](javascript:)[Reddit](javascript:)[Line](javascript:)[Email](javascript:)

Photo courtesy of the Hualien County Fire Department Oct. 25, 2026

Taipei, Oct. 25 (CNA) Jota Food Co. Chairman Yu Kuo-chi (余國基) died of severe injuries Sunday after the car he was driving crashed through a guardrail and plunged off a bridge in Hualien County, with the cause of the accident still under investigation, local police said.

Yu, 64, who was alone in the car, was driving north on County Road 193 when his vehicle crashed through a guardrail and fell from Guanglong Bridge in Xincheng Township for unknown reasons, according to the Hualien County Fire Department.

Department officers said they received a report of the accident at around 3 p.m., and when rescuers arrived at the scene, they found the car severely deformed with the driver trapped inside.

Rescuers used specialized equipment to cut open the vehicle and extricate the man, who was not breathing and did not have a heartbeat.

They performed cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) and rushed him to Hualien Tzu Chi Hospital, but he was later pronounced dead of the injuries he suffered, the fire department said.

The man was later identified as the chairman of the Hualien-based food company.

According to local police, they have obtained footage from surveillance cameras at intersections near the crash site, as well as recordings from the car's dashboard camera as part of the investigation that is underway.

Jota Food (宗泰食品), founded by Yu's father Yu Tsung-po (余宗柏) in 1970, operates four brands: Amis Mochi (阿美麻糬), the Chihsing Tan Katsuo Museum (七星柴魚博物館), the Taitung Amis Custard Apple Mochi Museum (台東阿美釋迦麻糬館), and Digenwei-Wanwei Fan Paradise (地耕味-玩味蕃樂園).

zh_title: 吉尔吉斯斯坦巴凯银行计划于 2027 年初在香港推出，以利用人民币流动性
summary: 吉尔吉斯斯坦巴凯银行计划于 2027 年初在香港推出人民币流动性 |中国劳工布告栏 周一，2026 年 11 月 2 日 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 吉尔吉斯斯坦巴凯银行计划于 2027 年初在香港推出，以利用人民币流动性 吉尔吉斯斯坦在亚太地区的第一家银行巴凯银行计划于 2027 年初在香港推出商业服务。首席执行官安德烈亚斯·梅莱蒂乌 (Andreas Meletiou) 表示，该分行将利用该市的深度离岸人民币池，促进中国与中央政府之间的人民币计价贸易亚洲，巴凯银行预计将达到1200亿美元，目标是商业化
content:
吉尔吉斯斯坦巴凯银行计划于 2027 年初在香港推出人民币流动性 |中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 2 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
吉尔吉斯斯坦巴凯银行计划于 2027 年初在香港推出，以利用人民币流动性
吉尔吉斯斯坦在亚太地区的第一家银行巴凯银行计划于 2027 年初在香港开展商业业务。首席执行官 Andreas Meletiou 表示，该分行将利用该市深厚的离岸人民币池促进中国与中亚之间的人民币计价贸易，预计 2027 年将达到 1200 亿美元。
八开银行首席执行官表示，该银行计划明年初在香港推出商业服务，以利用该市的离岸人民币流动性，随着人民币成为中国与中亚之间的主要结算媒介，其定位是促进以人民币计价的跨境贸易。
香港巴凯银行首席执行官安德烈亚斯·梅莱蒂乌(Andreas Meletiou)表示，两年前，中亚和中国之间的贸易主要以美元进行，但现在已经非常明显地转向人民币。他指出，由于当地离岸人民币流动性深厚，位于香港的银行在这些交易中处于有利地位。
“2025年，中国与中亚之间的贸易额将超过1000亿美元（7800亿港元），我们预计到今年年底这一数字将增至1200亿美元，”梅莱蒂乌说。尽管中国牢牢巩固了其作为中亚最大贸易伙伴的地位，但梅莱蒂乌指出，这两个快速增长地区之间的金融中介和专业银行服务仍相对不成熟。
巴凯银行香港分行最初将专注于企业现金管理、贸易融资和资金服务。它还将提供外汇对冲工具，以保护中亚货币免受人民币的影响。
在香港的扩张标志着巴凯银行的一个历史性里程碑，使其成为吉尔吉斯斯坦和更广泛的中亚地区第一家在亚太地区建立银行业务的金融机构。巴凯银行成立于1998年，总部位于吉尔吉斯斯坦，于10月5日获得香港金融管理局颁发的限制性银行牌照。根据限制性许可，批发贷款机构将专注于企业、机构和跨境贸易客户，不提供零售储蓄账户。
梅莱蒂乌表示，在评估全球金融中心后，在香港设立办事处是一个“非常明智的选择”，并列举了香港特区健全的监管环境、法律生态系统、深厚的人才库及其作为中国大陆超级联系人的战略地位。当地分行的团队主要由具有丰富全球和区域经验的香港银行家组成。
为了实现更广泛的影响力和运营规模，巴凯银行打算通过与传统银行、多边组织和金融科技公司的战略合作和伙伴关系进行运营。该银行成立之初的员工人数不足 40 人，预计根据业务需求，在未来两到三年内将增加到 50 名员工左右。展望未来，梅莱蒂乌强调，该银行的当务之急是在香港建立稳固的运营轨迹，尽管未来的长期计划可能包括寻求额外的牌照以扩大其产品组合。

Kyrgyzstan's Bakai Bank targets early 2027 Hong Kong launch to tap yuan liquidity | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 2 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Kyrgyzstan's Bakai Bank targets early 2027 Hong Kong launch to tap yuan liquidity
Bakai Bank, Kyrgyzstan's first lender in Asia-Pacific, plans a Hong Kong commercial launch in early 2027. CEO Andreas Meletiou says the branch will use the city's deep offshore yuan pool to facilitate yuan-denominated trade between China and Central Asia, which is expected to reach US$120 billion in
Bakai Bank is targeting a commercial launch in Hong Kong early next year to leverage the city's offshore Chinese yuan liquidity, positioning itself to facilitate yuan-denominated cross-border trade as the currency becomes the primary settlement medium between China and Central Asia, the lender's chief executive said.
Two years ago, trade between Central Asia and China was predominantly in US dollars, but there has been a very clear pivot to the yuan, said Andreas Meletiou, chief executive of Bakai Bank Hong Kong. He noted that being in Hong Kong places the bank in an advantageous position for those transactions because of the deep pool of local offshore yuan liquidity.
“In 2025, trade between China and Central Asia exceeded US$100 billion (HK$780 billion), and we expect that figure to rise to US$120 billion by the end of this year,” Meletiou said. While China has firmly cemented its position as Central Asia's top trading partner, Meletiou pointed out that financial intermediation and specialised banking services between the two rapidly growing regions remain relatively immature.
Bakai Bank's Hong Kong branch will initially focus on corporate cash management, trade finance, and treasury services. It will also provide foreign exchange hedging tools to protect Central Asian currencies against the yuan.
The Hong Kong expansion marks a historic milestone for Bakai Bank, making it the first financial institution from Kyrgyzstan and the broader Central Asian region to establish banking operations in the Asia-Pacific. Headquartered in Kyrgyzstan and established in 1998, Bakai Bank secured its restricted banking license from the Hong Kong Monetary Authority on 5 October. Under the restricted license, the wholesale lender will focus exclusively on corporate, institutional, and cross-border trade clients, without offering retail savings accounts.
Meletiou described setting up in Hong Kong as a "very conscious choice" after evaluating global financial hubs, citing the SAR's robust regulatory environment, legal ecosystem, deep talent pool, and its strategic identity as a super-connector to mainland China. The local branch's team is predominantly composed of Hong Kong bankers with extensive global and regional experience.
To achieve broader reach and operational scale, Bakai Bank intends to operate through strategic collaborations and partnerships with traditional banks, multilateral organisations, and fintech firms. Launching with a team of under 40 staff, the bank expects to grow to around 50 employees over the next two to three years based on business demand. Looking ahead, Meletiou emphasised that the bank's immediate priority is establishing a solid operational trajectory in Hong Kong, though future long-term plans may include pursuing additional licences to broaden its product suite.

content:
香港就保护投资者免受人工智能驱动的虚假信息侵害进行磋商中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 2 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港将就保护投资者免受人工智能驱动的虚假信息侵害进行磋商
香港财政司司长表示，政府今年将就法律框架征求市场意见，以保护投资者免受代理人工智能驱动的深度造假广告和虚假信息的影响。此举是在生成式人工智能沙盒测试扩展到证券和保险领域之后进行的。
香港财经事务及库务局局长许正宇 (Christopher Hui) 11 月 2 日表示，随着代理人工智能 (AI) 创造出更多此类内容，政府将在今年就如何建立法律框架以保护投资者免受虚假和捏造信息误导进行咨询市场。
Hui 在金融科技周活动上发表讲话时指出，金融发展局正在研究代理人工智能带来的风险和可能的对策。他表示，生成式人工智能沙盒测试已经从银行业扩展到证券和保险业，并强调需要覆盖包括强制性公积金在内的所有金融领域。
许还表示，香港交易及结算所（香港交易所）正准备今年推出一个多资产代币化平台，最初用于碳信用交易。该平台还将包括来自香港伦敦金属交易所（LME）仓库的仓单。
为了促进金融科技行业的可持续发展，许强调需要建立适当的监管体系。他表示，政府计划在今年年底前向立法会提交一项法案，以规范数字资产的咨询服务、交易、托管和管理。

Hong Kong to consult on protecting investors from AI-driven fake information | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 2 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong to consult on protecting investors from AI-driven fake information
Hong Kong's Financial Secretary said the government will consult the market this year on a legal framework to protect investors from deepfake ads and false information driven by agentic AI. The move follows the expansion of generative AI sandbox testing to securities and insurance.
Hong Kong's Secretary for Financial Services and Treasury, Christopher Hui, said on 2 November that the government will consult the market this year on how to establish a legal framework to protect investors from being misled by false and fabricated information, as agentic artificial intelligence (AI) creates more such content.
Speaking at a Financial Technology Week event, Hui noted that the Financial Development Authority is studying the risks posed by agentic AI and possible countermeasures. He said generative AI sandbox testing has already been expanded from banking to the securities and insurance industries, stressing the need to cover all financial sectors, including mandatory provident funds.
Hui also said Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing (HKEX) is preparing to launch a multi-asset tokenisation platform this year, initially for carbon credit trading. The platform will also include warehouse receipts from the London Metal Exchange (LME) warehouse in Hong Kong.
To promote sustainable development of the fintech industry, Hui emphasised the need for an appropriate regulatory system. He said the government plans to submit a bill to the Legislative Assembly by the end of this year to regulate advisory services, trading, custody and management of digital assets.

content:
Lacson: Senate majority to strip 2027 budget of ‘pork' | The Manila Times
Lacson: Senate majority to strip 2027 budget of ‘pork'
MANILA, Philippines — The Senate majority bloc is united in stripping the proposed P7.2 trillion 2027 national budget of questionable and corruption-prone allocations, including projects inserted by lawmakers without proper vetting, Sen. Panfilo Lacson said.
Lacson said on Monday the majority, including himself, backed efforts to weed out unwarranted allocations and ensure transparency at every stage of the budget-making process.
“The majority of senators are rallying behind Senate Finance Committee Chairman JV Ejercito’s efforts to cleanse the 2027 budget of unwarranted, whimsical, and corruption-prone items. — ALL MEANS ALL!” Lacson said in a social media post.
Over the weekend, Ejercito secured a commitment from the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) to remove infrastructure projects without complete supporting documents from the House-approved budget bill before plenary debates, unless the agency submits the required documents by Nov. 3.
Budget advocacy groups earlier cited the lack of supporting documents as one of the red flags in the House version of the proposed spending measure, warning that projects without clear documentation and proper justification could become vehicles for questionable spending.

A Senate review found that the number of DPWH projects had increased from 11,420 in the National Expenditure Program, the executive branch's original spending proposal, to 16,244 in the House-transmitted General Appropriations Bill.
Of these, 6,271 projects were introduced by lawmakers without prior vetting by the executive branch, raising questions about how the additional infrastructure allocations were selected, evaluated and justified.
Ejercito also announced that civil society organizations would be invited to observe the bicameral conference committee deliberations on the budget, where the Senate and House of Representatives reconcile their respective versions of the spending measure. The proceedings would also be livestreamed to allow the public to monitor discussions and proposed changes.
The transparency measures are part of broader efforts to prevent the return of questionable budget practices, particularly the insertion of projects and allocations outside the regular planning and evaluation process.

content:
香港交易所将于三月起延长收市后衍生品交易 |中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 2 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
港交所将于三月起延长收盘后衍生品交易
香港交易及结算所计划从 3 月份起将收盘后衍生品交易时间延长 1 小时 15 分钟，尚待监管部门批准。 11 月份正在考虑进一步延长至凌晨 5:15。该交易所还计划与香港金管局进行数字货币试点，用于境外保证金存款
香港交易及结算所（香港交易所）宣布，计划从明年 3 月起延长衍生品收盘后交易时段，但须获得监管机构批准和市场准备就绪。
根据新安排，盘后交易时段的收盘时间将从凌晨3点推迟至凌晨4点15分。该交易所表示，将根据初步延期后的市场发展情况，考虑进一步延期至明年11月凌晨5点15分。
香港交易所首席运营官刘贝蒂表示，全球市场的联系日益紧密，投资者需要更大的灵活性来应对不同时区的市场变化并管理风险。该交易所希望新措施以及之前宣布的使用数字货币进行保证金存款的试点计划将促进市场参与并增强服务和运营弹性。
香港交易所正与香港金融管理局（金管局）合作开展一项试点计划，探索在银行营业时间以外使用数字港元（e-HKD）支付保证金，为市​​场参与者在收市后交易时段提供更灵活的支付选择。实施细则将适时另行公布。

HK Exchange to extend post-close derivatives trading from March | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 2 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
HK Exchange to extend post-close derivatives trading from March
Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing plans to extend post-close derivatives trading by one hour 15 minutes from March, pending regulatory approval. A further extension to 5:15am is being considered for November. The exchange also plans a digital-currency pilot with the HKMA for margin deposits outside b
Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing (HKEX) has announced plans to extend the post-close trading session for derivatives from March next year, subject to regulatory approval and market readiness.
Under the new arrangement, the closing time of the after-hours trading session would be pushed back from 3am to 4:15am. The exchange said it would consider a further extension to 5:15am in November next year, depending on market development after the initial extension.
HKEX Chief Operating Officer Betty Lau said global markets are becoming increasingly interconnected, and investors need greater flexibility to respond to market changes across different time zones and to manage risk. The exchange hopes the new measures, together with a previously announced pilot scheme using digital currency for margin deposits, will facilitate market participation and enhance service and operational resilience.
HKEX is working with the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) on a pilot programme exploring the use of a digital Hong Kong dollar (e-HKD) for margin payments outside banking hours, offering market participants more flexible payment options during the post-close trading session. Details of the implementation will be announced separately in due course.

焦点：中国的机器人制造商已经掌握了这些动作。现在是大脑竞赛
焦点：中国的机器人制造商已经掌握了这些动作。现在是大脑竞赛
作者：Laurie Chen 和 Eduardo Baptista，路透社
- 2026 年 11 月 2 日 - 18:00 全部、世界
资料照片：2026 年 8 月 19 日在中国北京举行的 2026 年世界机器人大会上，X Square 人形机器人在公司展位上展示家庭作业。（路透社/Tingshu Wang）
北京 - 经过多年打造能够跑步、跳舞和后空翻的人形机器人，中国企业正在投入资源应对另一个挑战：开发人工智能，使这些机器能够在更广泛的工作领域发挥作用。
这种转变正在推动嵌入式人工智能的投资热潮，该领域专注于软件，使机器人能够了解周围环境，学习不熟悉的任务并适应，而无需为每项工作进行编程。
根据数据研究公司 ITjuzi 的数据，2026 年上半年，中国实体人工智能公司通过 322 笔交易筹集了 935 亿元人民币（130 亿美元）的资金，是去年同期的五倍。资金越来越多地流向机器人智能的专业开发商以及制造商。
上海技术咨询公司 ZenGen Labs 的创始人德莫特·麦格拉思 (Dermot McGrath) 表示，随着竞争压低硬件价格，机器人制造商“得出结论，利润不会来自硬件，而是来自大脑”。
新兴行业正在为中美科技竞争开辟新战线。路透社对五家中国机器人公司的创始人和高管以及行业分析师的采访显示，美国公司在一些先进的机器人人工智能系统方面处于领先地位，而中国开发商希望他们的制造实力和获得真实世界训练数据的机会能够帮助他们挑战美国竞争对手。
将人工智能与机器完美结合的国家可以在工厂和物流自动化方面获得优势，从而有可能重塑工业生产力和全球机器人技术市场。
Spirit AI 联合创始人高阳表示：“大脑确实是整个机器人堆栈中最薄弱的环节。”
包括 Physical Intelligence、Skild AI 和 Generalist 在内的美国初创公司正在开发软件，旨在教授机器人不同的技能，而无需进行大量的再培训。
Generalist 表示，在观看持续 3 到 12 秒的演示后，其 GEN-1.5 模型完成了大约 60% 的简单任务。中国的 X Square 发表的研究表明，机器人可以从单个人类视频中获取处理技能，而无需针对每项任务重新训练模型。
机器人顾问乔治·施蒂勒（Georg Stieler）表示：“美国领先的实验室正在设定严格的基准，特别是在机器人获取和重用技能的速度方面。”他认为中国最强大的初创公司是值得信赖的竞争对手。
虽然美国开发商受益于先进的人工智能研究和更容易获得强大的计算芯片，但中国企业可以与机器人制造商和工业客户密切合作，测试和改进他们的系统。
根据公司披露的信息，X Square、Galaxea 和 Spirit AI 等中国专业初创公司的估值均已达到约 30 亿美元。
X Square 联合创始人兼首席运营官杨谦表示：“我们希望机器人从由代码驱动转变为由常识驱动。”
老牌制造商也在投资。香港上市的UBTech招聘首席科学家职位，负责监督AI模型开发，薪酬高达1.24亿
