FOCUS: China's robot makers have mastered the moves. Now comes the race for brains
FOCUS: China's robot makers have mastered the moves. Now comes the race for brains
By Laurie Chen and Eduardo Baptista,Reuters
- Nov 02, 2026 - 18:00 All,World
FILE PHOTO: X Square humanoid robots demonstrate home work a the company's booth during the 2026 World Robot Conference, in Beijing, China on Aug. 19, 2026. (REUTERS/Tingshu Wang)
BEIJING - After years of building humanoid robots capable of running, dancing and performing backflips, Chinese companies are pouring resources into a different challenge: developing the AI that could make those machines useful across a wider range of jobs.
The shift is fuelling an investment boom in embodied AI, a field focused on software that allows robots to understand their surroundings, learn unfamiliar tasks and adapt without having to be programmed for every job.
Chinese embodied AI companies raised 93.5 billion yuan ($13 billion) across 322 deals in the first half of 2026, five times the amount a year earlier, according to data research firm ITjuzi. Funding is increasingly reaching specialist developers of robot intelligence alongside manufacturers.
As competition drives down hardware prices, robot makers have "concluded that the margin won't come from the hardware but from the brain," said Dermot McGrath, founder of Shanghai-based technology consultancy ZenGen Labs.
The emerging sector is opening a new front in US-China tech rivalry. American companies lead in some advanced robot AI systems, while Chinese developers hope their manufacturing strength and access to real-world training data will help them challenge their US competitors, according to Reuters interviews with founders and top executives at five Chinese robotics firms, as well as industry analysts.
The country that best combines AI with machines could gain an advantage in automating factories and logistics, potentially reshaping industrial productivity and the global market for robotics technology.
"The brain is indeed the weakest link in the complete robotics stack," said Spirit AI co-founder Gao Yang.
American startups, including Physical Intelligence, Skild AI and Generalist, are developing software intended to teach robots different skills without extensive retraining.
Generalist says its GEN-1.5 model completed around 60% of simple tasks after viewing a demonstration lasting between 3 and 12 seconds. China's X Square has published research showing robots acquiring handling skills from a single human video without retraining the model for each task.
"The leading American labs are setting a demanding benchmark, particularly in how quickly robots can acquire and reuse skills," said robotics consultant Georg Stieler, who considers China's strongest startups credible competitors.
While US developers benefit from advanced AI research and greater access to powerful computing chips, Chinese companies can work closely with robot manufacturers and industrial customers to test and improve their systems.
Specialist Chinese startups, including X Square, Galaxea and Spirit AI, have each reached valuations of roughly $3 billion, according to company disclosures.
"We want robots to shift from being driven by code to being driven by common sense," said X Square co-founder and COO Yang Qian.
Established manufacturers are investing too. Hong Kong-listed UBTech advertised a chief scientist position overseeing AI model development with compensation of up to 124 million yuan ($18 million), including equity and benefits. Hangzhou-based Unitree, one of the world's largest humanoid robot makers by shipments, has about 30 researchers developing AI that predicts how objects behave, according to a person briefed by the company.
Unitree did not respond to a request for comment.
Unlike chatbots, which learn from vast quantities of internet text, robots need examples of physical interactions, from gripping objects to handling flexible wires.
Chinese companies are pursuing different approaches to collecting that information, with some employing people to demonstrate tasks, others using computer simulations, and some combining both. The field remains crowded, with no company establishing itself as the clear leader.
Spirit AI has hired around 1,000 people to record everyday and industrial activities, Gao said. ACE Robotics uses wearable sensors to capture workers' movements and grip forces in stores and hotels.
Ant Group's robotics unit Robbyant said it trained a model using 160,000 hours of material, including 50,000 hours of human-guided robot movements. It also trained software on 20 robot configurations from 17 brands, aiming to use the same AI across different machines.
DexForce is taking another approach, using computer-generated environments to teach robots. Chief operating officer Nicole Yang said the company can prepare some industrial tasks for deployment within 6 to 8 hours and reported success rates above 99.9% in specified precision operations.
But simulations cannot perfectly reproduce physical interactions, said Jerry Wang of spatial intelligence company Manycore Tech, which designs simulated environments for AI training.
"Data quality is more important than data diversity, and more important than simply collecting data at massive scale," X Square's Yang said.
Chinese robot firms also face additional headwinds, including shortages of advanced Nvidia chips due to US export controls, and a squeeze on IPO funding amid regulatory concerns over inflated valuations and overcrowding.
As robots become more powerful, the shortage of advanced chips will become a serious problem for China's embodied AI industry, said Zhu Mingxuan, who leads development of JoyIn Technology's Aether robot AI.
JoyIn and other developers are already testing whether their software can enable robots to tackle unfamiliar problems.
Zhu described an experiment in which a robot repeatedly failed to place headphones in a cupboard beyond its reach.
Then engineers showed it videos of how people managed the task, and the robot pushed a box towards the cupboard and tried stepping onto it, Zhu said.
"Every time it was exploring a different behaviour," she said.
Real-world deployments in China leave no room for improvisation. Battery maker CATL said Spirit AI robots connect flexible wires during battery-pack testing at its Zhongzhou plant, reporting insertion success above 99%. Robbyant said its robots handle orders in two Shanghai pharmacies, with staff checking medicines before dispatch.
But the longer-term prize is software capable of learning new jobs without extensive adaptation. Success will depend how the same AI performs across different customers and workplaces and that will require companies to train increasingly powerful models with advanced chips.
Chinese companies are trying to reduce their computing requirements through more efficient models, synthetic data and simulations, while domestic chipmakers, including Huawei, are developing alternatives to Nvidia hardware. It remains unclear how far those efforts can offset the shortage.
Unitree founder Wang Xingxing said last month the company had tested OpenAI's GPT-6 on robots with encouraging results.
He said GPT-7, if released next year, could bring robotics its own "ChatGPT moment" — a step-change in capability akin to ChatGPT's 2022 launch, which turned generative AI into a mainstream consumer and business technology.
Wang said he would consider that threshold reached when robots were able to complete 80% of tasks in 80% of unfamiliar environments from spoken instructions.
But consultant Stieler said a breakthrough in demonstrations would not necessarily mean robots were ready for broad commercial use.
"If the question is when a model first handles a broad range of unfamiliar tasks in demonstrations, the optimists may well be right," he said. "If the question is when a customer can count on it, I would add years, not months."

台湾股市收跌，但因美国波动而脱离低点
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
中新社台北11月2日电 交易商称，台湾股市周一收盘下跌，但从当日低点回升，原因是市场仍然担心美国在人工智能基础设施方面的大规模支出引发的市场波动。
台湾证券交易所基准指数在 44,399.10 点至 45,156.17 点之间波动，最终下跌 291.69 点，至 44,920.14 点，跌幅为 0.65%。继周五的 9,396.1 亿新台币之后，成交总额达到 7,588.8 亿新台币（232.5 亿美元）。
交易商表示，该指数早盘面临巨大压力，暴跌 812.73 点至当日低点，主要是由于以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数下跌 2.86%，周五费城半导体指数暴跌 7.20%。
然而，交易商补充称，随着逢低买入者买入部分市场落后企业的股票，包括智能手机IC设计商联发科、iPhone组装商和人工智能服务器制造商鸿海精密工业有限公司的股票，当地市场收复了早前的大部分跌幅。
华南证券分析师Kevin Su表示，“对于逢低买入者来说，今天上午的下跌为包括联发科和鸿海在内的一些市场落后者创造了买入机会。”
联发科上涨 1.40%，收于新台币 3,970.00 元，脱离新台币 3,795.00 元的低点；鸿海上涨 2.24%，收于新台币 251.00 元，脱离新台币的低点 242.50 元。
电源管理解决方案供应商台达电子公司(Delta Electronics Inc.)也是逢低吸纳的焦点，该公司股价上涨1.50%，收于新台币1,355.00元。
Su 表示：“存储芯片供应商三星电子和 SK 海力士在首尔的反弹也引发了购买。” “对于区域市场来说，美国股市的暴跌似乎并不是世界末日。”
台湾存储芯片生产商南亚科技股价上涨0.44%，收于新台币456.50元，脱离低点新台币424.50元。
然而，合约芯片制造商台积电 (TSMC) 的美国存托凭证周五下跌 5.95%，其收盘未能上涨，下跌 1.69%，至新台币 2,330.00 元。
苏表示，原油价格飙升提振了石化库存，进一步提振了台交所。
台塑涨4.78%，收于新台币103.00元；南亚塑胶涨1.69%，收于新台币301.00元。台塑收涨0.83%，报新台币73.10元；台化纤收涨1.52%，报新台币73.60元。
因改善国家电网投资而跑赢大盘，富成电机收涨0.73%，至新台币555.00元；中新电机制造股份有限公司收涨0.65%，至新台币154.00元。
金融板块，富邦金控跌1.24%，报159.50元新台币；中信金控跌1.06%，报75.00新台币。
苏说：“随着新台币兑美元继续走弱，我怀疑今天购买大型科技股的资金来自政府主导的基金，而不是外国投资者，以增强投资者信心。”
“成交量下降表明人们对定于周二举行的美国中期选举持谨慎态度，”苏补充道。
据台湾证券交易所统计，周一外国机构投资者在主板净售股新台币735.2亿美元。

Taiwan shares end down but off lows amid U.S. volatility
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Taipei, Nov. 2 (CNA) Shares in Taiwan closed down Monday but recovered from the day's low as the market remained concerned about volatility in the United States amid questions over massive spending on AI infrastructure, dealers said.
The Taiex, the Taiwan Stock Exchange's benchmark index, ended down 291.69 points, or 0.65 percent, at 44,920.14 after moving between 44,399.10 and 45,156.17. Turnover totaled NT$758.88 billion (US$23.25 billion) following Friday's NT$939.61 billion.
The index faced heavy pressure in the early-morning session, tumbling 812.73 points to the day's low, largely on a 2.86 percent fall on the tech-heavy Nasdaq index and a 7.20 percent plunge on the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index Friday, dealers said.
However, the local market recouped most of its earlier losses as bargain hunters picked up shares in select market laggards, including smartphone IC designer MediaTek and iPhone assembler and AI server maker Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., dealers added.
"For bargain hunters, this morning's losses created buying opportunities for some market laggards with MediaTek and Hon Hai included," Hua Nan Securities analyst Kevin Su said.
MediaTek rose 1.40 percent to close at NT$3,970.00, off a low of NT$3,795.00 and Hon Hai gained 2.24 percent to end at NT$251.00, off a low of NT$242.50.
Also a focus of bargain hunting, power management solutions provider Delta Electronics Inc. added 1.50 percent to close at NT$1,355.00.
"Buying was also sparked by a rally among memory chip suppliers Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix in Seoul," Su said. "The U.S. tumble appeared not to be the end of the world to regional markets."
Shares in Taiwan's memory chip producer Nanya Technology Corp. rose 0.44 percent to end at NT$456.50, off a low of NT$424.50.
However, contract chipmaker Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC) failed to end in positive territory, dropping 1.69 percent to NT$2,330.00, after a 5.95 percent fall in its American depositary receipts Friday.
A spike in crude oil prices bolstered petrochemical stocks, giving an additional boost to the Taiex, Su said.
Formosa Petrochemical Corp. rose 4.78 percent to close at NT$103.00, Nan Ya Plastics Corp. gained 1.69 percent to end at NT$301.00. Formosa Plastics Corp. closed up 0.83 percent at NT$73.10, and Formosa Chemicals & Fibre Corp. ended up 1.52 percent at NT$73.60.
Also outperforming the broader market in the wake of investments to improve the national electricity grid, Fortune Electric Co. closed up 0.73 percent at NT$555.00 and Chung-Hsin Electric & Machinery Manufacturing Corp. ended up 0.65 percent at NT$154.00.
In the financial sector, Fubon Financial Holding Co. closed down 1.24 percent at NT$159.50 and CTBC Financial Holding Co. fell 1.06 percent at NT$75.00.
"As the Taiwan dollar continued to weaken against the greenback, I suspect today's buying of large tech stocks came from government-led funds, instead of foreign investors, to bolster investor confidence," Su said.
"Lower turnover showed caution about the U.S. midterm elections scheduled for Tuesday," Su added.
According to the Taiwan Stock Exchange, foreign institutional investors sold a net NT$73.52 billion of shares on the main board Monday.

优质旅游需求增长，台湾旅游展预计吸引 40 万游客 - 聚焦台湾
随着优质旅行需求的增长，台湾旅游展预计将吸引 40 万游客
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
这张 CNA 档案照片中的潜在游客参观台湾旅游展
中新社台北11月2日电 台湾国际旅展(ITF)主席周一表示，该展主办方希望今年能吸引超过40万名游客，年轻游客越来越多地寻求独特的体验，而不仅仅是讨价还价。
在台北举行的活动前新闻发布会上，台湾观光协会会长简余晏表示，早鸟票销量比去年增长了10%以上，去年参观人数超过36万人。
为庆祝其成立 40 周年，该展会将于 11 月 6 日至 9 日在台北南港展览馆一号馆举行，共有来自 123 个国家和城市的 550 多家参展商，占据 1,600 个展位。
“过去，人们来旅游展是为了获得物有所值的优惠和折扣餐券，”Chien 说。
“但我们发现，年轻旅行者越来越多地购买价格更高、独特的旅行，他们希望一生中至少体验一次。”
她说，极地探险、极光观赏之旅和欧洲行程等产品引起了人们的兴趣，并以每人 490,000 新台币（15,033 美元）的棒球之旅为例，很快就售空了。
钱说，旅行社推出了更多优质套餐，而西班牙朝圣路线和极光之旅对年轻顾客尤其有吸引力。与此同时，年长的旅行者往往更喜欢游轮。
她说，日本馆、菲律宾和旅行社的展位分配都达到了新高。
钱表示，尽管总体展位数量与去年相似，但私营部门的参与有所增加，而政府的参与因预算削减而减少。
她说，航空公司和旅行社早在展会之前就开始推销他们的产品，而一些未参加 ITF 的公司也举办在线销售活动，以满足需求。
钱表示，机票价格上涨和海外冲突并没有浇灭台湾消费者的旅游热情，尽管游客正在调整目的地以避免陷入困境的地区。
展会将展示国内和国际旅游产品，包括铁路旅行、游轮和主题行程。

Taiwan travel fair eyes 400,000 visitors as premium trip demand grows
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Prospective travelers visit a Taiwanese travel fair in this CNA file photo
Taipei, Nov. 2 (CNA) Organizers of the Taiwan International Travel Fair (ITF) hope to attract more than 400,000 visitors this year, with younger travelers increasingly seeking distinctive experiences rather than bargains alone, the organizer's chairwoman said Monday.
At a pre-event press conference in Taipei, Taiwan Visitors Association Chairwoman Chien Yu-yen (簡余晏) said early-bird ticket sales had risen more than 10 percent from last year, when attendance exceeded 360,000.
The fair, celebrating its 40th anniversary, will run Nov. 6-9 at Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center, Hall 1, featuring over 550 exhibitors occupying 1,600 booths representing 123 countries and cities.
"In the past, people came to the travel fair for value-for-money deals and discounted meal vouchers," Chien said.
"But we're finding that younger travelers are increasingly buying higher-priced, distinctive trips they want to experience at least once in their lives."
Polar expeditions, aurora-viewing trips and European itineraries were among the products drawing interest, she said, citing a baseball tour priced at NT$490,000 (US$15,033) per person that sold out quickly.
Travel agencies were responding with more premium packages, while pilgrimage routes in Spain and aurora tours were particularly appealing to younger customers, Chien said. Older travelers, meanwhile, tended to favor cruises.
Booth allocations for the Japan Pavilion, the Philippines, and travel agencies had reached new highs, she said.
Although the overall booth count remained similar to last year, private sector participation had increased while government presences were down following budget cuts, according to Chien.
Airlines and travel agencies began promoting their offerings well before the exhibition, while some companies not participating in the ITF were also holding online sales to capitalize on demand, she said.
Chien said higher airfares and overseas conflicts are not extinguishing Taiwanese consumers' enthusiasm for travel, though travelers are adjusting their destinations to avoid troubled areas.
The fair will feature both domestic and international travel products, including rail journeys, cruises and themed itineraries.

title: Synology warns of C3RB3R ransomware attacks targeting NAS devices

source: 网络安全、技术新闻和支持

content:
Synology 警告针对 NAS 设备的 C3RB3R 勒索软件攻击
Synology 警告针对 NAS 设备的 C3RB3R 勒索软件攻击
Synology 警告针对 NAS 设备的 C3RB3R 勒索软件攻击
由于 C3RB3r 勒索软件攻击激增，台湾网络附加存储 (NAS) 设备制造商 Synology 警告客户立即更新其设备。
该公司敦促用户启用自动更新并将其 NAS 设备上运行的 DiskStation Manager (DSM) 软件升级到最新版本，以保护他们的数据。
“Synology 已发现威胁行为者利用 2024 年 12 月修补的漏洞来攻击运行过时版本 DSM 的设备。这些攻击的目的是加密数据并勒索赎金，”该公司在周四的通报中表示。
“Synology 强烈敦促所有运行易受攻击版本的用户立即更新 DSM 以保护其系统。Synology 还建议启用自动更新以使 DSM 始终保持最新状态。”
当 BleepingComputer 寻求有关这些 C3RB3r 勒索软件攻击的更多信息时，未能立即联系到 Synology 发言人。
虽然 Synology 尚未透露这些持续攻击中利用的是哪个漏洞，但它链接到 2024 年 11 月的安全公告，其中包含针对漏洞发布的补丁信息，允许攻击者在未修补的设备上执行任意代码 (CVE-2024-10441)、读取文件 (CVE-2024-50629) 和写入文件 (CVE-2024-10445)。
建议 Synology 用户立即阻止从 Internet 对管理 Web 界面的访问，并更新其 DSM 软件，以阻止攻击者尝试破解和加密其设备。
产品严重性固定版本可用性 DSM 7.2.2 重要升级到 7.2.2-72806-1 或更高版本。 DSM 7.2.1 重要升级至 7.2.1-69057-6 或更高版本。 DSM 7.2 重要升级至 7.2-64570-4 或更高版本。 DSM 7.1 重要升级至 7.1.1-42962-7 或更高版本。 DSM 6.2 中等升级至 6.2.4-25556-8 或更高版本。
Synology 很少发布针对其客户设备的攻击的安全公告，最后一次此类警报发布于 2019 年 8 月，当时发生了导致 eCh0raix 勒索软件感染的大规模暴力攻击。
上周发布的公告是在 Synology 客户收到大量报告后发布的，这些客户的数据已被加密，并被提示从暗网门户以数千美元购买“C3rb3r Decryptor”工具。
第一份报告于两周前出现，受影响的用户表示勒索软件释放了勒索信息 (read-me3.txt)，并在加密文件中添加了 .L0CK3D 扩展名。
“你所有的重要文件都已被加密。任何使用第三方软件恢复文件的尝试都将对你的文件造成致命的伤害！安全解密文件的唯一方法是购买特殊的解密软件‘C3rb3r Decryptor’，”勒索信中警告道。
“在此页面上，您将收到如何购买解密软件来恢复所有文件的完整说明。此外，在此页面上，您将能够免费恢复任何一个文件，以确保‘C3rb3r Decryptor’能够帮助您。”
Cerber 勒索软件（也称为 C3RB3R 和 CerberImposter）目前部署在针对 Synology NAS 设备的攻击中，该勒索软件借用了 2016 年出现的臭名昭著的勒索软件即服务 (RaaS) 的名称。
在 2019 年底消失之前，旧的 Cerber 勒索软件操作占所有勒索软件攻击的 80% 以上，占 e 上所有勒索软件感染的四分之一。

【原文 English Original】
Synology warns of C3RB3R ransomware attacks targeting NAS devices
Synology warns of C3RB3R ransomware attacks targeting NAS devices
Synology warns of C3RB3R ransomware attacks targeting NAS devices
Taiwanese network-attached storage (NAS) appliance maker Synology warned customers to update their devices immediately due to a surge in C3RB3r ransomware attacks.
The company urged users to enable automatic updates and upgrade the DiskStation Manager (DSM) software running on their NAS devices to the latest version to protect their data.
"Synology has identified threat actors exploiting a vulnerability patched in December 2024 to target devices running outdated versions of DSM. These attacks aim to encrypt data and extort ransom," it said in a Thursday advisory.
"Synology strongly urges all users running vulnerable versions to update DSM immediately to protect their systems. Synology also recommends enabling automatic updates to keep DSM up to date at all times."
A Synology spokesperson was not immediately available when BleepingComputer reached out for more information on these C3RB3r ransomware attacks.
While Synology has yet to share which vulnerability is being exploited in these ongoing attacks, it linked to a November 2024 security advisory with information about patches released for vulnerabilities allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code (CVE-2024-10441), read files (CVE-2024-50629), and write files (CVE-2024-10445) on unpatched devices.
Synology users are advised to immediately block access to the management web interface from the Internet and update their DSM software to block attackers' attempts to hack and encrypt their devices.
Product Severity Fixed Release Availability DSM 7.2.2 Critical Upgrade to 7.2.2-72806-1 or above. DSM 7.2.1 Critical Upgrade to 7.2.1-69057-6 or above. DSM 7.2 Critical Upgrade to 7.2-64570-4 or above. DSM 7.1 Critical Upgrade to 7.1.1-42962-7 or above. DSM 6.2 Moderate Upgrade to 6.2.4-25556-8 or above.
Synology rarely issues security advisories warning of attacks targeting its customers' devices, with the last such alert published in August 2019 following large-scale brute-force attacks that led to eCh0raix ransomware infections.
Last week's advisory follows a massive wave of reports from Synology customers whose data was encrypted and who were prompted to buy "C3rb3r Decryptor" tool from a dark web portal for thousands of dollars.
The first reports surfaced more than two weeks ago, with affected users saying the ransomware dropped a ransom note (read-me3.txt) and added a .L0CK3D extension to encrypted files.
"All your important files have been encrypted. Any attempts to restore your files with thrid-party software will be fatal for your files! The only way to decrypt your files safely is to buy the special decryption software 'C3rb3r Decryptor'," the ransom note warns.
"At this page you will receive the complete instructions how to buy the decryption software for restoring all your files. Also at this page you will be able to restore any one file for free to be sure 'C3rb3r Decryptor' will help you."
The Cerber ransomware (also known as C3RB3R and CerberImposter), now deployed in attacks targeting Synology NAS devices, borrowed its name from a notorious Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) with the same name that emerged in 2016.
Before disappearing at the end of 2019, the old Cerber ransomware operation accounted for more than 80% of all ransomware attacks and a quarter of all ransomware infections on enterprise endpoints.
Starting in December 2021, when it was first spotted, C3RB3R was also deployed on Atlassian Confluence and GitLab servers as part of several attack waves exploiting remote code execution (CVE-2021-26084 and CVE-2021-22205) and authentication bypass (CVE-2023-22518) flaws.
Internet threat watchdog Shadowserver now tracks over 380,000 Internet-exposed Synology NAS devices, but doesn't provide information on how many have already been secured against these attacks or are honeypots.

content:
香港发展局向行政长官提交玛丽医院电梯调查报告 |中国劳工公告栏
星期二, 3 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港发展局向行政长官提交玛丽医院电梯调查报告
香港发展局已就玛丽医院新门诊大楼电梯问题向行政长官提交调查报告。十七部电梯已修复，其中七部现已开放供公众使用。该局会尽快向立法会发展事务委员会汇报。
香港发展局表示，已就玛丽医院新临床大楼多部升降机早前因工程问题无法运作一事向行政长官提交调查报告。该局现正遵照行政长官指示，提供进一步的补救工作及跟进行动的资料，并会尽快向立法会发展事务委员会汇报调查结果，并作出公开解释。
过去数月，该局表示重点督促建筑署及机电工程署尽快完成玛丽医院新临床大楼的修缮工程。截至目前，已有17部电梯进行了修复工程。根据目前的进展，剩余电梯的修复工作预计将在第四季度内完成。已修复的17部电梯中，有7部已通过检验，并根据医院需要开放供员工和公众使用。有关承建商自费为新启用的升降机提供操作人员，以改善与乘客的沟通。
自今年9月起，该局对玛丽医院一期临床大楼的电梯工程进行独立调查，旨在找出该工程在施工、验收和监督方面的不足之处，并探讨类似工程项目的监督制度是否有改进的空间。

Hong Kong development bureau submits Mary Hospital lift probe report to chief executive | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 3 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong development bureau submits Mary Hospital lift probe report to chief executive
Hong Kong's Development Bureau has submitted an investigation report to the chief executive on lift issues at Mary Hospital's new clinical block. Seventeen lifts have been repaired, with seven now open for public use. The bureau will report to LegCo's development panel soon.
The Development Bureau of Hong Kong said it has submitted an investigation report to the Chief Executive regarding multiple lifts at the new clinical block of Mary Hospital that earlier could not operate due to engineering problems. The bureau is now following the Chief Executive's instructions by providing further information on remedial works and follow-up actions, and will report the investigation findings to the Legislative Council's Development Panel as soon as possible, making a public explanation.
Over the past few months, the bureau said it had focused on urging the Architectural Services Department and the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department to complete remedial works at Mary Hospital's new clinical block as quickly as possible. So far, 17 lifts have undergone remedial works. Based on current progress, remedial work on the remaining lifts is expected to be completed within the fourth quarter. Among the 17 lifts that have been repaired, seven have passed inspection and, in accordance with hospital needs, have been opened for use by staff and the public. The contractor concerned has, at its own expense, provided operators for the newly commissioned lifts to improve communication with passengers.
Since September this year, the bureau has been conducting an independent investigation into the lift works at Mary Hospital's Clinical Block 1. The investigation aims to identify any shortcomings in the construction, acceptance inspection and supervision of the works, and to explore whether there is room to improve the oversight system for similar engineering projects.

RFI法广中文 / 非洲时事

## 美国将助马达加斯加建厂炼稀土

美国将资助印度洋中的非洲大岛国马达加斯加（Madagascar）在安帕辛达瓦（Ampasindava）建设一座稀土提炼厂。通过对这一项目的支持，华盛顿寻求实现供应链多元化，以应对中国。这是本台法广（RFI）非洲通讯员10月31日周六刊出的一篇有关中美关系的最新法文报道。目前在美国第二届特朗普政府中负责经济事务的副国务卿雅各布·赫尔伯格（Jacob Helberg）已确认了480万美元的首笔资金。

发表时间： 01/11/2026 - 22:51 更改时间： 01/11/2026 - 22:58

9 分钟 浏览时间

 Image d'archive / Vue aérienne de la mine de Kwale, au Kenya, modèle de référence pour la mine de Vara Mada, sur la Grande Île de Madagascar. (illustration) © Energy Fuels, avec autorisation.

据本台法广[非洲](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/)组（RFI Afrique）的法文报道，[马达加斯加](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E5%85%B3%E9%94%AE%E8%AF%8D/%E9%A9%AC%E8%BE%BE%E5%8A%A0%E6%96%AF%E5%8A%A0/)（[Madagascar](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/tag/madagascar/)）处于全球关键矿产资源争夺战的核心地带。两天前，美国政府中负责经济事务的副国务卿雅各布·赫尔伯格（Jacob Helberg）证实，作为试点，华盛顿将在马达加斯加西北部的安帕辛达瓦（Ampasindava）资助建设一座稀土元素提炼厂。

**-- 美国投资马达加斯加剑指中国 --**

本台法广（RFI）[非洲](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/)通讯员季兰姆（**Guilhem Fabry**）于2026年10月1日星期六发自马达加斯加首都安塔那那利佛（Antananarivo）的消息说，据估计，这一矿区蕴藏着近7亿吨离子型黏土（d’argiles ioniques），其中所含元素对于生产磁体具有极高价值，是众多技术产品中不可或缺的组件。

[![Image 2: format adapté](https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/5cfd06aa-d63a-11f1-94b9-1beafce15fea/w:1024/2026-11-01-D-FMM-Image-Afrique-Madagascar-Vara-Mada-archive-RFI.jpg) Image d'archive / Vue aérienne de la mine de Kwale, au Kenya, modèle de référence pour la mine de Vara Mada, sur la Grande Île de Madagascar. (illustration) © Energy Fuels, avec autorisation.](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E4%B8%AD%E5%9C%8B/20261101-rfi%E6%B3%95%E5%BB%A3-%E5%B0%BC%E5%8F%A4%E6%8B%89-%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2-%E7%BE%8E%E5%9C%8B%E5%B0%87%E5%8A%A9%E9%A6%AC%E9%81%94%E5%8A%A0%E6%96%AF%E5%8A%A0%E5%BB%BA%E5%BB%A0%E7%85%89%E7%A8%80%E5%9C%9F)
同一法文消息说，美国副国务卿雅各布·赫尔伯格（Jacob Helberg）已确认提供一笔480万美元的初步资金。这笔资金由美国国际开发金融公司（DFC）提供给英国企业Harena Rare Earths公司。该公司刚刚在三周前的10月8日，获得了马达加斯加当局就Ampasindava项目的开采许可证。这笔来自美国的投资旨在支持项目后续阶段的工作——包括开展环境与社会研究，以及建设中的试点工厂和实验室——为预计于2028年底启动的运营做好准备。

**--****马达加斯加****当地社区强烈反对****--**

本台法广[非洲](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/)组（RFI Afrique）的法文报道还提到，自2000年代以来，多家公司相继寻求勘探安帕辛达瓦（Ampasindava）地区的矿产潜力，却遭到了当地社区的强烈反对；当地居民对环境和健康风险深感担忧。通过支持这一项目，华盛顿旨在实现其供应链的多样化，以应对中国——中国在稀土开采和提炼领域是当之无愧的世界领先者。

 Tellurium, một trong các kim loại hiếm. Ảnh minh họa. AP 11/05/2022. AP - Rick Bowmer

本台法广（RFI）[非洲](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E9%97%9C%E9%8D%B5%E8%A9%9E/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/)通讯员在其这篇法文稿件的最后一个段落中指出，通过Energy Fuels公司，美国在此领域已经进驻[马达加斯加](https://www.rfi.fr/tw/%E9%97%9C%E9%8D%B5%E8%A9%9E/%E9%A6%AC%E9%81%94%E5%8A%A0%E6%96%AF%E5%8A%A0/)。这家公司是位于马达加斯加西南部Tuléar地区的Vara Mada大型项目股东之一。

C'est le chef-lieu de la région Atsimo-Andrefana.](https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/e38c5f9a-2645-11f1-8c17-005056bfb2b6/w:1024/FMM-archive-Afrique-Madagascar-et-sa-capitale-Antananarivo-Image-logo-RFI.jpg) 存档地图 / 印度洋中的非洲岛国马达加斯加及其首都安塔那那利佛（Antananarivo）。 carte archive / Madagascar et ses grandes villes. TechCrunch Mobility: A new, bigger AV boom is here
9:04 AM PST · November 1, 2026
Welcome back to TechCrunch Mobility, your hub for the future of transportation and now, more than ever, the role AI is playing in it. To get this in your inbox, sign up here for free — just click TechCrunch Mobility!
I’ve joked here and on the Equity and Autonocast podcasts that the autonomous vehicle industry feels a lot like 2016, at least in terms of the buzziness surrounding the sector.
But a recent conversation with Trucks VC partner Puneeth Meruva has me rethinking that comparison. There’s evidence that 2026 is even hotter — at least by certain measures — than those frothy dealmaking days of 2016 and 2017.
Trucks VC, which specializes in early-stage investing, has fielded pitches from 81 new autonomous vehicle startups so far in 2026 — two-thirds more than last year and enough to surpass the boom years of a decade ago. The VC firm argues in a new blog post that we’re in the midst of a second, even bigger AV wave fueled by technological breakthroughs. Yes, I’m talking about AI.
“For a long time AV companies were trying to go from what was AV 1.0 to AV 2.0, which is kind of this holy grail end-to-end architecture for AVs,” Meruva told me. “And I think the foundation models now provide a technical architecture that makes those end-to-end systems possible.”
These foundational models are particularly good at generalizing across different environments and scenarios, potentially making AVs cheaper and faster to deploy. The arrival of powerful open source models like Nvidia’s Alpamayo and Qwen’s general-purpose vision-language-action models has made it even easier for startups to get off the ground.
The barrier to entry is lower than ever before. Meruva said Trucks is consistently seeing startups deploy within a few months and with less than $1 million raised. (And while Meruva wouldn’t name names, the firm has invested in some of them.)
Of these 81 startups that pitched Trucks VC, I mistakenly assumed most would be applying their AV tech to construction, warehouse, agriculture, and mining. And yes, those were in the mix. But what surprised me was the growing number of startups pitching pure-play robotaxi businesses. And many are positioning themselves as direct competitors to Waymo.
As wild and galaxy brain-thinking as that may sound, Meruva thinks there is room for smaller players.
“In this world, smaller, more niche autonomy companies can compete — maybe they’re not competing with Waymo on a global scale, but maybe they’re competing in specific regions or specific types of routes,” he said.
And Meruva doesn’t see the pace flattening. He expects even more AV startups to pitch the firm next year.
Regular readers of this newsletter know we’ve been closely following Slate Auto — breaking the original story on Jeff Bezos’ investment way back in April 2025. But the company it spun out of is what got our attention this week.
Re:Build, a Massachusetts-based manufacturing accelerator, raised $2.1 billion to “expand Re:Build’s capacity to manufacture hard tech products and launch new industrial startups.” The investment was led by General Catalyst and JPMorganChase’s Strategic Investment Group. Other investors weren’t disclosed.
The company, which was co-founded by Amazon’s former commercial CEO Jeff Wilke, has billed itself as “America’s answer to Shenzhen.”
Bedrock Robotics raised $600 million in a funding round that values the autonomous vehicle technology startup at $4.1 billion. CapitalG and Emergence Capital co-led the Series C round. New investors US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Bessemer Venture Partners, and Temasek participated in the round, alongside existing investors 8VC, Georgian, Valor Equity Partners, Xora, Eclipse, Perry Creek Capital, and Nvidia.
DoorDash has agreed to acquire Instacart for $17 billion. Meanwhile, DoorDash noted in its third-quarter earnings that it has, so far, only received a few hundred orders from AI agents.
PreScalar, a San Francisco-based startup developing software and testing infrastructure for factories, raised $7 million in seed funding co-led by Dynamo Ventures and BMW i Ventures, with participation from Blue Wire Capital, Uplift Ventures, and Antler. The startup was founded last year by a trio who had stints at Cruise, Google, Rivian, and Waymo.
Elroy Air, a startup developing autonomous heavy-cargo drones for defense, rapid response, and commercial logistics, hired Jeremy Hux as its CFO in preparation for going public.
Ford announced two new EV chargers that will allow its forthcoming Fathom pickup truck to serve as a battery capable of delivering power to the home or grid.
GM is embracing hybrids now. Times sure have changed! The U.S. automaker is also trying to move past the driver data-selling controversy from several years ago. GM agreed to a $220 million settlement with 36 states (its settlement with California and the Federal Trade Commission happened earlier) to settle allegations that it illegally sold private driving behavior and location information to data brokers.
Kodiak AI will deliver 75 self-driving trucks to freight company DTL Transport starting in 2028. It’s the company’s first binding commercial deal for driverless big rigs that will run on public highways.
Rivian reported its third-quarter earnings, and a few items stood out to us. For one, the new R2 has been successful enough for the company to raise its 2026 delivery guidance by a couple thousands vehicles. Rivian, which had previously expected to deliver between 65,000 and 70,000 EVs this year, bumped up that floor to 67,000. But here is another potentially lucrative development: The $5.8 billion joint venture between Rivian and Volkswagen Group is expanding to include AI assistants. No word yet on whether that means VW will invest even more money into Rivian.
Tesla turns to Turo to boost adoption of Full Self-Driving (Supervised).
Waymo and Toyota have locked in a manufacturing partnership, officially moving them past the “we’re just talking” phase. Toyota will manufacture AV-ready bZ4X vehicles — and integrate Waymo’s self-driving system — at its factory in Japan. The vehicles will be used for robotaxi services in Japan, the U.K., and other international markets. Importantly, the companies hinted that this could eventually lead to a licensing deal in which Waymo AV tech is in personally owned vehicles.
Last call for founders, investors, and builders based in and around the Boston area. The Founder Summit — a one-day event in Boston — will be held on November 4. And I will be there! This event is really geared toward startup founders, aspiring founders, and investors. Attendees can expect advice-driven talks from VCs and serial founders, plus lots of chances to network.
For my TechCrunch Mobility readers, here is a 30% discount on tickets. Click this link and use the code mobility30.

From restaurant guides to payments, here’s how TikTok is building a super app
8:41 AM PDT · October 31, 2026
TikTok announced this week that it’s adding an in-app restaurant guide, marking another step in the platform’s expansion beyond social media. The company has also recently been spotted developing a feature that would allow users to send money over direct messages.
The social media app has steadily expanded its offerings in recent years, adding TikTok Shop, a map for local discovery, more robust search features, games, and more. It appears that TikTok is taking steps to evolve into a “super app,” a single platform where users can do much more than just watch and share videos and that can actually handle a wide range of needs in one destination.
The super app model is big in China with apps like WeChat, which is kind of like Facebook, WhatsApp, Apple Pay, and an app store all rolled into a single platform. Of course, there’s the question of whether a super app model would work outside of China, but that doesn’t mean TikTok won’t try.
Instead of switching between apps, TikTok is working to become the app that people use for most of their digital activities. After taking its biggest leap with TikTok Shop, the company — which, notably, transitioned to new, primarily U.S. ownership back in January — has applied the same playbook to recent developments.
TikTok has become a popular destination for restaurant recommendations, with viral videos often driving customers to local eateries. Now, the platform is looking to make that discovery process even easier with a new feature called “Must Eat.” The community-driven guide highlights restaurants getting attention on the platform.
“Must Eat” draws on more than 40 million posts and comments to compile restaurant recommendations and curated lists in one place. Users can browse restaurants by city and narrow their search by cuisine, price, rating, and location.
The move puts TikTok in more direct competition with platforms like Yelp and Google Maps. It also reflects how the app is expanding its role in users’ everyday decisions, from what they buy to where they choose to go out to eat.
Bloomberg reported in August that TikTok is developing a feature that would allow users to send each other money via direct messages. If rolled out, the feature would use the social media service’s TikTok Pay offering, which is already available in Southeast Asia for TikTok Shop purchases.
Additionally, Reuters reported in March that TikTok had applied to Brazil’s central bank for approval to operate as a financial technology company offering lending and payment services.
TikTok’s potential expansion into payments marks a significant way that the company is branching out beyond a social media platform and into a digital ecosystem. By aiming to bring financial services into its app, TikTok is looking to increase user engagement, open new revenue streams, and position itself to compete with fintech startups and e-commerce platforms.
Over the years, TikTok has steadily been looking to become a place where users can come for sports highlights and content. In early June, the company launched a dedicated hub for the FIFA World Cup where users can see scores, match schedules, standings, trending videos, highlights, videos from players, and more.
If people are already watching videos on TikTok but want to keep up with the score, they can do so without leaving the app or opening a dedicated sports news app or Google.
The World Cup hub was made possible through TikTok’s Sports-focused product called “TikTok GamePlan,” which is designed to allow sports teams, leagues, and broadcasters to drive discovery and engagement on the platform. The social media giant also has partnerships with Major League Soccer (MLS) and Major League Baseball (MLB) for behind-the-scenes and exclusive content.
In May, TikTok launched TikTok GO, a way for users to discover and book hotels, attractions, and experiences directly within its app in the United States. TikTok GO surfaces lodging and things to do through videos, search, and location pages. When users find something they’re interested in, they can view details, check availability, and complete a booking.
Instead of directing users to third-party websites after they find a destination or recommendation in a video, TikTok has started positioning itself as a one-stop platform where viral travel content can drive bookings and revenue.
While people have already been using TikTok as a search engine and replacement for Google, this latest step puts TikTok in more direct competition with Google’s core businesses, Search and Google Maps, because it’s working to not only be the app where you discover places, but also the platform where you purchase that trip.
It’s widely known that one of TikTok’s biggest leaps beyond social media was the launch of TikTok Shop. TikTok began testing TikTok Shop in 2021 and launched it in the U.S. in 2023. Since then, the company has been able to successfully compete with Amazon, Shein, and other online marketplaces.
According to eMarketer, TikTok Shop grew its U.S. sales by 407% in 2024 and another 108% in 2025 to reach $15.82 billion. As of last year, the company accounted for 18.2% of total social commerce in the U.S., with that number expected to reach 24.1% by 2027.
Additionally, TikTok began challenging digital marketplaces even further with the launch of TikTok Shop gift cards late last year. TikTok Shop has also recently expanded into luxury retail, after initially mainly being known for cheap goods.
TikTok’s popularity has influenced the music industry and how people discover new music, and the company tried to capitalize on this by launching a streaming service called TikTok Music in 2023 to take on platforms like Spotify and Apple Music, but ended up shutting it down a year later.
The company said it would focus on driving music listening and continue partnering with music streaming services rather than competing with them. TikTok hasn’t completely abandoned its music ambitions, however, as the company recently introduced a feature that lets Apple Music subscribers play full songs in the app after discovering them on their “For You” feed.
TikTok has launched a robust search experience that surfaces maps, local hashtags, and even reviews to help users discover trending restaurants, travel locations, shops, and local experiences. It has also added more detailed information about places and restaurants on dedicated pages, allowing users to quickly see things like opening hours, star ratings, price ranges, and more.
TikTok was already eating into Google’s Search business when it first launched, as it quickly surfaced videos featuring commentary and visuals of restaurant food and places. However, users may still have needed to turn to Google Search to find a place’s exact location or to read reviews. Over the past few years, however, TikTok has increasingly eliminated that need by integrating detailed information about places right within its app.
While TikTok is known for user-generated entertainment, the company has also begun embracing microdramas by launching an in-app Minis section and a dedicated stand-alone app for bite-sized TV shows that can be watched in a series of one-minute episodes. While TikTok already competes with streaming giants like Netflix for users’ attention, its move into scripted shows puts it in even more direct competition with them.
It’s worth noting that TikTok first took strides into entertainment with the launch of livestreaming and support for longer videos, a significant move away from its initial focus on 15-second videos.
TikTok has also launched a series of casual games in its app to get users to spend even more time on its platform and engage with others in DMs. The addition of games marked TikTok’s ongoing effort to go from a social media platform to an all-in-one entertainment platform where you can not only scroll through videos, but also challenge friends to easy-to-play games.

content:
唐纳德·特朗普在 7 月份的全国演讲中表示，情报机构的报告显示，美国选举极易受到外国干涉。他说，中国“购买、窃取或窃取了”18 个州的选民数据，并暗示外国特工以某种方式能够操纵实际选票。他当天公开的中央情报局和其他机构的报告并没有支持他最夸张的说法。但特朗普表示，外国政府可能从他手中窃取了 2020 年大选的机会，并且可能会再次发动袭击。民主党人认为这次演讲是下周选举的彩排。多年来，特朗普一直声称外国政府拥有侵入电子投票机以改变选举结果的权力。选举安全专家和立法者告诉我，如果共和党失去众议院和参议院的大量席位，他们预计他会再次提出同样的主张。他们担心他会利用机密情报报告作为借口，试图夺取选票或阻止各州计票。 “我们首先假设总统会这么做，”众议院情报委员会资深民主党人、康涅狄格州众议员吉姆·希姆斯上周对记者表示。但根据希姆斯表示他看到的有关选举的外国威胁的最新情报，美国的对手并没有改变选票。
他说：“我们从未见过真正进行干预的行动。”情报机构和选举监测组织多年来的报告为希姆斯提供了支持。外国政府进行宣传并试图破坏人们对政治进程的信心，他们试图影响政策，有时是通过间谍活动。但影响力和干扰之间存在很大区别，专家将其定义为以改变结果为目的的操纵选举。特朗普高级官员试图证明外国行为者与民主党和其他“深层国家”利益集团合作，以阻止特朗普在 2020 年连任，但他们的理论却落空了。前国家情报总监图尔西·加巴德（Tulsi Gabbard）甚至从波多黎各获取投票机并测试其是否有篡改的证据。她的探查没有发现任何结果。投票机如此安全的原因之一是它们没有连接到互联网。布伦南中心选举和政府项目副总裁劳伦斯·诺登告诉我：“外国或外部参与者要进行实际投票是极其困难的。”他补充说：“我们几乎拥有美国目前投票的所有投票的纸质备份。”因此，即使黑客设法通过计算机计票将选票从一名候选人转到另一名候选人身上，选举官员也能发现这种差异。诺登表示，在他看来，外国政府并不是本季的主要担忧。
相反，主要的担忧来源是离家较近的地方。“这次选举的新威胁是政府，”诺登说。真正的限制限制了特朗普干预中期选举的能力，即使他试图这样做。宪法赋予各州管理选举的权力，美国法律禁止总统实施许多专家认为的噩梦般的“国有化”投票场景。 “仅仅总统的声明并不足以在法律上证明闯入并试图夺取投票机或选票的合理性，”民主党人理查德·皮尔德斯 (Richard Pildes) 说。

I n a speech to the nation in July, Donald Trump said that reports from intelligence agencies showed that American elections were profoundly vulnerable to foreign interference. China had “bought, stolen, or hacked” voter data in 18 states, he said, and he implied that foreign operatives had somehow been able to manipulate actual votes. Reports by the CIA and other agencies that he made public that day did not back up his most extravagant claims. But Trump suggested that a foreign government may have stolen the 2020 election from him, and that it could strike again. Democrats consider that speech a dress rehearsal for next week’s elections. For years, Trump has claimed that foreign governments possess the power to hack electronic voting machines to change the outcome of a race. Election-security experts and lawmakers told me that they expect him to trot out the same claims again if Republicans lose large numbers of seats in the House and Senate. And they’re concerned that he’ll use classified intelligence reports as a pretext for trying to seize ballots or stop vote-counting by the states. “We start with the premise that the president is going to do that,” Representative Jim Himes of Connecticut, the senior Democrat on the House Intelligence Committee, told reporters last week. But according to the most recent intelligence that Himes said he had seen about foreign threats to the election, U.S. adversaries haven’t changed votes. “We have never seen an operation to actually interfere,” he said. Years of reporting from intelligence agencies and election-monitoring groups backs Himes up. Foreign governments disseminate propaganda and try to undermine confidence in the political process, and they seek to influence policy, sometimes through espionage. But there is a big difference between influence and interference, which experts define as manipulation of an election with the aim of altering the outcome. Top Trump officials have sought to prove that foreign actors worked with Democrats and other “deep state” interests to deny Trump a second term in 2020, only for their theories to come up empty. Former Director of National Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard went so far as to obtain voting machines from Puerto Rico and test them for evidence of tampering. Her probe found none . One reason voting machines are so secure is that they’re not connected to the internet. “It would be extremely hard for a foreign or outside actor to reach the actual vote,” Lawrence Norden, the vice president of the Elections and Government Program at the Brennan Center, told me. “And we have a paper backup of almost every vote that is cast in the United States at this point,” he added. So even if a hacker managed to flip a vote from one candidate to another on a computer tally, election officials could spot the discrepancy. Norden said that, in his view, foreign governments aren’t the major concern this season. Instead, the dominant source of worry is closer to home. “The new threat in this election is the administration,” Norden said. R eal limits constrain Trump’s ability to interfere in the midterms, even if he tries to do so. The Constitution gives states the power to administer elections, and U.S. law prevents a president from carrying out what many experts consider a nightmare scenario of “nationalizing” the vote. “A mere declaration by the president is not going to be enough legally to justify going in and trying to seize voting machines or ballots,” Richard Pildes, a professor at NYU School of Law, told me. Federal agents would need a warrant to take control of election equipment or ballots, and first they’d need to persuade a judge there was probable cause that a crime had occurred. Any classified intelligence reports might have to be shown to a judge, Pildes said. Even if the government was successful, it cannot legally remove the ballots themselves from state custody, and must rely on copies or images of them, he added. “There’s certainly no power in the executive branch to take over or nationalize the election process,” Pildes said. A White House spokeswoman told me that Trump was focused on prosecuting election crimes, including voter fraud, and on strengthening election infrastructure. The Department of Homeland Security has offered physical security and cybersecurity services to states and localities. “The only ‘concerns’ about election security are being caused by radical Democrats refusing to enact basic election security measures, supported by the majority of Americans, including voter ID and citizenship verification to ensure only Americans are electing America’s leaders,” the spokeswoman, Laruen Biss, said in a statement. “President Trump has done more than any other President to ensure we have free and fair elections.” [ Read: Trump still hasn’t found what he’s looking for ] Should Trump claim that foreign operatives are changing votes, Himes and his counterpart on the Senate Intelligence Committee, Mark Warner of Virginia, told reporters they would call the president’s intelligence advisers and ask for the underlying facts. Himes said that he told CIA Director John Ratcliffe and Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton, “When the president makes that announcement, you will answer your cellphone to give us information about what’s happening.” A spokesperson for Clayton’s office told me that since he was confirmed this summer, he “has made it clear” to the leadership of the House and Senate committees “that he is available to them 24/7 on any issue.” A CIA spokesperson told me, “Director Ratcliffe is responsive to CIA’s Oversight Committees and will continue to be available as appropriate.” Recently, House committee members met with career staff in Clayton’s office who monitor threats to election security. It’s a smaller group these days, after cuts by the administration, Himes said. “But we got a lot of confidence that they are doing their job, that if the president were to demand that they make something up, one way or another, we would learn about that,” he said. T he threat profile from U.S. adversaries this fall is similar to what it’s been before other major U.S. elections in recent years. Russia continues to spread misinformation aimed at undermining public confidence in the political system, voting machines, and Democrats in particular, according to lawmakers and election-security experts. In some cases, Moscow-aligned actors are making deepfake videos with the help of AI to spread false allegations of misconduct . China has focused more on local races and influencing specific policies, often by recruiting agents in the United States. (In May, a former mayor of a Los Angeles suburb pleaded guilty to acting as an illegal foreign agent, primarily by promoting Chinese propaganda.) As for the Iranians, who historically have tried to influence U.S. elections, they appear more focused this year on keeping gas prices high by disrupting traffic in the Strait of Hormuz. Foreign influence has been a prominent feature of American politics for a decade now, since Russia used propaganda and selectively leaked emails to divide voters and denigrate Trump’s 2016 opponent, Hillary Clinton. But true interference would be novel, alarming, and contradicted by U.S. intelligence agencies’ best estimates about what foreign adversaries actually hope to achieve. Norden said that both before the election and just after, Russian influence groups are likely to again sow divisions and political discord. One Russian propaganda group in particular, Storm-1516, was active in the 2024 election and could come on the scene again, he said. But peddling misinformation, however corrosive, is not the same thing as flipping votes. Meanwhile, Norden said, the Trump administration has laid the foundations to undermine the public’s confidence in the outcome of the election. That is its own kind of influence operation. [ From the October 2026 issue: The election deniers’ long game ] Intelligence officials seem aware of that particular risk. Back in July, when Trump tried to suggest that China might have had a hand in his loss, the declassified documents that the White House put on its website didn’t substantiate those claims. One CIA document that garnered significant attention from lawmakers and security experts contained a summary of China’s aggressive efforts to exert influence on American politics and economic policy. But it didn’t claim that China had ever interfered and changed votes. If any renewed claims of foreign interference by Trump next Tuesday, or in the days that follow, are to be believed, they will require the sort of evidence that he has so far been unable to supply.

title: 国会中期选举结果会影响美国的对华政策吗？
summary: 在德克萨斯州休斯顿的西格雷大都会多服务中心，一名女子抵达投票站，这是德克萨斯州中期选举提前投票的第一天。(2026年10月19日) 距离11月3日美国国会中期选举不到一个星期，选举结果将如何影响华盛顿对华政策，受到外界关注。两位前美国情报官员在接受美国之音采访时表示，无论国会控制权是否易手，美国对华政策预计仍将保持总体延续性，但新一届国会可能在对台军售、技术出口管制等具体议题上发挥更大作用。 美国前国防情报局代理局长戴维·谢德(David Shedd)认为，政策延续性的基础，
content: 在德克萨斯州休斯顿的西格雷大都会多服务中心，一名女子抵达投票站，这是德克萨斯州中期选举提前投票的第一天。(2026年10月19日) 距离11月3日美国国会中期选举不到一个星期，选举结果将如何影响华盛顿对华政策，受到外界关注。两位前美国情报官员在接受美国之音采访时表示，无论国会控制权是否易手，美国对华政策预计仍将保持总体延续性，但新一届国会可能在对台军售、技术出口管制等具体议题上发挥更大作用。 美国前国防情报局代理局长戴维·谢德(David Shedd)认为，政策延续性的基础，是两党对中国所构成威胁的共同关切。布鲁金斯学会研究员、前白宫国家安全委员会中国事务主任秦江南(Jon Czin)得出了类似结论，但对华盛顿应采取哪些具体政策，他质疑两党究竟有多大共识。 两人的分析指向一个区别：国会可以增加压力、推动立法并质疑行政部门的决定，却未必能够改变一位仍然主导对华关系的总统的政策方向。 “我不认为美国对华政策会出现太大波动，”秦江南在10月22日的采访中说。 谢德在10月27日接受采访时则表示，众议院和参议院“在应对中国所代表的威胁方面，确实存在非常强烈的两党合作趋势”。 都认为政策将延续，但理由不同 特朗普的外交强调与中国国家主席习近平直接接触。白宫将习近平9月对华盛顿的国事访问描述为一次成功的访问，也是推动双边关系发展的机会。 谢德预计，总统将继续寻求与北京进行建设性互动，而国会仍会关注安全威胁。 “就选举而言，我认为总体上还是会保持不变，”他说。 秦江南则更强调特朗普本人对政策的主导作用，以及北京在稀土矿产供应上拥有的筹码。在他看来，无论哪个党赢得国会控制权，这些制约因素都会继续存在。 但他也质疑，对中国的共同担忧是否意味着对具体措施存在共识。他认为，共和党人一直不愿公开挑战特朗普总统较为缓和的对华路线，而民主党内部对于是否应该进一步强化对抗，也存在不同看法。 因此，民主党即使在中期选举中获胜，也不一定会形成要求对华采取更强硬政策的一致立场。 台湾军售是实际检验 两位分析人士都认为，对台军售是国会可能加大施压力度的领域。 谢德预计，两党议员都会继续就一项等待行政当局批准、拟议金额为140亿美元的对台军售方案，向白宫施压。 国会的关切早于此次选举。今年5月，由民主党参议员珍妮·沙欣(Jeanne Shaheen)和共和党参议员汤姆·蒂利斯(Thom Tillis)牵头的跨党派参议员小组，敦促特朗普正式向国会通报这项军售。台湾国防部长顾立雄10月初则表示，华盛顿协助台湾加强防卫能力的承诺并未改变。 “是否推进这项军售方案，最终还是由总统决定，”秦江南说。不过，他预计这方面的压力会增加。 谢德认为，国会加强对台湾的支持，与特朗普寻求同北京保持建设性互动之间，可能存在张力。 中国声称台湾是其领土的一部分，反对美国对台军售。台湾则拒绝接受北京对其主权的主张。 技术限制与知识产权保护 谢德预计，保护敏感技术仍将是两党合作基础尤其牢固的领域。 “我可以告诉你，这是一个两党都非常关注的问题，尤其涉及前沿技术时，”他说。 他预计，国会将推动加强防范知识产权被盗的措施，包括通过立法扩大调查权限。这是他对未来动向的判断，并非下一届国会已经宣布的行动计划。 出口管制是另一个潜在检验。 涉及半导体制造设备及与外国供应方协调管制措施的《硬件技术管制多边协调法案》(Multilateral Alignment of Technology Controls on Hardware Act，简称MATCH法案)，获得了共和党和民主党议员的支持。众议院外交事务委员会今年4月通过了其审议的版本。 秦江南表示，议员可能寻求加强限制，但要获得特朗普支持，可能面临困难。他认为，将相关条款附加到《国防授权法案》(NDAA)等范围更广的立法中，可能是一条推进途径，但强调这只是他的推测。 “我认为，国会要真正迫使特朗普总统改变政策方向，将面临挑战，”他说。 共和党保住国会，也不意味着没有分歧 共和党即使保住两院，也未必能够消除特朗普与部分共和党议员之间的紧张关系。 秦江南表示，关键在于共和党如何解读选举结果。如果共和党人认为特朗普险些使他们丢掉席位，可能会更愿意抵制他的政策；如果他们认为特朗普再次证明了自己的政治号召力，则可能更不愿与他分歧。 谢德则不认为，共和党继续控制国会会改变总统的基本做法。 北京可能关注什么？ 谢德预计，无论国会选举结果如何，习近平都会继续将特朗普视为美国方面的主要对话对象。他认为，削弱美国对台湾的支持，是北京在当前双边关系中的首要目标。 秦江南则认为，中国领导层已经在考虑特朗普任期结束后的局面。如果民主党赢得众议院，可能进一步强化北京的判断，即特朗普在任期最后两年将面临更大的政治制约。 政策是否改变，最明确的证据可能来自选举后的具体决定：对台军售是否推进，技术限制是否得到行政部门支持，以及国会的批评能否转化为行动。 “我认为，对台军售将是一个很有说明力的指标，”秦江南说。 美国之音记者郑裕文对本文有贡献。

title: Tai Po fire: Housing Bureau to replace inspection unit criticised for multiple failings, ‘slack’ attitude
zh_title: 大埔火警：房局更换检查单位 被指多项失误、态度“松懈”
summary: 房屋局因去年大埔大火前的政策和运作失误以及“松懈”的工作态度而受到严厉批评，因此宣布计划更换独立检查单位。 2026 年 10 月 29 日，香港高级官员在新闻发布会上。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。香港行政长官李家超周四表示，房屋局的独立审查组（ICU）将进行重大改组，由一个新的监管机构取代，负责监督所有公共屋村的维修工程。周四，李在镕带领高级官员鞠躬道歉
content:
房屋局因去年大埔大火前的政策和运作失误以及“松懈”的工作态度而受到严厉批评，因此宣布计划更换独立检查单位。 2026 年 10 月 29 日，香港高级官员在新闻发布会上。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。香港行政长官李家超周四表示，房屋局的独立审查组（ICU）将进行重大改组，由一个新的监管机构取代，负责监督所有公共屋村的维修工程。周四，李光耀率领高级官员就去年 11 月宏福苑住宅区发生的致命火灾致歉，这场火灾造成 168 人死亡、数千人流离失所。独立审查组因其对宏福苑大型翻修工程的监管缺陷而面临激烈批评。当局表示，翻修过程中使用了不合格的建筑材料，导致火势迅速蔓延。负责调查火灾的独立委员会在报告中表示，ICU表现出“监管松懈的态度”，应对多次执法失误承担“全部责任”，包括对居民对潜在火灾隐患的投诉处理不当。独立委员会关于宏福苑火灾的报告副本，2026 年 10 月 29 日。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。
独立委员会表示：“即使监管制度存在漏洞和缺陷，如果审查组的工作人员认真对待他们的工作……他们确实有可能消除宏福苑的一些火灾隐患。” 房屋局新机构 新的监管机构将于下个月成立，副财政司司长黄伟纶周四表示。在何咏仪离职后，黄女士接任代理房屋局局长一职。李说，何咏仪已提出辞职，以承担对这场悲剧的政治责任。此次更换是当局周四宣布的全面措施的一部分，以应对独立委员会确定的与建筑维护工程相关的政府系统性失灵。黄说，新的监管机构将建立专门的团队，负责全市公共住房的翻修工程，并补充说，每个团队将包括一名通讯官员，以在翻修过程中与房主保持联系。与此同时，官员周四表示，发展局将修订《建筑物条例》，以加强新监管机构对参与大型建筑物维修工程的专业人士和承包商的监督。李周四表示，政府还将成立一个由布政司陈家伟领导的指导委员会，以跟进独立委员会提出的 120 项建议。
政务司司长陈家伟于 2026 年 10 月 29 日在新闻发布会上就 2025 年宏福苑致命大火举行。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。他补充说，指导委员会将监督各局和部门落实建议并推动“全面”改革。李还表示，政府将建立一个跨部门平台，集中全市建筑维护和翻新工程的相关记录和数据。目前，政府部门分别记录检查记录、安全违规行为和承包商定罪情况。一个独立委员会在其报告中指出，缺乏跨部门合作。

【原文 English Original】
The Housing Bureau has announced plans to replace an independent inspection unit following heavy criticism over policy and operational failures and a “slack” work attitude in the lead-up to last year’s massive Tai Po fire. Hong Kong top officials at a press conference on October 29, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee said on Thursday that a major shake-up would see the Housing Bureau’s Independent Checking Unit (ICU) replaced by a new regulatory body overseeing maintenance works at all public housing estates. Lee led top officials in bowing in apology on Thursday over the deadly blaze that broke out last November at the Wang Fuk Court housing estate, killing 168 people and displacing thousands. The ICU has faced fierce criticism over deficiencies in its oversight of a major renovation project at Wang Fuk Court. Authorities have said substandard construction materials were used during the renovation, which led to the rapid spread of the fire. An independent committee tasked with investigating the fire said in its report that the ICU demonstrated a “slack supervision attitude” and should be held “solely responsible” for several enforcement failures, including its mishandling of residents’ complaints over potential fire hazards. Copies of the independent committee’s report on the Wang Fuk Court fire, on October 29, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “Even with a regulatory regime with loopholes and deficiencies, had the staff of the ICU taken their works seriously… there was a real possibility that they could have removed some of the fire hazards in Wang Fuk Court,” the independent committee said. New Housing Bureau body The new regulatory body would be formed next month, Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong said on Thursday. Wong has assumed the role of acting secretary for housing following the departure of Winnie Ho, who Lee said had tendered her resignation to take political accountability for the tragedy. The replacement is part of the sweeping measures that authorities announced on Thursday in response to systemic government failures relating to building maintenance works identified by the independent committee. Wong said the new regulatory body would establish dedicated teams responsible for renovation works across the city’s public housing estates, adding that each team would include a communications officer to maintain contact with homeowners during the renovation process. Meanwhile, the Development Bureau would amend the Buildings Ordinance to strengthen the new regulatory body’s oversight of professionals and contractors involved in major building maintenance works, officials said on Thursday. The government would also establish a steering committee led by Chief Secretary Eric Chan to follow up on the 120 recommendations made by the independent committee, Lee said on Thursday. Chief Secretary Eric Chan at a press conference on October 29, 2026 about the deadly 2025 Wang Fuk Court blaze. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The steering committee would oversee bureaus and departments in implementing the recommendations and driving “comprehensive” reform, he added. Lee also said the government would set up a cross-departmental platform to centralise records and data related to building maintenance and renovation works across the city. At present, government departments log inspection records, safety violations, and contractor convictions separately. In its report, an independent committee cited a lack of interdepartmental communication as a systemic failure in regulatory oversight. The platform would enable departments to access comprehensive data and issue early risk warnings, which could aid the early detection of contractor combinations that tend to draw more complaints, according to Chan.
