title: US, Japan rehearse strikes to challenge PLA control of waters near Taiwan
zh_title: 美日演习打击解放军对台湾附近海域的控制
source: 南华早报SCMP（中国社会/科技/舆情）
summary: 美国和日本军队已经演练了在九州和日本西南岛屿上进行协调反舰打击和机动导弹部署，测试旨在挑战北京在台湾冲突中控制周边水域的能力的战术。现在已进入第二周，为期 11 天的【利剑 27 演习】(https://www.scmp.com/news/china/military/article/3370210/how-expanded-japan-us-military-exercises-could-complicate-pla-planning-over-taiwan?module=inline&pgtype=article) 已经测试了盟友如何威胁中国
content:
美国和日本军队已经演练了在九州和日本西南岛屿上进行协调反舰打击和机动导弹部署，测试旨在挑战北京在台湾冲突中控制周边水域的能力的战术。

为期 11 天的【利刃 27 演习】(https://www.scmp.com/news/china/military/article/3370210/how-expanded-japan-us-military-exercises-could-complicate-pla-planning-over-taiwan?module=inline&pgtype=article) 已经进入第二周，测试了盟国如何从多个方向威胁中国军舰，同时让自己的军力更加强大目标。

据美国和日本双方的声明称，他们还进行了修复跑道和维护海上补给线的练习，以便在基地遭受袭击和补给线中断时维持行动。

09:58

巴丹群岛会成为下一个南海爆发点吗？

分析人士表示，所采用的战术可能会使解放军在冲突期间更难定位和压制美国和日本军队，从而可能迫使中国指挥官投入更多资源进行侦察和瞄准。

然而，他们表示，盟军在攻击下维持分散行动的能力将取决于可靠的通信、补给和基础设施。
在 10 月 23 日至 24 日的训练中，美国海军 F/A-18 和 F-35 飞机以及海军陆战队陆基发射器模拟了对日本海（又称东海）的充气海上目标进行协调导弹打击。

两艘配备宙斯盾的日本导弹驱逐舰刚果号和玛雅号充当敌方力量，而美国太空军则帮助保护通信。

盟国还测试了他们在岛屿上移动主要武器和监视系统的速度。

日本C-2和C-130运输机用于移动美国[NMESIS反舰导弹发射器](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3369666/us-deploy-nmesis-anti-ship-system-japanese-island-closest-taiwan-first-time?module=inline&pgtype=article)、MADIS防空车辆和TPS-80监视雷达探测到冲绳西南部的先岛群岛。

演习计划要求将 NMESIS 和 MADIS 系统部署在台湾以东约 110 公里（70 英里）的与那国岛和更东北的石垣岛，监视雷达也部署在宫古岛。

东京大学副教授塞巴斯蒂安·马斯洛表示，正在测试的部署可能要求解放军“在第一岛链上建立更强大的防线”，而美国和日本军队的行动更靠近台湾。
日本陆上自卫队还将其新型25型反舰导弹系统从九州中部熊本基地转移到该岛西北部的一个训练区，这是自3月份部署在那里以来的首次大规模演习。 10月25日，工作人员在大约两分钟内将发射器置于发射位置。

据报道，这种导弹的射程约为 1000 公里，可以威胁到东海大部分地区的解放军海军军舰，包括接近台湾的通道，同时也可以到达中国大陆部分海岸线。

北京将台湾视为中国的一部分，必要时可以通过武力统一。包括美国在内的大多数国家都不承认台湾是一个独立国家，但华盛顿反对任何尝试

【原文 English Original】
US and Japanese forces have rehearsed coordinated anti-ship strikes and mobile missile deployments across Kyushu and Japan’s southwestern islands, testing tactics designed to challenge Beijing’s ability to control surrounding waters in a conflict over [Taiwan](https://www.scmp.com/topics/taiwan?module=inline&pgtype=article).

Now in its second week, the 11-day [Keen Sword 27 exercise](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/military/article/3370210/how-expanded-japan-us-military-exercises-could-complicate-pla-planning-over-taiwan?module=inline&pgtype=article) has tested how the allies could threaten Chinese warships from multiple directions while keeping their own forces harder to target.

They have also practised repairing runways and maintaining maritime supply routes to sustain operations in the event of attacks on bases and disruptions to supply lines, according to statements from both the US and Japanese sides.

09:58

Will Batanes become the next South China Sea flashpoint?

Analysts said the tactics employed could make it harder for the People’s Liberation Army to locate and neutralise US and Japanese forces during a conflict, potentially forcing Chinese commanders to devote more resources to reconnaissance and targeting.

However, the allies’ ability to sustain dispersed operations under attack would depend on reliable communications, supplies and infrastructure, they said.

During training on October 23-24, US Navy F/A-18 and F-35 aircraft and Marine Corps ground-based launchers simulated coordinated missile strikes against an inflatable maritime target in the Sea of Japan, also known as the East Sea.

Two Japanese Aegis-equipped guided-missile destroyers, Kongo and Maya, played the opposing force, while the US Space Force helped protect communications.

The allies also tested how quickly they could move major weapons and surveillance systems across the islands.

Japanese C-2 and C-130 transport aircraft were used to move American [NMESIS anti-ship missile launchers](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3369666/us-deploy-nmesis-anti-ship-system-japanese-island-closest-taiwan-first-time?module=inline&pgtype=article), MADIS air-defence vehicles and TPS-80 surveillance radars to the Sakishima Islands, southwest of Okinawa.

Exercise plans called for the NMESIS and MADIS systems to be positioned on Yonaguni, about 110km (70 miles) east of Taiwan, and Ishigaki, further northeast, with surveillance radars also assigned to Miyako.

Sebastian Maslow, an associate professor at the University of Tokyo, said the deployments being tested could require the PLA to account for “a more robust defence line along the first island chain”, with American and Japanese forces operating closer to Taiwan.

Japan’s Ground Self-Defence Force also moved its new Type 25 anti-ship missile system from its base in Kumamoto, central Kyushu, to a training area further northwest on the island for its first large-scale exercise since being deployed there in March. On October 25, personnel brought a launcher into firing position in about two minutes.

With a reported range of about 1,000km, the missile could threaten PLA Navy warships across much of the East China Sea, including approaches to Taiwan, while placing parts of mainland China’s coastline within reach.

Beijing sees Taiwan as part of China to be reunited by force if necessary. Most countries, including the US, do not recognise Taiwan as an independent state, but Washington is opposed to any attempt to take the self-governed island by force and is committed to supplying it with weapons.

Keen Sword 27, which runs until Thursday, has involved about 45,000 Japanese personnel and 11,000 American troops, along with forces from Australia, Canada, France, Germany, the Netherlands, New Zealand and the Philippines. Britain and South Korea are attending as observers.

It is the biennial exercise’s first iteration since Japan [established its permanent Joint Operations Command in March last year](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/military/article/3304057/japan-goes-offensive-joint-operations-command-chinas-pla-daily-says?module=inline&pgtype=article). The command was created to coordinate Japan’s ground, maritime and air forces under a single operational headquarters to enable faster, more coherent joint responses during crises.

This growing coordination was visible during the drills when Japanese units used targeting information from US forces and higher headquarters to simulate anti-ship attacks. Although no live missiles were fired, the exercise pointed to allied efforts to integrate their targeting and strike operations.

At the exercise’s opening, Lieutenant General George Rowell, deputy commander of the US Pacific Command, said the allies aimed to identify weaknesses in their military cooperation, including how they communicate, share information and coordinate operations before a conflict.

The allies also conducted runway-repair drills at four airbases across Japan, including Kadena on Okinawa, where engineers practised restoring damaged airfields to keep aircraft operating after simulated attacks.

Misato Matsuoka, an associate professor at Teikyo University, said “dispersal can improve survivability, but it does not guarantee it”, pointing to the vulnerability of airfields, ports and supply networks needed to sustain operations under attack.

Even if individual missile launchers remained operational, their effectiveness “may be reduced” if surveillance networks, communications or supply routes were “disrupted”, Matsuoka said.

A statement issued by Kagoshima prefecture on October 7, before the exercise started, said a planned American uncrewed maritime resupply operation was cancelled and a commercial vessel had been substituted for a US Army landing craft, without specifying the reasons.

Trump praises Takaichi ahead of Xi’s US visit

Other training on Tanegashima, about 40km south of Kyushu, was reduced for reasons including transport difficulties, while [Typhoon Champi](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/politics/article/3372015/thousands-evacuated-and-flights-grounded-typhoon-champi-hits-eastern-china?module=inline&pgtype=article) separately disrupted military flights and amphibious training.

Maslow said the disruptions had provided “valuable data points” for military planners, particularly on the use of commercial vessels to sustain operations. He cautioned against interpreting the changes as evidence of inadequate American or Japanese deployment capabilities.

He said that beyond its military objectives, the exercise had helped to “normalise” American and Japanese military presence across Japan’s southern islands, despite opposition from some local communities.

The key to “sustaining deterrence” would be closer allied integration of military and civilian infrastructure, he said.

title: China has tripled its satellite fleet since 2018 as expansion continues: DIA
zh_title: DIA：自 2018 年以来，随着扩张的继续，中国的卫星数量已增加两倍
summary: 华盛顿——国防情报局 (DIA) 的一份[新报告](https://www.dia.mil/Articles/Press-Release/Article/4633953/dia-releases-challenges-to-security-in-space/) 发现，自 2018 年以来，中国的情报、监视和侦察 (ISR) 卫星数量增加了两倍，并继续扩大探测、跟踪和瞄准美国及其盟国地面部队的能力和在海上。 “中国采用强大的天基情监侦能力，旨在增强其全球态势感知并实现远程打击”，包括电光（EO）和合成孔径雷达
content:
华盛顿——国防情报局 (DIA) 的一份[新报告](https://www.dia.mil/Articles/Press-Release/Article/4633953/dia-releases-challenges-to-security-in-space/) 发现，自 2018 年以来，中国的情报、监视和侦察 (ISR) 卫星数量增加了两倍，并继续扩大探测、跟踪和瞄准美国及其盟国地面部队的能力和在海上。

根据国防情报局周一发布的 2026 年太空安全挑战报告，“中国采用了强大的天基情监侦能力，旨在增强其全球态势感知能力并实现远程打击”，其中包括电光 (EO) 和合成孔径雷达 (SAR) 图像卫星以及其他提供电子和信号情报数据的卫星。

报告称，中国的情监侦卫星网络可以帮助解放军监视和瞄准世界各地的美国及其盟军，特别是整个印度-太平洋地区，包括朝鲜半岛、台湾、菲律宾、印度洋和南海。

DIA 的报告呼应了美国太空部队和太空司令部对解放军日益增强的构建[“杀伤链”](https://breakingdefense.com/2025/06/us-space-commands-gen-whiting-talks-golden-dome-ew-and-chinas-space-based-kill-chain/)以针对美国国内外联合部队的能力的担忧。
美国战略与国际研究中心航空航天安全项目副主任克莱顿·斯沃普表示，中国正在大力投资天基传感器，以监测地球并识别、跟踪和瞄准印度-太平洋地区的物体。

“美国和盟国决策者应该担心的是，解放军的传感器网络会如何削弱美国在空中和海底领域的隐形优势。未来我们是否能够在空中和海底领域进行不被发现的行动？”他告诉《突破防御》。

DIA 报告呼应了 [2026 年 7 月](https://www.spaceforce.mil/About-Us/Fact-Sheets/Fact-Sheet-Display/article/4297159/space-threat-fact-sheet/)太空部队关于太空威胁的情况说明书，指出截至 7 月，中国在轨道上拥有超过 510 颗 ISR 卫星。然而，与太空部队文件不同的是，DIA 报告承认其数量包括中华人民共和国和中国商业公司拥有的卫星。

报告称：“虽然许多ISR卫星表面上与商业和民用任务有关，但它们能力的双重用途性质以及可能的中国军民融合政策意味着它们收集的数据或图像可以被解放军使用。”

国防情报局还表示，中国商业公司正在向“因支持武器扩散而被西方供应商禁止的国家行为者”提供图像。
国防情报局的报告强调，中国的情监侦机群不断扩大并在技术上不断改进，特别是通过北京日益增长的近地轨道卫星群。

然而，美国企业研究所 (AEI) 高级研究员托德·哈里森 (Todd Harrison) 表示，DIA 的数据并不清楚其统计中包含哪些卫星，也缺乏重要的背景信息。

他告诉《Breaking Defense》，中国的作战监视和气象卫星数量已从 2018 年的 141 颗增加到今天的 541 颗，而仅用于监视的卫星数量已从 124 颗增加到 453 颗。“这些数字并没有告诉你的是，近年来曲线的斜率已经趋于平稳，卫星数量的增长速度没有那么快，”哈里森说。

与此同时，美国有 643 个正在进行的调查

【原文 English Original】
WASHINGTON — A [new report](https://www.dia.mil/Articles/Press-Release/Article/4633953/dia-releases-challenges-to-security-in-space/) by the Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA) finds that China has tripled its fleet of intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) satellites since 2018 and continues to expand capabilities to detect, track and target US and allied forces on the ground and at sea.

“China employs a robust space-based ISR capability designed to enhance its worldwide situational awareness and enable long-range strikes,” including electro-optical (EO) and synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery satellites and others that provide electronic and signals intelligence data, according to the DIA’s 2026 _Challenges to Space Security_ report, released Monday.

The report says China’s ISR satellite network can help the PLA monitor and target US and allied forces worldwide, particularly across the Indo-Pacific — including the Korean Peninsula, Taiwan, the Philippines, the Indian Ocean and the South China Sea.

The DIA report echoes concerns from US Space Force and Space Command about the PLA’s growing ability to build [“kill chains”](https://breakingdefense.com/2025/06/us-space-commands-gen-whiting-talks-golden-dome-ew-and-chinas-space-based-kill-chain/) to target US joint forces abroad and at home.

Clayton Swope, deputy director of the Center for Strategic and International Studies’ Aerospace Security Project, said China is investing heavily in space-based sensors to monitor Earth and identify, track and target objects in the Indo-Pacific.

“A concern on the minds of US and allied decision makers should be how PLA sensor webs could erode US advantages derived from stealth in the air and undersea domains. Will we be able to operate undetected in the air and undersea domains in the future?” he told Breaking Defense.

Echoing a [July 2026](https://www.spaceforce.mil/About-Us/Fact-Sheets/Fact-Sheet-Display/article/4297159/space-threat-fact-sheet/)Space Force fact sheet on space threats, the DIA report states that China had more than 510 ISR satellites in orbit as of July.Unlike the Space Force document, however, the DIA report acknowledges that its count includes satellites owned by both the People’s Republic of China and Chinese commercial firms.

“While many of these ISR satellites are ostensibly affiliated with commercial and civil missions, the dual-use nature of their capabilities and possibly the Chinese military-civil fusion policies means the data or imagery they collect can be used by the PLA,” the report says.

The DIA also says Chinese commercial firms are supplying imagery “to state actors banned by Western providers for supporting weapons proliferation.”

China’s ISR fleet continues to expand and improve technologically, the DIA report stresses, particularly through Beijing’s growing constellation of satellites in low Earth orbit.

However, American Enterprise Institute’s (AEI) Senior Fellow Todd Harrison said the DIA’s data is unclear about which satellites are included in its count and also lacks important context.

He told Breaking Defense that China’s operational surveillance and weather satellite fleet has grown from 141 in 2018 to 541 today, while its surveillance-only fleet has increased from 124 to 453.“What those numbers don’t tell you is that the slope of the curve has leveled off in recent years — the number of satellites is not increasing as fast,” Harrison said.

Meanwhile, the US has 643 operational surveillance and weather satellites — up from 298 in 2018 — and is expanding its ISR fleet faster than China, he said.

The following chart, created for Breaking Defense from AEI’s [Space Data Navigator](https://spacedata.aei.org/space/satellites?s=sVyo34KeBY), shows that trend.

The DIA report is the third in a series of unclassified reports examining US concerns about adversary advancements in military space, with the first version published in 2019.

The new report covers space threats emanating from China, Russia and “emerging” space powers.

It also looks at developments expected to exacerbate future challenges to US interests in space. Among those listed in the 2026 report: reusable space systems, such as rockets and spaceplanes; increasing use of artificial intelligence; orbital congestion; the collision risk posed by the many non-maneuverable spacecraft that will remain on orbit long after becoming inoperable; and the growing interest in satellites stationed in very low Earth orbit.

Intriguingly, the report includes what appears to be the first public image of China’s reusable [spaceplane](https://breakingdefense.com/tag/chinese-spaceplane/), most recently launched [in February](https://en.people.cn/n3/2026/0207/c90000-20423647.html). The spaceplane is widely believed to be modeled after the US X-37B. Victoria Samson, chief director of space security and stability at the Secure World Foundation, said the image appears to support that assessment.

“It looks a lot like the X-37B!” she told Breaking Defense.

The DIA concludes by predicting that space will become increasingly congested and competitive as capabilities advance and more countries expand their presence in the domain.

“The increase of Chinese, Russian, Iranian, and North Korean counterspace capabilities, rapid growth in the number of space objects, and the proliferation of requirements for space-enabled services will all complicate operations in space in the coming decade,” the report adds.

title: Hong Kong Wine and Spirits Fair returns in November with global exhibitors
zh_title: 香港酒品展十一月回归 云集全球参展商
summary: 香港 香港国际美酒展将于 11 月 5 日至 7 日回归，吸引来自 25 个国家的 620 多家参展商。该活动由香港贸发局主办，重点展示新兴葡萄酒产区、中国白酒品牌，以及香港在进出口额不断上升的情况下作为全球贸易中心的角色。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 27 日 22:44 HKT · 2 分钟阅读《香港报》国际葡萄酒及烈酒博览会将于 5 日至 7 日回归
content:
香港
香港国际美酒展将于 11 月 5 日至 7 日回归，吸引来自 25 个国家的 620 多家参展商。该活动由香港贸发局主办，重点展示新兴葡萄酒产区、中国白酒品牌，以及香港在进出口额不断上升的情况下作为全球贸易中心的角色。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 27 日 22:44 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港国际美酒展将于11月5日至7日回归，为全球买家提供一站式采购平台，重点关注新兴葡萄酒产区和中国顶级白酒品牌。今届展会由香港贸易发展局（香港贸发局）主办，云集超过25个国家及地区超过620家参展商，展示来自全球超过40个原产地的葡萄酒、烈酒、清酒、啤酒、低酒精及无酒精饮料及相关产品。

其中一大亮点是烈酒世界专区的回归，共有来自16个国家和地区的参展商，其中包括来自墨西哥、葡萄牙、斯洛伐克和英国的首次参展。在葡萄酒方面，来自格鲁吉亚和意大利卡拉布里亚地区的展馆将首次亮相，为买家提供发现反映其独特传统的独特葡萄酒的机会。
香港贸发局联席总裁林玉峰强调香港的独特优势，包括自由港地位、世界一流的物流基础设施、资本自由流动以及连接中国内地与全球市场的战略地位。林郑月娥表示，今年首8个月，香港葡萄酒进口额同比增长16%，出口额同比增长8%。受惠于酒类关税下调及市场需求增加，2025年烈酒进口量按年增加逾5%，预计进口额将增加近1亿港元。

林郑月娥补充说，葡萄酒及烈酒贸易的发展也将为相关行业带来机遇，包括物流、零售、仓储、餐饮、旅游和投资。本届展会还凸显了香港作为内地与世界各地的“超级联系人”和“超级增值者”的作用，支持葡萄酒及烈酒行业高质量发展。
白酒成为本届展会最强的品类之一，“中国十大白酒品牌”将齐聚今年的展会，其中包括贵州茅台和洋河等知名品牌。凭借香港作为国际葡萄酒及烈酒贸易中心的独特地位，参展的白酒生产商正利用展会作为开拓海外市场的平台，加速白酒的全球扩张、复兴和多元化。来自新疆、宁夏、西藏等中国主要葡萄酒产区的参展商将向国际买家展示他们的产品，展示内地国内葡萄酒行业不断增长的潜力。

展会的公共区域“周六嘉年华”将于活动最后一天向18岁或以上的葡萄酒爱好者开放。它将为公众提供品尝和购买全球葡萄酒和烈酒以及参与一系列互动主题活动的机会。

[![图3：亚当](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/e

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
The Hong Kong International Wine & Spirits Fair returns from 5-7 November, featuring over 620 exhibitors from 25 countries. Organised by HKTDC, the event highlights emerging wine regions, Chinese baijiu brands, and Hong Kong’s role as a global trading hub, amid rising import and export values.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

27 Oct 2026 at 22:44 HKT · 2 min read

The Hong Kong International Wine & Spirits Fair is set to return from 5 to 7 November, serving as a one-stop sourcing platform for global buyers and spotlighting emerging wine regions and top Chinese baijiu brands. Organised by the Hong Kong Trade Development Council (HKTDC), this year's fair will bring together more than 620 exhibitors from over 25 countries and regions, showcasing wines, spirits, sake, beer, low- and no-alcohol beverages and related products from more than 40 places of origin worldwide.

A major highlight is the return of the World of Spirits zone, featuring exhibitors from 16 countries and regions, including first-time participants from Mexico, Portugal, Slovakia and the United Kingdom. On the wine front, pavilions from Georgia and Italy’s Calabria region will make their debut, offering buyers an opportunity to discover distinctive wines that reflect their unique heritage.

Smilely Lam Yuk-fung, associate executive director of the HKTDC, highlighted Hong Kong’s unique advantages, including its free-port status, world-class logistics infrastructure, free flow of capital, and its strategic position connecting Mainland China with global markets. Lam noted that the city recorded a year-on-year increase in wine import value of 16 per cent and export value of 8 per cent in the first eight months of the year. Spirits import volumes increased by more than 5 per cent year on year in 2025, benefiting from a reduction in liquor duty and growing market demand, with the import value expected to rise by nearly HK$100 million.

The development of the wine and spirits trade would also generate opportunities for related industries including logistics, retail, warehousing, catering, tourism and investment, Lam added. The fair also highlights Hong Kong’s role as a “super-connector” and “super-value-adder” between the mainland and the rest of the world, supporting the high-quality development of the wine and spirits industry.

Baijiu stands out as one of the fair's strongest categories, as the “Top 10 Chinese Baijiu Brands” will converge at this year's fair, including renowned names such as Kweichow Moutai and Yanghe. Leveraging Hong Kong's unique position as an international wine and spirits trading hub, participating baijiu producers are using the fair as a platform to develop markets overseas and accelerate baijiu's global expansion, rejuvenation and diversification. Exhibitors from major Chinese wine-producing regions, including Xinjiang, Ningxia and Xizang, will showcase their products to international buyers, demonstrating the growing potential of the mainland's domestic wine industry.

The fair's public zone, Saturday Fiesta, will open to wine enthusiasts aged 18 or above on the final day of the event. It will offer the public an opportunity to sample and purchase global wines and spirits, as well as participate in a series of interactive thematic activities.

[![Image 3: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

# Latest Fukushima wastewater discharge will not affect Taiwan: NSC

10/27/2026 07:32 PM

Taipei, Oct. 27 (CNA) Japan's latest discharge of treated wastewater containing tritium from the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power plant is not expected to affect waters around Taiwan, the Nuclear Safety Commission (NSC) said Tuesday.

The 25th round of discharges began Monday and is expected to continue for 19 days, with about 7,800 metric tons of wastewater to be released, the NSC said in a report issued to update the public on each discharge round.

The wastewater is expected to mainly affect waters off eastern Japan, while tritium concentrations in waters around Taiwan are forecast to remain below the minimum detectable level of monitoring instruments, the NSC said, citing forecasts by Taiwan's Central Weather Administration (CWA) and information from Japan's Tokyo Electric Power Co. (TEPCO).

Japan began releasing treated wastewater from the disabled plant in August 2023. It has since completed 24 rounds of discharges, releasing a total of about 188,000 cubic meters of wastewater, according to the NSC.

Taiwan has also been monitoring radiation levels in surrounding waters. Since 2017, authorities have analyzed more than 20,000 samples of seawater, marine life, seafood, beach sand and seabed sediment, with no abnormal radiation detected, the NSC said.

(By Liang Chia-jou and Lee Hsin-Yin)

title: Taiwan shares edge up as TSMC bounces back - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: 台积电反弹，台湾股市小幅上涨 - 焦点台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月27日电 交易商称，台湾股市周二在拉锯交易时段后小幅收高，因合约芯片制造商台积电(TSMC)从早前的疲软中反弹，推动大盘进入积极区域。台湾证券交易所基准指数在 45,676.67 点至 46,585.45 点之间波动，最终上涨 54.80 点，至 46,096.23 点，涨幅为 0.12%。营业额总计 9,765.5 亿元新台币（299.6 亿美元）。美国科技股隔夜上涨后，市场开盘走高，但随后的抛售将台交所推低至前期水平。
content:
中新社台北10月27日电 交易商称，台湾股市周二在拉锯交易时段后小幅收高，因合约芯片制造商台积电(TSMC)从早前的疲软中反弹，推动大盘进入积极区域。

台湾证券交易所基准指数在 45,676.67 点至 46,585.45 点之间波动，最终上涨 54.80 点，至 46,096.23 点，涨幅为 0.12%。营业额总计 9,765.5 亿元新台币（299.6 亿美元）。

交易商称，美国科技股隔夜上涨后，市场开盘走高，但随后抛售将台交所推低前收盘价，随后逢低买入者开始买入台积电，特别是在交易时段尾盘。

国泰期货分析师蔡明汉表示，“从今天的走势来看，我认为大盘在经历了近期的波动之后，一直在盘整，因此当指数出现技术性反弹时，投资者倾向于锁定利润。”

蔡说：“幸运的是，对台积电基本面的信心没有改变，因为它保持了相对于同行的领先地位，促使投资者逢低买入该股。”

占当地市场总市值超过40%的台积电，在触及新台币2,380.00元低点后，上涨0.63%，收于新台币2,400.00元。其复苏帮助台交所将跌幅缩小了约 160 点，并推动半导体分类指数上涨 0.46%。
内存芯片供应商也吸引了逢低买盘，旺宏涨3.52%，收于新台币103.00元；南亚科技飙升6.52%，收于新台币441.00元。

智能手机芯片设计公司联发科技逆势下跌 1.25%，收于新台币 3,960.00 元。

其他科技板块中，iPhone组装商和人工智能(AI)服务器制造商鸿海精密工业股份有限公司(Hon Hai Precision Industry Co.)上涨1.02%，收于新台币247.50元；电源制造商台达电子(Delta Electronics Inc.)下跌3.21%，收于新台币1,510.00元。

交易商表示，旧经济股票在盘整中涨跌互现。

怡亨纺织跌 0.40%，收于新台币 323.00 元；马卡乐特工业公司跌 0.90%，收于新台币 207.00 元。

南亚塑胶股价下跌1.16%，收于新台币297.50元；台塑股价上涨0.81%，收于新台币74.40元。食品品牌统一企业收涨0.75%，至新台币80.20元；味全食品收涨0.87%，至新台币11.55元。

金融板块上涨0.74%，富邦金控收涨2.21%，收于新台币162.00元；国泰金控收涨0.44%，收于新台币114.00元；玉山金控收跌0.60%，收于新台币49.45元。
蔡说：“尽管出现反弹，但市场情绪仍保持谨慎，因为投资者等待微软、谷歌母公司 Alphabet 和亚马逊等美国主要云服务提供商的业绩，以获得更清晰的人工智能支出情况。”

据台湾证券交易所称，外国机构投资者周二在主板净售出价值新台币 81 亿美元的股票。

（弗兰西斯·黄）

Enditem/sfj

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 27 (CNA) Taiwan shares closed slightly higher Tuesday after a seesaw trading session, as contract chipmaker Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC) rebounded from earlier weakness to lift the broader market into positive territory, dealers said.

The Taiex, the Taiwan Stock Exchange's benchmark index, ended up 54.80 points, or 0.12 percent, at 46,096.23 after moving between 45,676.67 and 46,585.45. Turnover totaled NT$976.55 billion (US$29.96 billion).

The market opened higher after an overnight rally in U.S. technology stocks, but selling later pushed the Taiex below the previous close before bargain hunters moved in to pick up TSMC, particularly late in the trading session, dealers said.

"Judging from today's movement, I think the broader market has been consolidating after recent volatility, so when the index staged a technical rebound, investors tended to lock in profits," Cathay Futures analyst Tsai Ming-han said.

"Fortunately, faith in TSMC's fundamentals remained unchanged because it has maintained its lead over its peers, prompting investors to buy the stock on the dip," Tsai said.

TSMC, which accounts for over 40 percent of the local market's total capitalization, rose 0.63 percent to close at NT$2,400.00, after hitting a low of NT$2,380.00. Its recovery helped the Taiex trim its losses by about 160 points and pushed the semiconductor subindex 0.46 percent higher.

Memory chip suppliers also attracted bargain hunting, with Macronix International Co. rising 3.52 percent to end at NT$103.00 and Nanya Technology Corp. soaring 6.52 percent to close at NT$441.00.

Bucking the upturn, smartphone chip designer MediaTek Inc. fell 1.25 percent to end at NT$3,960.00.

Elsewhere in the tech sector, iPhone assembler and artificial intelligence (AI) server maker Hon Hai Precision Industry Co. rose 1.02 percent to close at NT$247.50, while power supply maker Delta Electronics Inc. fell 3.21 percent to end at NT$1,510.00.

Old-economy stocks were mixed amid the consolidation, dealers said.

Eclat Textile Co. lost 0.40 percent to close at NT$323.00, while Makalot Industrial Co. ended down 0.90 percent at NT$207.00.

Nan Ya Plastics Corp. fell 1.16 percent to close at NT$297.50, while Formosa Plastics Corp. added 0.81 percent to end at NT$74.40. Food brand Uni-President Enterprises Corp. closed up 0.75 percent at NT$80.20, and Wei Chuan Foods Corp. ended up 0.87 percent at NT$11.55.

In the financial sector, which rose 0.74 percent, Fubon Financial Holding Co. closed up 2.21 percent at NT$162.00 and Cathay Financial Holding Co. ended up 0.44 percent at NT$114.00, while E. Sun Financial Holding Co. fell 0.60 percent to close at NT$49.45.

"Despite the rebound, market sentiment stayed cautious as investors waited for results from major U.S. cloud service providers including Microsoft, Google's parent Alphabet and Amazon for a clearer picture of AI spending," Tsai said.

Foreign institutional investors sold a net NT$8.10 billion worth of shares on the main board Tuesday, according to the Taiwan Stock Exchange.

(By Frances Huang)

Enditem/sfj

**Supporting Yeliang Xia with donation for legal defence against the evil fugitive billionaire Wengui Guo (most wanted by Interpol)**

Mr. Yeliang Xia, a former professor at Peking University and a political dissident from China.

Mr. Xia has been sued for his inquiries and criticism through TV and twitter on Guo’s so-called exposure of top confidential information in China by Wengui Guo (aka Miles Kwok, a notorious Chinese billionaire and fugitive escaped from China in 2015 and Guo got RED NOTICE twice from INTERPOL) at Eastern District Court of Virginia.

Guo hired a gang of cyber accessories and made up tons of rumors to smear Mr. Xia and Xia’s family members while filing a complaint against Xia with an accusation of defamation and a claim of five million US $ for compensation.

Guo has been abusing legal resources in US with more than 41 lawsuits for defamation undergoing and he claimed that he planned to sue more than 91 persons for the accusation of defamation.

Mr. Xia and many other defendants can’t afford to hire a qualified and experienced attorney to defend themselves. Thus, with suggestions by many web bystanders, Xia started a campaign to collect donation for legal fees against Guo.

Xia will use those donations only for the purpose of the lawsuit and he has been supported by several volunteers to work on collection, bookkeeping and supervision of donations. The goal has been set to 100,000 US$, and an individual account of GoFundMe was set up as a major channel for donation.

Please contact Julia Lee and other volunteers through [email redacted] for the details.

We’re most grateful to your attention, encouragement, support and great help!

Yeliang Xia and his team of volunteers

原北大教授、政治异议人士，现时政/财经新闻评论人夏业良先生（美国之音/自由亚洲电台/博讯/新唐人等媒体）因网络质疑和评论，而被中国逃亡商人郭文贵花钱组织围攻/抹黑，并在美国弗吉尼亚东区联邦法院提交所谓诽谤指控和滥诉。

夏先生通过电视节目和推特对郭的所谓爆料（包括最高机密信息）进行了质疑和批评，郭雇佣组织了对夏及其家人的网络围攻，同时指控夏对他进行诽谤并索赔五百万美元。

郭滥用美国司法资源， 目前正在进行中的诉讼超过41起，郭宣称他计划起诉至少91位对他进行诽谤的个人。

夏先生和其他被告均无力承担雇佣合格并有经验的律师之花费。因此在众多网络旁观者的建议下开始了募捐应对郭之诉讼的律师费用。

夏先生将把募捐得款只用于本案诉讼之中，并且得到若干志愿者的支持和帮助，他们协助收集募捐款项/记账与募捐监督等工作。本次募捐活动的目标已设定为十万美元，并且已经开设了一个名为“GoFundMe”之软件的募捐账户平台以作为主要募捐渠道。

title: Gov’t demands report within week following blaze at Shek Kwu Chau waste facility
zh_title: 石鼓洲废物处理设施起火 政府要求一周内提交报告
summary: 香港环境部门已指示周一发生火灾的垃圾焚烧厂的工程承包商在 7 天内提交事故报告，此前已有近 1,000 人被疏散，其中一人被送往医院。 2026 年 10 月 26 日，香港石鼓洲人工岛上的 I·PARK1 垃圾焚烧厂冒出黑烟。照片：edward.chung_，来自 Threads。该声明是在周一下午 4.45 左右（即火灾发生大约三个小时）I·PARK1 废物管理设施（等级为 3）的火灾几小时后发布的。
content:
香港环境部门已指示周一发生火灾的垃圾焚烧厂的工程承包商在 7 天内提交事故报告，此前已有近 1,000 人被疏散，其中一人被送往医院。 2026 年 10 月 26 日，香港石鼓洲人工岛上的 I·PARK1 垃圾焚烧厂冒出黑烟。照片：edward.chung_，来自 Threads。该声明是在周一下午 4 点 45 分左右，I·PARK1 级三级废物管理设施的火灾被扑灭的几个小时后发布的，此时距离消防处 (FSD) 收到初步报告大约三个小时。该设施位于大屿山以南石鼓洲附近的一座人工岛上，是香港第一座垃圾焚烧发电厂。周一政府声明称，初步信息显示，火灾发生在主焚烧厂第三个焚烧模块的屋顶。起火原因仍在调查中。声明称：“火灾发生后，该设施的承包商根据其应急响应协议立即采取了行动，包括报告事件、部署响应小组、疏散工人和工作人员以及暂停关键系统运行。” 7天期限 声明称，约970名建筑工人和作业人员被疏散，其中一名工作人员报告感觉不适后被送往医院。
2026 年 10 月 26 日，香港石鼓洲人工岛上的 I·PARK1 垃圾焚烧厂冒出黑烟。照片：edward.chung_，来自 Threads。环境保护署表示，已指示承建商于七日内提交火警报告，并会联同消防处调查火警原因。环保署表示，亦会评估受损情况，并敦促承建商尽快进行维修。并补充说，该署正检讨火灾对设施运作的影响。据环保署称，I·PARK1 的三个焚烧模块设计每天可燃烧多达 3,000 吨废物。该项目是该市减少对垃圾填埋场依赖的更广泛努力的一部分。第一个模块于2025年12月开始试运行，日处理能力为1000吨。周一的声明称，该署已安排延长新界西堆填区扩建工程的运作时间，以弥补废物管理能力的不足。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong environmental authorities have instructed the works contractor for a waste incineration plant where a fire broke out on Monday to submit an incident report within seven days, after close to 1,000 people were evacuated, with one sent to hospital. Black smoke rises from I·PARK1, a waste incineration plant on an artificial island off Shek Kwu Chau in Hong Kong, on October 26, 2026. Photo: edward.chung_, via Threads. The statement came hours after the blaze at the I·PARK1 waste management facility, rated at No. 3, was put out at around 4.45pm on Monday, roughly three hours after the Fire Services Department (FSD) received initial reports. The facility, which sits on an artificial island off Shek Kwu Chau, south of Lantau Island, is Hong Kong’s first waste-to-energy plant. Preliminary information indicated that the fire broke out on the roof of the main incinerator building’s third incineration module, a Monday government statement said. The cause of the fire is still being investigated. “After the fire broke out, the contractor of the facility took immediate actions according to its emergency response protocol,” the statement said, including reporting the incident, deploying a response team, evacuating workers and staff, and suspending critical system operations. Seven-day deadline According to the statement, some 970 construction workers and operation staff were evacuated, with one staff member sent to hospital after reporting feeling unwell. Black smoke rises from I·PARK1, a waste incineration plant on an artificial island off Shek Kwu Chau in Hong Kong, on October 26, 2026. Photo: edward.chung_, via Threads. “The Environmental Protection Department (EPD) has instructed the contractor to submit a report on the fire incident within seven days and will work with the FSD to investigate the cause of fire,” it said. “The EPD will also evaluate the damage and urge the contractor to conduct repairs as soon as possible,” it said, adding that the department is conducting a review of the fire’s impact on the operations of the facility. The three incineration modules at I·PARK1 are designed to burn up to 3,000 tonnes of waste daily, according to the EPD. The project is part of the city’s broader effort to reduce its reliance on landfills. The first module began trial operations in December 2025 with a daily processing capacity of 1,000 tonnes. The department has arranged to extend the operating hours of the West New Territories Landfill Extension to make up for the shortfall in waste management capacity, the Monday statement said.

title: UPDATED: U.S. Navy Taps Attack Boat for 2027 Australian AUKUS Assignment
zh_title: 更新：美国海军选择攻击艇执行 2027 年澳大利亚 AUKUS 任务
summary: 弗吉尼亚级快速攻击潜艇科罗拉多号 (SSN-788) 于 2026 年 9 月 23 日抵达夏威夷珍珠港-希卡姆联合基地时进行演习。美国海军照片本文已更新，其中包括科罗拉多号 (SSN-788) 于 10 月 26 日抵达澳大利亚。五角大楼周一宣布，弗吉尼亚级潜艇将成为澳大利亚西部的主力核攻击艇。科罗拉多号 (SSN-788) 号将被分配给西方潜艇轮换部队，从 2027 年开始，该部队将驻扎在珀斯郊外的 HMAS 斯特林号。
content:
弗吉尼亚级快速攻击潜艇科罗拉多号 (SSN-788) 于 2026 年 9 月 23 日抵达夏威夷珍珠港-希卡姆联合基地时进行演习。美国海军照片本文已更新，其中包括科罗拉多号 (SSN-788) 于 10 月 26 日抵达澳大利亚。五角大楼周一宣布，弗吉尼亚级潜艇将成为澳大利亚西部的主力核攻击艇。美国海军科罗拉多号（SSN-788）将被分配到西潜艇轮换部队，从 2027 年开始，该部队将驻扎在珀斯郊外的斯特林号潜艇。澳大利亚政府和五角大楼领导层周一发表声明称，“选择科罗拉多号潜艇作为 2027 年第一艘被分配到 SRF-West 的潜艇，标志着 AUKUS 第一支柱的一个重要里程碑，也是加强太平洋集体威慑的决定性一步。”在这篇文章的早期版本之后，海军宣布科罗拉多州已抵达斯特灵进行维护。科罗拉多号的部署是美国、英国和澳大利亚之间 AUKUS 第一支柱协议的早期步骤之一，该协议旨在为澳大利亚建设基础设施，以便在 2030 年代为澳大利亚皇家海军部署三到五艘弗吉尼亚级攻击艇。根据目前的计划，SRF-West最终将容纳四艘弗吉尼亚级潜艇和一艘英国核攻击艇，作为AUKUS建造的一部分。
这一消息是在美国弗吉尼亚级潜艇在斯特灵进行第三次年度维护之前发布的，这是为轮换部署做准备的一部分。 2024 年，美国海军夏威夷号 (SSN-776) 被拉出，由潜艇母舰埃默里·南地号 (AS-39) 上的船员进行了维修。去年，佛蒙特号航空母舰（SSN-792）抵达斯特灵，在没有招标的情况下与澳大利亚工人一起使用。英国皇家海军核攻击潜艇 HMS Anson (S123) 于 2 月抵达澳大利亚维修团队。珍珠港海军造船厂和中级维修设施的任务是培训澳大利亚工人维修弗吉尼亚号，并监督斯特灵的维修和后勤设施。该公共庭院于今年早些时候完成了维护期。美国海军今年早些时候设立了两个司令部来支持这一努力——海军支援活动（NSA）斯特林和第3潜艇中队。“通过SRF-West，我们的潜艇在关键区域轮流穿行，由有机的（主要是澳大利亚的）维护人员保持这些船只的战斗状态。这不仅支持战备状态，而且还减轻了美国造船厂的负担，提高了我们快速攻击潜艇部队的战备状态，同时让澳大利亚做好维护自己国家的准备。”潜艇项目主任罗布·高彻中将在 6 月份的一份声明中写道。在周一发布的声明中，康涅狄格州民主党众议员乔·考特尼赞扬了此举。
他在一份声明中表示：“美国和英国攻击潜艇轮换与澳大利亚核动力潜艇的结合将改变盟军在印度-太平洋地区的海军态势。AUKUS第一支柱和第二支柱将继续全力推进，国会和海军将与英国和澳大利亚保持同步。”

【原文 English Original】
Virginia-class fast-attack submarine USS Colorado (SSN-788) maneuvers as it arrives at Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam, Hawaii, Sept. 23, 2026. US Navy photo This post has been updated to include that USS Colorado (SSN-788) arrived in Australia on Oct. 26. The Pentagon announced Monday the Virginia-class submarine that will be the lead nuclear attack boat in western Australia. USS Colorado (SSN-788) will be assigned to Submarine Rotational Force-West, which will be based HMAS Stirling outside of Perth starting in 2027. “The selection of USS Colorado as the first submarine assigned to SRF-West in 2027 marks a significant milestone for AUKUS Pillar I and is a decisive step in strengthening collective deterrence in the Pacific,” reads a Monday statement from the Australian Government and Pentagon leadership. Following an earlier version of this post, the Navy announced Colorado had arrived in Stirling for a maintenance period. The deployment of Colorado is one of the early steps of the AUKUS Pillar I agreement between the U.S., U.K. and Australia to build the infrastructure for Australia to field three to five Virginia-class attack boats for the Royal Australian Navy in the 2030s. Under current plans, SRF-West will eventually host four Virginia-class submarines and a U.K. nuclear attack boat as part of the AUKUS construct. The announcement comes ahead of the third annual maintenance period of an American Virginia-class boat in Stirling as part of preparing for the rotational deployments. In 2024, USS Hawaii (SSN-776) pulled was repaired by a crew aboard the submarine tender USS Emory S. Land (AS-39). Last year, USS Vermont (SSN-792) arrived in Stirling for an availability with Australian workers without the tender. Royal Navy nuclear attack submarine HMS Anson (S123) arrived in February for its own availability with the Australian maintenance teams. Pearl Harbor Naval Shipyard and Intermediate Maintenance Facility has been tasked with training Australian workers to repair Virginias as well as overseeing a repair and logistics attachment at Stirling. The public yard completed its maintenance period earlier this year. The U.S. Navy established two commands earlier this year to support the effort — Naval Support Activity (NSA) Stirling and Submarine Squadron 3. “With SRF-West, we have submarines rotating through a critical region with an organic, predominately Australian, maintenance workforce keeping those boats fit to fight. That not only supports readiness, but it also reduces the burden on the U.S. shipyards and increases our fast-attack submarine force’s readiness while preparing Australia to maintain their own SSNs,” reads a June statement from Director of Submarine Programs Vice Adm. Rob Gaucher. In a Monday statement on the announcement, Rep Joe Courtney (D-Conn.) praised the move. “The combination of U.S. and U.K. attack submarine rotations and Australian nuclear-powered submarines will transform allied naval posture in the Indo-Pacific. AUKUS Pillars I and II continue full steam ahead with Congress and the Navy in lock step with the U.K. and Australia,” he said in a statement.

title: WinGD secures long-term service contracts covering 14 dual-fuel LNG carriers across three major shipowners

content:
瑞士船舶电力公司 WinGD 已获得三项长期服务协议，涵盖 14 艘双燃料液化天然气运输船。与领先的液化天然气船舶管理公司签署的协议表明，行业对 OEM 主导的终身支持的信心不断增强，并标志着 WinGD 全球服务业务扩张取得了重大进展。

与中远海运液化天然气（香港）船舶管理公司、NYK 液化天然气船舶管理公司和 TMS 卡迪夫天然气公司签订的协议涵盖了采用不同代 WinGD X-DF 双燃料技术的船舶。这些合同反映了船东和运营商对长期服务合作伙伴关系日益增长的需求，这些合作伙伴关系在整个发动机生命周期中支持船舶性能、可靠性和运营效率。

WinGD 市场开发副总裁 Benny Hilström 表示：“这些协议表明运营商越来越重视原始发动机设计者提供的长期生命周期支持。

该服务包包括定期维护备件、技术人工、车间服务和咨询支持，以及通过 WinGD 的 WiDE 平台进行远程监控、故障排除和发动机优化。

最新协议扩大了 WinGD 在主要液化天然气运输市场的全球服务范围，并进一步加强了该公司不断增长的长期生命周期支持合同组合。
最近赢得的合同包括与中远海运液化天然气（香港）船舶管理公司签订的为期十年的协议，涵盖六艘由 WinGD 6X72DF 发动机提供动力的液化天然气运输船。
 WinGD 还与日本 NYK LNG Shipmanagement 签署了一份为期五年的服务协议，涵盖五艘液化天然气运输船的 10 台 X-DF 双燃料主发动机。该机队采用了几代 X-DF 技术。 HHI 和 SHI 分别于 2022 年和 2024 年建造的两艘船舶均由 WinGD 5X72DF 发动机提供动力，而 HHI 于 2025 年和 2026 年建造的三艘新船则配备了 5X72DF-2.1 发动机。

在世界主要船东和船舶管理市场之一的希腊，WinGD 签署了一份长期发动机服务协议，涵盖由雅典 TMS 卡迪夫天然气有限公司运营的三艘新建液化天然气运输船。

【原文 English Original】
Swiss marine power company WinGD has secured three long-term service agreements covering 14 dual-fuel LNG carriers. The agreements with leading LNG ship managers demonstrate growing industry confidence in OEM-led lifetime support and mark significant progress in the expansion of WinGD’s global service business.

The agreements with COSCO Shipping LNG (Hong Kong) Ship Management, NYK LNG Shipmanagement and TMS Cardiff Gas cover vessels powered by different generations of WinGD’s X-DF dual-fuel technology. The contracts reflect growing demand from owners and operators for long-term service partnerships that support vessel performance, reliability and operational efficiency throughout the engine lifecycle.

Benny Hilström VP Market Development at WinGD, said: “These agreements demonstrate the growing importance operators place on long-term lifecycle support from the original engine designer.

“LNG markets depend on timely, reliable and safe deliveries, making the performance of the vessels supporting this global trade critical. These long-term service agreements give our customers, some of the biggest names in shipping, consistent access to the expertise, maintenance and technical support needed to keep their engines performing reliably throughout their operational lives.

[![Image 2](https://www.hellenicshippingnews.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Global-Service-by-WinGD_1.jpg)](https://www.hellenicshippingnews.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Global-Service-by-WinGD_1.jpg)

Global Service by WinGD, brings together knowledge, insights and a worldwide service network to support

“More than service agreements, these partnerships help customers maximise reliability, efficiency and operational performance while navigating increasingly complex technical and regulatory requirements.”

The service package includes spare parts for scheduled maintenance, technical labour, workshop services and advisory support, alongside remote monitoring, troubleshooting and engine optimisation through WinGD’s WiDE platform.

[![Image 3](https://www.hellenicshippingnews.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/52324.jpg)](https://www.hellenicshippingnews.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/52324.jpg)

Combining physical service with continuous digital insight enables maintenance planning and engine optimisation tailored to each vessel’s operating profile.

Oil transport services

The latest agreements expand Global Service by WinGD’s presence across major LNG shipping markets and further strengthen the company’s growing portfolio of long-term lifecycle support contracts.

The recent contract wins include a ten-year agreement with COSCO Shipping LNG (Hong Kong) Ship Management covering six LNG carriers powered by WinGD 6X72DF engines.
 WinGD has also signed a five-year service agreement with Japan’s NYK LNG Shipmanagement covering ten X-DF dual-fuel main engines across five LNG carriers. The fleet spans several generations of X-DF technology. Two vessels, built in 2022 and 2024 at HHI and SHI respectively, are powered by WinGD 5X72DF engines, while three newer vessels, built in 2025 and 2026 by HHI, are equipped with 5X72DF-2.1 engines.

In Greece, one of the world’s major shipowning and ship management markets, WinGD has signed a long-term engine service agreement covering three newbuild LNG carriers operated by Athens-based TMS Cardiff Gas Ltd. Built by HD Hyundai Samho in South Korea, the vessels are each equipped with two WinGD 5X72DF dual-fuel engines.

Carmelo Cartalemi, Head of Strategic Marketing of WinGD, said: “No one understands X-DF engines quite like the people who designed them. We’ve spent years developing these engines and working with customers to understand how they perform in service, across different vessels and operating conditions. That experience gives us a real advantage in supporting them throughout their lifetime.

“Through Global Service by WinGD, we bring together that knowledge, insights from digital monitoring and a worldwide service network to support LNG carrier operators wherever their vessels are operating. This is not an off-the-shelf service offering. Every vessel and operator has different requirements, and our understanding of the engines, their operating history and individual vessel needs allows us to anticipate challenges, inform maintenance decisions and provide targeted technical support wherever it is needed.”

Launched in 2025, Global Service by WinGD brings together more than 125 years of two-stroke engine design expertise with a worldwide network providing field service, technical support, spare parts and digital expertise. The service extends WinGD’s involvement beyond engine delivery, giving operators direct access to OEM knowledge and support throughout the operational lifecycle. The latest contract awards demonstrate the market’s growing recognition of the value of that approach.
 Source: WinGD

title: China’s Communist Party elite gather for closed-door governance talks
zh_title: 中国共产党精英齐聚闭门谈治国理政
summary: 中国国家主席习近平和其他高层领导人周一在北京举行一次重要聚会，密切关注有关国家发展方向和未来领导力的线索。 2021年11月，中国共产党第十九届中央委员会第六次全体会议。资料图片：中国共产党。据官方媒体报道，大约有 300 名执政的共产党中央委员会成员出席了这次被称为五中全会的会议，他们将寻求加强内部纪律。其中包括减少腐败和提高干部效率的措施
content:
中国国家主席习近平和其他高层领导人周一在北京举行一次重要聚会，密切关注有关国家发展方向和未来领导力的线索。 2021年11月，中国共产党第十九届中央委员会第六次全体会议。资料图片：中国共产党。据官方媒体报道，大约有 300 名执政的共产党中央委员会成员出席了这次被称为五中全会的会议，他们将寻求加强内部纪律。其中包括减少腐败、提高干部效率和忠诚度的措施。这次在严密安保下举行的闭门会议在周四结束之前几乎不会公开，但会议的时机至关重要。另请参阅：关于中国共产党五中全会的信息五中全会在明年举行的一次重要党代会上召开，73岁的习近平几乎肯定会获得历史性的第四个任期并监督领导层改组。历次全会都是习近平巩固权威的关键时刻。这位中国领导人开展了长达14年的反腐败运动，清洗了数千名官员，其中包括数十名中央委员会官员。然而，他仍然对他认为干部没有执行他的命令感到沮丧。
官方媒体在全会前发表了一篇文章，内容是习近平一月份的一次讲话，其中他谴责了“两面派”官员，他们表面上遵守中央指令，但“内心抵制”，追求“个人主义”，而且是“政治机会主义”。 投票率低的分析人士告诉法新社，习近平正试图通过加强监督和规则来最大限度地提高干部的效率和忠诚度。但由于他的大规模清洗，预计今年的全会投票率将是前领导人毛泽东 1976 年去世以来的最低水平。中央委员会的 8 个席位空缺，另有 15 名成员正在接受调查并面临被替换的风险。习近平的反腐败运动还针对军队，推翻了党的最高武装部队机构中央军事委员会（CMC）七名委员中的五名。 2022年11月，习近平视察中央军委联合作战指挥中心。图片：中共新闻。据亚洲协会政策研究所称，2022 年任命的 44 名中央委员会军事成员中，只有两人没有被清洗或失踪。全会可能会任命新的中央军委委员；该党可以等到明年的代表大会来补充资金；或者习近平甚至可能重组党对其庞大军队的控制。
此次会谈也是在这个世界第二大经济体不稳定的时期举行的，该国一直在努力解决持续低迷的国内支出和关键房地产行业旷日持久的危机。与美国动荡的政治和经济关系也给中国领导人带来了压力。预计当局将在周四会议结束后发布结果摘要。

【原文 English Original】
China’s President Xi Jinping and other top leaders meet in Beijing on Monday at a key gathering watched closely for clues as to the country’s direction and future leadership. The sixth plenary session of the 19th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party in November 2021. File photo: Communist Party of China. Roughly 300 members of the ruling Communist Party’s Central Committee in attendance at the meeting, called the fifth plenum, will be looking to tighten discipline within their ranks, according to state media. That includes measures to reduce corruption and make cadres more effective and loyal. Little of the closed-door gathering, held under tight security, will be made known until it concludes on Thursday, but the timing of the meeting is crucial. See also: What to know about the Chinese Communist Party’s Fifth Plenum The fifth plenum comes ahead of a major party congress next year, where 73-year-old Xi is almost certain to secure a historic fourth term and oversee a leadership reshuffle. Previous plenums have represented key moments for Xi to cement his authority. The Chinese leader has waged a 14-year campaign against corruption that has purged thousands of officials, including dozens of the Central Committee. Yet he remains frustrated with cadres he deems are not implementing his orders. State media published an article ahead of the plenum, based on a speech Xi gave in January in which he railed against “two-faced” officials who appear to comply with central directives but “inwardly resist”, pursue “individualism” and are “politically opportunistic”. Low turnout Analysts told AFP that Xi is trying to maximise efficiency and loyalty among cadres by imposing more supervision and rules. But as a result of his expansive purges, this year’s plenum is expected to have the lowest turnout since former leader Mao Zedong’s death in 1976. Eight of the Central Committee’s seats lie vacant, with another 15 members under investigation and at risk of being replaced. Xi’s anti-corruption drive has also targeted the military, toppling five of the seven members of the Central Military Commission (CMC), the party’s top armed forces body. Xi Jinping inspects the Central Military Commission Joint Operations Command Center in November 2022. Photo: CPC News. Of 44 military members appointed to the Central Committee in 2022, only two have not been purged or disappeared, according to the Asia Society Policy Institute. The plenum could see new members appointed to the CMC; the party could wait until next year’s congress to replenish it; or Xi might even restructure party control over its vast military. The talks also come at an unsteady time for the world’s second-largest economy, which has struggled to address persistently sluggish domestic spending and a protracted crisis in the crucial property sector. Turbulent political and economic ties with the United States are also weighing on China’s leaders. Authorities are expected to release a summary of the outcomes after the meeting concludes on Thursday.

陸港三主教將罕見赴羅馬 與梵蒂岡國務卿共同出席研討會 | 兩岸要聞 | 兩岸 | 聯合新聞網
Your browser does not support HTML5 Audio! 😢
中梵向來受到關注。圖為2026年11月1日，在梵蒂岡城，教宗良十四世在俯瞰聖伯多祿廣場的辦公室窗前，帶領信眾進行「三鐘經」祈禱。歐新社
香港明報引述梵蒂岡官方信仰通訊社日前報導指出，北京主教李山、新任江蘇海門主教丁祖耀、香港教區主教周守仁本月5日將前往羅馬，參加主題為「在中國的普世教會面容」的國際研討會，梵蒂岡國務卿帕羅林預計也將出席同一場研討會。
報導稱，這研討會由羅馬宗座傳信大學舉辦，以紀念教宗庇護十一世於1926年祝聖六名中國籍主教100周年，在此之前中國主教均均由外國傳教士出任。根據活動議程，帕羅林、李山、周守仁、丁祖耀、中國社科院世界宗教研究所研究員劉國鵬及當地學者等將先後致詞，新任樞機團團長塔格萊則總結發言。
另，澳門教區今年慶祝成立450周年，教宗良十四世在致函澳門教區賀詞中提及，澳門教區是近代遠東首個成立的教區，「無數傳教士亦曾從這片小小的土地出發，走遍亞洲各地」。教宗肯定澳門教區在慈善、醫療及教育事業的工作，並鼓勵教區反思每個地方教會的使命，包括服務每一個人。
香港明報引述梵蒂岡官方信仰通訊社日前報導指出，北京主教李山、新任江蘇海門主教丁祖耀、香港教區主教周守仁本月5日將前往羅馬，參加主題為「在中國的普世教會面容」的國際研討會，梵蒂岡國務卿帕羅林預計也將出席同一場研討會。
中國大陸船隻近期在台灣周邊海域及開展各種作業，引發美日媒體關注。環球時報前總編輯胡錫進表示，台灣周邊海纜共24條，台灣99%以上對外通信依賴這些國際海纜，這些海纜一旦斷掉，對台灣的影響肯定是「癱瘓」級，而且一旦在戰時發生海纜被切斷，修復幾乎沒有可能。大陸蒐集台灣周邊海纜資料，目的之一就是支持中國的國防。
中國大陸和土耳其最近因為歷史與祖先溯源問題，在社媒X平台論戰，結果驚動全球許多網友加入，包括希臘、伊朗、俄羅斯、日本、南韓，瀏覽量已超過上千萬，希臘媒體還報導指這是「第一次推特戰爭」，到底是在爭論什麼會驚動那麼多國的網友，他們前前後後在網上是在「戰」什麼？
中國大陸與秘魯升級版自貿協定一日生效，大陸商務部稱，這彰顯了大陸致力於通過自貿談判，與各國共同維護多邊主義和自由貿易的決心。
大陸全國政協預計十一月十二日舉行紀念孫中山誕辰一六○周年活動，陸委會呼籲勿與陸方在台合辦或赴陸參加相關活動，避免淪為統戰工具。中共機關報人民日報昨刊文，批評陸委會升高兩岸對抗；並聲稱，台方此舉是怕台灣民眾親眼看到孫中山在建國方略構想的建設宏偉藍圖已在大陸實現。
大陸Ａ股經歷十月急跌後，金融監管部門準備採取行動「救市」。陸媒報導，中國人民銀行（大陸央行）、金融監督管理總局及證監會今日將分別邀集銀行、證券及基金機構開會「喝咖啡」，預期將加強政策支持，進一步穩定Ａ股市場。

位于莫斯科南部的察里津诺博物馆图像来源: Depositphotos/IMAGO
（德国之声中文网）美国驻俄大使馆告知俄罗斯当局周六可能发生恐怖袭击，地点在莫斯科南部察里津诺博物馆保护区公园。美方警告说，这场恐袭可能会“造成大量人员伤亡”。
美国大使馆表示，正与俄罗斯当局展开合作。美方已提醒在俄美国公民注意安全，避免前往以上提及的公园。
俄罗斯国内情报机构即联邦安全局（FSB）随后向媒体证实，收到美国情报方关于恐怖袭击风险的警告。
据俄罗斯塔斯社报道，俄联邦安全局表示，“通过合作渠道，我们从美方获悉了有关在莫斯科策划恐怖袭击的情报。目前，相关部门已经采取了必要应对措施。”报道称美俄双方均未透露更多细节。
美国已多次向莫斯科传递可能发生恐怖袭击的情报。2024年3月初美方提前发布了恐袭警报，当月22日，在莫斯科附近一个音乐厅发生恐怖袭击，造成151人死亡，数百人受伤。
德国驻莫斯科大使馆也强烈建议在俄德国公民避开察里津诺公园，称“有具体迹象表明当前存在安全威胁”。
位于莫斯科南部的察里津诺博物馆保护区，是由叶卡捷琳娜二世下令建于十八世纪的郊外庄园，但当时建设工程未能完成。大约20年前，俄罗斯政府对这片公园绿地及其历史建筑群进行了大规模的修复。

10月30日，刚刚与欧盟领导人进行会谈的加拿大总理卡尼接受了德国之声专访。他表示，加拿大对美国的依赖度过高，现在亟需深化与志同道合国家的多样化伙伴关系。
德国总理默茨在首尔与韩国总统李在明共同举行了联合新闻发布会，默茨表示，两国关系将提升至“深层战略伙伴关系”的水平。他说，在全球动荡时期，“我们现在加深伙伴关系是理所应当”。

北京坚持香港和澳门“一个国家，两种制度”中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 2 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
北京坚持香港和澳门“一个国家，两种制度”
国务院港澳事务办公室发表文章，援引国家主席习近平的讲话，要求坚定不移落实“一国两制”方针，确保社会长治久安。它强调国家安全、反制裁机制以及对香港的支持
国务院港澳办理论研究中心11月2日发表文章，援引习近平主席在庆祝中国共产党成立105周年大会上的讲话。习近平表示，促进香港、澳门长期繁荣稳定是中华民族伟大复兴的内在要求。
文章称，习近平的讲话加深了党对“一国两制”政策的认识。要求全面准确落实“港人治港”、“澳门人治澳门”、“爱国者治港”、“爱国者治澳”的方针。完善法治建设，支持香港、澳门更好融入国家发展。
文章强调，安全是发展的前提，是维护开放环境、稳定市场信心、维护国际关系的前提。报告称，“安全底线越牢固，香港、澳门开放发展的空间就越广阔”。会议指出，香港从混乱到秩序再到繁荣的转变是一个持续的过程。
文章警告说，国家安全威胁依然严重复杂，发展不能忽视安全。它呼吁加强反制裁和反外国干涉机制，包括反对“长臂管辖”。它支持对“反华分子、不稳定分子”保持高压，并完善国家安全法律体系。
文章支持香港和澳门特别行政区行政长官和政府有效实施五年计划。会议指出，香港要巩固国际金融、航运、贸易中心地位，加快北领地和国际科技创新中心发展。
文章最后表示，有祖国坚强后盾，在政府和社会共同努力下，香港、澳门一定能在“一国两制”框架下实现新贡献和更高质量发展。

Beijing insists on 'one country, two systems' for Hong Kong and Macau | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 2 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Beijing insists on 'one country, two systems' for Hong Kong and Macau
The State Council's Hong Kong and Macau Affairs Office published an article citing President Xi Jinping's call for steadfast implementation of the 'one country, two systems' principle to ensure long-term stability. It stressed national security, anti-sanctions mechanisms, and support for Hong Kong's
The State Council's Hong Kong and Macau Affairs Office, through its theoretical study centre, published an article on 2 November citing President Xi Jinping's speech at the 105th anniversary of the Chinese Communist Party. Xi said that promoting the long-term prosperity and stability of Hong Kong and Macau is an inherent requirement for the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.
The article said Xi's speech deepened the party's understanding of the 'one country, two systems' policy. It called for fully and accurately implementing the principle, along with 'Hong Kong people ruling Hong Kong' and 'Macau people ruling Macau', and the principle of 'patriots administering Hong Kong' and 'patriots administering Macau'. It urged improving legal governance and supporting Hong Kong and Macau to better integrate into national development.
The article stressed that security is a prerequisite for development and for maintaining an open environment, stable market confidence and international ties. It said 'the firmer the security baseline, the broader the space for Hong Kong and Macau's open development'. It noted that Hong Kong's transition from chaos to order and then to prosperity is a continuous process.
The article warned that national security threats remain serious and complex, and said development cannot ignore security. It called for strengthening anti-sanctions and anti-foreign-interference mechanisms, including countering 'long-arm jurisdiction'. It supported maintaining high pressure on 'anti-China, destabilising elements' and improving legal systems for national security.
The article backed the chief executives and governments of Hong Kong and Macau in effectively implementing their five-year plans. It said Hong Kong should consolidate its status as an international financial, shipping and trade centre, and accelerate the development of the Northern Territory and an international innovation and technology hub.
The article concluded that with the motherland as a strong backing and joint efforts by the governments and society, Hong Kong and Macau can achieve new contributions and higher-quality development under the 'one country, two systems' framework.

Fundraiser by tyrone thomas : Unite for Digital Fearlessness
tyrone thomas is organizing this fundraiser.
"Use what's in your hand" - Adam Clayton Powell Jr.
Your phone isn't just for posting stories and playing music. That little computer in your pocket has more power than entire governments had 20 years ago. Like the ancient Abhaya Mudra - the fearless hand gesture that banishes fear and offers protection from the "Evil Eye" - we're transforming these devices into something that helps communities meet the coming challenges with a sense of fearlessness, rooted in Free Collaboration and Privacy.
Abhaya started as disaster recovery - how do communities rebuild communication when the towers are down and the power's out? But we realized something profound: the same tools that help neighborhoods coordinate after a hurricane are exactly what we need when authoritarians try to silence us. Like the protective Abhaya Mudra, this system creates a shield against the "evil eye" of surveillance while becoming a helpful digital companion that guides and empowers our communities.
Drawing inspiration from Buckminster Fuller's vision of global cooperation for humanity's benefit, Abhaya is designed as the foundation for communities to work together toward a more equitable future. The ecosystem operates through five interconnected elements:
• Tor + Mobile based Mesh Networks: Messages that flow around censorship like water
• Mesh Based Distributed Storage: Truth that lives everywhere so it can't be destroyed
• Mesh Based Distributed Computation Service: AI-capable shared processing power for communities to solve their own challenges
• Sensor/Peripheral IO: User Controlled Eyes and ears embedded in the network
• Mesh Federation: Connecting local networks into unstoppable global resistance
"The ultimate measure of a man is not where he stands in moments of comfort and convenience, but where he stands at times of challenge and controversy." - MLK Jr.
After Hurricane Katrina, communities learned they couldn't wait for official help. Hong Kong protesters used mesh networks when the government tried to cut them off. Iranian women shared videos of police brutality when the state blocked social media. Puerto Ricans coordinated mutual aid through amateur radio when Maria destroyed the grid.
The pattern is clear: when systems fail - whether from natural disasters or deliberate suppression - communities need tools to build their own infrastructure. Communities united in purpose and vision can be powerful.
When you contribute to Abhaya, you're investing in infrastructure that makes communities fearless. No CEO can sell it. No government can buy it. No algorithm can suppress it. No storm can wash it away.
Every dollar helps us turn individual devices into collective power. Like Powell said - we're not waiting for someone to save us. We're using what's already in our hands to build the infrastructure of fearlessness.
Fund the network that makes communities fearless.
We're assembling an international team of developers and engineers who understand that code is power, and power should belong to the people. If you're a technologist looking to put your skills toward meaningful resistance, this is how you push back against authoritarianism and corporate overreach.
• Onion Router, I2P, Freenet protocols
• DevOps/SecOps fluent in Dark Web technologies
This is open-source work with no revenue model - Abhaya is designed to be free for all communities. For technologists feeling the weight of current events, it's a concrete way to turn skills into direct action and fulfill civic duty through code. Ready to put your shoulder to the wheel of progress? Reach out.
Because true community care means building the infrastructure that makes us all fearless.

WASHINGTON — The Pentagon has shipped some cyber operators from Maryland to sunny Hawaii in an effort to reinforce US Pacific Command’s technical defenses there under a concept called Cyber Defense Forces Pacific, according to a senior PACOM official.

Brig. Gen. Michael Smith, director for command, control, communications, computers and cyber at PACOM, told the TechNet Indo-Pacific Conference that the newcomers assigned to the Defense Information Systems Agency Pacific provide “a level of additional cybersecurity defense here in this theater.” DISA-Pacific is the regional field command of the Fort Meade-based organization.

“[I’m] really thankful for those folks because when they weren’t here, it’s just me,” he said at the event last week.

The personnel were drawn from the DoD’s Cyber Defense Command (DCDC), which is also based in Fort Meade in Maryland. The DCDC falls under US Cyber Command and is responsible for defending the Pentagon’s data networks.

Smith called the relocation to Hawaii of some servicemembers a “roll down” of DCDC personnel to PACOM’s area of responsibility, meant to “build out a more robust defender perspective with all the tools and assets to go with that.” The newly assigned personnel are trained to be adept at protecting information and responding to incidents, he said.

While Smith did not discuss any specific threats to PACOM networks, the command operates in the region with perhaps America’s most technically proficient adversary: China. [Experts say](https://scs.georgetown.edu/news-and-events/article/9453/securing-us-infrastructure-amid-volt-typhoon-threat/) that Beijing, for instance, has been caught [targeting the networks of military critical infrastructure installations in Guam](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-038a), a key US military installation, in an effort to cripple a Washington response to action in the region.

In the face of that and other threats in cyberspace, CYBERCOM has [sought to increase cyber defense funding in the region](https://defensescoop.com/2025/07/01/cyber-command-2026-budget-request-increase-funding-indo-pacific-defense/) in recent years.

content: 澳洲突然发出紧急提醒！ 全球多国掀起囤货潮！ 澳洲红十字会也发声！ 呼吁全民提前做好准备！ 澳洲华人也开始行动！ 有人半年前就开始囤货！ 评论区有人忍不住问： “真的是因为战争吗？” 连纸巾、大米都从中国海运！ 有人直言：至少便宜一半！ 全球突然掀起囤货潮！澳洲红十字会紧急提醒全民做好准备！罐头、饮用水开始囤，华人也坐不住了！ 最近，一条关于澳洲全民囤货的消息，突然在社交媒体上引发关注！ 罐头、饮用水、手电筒、手摇收音机，这些平时不太起眼的东西，如今竟然成了全球多国居民重点储备的物资。更让人意外的是，澳洲红十字会也公开提醒民众，应该提前做好应对紧急情况的准备！ 消息传到华人圈后，已经有人晒出自己的囤货计划，还有网友忍不住追问：“真的是因为战争吗？” 据Yahoo News Australia报道，全球多个国家已经开始出现应急用品销量上涨的情况。 在英国，罐头食品、瓶装水、手摇收音机和手电筒的销售量明显增加，越来越多居民开始准备应急物资。此前，英国方面呼吁公众储备至少三天的生活必需品，以应对战争、网络攻击和气候危机可能造成的影响。 而且，提前储备应急物资的并不只有英国。瑞典和挪威也鼓励居民准备足以维持一周生活的基本用品，日本、德国等国家同样不断提醒民众做好紧急准备。 从欧洲到亚洲，越来越多地方开始关注突发事件可能造成的供应中断。如今，这股应急储备的讨论也来到了澳洲！ 澳洲红十字会负责灾后恢复与社区韧性的Nichola Krey接受采访时明确表示，澳洲人也应该做好准备。 她说：“我们鼓励所有澳洲人为任何可能发生的中断做好准备。” 红十字会还提醒居民，应当了解自己所在地区可能面临的风险，并提前考虑一旦发生紧急情况该怎么办。澳洲人也不能等到事情真正发生，才开始寻找饮用水、食物和其他必需品！ 不过，澳洲面临的风险与欧洲并不完全相同。Krey特别指出，澳洲目前并没有迫在眉睫的战争威胁，但洪水、山火、极端高温和热带气旋等自然灾害，却一直威胁着不同地区。 澳洲红十字会数据显示，约五分之三的澳洲人一生中会经历某种紧急事件。对于一个经常受到极端天气影响的国家来说，提前准备确实有现实意义！ RMIT灾害管理专家Lucy Lunevich给出的建议更加引人关注。她认为，澳洲家庭应该准备至少一个月的食品和其他应急用品，以防突发事件导致供应链中断。罐头、饮用水以及其他能够长期保存的生活用品，都可以纳入家庭储备。她还强调，一旦发生不可预测的灾害，政府未必能够立即满足所有家庭的需要。 Lunevich表示，紧急情况可能发生得比人们预想中更快。过去政府或社区能够提前数年规划的风险，如今有些变化可能在很短时间内突然出现。 而在澳洲华人圈，已经有人提前行动了。一名小红书网友直接发帖：“囤货吧”，并表示自己半年前就开始储备罐头和饮用水，之后还不断补充。她写道：“目前至少能保证一周可以不出门。” 帖子下面的评论也很有意思。有人第一反应竟然是：“去买卫生纸”，让人想起口罩期间澳洲超市纸巾货架被抢空的场景。 还有网友担心地问：“真的是因为战争吗？”原本只是关于应急准备的讨论，却很快延伸到了战争风险、物资短缺以及未来生活的不确定性！ 除了食品和饮用水，红十字会还提醒家庭把重要证件、个人贵重物品放在容易取用的位置。日常需要服用的药品、处方也应提前检查，同时与家人和孩子讨论紧急情况下如何联系、到哪里避险。如果真的需要撤离，提前知道该带什么、该往哪里走，也能减少临时手忙脚乱。应急准备涉及的，远不只是买几箱罐头这么简单！ 从英国的应急物资销量激增，到澳洲专家建议储备一个月食品，再到华人已经准备好一周不出门的物资，这场囤货讨论正在引发越来越多关注。但就在大家开始担心突发危机时，澳洲华人还面临着另一个更现实的问题：日常生活用品实在太贵了！ 最近，越来越多人干脆把购物车搬回中国，连纸巾、零食、大米都开始跨国海运！ 澳洲物价贵到华人集体转向中国！每月海运三四次，纸巾、大米都从国内买！有人直言至少便宜一半！ 澳洲物价越来越贵，不少华人干脆把购物车搬回了中国！ 以前大家从国内海运家具、电器，如今连袜子、内裤、纸巾、零食、大米都开始跨国采购。有人每个月海运三四次，还有人直接一整托盘往澳洲寄。有华人直言，即便算上海运费，部分商品仍然“至少便宜一半”！ 据今日澳洲报道，华人Emma从2022年开始，就逐渐把日用品采购转向中国电商平台。如今，她每个月从中国海运3至4次，每次1至2箱，早已成为生活习惯。居家用品、儿童玩具、厨房器具、露营装备，几乎都能从淘宝买齐。每次集中下单，再统一运到澳洲，已经成了她固定的购物方式。 Emma表示，澳洲物价上涨，是她选择中国网购的重要原因。 前不久，她还从淘宝买了露营帐篷、能同时推两个孩子的推车，以及实木菜板等商品。她觉得国内不仅价格便宜，商品选择也更加丰富。“至少能便宜一半。” 这也是她坚持海运的重要原因！ 另一位华人乐乐，购物习惯更直接。她告诉记者：“我现在很少在澳洲买生鲜以外的东西了。” 口罩结束后，她就开始频繁从中国采购，再通过海运寄到澳洲。按照她自己的计算，这样购买生活用品，通常能节省三分之一到一半的开支！ 更夸张的是华人Nyssa，海运规模已经从几箱发展成了整托盘！最初她只是给家里的猫购买用品，后来商品越买越多，以前每个月两三箱，现在两三个月就要运来一整托盘。按照她的介绍，一托盘大约相当于七八箱商品。 而Nyssa海运的东西，更是五花八门。零食、东北大米、猫罐头、猫砂，几乎什么都买，保质期较短的食品甚至会选择空运。海运通常需要一个多月，空运则大约一周到半个月。虽然运输时间不短，但她依然觉得值得，因为有些商品在澳洲贵，甚至根本买不到。 谈起不断海运的原因，Nyssa说得非常直接：“有房贷，负担真的很重。”澳洲生活成本不断增加，食品、住房和各种日用品都需要花钱，长期下来也是一笔不小的支出。对于需要养家、还房贷的华人家庭来说，能节省一点是一点。 小红书评论区里，类似经历也不少。一名在澳洲生活23年的华人表示，除了必须在本地购买的食品，其他东西基本都从国内网购。 另一名网友更直接：“现在是纸巾都买海运的了。” 还有网友说：“吃的喝的也海运啊，我家小朋友都知道哪个好吃，几乎每个月一箱不间断。” 有人每年回国都会大量采购袜子、内裤和各种生活用品，再带回澳洲。 这样的变化，也与近几年澳洲物价持续上涨有关。澳洲统计局数据显示，2022年第四季度，年度通胀率曾达到7.8%。报道还提到，与2023年相比，2026年部分面粉价格上涨超过一倍，苹果价格翻倍，速溶咖啡上涨超过七成。生活成本不断增加，也让一些华人家庭开始重新计算每笔支出。 小编想说，最近澳洲这些消息，真让人有些不安！一边是红十字会呼吁全民提前准备应急物资，连华人都开始囤罐头和饮用水；另一边，澳洲物价居高不下，越来越多华人连纸巾、大米都要从中国海运，只为省点钱。生活成本已经够让人头疼了，如今还要为各种突发风险做好准备。希望大家理性储备、量力消费，也盼着澳洲物价能早日降下来，让普通家庭的日子轻松一点！ 您对此怎么看呢？欢迎评论区聊聊。 content: 作者臉書  2026-10-31 這幾天大家可能都在想，到底是誰傷害了中國人民的感情？我也來説説我的看法。 法國足球巨星姆巴佩（Kylian Mbappé）最近惹惱了中共，原因很簡單，他說毛澤東是個獨裁者。北京立刻火冒三丈，指責他「傷害了中國人民的感情」。可是，毛澤東本來就是獨裁者，他的統治還造成數千萬中國人死亡。難道說出這個歷史事實，比毛澤東當年害死那麼多中國人，更傷害中國人民的感情？ 這件事看起來荒唐，卻正好戳破了中共多年來慣用的一套政治把戲。只要有人批評共產黨，就說人家侮辱了中國；只要有人批評毛澤東，就說人家傷害了中國人民。毛澤東雖然已經死了半個世紀，但他留下的獨裁體制還在，中共對毛的政治遺產更是碰都不讓人碰。 「傷害中國人民的感情」這句話，大家應該早就聽膩了。美國總統見了達賴喇嘛，中國人民的感情受傷了。日本首相談到台灣，中國人民的感情又受傷了。外國政府批評中共迫害人權，中國人民的感情還是受傷了。 奇怪了，十四億中國人真的都這麼容易被傷感情嗎？更重要的是，誰問過他們？ 一個不讓人民自由選舉國家領導人、不准人民公開批評政府、連上網說幾句真心話都可能惹上麻煩的政權，居然一天到晚宣稱自己最了解全體中國人民的感情。這不是很可笑嗎？ 其實，這套說法已經用了幾十年。中國媒體研究計畫（China Media Project）發現，早在1959年，中共《人民日報》就在中印邊界爭端中拿「傷害中國人民感情」來指責印度。研究人員統計了1959年至2015年間《人民日報》的143個相關案例，發現中共用這句話罵得最多的是日本，其次是美國，而台灣和西藏問題也經常成為引爆點。 說穿了，只要有人碰到中共的政治利益，或者不接受它對歷史和領土的說法，中國人民的感情就會突然受到「嚴重傷害」。 最離譜的例子之一，就是1989年的天安門事件。當年中共出動軍隊鎮壓屠殺要求民主改革的中國民眾，美國國會對這場血腥鎮壓提出譴責。結果北京竟然反過來指責美國傷害了中國人民的感情。 這是什麼道理？殺害中國人民不算傷害中國人民的感情，譴責殺害中國人民的暴行，反倒成了傷害中國人民感情的罪過？ 這就是中共這套說詞最荒謬、也最虛偽的地方。 毛澤東搞大躍進，造成一場人類歷史上最嚴重的人為大饑荒，估計有三千萬到四千五百萬中國人因此喪命。接著又搞文化大革命，整個社會被折騰得天翻地覆。無數家庭被拆散，老師被學生批鬥，知識分子遭到迫害，寺廟古蹟被砸得亂七八糟。到了1989年，中共又在北京向自己的人民開槍。 中共治國無方，折騰有數。目前的中國，民不聊生，失業飛漲，就業艱難，人人思潤，萬衆躺平，遍地貪腐，無限監管，鎮壓空前。難道因此而受煎熬的億萬中國人民的痛苦就不算數？難道這些事情沒有傷害中國人民的感情？ 可是，中共偏偏不准這些人公開訴說自己的苦難。誰想追究責任，誰就可能受到打壓；誰想紀念歷史，誰就可能被當成政治上的尋釁滋事的人物。 所以，中共口中的「中國人民的感情」，其實有一個很奇怪的規矩，只要是外國人讓中國人不高興，中共就要替大家出頭；但如果是共產黨自己傷害了中國人民，那就最好閉嘴，連提都不准提，因爲在中共眼中， 被肆虐幾十年的中國人民是沒有感情的。 姆巴佩事件就很能說明這種荒唐的地方。中國媒體忙著譴責他的所謂「辱華」言論，卻不敢清楚告訴中國民眾，他到底說了什麼。有些中國網民連事情的來龍去脈都不知道，就被要求跟著生氣。連別人講了什麼都不讓你知道，卻要你義憤填膺，這不是很滑稽嗎？ 這種憤怒，很多時候根本不是人民自己產生的，而是中共需要人民生氣的時候，才刻意製造出來的。這套把戲其實很好懂。對內，中共可以把老百姓對經濟、失業、貪腐和社會不公的不滿，轉移到外國人身上。對外，則可以利用龐大的中國市場，逼外國政府、企業、學校、運動員和演藝界人士乖乖接受中共的政治規矩。 2019年，美國職籃休士頓火箭隊總經理莫雷（Daryl Morey）發文支持香港示威者，北京馬上對NBA展開抵制。其他外國企業和名人，只要在台灣、西藏等問題上說了中共不愛聽的話，也可能遭到封殺。 北京的意思再明白不過，你在美國可以有言論自由，但如果想賺中國市場的錢，就得先學會看共產黨的臉色。這其實就是拿生意當武器，逼自由世界接受中共的言論審查。 但是，中共這種動不動就發火的習慣，也暴露出它內心深處的不安全感。 在台灣問題、美國軍事行動，以及其他國際爭端上，北京經常把話說得很重，動不動就警告對方要承擔「嚴重後果」。但很多時候，最後也只是雷聲大、雨點小。嘴巴上喊得震天響，真正能做、敢做的事情卻未必有那麼多。 中國當然是一個有實力的大國，這一點沒有人否認。但一個真正有自信的大國，何必整天為了外國人的一句話、一張地圖、一個玩笑，就氣得跳腳？ 一方面宣稱中國已經強大起來，正在實現偉大的民族復興；另一方面又把中國人民說得好像玻璃心一樣，動不動就被外國人傷害。這兩件事擺在一起，不覺得很矛盾嗎？ 說到底，中共真正害怕的，不是中國人民的感情受傷，而是有人不再把共產黨當成中國的唯一代表。這也解釋了為什麼中共特別喜歡拿中國近代史上的屈辱做文章。 十九世紀以來，中國確實受到過列強侵略、不平等條約，以及日本軍國主義帶來的巨大災難。這些歷史都是真的，也值得中國人記住。但問題是，中共只准中國人記住外國人對中國造成的傷害，卻不准中國人自由討論共產黨自己造成的災難。 外國人一百多年前犯下的前科，北京可以沒完沒了地要求道歉；共產黨對中國人民造成比外國人所爲多出幾十倍的數千萬人死亡的歷史，卻連公開追究都不准。這根本不是尊重歷史。 只要國內經濟出了問題，社會矛盾增加，或者人民對政府不滿，北京就可以找個外國人來當出氣筒，然後把自己打扮成捍衛民族尊嚴的大英雄。這套政治操作最關鍵的一步，就是故意把共產黨和中國畫上等號。但中國就是中國，共產黨就是共產黨，兩者根本不是一回事。 對美國人來說，這件事其實有一個很直接的教訓，不要再為了行使自己的自由，而向獨裁者低頭道歉。北京沒有權力規定美國人能說什麼、大學能教什麼、企業能發表什麼，更沒有資格決定哪些歷史事實可以公開討論。 中共現在很聰明，它不需要在美國制定法律，只要拿中國市場當誘餌，就能讓不少美國機構自己替它執行言論審查。好萊塢為了中國票房修改劇本，大學怕惹北京不高興而迴避敏感議題，企業為了生意限制員工發言，體育聯盟更是動不動就為一句完全合法的政治言論公開道歉。 這才是美國人真正應該警惕的事情。一個外國獨裁政權，居然可以利用商業利益，讓自由社會的人自己放棄言論自由。這不是一般的外交摩擦，而是中共把自己的政治規矩一步步帶進美國社會。我們應該公開揭露中共的經濟脅迫，保護因為合法言論而遭到北京報復的美國人，並且清楚告訴北京，中國市場再大，也買不到替美國人制定言論規則的權力。 更重要的是，我們必須看穿中共最大的政治謊言， 强調共產黨不等於中國，共產黨的利益也不等於中國人民的利益。 真正侮辱中國人民的，不是有人說毛澤東是獨裁者，而是一個造成數千萬中國人死亡、掩蓋歷史真相、剝奪人民基本自由的政黨，居然還厚著臉皮，自稱是中國人民感情的守護者。北京與其整天教訓全世界不要傷害中國人民的感情，不如先向中國人民交代，共產黨自己到底給他們造成了多少苦難。 說穿了，中共根本不是在保護中國人民的感情，而是在拿中國人民的感情當人質。真正傷害中國人民尊嚴的，不是外國人批評共產黨，而是共產黨自己。
