content:
资料照片：位于首都华盛顿的美国联邦通信委员会(FCC)总部的主要入口。(2021年5月)
美国计划以国家安全为由，在近期作出禁止中国电信企业直接获取美国电话号码的决定，此举同时可以防范烦恼美国用户的与诈骗相关的自动拨号语音电话(robocalls)，而中国政府则对此表示反对。
美国联邦通信委员会(FCC)星期四(10月29日)表示，将于11月19日就一项禁止中国移动、中国电信、中国联通以及其他提供IP通信服务的中国企业直接获取美国电话号码的提案进行表决。
“通过这一决定，联邦通信委员会将加强我们抵御恶意行为者和非法自动语音电话拨打者的第一道防线，”美国联邦通信委员会主席布伦丹·卡尔(Brendan Carr)在一份声明中指出。
“互联网语音通话”(VoIP)是把语音转换为数字数据并通过宽带连接进行传输的一项被普遍使用的技术。
路透社指出，对于提供“互联网语音通话”的电信公司而言，“直接接入”是一种成本低得多的选择，也让它们更容易提供各类高级功能。
除了考虑禁止中国电信公司直接获取美国电话号码外，美国联邦通信委员会星期四还表示，正计划禁止那些使用被列入该机构“国家安全风险清单”企业相关设备的IP语音服务提供商开展服务。
美国联邦通信委员会还打算于2028年12月起，禁止所有中国实验室对美国智能手机等电子产品进行测试，理由是国家安全和知识产权保护方面的担忧。此外，对于被认定构成国家安全风险的中国企业，该机构还可能撤销其直接号码使用授权。
此前，美国联邦通信委员会已经下令禁止中国移动、中国电信和中国联通等电信公司向美国提供国际电信服务。
路透社指出，其他正在考虑的措施还包括直接禁止这些中国企业进入美国网络，同时禁止它们在美国境内运营数据中心。
中国政府对美国联邦通信委员会可能及即将实施的禁令表示反对。
“美方泛化国家安全概念，滥用国家力量无理打压中国企业，中方对此表示反对、强烈不满，”中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆在星期五举行的例行记者会上说。
郭嘉昆还表示，北京将“采取必要措施”，“坚定维护自身正当合法权益”。
近年来，由于与中国相关的黑客和网络窃密活动频繁，美国及其盟友担心中国窃取各自的电信数据和渗透各自的基础设施，因为这些活动可能会引发间谍活动和其他破坏性后果。
2024年下半年，华盛顿指控一个名为“盐台风”(Salt Typhoon)由中国政府支持的网络间谍组织窃取了美国消费者的通话记录及美国通话数据，并渗透进美国的电信企业和电信基础设施公司。
美国联邦调查局(FBI)今年表示，来自“盐台风”的威胁“依然十分严峻且持续存在”。
路透社说，美国联邦通信委员会今年7月将总部位于美国加州的“数字系统技术公司”(Digitalsystem Technology)列入“对美国国家安全构成风险的企业名单”，理由是该公司与中国电信企业存在关联，而且由中国公民拥有。
美众院中国问题特设委员会：中国电信企业在美监管牌照被吊销后仍留驻美国网络基础设施

title: Hong Kong to distribute ‘Security Bear’ national security picture books to 900 kindergartens
zh_title: 香港将向900所幼儿园派发《保安熊》国家安全绘本
summary: 保安局周二举行《安迪与保安熊：青少年维护国家安全》教育绘本首发仪式。保安局于2026年10月28日举行《安迪与保安熊：青少年维护国家安全》教育绘本首发仪式。照片：香港政府一站通。三卷本包括新故事和国家安全主题的儿歌。到今年年底，它们将分发到900家幼儿园和公共图书馆。根据周二的新闻稿，安全部长克里斯
content:
保安局周二举行《安迪与保安熊：青少年维护国家安全》教育绘本首发仪式。保安局于2026年10月28日举行《安迪与保安熊：青少年维护国家安全》教育绘本首发仪式。照片：香港政府一站通。三卷本包括新故事和国家安全主题的儿歌。到今年年底，它们将分发到900家幼儿园和公共图书馆。据周二的新闻稿称，保安局局长唐英年表示，“引人入胜的故事情节让孩子们发现和学习遵守规则和批判性思考的意义，让他们从小就明白维护国家安全的重要性。” 2025年11月11日，一部以国家安全为主题的互动剧在大会堂首映，小学生与保安局吉祥物“保安熊”互动。图片：香港政府一站通。安全熊系列是该局于2024年推出的。
不久之后，一场戏剧表演在学校巡回演出，吉祥物“安全熊”告诉孩子们，他们的家园必须“保持不受干扰，让每个人都能和平生活”。另请参阅：从互动戏剧到选举论坛：香港的政治转向华丽 所有八所大学教育资助委员会资助的本地大学都设有国民教育和国家安全课程，学生必须通过这些课程才能毕业。 儿童读物 2022 年 9 月，香港言语治疗师总会的五名成员因出版被视为煽动性的儿童读物而被判处 19 个月监禁。这些书涉及羊与狼对抗的寓言，羊代表民主抗议者，狼代表警察。经过一年的民主抗议和骚乱后，北京于 2020 年 6 月将国家安全立法直接纳入香港小宪法。它将颠覆、分裂国家、与外国势力勾结和恐怖主义行为定为刑事犯罪——广义上包括破坏交通和其他基础设施。此举赋予警方全面的新权力，并导致数百人在新的法律先例中被捕，同时数十个民间社会团体消失。当局表示，此举恢复了这座城市的稳定与和平，但拒绝接受贸易伙伴、联合国和非政府组织的批评。

【原文 English Original】
The Security Bureau held a launch ceremony for its Andy and Security Bear: Young Citizens Safeguarding National Security educational picture books on Tuesday. The Security Bureau held a launch ceremony on October 28, 2026 for their “Andy and Security Bear: Young Citizens Safeguarding National Security” educational picture books. Photo: GovHK. The three-volume set of titles includes new stories and national security-themed children’s songs. They will be distributed to 900 kindergartens and public libraries by the end of the year. According to a Tuesday press release, Secretary for Security Chris Tang said the “engaging storyline enables children to discover and learn the meaning of following rules and thinking critically, so that they can understand the importance of safeguarding national security from an early age.” Schoolchildren interact with “Security Bear,” a mascot of the Security Bureau, during the premiere of a national security-themed interactive drama at City Hall on November 11, 2025. Photo: GovHK. The Security Bear series was launched by the bureau in 2024. A theatre show toured schools shortly after , with the Security Bear mascot telling children that their homeland must “remain free from disruption, allowing everyone to live in peace.” See also: From interactive drama to election forums: Politics turns to pageantry in Hong Kong All eight University Grants Committee-funded local universities have national education and national security courses which students must pass in order to graduate. Children’s books In September 2022, five members of the General Union of Hong Kong Speech Therapists were sentenced to 19 months in prison for publishing children’s books that were deemed seditious . The books involved an allegory of sheep facing off against wolves, with the sheep representing pro-democracy protesters and the wolves representing the police. Beijing inserted national security legislation directly into Hong Kong’s mini-constitution in June 2020 following a year of pro-democracy protests and unrest. It criminalised subversion, secession, collusion with foreign forces and terrorist acts – broadly defined to include disruption to transport and other infrastructure. The move gave police sweeping new powers and led to hundreds of arrests amid new legal precedents , while dozens of civil society groups disappeared . The authorities say it restored stability and peace to the city, rejecting criticism from trade partners , the UN and NGOs .

title: Gibo snubs China at ADMM-Plus
zh_title: Gibo在ADMM-Plus上冷落中国
source: Rappler 菲律宾（调查/南海/选举）
summary: 在东南亚国家联盟（ASEAN）的任何会议中，这只是一场通常可以预见的仪式。当参加东盟防长会议的中国代表在拉普拉普市的麦克坦博览会上走过一小段红地毯时，镜头摇到了菲律宾代表的位置。然后握手并让摄像机快速暂停。不那么常规的是两位代表的级别。对于中国来说，是派驻马尼拉大使馆的武官。对于菲律宾来说，一位副部长一直代表
content:
在东南亚国家联盟（ASEAN）的任何会议中，这只是一场通常可以预见的仪式。当参加东盟防长会议的中国代表在拉普拉普市的麦克坦博览会上走过一小段红地毯时，镜头摇到了菲律宾代表的位置。然后握手并让摄像机快速暂停。不那么常规的是两位代表的级别。对于中国来说，是派驻马尼拉大使馆的武官。对于菲律宾来说，有一位副部长代表该国参加高级官员会议。就在几分钟前，国防部长小吉尔伯托·特奥多罗欢迎 ADMM Plus 合作伙伴的代表——包括级别低于他的副部长——参加会议。这是一个快照（或者也许是一个预演），展示了当一名受到有时好战的邻国马尼拉制裁的菲律宾官员同时担任某个地区集团主席时，可能会出现的尴尬和复杂情况。从快速交换中可以得到很多东西。首先，中国首次仅派出一名武官（无论如何，武官常驻菲律宾）代表中国参加东盟防务外交首屈一指的平台 ADMM。
中国共产党小报《环球时报》是这样描述的：这是“自2010年首届ADMM+会议以来中国在ADMM+中的代表级别最低”，并援引分析人士的话说，“出席率被降级应归咎于菲律宾”。这种冷落并非源自北京。 2026 年 9 月上旬，当被问及中国参加 ADMM-Plus 的情况时，特奥多罗一反常态地腼腆地回答他将如何接待中国同行。当被问及是否有可能不被邀请时，特奥多罗也表现得腼腆。到 2026 年 10 月中旬，特奥多罗承认，中国亲自参加可能会很尴尬。毕竟，中国驻马尼拉大使馆和北京本身都将特奥多罗列为问题。 2026年6月，外交部以特奥多罗及其直系亲属“多次对中国发表不负责任的言论，损害中方正当利益，破坏中菲关系”为由，对特奥多罗及其直系亲属实施制裁。  10月23日，也就是东盟及其伙伴国的国防部长和其他高级官员预计飞往宿务省参加会议的几天前，特奥多罗在新闻发布会上表示，已向中国发出参加会议的邀请。这封信由副部长伊格纳西奥·马德里加签署，他最终对这位武官表示欢迎。 10月26日，特奥多罗表示，他不知道北京是否回复了马德里加的信。
尽管一个国家——无论是东盟成员国还是其任何合作伙伴——必须得到主席或东道主的邀请才能参加这些多边活动，但这些邀请实际上是强制性的。无论双边问题如何，东道国都应该发出邀请。 27日，中国国防部宣布驻马尼拉武官杨雷大校将代表北京驻宿务。特奥多罗可能有无数的理由不欢迎杨。毕竟特奥多罗的级别明显高于高级队长。中国国防部长董军跳过 ADMM-Plus 的可能原因也有很多。但一切都以发生的事情为背景

【原文 English Original】
It was but a bit of drama in what is usually a predictable ritual in any meeting under the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN). As China’s representative to the ASEAN Defense Ministers’ Meeting made his way down a short red carpet walk at the Mactan Expo in Lapu-Lapu City, the camera panned to show the Philippines’ representative. Then a handshake and a quick pause for the cameras.  What was not so routinary were the ranks of the two representatives. For China, it was the defense attaché assigned to the embassy in Manila. For the Philippines, an undersecretary who’s been representing the country in senior officials’ meetings. Just a few minutes ago, no less than Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. welcomed representatives of ADMM’s Plus partners — including deputy ministers ranked below him — to the meeting.   It was a snapshot (or a preview, maybe) of the awkwardness and complications that can happen when a Filipino official sanctioned by Manila’s sometimes belligerent neighbor is also chairperson of a regional bloc.  There are a lot of things to unpack from the quick exchange. First, for the first time, China sent only a defense attaché — who is based in the Philippines anyway — to represent it in ADMM, ASEAN’s premiere platform for defense diplomacy. Chinese Communist Party tabloid Global Times framed it this way: it was the “lowest-level Chinese representation at the ADMM-Plus since its inaugural session in 2010” and that, quoting analysts, the “downgraded attendance is attributable to the Philippines.” The snub didn’t originate from Beijing.  In early September 2026, when asked about China’s participation in the ADMM-Plus, Teodoro was uncharacteristically coy when asked how he’d handle hosting his Chinese counterpart. When pressed if there was a chance they wouldn’t be invited, Teodoro played coy, too.  By mid-October 2026, Teodoro conceded that it could be awkward for China to participate in person. After all, the Chinese embassy in Manila and Beijing itself have tagged Teodoro as a problem. In June 2026, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs imposed sanctions on Teodoro and his immediate family after he supposedly “repeatedly made irresponsible remarks on China, which undermines China’s legitimate interests and sabotages China-Philippines relations.”  On October 23, or just days before defense ministers and other top officials from ASEAN and its partners were expected to fly to Cebu province for the meeting, Teodoro told a press conference that an invitation had been extended to China to participate in the meeting. The letter was signed by Undersecretary Ignacio Madriaga, who would eventually welcome the defense attaché. On October 26, Teodoro said he didn’t know if Beijing had replied to Madriaga’s letter. Although a country — be it an ASEAN member-state or any of its partners — must be invited by the chairman or host to participate in these multilateral events, these invitations are practically compulsory. The host country is expected to extend that invitation, regardless of bilateral issues. By the 27th, China’s Ministry of Defense announced that Senior Captain Yang Lei, the defense attaché to Manila, would represent Beijing in Cebu. There could be a myriad of reasons for Teodoro to skip welcoming Yang. Teodoro is, after all, ranked significantly higher than a senior captain. There are also many possible reasons for Chinese Defense Minister Dong Jun to skip ADMM-Plus. But everything is backdropped by what’s turning out to be the tensest turn yet for Philippine-China ties.  Chinese ambassador Jing Quan was summoned and widely criticized for saying the Philippines should be thankful that China does not use force in its disputes with the Philippines, as he reacted to Teodoro’s insistence that it’s Beijing that’s causing trouble in the region.  “Our functional cooperation must remain rooted in mutual respect and adherence to international law, including the United Nations Charter and the 1982 Convention on the Law of the Sea. ASEAN Member States and Dialogue Partners share the same principles, such as respect for sovereignty and territorial integrity, non-interference in internal affairs, the peaceful settlement of disputes, and the renunciation of the threat or use of force,” said Teodoro at the opening of the meeting. For years, of course, Teodoro has been among the loudest critics of Beijing in the Philippine government. Before China announced sanctions against him, Teodoro warned military and defense officials at the Shangrila Dialogue in Singapore that Beijing was not trustworthy in the context of South China Sea code negotiations.  China claims almost all of the South China Sea. It’s a claim that overlaps with claims of Southeast Asian countries, including the Philippines’.  For Manila, China’s claims have meant facing danger of harassment at sea in certain areas and features. For Beijing, it’s meant danger too — two of its China Coast Guard personnel died in a collision with its own warship, as both were trying to chase a Philippine Coast Guard ship.  – Rappler.com

title: Hong Kong leader apologizes for deadly Tai Po fire, pledges reform
zh_title: 香港特首就大埔火灾致歉并承诺改革
source: Rappler 菲律宾（调查/南海/选举）
summary: 香港 — — 香港特首李家超于 10 月 29 日星期四为去年 11 月导致香港 168 人死亡的致命大火道歉，他发布了一份独立报告，要求四个政府部门对这场经过一年多的安全投诉后爆发的火灾承担部分责任。李承诺对该市的建筑业和监管体系进行迅速而广泛的改革。由法官领导的小组这份长达 1000 多页的报告详细介绍了治理和监管方面的缺陷，包括普遍存在的操纵投标行为。 “火已经被扑灭，但改革才刚刚开始”
content:
香港 — — 香港特首李家超于 10 月 29 日星期四为去年 11 月导致香港 168 人死亡的致命大火道歉，他发布了一份独立报告，要求四个政府部门对这场经过一年多的安全投诉后爆发的火灾承担部分责任。李承诺对该市的建筑业和监管体系进行迅速而广泛的改革。由法官领导的小组这份长达 1000 多页的报告详细介绍了治理和监管方面的缺陷，包括普遍存在的操纵投标行为。报告称，“火已经被扑灭，但改革才刚刚开始”。 “委员会发现，没有一个政府部门有效地负责各种消防安全问题，有关火灾隐患的投诉陷入了真空。”大火烧毁了大埔北部区宏福苑住宅区的七栋31层塔楼，该住宅区正在进行翻修工程，并被防尘网和脚手架笼罩。在火灾发生前一年多的时间里，居民们多次对这项工程提出安全担忧，报告称火灾很可能是由“发光源……可能是香烟”引起的。这是该市自 1948 年以来最严重的死亡事件。数千名居民因家园无法居住而流离失所。 “作为行政长官和政府首脑，我深感悲痛，”李明博说，然后与其他七名官员一起鞠躬，罕见地表达了官方的忏悔。
“我谨代表特区政府向受害者和广大市民致歉。”李还宣布香港房屋局局长何温妮辞职，这是首位因火灾而辞职的官员。 纪律处分 宏福居民和其他批评者近几个月对政府缺乏问责表示愤怒。香港政府已成立一个独立小组来调查哪些官员应被追究责任并概述纪律处分。李明博的五年任期将于明年六月结束，他没有直接回答媒体有关他是否会寻求连任的问题，他说“实施改革是目标”而不是个人问题。李说，香港政务司司长陈家强现在将领导一个指导委员会，负责监督报告中倡导的改革，其中包括制定法律，将整个建筑行业的串通投标行为定为刑事犯罪，最高可处以 1000 万港元罚款和 10 年监禁。该委员会报告称，承包商Prestige Construction & Engineering Co Ltd和项目顾问Will Power Architects Co Ltd应承担主要责任。 Prestige、Will Power和七名个人已被提出至少25项与宏福苑火灾有关的刑事指控，包括过失杀人、串谋诈骗、洗钱和逃税。
但该报告还更进一步，将普遍存在的非法和可疑的建筑行为概述为“腐败的生态系统”。报告称，该行业的串通投标涉及多方，其中一些与三合会犯罪团伙有关。该委员会今年举行了30场听证会，有80名证人，包括居民、物业管理和装修人员、工程和消防专家、政府官员和监管机构。在调查火灾原因并审查建筑翻修监督时，它评估了超过一百万份文件和提交的材料。在报告发布之前，批评者曾表示该委员会缺乏

【原文 English Original】
HONG KONG – Hong Kong leader John Lee apologized on Thursday, October 29, for the deadly blaze that killed 168 people in the city last November, as he released an independent report that held four government departments partially responsible for a fire that erupted after more than a year of safety complaints. Lee promised swift but extensive reforms to the city’s building industry and regulatory system. The more than 1,000-page report by the judge-led panel detailed governance and supervisory failings, including widespread bid rigging. “The fire has been put out, but the reform has only just begun,” the report stated. “The Committee finds that no Government department took effective ownership of various fire safety issues and complaints about fire hazards fell into a vacuum.” The blaze ripped through seven 31-story tower blocks at the Wang Fuk Court residential complex, which was undergoing renovation work in the northern Tai Po district and shrouded in dust netting and scaffolding. Residents had repeatedly raised safety concerns over the work for more than a year before the fire, which the report said was most likely started by a “glowing source…likely a cigarette.” It was the deadliest in the city since 1948. Thousands of residents were displaced after their homes became uninhabitable. “As chief executive and head of the government, I am deeply saddened,” Lee said before bowing with seven other officials in a rare show of official contrition. “On behalf of the SAR government, I offer my apologies to the victims and the public at large.” Lee also announced the resignation of Hong Kong’s Housing Secretary Winnie Ho — the first official to resign over the inferno. Disciplinary action Wang Fuk residents and other critics have in recent months expressed anger at a perceived lack of government accountability. The Hong Kong government has set up an independent team to investigate which officials should be held accountable and to outline disciplinary actions. Lee, whose five-year term ends next June, did not directly respond to press questions over whether he would seek another term, saying “implementing the reforms is the goal” rather than personal matters. Lee said Hong Kong’s Chief Secretary Eric Chan will now head a steering committee to oversee reforms advocated in the report, which will include laws to criminalise bid rigging across the construction industry with fines of up to HK$10 million and 10 years’ imprisonment. The committee report said contractor Prestige Construction & Engineering Co Ltd and project consultant Will Power Architects Co Ltd should bear primary responsibility. At least 25 criminal charges related to the Wang Fuk Court fire have been made against Prestige, Will Power and seven individuals, including manslaughter, conspiracy to defraud, money laundering and tax evasion. But the report also went further, outlining widespread unlawful and dubious construction practices as a “corrupt eco-system.” The rigging of bids in the industry involved many different parties, some linked to triad organized crime gangs, it said. The committee held 30 hearings this year with 80 witnesses, including residents, property management and renovation personnel, engineering and fire experts, government officials and regulators. It evaluated more than one million files and submissions as it investigated the cause of the fire and reviewed oversight of building renovations. Before the report’s release, critics had said the committee lacked the statutory powers of a full public inquiry, which could potentially limit its ability to establish the full facts and accountability. Some groups in the Asian business hub have called for more transparency and accountability, amid warnings from authorities that any attempts to politicise the disaster would be severely punished. – Rappler.com

title: Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Guo Jiakun’s Regular Press Conference on October 26, 2026
summary: At the invitation of Member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of Foreign Affairs Wang Yi, Minister for Foreign Affairs of Iceland Þorgerður Katrín Gunnarsdóttir will visit China from October 26 to 31. **CCTV:
content:
At the invitation of Member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of Foreign Affairs Wang Yi, Minister for Foreign Affairs of Iceland Þorgerður Katrín Gunnarsdóttir will visit China from October 26 to 31.

**CCTV: China released the Progress Report on the AI Capacity-Building Action Plan for Good and for All at the 2026 Global Governance Forum (Xiong’an). How does China see the role of AI capacity-building in global governance?**

Guo Jiakun: Artificial intelligence is an emerging field in global governance, and a litmus test for the effectiveness of the global governance system. The global governance system would not become more just and equitable without the collective capacity enhancement of the Global South, and requires concrete efforts to strengthen the representation and voice of developing countries. China advocates for respecting the digital sovereignty of all countries. We believe that every country has the right to possess the foundational capabilities for independent AI development, and to seek a development path suited to its national conditions and practical needs, one that enables AI to be applied in real-world scenarios, address real problems, and generate sustained value.

As a responsible major country, China remains committed to providing global public goods in the field of AI. In 2024, China promoted the adoption of a UN General Assembly resolution on enhancing international cooperation on capacity-building of artificial intelligence, established the Group of Friends for International Cooperation on AI Capacity-Building, and released the AI Capacity-Building Action Plan for Good and for All. Over the past two years, China has taken major steps and practical measures to honor its commitment in advancing the above-mentioned initiative. Recently, at the 2026 Global Governance Forum (Xiong’an), China released the Progress Report on the AI Capacity-Building Action Plan for Good and for All, which systematically reviews the cooperation outcomes, practical experience and specific cases since the Action Plan was launched two years ago. The report identifies access to technology as the starting point and independent development as the goal, stresses the importance of demand-driven approaches, joint consultation and co-development for project delivery, and calls for promoting openness and open source and advancing AI models, data, and talent in a coordinated manner.

Looking ahead, we welcome more countries to join the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization, to explore more pathways for international cooperation on AI capacity-building, and to promote global AI development for good and for all with concrete actions.

**Brasil de Fato: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has just won the reelection. Does the Chinese foreign ministry have a comment or message regarding the outcome of this election and the prospect of China-Brazil relations on Lula’s next term? (Similar question from UOL of Brazil)**

Guo Jiakun: China takes note of the announcement by Brazil’s Superior Electoral Court of President Lula’s runoff victory and extends congratulations on that. China stands ready to work with Brazil to advance the building of the China-Brazil community with a shared future.

**Asahi Shimbun: Former Japanese Prime Minister Yasuo Fukuda just passed away. What’s your comment?**

Guo Jiakun: We express deep condolences and grief over former Prime Minister Yasuo Fukuda’s passing and heartfelt sympathies to his family.

Mr. Yasuo Fukuda is an old friend of the Chinese people, who actively contributed to the improvement and development of China-Japan relations. He has long been committed to the friendship between our two countries, and held a correct view of history. During his tenure as prime minister, China and Japan signed the fourth political document. After leaving office, he visited the Memorial Hall of the Victims in Nanjing Massacre. What’s more, he served for many years as Chairman of the Boao Forum for Asia, playing an important role in facilitating exchanges and cooperation in Asia.

Mr. Yasuo Fukuda once noted that the four political documents between China and Japan stipulated the principles governing bilateral relations, which we must bear in mind and never deviate from. Those firm and important remarks reflected the honor and responsibility of Japan’s statesman of the older generation and should evoke self-reflection and soul-searching among those currently running the Japanese government.

**AFP: Just following up on Brazil, Bolsonaro has called for those election results to be annulled. Does China have a comment on that?**

Guo Jiakun: China respects the choice of the Brazilian people.

**People’s Daily: On October 23, Member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister Wang Yi announced at the opening ceremony of the Global Governance Forum (Xiong’an) that China would issue a Position on Strengthening Outer Space Governance. Could you offer more information?**

Guo Jiakun: Outer space is the common frontier of all humanity and space exploration is humanity’s common endeavor. As announced by Member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister Wang Yi at the opening ceremony of the Global Governance Forum (Xiong’an), China has issued its Position on Strengthening Outer Space Governance. This is a major step by China to deliver on the four major global initiatives and advance efforts in building a community with a shared future for humanity in outer space.

The position paper takes the common values of humanity as the fundamental guidance and advocates that the development and security, as well as the stability and sustainability of outer space, should be pursued in a balanced way. It proposes that we should commit to openness and shared benefit, abide by the international rule of law, respect the rights of all States, advance innovation and development, safeguard common security, prevent armed conflicts, reduce misunderstanding and misperception, regulate commercial space activity, deepen international cooperation, and promote global governance.

The position paper outlines constructive approaches to address issues of common concern including development, security and governance in outer space, and provides a blueprint for relevant discussions and formulation of rules by the international community. China will continue working together with all parties in an open and constructive spirit to ensure that the outcomes of space development better benefit all humanity.

**China Daily: To follow up on Icelandic Foreign Minister Gunnarsdóttir’s upcoming visit you just announced, how does China see the current state of China-Iceland relations? What are your expectations for the visit?**

Guo Jiakun: We welcome Foreign Minister Gunnarsdóttir to visit China. China-Iceland relations have enjoyed sound momentum of growth in recent years. In 2025, when President Tómasdóttir was in China for the Global Leaders’ Meeting on Women, President Xi met with her and they reached important common understandings on deepening cooperation in such areas as economy and trade, geothermal energy, and people-to-people and cultural exchanges. As we mark the 55th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic ties between China and Iceland this year, the Chinese side looks forward to in-depth exchanges with the Icelandic side on bilateral relations and international and regional issues of mutual interest to further enhance trust, advance cooperation and renew our friendship.

**Yonhap News Agency: General Secretary of the Workers’ Party of Korea (WPK) and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (DPRK) Kim Jong Un visited Dandong, China last week. Was the visit proposed by China or the DPRK? Can you share more information on this visit?**

Guo Jiakun: On October 24, Member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee and Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC) Wang Huning accompanied General Secretary of the WPK and President of the State Affairs of the DPRK Kim Jong Un on a visit to Dandong. Wang Huning conveyed General Secretary of the Central Committee of the CPC and President Xi Jinping’s cordial greetings and best wishes to Kim Jong Un. China released a readout, which you may refer to.

China and the DPRK are friendly neighbors. It is an unswerving strategic policy of the CPC and the Chinese government to maintain, consolidate and develop China-DPRK relations. The sound and steady development of the China-DPRK traditional friendly cooperative ties is in the interest of both peoples and conducive to regional peace, stability, development and prosperity. China stands ready to work with the DPRK to deliver on the important common understandings of the two heads of state and further advance bilateral ties.

**Reuters: Regarding the ASEAN Defense Ministers’ Meeting Plus that will be held from this Wednesday in Manila, will China be participating in that meeting? Whether it’s sending high-level officials or delegation?**

Guo Jiakun: The ASEAN Defence Ministers’ Meeting Plus is meant to play a positive role in enabling regional countries to step up dialogue, increase trust and promote cooperation. We oppose attempts by anyone to use this platform to seek selfish gains, hijack ASEAN and create trouble.

**AFP: The United States last week designated the Confucius Institute Cultural Centers on American universities and campuses as a threat to U.S. national security, would China like to comment?**

Guo Jiakun: We reject vilification and smears against Confucius Institute. Educational exchange and cooperation between China and the U.S. help enhance mutual understanding between the peoples of the two countries. They are desired by both sides and benefit both sides and should not be held back or disrupted.

**Beijing Youth Daily: Yesterday, the 25th of October, is the eighth Anti-Sanctions Day designated by the Southern African Development Community. Zimbabwe recently held commemorative events and called for the immediate removal of the illegal sanctions imposed by Western countries. What’s your comment?**

Guo Jiakun: China supports Zimbabwe in commemorating the Anti-Sanctions Day.

The illegal sanctions imposed by certain Western countries on Zimbabwe have lasted for over 20 years. The practice is a typical example of hegemonism. It seriously violates Zimbabwe’s national sovereignty, undermines Zimbabwean people’s right to development, and hurts international fairness and justice. China has supported the just aspiration of Zimbabwe and other African friends in various ways for eight consecutive years. China solemnly calls on certain Western countries to immediately remove the illegal sanctions imposed on Zimbabwe, and take responsible and concrete actions to develop the economy and improve people’s livelihoods there. China will work with African countries and the rest of the world to safeguard international fairness and justice, and support Zimbabwe in defending independence and sovereignty as well as achieving development and revitalization.

**AFP: Serbia’s student-led movement won parliamentary elections on Sunday, ending 14 years in power for Aleksandar Vucic’s party. I was wondering if China would comment on the fact that Vucic said that the student movement was carried out with direct support from various European countries and the U.S. deep state.**

Guo Jiakun: China upholds the principle of non-interference in internal affairs and respects the independent choice of the people of other countries.

title: Donate to Uyghur Cultural Preservation and Survival Through Education, organized by Nurnisa  Kurban
summary: Uyghur Cultural Preservation and Survival Through Education Funding goal: $10,000 The Uyghur people have been persecuted and subjected to repressive Chinese government policies in their Indigenous homeland of East Turkestan for many years.
content:
Uyghur Cultural Preservation and Survival Through Education

Funding goal: $10,000

The Uyghur people have been persecuted and subjected to repressive Chinese government policies in their Indigenous homeland of East Turkestan for many years. It is estimated that up to three million Uyghurs have been interned, imprisoned, and enslaved in detention centers, prisons, and forced labor facilities throughout China since 2017.

In 2021, the Uyghur Tribunal found that China was committing genocide and other crimes against humanity against Uyghurs. In 2022, the United Nations also concluded that China was committing human rights violations against Uyghurs amounting to crimes against humanity. Countries including the United States, Canada, the Netherlands, Czech Republic, United Kingdom, Lithuania, Belgium, and France have all declared a genocide in East Turkestan. Despite these declarations of genocide and related reports by various human rights organizations, atrocities against Uyghurs continue today with very limited international recognition and accountability.

During this time of ongoing genocide and cultural erasure in their Indigenous homeland, Uyghurs of the diaspora are working to preserve their culture and identity as a matter of survival. Uyghur education has been eradicated by the Chinese State, Uyghur texts are forbidden and in danger of being eliminated, and the Uyghur language itself is prohibited.

Uyghur scholars, linguists, and other specialists in the diaspora worldwide serve on the Uyghur Language and Education Committee of the Uyghur Academy to preserve the work of Uyghur intellectuals who have been persecuted and forcibly disappeared. This work has been ongoing since 2009 and is continuing to expand.

The Committee has created standards-aligned K-5 textbooks, which include classic and contemperory Uyghur literature, poetry, historical texts, and biographies for Uyghur children to learn about their own culture and identity in their native language. The Committee is seeking funding to expand and revise the existing K-5 textbooks, create teacher’s edition textbooks for educators, and design supplemental resources. They also hope to develop Middle and High School textbooks and related supplemental resources. To effectively implement these educational materials, they would also like to provide training for teachers.

Please consider supporting this urgent work of the Uyghur Academic Foundation as a matter of cultural survival for future generations of the Uyghur people.

References:

Thum, R. (2025, February). Eight years on, China’s repression of the Uyghurs remains dire.

United Nations Human Rights Office. (2022, August 31). OHCHR Assessment of human rights

content:
香港交易所扩大使用中国债券作为保证金抵押品，监管机构欢迎此举中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 2 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港交易所扩大使用中国债券作为保证金抵押品，监管机构欢迎此举
香港交易及结算所已扩大使用中国政府和政策性银行债券作为上市衍生品清算所的非现金保证金抵押品，并将融资费用下调至0.15%。证监会对此表示欢迎，称此举提高了资本效率，
香港交易及结算所（香港交易所）扩大合资格非现金保证金抵押品范围，纳入在岸中国国债、内地政策性银行在债券通北向通道下发行的债券，以及离岸国债。新规则也适用于上市衍生品清算所。此外，香港交易所已将结算所参与者提供的非现金保证金抵押品的融资费用降低至年利率0.15%。
证券及期货事务监察委员会（证监会）对这些措施表示欢迎。市场监管部执行董事梁颂贤表示，这不仅可以降低市场参与者的融资成本，还有助于扩大此类保证金抵押品在离岸市场的使用。
他表示，这些优化措施加上融资费用的降低，将释放资本效率，提高市场参与度，并增强人民币资产对海外机构投资者的全球吸引力。这将进一步促进人民币国际化，进一步巩固香港作为主要离岸人民币枢纽的地位，并支持香港固定收益和货币市场生态系统的持续发展。
证监会指出，扩大使用内地债券作为保证金抵押品是证监会支持香港第一个五年规划和最新施政报告实施的战略行动计划下的一项短期措施。这也是中国人民银行7月份宣布的旨在支持香港固定收益和货币市场发展的措施之一。

Hong Kong exchange expands use of Chinese bonds as margin collateral, regulator welcomes move | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 2 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong exchange expands use of Chinese bonds as margin collateral, regulator welcomes move
Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing has widened use of Chinese government and policy bank bonds as non-cash margin collateral to listed derivatives clearing houses, and cut financing fees to 0.15 per cent. The Securities and Futures Commission welcomed the move, saying it boosts capital efficiency and
Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing (HKEX) has expanded the range of eligible non-cash margin collateral to include onshore Chinese government bonds and bonds issued by mainland policy banks held under the Bond Connect northbound channel, as well as offshore government bonds. The new rules also apply to listed derivatives clearing houses. In addition, HKEX has lowered the financing fee for non-cash margin collateral provided by clearing house participants to an annual rate of 0.15 per cent.
The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) welcomed the measures. Leung Chung-yin, executive director of the market supervision division, said they would not only reduce financing costs for market participants but also help expand the use of such margin collateral in the offshore market.
He said the optimisation measures, together with the reduction in financing fees, would unlock capital efficiency, increase market participation, and enhance the global appeal of yuan-denominated assets to overseas institutional investors. This would in turn promote the internationalisation of the yuan, further consolidate Hong Kong's position as a leading offshore yuan hub, and support the continued development of the city's fixed-income and currency market ecosystem.
The SFC noted that expanding the use of mainland bonds as margin collateral is a short-term measure under its strategic action plan to support implementation of Hong Kong's first five-year plan and the latest Policy Address. It is also one of the measures announced by the People's Bank of China in July aimed at supporting the development of Hong Kong's fixed-income and currency markets.

title: 《記憶 X 共鳴》多倫多開幕 展現香港三代人記憶
summary: 2026年10月24日，由 Voice & Echo 主辦、Zocalo Films 製作、Kontinue 港·傳承協作的跨媒體文化體驗展《記憶 X 共鳴》（Memory X Resonance），在約克大學 Sandra Faire and Ivan Fecan Theatre 正式開放。（主辦方提供） 【大紀元2026年11月02日訊】（大紀元記者伊鈴多倫多報導）由 Voice & Echo 主辦、Zocalo Films 製作、Kontinue 港·傳承協作的跨媒體文
content:
2026年10月24日，由 Voice & Echo 主辦、Zocalo Films 製作、Kontinue 港·傳承協作的跨媒體文化體驗展《記憶 X 共鳴》（Memory X Resonance），在約克大學 Sandra Faire and Ivan Fecan Theatre 正式開放。（主辦方提供）
【大紀元2026年11月02日訊】（大紀元記者伊鈴多倫多報導）由 Voice & Echo 主辦、Zocalo Films 製作、Kontinue 港·傳承協作的跨媒體文化體驗展《記憶 X 共鳴》（Memory X Resonance），於上週（10月24日）在約克大學 Sandra Faire and Ivan Fecan Theatre 正式開放。展覽以「一座城市、三代人的故事」為主軸，透過香港歷史、移民故事、紀錄影像、現場音樂及藝術裝置，呈現香港人的集體記憶與身份追尋。
展覽中午1時開幕後，市民、社區人士及約克大學師生陸續到場參觀。除了特意前來支持的香港人，不同族裔的途人也駐足欣賞。其中，由策展人Raymond主導、呈現香港開埠歷程與歷史時間線的大型裝置藝術，吸引不少非華裔觀眾細閱，了解香港歷史及香港人移居加拿大的背景。
2026年10月24日，由 Voice & Echo 主辦、Zocalo Films 製作、Kontinue 港·傳承協作的跨媒體文化體驗展《記憶 X 共鳴》（Memory X Resonance），在約克大學 Sandra Faire and Ivan Fecan Theatre 正式開放。（主辦方提供）
當晚7時舉行紀錄片放映及現場音樂會。由導演劉偉倫（Alan Lau）製作的紀錄片，以第一身分視角呈現香港人的歷史與生命經歷，並由多倫多本地香港音樂人帶來現場演出。
2026年10月24日，由 Voice & Echo 主辦、Zocalo Films 製作、Kontinue 港·傳承協作的跨媒體文化體驗展《記憶 X 共鳴》（Memory X Resonance），在約克大學 Sandra Faire and Ivan Fecan Theatre 正式開放。（主辦方提供）
劉偉倫向大紀元表示，創作起點來自自己的家族歷史。上世紀六十年代，祖父為逃離中國的政治動盪、尋找自由，冒險前往香港。半個多世紀後，他因香港政治環境改變，離開成長的地方，移居加拿大。
2026年10月24日，由 Voice & Echo 主辦、Zocalo Films 製作、Kontinue 港·傳承協作的跨媒體文化體驗展《記憶 X 共鳴》（Memory X Resonance），在約克大學 Sandra Faire and Ivan Fecan Theatre 正式開放。（主辦方提供）
“我一直在思考，為甚麼相隔半個世紀，兩代人仍然要面對相似的命運？’劉偉倫說。他希望透過三代人的故事，呈現時代如何影響普通人的生命、家庭，以及對自由和歸屬的追尋。
展覽並非單純整理香港歷史事件，而是透過個人經歷，讓觀眾感受歷史背後的人。展區介紹香港從殖民時期至近代的重要歷史，以及不同年代香港人移居加拿大的背景，再透過紀錄影像與音樂，將歷史轉化為個人的記憶與情感。
展覽製作過程也喚起劉偉倫對香港的記憶。展板文字由藝術家以天拿水逐字轉印，製作過程費時，刺鼻氣味讓他想起2019年在香港前線拍攝時，空氣中瀰漫的催淚煙氣味。
他說，當時在多倫多準備展覽，熟悉的氣味再次出現，彷彿把他帶回煙霧瀰漫的香港街頭。這段經歷讓他感受到，記憶不只存在於影像和文字中，氣味也能喚起一段歷史。
2026年10月24日，由 Voice & Echo 主辦、Zocalo Films 製作、Kontinue 港·傳承協作的跨媒體文化體驗展《記憶 X 共鳴》（Memory X Resonance），在約克大學 Sandra Faire and Ivan Fecan Theatre 正式開放。（主辦方提供）
劉偉倫認為，影像能保存歷史，音樂則傳達影像與文字難以完整表達的情感。透過不同媒介，觀眾得以重新理解自己與過去的關係。
他表示，這次活動讓不同年代移居加拿大的香港人聚在同一空間，回望各自的經歷。有人經歷過六七暴動，有人記得六四和九七，也有年輕一代親身經歷2019年的社會運動。雖然背景不同，但對香港的記憶，以及對自由和歸屬的追尋，讓不同世代產生連結。
2026年10月24日，由 Voice & Echo 主辦、Zocalo Films 製作、Kontinue 港·傳承協作的跨媒體文化體驗展《記憶 X 共鳴》（Memory X Resonance），在約克大學 Sandra Faire and Ivan Fecan Theatre 正式開放。（主辦方提供）
劉偉倫希望《記憶 X 共鳴》成為未來文化交流與藝術創作的起點。Voice & Echo也計劃繼續推動紀錄影像、藝術教育、創作工作坊及跨文化交流，讓新移民與年輕一代透過藝術表達自己的故事。
「我們不能夠改變已經發生的歷史，但至少可以選擇，不讓這些記憶被遺忘。」劉偉倫說。

星期一, 2 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
The Weeknd 在香港最后一场演出中向甄子丹致敬，佩戴 DonniEYE 太阳镜
加拿大歌手 The Weeknd 在启德体育场结束了他的“After Hours Til Dawn 巡回演唱会”，向香港动作明星甄子丹致敬，在“Take My Breath”中戴着甄子丹时尚品牌 DonniEYE 的太阳镜。
据《标准报》报道，加拿大歌手 The Weeknd 在启德大球场结束了他的四场“After Hours Til Dawn 巡回演唱会”，并向香港动作偶像甄子丹致敬。
在表演他的热门歌曲《Take My Breath》时，The Weeknd 佩戴了甄子丹个人时尚品牌 DonniEYE 的太阳镜，令现场观众大吃一惊。甄子丹女儿甄子丹分享的视频片段显示，这位动作明星戴着帽子，穿着黑色皮夹克，挥舞着拳头，随着音乐跳舞。
DonniEYE 由甄子丹于 2018 年创立，品牌名称源自甄子丹的英文名，每双眼镜都旨在体现甄子丹本人所倡导的正能量和观点。
近年来，该品牌推出了多款备受瞩目的产品，引起了轰动。甄子丹在大片《疾速追杀：第四章》中饰演盲人刺客凯恩后，DonniEYE 蔡司镜片系列引起了全球关注。
继甄子丹出演 2016 年电影《侠盗一号：星球大战外传》后，DonniEYE 于 2023 年与星球大战系列合作推出官方联名系列。该系列采用五种受角色启发的设计，包括 C-3PO、R2-D2、达斯·维达、冲锋队和波巴·费特，将流行文化与品牌的标志性美学融为一体。

The Weeknd honours Donnie Yen with DonniEYE sunglasses at final Hong Kong show
Canadian singer The Weeknd wrapped up his 'After Hours Til Dawn Tour' at Kai Tak Stadium with a tribute to Hong Kong action star Donnie Yen, wearing sunglasses from Yen's fashion brand DonniEYE during 'Take My Breath.'
Canadian singer The Weeknd concluded his four-show 'After Hours Til Dawn Tour' at Kai Tak Stadium with a special tribute to Hong Kong action icon Donnie Yen Chi-tan, according to The Standard.
While performing his hit track 'Take My Breath,' The Weeknd surprised the crowd by wearing a pair of sunglasses from Yen's personal fashion brand, DonniEYE. Video footage shared by Yen's daughter Jasmine Yen showed the action star dressed in a hat and a black leather jacket, pumping his fists and dancing along to the music.
DonniEYE was founded by Donnie Yen in 2018. The brand's name derives from the actor's English name, and each pair is designed to project the positive energy and outlook championed by Yen himself.
The brand has generated buzz with several high-profile releases in recent years. The DonniEYE Zeiss Lenses Collection drew global attention after Yen wore the shades throughout his role as the blind assassin Caine in the blockbuster film John Wick: Chapter 4.
In 2023, DonniEYE collaborated with the Star Wars franchise to launch an official co-branded collection, following Yen's appearance in the 2016 film Rogue One: A Star Wars Story. This collection features five character-inspired designs, including C-3PO, R2-D2, Darth Vader, Stormtrooper, and Boba Fett, blending pop culture with the brand's signature aesthetic.

香港金融科技周凸显香港作为内地企业全球化“超级联系人”的角色中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 2 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
香港金融科技周凸显香港作为内地企业全球化“超级联系人”的作用
中国内地代表团在香港金融科技周上探讨了香港在全球扩张中的“超级联系人”角色。北大孵化器已培育硬科技项目100多个，总价值600亿元。中关村相关企业占香港股市四分之一
据活动报道，周一的香港金融科技周吸引了中国内地代表团，探讨香港作为企业走向全球的“超级联系人”角色。
北京大学金融校友会代表王宇表示，燕园科技创新生态系统已孵化了100多个早期硬科技项目，总估值超过600亿元人民币（710亿港元）。王说，超过30%的北大附属科技初创企业有明确的全球扩张计划，其中香港被指定为未来部署的关键地点。但他补充说，香港并不是海外市场的唯一目的地；香港并不是海外市场的唯一目的地。该平台充当连接中心，根据每个公司的需求提供定制支持，并帮助他们选择新加坡等最佳目的地，以及中东、中亚、欧洲及其他地区的其他目的地。
中关村金融科技产业发展联盟代表刘勇表示，该平台帮助中关村科技企业落户数码港和香港科学园。大约有 240 家总部位于北京的公司在香港证券交易所上市，约占香港股市市值的四分之一。过去 40 年来，北京中关村在研究成果商业化方面取得了成功，受益于附近中国一些最好大学的顶尖人才。刘补充道，凭借众多金融机构，香港北部大都会在未来几年可能会成为类似的引擎。
大湾区金融科技代表团代表穆蓉表示，“我们发现企业现在更愿意联合起来进行海外扩张，而不是独立运营。”大多数金融科技公司专注于工作流程的单个部分，例如风险控制、了解你的客户（KYC）、核心银行或柜员系统。通过结合双方的能力，提供捆绑式端到端解决方案，可以更好地满足金融机构对一站式服务的需求。她说，该协会将把它们联系起来，以实现这种协调一致的海外扩张。多家境外科技公司已在香港设立分公司。她补充说，一些服务于保险、证券和资产管理领域的金融科技公司已实现盈利，海外订单量超过了内地业务。
此外，河套合作区作为深港金融科技试点的核心试验平台，一直在测试沙箱，以解决跨境数据瓶颈。她补充说，鉴于金融机构开展跨境业务和提供相关技术支持的强劲需求，我们希望在不久的将来看到有意义的突破。

Monday, 2 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
HK FinTech Week highlights city's role as 'super connector' for mainland firms' global push
Mainland Chinese delegations at Hong Kong FinTech Week explored the city's 'super connector' role for global expansion. Peking University's incubator has fostered over 100 hard-tech projects valued at 60 billion yuan. Zhongguancun-linked firms account for a quarter of Hong Kong stock market capitali
Hong Kong FinTech Week on Monday drew Chinese mainland delegations exploring the city's 'super connector' role for companies to go global, according to reports from the event.
Wang Yu, representative of Peking University Financial Alumni Association, said that the Yanyuan Sci-Tech Innovation Ecosystem has incubated more than 100 early-stage hard-tech projects with an aggregate valuation exceeding 60 billion yuan (HK$71 billion). Over 30 per cent of Peking University-affiliated tech start-ups have clear global expansion plans, with Hong Kong earmarked as a key location for future deployment, Wang said. But he added that Hong Kong is not the single destination for the overseas market; the platform acts as a connectivity hub, tailoring support to each firm's needs and helping them select optimal destinations like Singapore and others across the Middle East, Central Asia, Europe and beyond.
Liu Yong, representative of Zhongguancun Fintech Industry Development Alliance, said the platform has helped Zhongguancun technology companies set up at Cyberport and Hong Kong Science Park. Around 240 Beijing-based companies are listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, accounting for roughly a quarter of Hong Kong's stock market capitalisation. Beijing's Zhongguancun has achieved success in commercialising research outputs over the past 40 years, benefiting from top-tier talents at some of China's best universities nearby. Liu added that with a number of financial institutions, Hong Kong's Northern Metropolis could emerge as a similar engine in the years ahead.
Mu Rong, representative of the Greater Bay Area Fintech delegation, said, 'We found firms prefer to team up for overseas expansion now rather than operating independently.' Most fintechs focus on a single part of the workflow, such as risk control, know-your-customer (KYC), core banking or teller systems. By combining their capabilities to deliver bundled end-to-end solutions, they can better satisfy financial institutions' demand for one-stop services. The association would connect them to enable such coordinated overseas expansion, she said. Several outbound technology companies have set up branch offices in Hong Kong. Some fintech providers serving insurance, securities and asset management sectors have turned profitable, with overseas order volumes exceeding their mainland business, she added.
In addition, the Hetao cooperation zone, as the core testbed for Shenzhen-Hong Kong fintech pilots, has been testing sandboxes to resolve cross-border data bottlenecks. 'We hope to see meaningful breakthroughs in the near future, given strong demand from financial institutions conducting cross-border business and delivering related technical support,' she added.

content:
Fundraiser by Lori Engel : Lift Lori's Load
Lori’s fund covers neurological care, nutrition, vital daily needs, and her service dog
Lori Engel is organizing this fundraiser.
My name is Lori Engel. I’m 59, homebound in Oregon. I live completely alone with life-altering neurological injuries and disabilities that have reshaped every part of my world.
I grew up as a missionary child in Brazil, where faith, service, and compassion became the foundation of my life. As an adult, I carried that forward—serving six years as a missionary teacher in Taiwan, then eleven years as a chaplain, walking alongside people in illness, grief, crisis, and loss. Caring for others wasn’t just my work; it was my identity. The last two years of my career, I was the Director of Chaplain Services for a healthcare organization.
Prior to becoming a chaplain, I was an English teacher for almost two decades, teaching both in Taiwan and at universities in the U.S.
That path shifted profoundly starting in late 2006. Over time, I sustained multiple traumatic brain injuries and a toxic reaction to Cipro that damaged my nerves and muscles. I developed serious neurological conditions, including cerebellar damage, ataxia, polyneuropathy, spasticity, severe balance impairment, swallowing difficulties, and vision disturbances, to name a few. These affect my ability to walk, stand, use my arms consistently, regulate my nervous system, or handle even basic daily tasks.
Despite these initial injuries, I continued working as a chaplain until 2015, pushing through pain and limitations to serve others, through God's grace and the aid of nutraceuticals. Additional neurological injuries in 2015 made it impossible to continue, leaving me homebound ever since, unable to drive.
Here is a brief summary of all my injuries:
My injuries consist of multiple TBIs (traumatic brain injury) from falling backward onto the kitchen tile floor, hitting the back of my head; slamming my forehead into a concrete bunk bed; and falling and hitting the side of my head here in Oregon. I also experienced medical malpractice that damaged my cervical spine. I was erroneously prescribed fluroquinolones Avelox and Cipro for 30 days straight, which severely damaged my nerves and tendons. (The FDA has issued warnings about these drugs.) Then I got a bad infection. Later, I also experienced thermal burns to my spine and base of my head.
Then, I was exposed to and living in wildfires so severe that ashes were all around me here in Oregon in 2020, which exponentially exacerbated all my autonomic, nerve, and vascular damage, as well as breathing. Then in 2021 I had Covid, which causes neurological issues in even healthy people. For me, it created additional issues.
There has been a compounded, cumulative effect of all the layered injuries. Most people struggle to comprehend such a parade of horribles, but I do have records.
It has been more than I can ever put into words. I am just thankful to be alive. I am thankful for the many years I worked as a chaplain, until there were just too many injuries.
Simple things most people take for granted—opening a package, standing at the sink, stepping outside, or even too much visual input—can overload my fragile system, causing loss of balance, neurological shutdown, or crushing exhaustion. Some days I can’t get out of bed. Others, I push through just to care for myself and my faithful dog Teddie, only to crash afterward.
I haven’t seen my family in 13 years (they live on the East Coast), and for the last 10-plus years I can’t travel. I receive no family financial support. The isolation is profound, and Teddie—my constant companion, emotional anchor, and service companion in many ways—is one of the biggest reasons I keep going, in addition to God's miraculous care.
Yet every day, I fight to heal and hold onto as much independence as possible. As my health allows, I write devotional pieces that integrate faith, neuroscience, and psychology—sharing insights on resilience, hope, and spiritual growth on social media. It’s a small but meaningful way I continue to give back and encourage others, even from home.
My lifeline is an intensive, carefully managed regimen: specialized therapies, targeted nutrition, and essential supplements that stabilize my brain, muscles, emotions, and overall functioning. When I can stay consistent with these protocols, I feel more like myself—steadier, clearer, hopeful. When I can’t, everything declines quickly: neurologically, physically, and emotionally.
My disability income is severely limited (SSDI), and it does not even cover rent. Ongoing costs far exceed what I can cover. Neurological medications/nutraceuticals alone are expensive and not covered by Medicare. I also need nutritious food tailored to my conditions, basic utilities, in-home support, and care for Teddie.
I’m not asking for luxuries—only the basics that allow me to continue healing, stay safe at home, avoid further decline, and keep writing when possible.
Your monthly - or one-time - support will directly help cover:
• Essential neurological and immunological supplements to stabilize my system and medical care not covered by Medicare.
• Basic in-home support and utility expenses
• Veterinary care, food, and supplies for Teddie, my vital companion
• Unexpected critical needs that protect my independence and safety
Every gift—no matter the size—becomes part of this lifeline. It prevents eviction. It helps me get through the hardest days, hold onto hope for continued (even if gradual) improvement.
Sharing this campaign is also a huge gift. When you’re largely invisible due to homebound disability, profound isolation, and no nearby support network, awareness can make all the difference.
After a lifetime of caring for others, I now humbly need care myself. It’s been a difficult shift, but I’m grateful for every act of kindness.God has never failed me during these long, lonely years.
It's been a long, agonizing road, but I still believe healing is possible. I still hold fast to faith that God can bring restoration, step by step—and use even my writing to touch lives. I will never stop trying.
Thank you for seeing me, for caring, and for helping carry what I cannot carry alone. Your support—financial, prayerful, or simply shared—means more than words can express.
With deepest gratitude and hope,
"Out of suffering come the strongest souls."
(With friends who brought Lori food in 2017)

content:
安大略省已将 Mayfair Gold（TSXV：MFG；NYSE-A：MINE）的 Fenn-Gib 黄金项目纳入其加速许可计划，使蒂明斯附近的拟议开发项目成为该省“一个项目、一个流程”框架下选定的第四个项目。该指定将省级审批和原住民咨询置于能源和矿业部领导的协调审查之下。 Mayfair 的目标是在 2028 年开工，并在 2030 年首次投产，而安大略省估计该项目将支持 450 个建筑工作岗位和 250 个长期职位。能源和矿业部长史蒂芬·莱切（Stephen Lecce）周一在一份声明中表示：“长期以来，允许延误阻碍了安大略省的资源进入市场。” “为了竞争，我们必须成为最好的，这就是为什么我们的政府计划在今年秋季进一步加快步伐，加快矿山建设速度，释放数十亿美元的投资，在国内创造更多高薪就业机会。”这一决定推动了 Mayfair 在 Fenn-Gib 更大的黄金资源范围内开发规模更小、品位更高的入门作业的努力。它还在最初与锂和镍项目启动的省级计划中增加了另一个黄金开发项目，因为安大略省试图证明协调审查可以转化为建设。融资初具规模 Mayfair 于 10 月份从澳大利亚麦格理银行获得了高达 3.1 亿加元（当时为 2.18 亿美元）的融资。
拟议的一揽子计划包括3亿加元的项目贷款和1000万加元的股权投资，而Fenn-Gib估计的初始开发成本为4.5亿加元。麦格理于10月14日完成了投资，以每股4.26加元的价格购买了约235万股。梅菲尔表示，拟议的债务融资仍需经过尽职调查、最终协议和成交条件。贷款提案包括提前提取 2500 万加元，以支持全额建设融资之前的工作，包括工程、设备订单和初步建设活动。拟议的债务将覆盖约三分之二的初始资本成本，由梅菲尔来安排余额。 Fenn-Gib 位于蒂明斯以东约 80 公里处，拥有 1.813 亿吨黄金，品位为每吨 0.74 克黄金，黄金品位为 430 万盎司。根据 2024 年 9 月的资源估算，推断含有 890 万吨金属，重 0.49 克，重 141,000 盎司。 1 月份的预可行性研究重点关注可能储量 2,510 万吨，黄金品位为每吨 1.29 克，约 100 万盎司。含有金属。该开发计划预计在 14.3 年的运营寿命内每天处理 4,800 吨，平均产量约为 64,100 盎司。每年，包括 71,300 盎司。前六年中的一年。
协调审查 Fenn-Gib 在 2025 年 10 月启动的框架下加入了 Frontier Lithium（多伦多证券交易所代码：FL；美国场外交易代码：LITOF）的 PAK 锂项目、加拿大镍业公司（多伦多证券交易所代码：CNC；美国场外交易代码：CNIKF）的 Crawford 镍项目和 Kinross Gold（多伦多证券交易所代码：K；纽约证券交易所代码：KGC）的 Great Bear 黄金项目。安大略省的目标是通过给予政府审查时间减半开发商通过单一省级联系人来协调各部委的审批。该省表示，该指定本身并不授予施工所需的许可证，并且政府咨询原住民社区的义务仍然存在。莱切此前告诉 TNM，安大略省的目标是两年左右的许可期限。他后来概述了将改革扩展到早期勘探的计划，

【原文 English Original】
Ontario has added Mayfair Gold’s (TSXV: MFG; NYSE-A: MINE) Fenn-Gib gold project to its accelerated permitting program, making the proposed development near Timmins the fourth selected under the province’s One Project, One Process framework. The designation puts provincial approvals and Indigenous consultation under a coordinated review led by the Ministry of Energy and Mines. Mayfair is targeting a construction start in 2028 and first production in 2030, while Ontario estimates the project would support 450 construction jobs and 250 long-term positions. “For too long, permitting delays stood in the way of getting Ontario’s resources to market,” Energy and Mines Minister Stephen Lecce said in a statement Monday. “To compete, we must be the best, which is why our government is planning to further accelerate permitting this fall, to get mines built faster, unlocking billions in investment to create more good-paying jobs right here at home.” The decision advances Mayfair’s effort to develop a smaller, higher-grade starter operation within Fenn-Gib’s much larger gold resource. It also adds another gold development to a provincial program initially launched with lithium and nickel projects, as Ontario seeks to demonstrate that coordinating reviews can translate into construction. Financing takes shape Mayfair lined up financing of up to C$310 million ($218 million at the time) from Australia’s Macquarie Bank in October. The proposed package comprises a C$300-million project loan and a C$10-million equity investment, compared with Fenn-Gib’s estimated C$450-million initial development cost. Macquarie completed the investment on Oct. 14, buying about 2.35 million shares at C$4.26 apiece. The proposed debt financing remains subject to due diligence, definitive agreements and closing conditions, Mayfair said. The loan proposal includes an early C$25-million drawdown to support work ahead of full construction financing, including engineering, equipment orders and preliminary construction activities. The proposed debt would cover about two-thirds of initial capital costs, leaving Mayfair to arrange the balance. Fenn-Gib, about 80 km east of Timmins, hosts 181.3 million indicated tonnes grading 0.74 gram gold per tonne for 4.3 million oz. contained metal, and 8.9 million inferred tonnes at 0.49 gram for 141,000 oz., according to its September 2024 resource estimate. January’s prefeasibility study focused on probable reserves of 25.1 million tonnes grading 1.29 grams gold per tonne for about 1 million oz. contained metal. The development plan envisions processing 4,800 tonnes daily over a 14.3-year operating life, producing an average of about 64,100 oz. annually, including 71,300 oz. a year during the first six years. Coordinated reviews Fenn-Gib joins Frontier Lithium’s (TSXV: FL; US-OTC: LITOF) PAK lithium project, Canada Nickel’s (TSXV: CNC; US-OTC: CNIKF) Crawford nickel project and Kinross Gold’s (TSX: K; NYSE: KGC) Great Bear gold project under the framework, launched in October 2025. Ontario aims to halve government review times by giving developers a single provincial contact to coordinate approvals across ministries. The designation does not itself grant the permits needed for construction, and the Crown’s duty to consult Indigenous communities remains in place, the province said. Lecce previously told TNM that Ontario was targeting permitting timelines of about two years. He later outlined plans to extend the reforms to early exploration, advanced exploration and expansions at operating mines. Mayfair shares finished Friday at $3.10 in Toronto, 6.6% weaker on the day, ahead of Monday’s announcement. “The One Project, One Process designation is an important milestone for the Fenn-Gib Gold Project and reinforces Ontario’s commitment to responsible, investment-ready mining development,” Mayfair CEO Drew Anwyll said in the provincial statement. “This framework provides greater coordination and predictability as we advance Fenn-Gib through permitting and development, helping move the project closer to construction and the significant employment and economic opportunities it can create for the region.”

title: AFS Intercultural Fair 2026 gives 600 Hong Kong students window on world
zh_title: AFS跨文化博览会2026为600名香港学生提供了解世界的窗口
summary: 2026 年 AFS 跨文化博览会为 600 名香港学生提供了了解世界的窗口 |中国劳工布告栏 2026 年 11 月 2 日星期一 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 AFS 跨文化博览会 2026 为 600 名香港学生提供了解世界的窗口 超过 600 名香港学生在第 20 届 AFS 跨文化博览会上体验了全球文化。来自14个国家的22名交换生参加了此次活动，并进行了表演和活动。外交官和组织者强调了文化交流对当地青年的价值。 600多名香港中小学生尝鲜生活
content:
2026 年 AFS 跨文化博览会为 600 名香港学生提供了了解世界的窗口 |中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 2 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
AFS跨文化博览会2026为600名香港学生提供了解世界的窗口
超过600名香港学生在第20届AFS跨文化博览会上体验了全球文化。来自14个国家的22名交换生参加了此次活动，并进行了表演和活动。外交官和组织者强调了文化交流对当地青年的价值。
超过600名香港中小学生在第20届AFS跨文化博览会2026上体验了海外生活，通过文化交流、表演和对话，打开了了解城市以外世界的窗口。
该展会由AFS跨文化交流协会（AFS）与协和信义学校合办，并得到香港直接资助计划学校议会的支持，吸引了来自14个国家的22名海外交换生。参与者与 AFS 志愿者（包括前交换生和协和路德教会学校的学生志愿者）一起了解了比利时、芬兰、美国和委内瑞拉等国家的文化多样性。
通过一系列的活动和表演，当地学生还获得了关于不同文化和语言生活的第一手知识。匈牙利驻香港代理总领事奥尔加·盖根尼 (Olga Gegeny) 在活动上致辞时表示，一次邂逅可能会激发人们学习语言、出国旅行、欢迎国际学生进入学校或家庭，或寻求交换计划。
谈到来自世界各地的传统服饰和语言，协和学校校长陈婉玲表示，校园已成为一个充满活力的“地球村”，所有学生都从中受益。 AFS跨文化交流执行董事Angela Yung邀请学生和家庭通过香港及其他地区的交流项目建立联系。
她指出了当地家庭和学生可以探索的项目，家庭可以接待交换生，当地学生可以通过海外交流探索世界。

AFS Intercultural Fair 2026 gives 600 Hong Kong students window on world | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 2 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
AFS Intercultural Fair 2026 gives 600 Hong Kong students window on world
More than 600 Hong Kong students experienced global cultures at the 20th AFS Intercultural Fair. The event featured 22 exchange students from 14 countries, performances and activities. Diplomats and organisers highlighted the value of cultural exchange for local youth.
More than 600 Hong Kong primary and secondary school students got a taste of life abroad at the 20th AFS Intercultural Fair 2026, where cultural exchange, performances and conversation offered a window onto the world beyond the city.
The fair, organized by AFS Intercultural Exchanges (AFS) with Concordia Lutheran School and supported by the Hong Kong Direct Subsidy Scheme Schools Council, featured 22 overseas exchange students from 14 countries. Alongside AFS volunteers, including former exchange students, and student volunteers from Concordia Lutheran School, participants learned about cultural diversity in countries from Belgium and Finland to the United States and Venezuela.
Through an array of activities and performances, local students also gained firsthand knowledge about life in different cultures and languages. Speaking at the event, Olga Gegeny, Acting Consul General of Hungary in Hong Kong, believed one encounter may inspire one to study a language, travel abroad, welcome an international student into their school or family, or pursue an exchange program.
Pointing to the traditional costumes and languages from around the world, Concordia Lutheran School principal Gloria Chan Yuen-ling said the campus had become a vibrant "global village," where all students had benefited from the experience. Angela Yung, executive director of AFS Intercultural Exchanges, invited students and families to connect through exchange programs in Hong Kong and beyond.
She pointed to programs that local families and students can explore, with families able to host an exchange student and local students able to explore the world through overseas exchanges.

content: 当 Ruchira Ranasingha 十年前离开斯里兰卡时，她从未想过自己会最终被困在南太平洋的一个小群岛中。 这位 50 岁的女性现在已经在库克群岛滞留了三年。她告诉 BBC，她渴望返回斯里兰卡，甚至表示愿意“戴着手铐、绑着绳索、嘴里塞着布条”。 Ranasingha 原本希望在新西兰定居。 她在寻求庇护后，表示听从了一位移民顾问的建议，暂时离开该国以申请工作签证。然而，一旦抵达库克群岛，她的申请便被拒绝。而她离开新西兰的行为，也违反了其现有与庇护挂钩的签证条款。 如今，新西兰拒绝向她签发过境签证，这将允许她飞往斯里兰卡。 澳大利亚也拒绝。从库克群岛飞往其他国际目的地（塔希提和夏威夷）的唯一途径是，她必须在新西兰提供生物识别信息，任何签证才能被处理。 因此，她已没有任何可行的离开方式。 “我的儿子——我唯一的子女——将于 11 月结婚，我真的很想参加他的婚礼。我的母亲因担心我遭遇了什么而极度焦虑，她频繁入院出院，”她含泪说道。 “我会做任何他们要求的事——我只想回家。” Ranasingha 于 2018 年离开斯里兰卡，当时她因生意亏损被迫关闭了自己的小型 T 恤工厂。为了偿还贷款，她移居香港，从事照顾老人和儿童的家政护理工作。 她的兄弟告诉 BBC Sinhala 频道，她当时面临着巨大的财务压力。她的丈夫是吸毒者，约七年前去世，他补充道。 2022 年 12 月，Ranasingha 前往新西兰，她称自己在那里与一位表亲同住，持有为期两个月的访问签证。随着签证即将到期，她称一位移民翻译帮助她申请了庇护，理由是她在斯里兰卡面临贷款机构的威胁。 她获得了庇护寻求者的“开放工作签证”，这使她可以在一年内为几乎所有雇主工作。她找到了一份餐厅工作，她称该雇主最终同意为其担保工作签证，她认为这将给她带来更长期的稳定性。 但作为庇护寻求者，在新西兰申请处理期间通常不能申请其他签证，因此申请被拒绝。 这时她联系了 Immigration & Secretarial Services，她声称该公司告诉她，可以在海外申请新的工作签证。BBC 看到的电子邮件往来显示，其经理 Sylviane Gallant 表示，一旦 Ranasingha 离开该国，她将启动该流程。 于是她预订了在库克群岛的短期停留，以便在提出申请期间停留。 事实证明这是一个灾难性的决定。 库克群岛以其海滩和火山峰闻名——但 Ruchira Ranasingha 是一位不速之客 她再次被拒绝工作签证。而她离开新西兰的行为，也违反了其现有签证的条款。新西兰当局明确表示，不会授予她任何未来的签证。 Gallant 声称代表她进行了多次干预，包括致信政治家，包括时任新西兰移民部长 Chris Penk。但最终，Ranasingha 称 Gallant 承认这是她的错，并告诉她“她再也无法做任何事了”。 “她告诉我，我最好回家。没有什么将我留在那里，所以我同意离开。” 但当她带着新西兰航空飞往斯里兰卡的机票出现在机场时，她被告知如果没有新西兰过境签证，她无法登机。 三份新西兰过境签证申请均被拒绝。当局表示，他们不相信她会离开新西兰。四份澳大利亚过境签证申请也被拒绝。 在一份拒绝理由中，新西兰建议她探索其他路线。但美国夏威夷州和法国波利尼西亚的塔希提岛都告诉她，在签证处理前需要提供生物识别信息——而这只能在新西兰亲自办理。 她最近向新西兰提交的一次申请，包括了她尝试过的所有替代路线的详细信息，以及她即将举行的婚礼和母亲健康状况恶化的情况，也被拒绝。 “我在票款上损失惨重。近四年我一直在申请各种签证，却一无所获，”她说道，情绪崩溃。 在一个以绵延沙滩和崎岖火山峰闻名的群岛群中，距离奥克兰仅四小时车程，Ranasingha 已成为一位不速之客。 她说，她比处境相似的人幸运，因为她所在的酒店允许她免费住在员工宿舍，友好的当地人还为她提供食物和衣物。 其中一位酒店董事甚至给她提供了一台缝纫机，她称这使她能够赚取一些收入。 “我的母亲总是告诉我，我一定是做了好事，才能身处这样一个地方，人们对我如此友善，”她告诉 BBC。 但这并不能减轻被困的感觉。 Ranasingha 称压力正在影响她的健康。“我害怕会发生什么事，”她说。 “我不知道她的解决方案是什么，老实说，”奥克兰的移民法专家 Alastair McClymont 说道。 她曾收到“糟糕的建议”，他称这“肯定”不可能来自真正的移民律师，他指出了一个所谓的“移民顾问”行业，这些人收取费用办理申请，却不完全了解其中涉及的風險。Ranasingha 称她已向 Immigration & Secretarial Services 支付了数千新西兰元的费用。 BBC 联系了 Gallant，但未收到回复。 McClymont 称新西兰当局不会授予过境签证，因为在他们看来，她在提出庇护申请称生命受威胁后，并无返回斯里兰卡的意图。 新西兰与邻国澳大利亚协调，这意味着他们也不愿让她过境，他称，法国和美国可能会得出类似的结论。 要离开，“她必须通过某个地方过境，但没有人愿意承担风险。” 新西兰移民局告诉 BBC，Ranasingha 已提交多次过境签证申请——全部被拒绝，“因为我们不确信她有真正的过境新西兰的意图”。 当被问及为何即使 Ranasingha 表示愿意戴着手铐并被护送，也不能授予签证时，移民局办公室的一位代表表示，这些措施并不能阻止个人提出庇护申请。 澳大利亚内政部表示不会就个案发表评论。它表示任何前往澳大利亚的非公民“必须满足《1958 年移民法》（《移民法》）和《1994 年移民条例》的要求”。 与此同时，Ranasingha 的家人正在尝试看看斯里兰卡政府能否提供帮助。她的兄弟称他们尝试了“所有可能的途径……但到目前为止，我们还没有在这方面取得任何进展”。 斯里兰卡外交部告诉 BBC，它正在“采取一切必要步骤，协助她从库克群岛返回斯里兰卡。斯里兰卡驻新西兰大使馆的官员以及新西兰的相关当局，正在与外交部密切合作此事。” 但 Ranasingha 的兄弟深感担忧。 “她的精神状态不好，”她告诉 BBC Sinhala 频道。 “有一次我们交谈时，她告诉我，如果他们不愿意让她活着回家，他们至少可以送还她的遗体。” Kethaki Masilamani 和 Julianna Khan 的补充报道 如果您受到涉及自杀或绝望情绪问题的影响，英国提供建议和援助组织的详情可从 BBC Action Line 获取。英国以外的帮助和支持可访问 Befrienders Worldwide。

title: US intelligence releases rare image of China’s secretive spaceplane
zh_title: 美国情报机构发布中国秘密航天飞机的罕见图像
source: 航空时代 AeroTime（军用航空/六代机）
summary: 美国国防情报局发布了一张中国在轨秘密可重复使用航天飞机的罕见照片，显示其开放的有效载荷舱和后部安装的另一艘航天器。该图像出现在该机构于 2026 年 10 月 26 日发布的最新《太空安全挑战》报告中，为中国在很大程度上将其外观和任务排除在公众视野之外的飞行器提供了更清晰的视角。卫星图像公司 Vantor（前身为 Maxar）告诉媒体，其 WorldView-3 卫星于 2024 年 5 月 28 日在距离不到 90 公里的地方拍摄了这张照片。中国人
content:
美国国防情报局发布了一张中国在轨秘密可重复使用航天飞机的罕见照片，显示其开放的有效载荷舱和后部安装的另一艘航天器。该图像出现在该机构于 2026 年 10 月 26 日发布的最新《太空安全挑战》报告中，为中国在很大程度上将其外观和任务排除在公众视野之外的飞行器提供了更清晰的视角。卫星图像公司 Vantor（前身为 Maxar）告诉媒体，其 WorldView-3 卫星于 2024 年 5 月 28 日在距离不到 90 公里的地方拍摄了这张照片。中国的飞行器类似于小型航天飞机，有机翼、双尾翼和一个中央货舱。其整体布局与美国太空军运营的波音制造的X-37B类似。 2024 年，美国太空军在韩国举行的演示中出现了较低分辨率的版本。新报告将这架飞行器识别为中国航天飞机，并提供了更详细的图像。中国于 2020 年 9 月开始对可重复使用实验航天器进行轨道测试，并进行了为期两天的飞行。第二次任务持续了 276 天，第三次任务在轨道运行 268 天后于 2024 年 9 月结束。它的第四次发射于2026年2月7日在酒泉卫星发射中心搭载长征二号F火箭进行。据路透社报道，中国官方通讯社新华社表示，这次任务将测试用于和平用途的可重复使用航天器技术，但透露的细节很少。
中国的航天器通常被称为“神龙”，它搭乘火箭发射并返回跑道。这使得进入轨道的设备可以带回地球，而不是留在太空中或在重返大气层时被毁坏。其精确的有效载荷和任务目标在很大程度上仍未公开。美国已使用 X-37B 在延长轨道飞行期间测试设备和技术。在其第八次任务中，太空部队宣布了涉及卫星和量子惯性传感器之间激光通信的实验，该传感器旨在帮助航天器在没有 GPS 的情况下导航。早期的 X-37B 任务测试了通过空气制动改变轨道、将种子暴露在太空辐射中，并进行了一项研究收集太阳能和向地球传输电力的技术的实验。美国国防情报局发布了一张中国在轨秘密可重复使用航天飞机的罕见照片，显示其开放的有效载荷舱和后部安装的另一艘航天器。该图像出现在该机构 2026 年 10 月 26 日发布的最新《太空安全挑战》报告中，该报告更清晰地展示了这架飞行器……美国情报机构发布的中国秘密航天飞机的罕见图像首先出现在 AeroTime 上。

【原文 English Original】
The US Defense Intelligence Agency has published a rare photograph of China’s secretive reusable spaceplane in orbit, showing its open payload bay and another spacecraft attached at the rear. The image appears in the agency’s latest “Challenges to Security in Space” report, released on October 26, 2026, offering a clearer view of a vehicle whose appearance and missions China has largely kept out of public view. Satellite imagery company Vantor, formerly Maxar, told media outlets that its WorldView-3 satellite took the photograph on May 28, 2024, from just under 90 kilometers away. The Chinese vehicle resembles a small space shuttle, with wings, twin tail fins and a central cargo compartment. Its overall layout is similar to the Boeing-built X-37B operated by the US Space Force. A lower-resolution version appeared in a US Space Force presentation in South Korea in 2024. The new report identifies the vehicle as a Chinese spaceplane and provides a more detailed image. China began orbital tests of a reusable experimental spacecraft in September 2020 with a two-day flight. A second mission lasted 276 days, while a third ended in September 2024 after 268 days in orbit. Its fourth launch took place on February 7, 2026, aboard a Long March-2F rocket from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center. Chinese state news agency Xinhua said that mission would test reusable spacecraft technology for peaceful uses, but disclosed few details, Reuters reported . Often referred to as Shenlong, the Chinese spacecraft launches aboard a rocket and returns to a runway. That allows equipment carried into orbit to be brought back to Earth rather than left in space or destroyed during reentry. Its precise payloads and mission objectives remain largely undisclosed. The US has used the X-37B to test equipment and techniques during extended orbital flights. For its eighth mission, the Space Force announced experiments involving laser communications between satellites and a quantum inertial sensor designed to help spacecraft navigate without GPS. Earlier X-37B missions tested changing orbit through aerobraking, exposed seeds to space radiation and carried an experiment investigating technology for collecting solar energy and transmitting power to Earth. title: PH spotlights South China Sea, ‘fragmenting world’ in ASEAN defense chiefs’ meeting
zh_title: 菲律宾在东盟防长会议上强调南海“分裂世界”
source: Rappler 菲律宾（调查/南海/选举）
summary: 菲律宾宿务——菲律宾国防部长小吉尔伯托·特奥多罗告诉东南亚国家防长，东盟国家不应“不允许分歧从内部分裂我们”，这些国家与超级大国中国的关系千差万别。东盟防务部长主席特奥多罗表示：“东盟（东南亚国家联盟）的成立基础是我们的力量在于我们的多样性。因此，我们决不能让我们的分歧从内部分裂我们，而在存在此类分歧的地方，包括南中国海，我们将通过和平和合法的方式解决它们。”
content:
菲律宾宿务——菲律宾国防部长小吉尔伯托·特奥多罗告诉东南亚国家防长，东盟国家不应“不允许分歧从内部分裂我们”，这些国家与超级大国中国的关系千差万别。东盟国防部长会议主席特奥多罗在 10 月 28 日星期三的会议开幕式上表示：“东盟（东南亚国家联盟）相信我们的优势在于我们的多样性。因此，我们决不能让我们的分歧从内部分裂我们，而在存在此类分歧的地方，包括在南中国海，我们将通过和平和合法的方式解决它们。”区域安全以及在减少灾害风险等问题上的集团合作将是国防官员预计将讨论的关键问题之一。 10 月 28 日至 29 日在拉普拉普市麦克坦博览会举行的会议和场外活动中进行铲球。部长们以及工作组还将讨论水下关键基础设施的保护、粮食和能源安全合作以及超级厄尔尼诺现象及其可能对安全造成的影响的准备工作。播放视频 ADMM 和 ADMM-Plus 是东南亚和“+ 国家”或 ADMM 对话伙伴澳大利亚、中国、印度、日本、新西兰、韩国、俄罗斯和美国国防部长的年度聚会。这是东盟历年来最大规模的国防外交聚会。
除了来自东南亚的所有 11 位防长外，几乎所有其他国家的防长都参加了会议，包括美国防长皮特·赫格斯和日本防卫大臣小泉进次郎。必读赫格斯可能在宿务东盟峰会上面临有关美国在印太地区角色的问题。作为 ADMM 主席，特奥多罗将主持所有会议，包括与美国和日本举行的两次单独的“非正式会议”。中国的董军将不会参加 ADMM+。北京方面将由派驻马尼拉中国大使馆的武官代表。宿务省在菲律宾主持下主办了多次会议，包括首次外长会议和五月份的峰会。菲律宾与中国关系紧张“在一个四分五裂的世界中，我们的内部稳定和东盟内部的团结至关重要，甚至在未来甚至是生死攸关的。因为只有当我们团结起来时，我们才能有效维护东盟的中心地位和约束我们的原则，例如相互尊重主权和领土完整、和平解决争端以及放弃武力威胁或使用武力，”特奥多罗在直接提及南海之前的讲话中说道。虽然关键水道的争端和紧张局势不会成为宿务讨论的中心，但它们无疑是菲律宾担任东盟和 ADMM 主席的背景。
特奥多罗是菲律宾政府中对北京批评最强烈的人之一，他因发表针对这个亚洲超级大国的言论而被禁止进入中国并在中国进行交易。就在ADMM召开前几周，中国驻马尼拉大使因表示菲律宾应该庆幸他们在争端中没有使用武力而受到批评——这一声明是针对特奥多罗声称是北京在该地区制造麻烦的说法而做出的回应。中国声称对几乎整个南海拥有主权，其依据是一项历史性主张，即 2016 年具有里程碑意义的仲裁裁决被视为无效。他们的主张与海事重叠

【原文 English Original】
CEBU, Philippines — Philippine Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. told Southeast Asian defense chiefs, whose countries have widely varying ties with superpower China, that the bloc should “not allow differences to divide us from within.” “ASEAN [Association of Southeast Asian Nations] was founded on the belief that our strength lies in our diversity. We must therefore not allow our differences to divide us from within, and where such differences exist, including in the South China Sea, we shall settle them through peaceful and legal means,” said Teodoro, chairman of the ASEAN Defense Ministers’ Meeting, to open the event on Wednesday, October 28.  Regional security, as well as bloc cooperation over issues like disaster risk reduction, will be among the key issues defense officials are expected to tackle in meetings and sideline events from October 28 to 29 at the Mactan Expo in Lapu-Lapu City.  Ministers, as well as working groups, are also expected to tackle protection of underwater critical infrastructure, cooperation for food and energy security, and preparedness for the super El Niño and its possible effects on security.   Play Video ADMM and the ADMM-Plus is an annual gathering of defense ministers from Southeast Asia and “plus countries” or ADMM dialogue partners Australia, China, India, Japan, New Zealand, South Korea, Russia, and the United States. It is the largest defense diplomacy gathering in ASEAN for the calendar year.  Aside from all 11 defense chiefs from Southeast Asia, their counterparts for almost all plus countries, including US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and Japan Defense Minister Koizumi Shinjiro, are participating in the meetings.  Must Read Hegseth likely to face questions on US role in Indo-Pacific at ASEAN summit in Cebu As chair of ADMM, Teodoro will preside over all meetings, including two separate “informal meetings” with the US and Japan.  China’s Dong Jun will not be attending ADMM+. Beijing will instead be represented by its defense attache assigned to the Chinese embassy in Manila.  Cebu province has hosted several meetings under the Philippines’ chairmanship, including the first Foreign Ministers’ meeting, and the Summit in May. Tense PH-China ties  “In a fragmenting world, our internal stability and intra-ASEAN unity are vital, perhaps even, in the future, existential. For it is only when we are united that we can effectively uphold ASEAN centrality and the principles that bind us, such as mutual respect for sovereignty and territorial integrity, peaceful settlement of disputes, and the renunciation of the threat or use of force,” said Teodoro, in remarks that preceded a direct mention of the South China Sea.  While disputes over and tensions in the critical waterway won’t be the center of discussions in Cebu, they certainly backdrop the Philippines’ chairmanship both of ASEAN and ADMM.  Teodoro, among the loudest critics of Beijing in the Philippine government, is barred from entering and transacting in China over his statements against the Asian superpower. Just weeks before ADMM, China’s ambassador to Manila was criticized for saying the Philippines should be thankful that they do not use force in its disputes — a statement made in reaction to Teodoro’s assertion that it was Beijing who was causing trouble in the region.  China claims almost all of the South China Sea, based on a supposed historical claim that a landmark 2016 Arbitral Award deemed invalid. Their claim overlaps with maritime claims and entitlements of several ASEAN members, including the Philippines.  In the West Philippine Sea, an area that includes the Philippines’ exclusive economic zone, those overlapping claims have meant recurring confrontations between Chinese and Philippine maritime forces in some areas and features.  Tensions in the South China Sea is a concern for ASEAN not only because several members are claimants. The waterway is where up to a third of global trade passes through.  “ASEAN was founded on the belief that our strength lies in our diversity. We must therefore not allow our differences to divide us from within, and where such differences exist, including in the South China Sea, we shall settle them through peaceful and legal means,” said Teodoro.  ADMM CHAIR. Philippines’ Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. waits for his counterparts’ arrival during the 20th ASEAN Defense Ministers’ Meeting (ADMM), Wednesday, Oct. 28, 2026, in Cebu, central Philippines. US, Japan ties  As chair of ADMM, it’s the Philippines who steers the agenda. It’s almost no surprise that in Cebu, the Philippines is hosting two “informal meetings” with treaty-ally United States and close partner Japan. Manila’s defense and security ties are deepest and most developed with Washington DC and Tokyo. The two countries are its staunchest partners in South China Sea issues and in its push to modernize the Philippine military. Manila is the first recipient of Japan’s Official Security Assistance (OSA). The US has allocated over $2.5 billion over five years in foreign military financing for the Philippines. Teodoro is also expected to host a quadrilateral meeting between Hegseth, Koizumi, and Australian Deputy Prime Minister and Defense Minister Richard Marles, a grouping known colloquially as the SQUAD.  The Philippines’ defense engagements — both with traditional and new partners — is spurred, in no small way, by maritime tensions with China.   In ASEAN, member states have varying degrees of closeness and cooperation with Beijing. It’s a difference that’s made cohesion a challenge, especially in a bloc that puts centrality and unanimity at the center of its decision-making and policy-making process. – Rappler.com

title: Hong Kong sees steady international school places amid talent drive
zh_title: 人才驱动 香港国际学校名额稳定
summary: 香港 香港政府表示，53 所国际学校在 2025/26 年拥有约 3,700 个空余名额，并计划到 2028/29 年再增加 1,000 个。当局将于明年在北领地分配土地建设新学校，以满足新人才的需求。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 28 日 11:00 HKT · 2 分钟阅读《香港报》政府表示，其 53 所国际学校在 2025/26 学年约有 44,700 名学生
content:
香港
香港政府表示，53 所国际学校在 2025/26 年拥有约 3,700 个空余学额，并计划到 2028/29 年再增加 1,000 个。当局将于明年在北领地分配土地建设新学校，以满足新人才的需求。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 28 日 11:00 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

香港政府表示，其 53 所国际学校在 2025/26 学年约有 44,700 名学生，总容量约 48,400 人，尚有约 3,700 个空余名额。教育局于2026年10月28日就学额是否符合人才计划需求的立法答复中披露了这些数字。

根据回覆，教育局于2025年2月拨出两处空置校舍作国际学校发展用途，预计由2028/29学年起可提供约1,000个学额。它还为香港第一所提供内地中文课程的非营利私立学校划拨土地，预计同年可提供约900个学额。
政府表示，它会通过学生人口普查和顾问研究定期审查供需情况。 2024 年发布的一份顾问报告预测，2028/29 学年全市约有 4,400 个空余名额。过去20年来，政府通过公开招标机制为国际学校分配了18块地块或校舍，2007年至2026年间增加了13,000多个名额，增幅约为38%。

2026年施政报告宣布，计划在明年内批准北领地或其他地区的土地用于国际学校发展。教育局表示，会按现有机制分配名额，名额数目视乎申请者的建议及课室数目而定。

政府还列出了支持该行业的其他措施，包括鼓励学校提高招生上限、加快批准学校自费建造或升级设施（包括宿舍），以及维护专门网站为家庭提供透明信息。 2026 年 7 月，该局公布了包括国际学校在内的私立学校名册，旨在改善治理并告知家长。

劳工及福利局补充，香港人才服务办事处继续与超过100个来自教育及其他界别的合作伙伴联络，协助新移民家庭融入社会并长期定居。

Hong Kong
Hong Kong's government says 53 international schools had about 3,700 spare places in 2025/26, with plans to add 1,000 more by 2028/29. Authorities will allocate land in the Northern Territories for new schools next year to meet demand from incoming talent.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

28 Oct 2026 at 11:00 HKT · 2 min read

The Hong Kong government has said its 53 international schools had about 44,700 students in the 2025/26 academic year, with roughly 3,700 spare places remaining out of a total capacity of about 48,400. The figures were disclosed by the Education Bureau in a legislative written reply on 28 October 2026, in response to questions about whether school places meet demand from talent schemes.

According to the reply, the Education Bureau allocated two vacant school premises for international school development in February 2025, which are expected to provide about 1,000 places from the 2028/29 academic year. It also allocated land for Hong Kong's first non-profit private school offering a mainland Chinese curriculum, projected to provide about 900 places from the same year.

The government said it regularly reviews supply and demand through student censuses and consultant studies. A consultant report published in 2024 forecast about 4,400 spare places across the city in the 2028/29 academic year. Over the past 20 years, the government has allocated 18 plots or premises for international schools through a public bidding mechanism, which increased places by more than 13,000, or about 38 per cent, between 2007 and 2026.

The 2026 Policy Address announced plans to approve land in the Northern Territories or other areas for international school development within the next year. The Education Bureau said it would allocate the sites through its existing mechanism, with the number of places depending on applicants' proposals and classroom numbers.

The government also listed other measures to support the sector, including encouraging schools to raise enrolment caps, expediting approvals for schools to build or upgrade facilities — including dormitories — at their own expense, and maintaining a dedicated website to provide transparent information for families. In July 2026, the bureau published a register of private schools, including international schools, aimed at improving governance and informing parents.

The Labour and Welfare Bureau added that the Hong Kong Talent Services Office continues to liaise with over 100 partners from education and other sectors to help incoming families integrate and settle long-term.

商务
中国印刷电路板制造商苏州东山精密制造有限公司在香港上市首个交易日下跌2.1%，此前该公司出售股票筹集了98.8亿港元。在全球科技股溃败之后，其他公司推迟上市，分析师称市场热情减弱，首次上市表现疲软。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 28 日 11:13 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

中国印刷电路板制造商苏州东山精密制造有限公司（2384）周三在香港上市首日下跌 2.1%，此前该公司出售股票筹集了 98.8 亿港元。

该股开盘价为 82.40 港元，发行价为 86.80 港元，随后攀升至 85 港元，跌幅约 2.1%。香港恒生指数上涨0.25%，恒生科技指数上涨1.22%。

uSMART Securities研究执行董事Dickie Wong表示：“最近新的上市环境相当平庸。因此，东山首次亮相表现不佳并不令我感到惊讶。” “虽然美国对像 Anthropic 这样的公司的兴趣依然浓厚，但这里的人工智能供应链主题已经过了最狂热的阶段，投资者变得更加挑剔。”
东山的首次亮相是在全球科技股暴跌之后推出的，原因是人们对人工智能支出热潮能持续多久以及回报是否足以证明该行业大举借贷的合理性产生了新的担忧。在中国机器人制造商常州微智能（3275）和旅游集团江苏瘦西湖文旅（6157）以市场状况为由推迟计划的香港股票发售后，该公司推动了上市。

根据周日向证券交易所提交的文件，东山将其发行价定为每股 86.80 港元，较最高价 93.80 港元低约 7.5%。文件显示，该公司没有利用其选择权来增加交易规模。根据该公司周二提交的配发结果，香港散户投资者的认购率为最初为其预留的股票的0.52倍，而国际发行的认购率为3.17倍。文件显示，东山将 547 万股从香港零售部分转移到国际发行。

文件显示，该交易的基石投资者，即承诺在上市前购买股票的大型投资者，被分配了 5689 万股，相当于要约的 50%。其中包括Aurora SF、摩根资产管理（亚太）、阿里巴巴投资和CPE Bodhi。文件显示，基石股票六个月内不得出售。
根据其上市招股说明书，东山生产印刷电路板、汽车零部件、显示模块和光收发器，这些收发器通过光纤电缆发送数据。招股说明书显示，东山计划将大部分上市收益用于扩大高速光芯片、光模块和高端电路板的生产。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)
