Why the Country’s Food Insecurity Could Prevent a War Over Taiwan
Article link: https://www.foreignaffairs.com/china/limits-chinas-self-sufficiencyhttps://www.foreignaffairs.com/china/limits-chinas-self-sufficiency
This is a subscriber-only feature. Subscribe now or Sign in.
Chicago Cite not available at the moment
Request reprint permissions here.
When assessing the probability of a conflict in the Taiwan Strait, analysts tend to focus on a few obvious risks that China would face—namely, military defeat, economic slowdown, and restricted oil and technology imports. All of these are important, but an equally significant vulnerability is often left off the list: China’s reliance on soybean imports.
Beijing recognizes this liability. At the 20th Party Congress, in 2022, Chinese leader Xi Jinping identified “ensuring the security of food, energy resources, and critical industrial supply chains” as issues essential to national security and social stability. Food security, conspicuously listed first, is an especially sensitive issue for China’s 1.4 billion inhabitants: roughly 15 percent of the country’s population today was alive during the 1959–61 famine, which resulted in an estimated 30 million deaths.
As with technology and oil, Beijing has tried to limit its dependence on soybeans by building up stockpiles and diversifying its sources. But because soybeans are a fragile foodstuff, there is only so much China can do. Beijing can support a war effort, therefore, for only as long as the Chinese public could put the People’s Liberation Army’s success above its nutritional needs. And the key for deterring Chinese leaders from starting a conflict is to convince them that a domestic crisis would arrive sooner than any battlefield victory.
Disruption to critical imports is one of the most powerful deterrents to China’s use of force, and it’s a threat that the Chinese government has spent decades working to counter. The specter of a foreign blockade in the Strait of Malacca, through which most of Chinese oil imports pass, has worried Chinese leaders since at least 2003, when Chinese leader Hu Jintao warned about the risk of major powers’ interference creating a “Malacca dilemma” for China’s energy security. Beijing, however, has stockpiled massive reserves of oil, which it could complement in a crisis by increasing imports of Russian oil and, as Moscow has done, building up a sanctions-evading shadow fleet to transport oil from the Middle East.
Access to foreign technology is a newer but just as important concern, and China is similarly stockpiling critical components, such as chips. It is also having success in developing local alternatives. Beijing has already pulled ahead in some sectors, such as solar and battery manufacturing, or it is working to close the gap in others, as in semiconductors.
But Beijing has fewer options when it comes to self-sufficiency in food. Domestic production of staple grains—such as wheat, rice, and corn—accounts for more than 90 percent of consumption in these categories, but China remains dependent on foreign producers for other important foodstuffs, including soybeans, beef, and barley. Between 2000 and 2020, the share of China’s food supply provided by imports grew from six percent to 34 percent, and analysts predict it to increase to 41 percent by 2030. Part of this growth comes from the country’s economic development; as people become wealthier, their diets diversify, and they are no longer satisfied eating only grains. Between 1962 and 2024, meat as a percentage of the typical Chinese diet increased by a factor of 18.
This is where the central role of soybeans comes in. The legume provides a complex array of proteins in animal feed that other food sources and synthetic amino acids cannot replicate. Without it, livestock herds in China would shrink, thereby threatening domestic meat and dairy supplies. Soybean oil is also the most used cooking oil in China, making up nearly half the market. Alternatives, such as palm and rapeseed oils, are also mostly imported and face the same risks of maritime disruption, offering little relief.
Chinese soybean stockpiles might be able to last only a few months.
China has invested a great deal in securing and, when possible, diversifying its access to foreign food sources. In 2013, a Chinese company bought Smithfield Foods, the United States’ largest pork producer. And state-owned enterprises such as COFCO International, a branch of China’s largest food and agriculture company, are buying farms and building logistical infrastructure in major agriculture-producing countries, such as Argentina and Brazil, which allows them to buy directly from farmers. Such direct investments provide a buffer against price volatility, giving Beijing more control over the volume and cost of supplies at their source. China has also steadily increased its own domestic meat production, which accounts for more than 90 percent of China’s demand. But such efforts do little to mitigate the effects of disruptions in maritime shipping—especially of soybeans, which is a supply chain that is fragile even in peacetime.
The central rub is that China has no choice but to import its soybeans. There is not enough arable land in China to both expand soybean cultivation and sustain self-reliance in staple grains. (Soybeans are also a much less efficient crop than corn or wheat in China’s arid north, making this tradeoff the economical choice.) But the countries that grow and export soybeans are almost all in the Western Hemisphere, which presents even more logistical challenges. When the trade war between the United States and China broke out in 2018, for instance, Beijing limited its U.S. soybean imports from 40 percent to about 20 percent of its supply, making up the difference with increased imports from Brazil. But Brazil’s poor infrastructure and frequent natural disasters make its harvest more susceptible to failure than the U.S. harvest. In 2024, one Brazilian state lost a quarter to a third of its soybean harvest because of flooding.
U.S. and Brazilian ports are also about as far from China as they could be. Brazil’s Santos port, for example, is more than 10,000 miles from Guangzhou, which takes 45 days to ship. Because of soybeans’ sensitivity to humidity, this distance means that ships often arrive in China with rotten cargo. For similar reasons, the legume is also difficult to stockpile. Unlike rice and wheat reserves, which Beijing claims could last for years, soybean reserves are smaller and must be replaced more frequently. Chinese stockpiles might be able to last only a few months if its imports were cut off. Although China has been experimenting with bioengineered supplements in an effort to reduce the amount of soybeans in animal feed, rising food demand is offsetting any gains. In other words, its dependence on soybean imports is only continuing to grow.
The outbreak of war between China and the United States would pose existential threats to this supply chain. In the most extreme scenario, the U.S. military could block shipments from the Western Hemisphere to China, which would take away most of the country’s soybean imports. China has no naval bases or forward forces in Latin America that could counter these efforts.
But China’s food supply chains would suffer from disruption even without a U.S. embargo or blockade. Any war in the Pacific would bring with it massive risk premiums for maritime shipment insurance that might cause shipping firms to balk. Such an effect has already been on display for shipping in the Red Sea, where Houthi missile threats have caused insurance costs to skyrocket since 2024. A war in the Pacific could be far more intense and costly because it would involve major navies, and ships could not route around the danger zone, making the long-haul journey from Brazil financially ruinous for many companies.
Beijing could, in theory, offer sovereign guarantees to offset firms’ insurance premiums. Even then, the firms transporting soybeans, most of which are owned by U.S. and allied country parties, might cease transporting products to China to avoid abetting a hostile regime, to steer clear of dangers that would put their employees at risk, and to head off possible future exposure to sanctions for doing business with the country.
The fragilities of China’s food system are endemic.
Chinese analysts believe that China could circumvent some of these risks by using its own commercial fleet. Although this fleet has impressive capacity during peacetime—the Chinese shipping giant COSCO owns 468 dry bulk carriers—in wartime it would be stretched thin, facing demands to help move construction materials, industrial supplies, and foodstuffs for the People’s Liberation Army and to transport critical military materials such as coal and iron ore. Even available ships would likely lack personnel with the training needed to keep soybeans fresh during the long journey. And if ships tried to avoid the most dangerous sea-lanes, trips could take even longer, surpassing the 40 days that soybeans can be safely stored. Cargo might arrive rotten, if it arrived at all.
A war in the Pacific would not trigger an immediate food crisis in China. In the shorter term, the government could manage reduced imports by releasing supplies of soybeans, frozen pork, and other staples from state reserves. It could also reduce the minimum soybean inclusion rates for animal feed, which would slow livestock growth and cut meat output but which would be workable for a time. A few months of a managed crunch, however, is a best-case scenario. More likely is that panic buying and shipping disruptions would drain reserves faster than planned, turning a manageable shortfall into rising prices and visible shortages within months.
There is reason to believe, for instance, that Chinese stockpiles might not provide the short-term security they purport to. Over the last decade, local government warehouses meant to store emergency food supplies have been found empty or filled with rotten supplies, largely because of corruption. This not only calls into question how much extra food China truly has but also undermines public confidence in the government. In the case of a conflict, citizens conscious of the long-term disruption to come would begin panic buying and hoarding supplies. Whatever reserves do exist would eventually run out, with members of the elite likely being prioritized.
If the conflict dragged on, the situation would become increasingly dire. Agricultural producers, especially small farms, would be forced to cull their herds. Poultry, which requires especially high soybean content in its feed, would be the first casualty, which would then threaten the egg supply. Pork would be next. Cooking oils would grow scarce and expensive, making it difficult for restaurants and households to function. Eventually, public patience would wear thin: hoarding, protests over prices and shortages, and local officials diverting supplies could put mounting pressure on Beijing to end the war.
Unlike China’s vulnerabilities in energy or technology, the fragilities of the food system are endemic. If a conflict were to break out in the Pacific, the United States would not need to institute a blockade against China’s agricultural supplies or gather an international coalition to sanction China’s soybean imports. Soaring insurance costs and ship owners’ reluctance to sail into a war zone would be enough to squeeze the flow, and the Chinese government would have little recourse to stop it.
If Chinese leaders believed that they could achieve victory quickly and with few shots fired, they might take the bet. Deterrence, then, will require convincing them that they cannot. The United States, Taiwan, and other governments should invest in drones, rebuild munitions stockpiles, and ramp up messaging to China that a long, drawn-out conflict is likely. As long as China’s leaders believe that a war would be indecisive in its early stages, the threat of domestic crisis would be a powerful reason not to start one.

content:
Fundraiser by Hillary Johnson : Hong Kong Photojournalism Trip
Hillary Johnson is organizing this fundraiser.
Hi everyone, my name is Hillary Johnson, and I’m a photographer living in Chicago, working all over the Midwest and in Hong Kong. I have two main threads to my photography practice, photojournalism and fine art.
Though it feels awkward, I confess, I’m pushing ahead because I need your help.
I’m going to Hong Kong on November 12 to cover the protest and the election of a new cabinet in Hong Kong.
You might wonder why bother giving money to me or why my voice particular needs to be added to this news event, or even why this matters to you at all. I hear that and I’ll do my best to answer your questions. I’ll also explain what you can do if you’re interested in helping out.
A little bit about me: in addition to being a photographer I’m also someone who studies a martial art called Ving Tsun. This art is extremely popular in Hong Kong for various reasons that I won’t go into right now but if you’re curious you can ask me and I’ll be happy to answer. It was the practice of this martial art that introduced me to my husband, Matt Johnson who runs a kung fu school here in Chicago.
This martial art has a code of ethics that involves being a good citizen, being humble, promoting peace, and standing up for what is right and protecting those who need protection from bullies and so forth.
I made my first trip to Hong Kong a couple of years ago and I’ve been back a few times since then. Though I’m someone who likes spend a lot of time in remote locations being quiet and letting the busyness of my mind and heart settle down, I felt 100% in love with the city of Hong Kong, it’s culture, it’s people, and of course with my kung fu family there.
As a result it has been difficult watching the news and worrying about this place I love so much and the people who live there.
My concern for all of this led me to do a story for the Chicago Reader.
Here's a link to that: https://www.chicagoreader.com/chicago/photos-hong-kong-protest-freedom/Content?oid=73815391
I’m extremely grateful to the reader for giving me the time and space that it did. I made all the photographs, did all the interviews, and wrote all the text with guidance from the amazing Reader staff. In the process of working on that story I began to see, that much that was going on in Hong Kong seems to not quite be making it into the news. This made me want to go to Hong Kong and do more.
The stories we have been seeing her only the tip of the iceberg. I’m interested in the stories of ordinary people, their everyday life, and what they do.
How do they support each other in the midst of such extreme difficulty?
I want to understand the impact of what’s happening in this interaction between the Beijing mainland Chinese government in the city of Hong Kong in the Hong Kong people.
It’s interesting that Hong Kong has roots and connections stretching out from the city, all over the globe. While working on the story I’ve met many people here in Chicago who have a deep connections to Hong Kong.
I want to go and photograph an interview to help amplify the voices of those people not being heard as much as they might be.
Why do the events Hong Kong matter to you wherever you might live?
Number one. Hong Kong people are simply asking for fundamental human rights to be recognized.
Number two. The Hong Kong people are asking for the promises made by the Chinese government to be kept.
Number three. The Hong Kong people want their freedom.
All people everywhere around the world want their fundamental human rights, they want promises to be kept and they want freedom.
If we all look into our own hearts I believe we will see this truth is self evident.
What’s happening in Hong Kong matters to all of us, because all of us want the same things; freedom, respect- both given and received, dignity, and agency.
Further, for those of us living in other parts of the world, if we think that what’s happening in Hong Kong cannot happen to us wherever it is that we happen to live, I think if you forgive me, that view is naïve.
The road to tyranny is a slippery slope.
First one right is eroded, then another, then another.
For this trip to Hong Kong all the groundwork is in place.
Because of the network being built up over the years and as a result of my recent work, there are people on the ground in Hong Kong ready to help with making connections, translation, safety and getting around and so forth.
My intention is to get to Hong Kong do my work at the photographer and then do my best to get those stories out into the world so that everyone can know what is going on.
But I need help with the expenses.
Airfare and hotel around $2100-2400 depending on flight details
Transportation in Hong Kong When the MTR is shut down taxis may be necessary - estimating maybe $300
Money to pay translators and other fixtures and facilitators estimating $300-500
A laptop to process photos while I’m there so I can send them out to editors at various news outlets - around $200-300
I’m hoping to raise $3500. to cover all of that as well as some of my bills while I’m away so that the lights and heat are still on when I return home.
Addition I’ll provide links to news outlets as well as the story I did for the reader so that you can get more information about the situation over there.
I’ll also link or attach a video that I made about the story.
As things when I’m planning to offer in addition to publicly thinking everyone who supports this is the creation of a private Facebook group where I post updates photos and video from my time in Hong Kong.
This content will be exclusively for anyone who supports this trip.
I’m excited to announce that someone already made a first donation of $500 before even launched this campaign which let me adjust the amount needed to $3500
Honestly I wasn’t even planning on doing this but so many people said to me that they wanted to support the trip and believe in the mission of supporting truth and openness and democracy, that I pushed past my own discomfort and jumped in.
I want to thank all of you in advance for your support and help.
Please know that even if you can’t donate money to this trip, I’d be very grateful for your repeated sharing of the campaign. We all know how this works, and whether we like it or not it requires a certain diligence. A lather rinse and repeat process.
For those of you who can donate, please know how grateful I am for your support. And that no donation is too small or too large.
Again my heartfelt thanks. You should know also that I’ve never felt more sense of mission or purpose in going after story. This has my whole heart and I hope very much but I’ll find out that’s for publishing material of the world to know what is going on in Hong Kong at this critical time in history.
As a final note, I want to add that one of the things I’ve heard lately, is that China may be starting to crack down on the practice of martial arts.
This truly is history repeating itself. This happened during the period of conflict between the Ming and Qing dynasty.
It happened again during the cultural revolution.
And now it’s happening once again.
Why does China always clamp down on martial artists?
Because martial artists, as part of their training, learn how important it is to stand up and fight when it’s necessary. The core of traditional martial arts is about values that respect all people and offer protection to those who need it.
I like to think that with my camera I’m bringing the spirit of kung fu, of the Ving Tsun I love, to my practice using my camera to help protect and defend those in Hong Kong.
I hope that you’ll join me in this fight.
Let me know what questions you may have.
Happy to try my best to answer.
May all be safe, happy, strong and at ease. ❤️

source: 澳洲唐人街 – Australia ChinaTown News 中文华人新闻
summary: Erin Patterson 不仅于周五在维多利亚上诉法院败诉，检方也成功争取到撤销其假释资格。 这使得这位 52 岁的连环杀人犯成为澳大利亚第二位被判处无假释期终身监禁的女性。 Erin Patterson 正在对其定罪和判决提出上诉。AP 在此之前，NSW 女子 Katherine Knight 因 2001 年致其准丈夫 John Price 死亡而被判刑。 这位臭名昭著的连环女杀手被定罪，因用匕首刺穿其伴侣 37 次，随后将其剥皮，并企图将煮熟的肉喂给她的孩子们。 2
content: Erin Patterson 不仅于周五在维多利亚上诉法院败诉，检方也成功争取到撤销其假释资格。 这使得这位 52 岁的连环杀人犯成为澳大利亚第二位被判处无假释期终身监禁的女性。 Erin Patterson 正在对其定罪和判决提出上诉。AP 在此之前，NSW 女子 Katherine Knight 因 2001 年致其准丈夫 John Price 死亡而被判刑。 这位臭名昭著的连环女杀手被定罪，因用匕首刺穿其伴侣 37 次，随后将其剥皮，并企图将煮熟的肉喂给她的孩子们。 2006 年，Knight 试图对其判决提出上诉，声称该刑罚对其罪行而言过于严厉，但她的上诉被驳回。 Patterson 于 2025 年被定罪，罪名是谋杀其岳父母 Don 和 Gail Patterson，以及 Gail 的妹妹 Heather Wilkinson，并企图谋杀 Heather 的丈夫 Ian Wilkinson。 NSW 女子 Katherine Knight（右），因 2001 年致其准丈夫 John Price（左）死亡而被判刑。Supplied/Andrew Forbes 2023 年 7 月，她邀请该团伙在其位于维多利亚州偏远地区的 Leongatha 家中共进午餐，期间她为他们端上了掺有死亡帽毒蘑菇的惠灵顿牛排。 四人全部入院，但只有 Ian Wilkinson 在漫长的治疗后幸存下来。 Patterson 在 Dame Phyllis Frost Centre 旁观看上诉审理，她将在该处度过余生。 这位 52 岁的女子在多个理由上败诉，其律师辩称这些理由导致了“司法不公”。 他们指出，陪审团与检方成员及案件首席调查员被关押在同一酒店，并声称 Patterson 在法庭上遭受了过度激烈和压迫性的盘问。 2023 年 7 月，她邀请该团伙在其位于维多利亚州偏远地区的 Leongatha 家中共进午餐，期间她为他们端上了掺有死亡帽毒蘑菇的惠灵顿牛排。9News Justices Stephen McLeish, Lesley Taylor 和 Peter Kidd 在周五对其重新量刑时驳斥了这种说法。 "这种犯罪极其冷酷且经过精心策划，应受到最严厉的谴责，"法官们表示。 "这是一起如此令人震惊的犯罪行为，因此不适合设定无假释期，" 法官们认定，Patterson 在长达三周的时间里都保持了谋杀意图——从她邀请客人到其家中开始，一直持续到其受害者在用餐后入院期间她所撒的谎。 法官们认定 Patterson 在长达三周的时间里都保持了谋杀意图，一直持续到其受害者在用餐后入院期间她所撒的谎。A Current Affair "[Patterson 的]行为特征是一系列精心策划的欺骗，"法官们表示。 "这种犯罪是经过仔细规划和深思熟虑的。这是对（她）扩展家庭成员残酷的背叛信任。" Patterson 将在 11 月 27 日前向高等法院提出上诉，这将是她推翻定罪的最后希望。

title: At pivotal summit, Canadian-European security cooperation is a central focus
zh_title: 在关键峰会上，加拿大与欧洲的安全合作是焦点
summary: 维也纳——根据一份联合声明草案，加拿大和欧盟计划在周四于蒙特利尔举行的为期两天的峰会上深化在卫星服务、北极海上能力和国防工业关键材料方面的合作。拟议的措施将推进更广泛的战略伙伴关系，呼吁加拿大和欧洲在加强北约的同时为共同安全承担更大的责任。该草案最先由 Politico 报道，并未宣布新的部队部署或武器采购。根据目前的措辞，加拿大承诺进行谈判
content:
维也纳——根据一份联合声明草案，加拿大和欧盟计划在周四于蒙特利尔举行的为期两天的峰会上深化在卫星服务、北极海上能力和国防工业关键材料方面的合作。拟议的措施将推进更广泛的战略伙伴关系，呼吁加拿大和欧洲在加强北约的同时为共同安全承担更大的责任。该草案最先由 Politico 报道，并未宣布新的部队部署或武器采购。根据目前的措辞，加拿大承诺就获得欧洲伽利略卫星星座的服务进行谈判，并探索加拿大参与欧洲 IRIS² 卫星通信项目。布鲁塞尔似乎对加拿大丰富的自然资源特别感兴趣，整个部门专门讨论能源和关键原材料。该草案建议探索储存民用和国防工业所需的关键资源，以缓冲供应链免受市场波动和地缘政治干扰的影响。一些具体措辞已经存在一些不一致。 9 月中旬，欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩 (Ursula von der Leyen) 宣布计划让加拿大成为欧盟第一个“准成员”，这令一些欧洲国家的首都感到惊讶。
现在，正在进行的峰会的联合文件草案删除了这一措辞，取而代之的是“加拿大与欧盟的联系越来越紧密，但本身尚未成为正式成员”。加拿大选择不陷入术语之战，Politico 援引卡尼的话说，“好消息是，具体名称或术语并不重要。”  两个关键的统一因素使欧洲和加拿大更加紧密地联系在一起：俄罗斯对乌克兰的战争和美国总统唐纳德·特朗普。加拿大于2014年俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后启动“放心行动”，自2017年起领导北约驻拉脱维亚多国战斗群。2022年俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰后，两国合作与协调进一步深化。特朗普对北约、欧洲和加拿大主权的威胁加速了一体化进程。特别是北极已成为一个令人感兴趣的地区。今年二月，加拿大和丹麦签署了一份防务合作备忘录，特朗普在威胁军事力量的情况下坚持要求格陵兰岛成为美国的一部分。值得注意的是，与渥太华的协议是在丹麦、格陵兰和法罗群岛代表出席的情况下签署的。内容涵盖创新、产业合作、后勤互助、人员培训、演习等。
今年 3 月，加拿大、丹麦、芬兰、冰岛、挪威和瑞典在奥斯陆举行了峰会，为建立以北极为中心、以安全为重点的模式和具体行动奠定了基石，以确保这些国家日益将这一地区视为共同安全利益区，特别是针对俄罗斯，并在较小程度上针对中国。芬兰和挪威还分别于 4 月和 3 月与加拿大签署了北极安全主题协议，涵盖情报共享、互操作性、物流和破冰船建造等海事主题，除其他主题外。 7月，加拿大宣布打算购买多达12艘新的德国-挪威潜艇，更喜欢欧洲潜艇而不是韩国的报价，就在渥太华将瑞典萨博公司列为首选候选者几周后

【原文 English Original】
VIENNA — Canada and the European Union plan to deepen cooperation on satellite services, Arctic maritime capabilities and critical materials for defense industries at a two-day summit in Montreal that began on Thursday, according to a draft joint statement. The proposed measures would advance a broader strategic partnership that calls for Canada and Europe to assume greater responsibility for shared security while reinforcing NATO. The draft , first reported by Politico, does not announce new troop deployments or weapons purchases. Under the current wording, Canada is promised negotiations for access to services from Europe’s Galileo satellite constellation, as well as exploring Canadian participation in the European IRIS² satellite communications project.  Canada’s vast natural resources appear to be of particular interest to Brussels, with an entire section dedicated to energy and critical raw materials. The draft proposes exploring stockpiling of critical resources needed by civilian and defense industries to cushion supply chains against market fluctuations and geopolitical disruption. There’s already some dissonance about some specific wording. In mid-September, European Commission President Ursula  von der Leyen announced her plan to make Canada the EU’s first “associate member” –  to the surprise of some European capitals. Now, the draft joint document for the ongoing summit has removed this language, speaking instead of an “ever-closer association of Canada to the EU, short of full membership itself.” Canada is choosing not to get caught up in the war of terminology, with Politico quoting Carney as saying that “the good news is it doesn’t matter about specific names or nomenclature.”  Two key unifiers have driven Europe and Canada closer together: Russia’s war against Ukraine, and U.S. President Donald Trump. Canada launched Operation Reassurance in 2014 following Russia’s invasion of Ukraine and has led NATO’s multinational battle group in Latvia since 2017. Cooperation and coordination deepened further after Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Trump’s threats against NATO, Europe and Canadian sovereignty alike have accelerated the integration process. Particularly the Arctic has emerged as an area of interest. In February, Canada and Denmark signed a memorandum on defense cooperation amid Trump’s insistence that Greenland become a part of the United States, having threatened military force. Pointedly, the agreement with Ottawa was signed with Danish, Greenlandic and Faroese delegates present. It covered innovation, industrial cooperation, mutual logistics support, personnel, training and exercises.  And in March, Canada, Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway and Sweden held a summit in Oslo that laid the cornerstone for an Arctic-centric, security-focused format and concrete actions to secure an area that these countries increasingly perceive as a zone of joint security interests, especially vis-à-vis Russia and, to a lesser extent, China.  Finland and Norway also separately signed Arctic security-themed agreements with Canada in April and March, respectively, covering intelligence sharing, interoperability, logistics and maritime topics like the building of icebreakers, among other topics.  In July, Canada announced its intention to buy up to twelve new German-Norwegian submarines, preferring the European boats over a South Korean offer, just a few weeks after Ottawa singled out Sweden’s Saab as the preferred candidate to supply it with six new airborne early warning and control aircraft. Around the same time, Canada secured preferential access to procurement under the EU’s Security Action for Europe (SAFE) defense-financing program, allowing Canadian-origin components to account for up to 80% of the procurement value of equipment purchased with its loans.

content:
请在此回复。活动简介：“全球台湾研究所（GTI）很高兴邀请您参加题为“从抗灾岛到抗灾伙伴：台湾的民防和救灾能力”的公开研讨会。台湾持续承受着来自中华人民共和国的压力：北京继续依赖一系列灰色地带胁迫策略 — — 包括军事恐吓、经济压力和网络攻击 — — 并且不排除封锁或入侵。这些威胁可能会同时切断电力、通信和供应线路。保卫台湾不仅取决于其军队和政府，还取决于公民在危机发生时知道该怎么做。公众对现实的认识仍然落后于威胁。此外，自然现象不断挑战台湾：2026年最强热带气旋之一的台风“占比”于10月横扫台湾，影响旅游和商业活动，造成至少一人死亡，数千户家庭停电。尽管台湾总体上已做好应对台风和其他灾害的充分准备，但问题仍然是，这种准备是否也适用于人为、蓄意且更具破坏性的危机。在这方面，多年面对自然灾害和安全威胁的经历，让台湾拥有真正应对危机的专业知识。
这种专业知识现在已经足够强大，可以与美国和其他国际伙伴合作，并作为外交和发展合作的一种形式在国外分享。该小组将汇集来自美国和台湾的专家，以考虑台湾的灾难应对能力水平以及还需要做什么。讨论将涵盖民防和威慑；台湾民间组织从应急“前线”汲取的经验教训；美台合作；和外交的韧性。演讲嘉宾： 黄亚伦，隈研院国际事务部主任 刘一成，非政府组织 ARTICLE 19 亚太项目官员兼全球台湾研究所客座研究员 萧美曼，兰德公司台湾政策杰出胡主席 凯蒂·塞兹莫尔，外交关系委员会国家安全国际事务研究员 亚伦·范·阿莱斯廷，泛美发展基金会高级项目经理 主持人：杰西卡·肖，全球台湾研究所研究员 活动将于GTI 的办公室位于华盛顿特区杰斐逊广场西北 1836 号（距杜邦环岛地铁约一个街区）。开门时间为上午 9:30，活动将于上午 10:00 开始。将提供清淡的早餐。如有问题或疑虑，请直接联系高级项目经理 Abby Fu，邮箱为 afu@globaltaiwan.org。
**媒体：如果您想携带额外的船员或设备，请通过 blevine@globaltaiwan.org 联系 Ben Levine，以便我们确保为您提供住宿。”全球台湾研究所 1836 Jefferson Pl NW Washington, DC 20008 从弹性岛屿到弹性伙伴：台湾的民防和救灾能力（活动：26 年 11 月 10 日）首先出现在亚利桑那州立大学的《小战争杂志》上。

title: China's spaceplane bears striking resemblance to America's X-37B
zh_title: 中国的空天飞机与美国的X-37B惊人相似
summary: 据美国国防情报局 (DIA) 报道，中国的秘密太空飞机已在轨道上被美国商业卫星发现。DIA 的报告 [PDF] 警告称，中国、俄罗斯、伊朗和朝鲜的发展可能威胁太空安全，至少从美国的角度来看是这样。报告的大部分内容详细介绍了仍在开发中的系统，但第 53 页上的一张图片引人注目：Maxar Technologies 于 2024 年将中国的航天飞机送入轨道。该图像以前曾见过；大约两年前，Bluesky 用户@dutchspace 分享了行业研讨会上的低分辨率快照。
content:
据美国国防情报局 (DIA) 报道，中国的秘密太空飞机已在轨道上被美国商业卫星发现。DIA 的报告 [PDF] 警告称，中国、俄罗斯、伊朗和朝鲜的发展可能威胁太空安全，至少从美国的角度来看是这样。报告的大部分内容详细介绍了仍在开发中的系统，但第 53 页上的一张图片引人注目：Maxar Technologies 于 2024 年将中国的航天飞机送入轨道。该图像以前曾见过；大约两年前，Bluesky 用户@dutchspace 分享了行业研讨会上的低分辨率快照。然而，DIA 报告中的高分辨率图像显示了更多细节。该太空飞机还与美国太空部队的 X-37B 有着明显的相似之处。无人驾驶的 X-37 于 1999 年作为 NASA 项目开始，随后由美国国防部接管。经过对 X-37A 变体进行多次大气测试后，X-37B 于 2010 年发射。这架可重复使用的航天飞机可以在轨道上运行数年，执行机密活动。到目前为止，它已经推出了八次。根据 DIA 的报告，中国的首次航天飞机任务于 2020 年发射，并在轨道上停留了两天。第二颗于 2022 年发射，在轨道运行了 276 天，第三颗于 2023 年 12 月发射，在轨道运行了 268 天。最后两次任务似乎包括对轨道上物体的接近和交会测试。
令人难忘的是，俄罗斯在命运多舛的暴风雪号上拥有一架太空飞机，它与美国航天飞机有着惊人的相似之处（尽管从技术角度来看，两者是非常不同的野兽——尤其是，暴风雪号的轨道飞行器没有携带用于将其发射到太空的发动机）。然而，根据国防情报局的报告，俄罗斯“自那以后几乎没有取得任何进展”。美国最近证实它拥有太空武器，如果不认为竞争对手也拥有自己的武器，无论是动能武器还是某种形式的干扰技术，那就太天真了。本月早些时候，俄罗斯的 Kosmos-2612 悄悄靠近美国 ICEYE-X36 卫星，然后撤退。目前还不清楚他的意图是完全无辜地看着其他航天器，还是有点武力威胁。这无疑让美国立法者感到担忧。 ®

【原文 English Original】
China's secretive spaceplane has been spotted in orbit by a US commercial satellite, according to the Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA) The DIA's report [PDF] warns of developments by China, Russia, Iran, and North Korea that allegedly threaten space security, at least from a US perspective. Most of the report details systems still under development, but one image on page 53 stands out: China's spaceplane, snapped in orbit in 2024 by Maxar Technologies. The image has been seen before; a low-resolution snap from an industry symposium was shared by Bluesky user @dutchspace almost two years ago. However, the higher-resolution image in the DIA report shows more detail. The spaceplane also bears a distinct resemblance to the US Space Force's X-37B. The uncrewed X-37 began as a NASA project in 1999 before the US Department of Defense took over. After several atmospheric tests with an X-37A variant, the X-37B was launched in 2010. The reusable spaceplane can spend years in orbit, conducting classified activities. So far, it has launched eight times. According to the DIA's report, China's first spaceplane mission launched in 2020 and remained in orbit for two days. A second, launched in 2022, spent 276 days in orbit, and a third, launched in December 2023, spent 268 days in oribt. The last two missions appeared to include approach and rendezvous tests of objects in orbit. Russia, memorably, had a spaceplane in the ill-fated Buran, which bore an uncanny resemblance to the US Space Shuttle (although the two were very different beasts from a technical perspective – not least, Buran's orbiter did not carry the engines used to launch it to space). However, according to the DIA's report, Russia "has made little progress since." The US recently confirmed that it has weapons in space, and it would be naive not to assume rivals would have their own, whether kinetic or some form of jamming technology. Earlier this month, Russia's Kosmos-2612 sidled up to the US ICEYE-X36 satellite before retreating. It's unclear whether the intention was an entirely innocent look at a fellow spacecraft or a bit of saber-rattling; it certainly worried US lawmakers . ®

title: Rumours that design defect caused waste plant fire ‘groundless and entirely fictitious,’ gov’t says
zh_title: 政府表示，设计缺陷导致垃圾处理厂火灾的传言“毫无根据，完全是虚构的”
summary: 香港环境部门已经回应了“虚假谣言”，称垃圾焚烧厂发生的火灾是由设计缺陷和焚烧模块倒塌引起的。 2026 年 10 月 26 日，香港石鼓洲人工岛上的 I·PARK1 垃圾焚烧厂冒出黑烟。照片：edward.chung_，来自 Threads。环境保护署（环保署）周三表示，大屿山以南石鼓洲I·PARK1废物管理设施周一发生火灾，怀疑由建筑材料引起。
content:
香港环境部门已经回应了“虚假谣言”，称垃圾焚烧厂发生的火灾是由设计缺陷和焚烧模块倒塌引起的。 2026 年 10 月 26 日，香港石鼓洲人工岛上的 I·PARK1 垃圾焚烧厂冒出黑烟。照片：edward.chung_，来自 Threads。环境保护署（环保署）周三发表声明称，大屿山以南石鼓洲I·PARK1废物管理设施周一发生火灾，怀疑由建筑材料引起。该部门在工厂发生火灾两天后表示，“初步怀疑火灾源自建筑材料，而不是焚烧炉的运行或储存的废物”。声明称：“初步信息表明，火灾起源于焚烧炉大楼第三个焚烧模块区域的屋顶，该区域的收尾工作仍在进行中。” I·PARK1垃圾焚烧厂是香港第一座垃圾焚烧发电厂。其首个模块于2025年12月开始试运行，日处理能力为1000吨。 I·PARK1内的风冷冷凝器。照片：香港政府一站通。该项目是该市减少对垃圾填埋场依赖的更广泛努力的一部分。社交媒体帖子称，焚烧模块在火灾中倒塌，但没有提供证据。
HKFP无法立即在网上找到有关设计缺陷的传言。“毫无根据，完全虚构” 政府已命令废物处理厂的工程承包商在事故发生之日起7天内提交火灾事故报告。 2026 年 10 月 26 日，香港石鼓洲人工岛上的 I·PARK1 垃圾焚烧厂冒出黑烟。照片：edward.chung_，来自 Threads。声明称：“与此同时，环保署正在评估受损情况以及对设施及其处理能力的影响，并会敦促承包商尽快进行维修。”火灾发生时，该设施的废物接收暂停。声明称，“在对设施结构和所有关键系统进行全面检查，并确认适合重新启动设施安全运行后，该部门将尽快恢复接待。”环保署必须以最强烈的措辞声明，网上流传的有关‘焚化炉设计缺陷’和‘建造中的焚化模块倒塌’的指控毫无根据，完全是虚构的。” “环保署呼吁公众不要被这些虚假信息误导，并停止传播这些信息。”

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong’s environmental authorities have addressed “false rumours” that a fire that broke out at a waste incineration plant was caused by design defects and a collapsed incineration module. Black smoke rises from I·PARK1, a waste incineration plant on an artificial island off Shek Kwu Chau in Hong Kong on October 26, 2026. Photo: edward.chung_, via Threads. The fire that broke out at the I·PARK1 waste management facility in Shek Kwu Chau, south of Lantau Island, on Monday is suspected to have originated from construction materials, the Environmental Protection Department (EPD) said in a Wednesday statement. “It is preliminarily suspected that the fire originated from construction materials, rather than from the operation of the incinerator or the waste stored,” the department said, two days after the fire broke out at the plant. “Preliminary information indicates that the fire originated at the roof of the incinerator building’s third incineration module area where finishing work was still in progress,” it said. The I·PARK1 waste incinerator is Hong Kong’s first waste-to-energy plant. Its first module began trial operations in December 2025 and has a daily processing capacity of 1,000 tonnes. An air-cooled condenser in I·PARK1. Photo: GovHK. The project is part of the city’s broader effort to reduce its reliance on landfills. A social media post said that the incineration module had collapsed in the fire, although no proof was provided. Rumours about design flaws could not immediately be found online by HKFP. ‘Groundless and entirely fictitious’ The government has ordered the works contractor for the waste management plant to submit an incident report on the fire within seven days from the day of the accident. Black smoke rises from I·PARK1, a waste incineration plant on an artificial island off Shek Kwu Chau in Hong Kong on October 26, 2026. Photo: edward.chung_, via Threads. “Meanwhile, the EPD is evaluating the damage and the impact on the facility and its processing capacity, and will urge the contractor to conduct repairs as soon as possible,” the statement said. Waste reception at the facility was suspended when the fire broke out. The department will resume reception as soon as possible, the statement said, “following a comprehensive examination of the facility’s structure and all critical systems, and upon confirming that it is suitable to restart the facility’s safe operation.” “The EPD must state in the strongest terms that allegations circulated online about the ‘design defects of the incinerator’ and ‘collapse of incineration module under construction’ are groundless and entirely fictitious,” it said. “The EPD urges the public not to be misled by these false messages and to stop sharing them.”

title: Towngas CFO calls for climate resilience in infrastructure investment

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 28 日，香港时间 01:24 · 更新于 10 月 28 日，04:26 · 阅读时间 3 分钟

[Towngas](https://clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-Towngas-joint-venture-VENEX-named-global-sustainab-9259d7)执行董事兼首席财务官Edmund Yeung表示，从创纪录的降雨量到日益不稳定的天气模式，气候风险正在成为城市和企业的日常现实。他在《标准》中撰文指出，随着香港推进北方大都市发展并发展智能、可持续的社区，一个关键问题正在出现：今天建造的基础设施如何在面对明天的不确定性时保持弹性？
杨写道，韧性越来越成为评估长期投资的一个关键考虑因素。香港政府已在北部大都会制定了明确的方向，将智能、绿色和弹性原则融入新的开发区。这与中国的“十五五”规划紧密结合，预计该规划将继续强调数字化转型、气候适应和发展新的优质生产力。

杨认为，对于公用事业公司来说，气候风险最终是一个资产负债表问题。基础设施资产旨在为公众服务数十年，因此今天做出的投资决策必须考虑到未来的运营状况。在港华燃气，该公司已将气候相关风险和机遇纳入其企业风险管理框架，并进行定量情景分析，以评估到 2050 年的潜在财务影响。这些评估为长期规划和资本配置提供信息，帮助直接进行弹性投资，以实现最大价值，同时支持可持续业务增长。
杨写道，中华煤气基础设施的规划和运营都融入了弹性。该公司通过持续维护、风险评估和极端天气准备计划，继续加强关键资产和运营。该公司表示，通过尽早识别特定地点的气候风险并提前为恶劣天气事件做好准备，可以更好地保障运营连续性和服务可靠性。

杨表示，技术在增强中华煤气区域业务的弹性方面也发挥着越来越重要的作用。在中国大陆，该公司正在利用人工智能和智能自动化来支持能源基础设施、储能运营和新兴能源应用，提高运营可靠性。这些努力得到了不断发展的数字基础的支撑，该基础结合了先进的分析、强大的数据治理和集成的运营洞察，以提供更全面的资产和运营视图。这使公司能够更早地识别潜在风险，采取更主动的资产管理和维护计划，并增强服务的安全性和可靠性。它是一个

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Edmund Yeung, executive director and CFO of Towngas, argues that climate resilience must be embedded in infrastructure planning and investment. He says the Hong Kong government's Northern Metropolis and China's 15th Five-Year Plan align with this approach, and that Towngas uses AI and scenario analy

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

28 Oct 2026 at 01:24 HKT · updated 28 Oct, 04:26 · 3 min read

Climate risks are becoming an everyday reality for cities and businesses, from record-breaking rainfall to increasingly volatile weather patterns, according to Edmund Yeung, executive director and chief financial officer of [Towngas](https://clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-Towngas-joint-venture-VENEX-named-global-sustainab-9259d7). Writing in The Standard, he argues that as Hong Kong advances the Northern Metropolis and develops smart, sustainable communities, a key question is emerging: how can infrastructure built today remain resilient in the face of tomorrow's uncertainties?

Resilience is increasingly a key consideration in evaluating long-term investments, Yeung writes. The Hong Kong government has set a clear direction through the Northern Metropolis, where Smart, Green and Resilient principles are being embedded in new development areas. This aligns closely with China's 15th Five-Year Plan, which is expected to continue emphasising digital transformation, climate adaptation and the development of new quality productive forces.

For a public utility, climate risk is ultimately a balance-sheet issue, Yeung argues. Infrastructure assets are designed to serve the public for decades, so investment decisions made today must account for future operating conditions. At Towngas, the company has incorporated climate-related risks and opportunities into its enterprise risk management framework and conducts quantitative scenario analyses to assess potential financial impacts through 2050. These assessments inform long-term planning and capital allocation, helping direct resilience investments where they can deliver the greatest value while supporting sustainable business growth.

Resilience is built into both the planning and operation of Towngas's infrastructure, Yeung writes. The company continues to strengthen key assets and operations through ongoing maintenance, risk assessments and extreme-weather preparedness programmes. By identifying location-specific climate risks early and preparing for adverse weather events in advance, the company says it can better safeguard operational continuity and service reliability.

Technology also plays an increasingly important role in strengthening resilience across Towngas's regional operations, according to Yeung. On the Chinese mainland, the company is leveraging artificial intelligence and intelligent automation to support energy infrastructure, energy storage operations and emerging energy applications, enhancing operational reliability. These efforts are underpinned by a growing digital foundation that combines advanced analytics, robust data governance and integrated operational insights to provide a more comprehensive view of assets and operations. This enables the company to identify potential risks earlier, take a more proactive approach to asset management and maintenance planning, and strengthen the safety and reliability of services. It also helps make more informed investment decisions focused on long-term value creation.

Climate resilience is no longer solely an environmental objective, Yeung concludes; it is also a discipline in capital allocation, risk management and long-term value creation. As the energy transition accelerates and new energy solutions continue to evolve, resilience must be embedded in every investment, asset and capability developed. By combining technology, innovation and disciplined stewardship, Yeung writes, Towngas is laying the foundations for greater operational reliability, sustainable growth and enduring value for stakeholders and the communities it serves.

source: 美国海军学院工作人员（大量国会报告每周2-3次）
summary: 2026 年 7 月 25 日，在澳大利亚北领地邦迪山训练区举行的大规模伤亡训练活动中，美国海军陆战队轮换部队 - 达尔文 26 的水兵正在治疗模拟伤员。美国海军陆战队照片 海军陆战队轮换部队 - 达尔文 26.3 完成了在澳大利亚和印度-太平洋地区为期六个月的轮换部署，美国海军陆战队周五宣布。海军陆战队新闻稿称，MRF-D 部署的结束标志着第 15 次轮换。在部署期间，轮换部队首次获得特种海军陆战队空地特遣部队认证
content:
2026 年 7 月 25 日，在澳大利亚北领地邦迪山训练区举行的大规模伤亡训练活动中，美国海军陆战队轮换部队 - 达尔文 26 的水兵正在治疗模拟伤员。美国海军陆战队照片 海军陆战队轮换部队 - 达尔文 26.3 完成了在澳大利亚和印度-太平洋地区为期六个月的轮换部署，美国海军陆战队周五宣布。海军陆战队新闻稿称，MRF-D 部署的结束标志着第 15 次轮换。在部署期间，这支轮换部队被认证为特种目的海军陆战队空地特遣部队——这是 MRF-D 首次获得特殊认证。新闻稿称，MRF-D由海军陆战队第一师第五海军陆战团领导，将来自第一和第三海军陆战队远征军的2000名海军陆战队员和水兵合并成一支能够汇集指挥和控制、航空、地面作战和后勤能力的部队。 3月至10月，这支轮换部队与澳大利亚国防军以及地区盟友和伙伴一起在澳大利亚、菲律宾、新喀里多尼亚、巴布亚新几内亚、法属波利尼西亚和印度尼西亚进行训练。作为一支经过认证的特种海军陆战队空地特遣部队，MRF-D 在该地区充当前沿后备部队，能够从分散的地点开展行动并对危机做出快速反应。 “这第 15 次轮换证明了美国和澳大利亚在并肩训练时能够取得的成就，”美国
MRF-D 26.3 SPMAGT 指挥官、海军陆战队上校乔治·弗林在新闻稿中表示。 “我要向我们的澳大利亚国防军同行和全国各地的主办方表示最深切的谢意，感谢他们坚定不移的支持。通过在 Render Safe、Predators Run、Southern Jackaroo 和 Capital Reach 等演习中共同突破极限，我们从彼此身上学到了很多东西。我们已经建立了无与伦比的互操作性，证明我们可以快速有效地共同行动，以确保自由开放的印度太平洋地区。”一架美国海军陆战队 MV-22B 鱼鹰被分配到第 16 海军陆战队第 165 中型倾转旋翼机中队 (VMM)，第 3 海军陆战队飞机联队，在加利福尼亚州彭德尔顿海军陆战队基地营进行了“钢铁骑士 25”演习的模拟袭击后，准备与第 1 海军陆战师第 5 海军团第 1 营黑脚连一起接载海军陆战队员。 2025 年 12 月 12 日。美国海军陆战队照片 在该部队抵达澳大利亚参加“钢铁骑士 2025”演习之前，在美国开始了部署准备工作。这支仍在组建的部队于 2025 年 12 月 1 日至 14 日在南加州进行了演习，建立了地理上分布的指挥和控制节点，并演练了使用 MV-22B 鱼鹰倾转旋翼机和 C-130J 超级飞机进行人员和装备的长距离移动大力士飞机。
海军陆战队和水兵还接受了对大使馆增援、疏散行动、伤员疏散、远征医疗支援、航空节点行动和远征先进基地行动能力的评估。抵达达尔文后，MRF-D 26.3 开始了其区域训练活动，即 4 月 20 日至 5 月 8 日在菲律宾举行的“肩并肩 2026”演习。此次演习为 MRF-D 26.3 完成 SPMAGTF 认证提供了最终的操作环境。并肩作战期间，海军陆战队和水兵验证了他们救援飞机和人员、进行航空外部运输、运送物资的能力

【原文 English Original】
U.S. Navy sailors with Marine Rotational Force – Darwin 26 treat a simulated casualty during a mass casualty training event at Mount Bundy Training Area in Northern Territory, Australia, July 25, 2026. US Marine Corps photo Marine Rotational Force-Darwin 26.3 completed its six month rotational deployment to Australia and the Indo-Pacific, the service announced on Friday. The conclusion of the MRF-D’s deployment marks the 15th rotation, reads a Marine Corps news release . During the deployment, the rotational force was certified as a Special Purpose Marine Air-Ground Task Force – the first time a MRF-D has received the special certification. The MRF-D, led by 5th Marine Regiment, 1st Marine Division, combined 2,000 Marines and sailors from I and III Marine Expeditionary forces into a force capable of bringing together command and control, aviation, ground combat and logistics capabilities, reads the release. The rotational force trained alongside the Australian Defence Force and regional allies and partners from March to October throughout Australia, the Philippines, New Caledonia, Papua New Guinea, French Polynesia and Indonesia. As a certified Special Purpose Marine Air-Ground Task Force, the MRF-D acted as a forward-postured stand-in force in the region and was capable of operating from dispersed locations and responding quickly to crises. “This 15th rotation stands as a testament to what the U.S. and Australia can achieve when we train shoulder-to-shoulder,” U.S. Marine Corps Col. George Flynn, commanding officer of MRF-D 26.3 SPMAGT, said in the release. “I want to extend my deepest gratitude to our ADF counterparts and our hosts across the country for their unwavering support. By pushing our limits together during exercises like Render Safe, Predators Run, Southern Jackaroo and Capital Reach, we have learned immensely from one another. We have forged an unparalleled level of interoperability, proving that we can move together rapidly and effectively to ensure a free and open Indo-Pacific.” A U.S. Marine Corps MV-22B Osprey assigned to Marine Medium Tiltrotor Squadron (VMM) 165, Marine Aircraft Group 16, 3rd Marine Aircraft Wing, prepare to pick up Marines with Blackfoot Company, 1st Battalion, 5th Marine Regiment, 1st Marine Division, after a simulated raid as part of Exercise Steel Knight 25 at Marine Corps Base Camp Pendleton, California, Dec. 12, 2025. US Marine Corps photo Preparations for the deployment began in the U.S. before the unit arrived in Australia with participation in Exercise Steel Knight 2025. Conducted across Southern California from Dec. 1-14, 2025, the still-forming force established geographically distributed command-and-control nodes and rehearsed long-distance movement of personnel and equipment using MV-22B Osprey tiltrotor aircraft and C-130J Super Hercules aircraft. Marines and sailors also underwent evaluations on their ability to conduct embassy reinforcement, evacuation operations, casualty evacuation, expeditionary medical support, aviation-node operations and expeditionary advanced base operations. Following its arrival in Darwin, MRF-D 26.3 began its regional training campaign with Exercise Balikatan 2026, held from April 20 to May 8 in the Philippines. The exercise provided the final operational environment for MRF-D 26.3 to complete its SPMAGTF certification . During Balikatan, Marines and sailors validated their ability to recover aircraft and personnel, conduct aviation external lift, deliver supplies by air to a notional civilian population and establish expeditionary advanced bases in austere, dispersed locations. In Aporawan, Palawan, as part of Balikatan, MRF-D’s ground combat element trained alongside the Armed Forces of the Philippines, Australian Defense Force, New Zealand Defense Force and U.S. joint forces during a counter-landing live-fire exercise. The combined force synchronized Philippine Marine Corps artillery, High Mobility Artillery Rocket Systems, mortars, crew-served weapons, anti-armor systems and air-defense capabilities against simulated amphibious threats. Balikatan culminated on May 3 at Balabac Island, where multinational reconnaissance teams from the Philippine Marine Corps, Australian Army and 1st Reconnaissance Battalion shaped the operational environment before U.S., Philippine and Australian forces conducted an air assault to secure Balabac Airfield. Marine Medium Tiltrotor Squadron 268 (Reinforced) transported personnel and equipment from Antonio Bautista Air Base, while U.S. Army watercraft moved HIMARS into the austere maritime environment. The combined force then integrated air mobility, reconnaissance, ground maneuver and fires during a live-fire demonstration against simulated maritime targets. Coinciding with Balikatan, elements of the force deployed to New Caledonia for Exercise Tagata Toa, a multinational combined-arms exercise hosted by the French Armed Forces from April 27 to May 10. The deployment to New Caledonia also demonstrated the importance of partner-enabled mobility, reads the release. The Royal New Zealand Air Force provided a Boeing 757 and two C-130 Hercules aircraft to move Marines and equipment between Darwin, New Caledonia and Townsville. “By drawing on allied capacity, access and professional relationships, MRF-D moved personnel and equipment across international boundaries faster than it could have through unilateral means. That ability to leverage partner capabilities expanded the combined force’s reach and resilience across the Indo-Pacific,” reads the release. U.S. Marines with Fox Battery, 2nd Battalion, 11th Marine Regiment, Marine Rotational Force – Darwin 26, adjust the trajectory of an M777A2 lightweight 155mm howitzer while conducting a fire mission during Exercise Predator’s Walk at Mount Bundey Training Area, Northern Territory, Australia, May 21, 2026. US Marine Corps photo The special purpose MAGTF then returned its focus to northern Australia on May 18 with Exercise Predators Walk, which continued through June 12 and built tactical familiarity between Marines and Australian counterparts. Then, from May 29 to July 3 in Townsville, Marines trained alongside Australian and Japanese forces during Exercise Southern Jackaroo. The exercise included joint operations and live-fire training designed to strengthen combined readiness and interoperability in complex terrain. Other elements of the units deployed to the Philippines for Exercise KAMANDAG 10, held June 15 to July 1. The MRF-D then participated in a month-long deployment as part of participation in Operation Render Safe, the multinational effort to remove World War II-era unexploded ordnance and reduce risks to communities in East New Britain. From July 1-31, Marines of the MRF-D 26.3 explosive ordnance disposal element disposed of 732 munitions totalling 16,041 pounds of net explosive weight. From July 20 to Aug. 7, MRF-D 26 joined the Australian Army’s 1st Brigade and the Philippine Army’s 1st Brigade Combat Team for Exercise Predators Run 26, in the Townsville Field Training Area. The trilateral exercise integrated U.S., Australian and Philippine forces under a unified command structure for platoon-level training, force-on-force maneuvers and a combined defensive live-fire scenario. The unit employed multiple organic unmanned aircraft systems to expand logistics, medical support and ground-combat capabilities during the exercise U.S. Marines with Combat Logistics Battalion 5, Marine Rotational Force – Darwin 26, guide and stage tactical vehicles in preparation to embark aboard the Royal Australian Navy HMAS Canberra at the Port of Townsville in Queensland, Australia, August 2, 2026. US Marine Corps photo An embarked deployment took place in early August with Royal Australian Navy amphibious assault ship HMAS Canberra (L02). VMM-268 (Rein.) conducted MV-22B Osprey deck landing qualifications, while the Royal Australian Navy mechanized landing craft transported Marine Corps Joint Light Tactical Vehicles (JLTV) and Medium Tactical Vehicle Replacements from Canberra’s well deck to shore. In Indonesia from Aug. 12-28, Alpha Company, 1st Battalion, 5th Marines conducted an annual platoon exchange with Indonesian marines from 7th Infantry Battalion, 4th Brigade near Lampung. Then, from Aug. 31 toSept.11, 230 Marines and sailors joined Indonesian and multinational partners for combined-arms live fire, jungle operations, small-unit tactics, force-on-force training and subject-matter expert exchange as part of Exercise Super Garuda Shield 2026. The rotational force is scheduled to return to the Northern Territory in early 2027 for the 16th MRF-D rotation, according to an Australian Defense Department news release . I MEF deploys two rotational forces to the Indo-Pacific – MRF-D and Marine Rotational Force-South East Asia (MRF-SEA). In previous years, MRF-SEA would deploy from October to March with MRF-D entering the region in April. However, since April this year, MRF-SEA has maintained its command element on a continuous basis in the Philippines with the unit’s recent activity being a bilateral planning exercise with Philippine Joint Task Force personnel from Oct. 5-9. “For MRF-SEA, the planning exercise represents the progression of a rotation built around persistent engagement with Philippine partners,” reads a MRF-SEA news release .

zh_title: 海关联同消防处捣毁文锦渡民宅附近的非法加油站
summary: 香港海关及消防处周一在文锦渡住宅楼附近拆除一处非法加油站，检获约1,560公升未完税汽油，价值54,000港元。一名33岁的中国公民被捕。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 27 日 05:38 HKT · 2 分钟阅读 香港海关及消防处拆除住宅楼宇附近一座非法加油站
content:
香港
香港海关及消防处周一在文锦渡住宅楼附近拆除一处非法加油站，检获约1,560公升未完税汽油，价值54,000港元。一名33岁的中国公民被捕。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 27 日 05:38 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港海关及消防处周一在文锦渡地区住宅楼附近拆除一处非法加油站，检获约1,560公升未完税汽油，市值约54,000港元，完税价值约9,500港元。

周一早上的行动中，警方在文锦渡路上发现一个有围栏的金属棚，散发出浓烈的汽油味。警方怀疑某加油站为非法加油站，遂搜查，发现一辆跨境私家车在加油。男司机试图逃跑，但很快被制服并被捕。这名33岁的中国公民是一名非本地人，自称是汽车经销店员工，现已被拘留。
海关表示，该非法加油站缺乏合规的消防安全设备，存在重大安全隐患，尤其是在民宅附近。汽车、汽油和设备被扣押以进行进一步调查。海关会调查汽油的来源，并根据《应课税品条例》处理和没收有关物品。

海关强调会与消防处保持紧密合作，打击黑点及打击非法燃油活动，并警告市民切勿光顾非法油站。两部门呼吁市民透过海关24小时热线182 8080、消防处24小时热线5577 9666或消防处网站的「石油罢工」举报平台举报怀疑非法燃油活动。

根据《应课税品条例》，处理、出售或购买未完税燃油，最高可被罚款港币100万元及监禁两年，涉案车辆可能会被没收。根据《消防安全（火灾危险）条例》，出于商业目的持有或控制受控物质以转移到车辆油箱中是犯罪行为。根据危险品条例，在没有牌照或豁免的情况下制造、储存、运输或使用危险品，首次定罪最高可被罚款港币10万元及监禁六个月，再犯最高可被罚款港币20万元及监禁一年。
[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

Hong Kong
Hong Kong Customs and the Fire Services Department dismantled an illegal petrol station near residential buildings in Man Kam To on Monday, seizing about 1,560 litres of duty-not-paid petrol worth HK$54,000. A 33-year-old Chinese national was arrested.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

27 Oct 2026 at 05:38 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong Customs and the Fire Services Department (FSD) dismantled an illegal petrol station near residential buildings in the Man Kam To area on Monday, seizing about 1,560 litres of duty-not-paid petrol with a market value of about HK$54,000 and a duty value of about HK$9,500.

During the operation on Monday morning, officers found a fenced metal shed on Man Kam To Road emitting a strong petrol smell. Suspecting an illegal petrol station, they searched it and found a cross-border private car transferring fuel. The male driver tried to flee but was quickly subdued and arrested. The 33-year-old Chinese national, a non-local who claimed to be a car dealership employee, was taken into custody.

Customs said the illegal station lacked compliant fire safety equipment and posed a major safety hazard, especially as it was near homes. The car, petrol and equipment were seized for further investigation. Customs will investigate the source of the petrol and handle and confiscate the items under the Dutiable Commodities Ordinance.

Customs stressed it would maintain close cooperation with the FSD to target black spots and combat illegal fuel activities, warning the public not to patronize illegal petrol stations. The two departments urged the public to report suspected illegal fuel activities through Customs' 24-hour hotline 182 8080, the FSD's 24-hour hotline 5577 9666, or the 'Oil Strike' reporting platform on the FSD's website.

Under the Dutiable Commodities Ordinance, dealing with, selling or buying duty-not-paid fuel carries a maximum penalty of HK$1 million and two years' imprisonment, and vehicles involved may be confiscated. Under the Fire Safety (Fire Hazards) Regulations, possessing or controlling controlled substances for business purposes to transfer into vehicle fuel tanks is an offence. Under the Dangerous Goods Ordinance, manufacturing, storing, transporting or using dangerous goods without a licence or exemption carries a maximum fine of HK$100,000 and six months' jail on first conviction, and HK$200,000 and one year's jail on subsequent convictions.

# China National Team ETFs Draw Most Inflows Since Trade War Rout

By Bloomberg News

October 26, 2026 at 4:14 AM UTC

Save

Translate

China’s state-led funds stepped into the market with the heaviest buying since the April 2025 rout, as authorities ramped up efforts to [stem](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-23/china-stocks-sink-deeper-into-bear-market-despite-state-buying) a market freefall.

Inflows into nine exchange-traded funds known to be actively traded by the national team reached 128.7 billion yuan ($19 billion) last week, according to data compiled by Bloomberg. That’s the most since the nearly 140 billion yuan recorded during April 2025, when US President Donald Trump’s trade war battered markets and Beijing took a slew of [actions](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-04-08/china-vows-to-fight-to-the-end-if-us-insists-on-new-tariffs) to prop up investor sentiment.

He Jinbi, one of the biggest names in Chinese copper trading, has been sentenced to life in prison over fraud and other offenses committed by the company he founded, [Maike Metals International Co.](https://www.bloomberg.com/quote/0387958D:CH)

A court in the western Chinese city of Xi’an found Maike guilty of contract fraud, bribery and other offenses last month, and handed its 61-year-old boss, He, a life sentence, according to people familiar with the verdict. title: Hong Kong tourism plan aims to boost spending, extend stays
zh_title: 香港旅游计划旨在增加消费、延长停留时间
summary: 香港文化体育及旅游局局长罗淑娜制定了一项五年计划，到2030年将旅游业的年增加值从862亿港元提高到1,260亿港元，利用文化活动、当地社区和多元化景点，将游客人数转化为经济收益。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 26 日香港时间 06:02 · 2 分钟阅读秘书文化、体育及旅游 罗淑佩认为香港
content:
香港
文化体育及旅游局局长罗姗娜制定了一项五年计划，到2030年将旅游业的年度增加值从862亿港元提高到1,260亿港元，利用文化活动、当地社区和多元化景点，将游客人数转化为经济收益。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 26 日 06:02 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

文化体育及旅游局局长罗淑佩认为，香港的鲜明对比——商务会议、乡村远足和节日——可以说服游客停留更长时间、花更多钱并返回。随着香港推出第一个五年旅游计划，罗正押注于文化活动和当地社区，以将游客人数转化为经济收益。

罗说，2026年前9个月，香港接待了4070万人次游客，其中国庆黄金周期间有141万人次内地游客。政府的目标是到2030年将旅游业的年度增加值从2024年的862亿港元提高到1,260亿港元，并希望来自中国大陆以外的游客占过夜游客的40%。
为了传播好处，罗引用了旅游局发起的“品味香港”活动，该活动推荐了所有 18 个地区的餐馆，从茶餐厅到街头小吃摊。另一项名为“Hong Kong Good Take”的活动将绘制约 100 个电影拍摄地的地图，将影迷带入不同的社区。罗说，大约五分之一的中国境外游客会继续前往大陆，但她坚称这座城市不仅仅是一个中途停留地。

香港全年都有国际艺术、中国文化节目和大型节庆活动，为您提供了不同的回归理由。罗说，中秋国际灯会吸引了约73万人次参观，而圣诞节庆祝活动和新年倒计时之后，林村许愿树和黄大仙祠将举行农历新年传统活动。她说，其目的是通过独特的、限时的体验来产生“FOMO”（害怕错过的恐惧）。

根据拟议的资金改革，主要表演艺术团体将根据其过去的出席率进行评估，而不是根据其他学科进行评估。艺术素质以及在海外或内地演出的机会也很重要。在电影方面，罗希望巩固支持计划并吸引私人投资，认为香港电影必须与电影观众重新建立联系。在体育方面，启德体育公园定期举行的国际比赛可以鼓励围绕体育赛事的旅行，而新的培训计划将帮助退休运动员追求体育管理的职业生涯。
罗透露，她把拳击作为一种爱好，定期参加课程，并称自己是一名喜欢传统中餐馆和老式面包店的美食家。她徒步旅行，回忆起穿越大屿山的六个小时的长途跋涉，并希望尝试去离岛露营或豪华露营——这是她希望实现的儿时愿望。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law outlined a five-year plan to raise tourism's annual value added from HK$86.2 billion to HK$126 billion by 2030, leveraging cultural events, local neighborhoods and diversified attractions to turn visitor arrivals into economic gains.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

26 Oct 2026 at 06:02 HKT · 2 min read

Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law Shuk-pui believes Hong Kong's contrasts – business meetings, countryside hikes and festivals – can persuade travellers to stay longer, spend more and return. As Hong Kong launches its first five-year tourism plan, Law is betting on cultural events and local neighbourhoods to turn visitor arrivals into economic gains.

Hong Kong welcomed 40.7 million visitors in the first nine months of 2026, including 1.41 million mainland travellers during National Day Golden Week, Law said. The government aims to raise tourism's annual value added from HK$86.2 billion in 2024 to HK$126 billion by 2030, and wants visitors from outside mainland China to account for 40 per cent of overnight tourists.

To spread benefits, Law cited Taste Hong Kong, a Tourism Board campaign recommending eateries across all 18 districts, from cha chaan teng to street-food stalls. Another campaign, Hong Kong Good Take, will map about 100 film locations, bringing fans into different neighbourhoods. About one in five visitors from outside China travels onward to the mainland, Law said, but she insisted the city is more than a stopover.

Hong Kong's year-round calendar of international arts, Chinese cultural programmes and festive mega events offers different reasons to return. The Mid-Autumn International Lantern Spectacular drew about 730,000 visits, Law said, while Christmas celebrations and the New Year countdown are followed by Lunar New Year traditions at the Lam Tsuen wishing tree and Wong Tai Sin Temple. The aim, she said, is to generate FOMO – fear of missing out – through unique, time-limited experiences.

Under proposed funding reforms, major performing arts groups would be assessed on their own past attendance, not against other disciplines. Artistic quality and opportunities to perform overseas or on the mainland would also count. In film, Law wants to consolidate support schemes and attract private investment, arguing that Hong Kong cinema must reconnect with moviegoers. In sports, regular international tournaments at Kai Tak Sports Park could encourage trips around sporting events, while a new training scheme would help retired athletes pursue careers in sports management.

Law revealed she has taken up boxing as a hobby, attends regular classes, and describes herself as a foodie who enjoys traditional Chinese restaurants and old-fashioned bakeries. She hikes, recalling a six-hour trek across Lantau, and hopes to try camping or glamping on an outlying island – a childhood wish she hopes to fulfil.

# Between Declarations and Actions: BRICS and the Internationalization of the Chinese Agenda

### How is China leveraging BRICS's transition from declarations to practical mechanisms to advance its global agenda, and what are the strategic implications for the Middle East and Israel?

INSS Insight No. 2205, October 25, 2026

The BRICS summit held in New Delhi in September 2026 demonstrated the organization’s gradual evolution from a forum based primarily on declarations and political and economic coordination into a framework that is also developing practical mechanisms in technology, industry, health, agriculture, and space. For China, this process carries additional significance: BRICS enables it to advance ideas and initiatives originating in Beijing within a multilateral framework it does not control, thereby contributing to the internationalization of China’s global agenda. The article examines these trends, how they were reflected at the New Delhi summit, and their potential implications for the Middle East and Israel. The 18th BRICS Summit, held in New Delhi on September 12–13, 2026, was marked by an effort to deepen cooperation among member states and give it more practical expression. Alongside familiar positions on multipolarity, strengthening the status of the "Global South," reforming international institutions, and expanding the representation of developing nations, the summit highlighted two interconnected trends. The first is BRICS’s gradual evolution from a forum for political and economic coordination into a framework that is also building professional, technological, and institutional networks in industry, technology, health, agriculture, and space. The second is China’s effort to use this process to advance ideas, areas of activity, and mechanisms that it is developing itself within a multilateral framework not under its exclusive control. Precisely because India, Brazil, South Africa, and other countries help shape the agenda and make decisions, turning ideas originating in Beijing into BRICS initiatives is intended, under this approach, to give them a broader international foundation and legitimacy. In other words, the forum can be viewed as an additional platform for internationalizing the Chinese agenda. Both trends remain a work in progress. In many instances, the summit continued trends and decisions announced at earlier summits, including in artificial intelligence, which generated considerable headlines. It is therefore important to distinguish among three stages: announcing initiatives, establishing mechanisms and institutions to advance them, and implementing them in practice. In many areas, BRICS has already advanced from the first stage to the second, but whether many of these mechanisms will be implemented and will have a practical impact remains an open question. content:
台湾政治立场亲蓝的《联合报》公布最新民调显示，民进党高雄市长候选人赖瑞隆以40%支持度，领先国民党候选人柯志恩的33%。不过，未表态选民高达26%、中立选民有53%还在观望。学者分析，高雄选情偏冷，若蓝绿阵营能有效动员支持者、提高投票率，柯志恩仍有翻盘可能。
《联合报》针对高雄市长民调出炉，赖瑞隆以40%支持度领先柯志恩的33%，另有26%选民仍未决定。看好度方面，赖瑞隆以49%高于柯志恩的21%；但在政党倾向上，国民党支持者有88%力挺柯志恩，民进党支持者则有82%肯定赖瑞隆。
民众党支持者中，60%支持柯志恩，只有9%支持赖瑞隆；中立选民则是25%挺柯志恩，22%支持赖瑞隆，53%仍在观望。
《联合报》引述台湾中山大学政治所荣誉教授廖达琪分析，高雄选举关键应为中间选民及民众党支持者动向，前民众党主席柯文哲2024年总统大选曾在高雄拿到35万张票，但柯志恩在民众党支持者只获60%支持，仍有努力空间。
廖达琪说，随着柯赖两人辩论会结束，若能持续掀起话题热度、串联基层，比照2018年冲高投票率，差距仍可能缩小，高雄并非无翻盘机会。
据风传媒报道，高雄市长选战首场电视辩论会上周五（10月30日）晚登场，赖瑞隆及柯志恩针对《财政收支划分法》修法、政治献金及城市建设等议题交锋。
《联合报》也引述中山大学政治经济系特聘教授张其禄说，虽然柯赖民调差七个百分点，若加计蓝绿基本盘，实际差距可能更低。
张其禄称，未表态选民可能会受辩论结果或其他因素影响，只要有百分之三左右选民动摇，都可能改变选举结果。
台湾“九合一”地方选举将于11月28日投票，这场选举结果对13个月后的总统大选有举足轻重的影响。在最受关注的六个直辖市（俗称“六都”）中，国民党目前握有台北、新北、桃园、台中四都，民进党固守台南、高雄两都。

中国人民解放军在福建省平潭岛（距离台湾最近的地方）进行军事演习，一艘中国海警船在岛上巡逻。（示意图/图片来源：ADEK BERRY / AFP via Getty Images） 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
【看中国2026年11月2日讯】（看中国记者立明综合报导）台湾驻英国代表姚金祥近日投书英国大报《每日电讯报》（Daily Telegraph），以俄罗斯舰艇在英国周边海域活动、中国船舶疑似破坏波罗的海海底电缆等事件为例，指出中国与俄罗斯正透过灰色地带行动，挑战国际规范、威胁民主国家安全。他呼吁英国及理念相近国家加强合作，共同反制中共在台湾周边的军事胁迫、监控及海上扩张行动，维护航行自由与区域和平。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
姚金祥在投书中指出，欧洲近年接连发生海上安全事件，包括俄罗斯舰艇多次侵扰英国周边水域，并在海底电缆附近徘徊；2024年也曾发生中国相关船舶疑似刻意拖曳船锚，造成波罗的海光纤电缆受损。这些事件可能涉及对关键基础设施进行情蒐，凸显灰色地带活动已成为民主国家共同面临的安全挑战。
他表示，灰色地带胁迫行动透过低于全面军事冲突的方式，持续侵犯民主国家主权、挑战安全底线，试图在不引发直接战争的情况下，逐步改变既有国际秩序。若相关行为未受到有效吓阻，海上现状及国际规范恐遭侵蚀，让特定国家借此扩张战略利益。
谈及台湾周边情势，姚金祥指出，中共对海域活动常规的破坏尤其明显。10月11日台湾双十国庆结束后，中国随即宣布举行军事演习，声称目的是打击台独及反对外部势力干涉，并于12日展开实弹演训，显示北京无法接受台湾民主自治，持续以军事恫吓施压。
姚金祥认为，中共军演前未充分预告，违反国际海事组织（IMO）、《联合国海洋法公约》（UNCLOS）及《国际民用航空公约》所揭示的相关国际规范，也干扰国际海空交通，影响船舶航行及航空运输安全。
他进一步指出，中共类似行动并非仅限于台湾周边。去年中国海军舰艇曾在澳洲与新西兰之间的塔斯曼海举行实弹演习，同样未充分事先通知，显示北京正试图扩大在印太地区的影响力，并对日本、菲律宾等周边国家形成压力。
姚金祥也警告，中共近年企图在台湾东部海域扩张所谓的执法及管辖权，透过海上活动逐步形成对台湾的包围态势，推进其所谓的“蟒蛇战略”，意图在可能发生军事冲突时，切断台湾与外部世界的联系，增加对台封锁及入侵的可能性。
他强调，中共相关行动不只是台湾面临的威胁，也攸关全球安全与经济。外界估计，若台海爆发战争，全球经济损失可能达全球国内生产毛额（GDP）的10%，同时全球也将面临先进半导体供应中断的冲击，后果难以估计。
姚金祥最后呼吁，国际社会应对中共灰色地带行动采取更有力的回应，不能放任北京与莫斯科持续侵蚀国际法及既有安全秩序。他建议英国与理念相近国家深化海事资讯分享、强化共同韧性，并坚定捍卫航行自由及和平解决争端的原则，避免海洋成为威权国家威胁民主国家安全的工具。

Hong Kong Forum is organizing this fundraiser to benefit Hong Kong Forum Los Angeles.
Hong Kong Forum for Hong Kong Forum Los Angeles
5年過去了，彷彿一切烽煙已經在時間中沈沒，然而有些人仍然選擇不去遺忘。
Five years have passed since Hong Konger's last attempt to maintain their freedom, and it seems that all dust has settled. However, some people still choose not to forget.
經過多方努力，我們在Yermo的自由雕塑公園（Liberty Sculpture Park）建立起了香港地，用藝術去銘記香港人的意志不滅。
After many efforts, we have established Hong Kong Corner in the Liberty Sculpture Park in Yermo, using art to remember the unyielding will of the Hong Kongers.
香港地的維護和創作需要長期的投入，我們亟需你的支持。不論捐款多少，都代表著你對香港所出的一分力。
The maintenance and creation of Yermo's "Hong Kong Corner" requires long-term investment, and we urgently need your support. Any donation, no matter the amount, represents your contribution to the undying spirit of Hong Kongers.
We hope to meet in a free Hong Kong someday.
Donation serves 3 main purposes.
1. 現時香港地有四件展品，沙漠氣候極端，冬寒夏焰，烈日風沙，我們要定期維修，提供防曬材料予連儂牆， 令他們可以日久維新。
1. Currently, Hong Kong Corner has four exhibits. We need to perform regular maintenance for some of the art works and provide sun & water protection sealants in the harsh desert weather condition.
2. 香港抗爭者的雕像現時沒有任何解釋。 在我們維修的過程當中，經常見到美國本地人到訪，但他們對於2019抗爭一事並不了清楚。希望可以籌款建立一塊金屬牌匾， 刻上中英文描述，令到到訪者了解究竟發生了什麼事。
2. The statues of Hong Kong Protesters currently have no explanations. During our maintenance work, we often see local Americans visiting, but they are not familiar with the 2019 protests. We hope to raise funds to establish a metal plaque with descriptions in both Chinese and English to help visitors understand what happened.
3. 自由雕塑公園的創辦人陳維明老師亦為香港地建立了新牆，我們希望可以籌款聘請來自香港的專業藝術家，以壁畫描繪出香港的景況。
3. Mr. Chen Wei Ming, the art creator of Liberty Sculpture Park, has also built a new wall for Hong Kong Land. We hope to raise funds to pay for the expenses of hiring a professional artist from Hong Kong to depict the situation in Hong Kong with a mural.

title: 澳洲超市常见油，每日一勺或助抗癌，另一种需避免食用
source: 澳洲唐人街 – Australia ChinaTown News 中文华人新闻
summary: 一块貌不惊人的甜点，竟能悄悄瓦解人体内耗费上百万治疗费培养出的“抗癌特种兵”。而每天在餐盘中加上一勺清亮的橄榄油，却能让免疫细胞愈战愈勇。 香港大学与国际研究机构联合发表在《Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy》上的最新研究揭示了其中隐藏的真相： 看似微不足道的食用油选择，竟可能成为决定癌症免疫治疗成败的关键！ 图片来源：National Institutes of Health 这项新的研究聚焦于一种强大却对营养极其敏感的免疫细胞
content: 一块貌不惊人的甜点，竟能悄悄瓦解人体内耗费上百万治疗费培养出的“抗癌特种兵”。而每天在餐盘中加上一勺清亮的橄榄油，却能让免疫细胞愈战愈勇。 香港大学与国际研究机构联合发表在《Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy》上的最新研究揭示了其中隐藏的真相： 看似微不足道的食用油选择，竟可能成为决定癌症免疫治疗成败的关键！ 图片来源：National Institutes of Health 这项新的研究聚焦于一种强大却对营养极其敏感的免疫细胞——γδ-T 细胞。 人们日常饮食中的脂肪酸，如橄榄油中的油酸、动物油脂中的棕榈酸，除了提供能量，是否还在默默影响着免疫细胞的战斗力？ 这类细胞在人体免疫系统中既像刺客，也像信使，能直接攻击癌细胞，还能分泌细胞因子调动其他免疫力量。 然而，科学家在分析一批肝癌患者的治疗数据时意外发现，在接受γδ-T细胞疗法的患者中，疗效存在巨大差异。 进一步检测血清发现，那些治疗失败的患者，其血液中一种名为棕榈酸的饱和脂肪酸浓度普遍偏高，且几乎都摄入大量以棕榈油制成的糕点、酥皮食品； 而在反应良好的患者中，血清中油酸的水平则明显高出常人。 图片来源：ABC News 正是这组数据，引出了食用油对抗癌免疫反应影响的惊人秘密。 深入细胞机制层面，研究人员惊讶地发现，棕榈酸竟然诱导γδ-T细胞陷入一种“自杀性亢奋”的状态。 具体而言，棕榈酸在细胞中激活STING-STAT1信号通路，促使细胞不断释放干扰素-γ（IFNγ。这种原本用于攻击癌细胞的武器，过度释放反而触发细胞“焦亡”程序。 细胞膜上出现孔洞，关键的穿孔素、颗粒酶等抗癌分子大量流失，免疫细胞非但无法杀敌，反而先一步崩溃。 更严重的是，线粒体能量系统也随之瘫痪，导致这些原本英勇的“抗癌士兵”完全丧失战斗力。 而在同样的实验中，油酸展现出了惊人的保护力。 在动物实验中，喂食橄榄油高脂饮食的小鼠，其体内γδ-T细胞的抗肿瘤活性显著高于棕榈油组。当同时给予棕榈酸和油酸时，油酸能“中和”棕榈酸的毒性，使γδ-T细胞的功能恢复至接近正常水平。 不仅如此，它还能帮助细胞维持能量供应，提升杀伤效率。 实验数据显示，在补充油酸后，γδ-T细胞的杀伤效率提升了2.8倍，甚至超过了未经损伤的对照组细胞。 油酸的作用机制被形象地称为“披上复活甲”，它能够阻止焦亡导火索——ASC寡聚体的形成，阻断IFNγ的过度分泌，从而让免疫细胞从死亡边缘拉回。 也就是说，当我们在餐桌上选择橄榄油时，或许正在默默增强体内γδ-T细胞的抗肿瘤战斗力。 而早在之前的一项研究中，研究人员就发现了棕榈油之中的棕榈酸和癌症之间的联系： 在棕榈油中发现的这种酸会促进癌症的扩散！ 图片来源：7 News 在巴塞罗那生物医学研究所(IRB)对老鼠进行的一项研究中，研究人员发现，软脂酸会促进癌症在口腔和皮肤中的扩散(称为转移)。 而这种扩散导致全球约90%的癌症死亡！ 该研究小组之前的工作表明，在肿瘤中，只有一小部分细胞有能力到达其他器官并传播癌症。 这些细胞似乎严重依赖脂肪酸，尤其是棕榈酸，而棕榈酸就存在于棕榈油中！ 在这项发表在《自然》杂志上的研究中，研究人员给老鼠喂食了富含棕榈油的临时饮食。 当他们这样做时，他们发现肿瘤细胞变得更具攻击性，使它们更有可能扩散。 研究还发现，在橄榄油和亚麻籽等食物中发现的其他脂肪酸——油酸和亚油酸——并没有出现同样的效果。 除了这项发现，研究人员还在对老鼠饮食中补充棕榈酸时发现，棕榈酸不仅会促进癌细胞的转移扩散，还会对基因组产生长期影响。 即使从饮食中去除棕榈酸，在短时间内接触饮食中棕榈酸的癌细胞仍保持高度转移。 这意味着老鼠体内的癌细胞对棕榈酸产生了“记忆”，即使停止食用棕榈油影响依旧存在。 观察发现，短期内摄入过富含棕榈油饮食的老鼠的肿瘤，以及在体外短暂暴露于棕榈酸的肿瘤细胞，均在暂停高水平棕榈酸的接触或暴露后，仍保持高度肿瘤转移。 对于癌症患者来说，这项研究揭示了癌细胞扩散和棕榈油的关系，能够让他们在日常的饮食中更加注意。 在这项研究中，科学家明确指出，癌细胞对棕榈酸存在高度依赖，尤其在具备转移潜能的肿瘤细胞群体中，棕榈酸不仅提供能量，还通过影响基因表达，使其更具侵略性。 而橄榄油中的油酸和亚麻籽油中的亚油酸则未发现类似效应，反而在一些实验中展现出抑制肿瘤转移的倾向。 因此，这项研究的核心意义在于提醒人们，不仅要关注饮食中的糖分和蛋白质，脂肪酸的类型和比例同样对健康乃至癌症治疗有深远影响。 更为关键的是，这些“好油”与“坏油”并非罕见成分，它们广泛存在于我们日常生活的超市货架之上。 根据世界自然基金会的数据显示，棕榈油是全球消费量最大的植物油之一，因其价格低廉、稳定性高，被广泛用于饼干、巧克力、冰淇淋、人造奶油、方便面和加工面包中。 澳洲超市中你随手买的一包曲奇、一盒冰淇淋、一份冷冻披萨，都可能含有棕榈油。 而橄榄油虽然相对价格较高，但在成分、营养和健康效应上，已经被越来越多医学研究证实为更优选择。 对于癌症患者来说，这些科学发现不仅意味着要远离棕榈油，更可能影响未来治疗方案的设计。 一些领先的癌症研究机构，已开始在细胞治疗方案中加入油酸类保护成分，甚至尝试在冷冻保存剂中添加油酸衍生物，以维持免疫细胞活性。 与此同时，临床医生也正重新审视饮食干预对癌症疗效的可能协同效应。 香港大学的研究团队更是提出，油酸与棕榈酸的比值（PA/OA）有望成为预测γδ-T细胞治疗效果的生物标志物，为精准医疗提供新的检测方向。 当然，并非所有人都需要完全戒除棕榈油。 健康个体在正常膳食结构下偶尔摄入，并不会立刻导致免疫功能崩溃。 但对于已确诊癌症、尤其正在接受免疫疗法的患者来说，选择富含油酸的油脂，减少高棕榈酸食品的摄入，已成为一种有科学依据的辅助策略。 同样是生活中常用的油， 对健康的影响却截然不同。 棕榈油没有那么健康， 但相比之下更加健康的橄榄油， 对健康的影响却截然不同。 虽然对普通人来说， 棕榈油没有那么健康， 也没有那么可怕， 但相比之下更加健康的橄榄油， 显然是更好的选择。

title: Quad Joint Press Release on Economic Prosperity and Security
zh_title: 关于经济繁荣与安全的四方联合新闻稿
summary: 四国发言人办公室关于经济繁荣与安全的联合新闻稿 媒体报道 2026 年 10 月 31 日 以下声明由美国国务卿、澳大利亚外交部长、印度外长和日本外相发布。正文开始：美国国务卿与澳大利亚、印度和日本外长于 2026 年 10 月 31 日在佐治亚州亚特兰大举行会议，讨论正在进行的四方倡议的进展情况，并重申他们对自由开放的印太地区的承诺。四方米
content:
四国发言人办公室关于经济繁荣与安全的联合新闻稿 媒体报道 2026 年 10 月 31 日 以下声明由美国国务卿、澳大利亚外交部长、印度外长和日本外相发布。正文开始：美国国务卿与澳大利亚、印度和日本外长于 2026 年 10 月 31 日在佐治亚州亚特兰大举行会议，讨论正在进行的四方倡议的进展情况，并重申他们对自由开放的印太地区的承诺。四方部长强调经济安全对于维护全球稳定与繁荣的重要性。他们重申致力于建立可靠和开放的全球供应链以及值得信赖和有弹性的基础设施。他们对经济胁迫表示严重关切，包括任意出口限制，以及导致产能过剩、扰乱关键行业全球供应链的非市场政策和做法。认识到关键海上航道、不间断的商业流通、能源安全以及在不征收通行费的情况下海事人员和船只畅通无阻的通行和安全的重要性，他们重申绝对有必要根据《联合国海洋法公约》所反映的国际法保护和维护霍尔木兹海峡、红海和曼德海峡的航行权利和自由。
四方部长们强调了超级智能 (SI)* 和 Pax Silica 等举措对未来经济增长的重要性，并表示打算提供超过 8500 万美元的技术和财政援助，以支持整个印度-太平洋地区获得可信的 SI，包括通过 Quad SI 加速器。四方部长们对威胁国家和国际和平与安全的在线和网络诈骗泛滥表示深切关注。他们谴责犯罪团伙进行诈骗活动和贩卖人口，迫使他们欺骗我们的公民，每年从我们各自国家窃取数百亿美元来之不易的财富。四方国家承诺瓦解这些行动，并追究跨国犯罪集团及其领导人的责任。四方部长们对 2026 年 8 月 26 日山洪爆发中丧生的人们表示哀悼，并强调他们共同致力于在合作伙伴需要时提供支持。他们认识到印度作为尼泊尔救援第一反应者的主导作用，以及所有四方国家对尼泊尔的大力支持。
四方部长们欢迎在促进印度-太平洋地区繁荣的关键举措方面取得的进展，包括：经济繁荣与安全·确保关键矿产供应链安全：根据2026年5月宣布的四方关键矿产倡议框架，四方成员国加强了在关键矿产供应链上的合作，共同努力从电子废物和废料中回收关键矿产，以减少对任何单一供应商的依赖。他们欢迎私营部门主导的对废物收集网络、加工厂和炼油厂的投资，与四方国家合作建立值得信赖的关键矿物回收价值链。他们欢迎美国承诺提供1000万美元用于促进印度基础设施建设
