title: Hello Kitty firm apologises, scraps Japan TV tie-up after China anger
zh_title: 因中国愤怒，Hello Kitty 公司道歉并取消与日本电视合作
summary: 人气角色 Hello Kitty 背后的日本公司三丽鸥周四就其与一部被批评反华的电视间谍剧的合作道歉，并取消了与该剧的商品合作。 Hello Kitty x Vivant 联名款。照片：三丽鸥。几天前，中国赞助商因批评共产党领导人毛泽东是“独裁者”而放弃了足球巨星基利安·姆巴佩，这位皇家马德里前锋后来为此道歉。在日本广受观众欢迎的电视剧《Vivant》中，有一集描绘了一个中国附属组织折磨一名日本人的画面。
content:
人气角色 Hello Kitty 背后的日本公司三丽鸥周四就其与一部被批评反华的电视间谍剧的合作道歉，并取消了与该剧的商品合作。 Hello Kitty x Vivant 联名款。照片：三丽鸥。几天前，中国赞助商因批评共产党领导人毛泽东是“独裁者”而放弃了足球巨星基利安·姆巴佩，这位皇家马德里前锋后来为此道歉。在日本广受观众欢迎的电视剧《Vivant》中，有一集描绘了一个与中国有联系的组织正在折磨日本军方非官方间谍部队的一名成员。三丽鸥在一份声明中表示：“我们最近收到了各方关于与日剧《VIVANT》合作商品的反馈。” “对于这可能引起的任何担忧，我们深表歉意。”声明称，该项目“包含与三丽鸥集团企业理念不一致的表述”。三丽鸥表示，它“决定停止此次合作，以及所有后续项目和促销活动”。 Hello Kitty 和其他可爱的三丽鸥角色在一系列新奇商品中被描绘成《Vivant》（目前是第二季）中的角色。在道歉之前，中国官方媒体《环球时报》指责该节目“抹黑中国”，称其“在社交媒体上引发了震惊和强烈反弹”。 《Vivant》第一季的宣传图片。
图片来源：Netflix。该剧反映了“当前日本保守右翼政府的反华叙事，迎合了日本社会右翼极端主义的潮流”。自从日本首相高市早苗去年暗示日本可能对台湾问题进行军事干预以来，两国之间长期冷淡的关系已经恶化。北京声称自治的台湾是其领土，并誓言有一天会控制它。制作《Vivant》的私人广播公司 TBS 在给法新社的一份声明中表示，这部电视剧“完全是虚构的娱乐作品”。声明称：“绝对无意传递贬低任何特定国家或伤害公众情绪的信息。”该网络总裁告诉日本媒体，TBS“绝不采取煽动国家间冲突或纵容使用武力或暴力的立场”。在三丽鸥宣布这一消息之前，中国社交媒体平台微博上发表的评论愤怒地批评了这一商品合作。 “三丽鸥，你是一个传达美丽和善良信息的品牌，你为什么涉足这个领域？”一篇帖子说。 “这令人失望，”另一位写道。
“创始人长期参加各种反战活动，三丽鸥最初是建立在停止战争、珍视和平的理想之上的。”在三丽鸥发表声明后，中国外交部发言人郭家琨在周四的例行新闻发布会上回应了这些抱怨。2025 年 4 月 21 日，中国外交部发言人郭家琨在新闻发布会上。图片：中国外交部。他说：“这部电视剧再次暴露了日本国内长期存在着一股利用文化产品污蔑抹黑中国、散布反华情绪的势力。” “这应该引起国际社会和日本国内开明人士的警惕。”继姆巴佩之后，全国也出现了类似的愤怒

【原文 English Original】
Sanrio, the Japanese company behind the popular character Hello Kitty, apologised on Thursday over its tie-up with a TV spy drama criticised as anti-China, cancelling a merchandise collaboration with the show. Hello Kitty x Vivant collab. Photo: Sanrio. It comes days after Chinese sponsors dropped football superstar Kylian Mbappe over comments calling communist leader Mao Zedong a “dictator”, for which the Real Madrid forward later apologised. In one episode of “Vivant”, a drama with a wide audience in Japan, a Chinese-affiliated organisation had been depicted torturing a member of the Japanese military’s unofficial spy unit. “We have recently received feedback from various quarters regarding the collaborative merchandise with the Japanese television drama VIVANT,” Sanrio said in a statement. “We sincerely apologise for any concern this may have caused.” The project “contains expressions that are inconsistent with the Sanrio Group’s corporate philosophy”, it said. Sanrio said it had “decided to cease this collaboration, as well as all subsequent projects and promotional campaigns”. Hello Kitty and other cute Sanrio characters had been depicted as characters from “Vivant” — currently in its second season — in a range of novelty merchandise items. Before the apology, Chinese state media outlet the Global Times had accused the show of “smearing China”, saying it had “sparked shock and fierce backlash on social media”. Promotional image for the first season of Vivant. Photo: Netflix. The series reflects the “anti-China narrative of the current conservative Japanese right-wing administration, catering to the trend of right-wing extremism in Japanese society”, it said. Long-frosty ties between the countries have worsened since Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi suggested last year that Japan could intervene militarily in any conflict over Taiwan. Beijing claims self-ruled Taiwan as its territory and has vowed to bring it under control one day. ‘Beauty and goodness’ The drama “is a completely fictional entertainment work”, private broadcaster TBS, which created “Vivant”, said in a statement to AFP. “There is absolutely no intention to deliver messages that disparage any particular nation or hurt public sentiment,” it said. The network’s president told Japanese media that TBS “does not in any way take a position that foments conflict between nations or condones the use of force or violence”. Comments posted on Chinese social media platform Weibo before Sanrio’s announcement had angrily criticised the merchandise tie-up. “Sanrio, you are a brand for conveying a message of beauty and goodness, why have you got involved with this?” one post said. “It’s disappointing,” read another. “The founder has long taken part in various anti-war activities, and Sanrio was originally founded on the ideals of stopping war and cherishing peace.” Chinese foreign ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun echoed the complaints at a regular news briefing on Thursday, following Sanrio’s statement. Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun at a press conference on April 21, 2025. Photo: China’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs. “This television drama once again reveals the persistent existence inside Japan of a force that seeks to use cultural products to vilify and smear China and spread anti-Chinese sentiment,” he said. “This should raise alarm amongst the international community and enlightened individuals within Japan.” The furore follows similar ire from the country over Mbappe’s comments. Real Madrid apologised to Beijing on Wednesday after their French star striker apparently joked about Chinese former leader Mao, sparking a social media storm that saw Spanish football yanked off Chinese state TV. Mocking Mao — blamed by historians for millions of deaths — is taboo in China. In a clip of a video interview with French show “The Bridge” — since taken down — Mbappe talked about being amused by an internet meme of his face photoshopped onto “some guy, think he’s a Chinese dictator”. Mbappe issued his own apology on Tuesday, saying: “My comment was ill-judged and I now understand that it hurt many people in China and in Chinese communities around the world.”

title: Finland’s defense minister talks NATO, Ukraine and fishing
zh_title: 芬兰国防部长谈论北约、乌克兰和渔业
summary: 芬兰国防部长安蒂·哈卡宁于10月21日访问新西兰，与当地官员讨论安全问题。他的旅行日程还包括澳大利亚和日本，这表明尽管地理距离遥远，但北欧国家对该地区的兴趣。芬兰政府在访问前发布的一份声明中援引哈卡宁的话说：“我们正在加强与印太地区伙伴的关系。此外，我们看到了深化国防物资合作的大量机会。”他在惠灵顿接受了《国防新闻》的简短采访
content:
芬兰国防部长安蒂·哈卡宁于10月21日访问新西兰，与当地官员讨论安全问题。他的旅行日程还包括澳大利亚和日本，这表明尽管地理距离遥远，但北欧国家对该地区的兴趣。芬兰政府在访问前发布的一份声明中援引哈卡宁的话说：“我们正在加强与印太地区伙伴的关系。此外，我们看到了深化国防物资合作的大量机会。”他在惠灵顿接受了《国防新闻》的简短采访。芬兰准备接纳哪些北约资产？当我们加入北约时，我们就做好了在全国范围内保卫自己的准备。作为北约成员国，我们的首要责任是建立强大的国防，目前欧洲在海军、空军和太空领域拥有大量资产。我们在北极地区的芬兰土地上建立了北约北欧陆地总部。所以我们正在领导陆地防御。您认为芬兰国防的首要任务是什么？我们的国防政策有四大支柱。第一个是芬兰本身必须永远、永远准备好保卫我们自己的国家。其次，北约在北欧的实力很强。现在我们已经建立了北约在北极地区行动的能力，因此我们非常高兴看到北约越来越有能力在北部地区采取行动。
相关芬兰因无人机风险关闭领空，限制俄罗斯附近的海上交通芬兰军方表示，它关闭了芬兰的一段领空，并限制了该国南部海岸靠近俄罗斯边境的海上交通。第三，与不同国家的防务合作。一些国家——例如美国和欧洲国家——正在制定如何在危机情况下共同行动的行动计划，所以这是第三个支柱。支持北约第五条。第四个支柱是综合安全。我们必须从自己的国家获得足够的东西：能源、食品、国防工业的设备。我们为近 550 万人提供了民用避难所[编者注：芬兰总人口的大部分]，整个社会必须做好在危机模式下采取行动的准备。即使战争爆发，每家公司都必须计划如何运营。我们正在对这些支柱进行大力开发和投资。芬兰人的做事方式是高性价比、高品质、双赢。我们不仅仅是说芬兰需要一些东西，我们还准备提供我们的知识和专业知识。你们的 NH90 运营与新西兰的运营相比如何？一开始就遇到了困难。但现在我们的特种部队和陆军正在使用 NH90，它们是根据芬兰的需求和我们的特殊环境进行定制的。
我们的飞行员非常满意，当他们将NH90与现在市场上的其他一些设备进行比较时，他们认为这仍然是最好的。芬兰如何支持乌克兰？各个政治层面都高度重视。我们是乌克兰军队的坚定支持者。我们提供了大量资金，因为我们看到，如果乌克兰不阻止俄罗斯，俄罗斯对欧洲的渴望就会增加，他们就会做出一些令人讨厌的事情。支持乌克兰也是支持我们自身的安全，这向世界各地所有其他独裁者表明，民主国家团结一致支持乌克兰并反对针对邻国的暴力。这就是为什么我们很高兴看到新西兰也[支持]乌克兰。法国

【原文 English Original】
Finland’s Defense Minister Antti Häkkänen visited New Zealand on Oct. 21 to discuss security issues with officials there. His travel agenda also included Australia and Japan, signaling the Northern European country’s interest in the region despite the geographical distance. “We are reinforcing our relations with partners in the Indo-Pacific region. In addition, we see plenty of opportunities to deepen defense materiel cooperation,” Häkkänen was quoted as saying in a statement released by the Finnish government ahead of the trip. He caught up with Defense News in Wellington for a brief interview. What NATO assets is Finland prepared to host? When we joined NATO we were prepared, nationally, to defend ourselves. As a NATO member our first responsibility is a strong, national defense with lots of European assets in the Navy, Air Force and also in space nowadays. We have established NATO’s northern Europe’s land headquarters in the Arctic area, on Finnish soil. So we are leading the land defense. What are your priorities for Finland’s defense? We have four pillars in our defense policy. The first one is that Finland, by itself, has to be always, always, ready to defend our own country. Second, is strong NATO in northern Europe. Now we have built NATO’s capabilities to operate in Arctic areas, so we are really happy to see that  NATO’s evermore able to act in the north. Related Finland closes airspace, restricts maritime traffic near Russia over drone risk Finland’s military said it closed a section of Finnish airspace and restricted maritime traffic off the country’s southern coast near the Russian border. Third, is defense corporation with different countries. Some countries — for example the United States and European countries — are in operational planning on how to act together in crisis situations, so that’s the third pillar. Supporting NATO’s Article five.  And the fourth pillar is comprehensive security. We have to have enough from our own country: energy, food, equipment from the defense industry. We have civil shelters for almost 5.5 million people [ editor’s note: much of Finland’s total population ], and the whole society has to be prepared to act in crisis mode. Every company has to plan how they can operate, even if war starts. We are developing and investing heavily in those pillars. The Finnish way to do things is cost-effective, high-quality and win-win. We are not just saying that Finland needs something, we’re also ready to provide our knowledge, our expertise. How do your NH90 operations compare with New Zealand’s? There were difficulties at the start. But now our special forces and our land forces are using the NH90 and they have been customized to Finnish needs, to our special environment. Our pilots are really satisfied and when they have compared NH90 to some other equipment that is now in the market, they think that this is still the best one.  How is Finland supporting Ukraine ? Heavily, by all the political levels. We are heavy supporters of Ukrainian military from our stocks. We are giving a lot of money, because we see that if Ukraine doesn’t stop Russia, Russia’s hunger will grow for Europe and they will do something nasty. Supporting Ukraine is also supporting our own security and it shows all the other dictators around the world that democratic nations are united to support Ukraine and oppose violence against neighbors. That’s why we are really happy to see that New Zealand’s also [supporting] Ukraine.  France has offered to extend its nuclear deterrent to Europe, what do you think of that proposal ? Let me be clear, NATO’s nuclear deterrence comes [from] U.S. weapon systems, that’s for sure, but France gives an additional, extra deterrence and that will create some strategic dilemmas for Putin. Related Macron opens door to deploying French nuclear forces to European allies The plan is a “major evolution” of France’s deterrence posture, the president said in a long-awaited speech at the Île Longue naval base in Brittany. What keeps you awake at night ? My kids! I have two small kids and I live at the eastern border, at the Russian border, so I’m cool. I fish there, in beautiful lakes, and I have my house there with my family, so I’m taking it easy, like everyone who lives [there]. That’s a strong border.  We have always tried to have diplomatic relations with Russia, but throughout history, from Catherine the Great to Peter the Great, Russians have always been willing to use violence, against their own people, but also against their neighbors. That’s why Finland has been always pragmatic in defense and security, you have to always be ready. That’s why we are so cool and calm. There [are] a million reservists in Finland, everyone has had military training. We know that Russia is a threat, but we have to just do our stuff, be prepared to invest heavily, keep our friends close, get new friends globally and do stuff right —that’s the Finnish way to handle a difficult security situation. The Joint Expeditionary Force, is that proving useful? JEF is one of the most important defense operations for Finnish and northern Europe’s defense. We think that the most valuable part of JEF is that it can react fast; JEF has already operated, so there’s no need to wait for some kind of clear Article Five case. How can New Zealand’s forces support yours? Well, we are now having this dialogue between our partners … there’s different kinds of possibilities with different organizations. For example, today we discussed space capabilities, Finland has a lot of space companies and a lot of technological expertise, but New Zealand has different kinds of space capability, launching, for example. Also countering problems with undersea cables. Do you see Ukraine joining NATO? Maybe someday. Ukraine’s path is to the West, to their democratic alliances in Europe. But all the NATO countries have to approve it and U.S. and other countries have said no at this point. About a quarter of New Zealand’s defense force consists of women, do you know the percentage of women in Finland’s forces? It’s much smaller, but it’s rising. All the men are obliged to participate and it’s voluntary for women. The number of women are growing now because everyone in Finland wants to participate. Is everyone still happy in Finland? Yeah, we’re the happiest nation in the world, for nine years in a row. Even though there’s some challenges and dark clouds in the war in Europe, still people in Finland are quite cool. Russia is building new military infrastructure near our borders, so we have to do more for our security. But we can do it, it’s not a big problem. I’m optimistic. The Finnish mindset … it’s kind of a mixup of reason and optimism. You face the world as it is. You have to adapt, take your chances, find the possibilities in economy, security and do the best that you can do.

title: U.S. Marines Deploy Neros Archer Drone in Camp Fuji Exercise
zh_title: 美国海军陆战队在富士营演习中部署 Neros Archer 无人机
summary: 2026 年 10 月 20 日，第 31 海军陆战队远征队第 1/1 营登陆队 3 号首席准尉史蒂文·温恩 (Steven Winn) 向观察员介绍了 Neros Archer 无人机的性能。 美国海军陆战队照片 美国海军陆战队宣布，最近在日本富士营举行的实弹演习中首次使用了 Neros Archer 无人机。 10 月 20 日，海军陆战队第 31 远征部队第 1/1 营登陆队的海军陆战队员在富士营联合兵种训练中心使用尼罗斯弓箭手根据两种不同的场景执行了两次打击任务
content:
2026 年 10 月 20 日，第 31 海军陆战队远征队第 1/1 营登陆队 3 号首席准尉史蒂文·温恩 (Steven Winn) 向观察员介绍了 Neros Archer 无人机的性能。 美国海军陆战队照片 美国海军陆战队宣布，最近在日本富士营举行的实弹演习中首次使用了 Neros Archer 无人机。 10 月 20 日，第 31 海军陆战队远征部队 (MEU) 第 1/1 营登陆队的海军陆战队员在富士营联合兵种训练中心使用尼罗斯弓箭手执行了两次打击任务，该任务基于两种不同的场景，作为与该部队猎杀队相关的概念验证。 Neros Archer 是目前海军陆战队由第一人称视角飞行员驾驶的单向攻击无人机的记录项目。海军陆战队于 2025 年 11 月向 Neros 签订了一份合同，将在整个舰队海军陆战队中部署数量不详的 Neros Archer 无人机。无人机的猎杀概念是指情报、监视和侦察 (ISR) 无人机探测和跟踪目标，将坐标传递给配对的 FPV 攻击无人机操作员，由其执行精确的动能打击。据军种新闻稿称，本月的演习旨在扩展海军陆战队击败装甲部队和拦截对手地面通讯的能力。
海军陆战队第 31 远征部队第 1/1 营登陆队在 2026 年 10 月 20 日举行的训练演习期间，在富士营机动区联合兵种训练中心首次测试了 Neros Archer 无人机。美国海军陆战队照片 一个飞行场景被设计为反装甲伏击。 CATC 富士爆炸军械中心技术人员也参加了无人机测试，因为无人机配备了炸药有效载荷。该部门表示，这两种情况都成功引爆了目标。 10 月 20 日，数十名观察员观看了演习，海军陆战队驾驶无人机进行了两次单独的飞行。公布的演习图像显示，日本陆上自卫队成员观看了演习。 Neros Archer 无人机由从一等兵到中士等级别的初级海军陆战队员操作，单位领导亲自挑选一名海军陆战队员参加为期三周的训练课程。服务公告中写道，没有无人机经验是选择的唯一先决条件，因为没有什么可比较的，它确保操作员能够掌握 Neros Archer 无人机所需的技能。 “所有这些都是由士官和非士官处理的，”军士长说。格伦·代顿 (Glenn Dayton)，第 31 远征部队登陆队 1/1 营武器连连作战长。 “你看到的是我们地面部队的核心和灵魂。这不是由军士或军官执行的，我认为这是一个重要的方面。
我们的下级士兵是我们掌握这门手艺的人。”驻日本的美国海军陆战队也一直在尝试从海上平台部署“尼洛斯弓箭手”，在岸上执行侦察任务。五角大楼发布的图像显示，作为部队部署计划的一部分，与第 3 海军陆战师第 4 海军陆战团一起前沿部署的第 7 海军陆战团第 3 营的一名海军陆战队员，于 9 月 18 日在冲绳海岸附近的 B 型多任务侦察艇上发射了一架 Neros Archer 无人机。 与第 4 海军陆战队前沿部署的第 7 海军陆战团第 3 营的一名美国海军陆战队员海军陆战队第三师团，隶属于该部队

【原文 English Original】
Chief Warrant Officer 3 Steven Winn, Battalion Gunner, Battalion Landing Team 1/1, 31st Marine Expeditionary Unit, points out capabilities of the Neros Archer drone for observers, October 20, 2026. US Marine Corps photo The U.S. Marine Corps recently used the Neros Archer First Person View drone in a live-fire exercise at Camp Fuji, Japan, for the first time, the service announced. Marines of Battalion Landing Team 1/1, 31st Marine Expeditionary Unit (MEU) carried out two strike missions on Oct. 20 at Combined Arms Training Center, Camp Fuji with the Neros Archer based on two different scenarios as a proof of concept tied to the unit’s hunter-killer teams. Neros Archer is the current Marine Corps’ program of record for one-way attack drones flown by a first-person view pilot. The Marine Corps issued a contract in November of 2025 to Neros for an unspecified number of Neros Archer drones to be deployed across the Fleet Marine Force. The hunter-killer concept for drones sees an Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) drone detecting and tracking targets, passing coordinates to a paired FPV strike-drone operator who executes a precision kinetic strike. The exercises this month were meant to extend the Marines’ capabilities with defeating armor and interdicting ground line communications of adversaries, according to a service news release . Battalion Landing Team 1/1, 31st Marine Expeditionary Unit Marines tested out the Neros Archer drone, for the first time, on the Combined Arms Training Center, Camp Fuji maneuver area during a training exercise held October 20, 2026. US Marine Corps photo One flight scenario was designed as an anti-armor ambush. CATC Camp Fuji Explosive Ordnance technicians also attended the drone test as the drones were equipped with explosive payloads. Both scenarios involved successful detonations of the targets, the service said. A few dozen observers watched the exercise as the Marines flew the drone for two separate flights on Oct. 20. Imagery released of the exercise show that members of the Japan Ground Self-Defense Force observed the drills. Neros Archer drones are operated by junior enlisted Marines between the ranks of lance corporal to sergeant with unit leadership hand-picking a Marine to take part in the three-week training course. No prior drone experience is the only pre-requisite for selection as with nothing to compare to, it ensures that the operator can master the skills needed for the Neros Archer drone, the service announcement reads. “All this is handled by non-commissioned officers and non-NCOs,” said Master Sgt. Glenn Dayton, Company Operations Chief, Weapons Company, Battalion Landing Team 1/1, 31st MEU. “You’re looking at the heart and soul of our ground force. This is not executed by staff NCO or officers, I think that’s a huge aspect. Our lower enlisted are the ones we rely on to master this craft.” Japan-based U.S. Marines have also been experimenting with deploying Neros Archer from maritime platforms to carry out reconnaissance missions at the shore. A Pentagon imagery release shows a Marine of 3rd Battalion 7th Marine Regiment, forward deployed with 4th Marine Regiment, 3rd Marine Division, as part of the Unit Deployment Program, launching a Neros Archer drone from a Multi-Mission Reconnaissance Craft-B off the coast of Okinawa on Sept. 18. A U.S. Marine with 3rd Battalion 7th Marine Regiment, forward deployed with 4th Marine Regiment, 3rd Marine Division, as part of the Unit Deployment Program, launches a Neros Archer first-person view attack drone from a Multi-Mission Reconnaissance Craft-B off the coast of Okinawa, Japan, Sept. 18, 2026. US Marine Corps photo “The training served as a proof of concept for employing small unmanned aircraft systems from maritime platforms in support of sea-to-shore operations,” reads the image caption. Late last month, the drone was used in the U.S. National Drone Association Drone Crucible 26.3 exercise and competition held Sept. 27 to Oct. 2 in Starke, Fla. “In an evolving battlefield the Marines of 2nd [Marine Division] are using exercises such as the Drone Crucible to refine their skills, combat these developing threats and maintain the legacy as the tip of the spear,” reads a Marine Corps news release . The USNDA-hosted exercise is primarily focused on modernizing squad-level capabilities in the use of drones and counter-drone technologies and tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTP) and also works to enhance squad level capabilities through employment and evaluation of short-term future systems, according to a USNDA description of the exercise. U.S. Marine Corps Cpl. Brian Mckean, left, and Cpl. Aiden Brawley, both Small Unmanned Aircraft Systems operators with Division Training Company, Headquarters Battalion, 2nd Marine Division, fly a Neros Archer first-person view drone during United States National Drone Association Drone Crucible Competition 26.3 in Starke, Florida, Oct. 1, 2026. US Marine Corps photo The 2nd Marine Division conducted approximately 140 Small Unmanned Aerial Systems (SUAS) flights during Drone Crucible to assess system durability, develop new standard operating procedures and build pilot proficiency under various flight conditions, including in low light. “The fight doesn’t stop just because the sun goes down,” said 2nd Lt. Tanner Wodovick, a platoon commander with 2nd Battalion, 2nd Marine Regiment, 2nd MARDIV.“It’s a new experience for the pilot, so we’re getting them used to it.” Low-light operations added another layer of complexity for the drone team, reads the 2nd Marine Division release. For the competition, pilots used thermal cameras to positively identify targets before striking. The team developed hand and arm signals to reduce noise signatures at night. The training helped operators become familiar with night-flight procedures and use their systems effectively in low-light conditions, the service said. “We’re testing out new thermal cameras for the drones. Being able to fly at night is a new capability of ours, as well as doing night strikes and flying inside buildings with these drones.” said Sgt. Xander Morris, a drone operator with 2nd Battalion, 2nd Marine Regiment, 2nd MARDIV. Drone Crucible is designed to enable flexible field experimentation and a key part of that experimentation was testing hunter-killer integration at the small-unit level, giving drone teams a chance to develop standard operating procedures in complex urban environments, including long-distance navigation and operations within structures. “We can strike a target with precision and also have the capability to have an ISR platform up in the air to be able to give us corrections, spotting and do long-range strikes beyond line-of-sight strikes,” said Morris. “It’s really good training and whatever tactics we see fit, we can try out here.”

title: Tech and AI leaders expand China’s 2026 rich list as DeepSeek founder makes debut
zh_title: DeepSeek 创始人首次亮相，科技和人工智能领军人物扩大了中国 2026 年富豪榜
summary: 今年，中国的超级富豪数量创下历史新高，随着中国扩大人工智能影响力，包括 DeepSeek 创始人在内的科技巨头也加入了备受关注的富豪榜。德国西部美因河畔法兰克福，智能手机屏幕上的中国 Deepseek AI 应用程序的徽标和笔记本电脑屏幕上的中国 Kimi AI 应用程序的徽标（上）。照片：基里尔·库德里亚夫采夫/法新社。根据周二发布的年度胡润中国富豪榜，身家超过 50 亿元人民币（7.5 亿美元）的人数增至创纪录的 1,529 人，使上一届胡润富豪榜相形见绌。
content:
今年，中国的超级富豪数量创下历史新高，随着中国扩大人工智能影响力，包括 DeepSeek 创始人在内的科技巨头也加入了备受关注的富豪榜。德国西部美因河畔法兰克福，智能手机屏幕上的中国 Deepseek AI 应用程序的徽标和笔记本电脑屏幕上的中国 Kimi AI 应用程序的徽标（上）。照片：基里尔·库德里亚夫采夫/法新社。根据周二发布的年度胡润中国富豪榜，身家超过 50 亿元人民币（7.5 亿美元）的人数增至创纪录的 1,529 人，远超之前 2021 年 1,460 人的最高纪录。人工智能初创公司 DeepSeek 的创始人梁文峰首次以 417 亿美元的财富排名第七，是主要来自半导体、人工智能和机器人等行业的 263 名新富豪之一。他的财富因 DeepSeek 去年发布的震撼行业的 R1 推理模型而增加，引发了美国科技股的抛售。发布该榜单的胡润研究院首席研究员胡润表示，今年的榜单反映了中国的“双速经济”，即科技财富激增，而传统财富却在下降。在前 100 名企业中，有 60% 在中国​​所瞄准的行业中发家致富，这是中国 2015 年启动的一项计划的一部分，该计划旨在在 10 年内发展技术领先地位。 “今年是‘中国制造2025’回归的一年，”胡润在一份新闻稿中表示。
字节跳动创始人张一鸣成为 2024 年中国首富，他以 997 亿美元的财富估计重登榜首，创下了该榜单的纪录。 TikTok 应用。照片：Anton/Pexels。他超越了农夫山泉创始人钟珊珊，被誉为“瓶装水大王”。字节跳动（包括 TikTok 和抖音）在全球范围内面临着越来越大的监管压力，但其人工智能聊天机器人豆宝拥有近 4.2 亿月活跃用户，远远领先于国内竞争对手。宁德时代创始人曾彦宏、腾讯马化腾、网易丁磊和寒武纪陈天石也跻身前十。据报道，DeepSeek即将完成新一轮1000亿元人民币的融资，创下中国人工智能行业的纪录，这将使该公司的估值约为5000亿元人民币。周三发布的胡润中国女富豪榜中，触摸屏制造商蓝思科技创始人周群芳以 189 亿美元的财富稳居榜首。

【原文 English Original】
The number of mega-wealthy people in China reached an all-time high this year, with tech tycoons including the founder of DeepSeek joining a closely watched rich list as the country expands its AI reach. The logo of China’s Deepseek AI application on a smartphone screen and the logo of he logo of China’s Kimi AI application on a laptop screen (top) in Frankfurt am Main, western Germany. Photo: Kirill Kudryavtsev/AFP. The number of people worth more than 5 billion yuan ($750 million) rose to a record 1,529, according to the annual Hurun China Rich List released Tuesday, dwarfing the previous high of 1,460 in 2021. Liang Wenfeng, the founder of AI startup DeepSeek, made his debut at number seven with an estimated fortune of $41.7 billion — one of 263 newcomers largely from sectors including semiconductors, AI and robotics. His wealth was pumped up by DeepSeek’s industry-shaking R1 reasoning model released last year, triggering a sell-off in US tech stocks. This year’s roster reflected China’s “two-speed economy”, which has seen tech fortunes surge as traditional wealth declines, said Rupert Hoogewerf, chief researcher at the Hurun Research Institute, which publishes the list. Of the top 100, 60 percent made their fortunes in sectors targeted by China as part of a plan launched in 2015 to develop technological leadership within 10 years. “This was the year ‘Made in China 2025’ came home,” Hoogewerf said in a news release. ByteDance founder Zhang Yiming, China’s richest man in 2024, reclaimed the top spot with an estimated fortune of $99.7 billion — a record for the list. The TikTok app. Photo: Anton/Pexels. He overtook Nongfu Spring founder Zhong Shanshan, known as the “Bottled Water King”. ByteDance, which includes TikTok and Douyin, has faced growing regulatory pressure worldwide but its AI chatbot Doubao had nearly 420 million monthly active users — far ahead of domestic rivals. CATL founder Robin Zeng, Tencent’s Pony Ma, NetEase’s William Ding and Cambricon’s Chen Tianshi also made the top 10. DeepSeek is reportedly close to completing a new funding round worth 100 billion yuan — a record for China’s AI industry — which would value the company at around 500 billion yuan. Hurun’s list of China’s richest women, which was released on Wednesday, saw Zhou Qunfang, founder of touchscreen maker Lens Technology, retain her top position, with a $18.9 billion fortune.

title: Exiled Russian dissident Navalnaya warns dictators becoming 'more cunning'
summary: The widow of Russian opposition leader Alexei Navalny warned Tuesday that dictators are becoming "more cunning", as she helped launch a report revealing deepening global ties between autocrats and authoritarian-leaning parties. Yulia Navaln
content:
The widow of Russian opposition leader Alexei Navalny warned Tuesday that dictators are becoming "more cunning", as she helped launch a report revealing deepening global ties between autocrats and authoritarian-leaning parties.

Yulia Navalnaya, who heads the US-based Human Rights Foundation (HRF), urged people not to underestimate the threat that "very dangerous" dictators and their networks pose, arguing they can "only be defeated if those who fight for freedom cooperate too".

"They learn from one another, they work together," she told journalists in London at the launch of the new report, which finds European far-right parties are increasingly coordinating with authoritarian regimes beyond the continent.

"They turn to their own advantage the tools that free and democratic countries give them," she said.

"They know how to exploit the financial and legal systems of Western countries, how to get around restrictions and sanctions."

Navalnaya's husband Navalny, a staunch critic of Russian President Vladimir Putin, died in prison in 2024 while serving a 19-year sentence.

Five European countries, including Britain, France and Germany, concluded earlier this year that he was killed by a "rare toxin" from a dart frog and that the Russian state was the prime suspect.

Navalnaya, 50, has become Russia's leading exiled opposition figure, touring the world to meet foreign leaders, organising opposition rallies and publishing investigations into the alleged corruption of Putin's inner circle.

Asked about US special envoy Steve Witkoff recently telling Putin he was a humanitarian, she called the comment "nonsense" and "a pity".

- 'Crush dissent' -

The HRF collaborated with another US-based non-profit, Action for Democracy, to produce its latest "Authoritarian Collaboration Index" trends report.

It relies on data from HRF's "Tyranny Tracker", a real-time monitoring tool of ties between autocratic regimes, authoritarian-leaning governments and far-right parties.

The paper reported that such parties in Europe, such as Nigel Farage's Reform UK, Marine Le Pen's National Rally in France and Alice Weidel's Alternative for Germany (AfD), are now formalising links to "legitimise" each other.

The study said the AfD had this year "deepened its relations with Russia" beyond financial support towards more "dialogue and engagement".

The warnings come ahead of imminent elections in a host of European countries, including Spain, Germany and France, when far-right parties could make unprecedented gains.

The report found that while China and Russia remain the "primary anchors of a global axis of autocracy", media and technological cooperation has become "institutionalised" between similarly minded countries and parties, particularly across Africa and southeast Asia.

Domonkos Kovacs, project lead for the index, said that, amid "global democratic backsliding", the index aimed to "shed light" on this growing "global authoritarian solidarity".

"This is dictators helping each other crush dissent," he told reporters.

title: Donate to Support the Contemporary Uyghur Anthology, organized by Uyghur Anthology
summary: The Contemporary Uyghur Anthology is a publication that platforms Uyghur (and anyone drawing their roots from East Turkistan) artists and writers in the diaspora by providing a space that is often inaccessible to those in our community. The
content:
The Contemporary Uyghur Anthology is a publication that platforms Uyghur (and anyone drawing their roots from East Turkistan) artists and writers in the diaspora by providing a space that is often inaccessible to those in our community. There are no other projects of its kind in the English language, and with two volumes already published, we hope to take this project to the next level. It's a rare look at Uyghur expression in an environment where all our stories are told by people pushing their own narratives without the intimate knowledge of our lived experiences.

<"Manifesto" by Sumayah Jurad from Vol. II>

We asked ourselves these questions - why wait for others to invite us to the table when we can pull up a chair and introduce ourselves? Why let others speak for us without trying first to speak? Our broken English can only be improved with audacity, and world literature is only enriched by the presence of new voices.

All-in-all, our efforts have been met with support from our community and pleasant surprise from those who did not know what they did not know.

Somewhat unprecedented is that we publish the authors' original language alongside the translation. Our book is filled with Uyghur, Latin, Cyrillic, and Chinese script to encapsulate as much of our community's experience as we can.

**Our Story**

There are many publications in diaspora communities that platform East and South Asians, SEA, MENA, and more. Central Asia is often underrepresented in world literature or Asia-specific publications, and occupied territories even less so. Uyghurs themselves have been a relatively new diaspora community in English-speaking countries, and haven't had the opportunities to grow their literary or artistic communities. Many don't have the tools to nurture their talents, or knowledge of creative networks or opportunities, even when many journals seek work from underrepresented groups. In instances where they are aware, it's difficult to be published in this competitive field without the education and styles that publications look for. There are only a handful of literary translators translating from Uyghur to English, and not many Uyghurs who have had the chances to develop their creative language when learning English.

To sum up, the issues were:

*   No spaces for Uyghur writers and artists to develop their skills
*   A disconnect from artist communities, be it local or online
*   Lack of awareness of opportunities
*   No bridge between our native tongue and English, and in turn, world literature

So, we put together a small group at the Tarim Network to take on this challenge. Completely volunteer-run; the very essence of a passion project. We did a call-out for anything and all. New writers, established writers, any language, any genre, whatever we could print in a book. And here we were, the first book of its kind, created to speak for ourselves without outsider voices, without a publishing house, raw and straight from the source.

<From the launch of Vol. I at Harvard University>

The blurb from our first volume:

_"The Contemporary Uyghur Anthology is a collection of Uyghur reflections in diaspora. Weaving together memories of the homeland, experiences of displacement, and transitions of identities, this anthology is a creative reflection of the beauty and complexities of the Uyghur experience._

_By centering Uyghur voices at the forefront, this anthology serves as a form of living memory in a pivotal moment of Uyghur history. The title Under the Mulberry Tree refers to a story from the Uyghur literary classic Ana Yurt, where youthful Nuri faces terrible injustices, separation, and turmoil; but for one moment in the Charbagh, his love for Sebihe and his own family is full, ripe, and sweet, like the mulberries from the ancient tree. In a similar way that the mulberry tree offered comforts in Nuri’s time of need, we hope this volume offers a place of reflection and celebration of Uyghur culture."_

We'd partnered with a member from a Jewish organisation to run writing workshops and explain editorial processes, as we had never worked on something like this before. After that collaboration, we decided to publish a revised edition on our own. This time, we added editors' notes to the pages to explain certain terms and historical and cultural contexts - mainly for our own youth, who don't always have access to cultural education. We translated more pieces from Uyghur and Chinese. Our contributors spanned 13 countries, at all levels of experience.

Was this work sustainable? Equipped with the tools, experience, and outpouring of support from our first volume, we spent the next two years saying yes. Our first book was now in libraries, there were articles and academic papers that mentioned it, and most of all, we reaffirmed the need for this sort of work. Not only were we accepting submissions, we worked one-on-one with emerging writers and artists to edit their pieces. We also helped first-time translators have their first publications with help from more experienced translators, as well as connecting them with the original authors.

Our second volume was even better than the last. From the blurb:

"How do we respond to the unexpected, and how does it influence perceptions of ourselves or the environments in which we exist? As a diaspora population, unexpected encounters can shape and transform what it means to be Uyghur as we build a new life outside of the homeland. Encounters Under the Mulberry Tree takes on the literal, abstract, and expanded renditions of these moments. We feature contemporary and historical works, including art, poetry, and prose in five languages with contributors based in a dozen countries, from established writers like award-winning author and filmmaker Tahir Hamut Izgil, to emerging artists, writers and translators of all ages. This book is a library of vignettes that grapple with intersections and how we make sense of it all."

Our stats:

*   44 pieces in total by 36 contributors
*   Five languages (Uyghur, English, Chinese, Russian, Turkish)
*   All work translated into English
*   11 translators
*   Contributors based in over 10 countries

<Vol. II showcased at a college hosted by Rawan Mentorship>

**Volume 3**

Now we embark on our third volume. The three of us do this while maintaining full time jobs, academic careers, and other side projects. We all live in different countries and have only met in person once. But it's something that we need to do, for our community and for ourselves. Our contributors have gained so much from this experience and we want to extend this opportunity to more people. This needs to survive in order for similar initiatives to be born.

**How we'd like to proceed**

*   **Supporting the editors -** all expenses so far have been paid out-of-pocket or through book sales. We do not have any donors or sponsors (yet!).
*   **Supporting our contributors -** we cannot afford to pay any of our contributors. Despite this, we have given free copies of the book to contributors, but this is definitely leaving a dent in our pockets.
*   **Recruiting more people -** paid internships or remuneration for one-off work would help volunteers spend more time on this project in this economy.
*   **Enhance our level of expertise -**we want to improve. Workshops or courses for our editors and contributors, professional feedback, the works. Unfortunately there is no one who speaks Uyghur and who is involved in Western publishing or English literature on a professional or academic level. We would appreciate connections with professionals from any language background, or the funding to level up.
*   **Expand our network -**we'd love to promote our work at literary festivals, go to conferences, do book events, establish ourselves in the public eye, provide reader copies to reviewers, and so on. However, there is a funding barrier to overcome to be able to attend these events, organise, or pre-order books.

<Vol. I on display at the Mosquers Film Festival, 2025>

**Who we are**

**Munawwar Abdulla** is an Uyghur advocate, poet, and scientist born on unceded Kaurna land (Australia) and based in Massachusetts. She co-founded The Tarim Network, runs Uyghur Collective, and collaborates on projects with Uyghur rights organisations around the world. Her writings and literary translations have been published in places such as Modern Poetry in Translation, Asymptote, the Margins, the Georgia Review, and others.

**Sonya Imin** is a mixed Uyghur American scholar and multi-disciplinary creative who has worked on art and film projects across the US, Europe, and Central Asia. Growing up between the borderlands of the Uyghur homeland, broader Central Asia, and the midwestern United States, interrogations of belonging, home, and displacement influence the nature of her work. Currently based in Brussels, she is working on her doctoral research on Uyghur artistic production in the diaspora.

**Maidina Kadeer**is a mixed Uyghur-Hui writer and editor, born in Ghulja and currently based in Montreal (Tiohtià:ke), Canada. She holds a BA in English Literature and Law and Society from Concordia University, with a focus on post- and neo-colonial literature. Her work explores Uyghur identity, history, and culture through cuisine, agriculture, and neo-colonialism. She has contributed to projects such as a poem, NinetySix, in Slavs and Tatars’ Contest of the Fruits (2021) and participates in panels and interviews on Agriculture and Food History to raise awareness about Uyghur culture.

10/26/2026 10:52 AM

Taipei, Oct. 26 (CNA) The Greater Taipei area and the eastern half of Taiwan are expected to see brief isolated showers Monday, while areas south of Taoyuan will be cloudy to sunny, according to the Central Weather Administration (CWA).

Due to the influence of northeasterly winds, brief isolated afternoon showers may also occur in the mountainous areas of Nantou County, the CWA said.

Meanwhile, daytime temperatures will range between 26 and 28 degrees Celsius in northern, northeastern and eastern Taiwan on Monday, the CWA said.

Elsewhere, highs of 30-32 degrees can be expected, but inland areas of southern Taiwan may see even higher temperatures during the day, the CWA added.

On Monday night, the mercury will drop to lows of 21-24 degrees Celsius across the country, the CWA said.

Strengthening northeasterly winds on Tuesday and Wednesday will bring slightly cooler weather to northern and northeastern Taiwan, with daytime highs of around 25-26 degrees, the CWA said.

During those two days, brief isolated showers can be expected in areas north of Taoyuan, in eastern Taiwan, and on the Hengchun Peninsula in the south, the CWA forecast.

Other areas will be cloudy to sunny, but mountainous areas of Nantou County may also see some brief isolated afternoon showers on those two days, the CWA said.

The seasonal wind system is forecast to weaken Thursday and Friday, giving way to sunny to cloudy skies nationwide, before northeasterly winds strengthen again Saturday, bringing brief isolated showers to some areas, according to the CWA.

It also gave an update on Tropical Storm In-Fa, which it said was located about 4,640 kilometers east of Eluanbi in southern Taiwan as of 8 a.m. Monday.

The storm is forecast to move northwest before turning west-northwest, with no direct impact on Taiwan, the CWA said.

(By Chang Hsiung-feng and Ko Lin)

[![Image 11: Photo of Vedanta Society of Western Washington group](https://secure.meetupstatic.com/photos/event/3/7/2/a/event_530774122.jpeg?w=3840) ### Vedanta Society of Western Washington](https://www.meetup.com/vedanta-society-of-western-washington-meetup/)

## Details

Join us for a weekly rhythm of meditation, teaching, and discussion led by Swami Avikarananda. The morning begins with meditation, followed by a teaching on spiritual life and Vedanta. After the talk, those attending in person are welcome to remain for coffee, tea, and continued discussion in our dining room. The bookstore will also be open. This reflects the new Sunday structure beginning May 3, 2026.

Because meditation is now the foundation of the morning, we ask everyone to **plan ahead to arrive and be settled before 10am**. Entering after meditation has begun is disruptive to the meditation period and to those already practicing. Upon arrival, you may choose to join Swami Avikarananda for Guided Meditation in the Chapel, or enter the Shrine upstairs for Silent Meditation.

This event is held in person at the Seattle Ashrama, and the 10:30 teaching is also [livestreamed on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@vedantasocietyofwesternwa/streams). Like all Vedanta Society activities, it is open to all and free of charge. Past talks may be selected from our [YouTube playlists](https://www.youtube.com/@vedantasocietyofwesternwa/playlists).

**Sunday Schedule**
**10am** Meditation (_Guided in the Chapel or Silent in the upstairs Shrine_)
**10:30am** Teaching (also available on [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@vedantasocietyofwesternwa/streams))
**11:30am** Discuss Vedanta over coffee and tea; [Bookstore](https://vedanta-seattle.org/media/bookshop/) available

_90-minute program, followed by discussion._

### Speaker

#### Swami Avikarananda

Swami Avikarananda is an ordained Hindu monk of the Ramakrishna Order and a resident minister at the Vedanta Society of Western Washington in Seattle. He conducts regular scriptural classes, meditation sessions, and public lectures focused on Advaita Vedanta, the Bhagavad Gita, and the lives of Sri Ramakrishna, Sri Sarada Devi, and Swami Vivekananda.

**Craig De Meillon**

Donation protected

 My name is Craig De Meillon, and I am based in Miami, Florida. I work in safety and emergency management and am a trained firefighter and EMT with professional experience responding to disasters, emergencies, and humanitarian situations.

 I am raising these funds as an independent volunteer to support my deployment to the areas affected by the recent mudslides and flooding in Nepal near the China border. I am not a family member or representative of anyone affected by the disaster, nor am I collecting these funds on behalf of a government agency or other organization. I am responding independently based on my emergency-response experience and my ability to bring useful communications and search equipment into the field.

 The funds raised will be used primarily to cover the direct costs of my deployment and emergency-response work. This includes my airfare and ground transportation to and within the affected region, accommodation and essential field logistics, food and other necessary expenses while deployed, and emergency-response equipment and supplies.

 A significant part of the funding will also be used for search and communications capabilities. This may include purchasing or renting drones that can be used to conduct aerial searches, assess inaccessible areas, locate people who may be stranded or missing, and help response teams understand conditions on the ground. Funds will also be used for satellite communications equipment and associated Starlink service costs so that I can maintain reliable communications in areas where local telecommunications infrastructure may be damaged, unavailable, or overloaded.

 Where practical, I may purchase essential supplies locally rather than transporting them from the United States. This allows funds to be used more efficiently and can also support local businesses and responders.

 The primary beneficiary of this fundraiser is me, Craig De Meillon, because the funds are being raised to cover the actual expenses I incur while independently deploying and carrying out this emergency-response work. The money is not being raised for personal profit or general living expenses. It is intended to offset the costs directly associated with the mission, including travel, equipment, communications, transportation, and necessary field expenses.

 Once on the ground, I will coordinate as appropriate with local emergency responders, humanitarian organizations, community leaders, and other response personnel to determine where my skills, equipment, and communications capabilities can be most useful. My role and activities may change depending on the needs identified in the affected areas and the accessibility and safety of the region.

 I will keep records of mission-related expenses and provide updates throughout the deployment so donors can understand how the funds are being used and what work is being carried out on the ground.

 Thank you to everyone who contributes, shares this fundraiser, or supports the response in any way. Every contribution helps make it possible for me to get the equipment, communications, and resources needed to reach affected areas and assist where I can. Flood

content:
香港
香港理工大学校长滕锦光表示，香港理工大学的目标是将海外学生与中国内地学生的比例从40:60提高到50:50。该计划要求到2028年在九龙塘和稍后在何文田建立新的学生宿舍，并在北都大学城建立第二个校区。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 26 日 06:05 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港理工大学（理大）校长滕锦光表示，为了促进国际化，香港理工大学（PolyU）的目标是海外学生和中国内地学生的比例从目前的 40:60 提高到 50:50。理大在 2027 年 QS 世界大学排名中首次跻身前 50 名。

滕说，理大今年招收了约1,000名非本地学生，其中约600名来自中国大陆，400名来自其他国家。该目标与上个月发布的香港第一个五年计划一致，该计划的目标是到2029-30年让10万名非本地学生参加全日制专上课程，高于2024-25年的约8万名。
宿舍空间有限是一个主要障碍。理大拥有约4,000个宿舍名额，并保证所有非本地本科生可入住一年。 “由于这种安排，我们无法招收更多的非本地学生来攻读本科课程，”滕解释道。九龙塘的一间新学生宿舍预计将于 2028 年开业，稍后又在何文田开设另一间学生宿舍，以缓解瓶颈。

由于空间限制，大学纷纷迁往北方都市大学城 (NMUT)，该城占地 1,000 多公顷，横跨三个校区。滕说：“鉴于理大目前的空间限制，我们计划建设第二个校区，并将积极支持和参与NMUT。”但他没有透露更多细节。洪水桥校园的三个用地已于上个月开始申请。

滕说，奖学金仍然是从欠发达经济体（尤其是东南亚）招收“顶尖学生”的关键，并指出来自新加坡和中国大陆大学的竞争。他认为，香港留住人才的能力取决于职业前景：“这实际上取决于我们为他们提供的机会……而主要驱动力是创新和科技行业的发展。”他引用了中国移动于2024年在香港成立的研究部门，该部门招募了包括理大在内的本地毕业生。
理大正在追求以需求为导向、以问题为导向、跨学科研究和产学合作的“第四代大学”模式。最近的合作伙伴包括与天津大学的未来技术研究所以及与哈尔滨工业大学的国际设计学院，两者均位于深圳。理大在香港校园成立了理大跨学科研究学院（2022年）、理大人工智能学院（2025年）和理大航空航天研究院（2026年7月）。计划建立第四个卫生技术学院。

Hong Kong
Hong Kong Polytechnic University aims to raise its ratio of overseas to mainland Chinese students from 40:60 to 50:50, President Teng Jin-guang said. The plan requires new student hostels in Kowloon Tong by 2028 and Ho Man Tin later, plus a second campus in the Northern Metropolis University Town.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

26 Oct 2026 at 06:05 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong Polytechnic University (PolyU) is targeting a 50:50 split between overseas and mainland Chinese students, up from the current 40:60 ratio, to boost internationalisation, President Teng Jin-guang said. The goal follows PolyU's debut in the top 50 of the QS World University Rankings 2027.

Teng said PolyU enrolled about 1,000 non-local students this year, roughly 600 from mainland China and 400 from other countries. The target aligns with Hong Kong's first Five-Year Plan, published last month, which aims for 100,000 non-local students in full-time postsecondary programmes by 2029-30, up from about 80,000 in 2024-25.

Limited hostel space is a key obstacle. PolyU has about 4,000 hostel places and guarantees one-year residence for all non-local undergraduates. 'Because of this arrangement, we cannot have many more non-local students for the undergraduate programs,' Teng explained. A new student hostel in Kowloon Tong is expected to open in 2028, with another in Ho Man Tin later, easing the bottleneck.

Space constraints have pushed universities toward the Northern Metropolis University Town (NMUT), spanning over 1,000 hectares across three campuses. 'In view of PolyU's current space constraints, we plan to build a second campus and will actively support and participate in the NMUT,' Teng said, without disclosing further details. Applications for three sites in the Hung Shui Kiu campus opened last month.

Scholarships remain key for recruiting 'top-quality students' from less advanced economies, particularly Southeast Asia, Teng said, noting competition from Singaporean and mainland Chinese universities. Hong Kong's ability to retain talent depends on career prospects, he argued: 'It really depends on the opportunities we offer them … and the main driver is for the innovation and technology industry to be grown.' He cited China Mobile's research arm, established in Hong Kong in 2024, which has recruited local graduates including from PolyU.

PolyU is pursuing a 'fourth-generation university' model defined by demand-driven, problem-oriented, interdisciplinary research and academia-industry collaboration. Recent partnerships include the Institute of Future Technologies with Tianjin University and the International School of Design with Harbin Institute of Technology, both in Shenzhen. On its Hong Kong campus, PolyU has launched the PolyU Academy for Interdisciplinary Research (2022), the PolyU Academy for Artificial Intelligence (2025), and the PolyU Aerospace Research Academy (July 2026). A fourth academy on health technology is planned.

content:
财务主管表示，香港金融业女性高层领导人数有所增加中国劳工公告栏
星期一, 2 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻英文版
财务总监表示，香港金融业女性高层领导人数有所增加
香港财政司长陈茂波援引一项研究称，香港金融机构担任高级领导职务的女性比例将从 2018 年的 34% 上升至 2026 年的 45%。他在女性高管峰会上发表讲话。
香港财政司司长陈茂波周一表示，在快速变化的世界中，金融支持经济增长的两条原则至关重要：拥抱人才和以长远眼光管理资本。
陈在女性高管峰会上发表讲话时表示，欢迎来自不同背景的人才的机构能够更好地驾驭变革、做出明智的决策并抓住机遇。他援引一项研究显示，在香港金融机构担任高级领导职务的女性比例已从 2018 年的 34% 上升至 45%。陈将这一增长归因于个人努力、家庭支持和工作机会。
陈先生还强调，香港的普通法制度、自由的资本流动和深厚的专业知识为寻求长期投入资本的投资者提供了可靠的基础。他表示，香港与中国内地和世界其他地区的联系汇集了人才、创意和投资机会，使香港成为国际机构可以建立多元化团队并为不同市场的客户提供服务的地方。

Hong Kong financial sector sees rise in female senior leadership, says finance chief | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 2 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong financial sector sees rise in female senior leadership, says finance chief
Hong Kong's finance chief Paul Chan said financial institutions in the city have seen the proportion of women in senior leadership roles rise to 45 per cent in 2026 from 34 per cent in 2018, citing a study. He spoke at a summit on women executives.
Hong Kong's Financial Secretary Paul Chan Mo-po said on Monday that two principles are crucial for finance to support economic growth in a rapidly changing world: embracing talent and managing capital with a long-term perspective.
Speaking at the Women Executives Summit, Chan said institutions that welcome talent from all backgrounds are better able to navigate change, make sound decisions and seize opportunities. He cited a study showing that the proportion of women holding senior leadership roles in Hong Kong's financial institutions had reached 45 per cent, up from 34 per cent in 2018. Chan attributed the increase to individual effort, family support and workplace opportunities.
Chan also highlighted Hong Kong's common-law system, free capital flows and deep pool of professional expertise as providing a reliable foundation for investors seeking to commit capital over the long term. He said the city's connections with mainland China and the rest of the world bring together talent, ideas and investment opportunities, making Hong Kong a place where international institutions can build diverse teams and serve clients across markets.

content:
## 美国期中选举前夕 川普与民主党分别造势催票

（法新社华盛顿2日电） 美国期中选举前夕，民主党今天准备举行最后一波催票造势，总统川普也将在华府发表选前最后演说。外界预期，民主党至少能拿下国会其中一院的控制权，两年来首度能在政治上制衡川普。

发表时间： 02/11/2026 - 12:34

6 分钟 浏览时间

德州的塔拉里格（James Talarico）与堪萨斯州的韩密尔顿（Adam Hamilton）等民主党明星级联邦参议员候选人的造势集会，将为这场充满紧张与激烈竞争的选战划下句点。

川普（Donald Trump）则预定今天在华府林肯纪念堂（Lincoln Memorial）倒影池（Reflecting Pool）发表选前最后演说。他昨天才强调：「我们会赢。」

然而民调显示，民主党几乎笃定能从共和党手中夺下联邦众议院多数席次，也有机会赢得目前由共和党掌控的联邦参议院。

即使只拿下众议院，民主党也将掌握联邦预算的表决权，并主导富有权力的委员会，得以调查川普政府涉嫌贪腐的行径、已故性犯罪富豪艾普斯坦（Jeffrey Epstein）案的档案，以及其他极具争议的议题。

共和党若全面失去掌控国会的优势，川普将陷入陌生且不利的处境：在「跛脚鸭」（lame duck）任期中面临国内高通膨、对伊朗战事进展不顺，以及民主党对他在华府作为展开的调查。

不过，民主党人对胜选的预测依然保持警惕。此外，民主党在选战尾声面临内部分歧，左派候选人不时与党内建制派发生冲突。

例如，密西根州民主党籍众议员史蒂文斯（Haley Stevens）在该州关键的参议员选战中，昨天倒戈支持共和党候选人罗杰斯（Mike Rogers），而非同党的左翼进步派候选人塞德（Abdul El-Sayed）。

川普所属的共和党则采取政治焦土战术，将民主党人描绘成共产主义者，并公开将信奉伊斯兰教的塞德贴上恐怖分子标签。

然而，美国国家广播公司新闻网（NBC News）昨天公布的民调显示，6成受访者不满川普的施政表现，尤其是物价高涨问题。川普对伊朗发动的战争已持续8个月，让物价问题雪上加霜。

尽管众议院很可能改由民主党当家，参议院选战仍胜负未定。不过，民主党候选人在某些共和党铁票州出乎意料构成强力挑战，民调专家如今认为，民主党拿下参议院的胜算至少有5成。

若民主党在参议院占多数，将能阻止川普提名的终身职法官人选获得任命，包括最高法院大法官。

虽然本月3日才是投票日，全美已有创纪录的5400万人提前投票。

本次期中选举的广告支出约达110亿美元，其中很大一部分来自个别的超级金主，例如川普亲近盟友马斯克（Elon Musk）已捐出惊人的近5亿美元，以协助共和党候选人当选。

title: 台灣晶片輸大陸 經濟部研議加強管制
summary: 民進黨立委提案修訂《貿易法》，加嚴管制晶片輸往中國大陸。立法院經濟委員會2日召開公聽會。（宋碧龍／大紀元） 【大紀元2026年11月02日訊】（大紀元記者張原彰台灣台北報導）台灣民進黨立委提案修訂《貿易法》，對晶片輸往中國大陸加嚴管制，立法院經濟委員會2日召開公聽會予以探討。經濟部認為，修法可確保相關出口管制執法有更適切的法律依據及共同執法標準。學者也表態支持，但在中國的台商處境比較尷尬，政府應加以關注。 立委提案修訂《貿易法》第13條之2，明訂「特定積體電路、半導體晶圓關鍵
content:
民進黨立委提案修訂《貿易法》，加嚴管制晶片輸往中國大陸。立法院經濟委員會2日召開公聽會。（宋碧龍／大紀元）
【大紀元2026年11月02日訊】（大紀元記者張原彰台灣台北報導）台灣民進黨立委提案修訂《貿易法》，對晶片輸往中國大陸加嚴管制，立法院經濟委員會2日召開公聽會予以探討。經濟部認為，修法可確保相關出口管制執法有更適切的法律依據及共同執法標準。學者也表態支持，但在中國的台商處境比較尷尬，政府應加以關注。
立委提案修訂《貿易法》第13條之2，明訂「特定積體電路、半導體晶圓關鍵材料、零組件及製造設備」，未經許可不得輸出至中國大陸，也就是將這些項目列入「戰略性高科技貨品」管制範圍。
提案內容加重罰則。修法第27條之3明訂，若違反上述規定將處十年以下有期徒刑，得併科500萬元以上、1,000萬元（新台幣）以下罰金。經第三地轉運、轉售或其它迂迴方式將這些產品最終輸往中國大陸，亦處相同罰則，且沒收犯罪所得。
立法院經濟委員會2日舉辦「貿易法部分條文修正草案－晶片法案」公聽會，針對《貿易法》是否應修法以加嚴管制AI（人工智慧）晶片輸中等議題進行探討。
經濟部國際貿易署長劉威廉說，台灣作為全球半導體與AI供應鏈中心，相關科技貨品的出口管制作為受到國際關注。面對當前高科技貨品違規轉運手法層出不窮、供應鏈相關國家的法規落差，以及中小企業法遵能力不足等挑戰，經濟部透過國際合作強化執法量能，加強宣導企業出口管制法規。
劉威廉說，對於立法院及學界就擴大納管先進晶片議題的關切，經濟部正參酌台美對等貿易協定（ART）承諾，並依據《貿易法》授權，研議將高階晶片等高科技貨品納管的整體配套作法，以確保相關出口管制執法能有更適切的法律依據及共同執法標準，加強防堵高階晶片違規轉運，確保半導體「矽盾」實力，兼顧產業國際競爭力。
經濟民主連合律師賴中強說，修法當然應該做，《貿易法》第13條的原始立法目的就是授權主管機關基於確保國家安全，履行國際合作及協定，加強管理戰略性高科技貨品的輸出入及流向。
中華經濟研究院第一研究所副研究員王國臣表示，這次修法符合台美對等貿易協定及台灣的國家安全利益。但對台商而言，假設在中國的台商遵循美國法律不賣晶片給中國，北京有權給予罰款，若是聽北京的話，可能面臨美國的出口管制；禁斷令恐怕讓台商腹背受敵，政府後續需要關注這方面的議題。◇

content: 文章来源：美国之音 作者：杨安 中共二十届五中全会星期四(10月29日)落幕，中央军委副主席张升民罕见增选为中央政治局委员，另外确认开除33名高层人士党籍，创改革开放以来历届中央全会处分人数最多纪录。分析人士表示，这波人事汰换反映中共领导人习近平持续重塑党政军权力结构，旨在确保明年的中共二十一大能无悬念连任。 以“从严治党”为主题的二十届五中全会，确认开除前中央军委副主席张又侠、前中共新疆党委书记马兴瑞、前中共中央对外联络部部长刘建超等人党籍。 港媒《明报》报道指出，刘建超是首次被官方证实涉“严重违法违纪”。刘建超是资深外交官，一度被视为外长热门人选，但自去年7月便失联。报道称刘建超的问题较三中全会落马的前外长秦刚更为严重，因此遭断崖式贬官待遇。 “从严治党”下 出席委员人数锐减 据公报，本次会议审议通过“中共中央关于持之以恒推进全面从严治党若干重大问题的决定”。本次全会共有162名中央委员和117名候补中央委员出席，合计279人，出席委员较去年的四中全会减少36人，相较本届初更是减少四分之一，变相说明“从严治党”的成果。 位于台北的国防安全研究院副研究员王占玺指出，自从习近平打破惯例三连任以来，中共这几年间在国际事务、经济发展、社会治理上都面对了更严峻的挑战，习近平没有拿得出手的政绩足以回应国内外的质疑，只能借着“从严治党”的主张来回避遭遇治理挑战的困境。 王占玺向美国之音表示：“第一个其实是在国际上去强调，中共所谓的政党治理能力，这个其实是用这样的方式来证明，威权体制的正当性，也去挑战西方民主政治制度的有效性。中国社会内部，其实也去强调说，全面从严治党解决了党跟政府的一些问题。” 王占玺强调，五中全会的核心目标其实是进一步巩固习近平的权力地位，让他在明年二十一大的连任能够更顺利。 美国智库詹姆士敦基金会(Jamestown Foundation)研究员林和立星期三在台北的一场讲座上表示，即使习近平施政遭致批评，仍然会在二十一大连任国家主席、中共中央总书记及中央军委主席三个职位。 中共第二十一次全国代表大会预定于2027年下半年在北京召开。由于过去几年的反贪腐清洗，中共干部前仆后继落马，因此这次五中全会关于人事的递补，也被视为二十一大的权力布局线索。 递补中央委员10名 张升民罕见增选入政治局 据公报显示，全会按照中共党章规定，决定递补中央委员会候补委员卢东亮、包钢、邢善萍、曲莹璞、吕军、朱天舒、朱国贤、刘珺、刘捷、刘强为中央委员会委员。 其中，山西省省长卢东亮及浙江省省长刘捷，均曾被外界列名中共第七代接班人梯队。 新加坡国立大学政治系副教授庄嘉颖告诉美国之音 ： “虽然说现在可能还要有定论还是太早，就反正习(近平)也是会有一天会比较老，会比较没有那么多精力去管那么多事情，那这些被推上来的人，可能就是之后填补权力真空的人物。” 不过庄嘉颖补充说，习近平一方面不希望官员只能当橡皮图章，要拿出魄力办事，另一方面又认为太有魄力的官员是在搞小圈圈，动辄以党纪伺候，这样反而让下面的人左右为难。 至于已经接近被掏空的中央军委会，虽然张升民成为32年来首位再增选政治局委员，却没有递补任何一位军委。 中共二十大选出的七位中央军委会成员，张又侠、何卫东、刘振立、李尚福、苗华等五人先后遭到整肃。目前仅剩下身兼军委主席的习近平与张升民两人。 贯彻军委主席负责制 台北海洋科技大学通识教育中心助理教授吴瑟致接受美国之音采访时表示，张升民增选政治局委员，凸显军队纪律监督与政治忠诚的重要性。短期而言，有助于习近平强化控制，但长期可能造成高层互信不足、决策资讯失真及干部避责。 吴瑟致认为，在中共二十一大之前，军委会不可能补齐，甚至不太可能递补新人，主要原因在于军方在遭到数波清洗之后，能符合进入军委会门槛的将领人数有限。 资深中国观察家林和立说 ， 尽管明年二十一大将确定新一届中央军委名单，但是在仅剩两名中央军委的情况下，习近平势必会在重新组建中央军委阵容时面对巨大的困难。 吴瑟致则表示，在习近平倡导的军委主席负责制下，军委会其他成员已经成了可有可无的存在。 他说：“它彰显出来的意涵就是说，过去中央军委所强调的所谓的权力分配，或是这个集体领导这样的一个概念，其实已经慢慢朝向所谓的中央军委主席负责制，这样的一个所谓的权力集中一人的态势。”

title: Family Members Speak: The Toll of Political Imprisonment

content:
家属发言：政治监禁的代价 zevans@freedom… 2026 年 10 月 29 日星期四 - 00:00 类型观点 页面区块 中国诺贝尔和平奖获得者刘晓波在最后的公开声明中写信给他的妻子：“我在有形的监狱里服刑，而你在无形的心灵监狱里等待。”他的话语反映了一些家庭经常被忽视的痛苦，这些家庭面临着情感上的痛苦、不断增加的法律费用以及对亲人健康和安全的担忧。许多人发现自己被迫扮演陌生的倡导者角色，争取正当程序、探视权，甚至了解有关被单独监禁者的基本信息。对政治犯的声援也必须延伸至遭受这些苦难的家庭。下面，他们用自己的话分享了自己的经历。塔利亚·卡塔克 (Talia Khattak) 是政治犯伊德里斯·卡塔克 (Idris Khattak) 的女儿，伊德里斯·卡塔克 (Idris Khattak) 自 2019 年以来一直在巴基斯坦被拘留，原因是他努力保护该国普什图族少数民族免遭迫害。每天早上我醒来，努力继续我的生活，而每天晚上，持续不断的忧虑又回来了，我的心在下降：我的父亲在一场假审判中被定罪，他正在变老，生病，而且他没有得到他的药物。我躺在床上，无法入睡，想知道他是否感到痛苦，是否知道我们为他而战有多努力。我现在应该照顾他，但我听不到他的声音告诉我一切都会好起来的。
当他应该宠爱他的孙子时，他却被关在牢房里。他独自抚养我和妹妹，而现在，当他最需要我们的时候，我们却无法在他身边。我想念他的故事、他的笑话、他的歌声。他还活着，却又那么遥不可及。没有他的每一天都是我们永远回不去的一天。我祈祷他早日回到我们身边。政治犯 Tsi Conrad 的妻子 Enita Meyeh Yambong Tsi 自 2016 年以来一直在喀麦隆被拘留，原因是他对该国长达十年的英语危机、法语国家政府与英语地区之间的暴力冲突进行了新闻报道。我的丈夫齐·康拉德 (Tsi Conrad) 的入狱让我们一家人的心都碎了。他不是因为犯罪而入狱，而是因为他的良心和记者的工作。自从他被关押在孔登吉中央监狱后，我和我的孩子们被迫离开我们在巴门达曾经幸福的家，流离失所到雅温得，只是为了与他保持亲近。我的孩子们失去了家园、学校和童年。我既成为母亲又成为父亲，承受着分离的创伤，对丈夫生命的持续恐惧，以及让他在监狱里活着所付出的难以承受的代价。每天晚上，我都面对着他空荡荡的床边。每天早上，我的孩子们都会问同样令人心碎的问题：“爸爸回家了吗？”我努力让我们的家人团结在一起，同时看着他们的童年悄然逝去。
他的监狱围墙可能关押着他，但他的监禁却囚禁了我们所有人。 高普，政治犯高全福牧师和庞宇牧师的儿子高全福牧师和庞宇牧师自2025年以来因行使宗教自由和信仰权利而在中国被拘留。我父母的拘留改变了我和我家人的一切。作为他们的儿子，我不得不忍受与抚养我、教导我信仰、并向我展示正直生活意味着什么的两个人分离的痛苦。我每天醒来都想知道他们的安全、健康，以及他们是否要度过余生

Family Members Speak: The Toll of Political Imprisonment zevans@freedom… Thu, 10/29/2026 - 00:00 Type Perspectives Page blocks In his final public statement, Chinese Nobel Peace Prize laureate  Liu Xiaobo wrote to his wife: “I am serving my sentence in a tangible prison, while you wait in the intangible prison of the heart.” His words capture the often-overlooked suffering of families who grapple with emotional anguish, mounting legal fees, and fears for their loved ones’ health and safety. Many find themselves thrust into the unfamiliar role of advocate, fighting for due process, visitation rights, and even basic information about those held incommunicado. Solidarity with political prisoners must also extend to the families who endure these hardships. Below, they share their experiences in their own words. Talia Khattak, daughter of political prisoner  Idris Khattak Idris Khattak has been detained in Pakistan since 2019 in connection with his efforts to defend the country’s Pashtun ethnic minority from persecution. Every morning I wake up and try to carry on with my life, and every night the constant worry returns, and my heart drops: my father was convicted in a fake trial, he is getting old and sick, and he is not receiving his medicine. I lie awake wondering if he is in pain, if he knows how hard we are fighting for him. I should be caring for him now, yet I can’t hear his voice telling me it’s going to be okay.  When he should be spoiling his grandchildren, he is in a prison cell. He raised my sister and me on his own, and now, when he needs us the most, we cannot be there for him. I miss his stories, his jokes, the sound of him singing. He is alive, yet so out of reach. Every day without him is a day we will never get back. I pray he comes back home to us soon. Enita Meyeh Yambong Tsi, wife of political prisoner  Tsi Conrad Tsi Conrad has been detained in Cameroon since 2016 for his journalistic coverage of the country’s decade-long Anglophone crisis, the violent conflict between the Francophone-dominated government and the English-speaking regions. My husband, Tsi Conrad’s imprisonment has shattered the heart of our family. He was not jailed for a crime, but for his conscience and his work as a journalist. Since his detention in Kondengui Central Prison, my children and I have been forced to leave our once-happy home in Bamenda and displaced to Yaoundé, just to remain close to him. My children have lost their home, their school, and their childhood. I have become both mother and father, carrying the trauma of separation, the constant fear for my husband’s life, and the unbearable cost of keeping him alive in prison. Every night, I face his empty side of the bed. Every morning, my children ask the same heartbreaking question, “Is Daddy coming home?” I struggle to hold our family together while watching their childhood slip away. His prison walls may hold him, but his imprisonment has imprisoned us all. Gao Pu, son of political prisoners Pastor  Gao Quanfu and  Pang Yu Pastor Gao Quanfu and Pang Yu have been detained in China since 2025 for exercising their right to religious freedom and belief. My parents’ detention has changed everything for me and my family. As their son, I have had to endure the pain of being separated from the two people who raised me, taught me about faith, and showed me what it means to live with integrity. I wake up each day wondering about their safety, health, and whether they are going to spend the rest of their days in prison. Some of my family members have experienced harassment and intimidation. There has been tremendous fear, emotional strain, uncertainty, and helplessness. Milestones and holidays gatherings have been on pause because they have become reminders of our separation. In the past 17 months, I have experienced the absolute darkest moments of my life. Yet with the unbearable despair, this time has also strengthened my resolve and faith with clarity. For the first time, I understood what “I will go to the ends of the earth for you” meant. I am proud to be my parents’ son and I am becoming the son they raised me to be. One day soon, they will see that. Display image On As we mark October 30, the International Day of Political Prisoners, this week and reaffirm our solidarity with the more than one million people imprisoned worldwide for exercising their fundamental rights, we also recognize the families whose lives have been upended by their loved ones’ detention. content: 作者：林保華 自由時報     2026/10/28  中共廿屆五中全會從十月廿六日至廿九日在北京舉行，會議內容是研究「持之以恆推進全面從嚴治黨若干重大問題」，並審議《中共中央關於持之以恆推進全面從嚴治黨若干重大問題的決定（討論稿）》。據傳以北京大學為首、十多所重點大學，署名「高校在讀本科生與研究生」的聯名呼籲書，先後出現在北大等校內論壇，聲明要求「廢除國家主席無限期延任制」、啟動民主修憲等，貼文立即傳上社媒，但迅速被刪除，不會影響會議程序。 「從嚴治黨」是中共的政治術語。一九四九年建國後，一九五二年的三反運動就以貪污罪名槍斃了天津領導幹部張子善、劉青山。一九六〇年代初的「四清運動」包括經濟政治的貪腐濫權。一九六六年毛澤東發動文革打倒走資派，走資當然也有貪腐與路線。毛澤東當時還要求新幹部「鬥私批修」不要沾染貪腐，也無濟於事，但毛澤東可以「各取所需」就是最大的貪腐與濫權，別人可以嗎？ 改革開放以後，更以貪污是發展經濟的潤滑劑為由使之普遍化。鄧小平為紅二代找到既不放棄政治權勢，又可以攫取經濟利益的新道路。不久前，習近平以隆重紀念江澤民誕生一百週年並接見江澤民的子孫來默認江的「悶聲大發財」，也凸顯了習剛上台時，以從嚴治黨清算江的愛將周永康、郭伯雄、徐才厚的虛偽。 而廿屆的中央委員與候補委員中，被公開宣布落馬或失蹤的估計有兩成多，他們是以貪腐罪名被清洗，打破文革以來的紀錄，因而將缺席這次全會。其中不少是習近平自己提拔的幹部，證明幹部隊伍越反越貪。習卻將反貪視為功勞，並透過修憲恢復終身制。 為何「從嚴治黨」喊了幾十年，尤其習近平時代喊得最頻繁，卻仍然無效？因為這是制度問題，共產黨最抱緊的就是「黨的領導」，它關係到黨的最大利益，大小獨裁者的最大利益。改革開放後，胡耀邦、趙紫陽要動搖它，鄧小平以「四項基本原則」來制止。一九八六年胡耀邦虎年打虎，結果「打虎」變「打胡」，次年一月胡便被迫下台。 從一九五七年反右開始，我就體驗到在中國不能與任何共產黨員有爭執，因為他們身上有「黨的領導」的DNA，哪怕只有萬分之一，而我身上沒有，因此他必然是領導你的一方。而黨內的爭議，地位高的必然領導低的，除非你的後台比他高。「黨的領導」在憲法上的描述而被固定下來，就是封建等級制度在憲法上固定下來。你如果是非黨員，即使坐上副國級，權力還比不上黨員科長、處長。所以要去投共的國民黨員，自己掂量一點，不要走上宋慶齡、傅作義的道路。號稱「黨外布爾什維克」的郭沫若，即使是副國級，其奴態甚至比一般非黨群眾更甚。所以只要《中華人民共和國憲法》上有「黨的領導」，就不要期望中共會「從嚴治黨」。請問，誰來治習近平的貪腐濫權？ （作者林保華為資深時事評論員） https://lingfengcomment.pixnet.net/blog/posts/955955982679842254

title: Hong Kong independent bookstore Luck Win to shut Mong Kok branch by year end after half a century
zh_title: 半个世纪后，香港独立书店乐运旺角分店将于年底关闭
summary: 香港拥有数十年历史的书店乐运宣布年底前关闭旺角分店，成为香港最新一家关闭的独立书店。福运书店旺角分店。照片：幸运胜利。乐运周二宣布，其旺角书店最迟将于12月31日关闭。它没有给出任何理由。 “48年的经营并不容易，我们依依不舍。感谢所有新老朋友的支持。我们不得不告别。直到我们再次相聚。”这篇中文帖子写道。另请参阅：如何升级
content:
香港拥有数十年历史的书店乐运宣布年底前关闭旺角分店，成为香港最新一家关闭的独立书店。福运书店旺角分店。照片：幸运胜利。乐运周二宣布，其旺角书店最迟将于12月31日关闭。它没有给出任何理由。 “48年的经营并不容易，我们依依不舍。感谢所有新老朋友的支持。我们不得不告别。直到我们再次相聚。”这篇中文帖子写道。另请参阅：香港独立书店不断升级的打压如何让台湾出版商成为焦点。乐赢的一些顾客在帖子下评论说，他们书架上的很多书都是多年来在乐赢买的，告别很难过。福运书店旺角分店。照片：幸运胜利。该书店发布的照片​​显示，在关门前，所有书籍均享有 55% 的折扣。乐运是香港最古老的独立书店之一，在旺角和铜锣湾设有两家分店。铜锣湾分行的一名工作人员在电话中告诉《香港新闻社》，该分行仍在营业，尚未做出关闭的决定。 7月初，Luck Win和另一家于1997年开业的独立书店Elmbook被禁止参加该市官方的年度书展。
禁令发布后不久，Elmbook 在 Facebook 上表示，将关闭位于旺角的实体店。目前尚未公布具体关闭日期，但表示该店的租约将于明年 4 月结束。关店潮 近年来，香港的独立书店面临着越来越大的来自当局的压力，政府部门的检查和税务检查频繁。今年早些时候，随着国安警察逮捕了四家书店的工作人员，镇压行动进一步升级。 2026年7月15日，一名女子被香港警方护送离开“祝你住得愉快”独立书店。她的T恤上写着：“我是书店的员工。”照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 3月份，Book Punch的工作人员被捕，6月份，Hunter书店的工作人员被捕。 7月，Have a Nice Stay和Greenfield的工作人员在同一天被捕。逮捕前一天，Have a Nice Stay 宣布在运营四年后关闭。逮捕事件发生后，格林菲尔德还宣布将在租约到期后关闭。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong’s decades-old bookstore Luck Win has announced the shutdown of its Mong Kok branch by the end of the year, becoming the city’s latest independent bookstore to close. Luck Win Bookstore’s Mong Kok branch. Photo: Luck Win. Luck Win announced on Tuesday that its Mong Kok bookshop would close by December 31 at the latest. It did not cite any reasons. “Operating for 48 years has not been easy, and we are reluctant to say goodbye. We thank all our friends, new and old, for their support. We have to bid farewell. Until we meet again,” the Chinese-language post read. See also: How an escalating crackdown on Hong Kong’s independent bookstores put Taiwan publishers in the spotlight Some of Luck Win’s customers commented on the post, saying that many titles on their bookshelves were bought at Luck Win over the years and that it was sad to say goodbye. Luck Win Bookstore’s Mong Kok branch. Photo: Luck Win. Photos posted by the bookshop showed that it is offering a discount of 55 per cent off for all books ahead of its closure. One of Hong Kong’s oldest independent bookshop, Luck Win runs two branches in Mong Kok and Causeway Bay. A staff member at the Causeway Bay branch told HKFP on the phone that the branch is still operating and that no decision has been made to close it. Earlier in July, Luck Win and Elmbook, another independent bookshop that opened in 1997, were banned from participating in the city’s official annual book fair. Soon after the ban, Elmbook said on Facebook that it was shuttering its physical store in Mong Kok. It is yet to announce the exact closure date, although it said the store’s lease would end in April next year. Wave of closures Independent bookshops in Hong Kong have been facing increasing pressure from authorities in recent years, with frequent checks from government departments and tax inspections. The crackdown escalated earlier this year with the arrests of staff by national security police at four bookstores. A woman is escorted away from ‘Have a Nice Stay’ independent bookstore by Hong Kong police on July 15, 2026. Her t-shirt reads: “I am staff of a bookstore.” Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. In March, staff from Book Punch were arrested, and in June, staff from Hunter Bookstore were apprehended. In July, staff from Have a Nice Stay and Greenfield were arrested on the same day. A day before the arrests, Have a Nice Stay announced to close down after four years in operation. Following the arrests, Greenfield also announced that it will shutter after its lease expires .

title: Researchers uncover Volt Typhoon’s covert, ephemeral network
zh_title: 研究人员发现了 Volt Typhoon 的隐蔽、短暂的网络
summary: Lumen Technologies 的 Black Lotus Labs 在周三的一份报告中表示，中国政府支持的黑客组织 Volt Typhoon 多年来一直渗透到美国的关键基础设施网络，不断构建和拆除临时恶意基础设施，以潜入数百个敏感系统而不被发现。研究人员称之为“无声列车”的秘密访问操作并不是一个独立的网络，而是一系列受到攻击的小型办公室家庭办公室 (SOHO) 路由器、物联网 (IoT) 设备和企业基础设施，Volt Typhoon 已通过这些网络快速轮换
content:
Lumen Technologies 的 Black Lotus Labs 在周三的一份报告中表示，中国政府支持的黑客组织 Volt Typhoon 多年来一直渗透到美国的关键基础设施网络，不断构建和拆除临时恶意基础设施，以潜入数百个敏感系统而不被发现。研究人员称之为“无声列车”的秘密访问操作并不是一个独立的网络，而是一系列受感染的小型办公室家庭办公室 (SOHO) 路由器、物联网 (IoT) 设备和企业基础设施，Volt Typhoon 自 2023 年底以来已迅速轮换。研究人员表示，中国威胁组织利用这一系列短暂的受感染基础设施来利用网络边缘设备中的其他漏洞，包括零日漏洞，并获得对受害者网络更深入、持久的访问。 Black Lotus Labs 首席信息安全工程师 Michael Horka 告诉 Cyber​​Scoop：“各个链条每天都在组装和拆除，基础设施也在不断更新。” “Volt Typhoon 展示了一种可重复的能力，可以在不到两分钟的时间内重建具有不同基础设施的新链，从而使任何时刻的节点数量实际上接近于零。”自首次发现 Silent Train 活动以来，Black Lotus Labs 已通知数百名受害者，其中包括电信提供商、政府实体、国防承包商、通信服务、大学和 IT 公司。
关键基础设施的其他受害者包括水利、能源、交通、海事、铁路、航空和紧急服务部门的组织。“该框架的短暂性意味着我们的观察结果不应被解释为对伏特台风活动的完整普查，”该报告的首席研究员霍卡说。据 Black Lotus Labs 称，该民族国家组织在运营安全和保护访问方面的投资是引人注目的。霍卡说：“我们观察到基础设施在两分钟内组装完毕，会议平均大约四个小时，进行了广泛的清理、划分和新访问向量的持续开发。” “这是相当大的努力，甚至不是为了达到他们的最终目标，而纯粹是为了让重要的行动难以发现和追踪。”研究人员表示，在 FBI 和司法部于 2024 年初破坏 KV 僵尸网络后，Volt Typhoon 更加依赖 Silent Train。今年早些时候，美国和全球当局警告称，中国黑客组织利用受感染的普通设备上的秘密网络的方式发生了广泛转变。这些努力的影响是广泛且持续的。 Volt Typhoon 在 Silent Train 运营中利用和滥用了超过 27 个设备类别，包括边缘设备、企业管理工具、身份和访问管理系统、网络基础设施和其他技术。
“多样性很重要，但纪律更重要。”Horka 说，“特定的设备类型始终保留在供应链中的特定位置。它的运行方式不太像随机受损设备的集合，而更像是有组织的功能库存。”研究人员表示，该威胁组织已成功入侵 Fortinet、Cisco、ManageEngine、Ivanti、F5、Check Point、Palo Alto Networks、ServiceNow、TP-Link、Netgear 和 ArcGIS 的设备和技术。 Black Lotus Labs 还观察到已确认针对 Ver 的零日活动

【原文 English Original】
Volt Typhoon, a China-government backed hacking group that has infiltrated America’s critical infrastructure networks for years, has consistently built and dismantled ephemeral malicious infrastructure to burrow into hundreds of sensitive systems undetected, Lumen Technologies’ Black Lotus Labs said in a Wednesday report. The covert access operation that researchers call “Silent Train” isn’t a standalone network, but rather a series of compromised small office home office (SOHO) routers, internet of things (IoT) devices and enterprise infrastructure that Volt Typhoon has rapidly rotated through since late 2023.  The Chinese threat group has used this chain of short-lived compromised infrastructure to exploit additional vulnerabilities, including zero-days, in network edge devices and gain deeper, persistent access into victim networks, researchers said.  “Individual chains are assembled and dismantled every day, with infrastructure continually refreshed,” Michael Horka, principal information security engineer at Black Lotus Labs, told CyberScoop. “Volt Typhoon demonstrated a repeatable capability to rebuild a new chain with different infrastructure in less than two minutes, making the number of nodes at any one moment effectively close to zero.” Black Lotus Labs has notified hundreds of victims since it first identified Silent Train activity, including telecom providers, government entities, defense contractors, communication services, universities and IT firms. Other victims spanning critical infrastructure include organizations in the water, energy, transportation, maritime, rail, aviation and emergency services sectors. “The ephemeral nature of the framework means our observations should not be interpreted as a complete census of Volt Typhoon activity,” said Horka, who also was the lead researcher on the report. The nation-state group’s investment in operational security and preserving access is remarkable, according to Black Lotus Labs. “We observed infrastructure assembled in under two minutes, sessions averaging roughly four hours, extensive cleanup, compartmentalization and continued development of new access vectors,” Horka said. “That is considerable effort devoted not even to get into their end targets, but purely to making important operations difficult to discover and trace.” Volt Typhoon relied more heavily on Silent Train after the FBI and Justice Department disrupted the KV Botnet in early 2024, researchers said. Earlier this year, U.S. and global authorities warned about a widespread shift in Chinese hacking groups’ use of covert networks riding on compromised common devices. The reach of those efforts is extensive and ongoing. Volt Typhoon has exploited and abused more than 27 device classes in Silent Train operations, including edge devices, enterprise management tools, identity and access management systems, networking infrastructure and other technologies.  “The diversity matters, but the discipline matters even more,” Horka said. “Specific device types were consistently reserved for particular positions in the chain. It operated less like a collection of randomly compromised devices and more like an organized inventory of capabilities.” The threat group has successfully compromised devices and technologies from Fortinet, Cisco, ManageEngine, Ivanti, F5, Check Point, Palo Alto Networks, ServiceNow, TP-Link, Netgear and ArcGIS, researchers said. Black Lotus Labs also observed confirmed zero-day campaigns targeting Versa Director, N-Able N-Central, Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN and VeloCloud Orchestrator.  “The exploitation patterns, victimology, and geographic targeting observed throughout our investigation point to a sustained focus on communications, defense, government, and critical infrastructure environments of enduring strategic value,” Black Lotus Labs researchers wrote in the report. “Through repeated targeting of centralized management platforms and control-plane technologies, Silent Train shows how Volt Typhoon systematically pursues and preserves access to some of the most consequential networks in the United States.” Silent Train’s ephemerality and operational discipline means it can’t be measured in size. These attributes also make it “fundamentally difficult to disrupt because there isn’t one network to take down,” Horka said.  “What exists today will be completely different tomorrow,” he added. “You can try to remove individual pieces, but removing the actor’s ability to continuously rebuild them is a much harder problem to solve.” The post Researchers uncover Volt Typhoon’s covert, ephemeral network appeared first on CyberScoop .

title: Lockheed Martin Showcases 1000 km PrSM Inc 4 Prototype
zh_title: 洛克希德·马丁公司展示 1000 公里 PrSM Inc 4 原型机
summary: 洛克希德·马丁公司的精确打击导弹 (PrSM) Increment 4 原型机将使用冲压发动机技术和先进的传感器套件来打击 1000 公里外的移动船只。 “随着威胁在全球战区不断演变，陆军需要一种现代化的精确导弹，其射程远远超出当前能力。当从 HIMARS 发射器发射时，PrSM Increment 4 预计将击中至少 1,000 公里外的移动海上和可重新定位的陆地目标，”洛克希德·马丁公司的新闻稿中写道。根据周一发布的消息，洛克希德·马丁公司提交的 PrSM Inc 4 原型机将
content:
洛克希德·马丁公司的精确打击导弹 (PrSM) Increment 4 原型机将使用冲压发动机技术和先进的传感器套件来打击 1000 公里外的移动船只。 “随着威胁在全球战区不断演变，陆军需要一种现代化的精确导弹，其射程远远超出当前能力。当从 HIMARS 发射器发射时，PrSM Increment 4 预计将击中至少 1,000 公里外的移动海上和可重新定位的陆地目标，”洛克希德·马丁公司的新闻稿中写道。根据周一发布的消息，洛克希德·马丁公司提交的 PrSM Inc 4 原型机将使用 L3Harris 的推进系统和现有的制导系统。该公司的Strigo产品中心是一个专门开发数据链、频率传感器和导弹导引头的部门，其工作将为该弹药的制导套件提供信息。该声明强调了 PrSM Inc 1 的“经过战斗验证”的制导和控制系统。这是指该导弹在史诗愤怒行动中针对伊朗目标的交战。洛克希德·马丁公司目前位于阿肯色州卡姆登的 PrSM Inc 1 和 2 导弹生产线可以支持该公司 Inc 4 产品的生产。根据新闻稿，使用现有生产线将实现“所有版本导弹的规模经济”。这家美国防务公司是美国陆军选择参与远程海上打击计划的五家公司之一。
洛克希德·马丁公司的原型机将与 Anduril、Castelion、Mach Industries 和 RTX 提交的材料进行对比。2027 年和 2028 年的测试将为陆军的最终裁决提供依据。源自地面部队的作战需求，PrSM Inc 4将成为华盛顿针对中国的地面反舰能力的关键组成部分。美军计划通过 M142 高机动火箭炮系统等发射器使中国军队受到来自第一岛链群岛的威胁。加拿大和澳大利亚还计划在其 HIMARS 发射器上部署海上打击 PrSM 变体。洛克希德·马丁公司展示 1000 公里 PrSM Inc 4 原型机的帖子首先出现在《海军新闻》上。

【原文 English Original】
Lockheed Martin’s Precision Strike Missile (PrSM) Increment 4 prototype will use ramjet technology and an advanced sensor suite to strike moving ships over 1,000 kilometers away. “As threats evolve throughout the global theater, the Army needs a modernized precision missile that can perform at ranges far beyond current capabilities. When fired from a HIMARS launcher, PrSM Increment 4 is expected to hit both moving maritime and relocatable land targets at least 1,000 km away,” reads the Lockheed Martin release. According to a Monday release, Lockheed Martin’s PrSM Inc 4 prototype submission will use a propulsion system from L3Harris and existing guidance systems. Work from company’s Strigo Product Center, a department specializing in the development of data links, frequency sensors and missile seekers, will inform the munition’s guidance suite. The statement highlighted the “battle-proven” guidance and control systems from PrSM Inc 1. This is in reference to the missile’s engagements during Operation Epic Fury against Iranian targets. Lockheed Martin’s current PrSM Inc 1 and 2 missile production line at Camden, Arkansas, can support the production of the firm’s Inc 4 offering. According to the release, the use of existing lines will achieve “economies of scale for all versions of the missile.” The American defense firm is one of five companies down selected by the U.S. Army for the extended-range maritime strike program. Lockheed Martin’s prototype will go against submissions from Anduril, Castelion, Mach Industries and RTX. Tests in 2027 and 2028 will inform the Army’s final award. Derived from the ground branch’s operational needs , PrSM Inc 4 will form a key component of Washington’s ground-based anti-shipping capabilities against China. From launchers such as the M142 High Mobility Rocket Artillery System, U.S. forces plan to hold Chinese forces under threat from archipelagos in the First Island Chain. Canada and Australia also plan to field maritime strike PrSM variants on their HIMARS launchers. The post Lockheed Martin Showcases 1000 km PrSM Inc 4 Prototype appeared first on Naval News .

Chinese President Xi Jinping on Tuesday ⁠extended condolences to the family of former Japanese Prime Minister Yasuo Fukuda, who died last week, while calling on Japan’s current leadership to “safeguard the political foundation” of ties that have been ​strained since late last year.

Fukuda, who died on Thursday ‌from heart ‌failure at the age of 90, used ​his brief period in office to seek closer ties with Asian neighbors, particularly China, with which relations have periodically ⁠been tense.

Fukuda was a Japanese politician of integrity and responsibility, as well ⁠as an old friend of the Chinese people, Xi said in his message, according to ​the state-run Xinhua news agency. ⁠Fukuda “upheld a correct view of history,” Xi said.

The comments were a rare direct ⁠reference by ​the Chinese leader to the relationship between ​the two countries since it deteriorated late last year.

Ties ​between ‌China and Japan sank to their worst levels in years after current Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi angered Beijing in November 2025 by suggesting that Japan ‌could deploy its military if a Chinese move against neighboring Taiwan also threatened its territory.

Beijing called Takaichi’s remarks “egregious” and demanded that she retract them. China has advised its citizens against travel to ​Japan, ​while also banning exports to Japan of ​items that can have a military application, including some ⁠rare earths.

In his message on Tuesday, Xi said he “hopes Japan’s current leaders to cherish the hard work and efforts made by the older generation of politicians, abide by ​the four political documents between China and Japan, and earnestly safeguard the political foundation of bilateral relations.”

China would remember Fukuda’s contributions to China-Japan relations and to Asia’s development, Xi added.
