title: 五中全会北京戒备森严 访民遭疯狂截访
summary: 五中全会期间，北京警察搜查访民。（访民提供） 【大纪元2026年10月28日讯】（大纪元记者钟元、洪宁采访报导）每逢中共重大会议，北京街头就异常紧张。如今，随着五中全会召开，街头安保森严。大街小巷、桥头路口、车站周边，到处有人巡查、盘问，对上访者拦访截访。北京市民表示，街头不仅出现了民兵巡查，还到处可见由街道老人组成的“小脚侦缉队”。 北京街头气氛紧张 民兵、街道大妈全上岗 北京市民惠女士对大纪元表示，今年自“十一”以来，尤其是五中全会期间，北京街头的安保戒备比往年更严厉。
content: 五中全会期间，北京警察搜查访民。（访民提供） 【大纪元2026年10月28日讯】（大纪元记者钟元、洪宁采访报导）每逢中共重大会议，北京街头就异常紧张。如今，随着五中全会召开，街头安保森严。大街小巷、桥头路口、车站周边，到处有人巡查、盘问，对上访者拦访截访。北京市民表示，街头不仅出现了民兵巡查，还到处可见由街道老人组成的“小脚侦缉队”。 北京街头气氛紧张 民兵、街道大妈全上岗 北京市民惠女士对大纪元表示，今年自“十一”以来，尤其是五中全会期间，北京街头的安保戒备比往年更严厉。 她说，有些保安改穿绿装，他们自称是民兵。还有六七十岁的老人组成的“小脚侦缉队”，穿蓝衬衫，戴着袖标，“满街都是，现在已经是全民动员了，全都上岗了”。 在京访民陈女士（化名）表示，她看到在街上到处是穿迷彩服的年轻人，街头巷尾还安装了不少新的摄像头，“气氛紧张”。 严控访民 警方搜查抓人 据惠女士介绍，每逢敏感日，都有北京当地的维权人士被警察送到外地控制起来。此次五中全会期间，为了躲避骚扰，有几人离家出走。“属地都快急疯了，有的报到市公安局了。他们太紧张了，北京街头到处都有盘查，尤其对访民更是严加管控。” 惠女士的楼下也有人24小时蹲守监控，长年不撤岗。“我已被禁止进入二环，前门、天安门那一带。北京上网的网民有的（因网上言论）被带走的，有的在家管控的。假如你在网上说什么东西，地方就打压你，或者给你刑拘。” 据陈女士介绍，访民集中住宿的房山大东村，今年遭到警方连续搜查、抓人。“他们就是截访、拦访，到处找人，抓走了很多人。” 惠女士也表示，“北京老出事，不断有访民跳河、自杀，报复社会的也特别多。现在把老百姓当成暴徒了，太可怕了。” 今年7月中共国家信访局实施新规《关于进一步规范群众来访登记工作的办法》，让无数访民陷入伸冤无望的绝境。不断传出有人喝药、跳入永定河自杀的消息。 据访民介绍，当局为了防止上访者爬树喊冤，在北京信访局接待处附近的树干上，都安装了带刺的铁片。 不仅在北京，外地访民进京上访途中也面临截访和遣返。重庆访民肖成林在石家庄站被维稳办人员强行带走，送回老家。 街道两旁的树上安装了带刺的铁片。（访民提供） 各地访民遭严控 上海访民家属受骚扰 上海访民沈艳秋对大纪元表示，10月27日早上，她的女儿接到一男子的骚扰电话。沈艳秋将电话回拨过去，对方自称是上海市虹口区凉城街道办事处平安办的，并让她下午去平安办。 当天下午，沈艳秋到平安办见到了该男子，但平安办主任却称不认识此人。 沈艳秋表示，平安办是负责维稳的。“这肯定与开五中全会有关，我抗议对我女儿的骚扰。”

title: Chip Industry Week In Review
zh_title: 芯片行业周回顾
source: 半导体工程 SemiEngineering（制造/封装）
summary: AI内存和容量 SK海力士预计内存供应限制将持续到2030年，DRAM和HBM销量实际上会在2029年售完。三星预计到2028年内存供应将吃紧，理由是晶圆厂建设和设备交付周期较长、芯片更大、下一代HBM工艺复杂性更高，以及DRAM容量向HBM转移。三星表示，其 2027 年 HBM 供应已售罄。据报道，SK 海力士的美国子公司 Solidigm 正在与美国商务部讨论拟议的 45B 美元 NAND 闪存工厂。中国长鑫存储计划很快开始限量生产
content:
AI内存和容量 SK海力士预计内存供应限制将持续到2030年，DRAM和HBM销量实际上会在2029年售完。三星预计到2028年内存供应将吃紧，理由是晶圆厂建设和设备交付周期较长、芯片更大、下一代HBM工艺复杂性更高，以及DRAM容量向HBM转移。三星表示，其 2027 年 HBM 供应已售罄。据报道，SK 海力士的美国子公司 Solidigm 正在与美国商务部讨论拟议的 45B 美元 NAND 闪存工厂。据路透社报道，中国长鑫存储计划很快开始限量生产 HBM3E 内存，尽管产量仅为 20% 至 30%。 Anthropic 在其 IPO 文件中警告称，HBM 短缺和台积电有限的制造能力可能会限制人工智能的扩张。先进封装 ASE 预计其先进封装收入将在 2027 年翻一番，Amkor 正在大力推进新的高密度扇出和 2.5D 封装项目。据报道，由于人工智能需求继续对先进封装产能造成压力，台积电正在考虑将 CoWoS 的价格上涨 20%。应用材料公司计划将其在 Besi 的股份增加至约 20%，深化战略合作伙伴关系，将业务范围从混合键合扩展到新的互连架构和人工智能先进封装技术。制造 英特尔代工厂报告第三季度的制造执行有所改善，称 18A 的良率和周期时间有所改善。
该公司还在 10 月份发布了 14A 0.9 PDK，并表示将继续吸引 18A-P 和 14A 左右的潜在外部客户，同时推进其 EMIB-T 先进封装技术。英飞凌计划到 2034 年在奥地利菲拉赫工厂投资 1.1B 欧元，建立欧洲首个在 300mm 晶圆上生产下一代 GaN 功率半导体的大批量制造工厂。随着先进封装和硅光子学需求的增长，联华电子额外批准了 3.2B 美元的资本支出，以加速其在新加坡和台南的产能扩张。 Lam Research 和imec 扩大了在先进 3D 集成、下一代内存和高数值孔径 EUV 图案化方面的合作。这项工作包括用于先进封装的沉积、蚀刻和等离子切割工艺，以及 Lam 的 Aether 干阻技术。 AI 工具和加速器 Cadence 推出了一系列用于代理芯片和系统设计的领域专用 AI 模型。该产品组合与 Cadence 的 EDA 工具集成，涵盖多种模型大小和架构，结合了经过培训的法学硕士、决策模型和自我改进的代理技能。 Arm 为代理 AI 引入了新的 CPU 基准测试方法。该框架使用可重复的测量和端到端任务结果来评估代理工作负载的 CPU 性能，包括工具执行、编排和推理。
据 The Information 报道，谷歌正在扩大其定制人工智能加速器的覆盖范围，据报道 OpenAI 计划购买其 TPU。另外，甲骨文将从 2027 年开始通过其云基础设施提供谷歌的 TPU，并计划在 2027 年秋季添加 Arm 的 AGI CPU。博通的 XPU 和网络设备将从 2027 年开始支持 Anthropic 的人工智能基础设施扩张，融资安排为 63B 美元。 Meta 正在其数据中心扩大 Nvidia 和 AMD AI 基础设施的部署，两家芯片制造商也持有该公司的股份。交易和资金英特尔计划收购自动量子算法合成开发商 Classiq

【原文 English Original】
AI memory and capacity SK hynix expects memory supply constraints to persist through 2030 , with DRAM and HBM volumes effectively sold out through 2029. Samsung expects tight memory supply through 2028 , citing lengthy fab construction and equipment lead times, larger dies, and greater process complexity in next-gen HBM, as well as a shift of DRAM capacity toward HBM. Samsung said its 2027 HBM supply is already sold out. Solidigm , SK hynix’s U.S. subsidiary, reportedly is discussing a proposed $45B NAND flash fab with the U.S. Commerce Department. China’s CXMT plans to soon begin limited production of HBM3E memory , despite manufacturing yields of just 20% to 30%, per Reuters. Anthropic warned in its IPO filing that HBM shortages and limited TSMC manufacturing capacity could constrain AI expansion. Advanced packaging ASE forecasts a doubling of its advanced-packaging revenue in 2027, and Amkor is ramping new high-density fan-out and 2.5D packaging programs. TSMC reportedly is considering a 20% price increase for CoWoS as AI demand continues to strain advanced-packaging capacity. Applied Materials plans to increase its stake in Besi to ~20%, deepening a strategic partnership that is expanding beyond hybrid bonding into new interconnect architectures and advanced packaging technologies for AI. Manufacturing Intel Foundry reported improving manufacturing execution in Q3, citing better yields and cycle times on 18A. The company also released its 14A 0.9 PDK in October and said it continues to engage prospective external customers around 18A-P and 14A, while advancing its EMIB-T advanced-packaging technology. Infineon plans to invest €1.1B through 2034 at its Villach, Austria facility to establish Europe’s first high-volume manufacturing facility for next-gen GaN power semiconductors on 300mm wafers. UMC approved an additional $3.2B in capital spending to accelerate its capacity expansion in Singapore and Tainan as demand grows for advanced packaging and silicon photonics. Lam Research and imec expanded their collaboration on advanced 3D integration, next-gen memory, and high-NA EUV patterning. The work includes deposition, etch, and plasma dicing processes for advanced packaging, along with Lam’s Aether dry resist technology. AI tools and accelerators Cadence introduced a portfolio of domain-specialized AI models for agentic chip and system design. Integrated with Cadence’s EDA tools, the portfolio spans multiple model sizes and architectures, combining post-trained LLMs, decision models, and self-improving agent skills. Arm introduced a new CPU benchmarking methodology for agentic AI . The framework evaluates CPU performance across agentic workloads, including tool execution, orchestration, and reasoning, using repeatable measurements and end-to-end task outcomes. Google is expanding the reach of its custom AI accelerators, with OpenAI reportedly planning to purchase its TPUs , reports The Information. Separately, Oracle will offer Google’s TPUs through its cloud infrastructure beginning in 2027 and plans to add Arm ’s AGI CPUs in fall 2027. Broadcom’ s XPUs and networking equipment will support Anthropic ‘s AI infrastructure expansion, beginning in 2027, under a $63B financing arrangement. Meta is expanding deployments of Nvidia and AMD AI infrastructure across its data centers, with both chipmakers also taking stakes in the company. Deals and funding Intel plans to acquire Classiq , a developer of automated quantum algorithm synthesis software. Intel says the acquisition will give it a full stack of quantum offerings, adding to its silicon spin-qubit technology and manufacturing. FuriosaAI raised $620M to scale production of its AI inference accelerator . Unconventional AI plans to acquire NeuReality . Unconfirmed : Marvell is reportedly in advanced talks to acquire optical components maker Lumentum , per Bloomberg. Onsemi reportedly is in talks to acquire Ferric , a startup developing integrated voltage regulators for AI processors, for nearly $1B, according to The Information. Earnings Quarterly revenue and % growth versus the same quarter in the prior year , unless otherwise indicated: Advantest : ¥477.7B, up 82% , with robust tester demand for AI. Amkor : Net income $191M, up 50% , due to a richer mix of high-value advanced packaging . ASE: NT$244.2B, up 45% . Cadence : $1.6B, up 22% , with a record backlog of $8.2B. Intel : $16.5B, up 21% , with 78% data center and AI sales and foundry revenue up 58%. Rambus: Record $218M, up 22% . Samsung : KRW 195.3T, up 127% , major ramp in HBM4. SK hynix : Record KRW 104.6T, up 328% . Teradyne: $1.3B, up 70% , with record memory and systems test revenue. UMC : NT$74.2B, up ~25.6% , with fab utilization reaching 92%. Quick Links To More News In-Depth — Systems & Design newsletter, imec’s optical interconnects report, CPO test, and how much can semiconductor models hide. Global — Supply-chain coordination, U.S.–Europe research partnerships, equipment manufacturing shifts, and Asian fab investments. New Technologies — AI power delivery, agentic chip design, photonics, analog IMC, and vehicle power. Security — New CWE HW weakness, UEFI and BMC flaws, PQC roadmap, and RF-fingerprinting. Trending Video — Leveraging patterns in formal verification to reach sign-off faster. Research — Faster chip simulation, ultrathin memory materials, in-sensor computing, and solar-cell advances. Quantum Hardware — Multi-chip quantum processors, faster qubit gates, on-chip quantum light sources, and spin qubits. Workforce | Education — AI in engineering education, VR-based fab training, and expanding university semiconductor workforce programs. Events and Webinars — Micro 2026, PIC Summit, full-chip curvilinear patterning, and functional verification study. Global Asia Vietnam ‘s first semiconductor fab may miss its 2027 trial-production target , according to Reuters. The estimated US$1.3B Viettel project reportedly has yet to begin construction, while negotiations for ASML lithography equipment remain unresolved. Viettel maintains the project is on schedule. South Korea’s PSK is planning a new US$125M semiconductor equipment manufacturing facility in Yongin’s semiconductor cluster. Americas ITIF says the U.S.-led Pax Silica initiative has grown to 26 countries, coordinating on semiconductors, critical minerals, energy, advanced manufacturing, and AI infrastructure to reduce dependence on vulnerable supply chains. Imec and Indiana University formed a semiconductor research partnership focused on advanced electronics, photonics, and workforce development. Initial research will test imec-developed electronic and photonic components in extreme environments, including space. Cadence will provide U.S. Department of Energy National Laboratories with access to EDA, SDA, multiphysics simulation, digital twins, advanced packaging, and 3D-IC workflows, along with technical expertise. Europe SUSS MicroTec will consolidate semiconductor equipment production in Zhubei, Taiwan, and Sternenfels, Germany, and end manufacturing at its Garching facility near Munich. In-Depth Semiconductor Engineering published the Systems and Design newsletter , including: Special Report : AI Raises The Bar For Tomorrow’s Engineers Auto-Generation Of Properties: Methodology Insertion Rethinking Shift Left In Chip Design Plus : The imec Report : Scaling Optical Interconnects For The AI Era Bringing Down Test Costs For Co-Packaged Optics How Much Can Semiconductor Models Hide ? New Technologies Chip design and verification ChipAgents is expanding its agentic AI platform across digital and analog chip design with a neural engine that combines persistent design knowledge, advanced reasoning and orchestration, dynamic model routing, and physics-aware models. It will also work with Nvidia to fine-tune Nemotron models. Axiomise and Agnisys teamed up to verify NoCs using formal technologies. AI power delivery Infineon introduced new AI power-delivery technologies, including a ±400 V/800 V rack power-distribution reference board, a 5.6 kW M-CRPS reference design, and 900 V monolithic bidirectional GaN switches for solid-state transformers in AI data centers. Compute, memory and photonics PsiQuantum demonstrated an 8×8 optical circuit switch built on silicon photonics for AI infrastructure. TetraMem taped out a 12nm analog in-memory computing SoC based on multi-level RRAM and developed using Synopsys ‘ cloud EDA tools. Fraunhofer IIS integrated permanent micromagnets directly into the silicon substrate of a magnetic sensor chip at wafer level. Automotive Infineon introduced a chip-embedding platform for high-voltage power electronics, LinearFET technology for solid-state power distribution in EVs and SDVs, new MOSFETs for 12 V and 48 V vehicle systems, and a high-voltage BMS reference design. STMicro released an automotive safety sensor platform that combines accelerometers and gyroscopes for ADAS and vehicle-safety applications. Bosch debuted a new MEMS inertial sensor platform, combining ADAS and vehicle-safety functions up to ASIL D. Research TU Munich researchers developed neural-network-based transistor models for 3nm nanosheet devices, accelerating standard-cell library characterization by up to 8× compared with a conventional compact model. The models kept delay-estimation errors below 0.11%. A Brown University -led team demonstrated ultrathin multiferroic films that retain ferroelectric and magnetic properties at thicknesses of just a few angstroms, overcoming the dead-layer effect in bismuth ferrite. The films also exhibited altermagnetic properties, potentially enabling low-power memory and logic devices. Chinese Academy of Sciences -led researchers developed a III-nitride-based in-sensor computing device that uses interfacial polarization to separate photogenerated carriers and reduce recombination losses. The sensor-memristor achieved responsivity on the order of 10⁶ A/W, an on/off ratio of 10⁵, and maintained high performance at temperatures up to 300°C. University of Oxford -led researchers identified a pseudo-direct semiconductor in bismuth sulfide that combines strong light absorption with slower electron–hole recombination. Its unusual electronic structure was estimated to reduce recombination rates by about 75% at room temperature compared with conventional semiconductors with similarly strong absorption, potentially improving solar-cell efficiency. Security MITRE ’s CWE Program released CWE 5.0 , adding new weaknesses, including Hardware Simulation/Synthesis Mismatch . The new hardware weakness covers security-relevant cases where RTL behaves differently after synthesis, potentially exposing data, altering protected state, or bypassing security controls in the resulting hardware. Alerts and hacks TianoCore disclosed a critical vulnerability in its widely used EDK II UEFI firmware. The memory-corruption flaw could allow an unauthenticated network attacker to execute code during PXE boot, before the OS loads and before Secure Boot or measured boot can verify any OS component. Supermicro disclosed nine BMC firmware vulnerabilities across two Oct. 26 advisories, including a critical flaw that could let an unauthenticated network attacker execute arbitrary IPMI commands on an active session. The disclosures also cover privilege-escalation, key-exposure, memory-access, and command-injection flaws. Keystone said a breach exposed a key used to authenticate its hardware wallets , potentially allowing counterfeit devices to pass authenticity checks. The company is destroying 18,835 unsold devices containing the compromised key. Government security news NIST finalized its road map for transitioning to PQC , identifying the quantum-vulnerable standards that federal systems and technology providers will need to replace with quantum-resistant algorithms. NIST also explained its RF-fingerprinting technique for detecting hardware tampering , using subtle differences in devices’ radio emissions to identify altered or substituted components with more than 95% accuracy in testing. New capabilities and tools Eclypsium and Nvidia demonstrated how a compromised privileged component in AI compute infrastructure could alter model weights and outputs during live inference without modifying the stored model. Altera introduced its Agilex 2X FPGA and SoC portfolio with a hardware root of trust, secure boot and attestation , PQC-ready crypto, and line-rate encryption for Ethernet, PCIe and memory. Google introduced Gemini 4 Carbon , its latest frontier model with cybersecurity capabilities. Security technical papers Fault Vulnerability of HW Malware Detectors ( UC Davis et al) Detection & classification of RISC-V HW exploits using ML ( UPC ) Bringing Hardware Security Education to All ( U. of Kansas, UF et al.) Provably Secure Data Memory-Dependent Prefetching ( DistriNet, KU Leuven ) Rowhammer attack on Fil-C’s software capabilities (Independent researcher and U. Sussex ) Trending Video Why Proof Convergence Matters : Leveraging patterns in formal verification to reach sign-off faster. Ashish Darbari, CEO of Axiomise , talks about the impact of functional interactions involving safety and security, where to look for common patterns to prevent bugs from creeping into these designs, and how this all can be used to reduce time to sign-off with higher coverage. Quantum Hardware IBM demonstrated four interconnects linking two Nighthawk quantum processors , achieving 99% average quantum state-transfer fidelity and 94.75% two-qubit gate fidelity, advancing modular quantum computing. NVision Quantum demonstrated a single-molecule spin-photon interface and partnered with HyperLight to integrate molecular qubits onto photonic chips using established semiconductor fabrication processes. FZ Jülich -led researchers demonstrated 6.8-nanosecond single-qubit gates on a superconducting transmon, achieving 99.981% and 99.989% fidelity. Precision pulse shaping suppressed unwanted transitions, keeping leakage below 0.002% per operation. A Technical University of Denmark team demonstrated integrated quantum light sources using 2D materials , coupling WSe₂ single-photon emitters to WS₂ waveguides on a chip, with an estimated minimum waveguide-coupled rate of 1.68 million photons per second. Workforce, Education In a new special report, Semiconductor Engineering examines how AI is changing the skills tomorrow’s engineers will need, with universities placing greater emphasis on strong math and physics fundamentals, critical thinking, and the ability to validate AI-generated results. Semiconductor employers say graduates will need both AI fluency and enough technical depth to recognize when AI gets things wrong. Northeastern University developed a VR and holographic training platform for semiconductor manufacturing that lets one student operate a simulated nanofabrication furnace used to grow nanowires while other students follow the process on a 3D display. UCSD and TSMC launched a new hands-on semiconductor training program for undergraduates. title: Lynas locks in price floors as revenue jumps 55%
zh_title: 莱纳斯锁定价格下限，收入猛增 55%
source: MINING.COM 全球矿业（稀土/关键矿产）
summary: 澳大利亚莱纳斯稀土公司（ASX：LYC；美国场外交易市场代码：LYSCF、LYSDY）已获得涵盖其一半以上产量的最低价格协议，因为制造商为中国境外的供应支付溢价。该公司周四表示，截至 9 月 30 日的三个月内，平均售价上涨 88%，达到创纪录的每公斤 102.1 澳元（合 72 美元），收入增长 55% 至 3.101 亿澳元（合 2.18 亿美元）。销量同比下降 18%。莱纳斯表示，定价上涨反映了市场价格、溢价以及轻重稀土捆绑销售的走强。 “原始设备制造商有一个真正的战略来确保部分产品的安全。
content:
澳大利亚莱纳斯稀土公司（ASX：LYC；美国场外交易市场代码：LYSCF、LYSDY）已获得涵盖其一半以上产量的最低价格协议，因为制造商为中国境外的供应支付溢价。该公司周四表示，截至 9 月 30 日的三个月内，平均售价上涨 88%，达到创纪录的每公斤 102.1 澳元（合 72 美元），收入增长 55% 至 3.101 亿澳元（合 2.18 亿美元）。销量同比下降 18%。莱纳斯表示，定价上涨反映了市场价格、溢价以及轻重稀土捆绑销售的走强。临时首席执行官 Pol Le Roux 在周四的电话会议上对分析师表示：“原始设备制造商有一个真正的战略，可以从中国境外确保部分供应。”他指的是原始设备制造商。随着制造商寻求替代供应商，这些合同为莱纳斯提供了一些保护，使其免受中国价格波动的影响。但以商业规模可靠地分离稀土对于中国以外的新兴供应链来说仍然是一个挑战。莱纳斯股价周四在悉尼上涨 4.2%，周五下跌 7.1%，至 12.10 澳元，该公司估值约为 122 亿澳元。停产压力莱纳斯本季度销售了 3,039 吨稀土氧化物，产量为 4,254 吨，同比增长 7%。用于永磁体的氧化钕镨产量创下季度记录 2,082 吨。 Le Roux 将产销之间的差距部分归因于 9 月底的强劲产量，而这些产量在季度末之前无法开具发票。
分析师敦促对钕镨销售进行细分，以区分产品结构的变化和价格上涨；他表示莱纳斯将寻求在未来的报告中提供这一细节。莱纳斯没有在季度报告中披露其底价。由于其马来西亚工厂关闭约一个月进行维护，产量预计将在 12 月份季度下降。西澳大利亚州的卡尔古利也面临着大约两周的电力网络升级关闭。 Le Roux 表示，莱纳斯的库存（包括其日本经销商持有的材料）应该能够在停工期间维持客户供应。该公司计划进行修改，以缓解加工瓶颈并提高设备可靠性，预计截至 2027 年 3 月和 6 月的季度产量将有所增加。莱纳斯正在使用镝和铽供应来帮助与购买钕和镨的磁铁制造商建立长期关系。 Le Roux 表示，将轻稀土和重稀土结合起来，可以让客户从一个供应商那里获得更多所需的材料。截至 9 月底，莱纳斯拥有 12.1 亿澳元现金和短期存款。巴西收购 本月早些时候，Lynas 同意以 9.68 亿澳元的价格收购 Meteoric Resources（ASX：MEI；US-OTC：METOF）。拟议的全股权收购将增加巴西东南部波苏斯迪卡尔达斯附近的 Caldeira 稀土项目。完成仍有待股东、法院和监管机构的批准。
莱纳斯在西澳大利亚经营韦尔德山矿，在卡尔古利加工材料，并在马来西亚分离稀土。初步计划是在卡尔代拉生产混合稀土碳酸盐，然后运往马来西亚进行分离。一项工程审查正在研究卡尔代拉如何适应莱纳斯的处理网络。勒鲁表示，首要任务是降低采矿和加工成本，并尽快将项目投入生产。

【原文 English Original】
Australia’s Lynas Rare Earths (ASX: LYC; US-OTC: LYSCF, LYSDY) has secured minimum-price agreements covering more than half its production as manufacturers pay premiums for supplies outside China. Average selling prices jumped 88% to a record A$102.1 ($72) per kg in the three months to Sept. 30, lifting revenue 55% to A$310.1 million ($218 million), the company said Thursday. Sales volumes fell 18% from a year earlier. The pricing gains reflected stronger market prices, premiums and the bundling of light and heavy rare earths, Lynas said. “There is a real strategy from OEMs to secure part of their supply from outside China,” interim CEO Pol Le Roux told analysts on a call Thursday, referring to original equipment manufacturers. The contracts give Lynas some protection from Chinese price swings as manufacturers seek alternative suppliers. But separating rare earths reliably at commercial scale remains a challenge for the emerging supply chain outside China. Lynas shares rose 4.2% Thursday in Sydney, then fell 7.1% Friday to A$12.10, valuing the company at about A$12.2 billion. Shutdown pressure Lynas sold 3,039 tonnes of rare earth oxides during the quarter while producing 4,254 tonnes, up 7% from a year earlier. Output of neodymium-praseodymium oxide, used in permanent magnets, reached a quarterly record of 2,082 tonnes. Le Roux attributed the gap between production and sales partly to strong output late in September that couldn’t be invoiced before quarter-end. Analysts pressed for a breakdown of neodymium-praseodymium sales to distinguish changes in product mix from stronger prices; he said Lynas would seek to provide that detail in future reports. Lynas didn’t disclose its floor prices in the quarterly release. Production is set to fall in the December quarter as its Malaysian plant shuts for about a month of maintenance. Kalgoorlie, in Western Australia, also faces a roughly two-week shutdown for electricity-network upgrades. Inventories, including material held by its Japanese distributor, should allow Lynas to maintain customer supplies during the stoppages, Le Roux said. The company plans modifications to relieve processing bottlenecks and improve equipment reliability, with stronger production expected in the quarters ending March and June 2027. Lynas is using dysprosium and terbium supplies to help secure longer-term relationships with magnet makers buying neodymium and praseodymium. Combining light and heavy rare earths gives customers more of the materials they need from one supplier, Le Roux said. Lynas ended September with A$1.21 billion in cash and short-term deposits. Brazil acquisition Earlier this month, Lynas agreed to buy Meteoric Resources (ASX: MEI; US-OTC: METOF) in a deal valued at A$968 million. The proposed all-share acquisition would add the Caldeira rare earths project near Poços de Caldas in southeastern Brazil. Completion remains subject to shareholder, court and regulatory approvals. Lynas operates the Mt Weld mine in Western Australia, processes material at Kalgoorlie and separates rare earths in Malaysia. The initial plan is to produce mixed rare earth carbonate at Caldeira and send it to Malaysia for separation. An engineering review is examining how Caldeira could fit Lynas’ processing network. The priorities were to reduce costs across mining and processing and bring the project into production as quickly as possible, Le Roux said.

title: 孙悟空爱上林黛玉：中国AI短剧怎么成了“不当婚恋”
source: 美国已不是世界老大 - 纽约时报中文网

content:
一段人工智能生成视频的画面截图，画面中的孙悟空和林黛玉分别出自中国古典名著《西游记》和《红楼梦》。这两部作品均于上世纪80年代被改编成电视剧。
近几周，一系列温馨治愈的视频在中国互联网上引发热议。视频中，身穿黄色练功服的孙悟空与一位身披绣花绸缎的少女手牵着手，在沙滩和郁郁葱葱的林间小道上嬉戏。他们一起坐过山车，还在灯笼点亮的夜市里品尝冰淇淋。
这对意想不到的情侣是孙悟空和林黛玉，分别来自中国古典名著《西游记》和《红楼梦》，它们都在上世纪80年代被改编成电视剧。
此前，这两个人物从未在文学作品中或荧屏上相遇。他们的爱情故事由粉丝杜撰，有人使用人工智能，有人则把老版电视剧的片段剪辑在一起。
这些视频虽然受到中国观众的欢迎，却也引起了当局的注意。他们认为，将来自不同世界的人物放在一起，太过天马行空。
本月，中共机关报《人民日报》发表评论文章，承认改写人物命运具有吸引力，但同时警告，这可能损害原著的精神内核。《西游记》和《红楼梦》位列中国四大古典名著。评论呼吁划定红线，禁止那些“调侃英雄……的恶意篡改”视频。
根据政府要求清理“扭曲”原著精神、颠覆角色设定的AI魔改视频的指令，多家网络平台在10月表示，已下架数千条将孙悟空和林黛玉塑造成情侣的视频。其中一家平台称，两人之间存在“不当婚恋关联”。
这两部20世纪80年代的电视剧改编作品是中国千禧一代的童年记忆，剧中人物因不循常规、不受世俗束缚的性格深受喜爱。两部原著小说也曾多次被改编成电影和戏曲。
《西游记》中的美猴王孙悟空是一个不受约束的角色，陪伴着一位天真淳朴的僧人踏上追求涅槃的旅程。他常常与天庭众神发生冲突。
《红楼梦》中的林黛玉自幼失去双亲，被有钱的亲戚收养。她多愁善感、体弱多病，常常以带着怨气的言语反唇相讥。最终，她深爱的人被安排迎娶另一名女子，而她心碎而死。
英国曼彻斯特大学社会学讲师葛亮表示，中国政府要求人们以尊崇的态度诠释经典作品。尽管这些小说历来不断被改编，但这些再创作似乎越过了那条界限。
葛亮还说，视频平台快手使用“不当婚恋关联”这一说法颇能说明问题。在他看来，当局似乎担心的是“大规模未经授权地创作亲密关系叙事”。
一些经典改编作品得到了共产党的鼓励。中国领导人习近平一直呼吁复兴传统文化，称古典文学与革命英雄一道，构成现代中国身份认同的基础。采用高度逼真的视觉呈现、同样取材于《西游记》的现象级电子游戏《黑神话：悟空》被誉为软实力的一大胜利，以至于山西省旅游部门发布了一段推广视频，展示游戏中出现的当地名胜古迹。
范德堡大学亚洲研究助理教授郝宇骢透过电子邮件表示，重新诠释中国历史、神话和经典的自由仍受“意识形态正确性”的约束。
她还说：“讲好中国故事以及可能被视为颠覆性的方式讲述中国故事，二者之间的界限往往模糊不清。”
今年1月，国家广播电视总局启动一项整治行动，清理其称为诋毁革命英雄、歪曲历史事实、歪曲古典文学人物精神的AI魔改视频。
包括微信和抖音在内的社交媒体及视频平台在10月表示，已删除违反相关规定、涉及古典文学作品的人工智能生成视频。
来自中国的科技作者和文化评论人士阿芙拉·王（音）表示，林黛玉和孙悟空这对组合之所以如此受欢迎，“是因为这两个人物有着天壤之别，同时又都深深植根于这一代人的集体记忆之中”。
她说，观众似乎很喜欢看到这两个人物在一起获得幸福，尤其是看到林黛玉终于过上称心如意的生活。《人民日报》那篇评论下获赞最多的一条评论写道：“愿所有美好的人都能有美好的人生。但现实往往如此残酷。”就连广州铁路部门也发布了一则广告，将其与乘客之间的关系比作孙悟空与林黛玉之间的默契。
对于这些视频遭到下架，网民大多报以嘲讽。有人开玩笑说，凡是能让女性感到幸福的关系，都会被贴上“不当恋爱关系”的标签。
杜克大学汉学家周成荫表示，早在1961年，毛泽东就曾自比大闹天宫的孙悟空。这说明，重新诠释经典作品作为一种政治行为，可以追溯到中华人民共和国成立初期。
她在电子邮件中写道：“粉丝们觉得——而且理直气壮地觉得，他们完全有权重新演绎经典。毕竟，‘谁不希望黛玉幸福呢’似乎是最普遍的心声！”

title: Gold dip draws Asian buyers as North American funds lose cash
zh_title: 北美基金亏损现金，金价下跌吸引亚洲买家
summary: BMO资本市场在其最新的贵金属监测报告中表示，随着北美投资者从黄金基金撤资，金价下跌正在推高印度金条溢价和中国交易活动。印度溢价升至每盎司 15 美元。截至 10 月 23 日当周，受价格下跌和十​​胜节采购的推动，价格从一周前的 11 美元上涨。上海黄金交易所每周实物结算黄金合约成交量达到约430吨，为4月份以来的最高水平。现货黄金每周下跌 4%，跌至每盎司 4,000 美元的低点，结束了自星星以来的跌势，随后出现回升
content:
BMO资本市场在其最新的贵金属监测报告中表示，随着北美投资者从黄金基金撤资，金价下跌正在推高印度金条溢价和中国交易活动。印度溢价升至每盎司 15 美元。截至 10 月 23 日当周，受价格下跌和十​​胜节采购的推动，价格从一周前的 11 美元上涨。上海黄金交易所的实物结算黄金合约每周成交量达到约430吨，为4月份以来的最高水平。 BMO表示，在现货黄金每周下跌4%至每盎司4,000美元的低点之后，金价回升，使年初以来的跌幅达到7%。 BMO 的研究团队（包括分析师 Helen Amos 和 George Heppel）在周三的一份报告中写道：“价格下跌开始吸引实物买家重返市场。” ETF 资金流出 随着金融投资者撤退，买盘提供了支撑。 BMO表示，经过三个月的净流入后，全球黄金上市交易基金在截至10月23日的一周内录得11亿美元的净流出。北美的提款额为 17 亿美元，部分被欧洲的 4.85 亿美元的流入额所抵消。投机头寸也有所减弱，净多头期货头寸降至八月以来的最低水平。 BMO表示，尽管中东紧张局势升级且油价上涨，但美国股市的疲软鼓励投资者转向政府债券而不是黄金。尽管债券收益率有所下降，但黄金仍面临压力。
中国的交易所数据衡量的是交易活动而不是零售需求。 银行的分歧 各国央行的看法也存在分歧。 BMO表示，俄罗斯9月出售了6吨，这是连续第十个月出售，使官方持有量降至2019年以来的最低水平。随着乌克兰战争的继续，蒙特利尔银行将抛售与不断增加的财政压力联系起来。 BMO表示，哈萨克斯坦表示计划将其黄金储备比例从78%降至75%，可能涉及以不变价格出售约14吨。与此同时，中国9月份连续23个月增加黄金储备。持有量增至 7,747 万盎司。 7673 万盎司起BMO 表示，八月份。 BMO 表示，周三下午的美联储决定代表着下一个考验。截至 10 月 27 日，市场认为再次加息的可能性不到 10%，低于一个月前的约 70%。 BMO还指出周四发布的美国经济增长和通胀数据是政策前景的驱动因素。

【原文 English Original】
Lower gold prices are lifting Indian bullion premiums and Chinese trading activity as North American investors withdraw money from gold funds, BMO Capital Markets said in its latest Precious Metals Monitor. Indian premiums rose to $15 an oz. for the week ended Oct. 23 from $11 a week earlier, helped by lower prices and buying for the Dussehra festival. On the Shanghai Gold Exchange, weekly volume in a physically settled gold contract reached about 430 tonnes, the highest since April. The pickup followed a 4% weekly drop in spot gold to the low $4,000s per oz., taking its decline since the start of the year to 7%, BMO said. “The decline in prices is beginning to draw physical buyers back into the market,” BMO’s research team, including analysts Helen Amos and George Heppel, wrote in a note on Wednesday. ETF outflows The buying offers support as financial investors retreat. After three months of net inflows, global gold exchange-traded funds recorded $1.1 billion of net outflows in the week ended Oct. 23, BMO said. North America accounted for $1.7 billion of withdrawals, partly offset by $485 million of European inflows. Speculative positioning also weakened, with net long futures positions falling to their lowest level since August. BMO said weakness in U.S. equities had encouraged investors to move into government bonds rather than gold, despite escalating Middle East tensions and elevated oil prices. Gold remained under pressure even as bond yields eased. The Chinese exchange figure measures trading activity rather than retail demand. Banks diverge Central banks also diverged. Russia sold 6 tonnes in September, its tenth consecutive month of sales, leaving official holdings at their lowest since 2019, BMO said. BMO linked the selling to mounting fiscal pressure as the war in Ukraine continues. Kazakhstan signalled plans to reduce gold’s share of its reserves to 75% from 78%, potentially involving sales of about 14 tonnes at unchanged prices, BMO said. China, meanwhile, increased its gold reserves for a 23rd consecutive month in September. Holdings rose to 77.47 million oz. from 76.73 million oz. in August, BMO said. Wednesday afternoon’s Federal Reserve decision represents the next test, BMO says. As of Oct. 27, markets assigned less than a 10% chance of another rate increase, down from about 70% a month earlier. BMO also pointed to U.S. economic growth and inflation releases Thursday as drivers of the policy outlook.

content:
商务
中化集团控股的瑞士-中国农化集团先正达计划在香港上市，估值至少为 660 亿美元，预计时间为 2027 年初。此次 IPO 可能筹集 5-100 亿美元，所得资金将用于削减债务以及投资作物保护和种子。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 28 日 11:28 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

两位知情人士告诉路透社，先正达顾问的目标是将这家瑞中农化集团在香港上市的估值至少为 660 亿美元，该上市可能于明年初进行。

消息人士称，瑞银和中国国际金融公司正在以 2026 年预期核心收益 15 至 20 倍的价格营销这家总部位于巴塞尔的种子和作物保护产品制造商。基于中国国有企业中化集团控股的先正达 2025 年 EBITDA 为 44 亿美元，这将使该公司的估值达到 660 亿美元至 880 亿美元，使本次发行跻身明年预计最大的全球 IPO 之列。

消息人士称，这一估值反映了先正达努力将自己定位为一家生物技术公司，而不是化学品生产商。其中一位人士补充说，作物保护领域强大的产品阵容以及抗病虫害新种子品种的开发渠道支撑了高估值。
中信银行和美国银行也正在帮助进行首次公开​​募股。先正达和瑞银拒绝置评。中金公司、中信银行和美国银行没有立即回应请求。

三名消息人士称，IPO 仍可能在 2026 年底前进行，但 2027 年初首次公开募股被认为更有可能。一位人士表示，“人们有信心一月份的窗口期是可行的”。银行家们正在上海、香港和北京与投资者会面，然后计划在法兰克福和伦敦进行营销。

消息人士补充称，随着对人工智能相关股票的热情降温，一些亚洲投资者也对更传统的工业公司表现出了新的兴趣。中化集团于2017年以430亿美元收购的先正达计划出售10%至20%的股份，并将所得资金用于减少债务并投资于作物保护产品和种子。该公司已申请上市，可能筹集 50 亿美元至 100 亿美元的资金。

Syngenta, a Swiss-Chinese agrochemicals group controlled by Sinochem, is targeting a valuation of at least US$66 billion in its planned Hong Kong listing, likely in early 2027. The IPO could raise US$5-10 billion, with proceeds used to cut debt and invest in crop protection and seeds.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

28 Oct 2026 at 11:28 HKT · 2 min read

Syngenta's advisers are targeting a valuation of at least US$66 billion in the Swiss-Chinese agrochemicals group's planned Hong Kong listing, which is likely to take place early next year, two people familiar with the matter told Reuters.

UBS and China International Capital Corp are marketing the Basel-based maker of seeds and crop-protection products at 15 to 20 times expected 2026 core earnings, the sources said. That would value Syngenta, which is controlled by Chinese state-owned firm Sinochem, at US$66 billion to US$88 billion, based on its 2025 EBITDA of US$4.4 billion, placing the offering among the largest global IPOs expected next year.

The valuation reflects Syngenta's efforts to position itself more as a biotechnology company than a chemicals producer, the sources said. One of them added that a strong product line-up in crop protection and development pipeline for new seed varieties resistant to disease and pests supported a high valuation.

China CITIC Bank and Bank of America are also helping run the IPO. Syngenta and UBS declined to comment. CICC, China CITIC Bank and Bank of America did not immediately respond to requests.

Three sources said the IPO could still take place before the end of 2026, but an early-2027 debut was considered more likely. 'There's confidence a January window is feasible,' said one. The bankers are meeting investors in Shanghai, Hong Kong and Beijing ahead of planned marketing in Frankfurt and London.

Some Asian investors are also showing renewed interest in more traditional industrial companies as enthusiasm for artificial intelligence-related stocks cools, the sources added. Syngenta, which Sinochem acquired for US$43 billion in 2017, plans to sell a stake of 10 per cent to 20 per cent and use the proceeds to reduce debt and invest in crop-protection products and seeds. The company has already filed for the flotation which could raise US$5 billion to US$10 billion.

content:
人工智能
香港工人和管理人员为人工智能代理建立权限和批准矩阵的实用指南，涵盖电子邮件、文件、数据库和外部操作，以及日志和终止开关。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 28 日 09:00 香港时间 · 阅读时间 6 分钟

您刚刚被告知您的团队将聘请人工智能代理来处理客户电子邮件、更新电子表格以及从公司数据库中提取数据。承诺就是效率。担心的是代理可能会读取不应该读取的内容、更改关键文件或向错误的人发送消息。如果没有明确的界限，人工智能代理可能会成为一种负担。本文提供了一个协议，您可以运行它来构建权限和批准矩阵，控制 AI 代理可以读取、更改和发送的内容，并确保您在部署之前拥有日志和终止开关。

## 为什么权限对于 AI 代理很重要
人工智能代理不是人类同事。它没有常识或情境意识。如果您授予它对文件夹的访问权限，它可能会读取该文件夹中的每个文件。如果您让它发送电子邮件，它可能会用错误的数据回复客户。香港个人资料私隐专员公署（PCPD）发布了有关人工智能和代理系统的指南，强调组织必须确保数据最小化和目的限制。 NIST 生成人工智能配置文件（2024 年 7 月）同样要求映射数据流并实施访问控制。权限矩阵是满足这些要求的实用工具。

## 构建权限矩阵

权限矩阵是一个表格，列出了代理可以访问的每个资源并准确指定允许执行哪些操作。使用以下类别作为起点。

* **电子邮件**：定义代理可以读取哪些邮箱、可以从哪些邮箱发送邮件以及是否可以删除或存档邮件。例如，允许对支持收件箱进行只读访问，但在发送任何包含报价的回复之前需要人工批准。
* **文件**：指定文件夹和文件类型。客服人员可以读取共享云端硬盘中的 PDF，但不能对其进行编辑。它可能会将新文档写入暂存文件夹，但不会覆盖现有文档。除非明确需要，否则限制对包含个人数据或财务记录的文件夹的访问。
* **数据库**：授予对特定表或视图的只读访问权限。切勿授予对生产数据库的写访问权限。如果代理需要更新记录，请通过单独的审批队列路由这些更改。
* **外部操作**：这包括发布到社交媒体、向第三方服务发送 API 调用或进行付款。每项外部行动在执行前都应获得主管的明确批准。

对于每个资源，记录权限级别：读取、写入、更新、删除或执行。然后添加批准要求列：无、自动或手动。手动批准意味着在代理继续操作之前，人类必须审查并确认操作。

## 设置审批流程

并非每个动作都需要有人参与。低风险的操作，例如阅读公共常见问题解答文档，可以是自动的。高风险操作（例如发送包含客户个人数据的电子邮件）必须需要手动批准。设计您的工作流程，以便代理标记操作并等待是或否

【原文 English Original】
Artificial Intelligence
A practical guide for Hong Kong workers and managers to build a permissions-and-approval matrix for AI agents, covering email, files, databases, and external actions, plus logs and a kill switch.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

28 Oct 2026 at 09:00 HKT · 6 min read

You have just been told your team will get an AI agent to handle customer emails, update spreadsheets, and pull data from the company database. The promise is efficiency. The worry is that the agent might read something it should not, change a critical file, or send a message to the wrong person. Without clear boundaries, an AI agent can become a liability. This article provides a protocol you can run to build a permissions-and-approval matrix that controls what an AI agent may read, change, and send, and ensures you have logs and a kill switch in place before deployment.

## Why permissions matter for AI agents

An AI agent is not a human colleague. It does not have common sense or context awareness. If you give it access to a folder, it may read every file in that folder. If you let it send emails, it may reply to a customer with incorrect data. The Hong Kong Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data (PCPD) has issued guidance on AI and agentic systems, emphasising that organisations must ensure data minimisation and purpose limitation. The NIST Generative AI Profile (July 2024) similarly calls for mapping data flows and enforcing access controls. A permissions matrix is the practical tool to meet these requirements.

## Building the permissions matrix

A permissions matrix is a table that lists each resource an agent can access and specifies exactly what actions are allowed. Use the following categories as a starting point.

*   **Email**: Define which mailboxes the agent can read, which it can send from, and whether it can delete or archive messages. For example, allow read-only access to the support inbox, but require human approval before sending any reply that contains a price quote.
*   **Files**: Specify folders and file types. An agent may read PDFs in a shared drive but not edit them. It may write new documents to a staging folder but not overwrite existing ones. Restrict access to folders containing personal data or financial records unless explicitly needed.
*   **Databases**: Grant read-only access to specific tables or views. Never give write access to production databases. If the agent needs to update records, route those changes through a separate approval queue.
*   **External actions**: This includes posting to social media, sending API calls to third-party services, or making payments. Each external action should require explicit approval from a human supervisor before execution.

For each resource, document the permission level: read, write, update, delete, or execute. Then add a column for approval requirements: none, automatic, or manual. Manual approval means a human must review and confirm the action before the agent proceeds.

## Setting up approval workflows

Not every action needs a human in the loop. Low-risk actions, such as reading a public FAQ document, can be automatic. High-risk actions, such as sending an email with a customer’s personal data, must require manual approval. Design your workflow so that the agent flags the action and waits for a yes or no from a designated approver. The approver should see a clear summary of what the agent intends to do, including the data involved and the recipient.

Consider using a tiered approval system. For example:

*   **Tier 1**: Read-only actions – automatic.
*   **Tier 2**: Writes to non-sensitive folders – automatic with logging.
*   **Tier 3**: Sends external communications or writes to sensitive data – requires manual approval.
*   **Tier 4**: Deletes data or makes payments – requires two-person approval.

This tiered approach balances efficiency with safety.

## Logging everything the agent does

Logs are your audit trail. Every action the agent takes should be recorded with a timestamp, the resource accessed, the action type, and the outcome (approved, rejected, or failed). Logs should be stored in a separate system that the agent cannot modify. This ensures that if something goes wrong, you can trace exactly what happened.

NIST’s AI RMF recommends continuous monitoring and logging as a core practice for trustworthy AI. In Hong Kong, the PCPD expects organisations to maintain records of data processing activities, especially when automated decisions are involved. Your logs should be reviewed regularly, not just after an incident.

## Installing a kill switch

A kill switch is a mechanism that immediately stops the agent from taking any further actions. It should be accessible to a designated human operator, preferably via a simple interface such as a button in a dashboard or a command in a chat tool. The kill switch must override all permissions and approval workflows. When activated, the agent should stop all pending actions and enter a safe state where it cannot read, write, or send anything until manually reset.

Test the kill switch before deployment. Simulate a scenario where the agent is about to send a message to the wrong recipient. Activate the kill switch and verify that the message is not sent. Document the test results.

## Limitations and privacy considerations

No permissions matrix is foolproof. An agent may misinterpret a permission or a human may approve a risky action without proper review. Always apply the principle of least privilege: give the agent the minimum access needed to perform its task, and no more. Review permissions regularly, especially when the agent’s role changes.

Privacy is a key concern. If the agent accesses personal data, you must comply with Hong Kong’s Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance. The PCPD guidance advises conducting a privacy impact assessment before deploying any AI system that processes personal data. Ensure that the agent does not retain data longer than necessary and that logs do not contain unnecessary personal information.

## Practical checklist for deployment

Before you let an AI agent work on live systems, run through this checklist:

1.   Map all resources the agent will access: email, files, databases, external services.
2.   Define read/write/delete permissions for each resource.
3.   Assign approval tiers: automatic, manual, or two-person.
4.   Set up logging: capture action, timestamp, resource, outcome.
5.   Install a kill switch and test it.
6.   Conduct a privacy impact assessment if personal data is involved.
7.   Review permissions with the team and get sign-off from a manager.
8.   Schedule a periodic review of permissions and logs.

By following this protocol, you can deploy AI agents with confidence, knowing that you have controls in place to prevent unauthorised reads, unwanted changes, and unintended sends. The goal is not to eliminate risk entirely, but to manage it transparently and responsibly.

## Sources and further reading

*   [Hong Kong PCPD: AI framework for agentic AI](https://www.pcpd.org.hk/english/resources_centre/publications/guidance/guidance.html)
*   [NIST: Generative AI Profile](https://www.nist.gov/publications/artificial-intelligence-risk-management-framework-generative-artificial-intelligence)
*   [OWASP: Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025](https://owasp.org/www-project-top-10-for-large-language-model-applications/assets/PDF/OWASP-Top-10-for-LLMs-v2025.pdf)

_Guidance and regulations can change; check the current primary sources before applying them to a consequential workplace decision._

content:
Presented by Susan Rogert, Reiki Master, Teacher & Certified Medical Reiki Practitioner

What if your body has been holding on to something your heart is ready to release?

Some experiences leave more than memories. They leave echoes — old wounds, unspoken emotions, and invisible burdens we may not even realize we're carrying.

Even when our minds have moved on, our bodies may still remember. But what if there's a gentler way to release what we've been holding and open the door to healing?

Join us for a fascinating exploration with Susan Rogert, as she takes us beyond the physical and into the unseen world of energy, where she believes the imprints of trauma can linger — and where new possibilities for healing may begin.

Drawing on nine years of working with first responders and military personnel, Susan will share what she has witnessed through her Reiki practice, how trauma may influence our energetic well-being, and how gentle energy work can offer a path toward greater peace, balance, and release.

Meet Susan Rogert
 Susan is a Reiki Master, teacher, certified Medical Reiki practitioner, and founder of Healing Home Omaha, a program devoted to offering natural energy healing practices to first responders and military personnel.

For nine years, she has dedicated herself to helping those who have carried extraordinary burdens, discovering along the way the profound connection she sees between the body's energy, our experiences, and our capacity for healing.

Susan brings something beautiful to her work: a gentle presence, a compassionate heart, and a deep respect for the healing journey of every person she encounters.

Perhaps the most extraordinary part of healing isn't what we discover we've been carrying — but what becomes possible when we finally begin to let it go.

If time permits, the talk will end with a meditation.

content:
摘要： Statista 的新研究和专家对如何构建现实世界供应链灵活性的见解。您的物流计划最后一次真正按计划进行是什么时候？在物流方面，预计会出现中断。然而，尽管许多运营商正在抓住东南亚更多航线选择和模式带来的机遇，但新的研究表明，物流系统并没有跟上。

**更多选择，更多路线，但不是更多弹性**
 去年，中国与东盟贸易额突破1.05万亿美元。制造中心正在整个地区蔓延，需要更多的货运选择，所有这一切都是在几乎持续中断的背景下进行的。每一次转变都迫使公司重新思考如何（有时是在哪里）转移库存。

该地区 87% 的物流决策者表示，他们的应对措施是增加多式联运路线的使用。然而，92% 的受访者表示，多样化路由仅在其网络中部分实施。

在我们研究的四项单独衡量标准中，只有 0-2% 的受访者选择了最高级别的路由实施、合作伙伴连接、公共机构集成或端到端可见性。
多样化的路线选择只是第一步。还必须有可用的容量。商业安排需要做好准备。交接工作需要发挥作用。并且需要有人有权拨打电话。如果没有这些要素，纸面上看起来具有弹性的路径在实际发生中断时几乎无法提供灵活性。

> 自新冠疫情爆发以来，供应链出现了巨大的波动……每年我们都会遇到一些中断。”
> _Kevin Burrell，马士基 – 湄公河董事总经理_

**对破坏的下意识反应**
 在过去 12-24 个月中，69% 的物流领导者表示，阻塞点对其运营产生了显着或非常显着的影响。大多数人都会对每次危机做出反应，而不是为危机做好计划——将安全库存增加 50% 或转向最后一刻的空运选择。在这两种情况下，运营商都需要支付更多费用来适应不可预测的网络。

**真正的弹性构建者：充分利用路线选项的系统、数据、合作伙伴和移交**
从中国通过东南亚运输货物可能涉及一长串组织：货运代理、卡车运输公司、码头、海关机构、经纪人、港口、航空公司、航运公司和仓库都可能接触同一批货物。

就个体而言，其中许多组织都装备精良，但每次移交都会造成信息黑洞，而每一种额外的模式都会造成另一次移交。

因此，虽然额外的模式和网关为您提供了更多解决中断的方法，但它们也为您提供了更多信息和责任消失的点。这些弱点在不同地区之间也不一致——研究发现，两个受访者群体的交付时间差异很大，但背后存在不同的问题。这说明了为什么相同的解决方案不能简单地应用于每个走廊。

Summary: New Statista research and expert insight on what it takes to build real-world supply chain flexibility. When was the last time your logistics plan actually went to plan? In logistics, disruption is expected. But while many operators are taking the opportunity posed by more route options and modes through Southeast Asia, new research suggests that the logistics systems aren’t keeping up.

**More options, more routes, but not more resilience**
 Last year, trade between China and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) exceeded US$1.05 trillion. Manufacturing hubs are spreading across the region, requiring more freight options, all of this against a backdrop of almost constant disruption. Each shift forces companies to rethink how – and sometimes where – they move inventory.

87% of logistics decision-makers in the area say they’ve responded by increasing their use of multimodal routes. However, 92% describe diversified routing as only partially implemented across their networks.

Across four separate measures in our research, just 0-2% of respondents selected the highest level of routing implementation, partner connectivity, public-authority integration, or end-to-end visibility.

Diversifying route options is only the first step. There must also be capacity available. Commercial arrangements need to be ready. The handovers need to work. And someone needs to have the authority to make the call. Without those elements, a path that looks like resilience on paper can offer little flexibility when a disruption actually happens.

> Ever since COVID, there is that vast volatility in the supply chain…every year we will have some disruption.’’
> _Kevin Burrell, Maersk – Managing Director – Mekong_

[![Image 2](https://www.hellenicshippingnews.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/08796.jpg)](https://www.hellenicshippingnews.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/08796.jpg)

**Knee-jerk responses to disruption**
 Over the past 12-24 months, 69% of the logistics leaders say chokepoints have affected their operations significantly or very significantly. Most are reacting to each crisis, rather than planning for them – increasing safety stock by 50% or turning to last-minute airfreight options. In both cases, operators are paying more to live with an unpredictable network.

Discover more

Shipping news subscription

Daily shipping news

Freight transport services

**The real resilience builder: systems, data, partners and handovers that make full use of the route options**
 Transporting freight from China through Southeast Asia can involve a long chain of organisations: freight forwarders, trucking companies, terminals, customs agencies, brokers, ports, airlines, shipping lines and warehouses might all touch the same shipment.

Individually, many of those organisations are well equipped, but each handover creates a black hole of information – and every additional mode creates another handover.

So, while additional modes and gateways give you more ways around a disruption, they also give you more points where information – and accountability – disappear. Those weak points are also inconsistent across regions – research found high lead-time variability across both respondent groups, but with different problems underneath. This shows why the same solution can’t simply be applied to every corridor.

Lack of digitisation isn’t the issue, either – 91% of organisations already use digital documentation, for example, but 51% also report limited integration with external partners.

**The solution: stop looking for the perfect route**
 The strongest logistics networks can recognise when current routes won’t work, identify the right alternative, and activate it quickly. For most organisations, that doesn’t mean rebuilding the entire network at once. Instead, you need to:

[![Image 3](https://www.hellenicshippingnews.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/8756-1.jpg)](https://www.hellenicshippingnews.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/8756-1.jpg)

[![Image 4](https://www.hellenicshippingnews.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/09090909.jpg)](https://www.hellenicshippingnews.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/09090909.jpg)

**The ideal route exists – it just changes every day**
 Successful players will have a network agile enough to find and execute it.

Discover more

Online newspaper access

Track Sea Cargo

Read Daily News

No route or strategy is an ideal fit for the China-Southeast Asia corridor. What works is increasing the maturity of your network and processes to buffer selectively, diversify deliberately, and prepare your response to disruption.

**How resilient is your supply chain?**
 Research conducted with 260 logistics and supply chain decision-makers across Asia-Pacific found that organisations differ significantly in their ability to anticipate, absorb and respond to disruption.

To help organisations evaluate their readiness, No Perfect Route introduces a Supply Chain Resilience Maturity Model that identifies five stages of resilience capability, from reactive response to proactive orchestration.

Most organisations operate somewhere within this spectrum.

Understanding where you sit is the first step towards improvement.

**MATURITY MODEL – what stage are you?**
 Most organisations can be placed in one of five stages of maturity. Understanding where yours sits is an important starting point for improving resilience.

**Stage 1: Reactive**
 You handle disruptions through ad hoc, manual firefighting after cargo is already delayed. Fallback corridors are mostly on paper.

**Stage 2: Managed**
 Basic visibility tools exist, but modal shifts remain manual, siloed, and heavily dependent on tribal knowledge and key individuals. This leaves your network vulnerable when key staff are unavailable.

**Stage 3: Connected**
 Systems exchange data across supply chain partners, but execution relies on checkpoint updates rather than real-time tracking. You still absorb delays because your teams only discover disruptions after the fact.

**Stage 4: Orchestrated**
 Alternative routes are pre-costed, pre-tested, and backed by pre-approved decision rights. Your team switches modes rapidly, protecting the bottom line and safeguarding customer delivery dates.

**Stage 5: Proactive**
 Predictive external signals (weather, port congestion, tariffs) are integrated into live routing, adjusting flows before disruption impacts customer delivery.
 Source: Maersk

title: An Architectural Deep Dive into New CLPR (Cross-Ledger Protocol) Lab, Wed, Nov 18, 2026, 11:00 AM   | Meetup
summary: ## Details **LFDT Labs Introduces CLPR - An Architectural Deep Dive into CLPR (Cross-Ledger Protocol)** Join us for an in-depth technical session introducing CLPR (Cross-Ledger Protocol), a newly approved open-source project hosted under th
content:
## Details

**LFDT Labs Introduces CLPR - An Architectural Deep Dive into CLPR (Cross-Ledger Protocol)**

Join us for an in-depth technical session introducing CLPR (Cross-Ledger Protocol), a newly approved open-source project hosted under the LF Decentralized Trust Labs.
 Traditional cross-chain bridges often introduce security vulnerabilities, liquidity locking, and third-party trust assumptions. CLPR takes a fundamental shift: enabling direct, asynchronous ledger-to-ledger communication using cryptographic state proofs.

In this Meetup, we will explore:
**Architectural Overview (20–30 min)**
 The problem with traditional bridges.
 Core trust model.
 Breakdown of the protocol layers.
 How to adapt CLPR for arbitrary EVM, non-EVM, public, and enterprise ledger types.

**Implementation Deep Dive (45–60 min)**
 Hiero Native Implementation
 Besu Reference Implementation

**Live Software Demo and Q&A (30 min)**
 Live Demonstration: Watching CLPR execute cross-ledger state proof verification in real time.

**Q&A and Community Discussion and get involved in the LFDT Lab.**

**Zoom Meeting Link**: [https://zoom.us/my/hyperledger.community.3?pwd=UE90WHhEaHRqOGEyMkV3cldKa2d2dz09](https://zoom.us/my/hyperledger.community.3?pwd=UE90WHhEaHRqOGEyMkV3cldKa2d2dz09)

**Please note: This event is being shared with our entire global community. If you're interested in this content but can't attend the event live, feel free to sign up and we will send you a link to the recording after the meetup is over.**

### Speaker

#### Edward Wertz

[Edward Wertz](https://www.linkedin.com/in/edward-wertz-6aa26012/) ([https://github.com/edward-swirldslabs](https://github.com/edward-swirldslabs))

Edward Wertz is a software architect at Hashgraph, the developers of the Hedera blockchain. He is one of the maintainers of the LFDT CLPR LAB that enables cross ledger communication. Prior to Hashgraph, he worked for L3Harris as a data engineer and software architect. He completed his PhD in knowledge representation and reasoning in 2019.

title: Commentator charged with disclosing nat. security probe says unaware investigation was underway
zh_title: 评论员被指控披露 nat。安全调查称不知情的调查正在进行中
summary: 一名被指控披露国家安全调查细节的香港政治评论员作证说，他不相信调查正在进行中。黄安贤的 YouTube 频道。照片：截图，来自 YouTube。黄国恩（笔名黄安然）周二在区域法院继续作证。这位代表自己的 72 岁老人去年 12 月在 YouTube 上发布了两段讨论前一天与国家安全警察会面的视频后被捕。根据《国家安全法》，泄露国家安全调查的细节属于犯罪行为。
content:
一名被指控披露国家安全调查细节的香港政治评论员作证说，他不相信调查正在进行中。黄安贤的 YouTube 频道。照片：截图，来自 YouTube。黄国恩（笔名黄安然）周二在区域法院继续作证。这位代表自己的 72 岁老人去年 12 月在 YouTube 上发布了两段讨论前一天与国家安全警察会面的视频后被捕。根据《维护国家安全条例》(SNSO)，泄露国家安全调查的细节属于犯罪行为，该条例是香港本土制定的安全法，在当地被称为第 23 条。国家安全警察带他来讨论几天前发生的宏福苑致命火灾的新闻发布会，黄预定在会上发表讲话。黄在回应检方提问时证实，他确实在视频中表示，他在旺角警署见过这些警员，并描述了他们的年龄和外貌。但他表示，在发布这些视频之前，他已经经过深思熟虑，并且他判断警方不会进行调查。黄说，他相信这次会议的目的只是让官员阻止新闻发布会的进行。湾仔区域法院。资料图片：HKFP。
黄补充说，官员们询问他计划在新闻发布会上谈论什么（最终被取消）以及他是否与任何组织合作。因此，他认为谈论这次会议没有问题。他还告诉法庭，警方在会面期间给了他一份保密协议，但他“基本上没有看过”。媒体报道周二是庭审的第 12 天，黄先生在庭审中代表自己。在作证的第一天，他告诉法庭，他拥有法学学士和硕士学位。周二，黄还表示，当所讨论的信息已经为公众所知时，他不认为这是一种披露行为。黄安贤.照片：截图，来自 YouTube。黄说，媒体已经报道了他被国安警察带走的消息。当检方询问他在视频中所说的话——包括他会见的人和讨论的内容——是否超出媒体报道的内容时，黄同意。黄还因去年 1 月至 12 月期间发布的 30 个评论视频而面临煽动叛乱指控。周二的听证会开始时，黄播放了他的 YouTube 频道上的四个视频，这些视频不属于这 30 个视频。在这四个视频中，黄谈到了宏福苑火灾等话题。
例如，他谈到了改造项目的争议，以及国家支持的媒体《大公报》删除了四篇有关该住宅区建设的调查文章。他告诉法庭，他想更全面地描述他的评论，并且他从未煽动公众参与任何行动。审判将于周三继续进行。

【原文 English Original】
A Hong Kong political commentator charged with revealing details of a national security probe has testified that he did not believe an investigation was underway. Wong On-yin’s YouTube Channel. Photo: Screenshot, via YouTube. Wong Kwok-ngon, known by his pen name Wong On-yin, continued his testimony at the District Court on Tuesday. The 72-year-old, who is representing himself, was arrested last December after publishing two YouTube videos discussing a meeting with national security police that took place the day before. Revealing details of a national security investigation is a crime under the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance (SNSO), the city’s homegrown security law known locally as Article 23. National security police had brought him in to discuss a press conference about the fatal Wang Fuk Court fire, which had occurred days earlier, at which Wong was scheduled to speak. In response to the prosecution’s questions, Wong confirmed that he did say in his video that he met the officers at Mong Kok Police Station, and that he described their ages and appearances. But he said he had put in considerable thought before publishing the videos, and that it was his judgement that police were not carrying out an investigation. Wong said he believed the meeting’s purpose was just for officers to stop the press conference from going ahead. District Court in Wan Chai. File photo: HKFP. Wong added that officers asked him what he planned to talk about during the press conference – which was eventually called off – and whether he had collaborated with any organisations. Therefore, he did not think there was a problem with talking about the meeting, he said. He also told the court that police handed him a confidentiality agreement during the meeting , but that he “basically did not look at it.” Media reports Tuesday marked the 12th day of the trial, in which Wong is representing himself. During the first day of his testimony, he told the court that he held bachelor’s and master’s degrees in law. On Tuesday, Wong also said he did not consider it an act of disclosure when the information being discussed was already known to the public. Wong On-yin. Photo: Screenshot, via YouTube. Wong said the media had already reported the news that he had been taken in by national security police. When asked by the prosecution whether what he said in the videos – including the people he met with and what was discussed – went beyond what was reported in the media, Wong agreed. Wong also faces a sedition charge in relation to 30 commentary videos he posted between January and December last year. Tuesday’s hearing began with Wong playing four videos from his YouTube channel that were not among those 30. In those four videos, Wong talked about topics such as the Wang Fuk Court fire. For example, he spoke on controversies in renovation projects and the removal of four investigative articles by state-backed outlet Ta Kung Pao about the construction at the housing estate. He told the court he wanted to give a more complete picture of his commentary, and that he had never incited the public to take part in any action. The trial will continue on Wednesday.

title: Foreign fund outflows send Taiwan dollar sharply lower: Central bank - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: 央行：外资流出导致新台币大幅贬值 - 聚焦台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月27日电 央行表示，境外机构投资者资金净流出是近几个月新台币兑美元大幅贬值的重要因素。央行在定于周三举行的听证会之前向立法院提交的一份书面报告中表示，自7月初以来，外国机构投资者的资金净流出为543亿美元。央行表示，同期，新台币兑美元贬值约2%。今年上半年，外资企业
content:
中新社台北10月27日电 央行表示，境外机构投资者资金净流出是近几个月新台币兑美元大幅贬值的重要因素。

央行在定于周三举行的听证会之前向立法院提交的一份书面报告中表示，自7月初以来，外国机构投资者的资金净流出为543亿美元。

央行表示，同期，新台币兑美元贬值约2%。

央行表示，今年上半年，外国机构投资者资金净流出233亿美元，在中东军事紧张局势升级以及美联储鹰派担忧的背景下，台币面临更大的下行压力。

它补充说，为了缓解当地外汇市场的波动，央行在六个月期间卖出的资金比买入的资金多了170.4亿美元。

央行表示，从7月到10月21日，对美国和伊朗之间军事冲突的担忧再度升温，加上人工智能支出担忧导致全球科技股遭到抛售，对台湾证券交易所的基准指数Taiex造成压力，促使外国机构投资者从台湾金融市场撤出更多资金。
这四个月期间，外国机构投资者的股票净卖出额为新台币 1.25 万亿元，相当于约 387 亿美元。央行表示，包括资本利得和现金股息在内的资金净流出总额达到约543亿美元。

央行表示，尽管出现资金外流，但与其他几种非美元货币相比，新台币仍保持相对稳定。

据央行数据，从1月1日到10月21日，新台币兑美元贬值3.23%，而衡量美元兑一揽子主要贸易伙伴货币的美元指数则上涨3.49%。

央行表示，同期，新台币的跌幅不如瑞士法郎（下跌3.89%）、欧元（下跌4.35%）和泰铢（下跌6.29%）明显。

报告称，台湾是一个小型开放经济体，外汇市场相对薄弱，严重依赖贸易，因此央行有必要进行干预以稳定汇率。

央行补充称，其目标是使新台币相对于欧元、韩元和日元的波动保持在相对狭窄的范围内，帮助台湾出口商稳定价格和获得订单，同时支持更广泛的经济。

（潘子瑜、黄芳芳摄）

结局/AW

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 27 (CNA) Net fund outflows by foreign institutional investors have been a major factor behind the Taiwan dollar's sharp depreciation against the U.S. dollar in recent months, the central bank said.

In a written report submitted to the Legislative Yuan ahead of a hearing scheduled for Wednesday, the central bank said foreign institutional investors recorded net fund outflows of US$54.3 billion since the beginning of July.

During the same period, the Taiwan dollar depreciated about 2 percent against the U.S. dollar, the central bank said.

In the first half of this year, foreign institutional investors recorded net fund outflows of US$23.3 billion, adding downward pressure on the Taiwan dollar amid escalating military tensions in the Middle East and concerns about a hawkish U.S. Federal Reserve, the central bank said.

To ease volatility in the local foreign exchange market, the central bank sold US$17.04 billion more than it bought during the six-month period, it added.

From July through Oct. 21, renewed concerns about military conflict between the United States and Iran, along with a global sell-off in technology stocks amid AI spending concerns, weighed on the Taiex, the Taiwan Stock Exchange's benchmark index, prompting foreign institutional investors to withdraw more funds from Taiwan's financial markets, the central bank said.

During the four-month period, foreign institutional investors recorded net stock sales of NT$1.25 trillion, equivalent to about US$38.7 billion. Their total net fund outflows, including capital gains and cash dividends, reached about US$54.3 billion, the central bank said.

Despite the outflows, the Taiwan dollar remained relatively stable compared with several other non-U.S. dollar currencies, the central bank said.

From Jan. 1 through Oct. 21, the Taiwan dollar depreciated 3.23 percent against the U.S. dollar, while the U.S. dollar index, which measures the greenback against a basket of major trading partners' currencies, rose 3.49 percent, according to the central bank.

During the same period, the Taiwan dollar's decline was less pronounced than those of the Swiss franc, which fell 3.89 percent, the euro, which dropped 4.35 percent, and the Thai baht, which tumbled 6.29 percent, the central bank said.

Taiwan is a small, open economy with a relatively shallow foreign exchange market and a heavy reliance on trade, making central bank intervention necessary to stabilize the currency, the report said.

The central bank added that it aims to keep fluctuations of the Taiwan dollar within a relatively narrow range compared with those of the euro, South Korean won and Japanese yen, helping Taiwanese exporters stabilize prices and secure orders, while supporting the broader economy.

(By Pan Tzu-yu and Frances Huang)

Enditem/AW

# Help our local Uyghur restaurant!

In 2018, Gairatjan Rozi, a talented Uyghur chef, trained in Europe and now settled in America, opened 'Marco & Polo' in Hyattsville.  The restaurant's menu features the cuisine of his homeland, in the Uyghur Autonomous Region of China, with classic Uyghur dishes including hand-pulled laghman noodles, dumplings, and lamb kebabs, complemented by more familiar Turkish and Mediterranean fare. Within just a few years, Mr. Rozi and his restaurant has earned the love of our community. His food & restaurant has been featured in the local press and has earned a dedicated following in the Washington DC region. Unfortunately the COVID-19 pandemic is forcing Mr. Rozi to close his family-run kitchen, shutter his beloved restaurant, and put in storage his colorful collection of Uyghur artifacts which decorate 'Marco & Polo.' But Mr. Rozi is hopeful. Having dedicated his new life in America to 'Marco & Polo,' he dreams of reopening his restaurant soon - in a new location that will attract even more customers who want to enjoy & explore both the cuisine and the Uyghur culture of Central Asia. Your generous donation to this GoFundMe effort will help Mr. Rozi begin to recover finically from the COVID-19 disaster and allow him to pursue his dream of creating another unique Uyghur dining experience for our community! **Gulnisa Nazarova**

Donation protected

My name is Gulnisa Nazarova, and I have been an Uyghur language instructor for over 20 years. This year, as I turn 60, instead of gifts I am asking for something much closer to my heart.

My dear mother taught me how to cook. Through her hands, I learned patience, generosity, and how food carries memory. Many of the dishes she passed on come from the Uyghur tradition, a cuisine rich in history, flavor, and storytelling, yet still too little known and increasingly at risk of being forgotten.

This fundraiser supports a lifelong dream of mine: creating a cookbook dedicated to Uyghur cuisine and cultural heritage.

My connection to Uyghur culture begins with my family and upbringing. My parents and ancestors came from the Uyghur Autonomous Region, known as Eastern Turkistan to Soviet Central Asia in the mid-20th century, carrying with them their traditions, food, language, history, and stories. I grew up learning not only recipes, but also their deeper meaning — meals that bring families together, celebrations filled with memory, and dishes that carry history from one generation to the next.

Over the years, I have worked professionally to support Uyghur language and culture through teaching, writing, and sharing my knowledge with others around the world. This cookbook, however, is different. It comes directly from the heart — from meals shared with my family and from a deep desire to preserve the taste of home for future generations.

This is a personal initiative, and the funds raised will help cover:

*   Research and documentation of recipes and food stories
*   Photography and image use for the book
*   Writing and editing
*   Professional design
*   Initial publication costs

Whether you give a little or a lot, you are helping keep a culinary heritage alive.

Thank you for celebrating my 60th birthday by honoring my mother’s legacy with me.

title: 什么是革命？为什么会爆发革命？——重读《旧制度与大革命》
summary: 来源：壹家言 2026-10-27 1856年，法国政治思想家亚历西斯·德·托克维尔出版《旧制度与大革命》（L'Ancien Régime et la Révolution）。这部著作并非按年代叙述攻占巴士底狱或雅各宾专政的过程，而是追问一个更根本的问题：为什么法国大革命偏偏在最繁荣、压迫有所减轻的旧制度末期爆发？革命究竟摧毁了什么，又继承了什么？ 2012年，该书被中国高层在反腐座谈会上公开推荐，引发知识界重读热潮。因为在转型社会中，托克维尔的警示从未过时。 一、革命为何
content: 来源：壹家言  2026-10-27 1856年，法国政治思想家亚历西斯·德·托克维尔出版《旧制度与大革命》（L'Ancien Régime et la Révolution）。这部著作并非按年代叙述攻占巴士底狱或雅各宾专政的过程，而是追问一个更根本的问题：为什么法国大革命偏偏在最繁荣、压迫有所减轻的旧制度末期爆发？革命究竟摧毁了什么，又继承了什么？ 2012年，该书被中国高层在反腐座谈会上公开推荐，引发知识界重读热潮。因为在转型社会中，托克维尔的警示从未过时。 一、革命为何不在最黑暗时爆发——托克维尔定律 传统认知中，"民不聊生必生革命"，托克维尔却观察到反直觉的事实： "革命的发生并非总因为人们的处境越来越坏 。最常见的情况是，一向毫无怨言仿佛若无其事地忍受最难忍受法律的人民，一旦法律压力减轻，他们就将它猛力抛弃。" 路易十六治下的法国，是旧君主制最繁荣的时期，工商业增长、废除部分农奴制、减免部分苛捐杂税。但恰恰是这个"开始改革、压迫略减"的时刻，民众权利意识已被启蒙运动唤醒，对残存的免税特权、贵族豁免权和不平等感到比以前更不能容忍。 这就是托克维尔的核心判断： 当社会期望增速超过制度改革速度，动荡风险反而最高。 繁荣提高了参照系，减轻了恐惧，却放大了不公感的刺痛。这被称为"托克维尔悖论"或"托克维尔定律"。 二、旧制度未死，只是换了外壳——中央集权的延续 托克维尔另一颠覆性论点是： 法国大革命并没有与过去彻底决裂，而是完成了旧制度已开始推行的行政中央集权。 大革命废除了封建君主、拍卖教会土地、宣布人人平等，却同时扫除了唯一能对王权形成制衡的力量地方贵族和自治团体。旧制度下，国王通过总监制一点点剥夺贵族的地方治理权；大革命干脆消灭了所有中间团体（行会、公社自治、省议会）， 使国家机器直接面对孤立的个体公民。 结果是拿破仑接手后，中央集权官僚体系比波旁王朝更庞大、更彻底、更具"革命合法性"。托克维尔痛切地写道： "大革命在摧毁旧制度某些部分的同时，却更牢固地确立了它最核心的部分—— 行政集权。这是旧制度留给新法国的真正遗产。" 换言之，推翻旧政权不等于消灭旧制度的结构性痼疾。 三、阶级孤立与特权——引爆革命的火药桶 旧制度晚期，法国贵族被剥夺了管理地方、审理案件、维持治安的政治职能（这些被中央督办官接管），却保留了免税权、优先任官权、狩猎权等经济与社会特权。贵族阶层逐渐退居凡尔赛，与资产阶级、农民彻底脱节， 既不承担公共责任又垄断好处。 托克维尔对此刻画极为犀利： "当贵族不仅拥有特权而且拥有政权时，当他们进行统治管理时，他们的个人权利更大，却不引人注意……当贵族不再负责这些事情，贵族特权的分量便显得沉重，甚至贵族本身的存在也成为问题。" 失去治理功能却保有剥削特权的寄生阶层，与承受重税且无政治表达的第三等级之间形成致命隔阂 ——这便是法国社会"老死不相往来"的阶级孤立。农民感到被抛弃，资产阶级感到被排挤，仇恨在沉默中积聚，直到陈情书打开闸门。 四、"革命"被滥用之后——什么是真正的革命？ 二十世纪以来，"革命"一词被极权运动、法西斯组织、宗教极端势力广泛盗用。 以"阶级解放""民族复兴""信仰救赎"之名夺权，宣称代表历史进步，实则建立比旧制度更专制的恐怖统治。历史反复证明： 推翻旧政权本身不保证社会进步，自称革命也不等于真正革命。 托克维尔在《旧制度与大革命》中对大革命的复杂态度提示我们：真正的革命不应仅凭是否砸烂旧庙堂来判断，而应依据现代政治文明的标尺来审视： 是否尊重人的生命与尊严； 是否保障思想、言论、信仰与结社自由； 是否坚持法律面前人人平等、实行有限政府与权力制衡； 是否保护合法财产权与司法独立； 是否通过民主制度实现政府的和平更替与公民对权力的真实监督。 真正的革命，是推动上述文明原则发展，使人更自由、权利更有保障、权力受更多制度约束、法治更完善、人民能通过有效参与监督政府。 而不是与之相反。 它未必伴随街垒战与断头台，却可能比暴力更深刻地重塑一个国家。

title: Graphs, matrices and second-method checks: where MathGPT fits in analytical work
zh_title: 图形、矩阵和第二种方法检查：MathGPT 在分析工作中的适用范围
summary: 香港的人工智能工作者和管理者可以使用 MathGPT.now 通过绘图、矩阵运算和第二种方法检查来验证分析工作。本文提供了在运营和财务环境中应用域、单位、替换和基于图的验证的实用协议。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 26 日香港时间 09:00 · 阅读 6 分钟负责确定茶的电子表格
content:
人工智能
香港的工人和管理人员可以使用 MathGPT.now 通过绘图、矩阵运算和第二种方法检查来验证分析工作。本文提供了在运营和财务环境中应用域、单位、替换和基于图的验证的实用协议。

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 26 日 09:00 香港时间 · 阅读时间 6 分钟

当您负责确定团队奖金或贯穿整个季度的预算线的电子表格时，单个算术单可能会导致成本高昂的决策。香港的分析工作者——无论是运营、财务还是物流——通常都会处理图表、矩阵和多步骤计算。问题不在于是否使用人工智能数学工具，而在于如何在不外包判断的情况下使用它作为严格的第二次检查。 MathGPT.now 是一款免费的人工智能数学求解器，提供了一种结构化的方法来验证工作，但前提是您应用与同事评审相同的规则。

## MathGPT.now 为分析工作者提供什么
MathGPT.now 是一个基于浏览器的工具，它接受输入或拍照的数学问题并返回分步解决方案。其公开材料描述了一个将问题、方法、工作、答案和验证分开的结构。验证步骤是专业用途的关键：它可以包括替换、单元检查、域检查或通过替代方法求解。该工具还包括图形计算器、科学计算器以及练习题和公式参考库。基本使用无需注册，但付费套餐（每月 9.99 美元或通过学生电子邮件按年计费 4.99 美元）消除了使用限制。对于工作场所设置，免费套餐足以满足偶尔的验证任务，但大量用户应该意识到潜在的限制 - 该网站没有公开指定确切的免费套餐限制。

## 绘图作为操作中的目视检查
考虑香港仓库的一位运营分析师，他将拣货时间建模为订单大小的函数。假设模型为 _y = 0.4x + sin(x)_，其中 _x_ 是项目数，_y_ 是分钟。在 _x = 1.74_ 时，导数 _f'(x) = 0.91_ 表示曲线正在增加。经理可以将此函数输入 MathGPT.now 的图形计算器，并目视检查该点周围的斜率是否与声称的速率相符。该工具绘制曲线并可以显示交叉点和变化。这不是证明，而是一种快速的合理性检查：如果图表显示模型预测上升的情况下急剧下降，则说明有问题。协议很简单：输入函数，记下相关域的形状，然后与您自己的期望进行比较。如果视觉效果与您的计算相矛盾，请重新检查两者。

## 金融建模中的矩阵运算

香港的财务团队经常使用矩阵来衡量投资组合风险或多货币风险。例如，一个简单的二资产协方差矩阵可用于计算投资组合方差。 MathGPT.now 的线性代数主题涵盖向量、矩阵、变换、特征值和系统。工作人员可以输入矩阵乘法或求逆问题并收到逐步解决方案。要将其用作检查，请勿仅依赖最终数字。相反，请逐行遵循工作：验证

Artificial Intelligence
Workers and managers in Hong Kong can use MathGPT.now to verify analytical work through graphing, matrix operations, and second-method checks. This article provides a practical protocol for applying domain, units, substitution, and graph-based verification in operations and finance contexts.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

26 Oct 2026 at 09:00 HKT · 6 min read

When you are responsible for a spreadsheet that determines a team’s bonus or a budget line that runs through the quarter, a single arithmetic slip can cascade into a costly decision. Analytical workers in Hong Kong—whether in operations, finance, or logistics—routinely handle graphs, matrices, and multi-step calculations. The question is not whether to use an AI math tool, but how to use one as a rigorous second check without outsourcing judgment. MathGPT.now, a free AI math solver, offers a structured way to verify work, but only if you apply the same discipline you would to a colleague’s review.

## What MathGPT.now offers the analytical worker

MathGPT.now is a browser-based tool that accepts typed or photographed math questions and returns a step-by-step solution. Its public materials describe a structure that separates the problem, method, working, answer, and verification. The verification step is the key for professional use: it can include substitution, unit checks, domain checks, or solving by an alternative method. The tool also includes a graphing calculator, a scientific calculator, and a library of practice questions and formula references. No signup is required for basic use, though a paid tier ($9.99/month or $4.99/month billed yearly with a student email) removes usage limits. For a workplace setting, the free tier is sufficient for occasional verification tasks, but heavy users should be aware of potential throttling—the site does not publicly specify exact free-tier limits.

## Graphing as a visual check in operations

Consider an operations analyst in a Hong Kong warehouse who models picking time as a function of order size. Suppose the model is _y = 0.4x + sin(x)_, where _x_ is the number of items and _y_ is minutes. At _x = 1.74_, the derivative _f'(x) = 0.91_ indicates the curve is increasing. A manager can enter this function into MathGPT.now’s graphing calculator and visually inspect whether the slope around that point matches the claimed rate. The tool plots the curve and can show intersections and change. This is not a proof, but it is a rapid plausibility check: if the graph shows a steep drop where the model predicts a rise, something is wrong. The protocol is simple: input the function, note the shape at the relevant domain, and compare with your own expectation. If the visual contradicts your calculation, re-examine both.

## Matrix operations in financial modelling

Finance teams in Hong Kong often use matrices for portfolio risk or multi-currency exposure. For example, a simple two-asset covariance matrix might be used to compute portfolio variance. MathGPT.now’s linear algebra topic coverage includes vectors, matrices, transformations, eigenvalues, and systems. A worker can type a matrix multiplication or inversion problem and receive a step-by-step solution. To use this as a check, do not rely on the final number alone. Instead, follow the working line by line: verify that the dimensions align, that each arithmetic step is correct, and that the final matrix has the expected shape. If the tool returns a 2x2 matrix where you expected 3x3, the error is likely in your input, not the tool. The public information does not specify whether MathGPT.now handles symbolic matrix entries or only numeric ones; a hands-on test would clarify this limitation.

## Domain, units, and substitution checks

MathGPT.now’s verification step explicitly includes checking the result by substitution, units, domain, or another method. For a Hong Kong logistics example: if you calculate the fuel cost for a delivery route as _cost = distance × rate_, and the answer is 500, ask: 500 what? The tool can check that units are consistent. If distance is in kilometres and rate is in dollars per litre, but fuel efficiency is missing, the number is meaningless. The domain check is equally important: if your model predicts a negative time for a positive input, the result is invalid. A worker can input the original equation and the proposed answer, and ask MathGPT.now to substitute and verify. The tool will show whether the left side equals the right side. This is a mechanical check, not a conceptual one, but it catches transcription errors and miskeyed numbers.

## Second-method checks: not a guarantee

The most powerful feature for professional use is the ability to solve the same problem by a different method. MathGPT.now’s interface allows you to ask for an alternative approach—for instance, solving a system of equations by substitution after you used elimination. If both methods yield the same answer, confidence increases. But this is not a guarantee. The tool may use the same underlying engine for both methods, meaning a systematic error could replicate. The UNESCO Guidance for generative AI in education and research (2023) warns that generative AI tools can produce plausible but incorrect outputs, and that human oversight remains essential. The OECD AI Principles (2019, updated 2024) emphasise transparency and accountability: you, the user, are accountable for the final decision. A second-method check in MathGPT.now is a useful cross-check, but it does not replace domain expertise or a manual sanity test.

## Privacy and security considerations for Hong Kong users

When you type or photograph a problem, the data is sent to MathGPT.now’s servers. The site states that payments are processed by Stripe and that progress stays in your browser, but it does not publicly specify data retention policies for problem inputs. For sensitive financial models or proprietary operational data, avoid entering actual numbers. Instead, anonymise the problem: change the values but keep the structure. For example, if your real covariance matrix contains confidential return data, replace the numbers with simple integers that preserve the mathematical relationship. The NIST AI Risk Management Framework resources (2023) recommend that organisations map risks related to data privacy and transparency. Hong Kong’s Personal Data Privacy Ordinance (PDPO) applies if any personal data is involved. For most analytical work, the risk is low if you use generic inputs, but be aware that the tool is not designed for confidential data.

## Practical checklist for using MathGPT.now at work

*   **Define the problem clearly** — Write down the equation or matrix exactly as you intend to check it.
*   **Run the tool once** — Input the problem and note the step-by-step working, not just the final answer.
*   **Verify units and domain** — Check that the answer has the right dimension and falls within a plausible range.
*   **Perform a substitution check** — Plug the answer back into the original equation manually or via the tool.
*   **Try a second method** — Ask MathGPT.now to solve using a different approach and compare results.
*   **Graph the function** — For any single-variable model, plot it and confirm the shape matches your expectation.
*   **Anonymise sensitive data** — Replace real numbers with structurally equivalent placeholders before input.
*   **Document the check** — Save or screenshot the steps as part of your audit trail.
*   **Apply human review** — Do not accept any output that contradicts your own understanding of the problem.

MathGPT.now is a free, accessible tool that can strengthen your analytical workflow when used with discipline. It does not replace judgment, but it can catch mistakes that a tired eye might miss. For Hong Kong workers juggling spreadsheets, models, and deadlines, that is a practical advantage.

**Help for Bhujung Tamang**

Dominic and Kayla are raising funds for Bhujung Tamang, a friend they met while traveling in Nepal before/after the Langtang trek. During that trip, Dominic and Kayla stayed with Bhujung for a few days in his village of Syabru Besi. Bhujung welcomed them with kindness and gave them a truly special local experience they have never forgotten. Now, after a devastating flood destroyed Syabru Besi, Bhujung is facing an unimaginable loss. His home and hotel were destroyed, many of his friends were killed or are missing, and he lost all of his possessions in the disaster. It is estimated that Syabru Besi still has 1300 people missing.

Dominic and Kayla met Bhujung by chance while starting their 7 day hike up the Langtang Valley, one of Nepal's premier hiking destinations. They were looking for a place to stay and found the only hotel in the Old Village of Syabru Besi. Upon getting to know Bhujung, Dominic and Kayla discovered that they were the first guests Bhujung had had in almost 3 years because he was taking care of his late mother's declining health. As a token of gratitude and friendship, Bhujung gifted Dominic and Kayla a hand stitched bag his mother made pictured above.

This fundraiser is meant to provide direct relief to Bhujung as he begins the long process of recovering and rebuilding after this tragedy. The money raised will go directly to him to help support his immediate needs (food, housing, etc.) and give him a foundation to move forward after losing so much. Dominic and Kayla are asking for donations of any amount to help Bhujung through this heartbreaking time. If you are able to give, thank you for showing compassion and support to someone who once showed such generosity to travelers far from home. Please consider donating and sharing this fundraiser to help Bhujung rebuild his life.

Please Help Flood Victims at the Nepal–Tibet Border

Severe flooding has left families across the Nepal–Tibet border region without homes, food, clean water, and essential medical care. Their needs are urgent, and your support can provide immediate relief, comfort, and hope.

The Indian Association of Sacramento (IAS) based in Sacramento , California, USA has a long-standing commitment to helping families in need. We have supported more than 40 charitable causes and raised over $250,000 for those facing hardship. We have also responded to natural disasters, including supporting victims of the 2025 Nepal earthquake.

Today, we ask you to stand with flood-affected families. Please give what you can—every contribution matters, and even a small donation can help provide vital supplies and support.

Together, we can bring relief to families who have lost so much.
