zh_title: CNO Caudle 近距离观察美国海军最新的高超音速导弹
summary: 10 月 28 日，美国海军作战部长达里尔·考德尔上将在访问马里兰州帕图森特河海军航空站时，近距离观察了美国海军的新型“黑胡子”空射高超音速导弹，让人们难得一睹美国海军为其舰载战斗机群开发新型远程打击能力的努力。据美国海军发布的新闻稿称，考德尔参观了第 23 空中测试和评估中队 (VX)，那里的工作人员向海军高级军官介绍了黑胡子导弹的情况，该导弹最近在该设施的一架 F/A-18E/F 超级大黄蜂上进行了飞行测试。
content:
10 月 28 日，美国海军作战部长达里尔·考德尔上将在访问马里兰州帕图森特河海军航空站时，近距离观察了美国海军的新型“黑胡子”空射高超音速导弹，让人们难得一睹美国海军为其舰载战斗机群开发新型远程打击能力的努力。据美国海军 11 月 2 日发布的新闻稿称，考德尔参观了第 23 空中测试和评估中队 (VX)，那里的人员向海军高级军官介绍了黑胡子导弹的情况，该导弹最近在 F/A-18E/F 超级大黄蜂上进行了飞行测试。这种高超音速武器首次公开了其名称的暗示，侧面显示为“AHM-XXX”。唯一已知的具有“AHM”名称的武器是美国空军的超燃冲压发动机驱动的高超音速攻击巡航导弹，计划在本世纪末之前进入有限服役。命名系统中新添加了“H”名称，用于识别三军用高超音速导弹。值得注意的是，助推滑翔 AGM-183 空射快速反应武器没有“H”名称。这次访问标志着海军对“黑胡子”的最新公开认可之一，“黑胡子”是一种新型空射武器，旨在扩大海军的远程打击能力，为针对日益复杂的敌方防空系统的潜在行动做好准备。
Blackbeard 平台被其制造商 Castelion 吹捧为一种低成本高超音速打击武器，专为快速部署和制造而设计。 装备 Blackbeard 的 F/A-18 超级大黄蜂（美国海军视频截图） 美国海军在公告中没有透露有关该导弹性能、飞行测试目标或开发时间表的更多细节。考德尔此次访问正值海军寻求现代化其舰载机联队，配备远程武器和能够远距离作战的无人飞机，特别是在印度-太平洋地区，中国不断扩大的远程导弹武库和先进的防空系统对传统的航母作战构成了重大挑战。美国海军和空军高级官员强调，隐身性、航程和防区外能力是未来空战的定义要素——黑胡子可以为第四代非隐身超级大黄蜂机队提供这些能力。 “Blackbeard 由 Castelion 开发，由组合采办执行航空 (PAE(A)) 通过其未来能力开发和集成 (FCD&I) 航空快速能力小组领导，并与海军空战中心和国防部快速能力办公室协调，将为舰载攻击战斗机提供快速响应的高速打击选项，以刺穿有争议的反介入/区域拒止 (A2/AD) 范围，同时显着扩大战区弹匣容量深度。”我们。
海军 该导弹是海军扩大舰载战斗机远程打击能力的更广泛努力的一部分，特别是当海军正在为针对印度-太平洋地区（特别是中国）日益复杂的防空系统的潜在行动做准备时。“黑胡子”提供的防区外打击能力将为“超级大黄蜂”提供打击由远程导弹和高端第五代战斗机防御的目标的战斗机会，并与美国正在开发的一套额外的低成本弹药相结合。陆军、美国海军陆战队和美国空军。在海军服役时，黑胡子

【原文 English Original】
Chief of Naval Operations Adm. Daryl Caudle got an up-close look at the U.S. Navy’s new Blackbeard air-launched hypersonic missile during a visit to Naval Air Station Patuxent River, Maryland, on Oct. 28, offering a rare glimpse into the service’s efforts to develop new long-range strike capabilities for its carrier-based fighter fleet. Caudle toured Air Test and Evaluation Squadron (VX) 23, where personnel briefed the Navy’s top officer on the Blackbeard missile, which was recently flight-tested aboard an F/A-18E/F Super Hornet at the installation, according to a U.S. Navy news release published Nov. 2. The hypersonic weapon touted its first hints at a designation, seen on the side as “AHM-XXX”. The only other weapon known to have an “AHM” designation is the U.S. Air Force’s scramjet-powered Hypersonic Attack Cruise Missile, intended to enter limited service before the end of the decade. The “H” designation was newly added to the nomenclature system to identify tri-service hypersonic missiles. Notably, the boost-glide AGM-183 Air-Launched Rapid Response Weapon does not feature an “H” designation. The visit marks one of the Navy’s latest public acknowledgments of Blackbeard, a new air-launched weapon intended to expand the service’s long-range strike capabilities as it prepares for potential operations against increasingly sophisticated adversary air defenses. The Blackbeard platform is touted by its builder, Castelion, as a low-cost hypersonic strike weapon designed for rapid fielding and manufacturing. F/A-18 Super Hornet armed with Blackbeard (Screenshot from US Navy video) The Navy did not disclose additional details about the missile’s performance, flight-test objectives or development timeline in its announcement. Caudle’s visit comes as the Navy seeks to modernize its carrier air wings with longer-range weapons and uncrewed aircraft capable of operating across vast distances, particularly in the Indo-Pacific, where China’s expanding arsenal of long-range missiles and sophisticated air defenses poses significant challenges to traditional carrier operations. Top service officials in the U.S. Navy and U.S. Air Force have stressed stealth, range, and standoff capability as defining elements of future air warfare — which Blackbeard can provide to the fourth-generation, non-stealth Super Hornet fleet. “Developed by Castelion and led by the Portfolio Acquisition Executive Aviation (PAE(A)) through its Future Capability Development and Integration (FCD&I) Aviation Rapid Capabilities Cell, in coordination with the Naval Air Warfare Centers and the DON Rapid Capabilities Office, Blackbeard will provide carrier-based strike fighters with a responsive, high-speed strike option to pierce contested anti-access/area-denial (A2/AD) envelopes while significantly expanding theater magazine depth.” U.S. Navy The missile is part of a broader effort to expand the Navy’s long-range strike capabilities aboard its carrier-based fighter fleet, particularly as the service prepares for potential operations against increasingly sophisticated air defense systems fielded by in the Indo-Pacific, particularly China. The standoff strike capability delivered by Blackbeard would give Super Hornets a fighting chance at engaging targets defended by long-range missiles and high-end fifth-generation fighters, mixing into a suite of additional low-cost munitions under development for the U.S. Army, U.S. Marine Corps, and U.S. Air Force. In Navy service, the Blackbeard joins a growing family of advanced weapons under development or in-production including the air-to-air AIM-174B, AIM-260A and AIM-424A, as well as anti-ship programs that include the Family of Affordable Mass Munition, Extended Range Attack Munition, JDAM-LR, and Coalition Heterogeneous Affordable Offensive Strike efforts. Zone 5’s Rusty Dagger is one of the two primary acquisitions for PAE Fires in its CHAOS missile program. (Zone 5 Photo) Separately, the Navy is developing the Conventional Prompt Strike (CPS) hypersonic missile for deployment aboard surface combatants and submarines. Unlike Blackbeard, CPS is a much larger weapon intended to provide the fleet with a conventional long-range prompt strike capability against high-value targets. The lines of effort, from high-end to low-end, represent a rearranging service-wide initiative looking to bring affordability and producibility to advanced weapons. After the U.S. Navy’s Hypersonic Air Launched Offensive missile was put on hold last April , the service turned to more affordable, accessible platforms designed for rapid fielding. 失事的是一架里爾60型噴射機（Learjet 60），從美國德州奧斯汀（Austin）起飛，原定飛往島國巴哈馬，卻墜毀於佛州棕櫚灘郡（Palm Beach County）一處住宅區附近。
美聯社報導，美國國家運輸安全委員會（National Transportation Safety Board）委員柴普曼（Tom Chapman）於記者會說道，這架噴射機似乎在撞擊地面之前就已開始解體。
柴普曼指出：「我們確實掌握一些跡象，顯示飛機在撞擊之前就開始解體。」
他還提及：「我們可能會在實際撞擊地點相隔一段距離的地方，找到飛機部分零件。」
相關當局尚未公布罹難者姓名，棕櫚灘郡警方拒絕談論這起空難事故的調查，但透露調查仍處於初步階段。

SpaceX reportedly wants to buy Boost Mobile to compete with AT&T, T-Mobile, and Verizon
8:44 AM PST · November 2, 2026
SpaceX is looking to buy Boost Mobile from EchoStar, according to a report from The Washington Post. If the deal goes through, it would help the Elon Musk-owned company build a hybrid cellular-satellite network that could help catapult it into fourth place among the top U.S. wireless providers.
The space-launch company has been dabbling in cellular connectivity, rolling out satellite access to T-Mobile’s subscribers in 2024. Last year, SpaceX bought $17 billion worth of wireless spectrum from EchoStar for cellular services, which could help the company’s Starlink service reach inside buildings, for example, something it currently struggles with.
“This is the last critical piece of the spectrum puzzle needed for SpaceX to provide complete phone coverage in America,” Musk said on X at the time of the spectrum acquisition. Yet, if Musk is still looking to buy access to terrestrial networks, it apparently wasn’t the last piece.
Elon Musk, SpaceX’s CEO, reportedly spoke directly with EchoStar chairman Charlie Ergen in October about acquiring Boost Mobile, the mobile virtual network operator. EchoStar has about 7.5 million customers between Boost Mobile and Gen Mobile, its other mobile service offering.
Musk has also approached AT&T, T-Mobile, and Verizon about buying capacity on their networks. All three rejected Musk, and they may still have a say in a SpaceX acquisition of Boost Mobile. Boost doesn’t operate its own towers, instead leasing capacity from AT&T and T-Mobile, which might need to approve such a deal. Sources speaking to The Post said that network leases are usually nontransferable.
The big three providers each have over 100 million subscribers, dwarfing Boost Mobile. But while the acquisition would give SpaceX an immediate bump in subscribers, the true value of the deal would be giving the company access to terrestrial cellular networks.
Gaining access to towers leased to Boost Mobile would expand coverage significantly — Boost currently covers most of the 48 contiguous states in the U.S. — allowing Starlink to cover devices when they’re outdoors and relying on cell towers to handle devices when Starlink signals can’t reach them.

Ninja’s first-ever microwave just replaced two of my kitchen appliances at once
6:42 AM PST · November 2, 2026
I never thought I’d get excited about replacing my microwave, but the Ninja Crispi Microwave and Air Fryer has made a pretty convincing case for ditching two appliances and making room for one. Combining a microwave with a built-in air fryer, it’s designed to speed up everyday cooking, give leftovers their crunch back and, perhaps best of all, free up some valuable kitchen counter space.
Priced at $449.99, it’s certainly not a budget-friendly microwave. But this is no ordinary machine for heating leftover soup. Ninja has paired a 1,000W microwave with a 1,700W air fryer system, powered by its FusionCrisp technology, which combines the speed of microwave cooking with the golden, crispy results you’d typically expect from an air fryer.
Think leftover pizza, chicken tenders, fries, and all those foods that tend to turn sad and soggy in a traditional microwave. Instead, the idea is to get food that’s piping hot and juicy on the inside, with a deliciously crisp, golden finish on the outside. In other words, no more choosing between speed and texture.
Of course, microwave and air fryer combinations aren’t entirely new. Brands such as Smeg have already explored the concept, while plenty of modern microwaves come with a range of additional cooking functions.
What makes the Ninja Crispi Microwave particularly interesting, however, is its FusionCrisp technology, which is designed to bring both cooking methods together rather than simply offering two separate functions. It comes with a 5.5-quart glass cooking dish and a nonstick crisper plate, which sits on top when you want to air fry and crisp up your food.
Another part that makes it stand out is that there isn’t a rotating plate inside, opening up a lot more space to cook more dishes at once.
It’s not just about reheating leftovers. For example, if you want to make a pasta bake, the microwave can cook the pasta, while the air fryer crisps up the cheese on top.
There’s one thing to consider before buying it, though. Measuring 20.3 x 17.56 x 14.1 inches, the microwave is hardly compact. It takes up a fair amount of counter space, so while it could free up room if you’re replacing a separate microwave and air fryer, it’s not necessarily the ideal solution for a small apartment kitchen.
Then there’s the $449.99 price tag. That’s a considerable amount to spend on a microwave, particularly when a basic model can handle everyday reheating for a fraction of the cost. But if you’re someone who regularly reaches for both a microwave and an air fryer, the combination could make a lot more sense.

content:
日媒报道称，中国大陆科考船数月来在台湾附近海域异常活动，航迹与海底电缆重叠。图为今年4月20日，“同济”号在南中国海执行春季航次任务。 （新华社）
（东京/北京综合讯）日媒报道称，中国大陆科考船数月来在台湾附近海域异常活动，航迹与海底电缆重叠，可能是为台海紧张局势下可能出现的突发事件做准备。
《读卖新闻》星期天（11月1日）引述地理空间情报分析公司ingeniSPACE称，今年5月以来，四艘大陆科考船在台湾附近特定海域多次出现异常活动，包括隶属于大陆自然资源部的“向阳红22”号、上海和福建高校运行的“同济”号和“嘉庚”号，以及一艘在船舶自动识别系统（AIS）中显示为“MUSHANZI”的船只。
数据显示，向阳红22号多次在台湾北部特定海域航行，期间出现减速、停船和不规则变向等行为；嘉庚号在东部海域、MUSHANZI号在南部巴士海峡也出现类似行为；同济号则多次绕台湾本岛航行，并在多个特定地点停船或减速。
ingeniSPACE透过AIS等数据分析发现，这些船舶减速或停船的区域，均与连接台湾及其他海外地区的海底电缆铺设区域重叠，认为大陆船只正在大范围区域内收集海底光缆信息。
《读卖新闻》引述一名台湾官员称，ingeniSPACE的数据和分析与台湾当局了解的情况相符。
日本九州大学教授益尾知佐子分析，大陆船只似乎在为可能出现的台湾冲突或陆美争端做准备。她认为，北京在必要情形下，可能会切断太平洋沿岸海底电缆，以扰乱日本社会并阻碍日美间通讯。
ingeniSPACE首席运营官杰森·王（音译，Jason Wang）则指出，类似行动也在日本和菲律宾附近海域出现，“中方正为第一岛链沿线大片区域可能发生的突发事件做准备，以应对灰色地带的行动”。
针对上述报道，《环球时报》前总编辑胡锡进星期天在微博发文称，台湾海域地处东亚—太平洋数据走廊的关键节点，其周边海缆共24条，包括14条国际线路，连接着日本、美国、新加坡、菲律宾等国，“这些海缆一旦同时断掉或大部分同时断掉，对台湾的影响肯定是‘瘫痪’级的”。
胡锡进说，美日掌握的所有水文资料、海底地形情况以及其他相关信息，中国大陆都应该掌握，“至于我们要用那些资料做什么，我认为它们的作用应该是全面的，其中当然包括支持我们的国防”。

路透社報導，美國司法部提出緊急聲請，尋求在逐一查證選民的公民身分前暫停計算這些有爭議的選票，這場法律戰可能影響數以千計選民。
川普所屬的共和黨正力拚在11月3日期中選舉中保住國會控制權。加州是美國人口最多的州，也是民主黨票倉。川普政府在期中選舉前加強關注所謂非公民投票問題。
司法部在向最高法院提出的聲請文件中表示：「一旦加州將遭質疑的選票與合法選票混在一起，就無法再將遭質疑的選票區分出來。」
川普政府請求最高法院下令加州將名單上人員所投的選票與其他選票分開，在確認這些選民具有美國公民身分前不得計票。司法部今天敦促最高法院迅速採取行動，在大法官正式裁定司法部的聲請前先下令暫時擱置這些選票。（編譯：盧映孜）1151103
